definition: (fig.) label; CL:頂|顶[ding3]; bad name; cap; hat

exampleEnglish: The sun is strong; you should wear a hat.
hintSimplified: 戴在头上，可以挡太阳。
hintTraditional: 戴在頭上，可以擋太陽。
hintEnglish: Worn on the head to block the sun.

exampleSimplified: 她的皮包很漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 她的皮包很漂亮。
exampleEnglish: Her leather handbag is very pretty.
hintSimplified: 用皮做的，出门时用来放东西。
hintTraditional: 用皮做的，出門時用來放東西。

exampleSimplified: 外面冷，穿外套吧。
exampleTraditional: 外面冷，穿外套吧。
exampleEnglish: It's cold outside; wear a jacket.
hintSimplified: 穿在衣服外面，保暖用。
hintTraditional: 穿在衣服外面，保暖用。
hintEnglish: Worn over your clothes to keep warm.

definition: to be careful; to take care
exampleSimplified: 路很滑，请小心。
exampleTraditional: 路很滑，請小心。
exampleEnglish: The road is slippery; please be careful.
hintSimplified: 做事很注意，避免出事。
hintTraditional: 做事很注意，避免出事。
hintEnglish: Paying attention to avoid accidents.

definition: comparatively; comparison; quite; relatively; to compare; to contrast
exampleSimplified: 这个比较便宜。
exampleTraditional: 這個比較便宜。
exampleEnglish: This one is comparatively cheaper.
hintSimplified: 和别的东西比，程度更高一点。
hintTraditional: 和別的東西比，程度更高一點。
hintEnglish: A bit higher in degree when compared with another.

exampleSimplified: 他今天的样子很累。
exampleTraditional: 他今天的樣子很累。
exampleEnglish: He looks tired today.
hintSimplified: 一个人或东西看起来的外表。
hintTraditional: 一個人或東西看起來的外表。
hintEnglish: How a person or thing appears from the outside.

definition: (often followed by 是[shi4]) in particular; expressly; for a specific purpose; unusual; special; very; especially; particularly
exampleSimplified: 这家店的茶特别好喝。
exampleTraditional: 這家店的茶特別好喝。
exampleEnglish: The tea at this shop is especially good.
hintSimplified: 不是普通的，很不一样。
hintTraditional: 不是普通的，很不一樣。
hintEnglish: Not ordinary, very different.

exampleSimplified: 这个问题很简单。
exampleTraditional: 這個問題很簡單。
exampleEnglish: This question is very simple.
hintSimplified: 不复杂，一看就懂。
hintTraditional: 不複雜，一看就懂。
hintEnglish: Not complicated, understood at a glance.

definition: (sth or sb) else; other; the rest
exampleSimplified: 其他人都回家了。
exampleTraditional: 其他人都回家了。
exampleEnglish: Everyone else went home.
hintSimplified: 除了刚才说的以外，别的。
hintTraditional: 除了剛才說的以外，別的。
hintEnglish: Besides what was just mentioned, the rest.

exampleSimplified: 我还有其它问题。
exampleTraditional: 我還有其它問題。
exampleEnglish: I have other questions as well.
hintSimplified: 说到别的东西时用，不用于人。
hintTraditional: 說到別的東西時用，不用於人。
hintEnglish: Used for other things, not for people.

exampleSimplified: 我听到一个奇怪的声音。
exampleTraditional: 我聽到一個奇怪的聲音。
exampleEnglish: I heard a strange sound.
hintSimplified: 耳朵听到的东西。
hintTraditional: 耳朵聽到的東西。
hintEnglish: What the ears hear.

exampleSimplified: 他好像生病了。
exampleTraditional: 他好像生病了。
exampleEnglish: He seems to be sick.
hintSimplified: 不太确定，看起来是这样。
hintTraditional: 不太確定，看起來是這樣。
hintEnglish: Not quite sure, but it appears that way.

definition: odd; strange; to be baffled; to marvel
exampleSimplified: 这件事很奇怪。
exampleTraditional: 這件事很奇怪。
exampleEnglish: This matter is very strange.
hintSimplified: 和平常不一样，让人觉得不懂。
hintTraditional: 和平常不一樣，讓人覺得不懂。
hintEnglish: Different from usual, leaving you puzzled.

exampleSimplified: 我午餐吃了一个汉堡。
exampleTraditional: 我午餐吃了一個漢堡。
exampleEnglish: I had a hamburger for lunch.
hintSimplified: 两片面包中间夹着肉和菜。
hintTraditional: 兩片面包中間夾著肉和菜。
hintEnglish: Meat and vegetables sandwiched between two buns.

definition: Apple (American tech company); CL:個|个[ge4],顆|颗[ke1]; apple
exampleSimplified: 她每天吃一个苹果。
exampleTraditional: 她每天吃一個蘋果。
exampleEnglish: She eats an apple every day.
hintSimplified: 圆圆的红色或绿色水果，也是一家手机公司的名字。
hintTraditional: 圓圓的紅色或綠色水果，也是一家手機公司的名字。
hintEnglish: A round red or green fruit, also the name of a phone company.

exampleSimplified: 夏天吃西瓜很舒服。
exampleTraditional: 夏天吃西瓜很舒服。
exampleEnglish: Eating watermelon in summer is refreshing.
hintSimplified: 外面绿色，里面红红的大水果。
hintTraditional: 外面綠色，裡面紅紅的大水果。
hintEnglish: A big fruit that's green outside and red inside.

exampleSimplified: 他喝了一杯啤酒。
exampleTraditional: 他喝了一杯啤酒。
exampleEnglish: He drank a glass of beer.
hintSimplified: 金黄色，有泡泡，成年人喝的酒。
hintTraditional: 金黃色，有泡泡，成年人喝的酒。
hintEnglish: A golden, foamy alcoholic drink for adults.

exampleSimplified: 我早上喝红茶。
exampleTraditional: 我早上喝紅茶。
exampleEnglish: I drink black tea in the morning.
hintSimplified: 茶叶发酵过，泡出来的茶是红褐色。
hintTraditional: 茶葉發酵過，泡出來的茶是紅褐色。
hintEnglish: Fermented tea leaves brew into a reddish-brown drink.

definition: dessert; dim sum (in Cantonese cooking); light refreshments; pastry
exampleSimplified: 下午我们吃点心。
exampleTraditional: 下午我們吃點心。
exampleEnglish: In the afternoon we have snacks.
hintSimplified: 正餐之外，吃的小甜食。
hintTraditional: 正餐之外，吃的小甜食。
hintEnglish: Little sweets eaten outside main meals.

exampleSimplified: 吃青菜对身体好。
exampleTraditional: 吃青菜對身體好。
exampleEnglish: Eating vegetables is good for the body.
hintSimplified: 绿色叶子的蔬菜。
hintTraditional: 綠色葉子的蔬菜。
hintEnglish: Vegetables with green leaves.

exampleSimplified: 请给我一把叉子。
exampleTraditional: 請給我一把叉子。
exampleEnglish: Please give me a fork.
hintSimplified: 西餐里用来叉食物。
hintTraditional: 西餐裡用來叉食物。
hintEnglish: Used in Western meals to spear food.

exampleSimplified: 这把刀子很快。
exampleTraditional: 這把刀子很快。
exampleEnglish: This knife is very sharp.
hintSimplified: 切东西用，要小心拿。
hintTraditional: 切東西用，要小心拿。
hintEnglish: Used to cut things and must be handled carefully.

exampleSimplified: 请用汤匙喝汤。
exampleTraditional: 請用湯匙喝湯。
exampleEnglish: Please use a spoon to drink the soup.
hintSimplified: 喝汤时拿的小工具。
hintTraditional: 喝湯時拿的小工具。
hintEnglish: The small tool you hold when eating soup.

exampleSimplified: 盘子里有三个饺子。
exampleTraditional: 盤子裡有三個餃子。
exampleEnglish: There are three dumplings on the plate.
hintSimplified: 圆圆扁扁的，用来装菜。
hintTraditional: 圓圓扁扁的，用來裝菜。
hintEnglish: Round and flat, used to serve food.

exampleSimplified: 瓶子里有水。
exampleTraditional: 瓶子裡有水。
exampleEnglish: There's water in the bottle.
hintSimplified: 口小肚子大，可以装水或饮料。
hintTraditional: 口小肚子大，可以裝水或飲料。
hintEnglish: A narrow mouth and a big belly; it holds water or drinks.

exampleSimplified: 我吃了一半就饱了。
exampleTraditional: 我吃了一半就飽了。
exampleEnglish: I got full after eating half.
hintSimplified: 把东西平分成两份的其中一份。
hintTraditional: 把東西平分成兩份的其中一份。
hintEnglish: One of the two equal parts of something.

definition: (dialect) smell; odor; (fig.) feeling (of ...); sense (of ...); hint (of ...); (fig.) interest; delight; flavor; taste
exampleSimplified: 这道菜的味道很好。
exampleTraditional: 這道菜的味道很好。
exampleEnglish: The flavor of this dish is very good.
hintSimplified: 舌头或鼻子感觉到的东西。
hintTraditional: 舌頭或鼻子感覺到的東西。
hintEnglish: What the tongue or nose senses.

exampleSimplified: 我全部都吃完了。
exampleTraditional: 我全部都吃完了。
exampleEnglish: I finished eating all of it.
hintSimplified: 没有一个漏掉，整个的。
hintTraditional: 沒有一個漏掉，整個的。
hintEnglish: Without missing a single bit; the whole thing.

definition: all; to have; to possess; to own
exampleSimplified: 所有的学生都来了。
exampleTraditional: 所有的學生都來了。
exampleEnglish: All the students have come.
hintSimplified: 没有例外，每一个。
hintTraditional: 沒有例外，每一個。
hintEnglish: Without exception, every single one.

definition: needs; to need; to want; to demand; to require
exampleSimplified: 我需要你的帮助。
exampleTraditional: 我需要你的幫助。
exampleEnglish: I need your help.
hintSimplified: 缺少某样东西，必须得到。
hintTraditional: 缺少某樣東西，必須得到。
hintEnglish: Lacking something and having to get it.

exampleSimplified: 我想去，但是太累了。
exampleTraditional: 我想去，但是太累了。
exampleEnglish: I want to go, but I'm too tired.
hintSimplified: 前后意思不同时用的连接词。
hintTraditional: 前後意思不同時用的連線詞。
hintEnglish: A connector used when the two parts differ in meaning.

definition: either one or the other; or
exampleSimplified: 你想喝茶或是咖啡？
exampleTraditional: 你想喝茶或是咖啡？
exampleEnglish: Would you like tea or coffee?
hintSimplified: 连接两个可以选的东西。
hintTraditional: 連線兩個可以選的東西。
hintEnglish: Links two things you could choose from.

exampleSimplified: 要是你有空，就来找我。
exampleTraditional: 要是你有空，就來找我。
exampleEnglish: If you're free, come and see me.
hintSimplified: 说“假如”的另一种口语说法。
hintTraditional: 說“假如”的另一種口語說法。
hintEnglish: Another casual way to say "suppose."

gloss: although; even though (often used correlatively with 可是[ke3 shi4] or 但是[dan4 shi4] etc)
definition: although; even though (often used correlatively with 可是[ke3 shi4] or 但是[dan4 shi4] etc)
exampleSimplified: 虽然很累，但是他还是去了。
exampleTraditional: 雖然很累，但是他還是去了。
exampleEnglish: Although he was tired, he still went.
hintSimplified: 先承认一个事实，后面意思会转折。
hintTraditional: 先承認一個事實，後面意思會轉折。
hintEnglish: First admits a fact, and then the meaning turns around.

definition: (before a number) ... or so; about ...; like that; in that way; to that extent; then; in that case; variant of 那麼|那么[na4 me5]
exampleSimplified: 你为什么那么高兴？
exampleTraditional: 你為什麼那麼高興？
exampleEnglish: Why are you so happy?
hintSimplified: 表示程度很高，指着前面说过的。
hintTraditional: 表示程度很高，指著前面說過的。
hintEnglish: Shows a high degree, pointing back at what's been said.

definition: how much?; like this; so much; this much; this way; variant of 這麼|这么[zhe4 me5]
exampleSimplified: 今天怎么这么冷？
exampleTraditional: 今天怎麼這麼冷？
exampleEnglish: Why is it so cold today?
hintSimplified: 表示程度，指着眼前的情况。
hintTraditional: 表示程度，指著眼前的情況。
hintEnglish: Shows degree, pointing at what's right in front of you.

definition: at first; it goes without saying; of course; original; originally
exampleSimplified: 我本来想去，可是下雨了。
exampleTraditional: 我本來想去，可是下雨了。
exampleEnglish: I originally wanted to go, but it rained.
hintSimplified: 一开始是这样，后来变了。
hintTraditional: 一開始是這樣，後來變了。
hintEnglish: That's how it was at the start, but later it changed.

gloss: to think; to believe (often with the implication that the belief is mistaken – unless referring to one's own current belief)
definition: to think; to believe (often with the implication that the belief is mistaken – unless referring to one's own current belief)
exampleSimplified: 我以为你不来了。
exampleTraditional: 我以為你不來了。
exampleEnglish: I thought you weren't coming.
hintSimplified: 心里想的事，结果不是真的。
hintTraditional: 心裡想的事，結果不是真的。
hintEnglish: What you thought turned out not to be true.

exampleTraditional: 有的人喜歡吃甜的。
exampleEnglish: Some people like eating sweet things.
hintSimplified: 说一部分人或东西，不是全部。
hintTraditional: 說一部分人或東西，不是全部。
hintEnglish: Talking about a portion of people or things, not all.

gloss: (after a verb) a bit; a little (indicating brief duration, or softening the tone, or suggesting giving sth a try)
definition: (after a verb) a bit; a little (indicating brief duration, or softening the tone, or suggesting giving sth a try); all at once; suddenly
exampleSimplified: 请等一下。
exampleTraditional: 請等一下。
exampleEnglish: Please wait a moment.
hintSimplified: 放在动词后面，让动作变短、变轻松。
hintTraditional: 放在動詞後面，讓動作變短、變輕鬆。
hintEnglish: Placed after a verb to make the action brief and casual.

gloss: anyway (to get back to a previous topic)
definition: anyway (to get back to a previous topic); but; cannot be more (after adjectival); however; merely; no more than; only
exampleSimplified: 这很好，不过有点贵。
exampleTraditional: 這很好，不過有點貴。
exampleEnglish: This is good, but a bit expensive.
hintSimplified: 轻轻转折，说一个小问题。
hintTraditional: 輕輕轉折，說一個小問題。
hintEnglish: A gentle turn to mention a small problem.

exampleSimplified: 我弟弟是在台北出生的。
exampleTraditional: 我弟弟是在台北出生的。
exampleEnglish: My younger brother was born in Taipei.
hintSimplified: 医院里的小宝宝第一天来到这个世界。
hintTraditional: 醫院裡的小寶寶第一天來到這個世界。
hintEnglish: A little baby arriving in the world on its very first day.

definition: different; distinct; not alike; not the same

exampleEnglish: Our ideas are different.

hintTraditional: 兩個東西不一樣。
hintEnglish: Two things that are not alike.

exampleTraditional: 請把你的住址寫在信封上。
exampleEnglish: Please write your address on the envelope.
hintSimplified: 寄信时，要写在信封上的家的位置。
hintTraditional: 寄信時，要寫在信封上的家的位置。
hintEnglish: What you write on an envelope to say where a home is.

definition: (linguistics) parent language; mother tongue; native language

exampleTraditional: 我的母語是法文。
exampleEnglish: My native language is French.
hintSimplified: 从小跟爸妈学会的第一种语言。
hintTraditional: 從小跟爸媽學會的第一種語言。
hintEnglish: The first language you learned from your parents as a child.

exampleEnglish: The clock on the wall has stopped.

hintTraditional: 掛在牆上，用來看幾點。
hintEnglish: Hung on the wall to see what time it is.

definition: (literary) to portray vividly in painting; a fax; to fax

exampleEnglish: Please fax this document to me.

hintTraditional: 辦公室裡把紙張內容經電話線送到別處的方法。
hintEnglish: A way offices send a page's content to another place over a phone line.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; day; daytime; during the day
exampleSimplified: 白天很热，晚上比较凉。

exampleEnglish: It's hot during the day and cooler at night.

hintTraditional: 太陽出來、天空明亮的那段時間。
hintEnglish: The stretch of time when the sun is up and the sky is bright.

gloss: in the middle of the night
definition: in the middle of the night; midnight

exampleTraditional: 他半夜還在寫報告。
exampleEnglish: He was still writing a report in the middle of the night.

hintTraditional: 大家都睡著了，大約是凌晨十二點以後。
hintEnglish: Everyone is asleep, around the hours after twelve o'clock.

exampleSimplified: 夜晚的星星很漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 夜晚的星星很漂亮。
exampleEnglish: The stars are beautiful at night.

hintTraditional: 太陽下山以後，天色變黑的時候。
hintEnglish: When the sky turns dark after the sun goes down.

definition: a (calendar) date; day; days of one's life

exampleTraditional: 今天是個好日子。
exampleEnglish: Today is a good day.
hintSimplified: 一天一天过，也可以指某一天。
hintTraditional: 一天一天過，也可以指某一天。
hintEnglish: Days passing one by one, or one particular day.

exampleTraditional: 春季是旅行的好時候。
exampleEnglish: Spring is a good time for traveling.
hintSimplified: 三月到五月，花开的季节。
hintTraditional: 三月到五月，花開的季節。
hintEnglish: The season from March to May when flowers bloom.

definition: before too long; not long (after); soon; soon after
exampleSimplified: 不久我们就要放假了。
exampleTraditional: 不久我們就要放假了。
exampleEnglish: We'll be on vacation before long.
hintSimplified: 再过一小段时间。
hintTraditional: 再過一小段時間。
hintEnglish: After just a short while.

definition: a moment ago; just now; just now (variant of 剛才|刚才[gang1 cai2])

exampleEnglish: He was still here a moment ago.
hintSimplified: 几分钟以前才发生的事。
hintTraditional: 幾分鐘以前才發生的事。
hintEnglish: Something that happened only a few minutes earlier.

exampleSimplified: 我每天在家吃早点。
exampleTraditional: 我每天在家吃早點。
exampleEnglish: I eat breakfast at home every day.
hintSimplified: 一天的第一餐，在上午以前吃。
hintTraditional: 一天的第一餐，在上午以前吃。
hintEnglish: The first meal of the day, eaten before the morning is over.

definition: by chance; it just so happens that; just (in time); just enough; just right; to chance to; to happen to

exampleEnglish: You came just at the right time; we're about to eat.
hintSimplified: 时间刚刚对，不早也不晚。
hintTraditional: 時間剛剛對，不早也不晚。
hintEnglish: The timing is just right, neither early nor late.

exampleSimplified: 她的年纪比我大。
exampleTraditional: 她的年紀比我大。
exampleEnglish: She's older than me.
hintSimplified: 一个人活了多少岁。
hintTraditional: 一個人活了多少歲。
hintEnglish: How many years a person has lived.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; a male; a man; men
exampleSimplified: 那个男人在等公车。
exampleTraditional: 那個男人在等公車。
exampleEnglish: That man is waiting for the bus.
hintSimplified: 成年的男性。
hintTraditional: 成年的男性。
hintEnglish: An adult of the male sex.

exampleSimplified: 这个女人是我的老师。

exampleEnglish: This woman is my teacher.
hintSimplified: 成年的女性。
hintTraditional: 成年的女性。
hintEnglish: An adult of the female sex.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; also pr. [fu4 qin5]; father

hintTraditional: 比較正式地稱呼媽媽。
hintEnglish: A more formal way to refer to mom.

hintSimplified: 爸爸和妈妈两个人。
hintTraditional: 爸爸和媽媽兩個人。

definition: (of sb) to express; to state; to show; (of sth) to indicate; to signify; to show; expression; manifestation
exampleSimplified: 老师表示下星期会考试。
exampleTraditional: 老師表示下星期會考試。
exampleEnglish: The teacher said there will be an exam next week.
hintSimplified: 用话或动作把自己的意见或态度说明出来。
hintTraditional: 用話或動作把自己的意見或態度說明出來。
hintEnglish: To make your opinion or attitude known through words or actions.

definition: behavior; display; expression; manifestation; performance (at work etc); show; to display; to manifest; to show; to show off
exampleSimplified: 他今天在比赛中的表现非常好。
exampleTraditional: 他今天在比賽中的表現非常好。
exampleEnglish: His performance in today's competition was very good.
hintSimplified: 一个人在工作、考试或比赛中做得怎么样。
hintTraditional: 一個人在工作、考試或比賽中做得怎麼樣。
hintEnglish: How well a person does at work, in a test or in a competition.

definition: CL:場|场[chang3]; exhibition; performance; play; show; to act; to demonstrate; to perform
exampleSimplified: 今晚的表演八点开始。
exampleTraditional: 今晚的表演八點開始。
exampleEnglish: Tonight's performance starts at eight o'clock.
hintSimplified: 歌手、演员或舞者在台上给观众看的节目。
hintTraditional: 歌手、演員或舞者在臺上給觀眾看的節目。
hintEnglish: A show that singers, actors or dancers present on stage to an audience.

definition: after all; all in all; in the final analysis; when all is said and done
exampleSimplified: 他毕竟还是个孩子,别骂他了。
exampleTraditional: 他畢竟還是個孩子,別罵他了。
exampleEnglish: He is a child after all, so don't scold him.
hintSimplified: 副词,用来强调最后的事实或原因,常带有“要记住”的意思。
hintTraditional: 副詞,用來強調最後的事實或原因,常帶有“要記住”的意思。
hintEnglish: An adverb that stresses the final fact or reason, as in “remember this”.

definition: to avert; to avoid; to prevent; to refrain from
exampleSimplified: 开车要小心,才能避免发生意外。
exampleTraditional: 開車要小心,才能避免發生意外。
exampleEnglish: Drive carefully so that you can avoid accidents.
hintSimplified: 想办法不让不好的事情发生。
hintTraditional: 想辦法不讓不好的事情發生。
hintEnglish: To find ways to keep bad things from happening.

gloss: for example; for instance; such as
definition: for example; for instance; such as; see 比如縣|比如县[Bi3 ru2 Xian4]
exampleSimplified: 我喜欢水果,比如苹果和香蕉。
exampleTraditional: 我喜歡水果,比如蘋果和香蕉。
exampleEnglish: I like fruit, for example apples and bananas.
hintSimplified: 放在句子中,用来引出一个例子。
hintTraditional: 放在句子中,用來引出一個例子。
hintEnglish: Used in a sentence to introduce an example.

exampleSimplified: 没有必要为这种小事生气。
exampleTraditional: 沒有必要為這種小事生氣。
exampleEnglish: There is no need to get angry over such a small matter.
hintSimplified: 一定需要的,不能没有的。
hintTraditional: 一定需要的,不能沒有的。
hintEnglish: Something that is definitely needed and cannot be left out.

definition: (old) court academician; (old) person specialized in a skill or trade; doctor (as an academic degree)
exampleSimplified: 他在美国拿到了博士学位。
exampleTraditional: 他在美國拿到了博士學位。
exampleEnglish: He earned his doctorate in the United States.
hintSimplified: 大学里最高的学位,或拥有这个学位的人。
hintTraditional: 大學裡最高的學位,或擁有這個學位的人。
hintEnglish: The highest university degree, or a person who holds it.

definition: not to meet; not to see; to be missing; to have disappeared
exampleSimplified: 我的钥匙不见了,你看到了吗?
exampleTraditional: 我的鑰匙不見了,你看到了嗎?
exampleEnglish: My keys are gone. Have you seen them?
hintSimplified: 东西找不到了,或者人突然不在了。
hintTraditional: 東西找不到了,或者人突然不在了。
hintEnglish: Something cannot be found anymore, or a person is suddenly not there.

exampleSimplified: 他不断地练习,所以进步很快。
exampleTraditional: 他不斷地練習,所以進步很快。
exampleEnglish: He keeps practicing nonstop, so he improves quickly.
hintSimplified: 一直继续,中间没有停下来。
hintTraditional: 一直繼續,中間沒有停下來。
hintEnglish: Continuing without stopping in between.

definition: no matter what (who, how etc); not to discuss; regardless of; whatever
exampleSimplified: 不论天气好不好,我们都要出发。
exampleTraditional: 不論天氣好不好,我們都要出發。
exampleEnglish: Whether the weather is good or not, we have to set off.
hintSimplified: 连词,表示在任何情况下结果都一样。
hintTraditional: 連詞,表示在任何情況下結果都一樣。
hintEnglish: A conjunction meaning the result is the same under any circumstances.

gloss: (before a number) to be less than
definition: (before a number) to be less than; dissatisfied; discontented; resentful
exampleSimplified: 客人对服务感到很不满。
exampleTraditional: 客人對服務感到很不滿。
exampleEnglish: The customer felt very dissatisfied with the service.
hintSimplified: 觉得事情不够好,心里不高兴。
hintTraditional: 覺得事情不夠好,心裡不高興。
hintEnglish: Feeling that things are not good enough and being unhappy.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; branch; department; division; section
exampleSimplified: 他在公司的业务部门工作。
exampleTraditional: 他在公司的業務部門工作。
exampleEnglish: He works in the sales department of the company.
hintSimplified: 公司或政府里分工负责不同工作的单位。
hintTraditional: 公司或政府裡分工負責不同工作的單位。
hintEnglish: A unit in a company or government responsible for a particular type of work.

definition: it would be better to; not equal to; not as good as; inferior to
exampleSimplified: 外面太热了,不如在家看电影。
exampleTraditional: 外面太熱了,不如在家看電影。
exampleEnglish: It's too hot outside; we'd be better off watching a movie at home.
hintSimplified: 用来比较两个办法,说明另一个选择更好。
hintTraditional: 用來比較兩個辦法,說明另一個選擇更好。
hintEnglish: Used to compare two options and suggest the other one is better.

gloss: many; quite a few; a good number of
definition: many; quite a few; a good number of
exampleSimplified: 这个周末来了不少朋友。
exampleTraditional: 這個週末來了不少朋友。
exampleEnglish: Quite a few friends came this weekend.
hintSimplified: 表示数量不是很小，有相当多。
hintTraditional: 表示數量不是很小，有相當多。
hintEnglish: Indicates the amount is not small; a fair number.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; adversity; misfortune; sad; unfortunate; unfortunately
exampleSimplified: 他在这次意外中不幸受伤了。
exampleTraditional: 他在這次意外中不幸受傷了。
exampleEnglish: He was unfortunately injured in this accident.
hintSimplified: 形容运气很坏，遇到让人难过的事。
hintTraditional: 形容運氣很壞，遇到讓人難過的事。
hintEnglish: Describes bad luck, meeting with something sad.

gloss: to arrange; to set up; to lay out
definition: to arrange; to set up; to lay out; to assign (tasks, homework etc)
exampleSimplified: 我们把教室布置得很漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 我們把教室布置得很漂亮。
exampleEnglish: We decorated the classroom beautifully.
hintSimplified: 派对或活动前，把房间摆好、装饰好。
hintTraditional: 派對或活動前，把房間擺好、裝飾好。
hintEnglish: Before a party or event, you set up and decorate a room.

definition: cannot; deficiency; inadequate; insufficient; lacking; not enough; not worth; should not
exampleSimplified: 这个月的预算不足，我们要省钱。
exampleTraditional: 這個月的預算不足，我們要省錢。
exampleEnglish: This month's budget is insufficient, so we need to save money.
hintSimplified: 数量没有达到需要的程度，不够。
hintTraditional: 數量沒有達到需要的程度，不夠。
hintEnglish: The amount does not reach what is needed; not enough.

gloss: (fig.) person who has the potential to do the job
definition: (fig.) person who has the potential to do the job; (raw) material; data
exampleSimplified: 请把报告需要的材料准备好。
exampleTraditional: 請把報告需要的材料準備好。
exampleEnglish: Please prepare the materials needed for the report.
hintSimplified: 做报告或做东西时需要用到的资料或原料。
hintTraditional: 做報告或做東西時需要用到的資料或原料。
hintEnglish: The data or raw items you need when doing a report or making something.

definition: to adopt; to employ; to use
exampleSimplified: 公司决定采用新的办法。
exampleTraditional: 公司決定採用新的辦法。
exampleEnglish: The company decided to adopt a new method.
hintSimplified: 选择一种方法或意见，然后拿来使用。
hintTraditional: 選擇一種方法或意見，然後拿來使用。
hintEnglish: To choose a method or opinion and then put it to use.

definition: consultation; reference; to consult; to refer
exampleSimplified: 写报告时可以参考这本书。
exampleTraditional: 寫報告時可以參考這本書。
exampleEnglish: You can refer to this book when writing the report.
hintSimplified: 做决定或写作业前，看看别人的资料帮助自己。
hintTraditional: 做決定或寫作業前，看看別人的資料幫助自己。
hintEnglish: Before deciding or writing, you look at others' material for help.

exampleSimplified: 孩子们在公园的草地上玩球。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們在公園的草地上玩球。
exampleEnglish: The kids are playing ball on the park's lawn.
hintSimplified: 公园里长满绿草的一片地方，可以坐着休息。
hintTraditional: 公園裡長滿綠草的一片地方，可以坐著休息。
hintEnglish: A patch of ground covered in green grass in a park where you can sit.

exampleSimplified: 草原上有很多马和羊。
exampleTraditional: 草原上有很多馬和羊。
exampleEnglish: There are many horses and sheep on the grasslands.
hintSimplified: 非常辽阔、没有什么树的大片绿色土地，常有牛羊。
hintTraditional: 非常遼闊、沒有什麼樹的大片綠色土地，常有牛羊。
hintEnglish: A vast green land with few trees, often with cattle and sheep.

gloss: (past tense marker used before verb or clause)
definition: (past tense marker used before verb or clause); already; ever; former; once; previously
exampleSimplified: 我曾经在台湾住过两年。
exampleTraditional: 我曾經在台灣住過兩年。
exampleEnglish: I once lived in Taiwan for two years.
hintSimplified: 放在动词前，说明这件事以前发生过。
hintTraditional: 放在動詞前，說明這件事以前發生過。
hintEnglish: Placed before a verb to say something happened in the past.

exampleSimplified: 我今天差点迟到。
exampleTraditional: 我今天差點遲到。
exampleEnglish: I almost was late today.
hintSimplified: 表示某件事几乎发生，但最后没有发生。
hintTraditional: 表示某件事幾乎發生，但最後沒有發生。
hintEnglish: Shows something nearly happened but in the end did not.

exampleSimplified: 这两个城市的生活差别很大。
exampleTraditional: 這兩個城市的生活差別很大。
exampleEnglish: The lifestyles of these two cities differ greatly.
hintSimplified: 两个东西不一样的地方。
hintTraditional: 兩個東西不一樣的地方。
hintEnglish: The place where two things are not the same.

gloss: to try (to see what it's like or whether one can do it)
definition: to try (to see what it's like or whether one can do it)
exampleSimplified: 我想尝试做一道新的菜。
exampleTraditional: 我想嘗試做一道新的菜。
exampleEnglish: I want to try making a new dish.
hintSimplified: 没做过的事，先做做看，看结果怎么样。
hintTraditional: 沒做過的事，先做做看，看結果怎麼樣。
hintEnglish: Doing something new for the first time to see how it turns out.

exclusionReason: Traditional form is not listed among dictionary recognized forms

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂生产很多电子产品。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠生產很多電子產品。
exampleEnglish: This factory makes many electronic products.
hintSimplified: 工厂做出来、拿到店里卖的东西。
hintTraditional: 工廠做出來、拿到店裡賣的東西。
hintEnglish: Things made by a factory and sold in stores.

gloss: to arise; to come into being; to come about
definition: to arise; to come into being; to come about; to give rise to; to bring into being; to bring about; to produce; to engender; to generate
exampleSimplified: 两个人之间产生了误会。
exampleTraditional: 兩個人之間產生了誤會。
exampleEnglish: A misunderstanding arose between the two people.
hintSimplified: 原来没有的问题或感觉，慢慢出现了。
hintTraditional: 原來沒有的問題或感覺，慢慢出現了。
hintEnglish: A problem or feeling that wasn't there before comes into existence.

definition: to exceed; to outstrip; to surpass
exampleSimplified: 今天的气温超过三十五度。
exampleTraditional: 今天的氣溫超過三十五度。
exampleEnglish: Today's temperature exceeded thirty-five degrees.
hintSimplified: 比某个数字或速度更多、更高。
hintTraditional: 比某個數字或速度更多、更高。
hintEnglish: To be more or higher than a certain number or speed.

exampleSimplified: 这家超级市场的东西很便宜。
exampleTraditional: 這家超級市場的東西很便宜。
exampleEnglish: The things at this supermarket are very cheap.
hintSimplified: 放在名词前，表示比一般的更大、更厉害。
hintTraditional: 放在名詞前，表示比一般的更大、更厲害。
hintEnglish: Placed before a noun to mean bigger or stronger than ordinary.

definition: CL:頓|顿[dun4]; quarrel; to have a row; to quarrel
exampleSimplified: 他们昨天因为小事吵架了。
exampleTraditional: 他們昨天因為小事吵架了。
exampleEnglish: They had an argument yesterday over a small matter.
hintSimplified: 两个人意见不同，大声说话，互相生气。
hintTraditional: 兩個人意見不同，大聲說話，互相生氣。
hintEnglish: Two people disagree, speak loudly and get angry at each other.

exampleSimplified: 两种文化之间有明显的差异。
exampleTraditional: 兩種文化之間有明顯的差異。
exampleEnglish: There are obvious differences between the two cultures.
hintSimplified: 比较两件事物时发现的不同之处，常用于正式场合。
hintTraditional: 比較兩件事物時發現的不同之處，常用於正式場合。
hintEnglish: Differences found when comparing two things, often in formal contexts.

exampleSimplified: 昨天路上发生了一起车祸。
exampleTraditional: 昨天路上發生了一起車禍。
exampleEnglish: A car accident happened on the road yesterday.
hintSimplified: 汽车在路上相撞，可能让人受伤。
hintTraditional: 汽車在路上相撞，可能讓人受傷。
hintEnglish: Cars collide on the road, possibly hurting people.

exampleSimplified: 他穿着一件白色的衬衫。
exampleTraditional: 他穿著一件白色的襯衫。
exampleEnglish: He is wearing a white shirt.
hintSimplified: 上班时常穿的有领子和扣子的上衣。
hintTraditional: 上班時常穿的有領子和釦子的上衣。
hintEnglish: A top with a collar and buttons often worn to work.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; achievement; gain; profit; result
exampleSimplified: 这是我们努力一年的成果。
exampleTraditional: 這是我們努力一年的成果。
exampleEnglish: This is the result of our year of hard work.
hintSimplified: 长时间努力以后得到的好结果。
hintTraditional: 長時間努力以後得到的好結果。
hintEnglish: The good outcome gained after long effort.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; accomplishment; achievement; success; to achieve (a result); to bring about; to create
exampleSimplified: 他在科学上有很大的成就。
exampleTraditional: 他在科學上有很大的成就。
exampleEnglish: He has great achievements in science.
hintSimplified: 一个人经过努力，做出了重要而了不起的事。
hintTraditional: 一個人經過努力，做出了重要而了不起的事。
hintEnglish: Important, impressive things a person has done through effort.

definition: recognition (diplomatic, artistic etc); to acknowledge; to admit; to concede; to recognize
exampleSimplified: 他承认这次是自己的错。
exampleTraditional: 他承認這次是自己的錯。
exampleEnglish: He admitted that it was his own fault this time.
hintSimplified: 说出某件事是真的，尤其是自己做错的事。
hintTraditional: 說出某件事是真的，尤其是自己做錯的事。
hintEnglish: To say something is true, especially a mistake of your own.

exampleSimplified: 他是一个很诚实的孩子，从来不说谎。
exampleTraditional: 他是一個很誠實的孩子，從來不說謊。
exampleEnglish: He is a very honest child who never lies.
hintSimplified: 形容人说真话，不骗别人。
hintTraditional: 形容人說真話，不騙別人。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who tells the truth and doesn't deceive others.

definition: Taiwan pr. [cheng2shou2]; mature; ripe; to mature; to ripen
exampleSimplified: 这个苹果已经成熟了,可以摘了。
exampleTraditional: 這個蘋果已經成熟了,可以摘了。
exampleEnglish: This apple is already ripe and can be picked.
hintSimplified: 水果长到可以吃的时候,或者人变得懂事,就可以这样形容。
hintTraditional: 水果長到可以吃的時候,或者人變得懂事,就可以這樣形容。
hintEnglish: Describes fruit that has reached the point of being ready to eat, or a person who has become mature in thinking.

exampleSimplified: 孩子在爱的环境中成长,会更快乐。
exampleTraditional: 孩子在愛的環境中成長,會更快樂。
exampleEnglish: Children who grow up in a loving environment are happier.
hintSimplified: 小孩一年一年变高、变懂事的过程。
hintTraditional: 小孩一年一年變高、變懂事的過程。
hintEnglish: The process of a child getting taller and wiser year after year.

definition: CL:條|条[tiao2],隻|只[zhi1]; bug; insect; worm
exampleSimplified: 草地上有很多小虫子在爬。
exampleTraditional: 草地上有很多小蟲子在爬。
exampleEnglish: There are many little bugs crawling on the grass.
hintSimplified: 很小的动物,常常在草里或树上,有些人很怕它们。
hintTraditional: 很小的動物,常常在草裡或樹上,有些人很怕它們。
hintEnglish: Small creatures often found in grass or on trees; some people are afraid of them.

definition: full; rich; substantial; to augment; to enrich; to substantiate (an argument)
exampleSimplified: 他的暑假过得很充实,学了很多东西。
exampleTraditional: 他的暑假過得很充實,學了很多東西。
exampleEnglish: His summer vacation was very fulfilling; he learned a lot.
hintSimplified: 形容生活里有很多有意义的事,一点也不空虚。
hintTraditional: 形容生活裡有很多有意義的事,一點也不空虛。
hintEnglish: Describes a life full of meaningful things, not empty at all.

exampleSimplified: 这份报告写错了,我要重新写一次。
exampleTraditional: 這份報告寫錯了,我要重新寫一次。
exampleEnglish: This report has mistakes; I have to write it again from scratch.
hintSimplified: 做错或不满意以后,从头再做一次。
hintTraditional: 做錯或不滿意以後,從頭再做一次。
hintEnglish: After a mistake or dissatisfaction, doing something over from the beginning.

definition: to bring about; to create; to produce; to set (a record)
exampleSimplified: 艺术家用双手创造出美丽的作品。
exampleTraditional: 藝術家用雙手創造出美麗的作品。
exampleEnglish: The artist creates beautiful works with their hands.
hintSimplified: 做出以前没有的新东西。
hintTraditional: 做出以前沒有的新東西。
hintEnglish: To make something new that did not exist before.

exampleSimplified: 这本小说明年春天就会出版。
exampleTraditional: 這本小說明年春天就會出版。
exampleEnglish: This novel will be published next spring.
hintSimplified: 书或杂志印好以后,拿到书店给大家看。
hintTraditional: 書或雜誌印好以後,拿到書店給大家看。
hintEnglish: What happens when a book or magazine is printed and released to the public.

gloss: to go on an official or business trip
definition: to go on an official or business trip
exampleSimplified: 我下个星期要去台中出差。
exampleTraditional: 我下個星期要去台中出差。
exampleEnglish: Next week I have to go to Taichung on a business trip.
hintSimplified: 因为公司的工作,要暂时去别的城市。
hintTraditional: 因為公司的工作,要暫時去別的城市。
hintEnglish: Temporarily traveling to another city because of one's company work.

gloss: (fig.) to proceed from (a particular standpoint or basis)
definition: (fig.) to proceed from (a particular standpoint or basis); to set off; to start (on a journey)
exampleSimplified: 我们明天早上七点从学校出发。
exampleTraditional: 我們明天早上七點從學校出發。
exampleEnglish: We will set off from school at seven tomorrow morning.
hintSimplified: 旅行或活动开始时,离开原来的地方。
hintTraditional: 旅行或活動開始時,離開原來的地方。
hintEnglish: Leaving the starting place when a trip or activity begins.

definition: to appear; to arise; to emerge; to show up
exampleSimplified: 天空中突然出现了一道彩虹。
exampleTraditional: 天空中突然出現了一道彩虹。
exampleEnglish: A rainbow suddenly appeared in the sky.
hintSimplified: 原来看不到的东西,忽然让人看见了。
hintTraditional: 原來看不到的東西,忽然讓人看見了。
hintEnglish: Something not visible before suddenly comes into view.

exampleSimplified: 这间房子要出租,一个月一万元。
exampleTraditional: 這間房子要出租,一個月一萬元。
exampleEnglish: This house is for rent, ten thousand dollars a month.
hintSimplified: 房东把房子或车给别人用,再收钱。
hintTraditional: 房東把房子或車給別人用,再收錢。
hintEnglish: What a landlord does when letting others use a house or car for money.

definition: to handle; to deal with; to punish; to sell at reduced prices; to treat sth by a special process; to process
exampleSimplified: 老板请我马上处理这个问题。
exampleTraditional: 老闆請我馬上處理這個問題。
exampleEnglish: The boss asked me to deal with this problem right away.
hintSimplified: 遇到事情或问题时,想办法把它解决。
hintTraditional: 遇到事情或問題時,想辦法把它解決。
hintEnglish: Finding a way to settle a matter or problem when it comes up.

exampleSimplified: 那位厨师做的牛肉面非常好吃。
exampleTraditional: 那位廚師做的牛肉麵非常好吃。
exampleEnglish: The beef noodles made by that chef are delicious.
hintSimplified: 在餐厅里负责做菜的人。
hintTraditional: 在餐廳裡負責做菜的人。
hintEnglish: The person in a restaurant who is in charge of cooking.

definition: irritant; to provoke; to irritate; to upset; to stimulate; to excite
exampleSimplified: 坐云霄飞车真的很刺激。
exampleTraditional: 坐雲霄飛車真的很刺激。
exampleEnglish: Riding a roller coaster is really thrilling.
hintSimplified: 让人心跳很快、觉得很兴奋或紧张的感觉。
hintTraditional: 讓人心跳很快、覺得很興奮或緊張的感覺。
hintEnglish: A feeling that makes your heart race with excitement or tension.

exampleSimplified: 他从不喝咖啡,只喝茶。
exampleTraditional: 他從不喝咖啡,只喝茶。
exampleEnglish: He never drinks coffee, only tea.
hintSimplified: 表示一直以来都没有做过某件事,一次也没有。
hintTraditional: 表示一直以來都沒有做過某件事,一次也沒有。
hintEnglish: Shows that someone has never, at any time, done a certain thing.

gloss: from childhood; from a young age
definition: from childhood; from a young age
exampleSimplified: 她从小就喜欢画画。
exampleTraditional: 她從小就喜歡畫畫。
exampleEnglish: She has loved drawing since she was little.
hintSimplified: 表示从年纪还很小的时候开始。
hintTraditional: 表示從年紀還很小的時候開始。
hintEnglish: Indicates starting from when one was very young.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市还存在不少问题。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市還存在不少問題。
exampleEnglish: This city still has quite a few problems.
hintSimplified: 东西或问题是真的有,没有消失。
hintTraditional: 東西或問題是真的有,沒有消失。
hintEnglish: Something or some problem is really there and has not disappeared.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; error; mistake; mistaken; false; wrong
exampleSimplified: 这个错误很小,改一下就好了。
exampleTraditional: 這個錯誤很小,改一下就好了。
exampleEnglish: This mistake is small; just fix it and it's fine.
hintSimplified: 不对的地方,老师常常会用红笔圈出来。
hintTraditional: 不對的地方,老師常常會用紅筆圈出來。
hintEnglish: A wrong point, which teachers often circle in red pen.

definition: check; defeat; disappointment; frustration; reverse; setback; to blunt; to discourage; to frustrate; to set sb back; to subdue
exampleSimplified: 遇到挫折时,不要轻易放弃。
exampleTraditional: 遇到挫折時,不要輕易放棄。
exampleEnglish: When you meet setbacks, don't give up easily.
hintSimplified: 做事不顺利、失败时遇到的困难。
hintTraditional: 做事不順利、失敗時遇到的困難。
hintEnglish: The difficulty you meet when things don't go well or you fail.

exampleSimplified: 两家公司终于达成了共识。
exampleTraditional: 兩家公司終於達成了共識。
exampleEnglish: The two companies finally reached a consensus.
hintSimplified: 经过讨论或努力,最后得到想要的结果或协议。
hintTraditional: 經過討論或努力,最後得到想要的結果或協議。
hintEnglish: After discussion or effort, finally obtaining the desired result or agreement.

definition: CL:場|场[chang2]; to come to blows; to fight; to scuffle
exampleSimplified: 小孩在学校打架,老师很生气。
exampleTraditional: 小孩在學校打架,老師很生氣。
exampleEnglish: The kids fought at school and the teacher was angry.
hintSimplified: 两个人生气时用拳头互相攻击。
hintTraditional: 兩個人生氣時用拳頭互相攻擊。
hintEnglish: When two people, angry, attack each other with their fists.

definition: a type of green tea; easy-mannered; expert; generous; in good taste; magnanimous; mother earth; natural and relaxed; scholar; see 大方縣|大方县[Da4 fang1 Xian4]; stylish
exampleSimplified: 他很大方,常常请朋友吃饭。
exampleTraditional: 他很大方,常常請朋友吃飯。
exampleEnglish: He is very generous and often treats friends to meals.
hintSimplified: 形容人不小气,花钱或做事都很自然、不拘束。
hintTraditional: 形容人不小氣,花錢或做事都很自然、不拘束。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who isn't stingy and acts naturally and without restraint.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],屆|届[jie4]; convention; general assembly; general meeting
exampleSimplified: 全校同学都去礼堂参加大会。
exampleTraditional: 全校同學都去禮堂參加大會。
exampleEnglish: All the students went to the auditorium for the general assembly.
hintSimplified: 很多人聚在一起开的正式大型会议。
hintTraditional: 很多人聚在一起開的正式大型會議。
hintEnglish: A formal, large meeting where many people gather.

definition: CL:位[wei4],個|个[ge4],名[ming2]; delegate; in the name of; on behalf of; representative; to represent; to stand for
exampleSimplified: 他是我们班的代表,要去开会。
exampleTraditional: 他是我們班的代表,要去開會。
exampleEnglish: He is our class representative and has to go to the meeting.
hintSimplified: 替一群人出面说话或参加活动的人;也可以指象征某种意思。
hintTraditional: 替一群人出面說話或參加活動的人;也可以指象徵某種意思。
hintEnglish: A person who speaks or attends on behalf of a group; also to stand for a meaning.

gloss: to replace; to take the place of
definition: to replace; to take the place of
exampleSimplified: 今天我生病了,请你代替我去开会。
exampleTraditional: 今天我生病了,請你代替我去開會。
exampleEnglish: I'm sick today, so please go to the meeting in my place.
hintSimplified: 别人不能做时,由你来做他的位置或工作。
hintTraditional: 別人不能做時,由你來做他的位置或工作。
hintEnglish: When someone can't do it, you take over their position or job.

exampleSimplified: 老师带领学生参观博物馆。
exampleTraditional: 老師帶領學生參觀博物館。
exampleEnglish: The teacher led the students on a visit to the museum.
hintSimplified: 走在前面,指引一群人往某个方向前进或做事。
hintTraditional: 走在前面,指引一群人往某個方向前進或做事。
hintEnglish: To walk in front and lead a group toward a direction or task.

exampleSimplified: 这个孩子很单纯,从来不骗人。
exampleTraditional: 這個孩子很單純,從來不騙人。
exampleEnglish: This child is very innocent and never lies.
hintSimplified: 形容人想法简单,没有复杂的心机。
hintTraditional: 形容人想法簡單,沒有複雜的心機。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose thoughts are simple, without scheming.

gloss: at the scene; on the spot
definition: at the scene; on the spot
exampleSimplified: 他发现钱包不见了,当场就哭了。
exampleTraditional: 他發現錢包不見了,當場就哭了。
exampleEnglish: He discovered his wallet was missing and cried right then and there.
hintSimplified: 事情发生的那个地点、那个时候,马上就做。
hintTraditional: 事情發生的那個地點、那個時候,馬上就做。
hintEnglish: At the very place and moment something happens, immediately.

exampleSimplified: 我想尝尝当地的特色小吃。
exampleTraditional: 我想嚐嚐當地的特色小吃。
exampleEnglish: I want to try the specialty snacks of the area.
hintSimplified: 指你现在所在或所说的那个地方。
hintTraditional: 指你現在所在或所說的那個地方。
hintEnglish: Refers to the place where you are or the place being talked about.

definition: in sb's presence; to sb's face
exampleSimplified: 有话请你当面跟他说清楚。
exampleTraditional: 有話請你當面跟他說清楚。
exampleEnglish: If you have something to say, please tell him directly to his face.
hintSimplified: 两个人面对面,不是用电话或信息。
hintTraditional: 兩個人面對面,不是用電話或資訊。
hintEnglish: Two people face to face, not by phone or message.

gloss: in those days; back then; in those years
definition: in those days; back then; in those years; that very same year; to be in the prime of life
exampleSimplified: 当年我们一起在这里念书。
exampleTraditional: 當年我們一起在這裡唸書。
exampleEnglish: Back then, we studied here together.
hintSimplified: 说起很久以前的那段日子时常用的词。
hintTraditional: 說起很久以前的那段日子時常用的詞。
hintEnglish: A word used when recalling a period long ago.

definition: on that day; the same day
exampleSimplified: 这张票当天有效,明天就不能用了。
exampleTraditional: 這張票當天有效,明天就不能用了。
exampleEnglish: This ticket is valid only that day; tomorrow it can't be used.
hintSimplified: 指事情发生的同一天,不是前一天或后一天。
hintTraditional: 指事情發生的同一天,不是前一天或後一天。
hintEnglish: The very same day something happens, not the day before or after.

definition: to regard as; to treat as
exampleSimplified: 他把这件事当作一次学习的机会。
exampleTraditional: 他把這件事當作一次學習的機會。
exampleEnglish: He regarded this matter as a chance to learn.
hintSimplified: 把一个东西或事情看成另一种东西来对待。
hintTraditional: 把一個東西或事情看成另一種東西來對待。
hintEnglish: To treat one thing as if it were another.

definition: to look upon as; to regard as; to treat as
exampleSimplified: 别把我的话当做耳边风。
exampleTraditional: 別把我的話當做耳邊風。
exampleEnglish: Don't treat my words as if they were just wind in your ear.
hintSimplified: 把一个东西或事情看成另一种东西来对待,和“当作”很像。
hintTraditional: 把一個東西或事情看成另一種東西來對待,和“當作”很像。
hintEnglish: To treat one thing as if it were another; very similar to a common variant.

definition: to assume office of; to hold a governmental office or post; to serve as; to take charge of
exampleSimplified: 她担任我们班的班长。
exampleTraditional: 她擔任我們班的班長。
exampleEnglish: She serves as our class president.
hintSimplified: 接受一个职位或工作,并负起责任。
hintTraditional: 接受一個職位或工作,並負起責任。
hintEnglish: To take on a position or job and its responsibility.

exampleSimplified: 他三十岁了,还是单身。
exampleTraditional: 他三十歲了,還是單身。
exampleEnglish: He is thirty and still single.
hintSimplified: 没有结婚,也没有另一半的状态。
hintTraditional: 沒有結婚,也沒有另一半的狀態。
hintEnglish: The state of having no spouse or partner.

exampleSimplified: 这部电影的导演很有名。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影的導演很有名。
exampleEnglish: The director of this movie is very famous.
hintSimplified: 拍电影时,指挥演员和工作人员的人。
hintTraditional: 拍電影時,指揮演員和工作人員的人。
hintEnglish: The person who guides actors and crew when making a film.

definition: after all; finally; in the end; to the end; to the last; when all is said and done
exampleSimplified: 你到底想不想去?
exampleTraditional: 你到底想不想去?
exampleEnglish: Do you actually want to go or not?
hintSimplified: 追问时用,表示想知道最后真正的答案。
hintTraditional: 追問時用,表示想知道最後真正的答案。
hintEnglish: Used when pressing a question, wanting the real final answer.

definition: actually; contrariwise; contrary to what one might expect; why don't you
exampleSimplified: 这家店不大,东西倒是挺便宜的。
exampleTraditional: 這家店不大,東西倒是挺便宜的。
exampleEnglish: This shop isn't big, but the things are actually quite cheap.
hintSimplified: 用在句中,表示和前面的想法有一点相反或让步。
hintTraditional: 用在句中,表示和前面的想法有一點相反或讓步。
hintEnglish: Used mid-sentence to show a slight contrast or concession with what came before.

exampleSimplified: 尊敬老人是一种基本的道德。
exampleTraditional: 尊敬老人是一種基本的道德。
exampleEnglish: Respecting the elderly is a basic moral value.
hintSimplified: 社会认为人应该遵守的对与错的标准。
hintTraditional: 社會認為人應該遵守的對與錯的標準。
hintEnglish: Standards of right and wrong that society expects people to follow.

exampleSimplified: 道教是中国本土的宗教。
exampleTraditional: 道教是中國本土的宗教。
exampleEnglish: Taoism is a native religion of China.
hintSimplified: 一种起源于中国的宗教,和老子有关。
hintTraditional: 一種起源於中國的宗教,和老子有關。
hintEnglish: A religion originating in China, linked to Laozi.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; argument; basis; justification; principle; reason; sense
exampleSimplified: 他说得很有道理,我同意。
exampleTraditional: 他說得很有道理,我同意。
exampleEnglish: What he said makes a lot of sense; I agree.
hintSimplified: 一件事让人觉得合理、说得通的原因。
hintTraditional: 一件事讓人覺得合理、說得通的原因。
hintEnglish: The reasoning that makes something seem sensible and justified.

exampleSimplified: 做错事了就应该向别人道歉。
exampleTraditional: 做錯事了就應該向別人道歉。
exampleEnglish: If you do something wrong, you should apologize to others.
hintSimplified: 做错事以后,说“对不起”表示后悔。
hintTraditional: 做錯事以後,說“對不起”表示後悔。
hintEnglish: After doing wrong, saying sorry to show regret.

gloss: to answer positively; to agree; to accept; to promise
definition: to answer positively; to agree; to accept; to promise; to answer; to respond
exampleSimplified: 爸爸答应周末带我去动物园。
exampleTraditional: 爸爸答應週末帶我去動物園。
exampleEnglish: Dad promised to take me to the zoo this weekend.
hintSimplified: 别人请求你时,你说“好”,同意去做。
hintTraditional: 別人請求你時,你說“好”,同意去做。
hintEnglish: When someone asks you for something, you say yes and agree to do it.

exampleSimplified: 周末我们全家一起打扫房间。
exampleTraditional: 週末我們全家一起打掃房間。
exampleEnglish: On weekends our whole family cleans the rooms together.
hintSimplified: 用扫把或拖把把家里弄干净。
hintTraditional: 用掃把或拖把把家裡弄乾淨。
hintEnglish: Using a broom or mop to make the home clean.

definition: to ask about; to ask around; to make some inquiries
exampleSimplified: 我想向你打听一下这附近的餐厅。
exampleTraditional: 我想向你打聽一下這附近的餐廳。
exampleEnglish: I'd like to ask you about restaurants around here.
hintSimplified: 不太清楚某件事,所以向别人问消息。
hintTraditional: 不太清楚某件事,所以向別人問訊息。
hintEnglish: Not knowing about something, you ask others for information.

definition: adults and children; at any rate; consideration of seniority; large and small; size
exampleSimplified: 这两个箱子大小不一样。
exampleTraditional: 這兩個箱子大小不一樣。
exampleEnglish: These two boxes are not the same size.
hintSimplified: 说一个东西体积或面积是多少、有多大。
hintTraditional: 說一個東西體積或面積是多少、有多大。
hintEnglish: Talks about how big or small an object's volume or area is.

exampleSimplified: 从我家到学校大约要二十分钟。
exampleTraditional: 從我家到學校大約要二十分鐘。
exampleEnglish: It takes about twenty minutes from my home to school.
hintSimplified: 用来说不太精确的数字或时间。
hintTraditional: 用來說不太精確的數字或時間。
hintEnglish: Used for a number or time that is not exact.

definition: to fight a battle; to go to war
exampleSimplified: 那两个国家已经打仗好几年了。
exampleTraditional: 那兩個國家已經打仗好幾年了。
exampleEnglish: Those two countries have been at war for several years.
hintSimplified: 两个国家或军队互相用武器作战。
hintTraditional: 兩個國家或軍隊互相用武器作戰。
hintEnglish: Two countries or armies fighting each other with weapons.

definition: complacent; pleased with oneself; proud of oneself
exampleSimplified: 他考了第一名,看起来很得意。
exampleTraditional: 他考了第一名,看起來很得意。
exampleEnglish: He got first place and looks very pleased with himself.
hintSimplified: 因为成功而很高兴,甚至有点骄傲的样子。
hintTraditional: 因為成功而很高興,甚至有點驕傲的樣子。
hintEnglish: Very happy because of success, even a little proud.

exampleSimplified: 我在车站等待朋友的到来。
exampleTraditional: 我在車站等待朋友的到來。
exampleEnglish: I am waiting at the station for my friend to arrive.
hintSimplified: 人在某地不做别的事,希望某人或某事出现。
hintTraditional: 人在某地不做別的事,希望某人或某事出現。
hintEnglish: Staying somewhere, hoping that someone or something will show up.

exampleSimplified: 舞台上的灯光很漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 舞台上的燈光很漂亮。
exampleEnglish: The lighting on the stage is beautiful.
hintSimplified: 演唱会或戏剧里,照亮舞台的各种光。
hintTraditional: 演唱會或戲劇裡,照亮舞台的各種光。
hintEnglish: The various lights that illuminate the stage at a concert or play.

exampleSimplified: 士兵们勇敢地面对敌人。
exampleTraditional: 士兵們勇敢地面對敵人。
exampleEnglish: The soldiers bravely faced the enemy.
hintSimplified: 战争中和你站在对立面、要打败你的人。
hintTraditional: 戰爭中和你站在對立面、要打敗你的人。
hintEnglish: In a war, the people on the opposing side who want to defeat you.

exampleSimplified: 飞机下午三点抵达台北。
exampleTraditional: 飛機下午三點抵達台北。
exampleEnglish: The plane arrives in Taipei at three in the afternoon.
hintSimplified: 旅行到了目的地,比较正式的说法。
hintTraditional: 旅行到了目的地,比較正式的說法。
hintEnglish: Reaching the destination of a trip; a rather formal expression.

exampleSimplified: 这个房间的地板是木头做的。
exampleTraditional: 這個房間的地板是木頭做的。
exampleEnglish: The floor of this room is made of wood.
hintSimplified: 房间里我们脚下踩的那一层,常用木头或瓷砖做。
hintTraditional: 房間裡我們腳下踩的那一層,常用木頭或瓷磚做。
hintEnglish: The surface under our feet in a room, often made of wood or tiles.

exampleSimplified: 这一地带夏天常常下大雨。
exampleTraditional: 這一地帶夏天常常下大雨。
exampleEnglish: This area often has heavy rain in summer.
hintSimplified: 指有某种特点的一片土地范围。
hintTraditional: 指有某種特點的一片土地範圍。
hintEnglish: A stretch of land that has a particular characteristic.

exampleSimplified: 他的地理成绩很好,知道很多国家的位置。
exampleTraditional: 他的地理成績很好,知道很多國家的位置。
exampleEnglish: He does well in geography and knows where many countries are.
hintSimplified: 学校的一门课,学山、河、国家和气候。
hintTraditional: 學校的一門課,學山、河、國家和氣候。
hintEnglish: A school subject about mountains, rivers, countries and climate.

exampleSimplified: 我们都住在同一个地球上。
exampleTraditional: 我們都住在同一個地球上。
exampleEnglish: We all live on the same planet Earth.
hintSimplified: 人类居住的星球,围着太阳转。
hintTraditional: 人類居住的星球,圍著太陽轉。
hintEnglish: The planet humans live on, which goes around the sun.

definition: prefecture (in China's administrative system); region; area (informal or geographical term)
exampleSimplified: 这个地区的冬天很冷。
exampleTraditional: 這個地區的冬天很冷。
exampleEnglish: The winters in this area are very cold.
hintSimplified: 比城市大,指一片有范围的地方。
hintTraditional: 比城市大,指一片有範圍的地方。
hintEnglish: A zone with boundaries, usually larger than a city.

exampleSimplified: 他在夜市的地摊上买了一双袜子。
exampleTraditional: 他在夜市的地攤上買了一雙襪子。
exampleEnglish: He bought a pair of socks at a street stall in the night market.
hintSimplified: 小贩把东西放在路边地上卖的摊子。
hintTraditional: 小販把東西放在路邊地上賣的攤子。
hintEnglish: A vendor's stand where goods are laid out on the ground by the road.

exampleSimplified: 她在公司里有很高的地位。
exampleTraditional: 她在公司裡有很高的地位。
exampleEnglish: She has a high standing in the company.
hintSimplified: 一个人在社会或团体中的高低位置。
hintTraditional: 一個人在社會或團體中的高低位置。
hintEnglish: A person's high or low rank in society or a group.

definition: covert; clandestine; ground; floor; underground; subterranean
exampleSimplified: 这家商店在大楼的地下一层。
exampleTraditional: 這家商店在大樓的地下一層。
exampleEnglish: This shop is on the basement level of the building.
hintSimplified: 在地面以下的空间,和楼上相反。
hintTraditional: 在地面以下的空間,和樓上相反。
hintEnglish: The space below ground level, the opposite of upstairs.

exampleSimplified: 这里的地形很复杂,有山也有河。
exampleTraditional: 這裡的地形很複雜,有山也有河。
exampleEnglish: The terrain here is complex, with both mountains and rivers.
hintSimplified: 土地表面的样子,例如高山、平原或山谷。
hintTraditional: 土地表面的樣子,例如高山、平原或山谷。
hintEnglish: The shape of the land surface, such as mountains, plains or valleys.

gloss: (in the context of Japan) electric train
definition: (in the context of Japan) electric train; e-bike; electric car; tram; streetcar; trolleybus
exampleSimplified: 我每天坐电车去上班。
exampleTraditional: 我每天坐電車去上班。
exampleEnglish: I take the electric train to work every day.
hintSimplified: 用电力在轨道上跑的交通工具,在城市里很常见。
hintTraditional: 用電力在軌道上跑的交通工具,在城市裡很常見。
hintEnglish: A vehicle powered by electricity that runs on rails in cities.

definition: CL:節|节[jie2],組|组[zu3]; battery; electric cell
exampleSimplified: 遥控器的电池没电了。
exampleTraditional: 遙控器的電池沒電了。
exampleEnglish: The remote control's battery is dead.
hintSimplified: 放进手电筒或遥控器里,可以提供电力的小东西。
hintTraditional: 放進手電筒或遙控器裡,可以提供電力的小東西。
hintEnglish: A small thing put in a flashlight or remote to supply power.

exampleSimplified: 天黑了,请把电灯打开。
exampleTraditional: 天黑了,請把電燈開啟。
exampleEnglish: It's dark; please turn on the light.
hintSimplified: 房间里用电发光的东西,天黑时要开它。
hintTraditional: 房間裡用電發光的東西,天黑時要開它。
hintEnglish: A device in a room that gives light with electricity; you switch it on when it's dark.

definition: (opinion) poll; CL:項|项[xiang4],個|个[ge4]; inquiry; investigation; survey; to investigate; to survey
exampleSimplified: 警察正在调查这件事。
exampleTraditional: 警察正在調查這件事。
exampleEnglish: The police are investigating this matter.
hintSimplified: 为了知道真相或意见,去仔细询问和查看。
hintTraditional: 為了知道真相或意見,去仔細詢問和檢視。
hintEnglish: Carefully asking and examining in order to learn the truth or people's opinions.

exampleSimplified: 台风从东北方向吹过来。
exampleTraditional: 颱風從東北方向吹過來。
exampleEnglish: The typhoon is blowing in from the northeast.
hintSimplified: 在东边和北边之间的方向。
hintTraditional: 在東邊和北邊之間的方向。
hintEnglish: The direction between east and north.

exampleSimplified: 台湾在亚洲的东南边。
exampleTraditional: 台灣在亞洲的東南邊。
exampleEnglish: Taiwan is in the southeast of Asia.
hintSimplified: 在东边和南边之间的方向。
hintTraditional: 在東邊和南邊之間的方向。
hintEnglish: The direction between east and south.

gloss: (esp. of a child) sensible; thoughtful; intelligent
definition: (esp. of a child) sensible; thoughtful; intelligent; to grow beyond the naivete of childhood; to be aware of what is going on in the world
exampleSimplified: 这个孩子很懂事,会帮妈妈做家事。
exampleTraditional: 這個孩子很懂事,會幫媽媽做家事。
exampleEnglish: This child is very sensible and helps Mom with housework.
hintSimplified: 形容孩子明白道理,会替别人着想,不让大人担心。
hintTraditional: 形容孩子明白道理,會替別人著想,不讓大人擔心。
hintEnglish: Describes a child who understands things and thinks of others, not worrying adults.

exampleSimplified: 都市里的生活节奏很快。
exampleTraditional: 都市裡的生活節奏很快。
exampleEnglish: The pace of life in the city is fast.
hintSimplified: 人口很多、高楼很多的大地方。
hintTraditional: 人口很多、高樓很多的大地方。
hintEnglish: A big place with many people and tall buildings.

exampleSimplified: 毒品会严重伤害人的身体。
exampleTraditional: 毒品會嚴重傷害人的身體。
exampleEnglish: Drugs can seriously harm people's bodies.
hintSimplified: 法律禁止的东西,让人上瘾,对健康很不好。
hintTraditional: 法律禁止的東西,讓人上癮,對健康很不好。
hintEnglish: Illegal substances that are addictive and very bad for health.

exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅有独特的风格。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳有獨特的風格。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant has a unique style.
hintSimplified: 形容和别的都不一样,有自己的特色。
hintTraditional: 形容和別的都不一樣,有自己的特色。
hintEnglish: Describes something different from all others, with its own character.

exampleSimplified: 这本杂志有很多年轻的读者。
exampleTraditional: 這本雜誌有很多年輕的讀者。
exampleEnglish: This magazine has many young readers.
hintSimplified: 看书、报纸或杂志的人。
hintTraditional: 看書、報紙或雜誌的人。
hintEnglish: A person who looks at books, newspapers or magazines.

gloss: the other person; the other side; the other party
definition: the other person; the other side; the other party
exampleSimplified: 谈话时要认真听对方说的话。
exampleTraditional: 談話時要認真聽對方說的話。
exampleEnglish: When talking, you should listen carefully to what the other person says.
hintSimplified: 在谈话或比赛中,不是自己这一边的那个人。
hintTraditional: 在談話或比賽中,不是自己這一邊的那個人。
hintEnglish: In a conversation or match, the person who is not on your side.

exampleSimplified: 这段对话很有意思,我们再听一次吧。
exampleTraditional: 這段對話很有意思,我們再聽一次吧。
exampleEnglish: This conversation is interesting; let's listen to it once more.
hintSimplified: 两个人你一句我一句地说话,课本里常有这样的内容。
hintTraditional: 兩個人你一句我一句地說話,課本里常有這樣的內容。
hintEnglish: Two people speak back and forth, often found in textbooks.

definition: Correct!; Oh, by the way, ...; Oh, that's right, ... (when one suddenly remembers sth one wanted to mention)
exampleSimplified: 对了,明天下午你有空吗?
exampleTraditional: 對了,明天下午你有空嗎?
exampleEnglish: Oh right, are you free tomorrow afternoon?
hintSimplified: 说话时突然想起另一件事,用来引出新话题。
hintTraditional: 說話時突然想起另一件事,用來引出新話題。
hintEnglish: Said when you suddenly remember something and want to bring up a new topic.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; partner; boyfriend; girlfriend; target; object
exampleSimplified: 他的男朋友就是他大学时的结婚对象。
exampleTraditional: 他的男朋友就是他大學時的結婚對象。
exampleEnglish: His partner is the person he is going to marry, whom he met at university.
hintSimplified: 可以指你正在交往或想结婚的人,也可以指研究或服务的人群。
hintTraditional: 可以指你正在交往或想結婚的人,也可以指研究或服務的人群。
hintEnglish: It can mean the person you date or plan to marry, or the target of a study or service.

exampleSimplified: 六月一日是儿童节,孩子们都很开心。
exampleTraditional: 六月一日是兒童節,孩子們都很開心。
exampleEnglish: June 1st is Children's Day, and the kids are all happy.
hintSimplified: 指年纪还小、还没长大的人,通常在小学或更小的年纪。
hintTraditional: 指年紀還小、還沒長大的人,通常在小學或更小的年紀。
hintEnglish: Refers to young people who haven't grown up yet, usually of primary-school age or younger.

exampleSimplified: 他在报纸上发表了一篇文章。
exampleTraditional: 他在報紙上發表了一篇文章。
exampleEnglish: He published an article in the newspaper.
hintSimplified: 把文章、研究或意见正式告诉大家或登出来。
hintTraditional: 把文章、研究或意見正式告訴大家或登出來。
hintEnglish: To formally make an article, research or opinion public.

exampleSimplified: 新年的时候,大家都说“恭喜发财”。
exampleTraditional: 新年的時候,大家都說“恭喜發財”。
exampleEnglish: At New Year, everyone says "wishing you prosperity."
hintSimplified: 新年常听到的祝福,希望赚很多钱、变成有钱人。
hintTraditional: 新年常聽到的祝福,希望賺很多錢、變成有錢人。
hintEnglish: A New Year wish for earning lots of money and becoming wealthy.

gloss: to issue (an order, decree etc); to send out; to dispatch
definition: to issue (an order, decree etc); to send out; to dispatch; to produce (a sound); to let out (a laugh)
exampleSimplified: 手机突然发出很大的声音。
exampleTraditional: 手機突然發出很大的聲音。
exampleEnglish: The phone suddenly made a very loud sound.
hintSimplified: 让声音、光或信息从某处产生并传出来。
hintTraditional: 讓聲音、光或資訊從某處產生並傳出來。
hintEnglish: To make a sound, light or message come out and spread from somewhere.

gloss: (literary) to achieve fame and fortune; to prosper
definition: (literary) to achieve fame and fortune; to prosper; to develop; to promote; to expand; well-developed; flourishing
exampleSimplified: 台湾的交通很发达,出门很方便。
exampleTraditional: 台灣的交通很發達,出門很方便。
exampleEnglish: Taiwan's transportation is well developed, so getting around is convenient.
hintSimplified: 形容一个地方的经济、科技或设施进步得很好。
hintTraditional: 形容一個地方的經濟、科技或設施進步得很好。
hintEnglish: Describes a place whose economy, technology or facilities are highly advanced.

gloss: to bring out implicit or innate qualities
definition: to bring out implicit or innate qualities; to develop (an idea); to display; to elaborate (on a theme); to exhibit; to express (a thought or moral)
exampleSimplified: 比赛时,他发挥了最好的实力。
exampleTraditional: 比賽時,他發揮了最好的實力。
exampleEnglish: During the match, he showed his best ability.
hintSimplified: 把自己的能力或才华充分表现出来。
hintTraditional: 把自己的能力或才華充分表現出來。
hintEnglish: To fully show your own ability or talent.

definition: to become aware; to detect; to perceive; to realize
exampleSimplified: 回到家以后,我才发觉钥匙不见了。
exampleTraditional: 回到家以後,我才發覺鑰匙不見了。
exampleEnglish: Only after getting home did I realize my keys were missing.
hintSimplified: 本来没注意到,后来突然发现或感觉到某件事。
hintTraditional: 本來沒注意到,後來突然發現或感覺到某件事。
hintEnglish: You hadn't noticed something at first, but later suddenly realize it.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; an invention; to invent
exampleSimplified: 电灯是爱迪生发明的。
exampleTraditional: 電燈是愛迪生發明的。
exampleEnglish: The electric light was invented by Edison.
hintSimplified: 第一次做出以前没有的新东西或新方法。
hintTraditional: 第一次做出以前沒有的新東西或新方法。
hintEnglish: To create a new thing or method that did not exist before.

exampleSimplified: 他吃了药,病情反而更严重了。
exampleTraditional: 他吃了藥,病情反而更嚴重了。
exampleEnglish: He took medicine, but his condition got worse instead.
hintSimplified: 用在结果和预期相反的时候,表示出乎意料。
hintTraditional: 用在結果和預期相反的時候,表示出乎意料。
hintEnglish: Used when the result is the opposite of what was expected.

definition: CL:種|种[zhong3]; way; method; manner; mode; pattern (of behavior etc)
exampleSimplified: 每个人学习的方式都不一样。
exampleTraditional: 每個人學習的方式都不一樣。
exampleEnglish: Everyone learns in a different way.
hintSimplified: 做一件事所用的方法或形式。
hintTraditional: 做一件事所用的方法或形式。
hintEnglish: The method or form used to do something.

exampleSimplified: 房东每个月向房客收房租。
exampleTraditional: 房東每個月向房客收房租。
exampleEnglish: The landlord collects rent from the tenant every month.
hintSimplified: 付钱租别人的房子来住的人。
hintTraditional: 付錢租別人的房子來住的人。
hintEnglish: A person who pays to live in someone else's house.

gloss: (Tw) to interview (e.g. for a report or feature story)
definition: (Tw) to interview (e.g. for a report or feature story); (computing) to visit (a website); to access (a network resource etc); CL:次[ci4]; to visit; to call on (a person or place)
exampleSimplified: 记者明天要访问那位有名的作家。
exampleTraditional: 記者明天要訪問那位有名的作家。
exampleEnglish: The reporter will interview that famous writer tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 记者向某个人提出问题,了解他的想法或经历。
hintTraditional: 記者向某個人提出問題,了解他的想法或經歷。
hintEnglish: A reporter asks someone questions to learn about their views or experiences.

definition: to be distressed; to be worried; worries
exampleSimplified: 工作和家庭的问题让他很烦恼。
exampleTraditional: 工作和家庭的問題讓他很煩惱。
exampleEnglish: Problems with work and family trouble him a lot.
hintSimplified: 心里有难解决的事,觉得不开心、很困扰。
hintTraditional: 心裡有難解決的事,覺得不開心、很困擾。
hintEnglish: Feeling upset and troubled because of problems that are hard to solve.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; extent; limit; range; scope
exampleSimplified: 这次考试的范围是第一课到第五课。
exampleTraditional: 這次考試的範圍是第一課到第五課。
exampleEnglish: The scope of this exam is lessons one to five.
hintSimplified: 事情、活动或考试所包括的界限。
hintTraditional: 事情、活動或考試所包括的界限。
hintEnglish: The limits of what is included in something, such as an exam or an activity.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],位[wei4],名[ming2]; interpretation; interpreter; to interpret; to translate; translation; translator
exampleSimplified: 她的工作是把中文小说翻译成法文。
exampleTraditional: 她的工作是把中文小說翻譯成法文。
exampleEnglish: Her job is to translate Chinese novels into French.
hintSimplified: 把一种语言的意思换成另一种语言说出来或写出来。
hintTraditional: 把一種語言的意思換成另一種語言說出來或寫出來。
hintEnglish: To convey the meaning of one language in another language.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; chemical reaction; reaction; reply; response; to react; to respond
exampleSimplified: 听到这个消息,他的反应很平静。
exampleTraditional: 聽到這個訊息,他的反應很平靜。
exampleEnglish: Hearing the news, his reaction was very calm.
hintSimplified: 遇到事情时,人或东西立刻表现出来的样子。
hintTraditional: 遇到事情時,人或東西立刻表現出來的樣子。
hintEnglish: How a person or thing immediately responds when something happens.

definition: invoice; receipt; bill; uniform invoice (abbr. for 統一發票|统一发票[tong3 yi1 fa1 piao4])
exampleSimplified: 买东西以后,请记得跟老板要发票。
exampleTraditional: 買東西以後,請記得跟老闆要發票。
exampleEnglish: After buying something, remember to ask the shopkeeper for a receipt.
hintSimplified: 买东西后店家给的纸,上面有号码,可以对奖。
hintTraditional: 買東西后店家給的紙,上面有號碼,可以對獎。
hintEnglish: A paper given by the shop after a purchase, with a number you can use in a lottery.

definition: CL:筆|笔[bi3],個|个[ge4]; cost; expenditure; expense
exampleSimplified: 这次旅行的费用比我想的还高。
exampleTraditional: 這次旅行的費用比我想的還高。
exampleEnglish: The cost of this trip is higher than I thought.
hintSimplified: 做一件事或使用服务需要付出的钱。
hintTraditional: 做一件事或使用服務需要付出的錢。
hintEnglish: The money you must spend to do something or use a service.

exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅的菜色很丰富。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳的菜色很豐富。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant has a rich variety of dishes.
hintSimplified: 形容种类很多、内容很充实。
hintTraditional: 形容種類很多、內容很充實。
hintEnglish: Describes something with many kinds and plenty of content.

exampleSimplified: 我很喜欢这位设计师的风格。
exampleTraditional: 我很喜歡這位設計師的風格。
exampleEnglish: I really like this designer's style.
hintSimplified: 艺术、穿着或写作中,一个人或作品独特的特色。
hintTraditional: 藝術、穿著或寫作中,一個人或作品獨特的特色。
hintEnglish: The distinctive character of a person's or work's art, dress or writing.

exampleSimplified: 每个地方的风俗习惯都不太一样。
exampleTraditional: 每個地方的風俗習慣都不太一樣。
exampleEnglish: The customs of every place are somewhat different.
hintSimplified: 一个地方的人长期形成的生活习惯和过节方式。
hintTraditional: 一個地方的人長期形成的生活習慣和過節方式。
hintEnglish: The long-standing habits and festival practices formed by people in a place.

exampleSimplified: 老师把吵架的两个学生分开坐。
exampleTraditional: 老師把吵架的兩個學生分開坐。
exampleEnglish: The teacher made the two quarreling students sit apart.
hintSimplified: 让原来在一起的人或东西不再在一起。
hintTraditional: 讓原來在一起的人或東西不再在一起。
hintEnglish: To make people or things that were together no longer together.

exampleSimplified: 他的奶奶每天都去佛教寺庙拜拜。
exampleTraditional: 他的奶奶每天都去佛教寺廟拜拜。
exampleEnglish: His grandmother goes to a Buddhist temple to pray every day.
hintSimplified: 这是一种起源于印度的宗教,信徒常常念经、吃素、去寺庙。
hintTraditional: 這是一種起源於印度的宗教,信徒常常唸經、吃素、去寺廟。
hintEnglish: This is a religion that originated in India; followers often chant sutras, eat vegetarian food and visit temples.

exampleSimplified: 快点走吧,否则我们会迟到。
exampleTraditional: 快點走吧,否則我們會遲到。
exampleEnglish: Let's hurry, otherwise we'll be late.
hintSimplified: 这个词用来说明如果前面的事情不成立,就会有不好的结果。
hintTraditional: 這個詞用來說明如果前面的事情不成立,就會有不好的結果。
hintEnglish: This word is used to say that if the previous condition isn't met, a bad result will follow.

definition: CL:對|对[dui4]; a (married) couple; husband and wife
exampleSimplified: 那对夫妇每个周末都带孩子去公园。
exampleTraditional: 那對夫婦每個週末都帶孩子去公園。
exampleEnglish: That couple takes their children to the park every weekend.
hintSimplified: 指结了婚的一男一女,也就是丈夫和妻子两个人。
hintTraditional: 指結了婚的一男一女,也就是丈夫和妻子兩個人。
hintEnglish: It refers to a married man and woman, that is, a husband and wife together.

definition: (physics) coincidence; in accordance with; to agree with; to conform to; to meet (a requirement)
exampleSimplified: 这份工作不符合我的兴趣。
exampleTraditional: 這份工作不符合我的興趣。
exampleEnglish: This job does not match my interests.
hintSimplified: 当一样东西跟要求、条件或标准一致时,就可以用这个词。
hintTraditional: 當一樣東西跟要求、條件或標準一致時,就可以用這個詞。
hintEnglish: Use this word when something agrees with a requirement, condition or standard.

definition: (social) welfare; benefit (provided by an employer or organization)
exampleSimplified: 这家公司的福利很好,还有免费的健康检查。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司的福利很好,還有免費的健康檢查。
exampleEnglish: This company has great benefits, including free health checkups.
hintSimplified: 公司除了薪水以外,给员工的好处,例如保险、年假和旅游补助。
hintTraditional: 公司除了薪水以外,給員工的好處,例如保險、年假和旅遊補助。
hintEnglish: The extra advantages a company gives employees besides salary, such as insurance, vacation and travel subsidies.

exampleSimplified: 这家店卖各种年轻人喜欢的服装。
exampleTraditional: 這家店賣各種年輕人喜歡的服裝。
exampleEnglish: This shop sells all kinds of clothing that young people like.
hintSimplified: 衣服、裤子、裙子等穿在身上的东西的总称。
hintTraditional: 衣服、褲子、裙子等穿在身上的東西的總稱。
hintEnglish: A general term for clothes, pants, skirts and other things worn on the body.

definition: corruption; rotten; to corrupt; to rot
exampleSimplified: 政府正在努力解决官员腐败的问题。
exampleTraditional: 政府正在努力解決官員腐敗的問題。
exampleEnglish: The government is working hard to solve the problem of official corruption.
hintSimplified: 形容官员或制度不诚实、拿不该拿的钱;食物放太久也会这样。
hintTraditional: 形容官員或制度不誠實、拿不該拿的錢;食物放太久也會這樣。
hintEnglish: Describes officials or systems that are dishonest and take money they shouldn't; food left too long can also do this.

gloss: to pay; to expend; to invest (energy or time)
definition: to pay; to expend; to invest (energy or time)
exampleSimplified: 为了完成这个计划,他付出了很多时间和努力。
exampleTraditional: 為了完成這個計劃,他付出了很多時間和努力。
exampleEnglish: To complete this plan, he put in a lot of time and effort.
hintSimplified: 为了一件事,花掉很多时间、力气或金钱。
hintTraditional: 為了一件事,花掉很多時間、力氣或金錢。
hintEnglish: To spend a lot of time, energy or money for the sake of something.

definition: burden; to bear (an expense, a responsibility etc)
exampleSimplified: 房租对他来说是很重的负担。
exampleTraditional: 房租對他來說是很重的負擔。
exampleEnglish: The rent is a heavy burden for him.
hintSimplified: 指让人感到压力很大、很难承受的责任或花费。

definition: CL:次[ci4]; inspection; to examine; to inspect

gloss: to reduce; to lower; to bring down
definition: to reduce; to lower; to bring down

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; a speech; to address; to speak; to talk

definition: carefully selected for quality; tastefully chosen; to pay particular attention to

definition: to alleviate; to ease; to lighten

gloss: to lessen; to decrease; to reduce; to lower

hintEnglish: An adverb used to stress that a situation is almost to an exaggerated degree.

definition: to establish; to found; to set up

gloss: to build; to construct; to establish; to develop; to institute
