exampleEnglish: Hearing this news, everyone was very surprised.
hintSimplified: 遇到想不到的事情时,心里觉得很意外的感觉。
hintTraditional: 遇到想不到的事情時,心裡覺得很意外的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling you have when something totally unexpected happens.

exampleSimplified: 路上发生车祸,警察很快就来了。
exampleTraditional: 路上發生車禍,警察很快就來了。
exampleEnglish: A car accident happened on the road, and the police arrived quickly.
hintSimplified: 穿制服,负责维持社会安全、抓坏人的人。
hintTraditional: 穿制服,負責維持社會安全、抓壞人的人。
hintEnglish: People in uniform who keep the public safe and catch criminals.

gloss: (go ahead and do it) without hesitating
definition: (go ahead and do it) without hesitating; although; despite; do not hesitate (to ask, complain etc); even though; in spite of; unhesitatingly
exampleSimplified: 尽管下大雨,他还是准时来了。
exampleTraditional: 儘管下大雨,他還是準時來了。
exampleEnglish: Even though it rained heavily, he still came on time.
hintSimplified: 用来连接两个相反的意思,表示虽然有困难,结果还是一样。
hintTraditional: 用來連線兩個相反的意思,表示雖然有困難,結果還是一樣。
hintEnglish: Used to link two contrasting ideas: despite a difficulty, the result stays the same.

gloss: (of a process etc) to proceed; to be in progress; to be underway
definition: (of a process etc) to proceed; to be in progress; to be underway; (of an army etc) to be on the march; to advance; (of people) to carry out; to conduct (an investigation or discussion etc)
exampleSimplified: 会议正在进行,请你小声一点。
exampleTraditional: 會議正在進行,請你小聲一點。
exampleEnglish: The meeting is in progress, please keep your voice down.
hintSimplified: 表示一件事情正在做,或者开始做下去。
hintTraditional: 表示一件事情正在做,或者開始做下去。
hintEnglish: Says that something is underway or being carried out.

exampleSimplified: 下班以后,他们常去那家酒吧聊天。
exampleTraditional: 下班以後,他們常去那家酒吧聊天。
exampleEnglish: After work, they often go to that bar to chat.
hintSimplified: 晚上人们去喝酒、听音乐、放松的地方。
hintTraditional: 晚上人們去喝酒、聽音樂、放鬆的地方。
hintEnglish: A place where people go in the evening to have drinks, hear music and relax.

gloss: (used correlatively with 也[ye3]) even; even if
definition: (used correlatively with 也[ye3]) even; even if; exactly; precisely; only; simply; just
exampleSimplified: 就是下雨,我也要去爬山。
exampleTraditional: 就是下雨,我也要去爬山。
exampleEnglish: Even if it rains, I still want to go hiking.
hintSimplified: 用在假设的句子里,表示即使情况不好,结果也不会改变。
hintTraditional: 用在假設的句子裡,表示即使情況不好,結果也不會改變。
hintEnglish: Used in hypothetical sentences: even if things are bad, the result won't change.

exampleSimplified: 就算你不说,我也知道是谁做的。
exampleTraditional: 就算你不說,我也知道是誰做的。
exampleEnglish: Even if you don't say it, I know who did it.
hintSimplified: 口语里常用,表示即使有某种条件,结果还是一样。
hintTraditional: 口語裡常用,表示即使有某種條件,結果還是一樣。
hintEnglish: Common in speech: even under a given condition, the outcome stays the same.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; maternal uncle (informal); mother's brother
exampleSimplified: 我舅舅住在台南,过年时我们会去看他。
exampleTraditional: 我舅舅住在臺南,過年時我們會去看他。
exampleEnglish: My uncle lives in Tainan, and we visit him at Chinese New Year.
hintSimplified: 妈妈的兄弟,是家里的男性亲戚。
hintTraditional: 媽媽的兄弟,是家裡的男性親戚。
hintEnglish: Your mother's brother, a male relative.

exampleSimplified: 舅妈做的菜很好吃,我每次都吃很多。
exampleTraditional: 舅媽做的菜很好吃,我每次都吃很多。
exampleEnglish: My aunt's cooking is delicious, and I always eat a lot.
hintSimplified: 妈妈的兄弟的太太。
hintTraditional: 媽媽的兄弟的太太。
hintEnglish: The wife of your mother's brother.

definition: resident in; to dwell; to live in a place; to reside
exampleSimplified: 他在台北居住了十年。
exampleTraditional: 他在台北居住了十年。
exampleEnglish: He has lived in Taipei for ten years.
hintSimplified: 长期在某个地方生活、有家的意思,比较正式。
hintTraditional: 長期在某個地方生活、有家的意思,比較正式。
hintEnglish: To live in a place long-term and have a home there; a rather formal word.

exampleSimplified: 学校打算下个月举办运动会。
exampleTraditional: 學校打算下個月舉辦運動會。
exampleEnglish: The school plans to hold a sports day next month.
hintSimplified: 安排并开始一场活动或比赛。
hintTraditional: 安排並開始一場活動或比賽。
hintEnglish: To organize and put on an event or competition.

gloss: to put up one's hand (as signal)
definition: to put up one's hand (as signal); to raise a hand
exampleSimplified: 有问题的同学请举手。
exampleTraditional: 有問題的同學請舉手。
exampleEnglish: Students who have questions, please raise your hand.
hintSimplified: 在教室里想发言时,把手向上抬起来。
hintTraditional: 在教室裡想發言時,把手向上抬起來。
hintEnglish: What you do in class when you want to speak: lift your hand up.

exampleSimplified: 婚礼将在下星期六举行。
exampleTraditional: 婚禮將在下星期六舉行。
exampleEnglish: The wedding will be held next Saturday.
hintSimplified: 比较正式地说,会议或典礼在某个时间地点进行。
hintTraditional: 比較正式地說,會議或典禮在某個時間地點進行。
hintEnglish: A formal way to say a meeting or ceremony takes place at a certain time and place.

gloss: to refuse; to decline; to reject
definition: to refuse; to decline; to reject
exampleSimplified: 他很客气地拒绝了我的邀请。
exampleTraditional: 他很客氣地拒絕了我的邀請。
exampleEnglish: He politely declined my invitation.
hintSimplified: 别人请你做事,你回答不同意、不接受。
hintTraditional: 別人請你做事,你回答不同意、不接受。
hintEnglish: When someone asks you for something and you answer that you won't accept.

definition: distance; separation (in space or time); to be ... away from; to be ... from
exampleSimplified: 我家和学校的距离不远。
exampleTraditional: 我家和學校的距離不遠。
exampleEnglish: The distance between my home and school is not far.
hintSimplified: 两个地方之间有多远,可以用公里来量。
hintTraditional: 兩個地方之間有多遠,可以用公里來量。
hintEnglish: How far apart two places are, measurable in kilometers.

exampleSimplified: 导演正在修改这部电影的剧本。
exampleTraditional: 導演正在修改這部電影的劇本。
exampleEnglish: The director is revising the script of this movie.
hintSimplified: 演员演戏前要看的文字,写着对话和故事。
hintTraditional: 演員演戲前要看的文字,寫著對話和故事。
hintEnglish: The text actors read before performing, with dialogue and story.

exampleSimplified: 这部电视剧的剧情很精彩,我每天都追。
exampleTraditional: 這部電視劇的劇情很精彩,我每天都追。
exampleEnglish: The plot of this TV drama is great, and I follow it every day.
hintSimplified: 电影或电视里发生的故事内容。
hintTraditional: 電影或電視裡發生的故事內容。
hintEnglish: The story content of what happens in a movie or TV show.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市具有很长的历史。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市具有很長的歷史。
exampleEnglish: This city has a very long history.
hintSimplified: 比较正式的说法,表示拥有某种特点或条件。
hintTraditional: 比較正式的說法,表示擁有某種特點或條件。
hintEnglish: A formal way to say something possesses a certain feature or condition.

exampleSimplified: 我绝对不会忘记你的帮助。
exampleTraditional: 我絕對不會忘記你的幫助。
exampleEnglish: I will absolutely never forget your help.
hintSimplified: 表示非常肯定,没有任何例外或怀疑。
hintTraditional: 表示非常肯定,沒有任何例外或懷疑。
hintEnglish: Expresses complete certainty, with no exceptions or doubt.

definition: also pr. [jiao3se4]; role; part (in a play or movie etc)
exampleSimplified: 她在这部电影里演一个很重要的角色。
exampleTraditional: 她在這部電影裡演一個很重要的角色。
exampleEnglish: In this movie she plays a very important role.
hintSimplified: 演员在戏里扮演的人物。
hintTraditional: 演員在戲裡扮演的人物。
hintEnglish: The character that an actor plays in a show.

exampleSimplified: 军队的任务是保护国家。
exampleTraditional: 軍隊的任務是保護國家。
exampleEnglish: The army's mission is to protect the country.
hintSimplified: 由很多士兵组成,负责保卫国家的组织。
hintTraditional: 由很多士兵組成,負責保衛國家的組織。
hintEnglish: An organization made up of many soldiers that defends a country.

exampleSimplified: 他的爸爸是一位军人,常常不在家。
exampleTraditional: 他的爸爸是一位軍人,常常不在家。
exampleEnglish: His father is a soldier and is often away from home.
hintSimplified: 这种人穿制服,保护国家,在军队里工作。
hintTraditional: 這種人穿制服,保護國家,在軍隊裡工作。
hintEnglish: This kind of person wears a uniform, protects the country and works in the army.

exampleSimplified: 一辆大卡车停在工厂门口。
exampleTraditional: 一輛大卡車停在工廠門口。
exampleEnglish: A big truck is parked at the factory gate.
hintSimplified: 这种大车常用来运送很多货物。
hintTraditional: 這種大車常用來運送很多貨物。
hintEnglish: This big vehicle is often used to carry lots of goods.

definition: to be open (to the public); to be open-minded; to bloom; to open; to open up (to the outside); unconstrained in one's sexuality; unrestrained by convention
exampleSimplified: 这个公园每天早上六点开放。
exampleTraditional: 這個公園每天早上六點開放。
exampleEnglish: This park is open to the public every morning at six.
hintSimplified: 博物馆或公园让大家可以进去参观,就是这样。
hintTraditional: 博物館或公園讓大家可以進去參觀,就是這樣。
hintEnglish: When a museum or park lets everyone come in to visit, it is like this.

definition: (fig.) to burst with joy; (fig.) to burst; to split open; (fig.) to spring up everywhere; to flourish; to bloom; to blossom; to flower
exampleSimplified: 春天到了,院子里的樱花开花了。
exampleTraditional: 春天到了,院子裡的櫻花開花了。
exampleEnglish: Spring has come and the cherry trees in the yard are blooming.
hintSimplified: 春天时,树或植物长出美丽的花朵。
hintTraditional: 春天時,樹或植物長出美麗的花朵。
hintEnglish: In spring, trees or plants produce beautiful flowers.

definition: (of character) optimistic; carefree; cheerful; open and clear; spacious and well-lit
exampleSimplified: 她的个性很开朗,大家都喜欢她。
exampleTraditional: 她的個性很開朗,大家都喜歡她。
exampleEnglish: She has a cheerful personality and everyone likes her.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人性格乐观,爱笑,不容易难过。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人性格樂觀,愛笑,不容易難過。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is optimistic, laughs often and is not easily sad.

exampleSimplified: 台湾的科技公司很有名。
exampleTraditional: 台灣的科技公司很有名。
exampleEnglish: Taiwan's technology companies are very famous.
hintSimplified: 手机、电脑和芯片都和这个领域有关。
hintTraditional: 手機、電腦和晶片都和這個領域有關。
hintEnglish: Phones, computers and chips are all related to this field.

definition: CL:門|门[men2],個|个[ge4],種|种[zhong3]; rational; science; scientific; scientific knowledge
exampleSimplified: 他对科学很有兴趣,长大想当研究员。
exampleTraditional: 他對科學很有興趣,長大想當研究員。
exampleEnglish: He is very interested in science and wants to be a researcher when he grows up.
hintSimplified: 物理、化学、生物都属于这个领域,用实验来了解世界。
hintTraditional: 物理、化學、生物都屬於這個領域,用實驗來了解世界。
hintEnglish: Physics, chemistry and biology belong to this field, which uses experiments to understand the world.

exampleSimplified: 他做事很认真,是个可靠的人。
exampleTraditional: 他做事很認真,是個可靠的人。
exampleEnglish: He works conscientiously; he is a reliable person.
hintSimplified: 你可以相信他,把重要的事交给他也放心。
hintTraditional: 你可以相信他,把重要的事交給他也放心。
hintEnglish: You can trust him and feel safe giving him important tasks.

definition: pathetic; pitiful; to have pity on
exampleSimplified: 那只小狗没有家,看起来很可怜。
exampleTraditional: 那隻小狗沒有家,看起來很可憐。
exampleEnglish: That little dog has no home and looks pitiful.
hintSimplified: 看到没有家的小动物,你会觉得它很需要同情。
hintTraditional: 看到沒有家的小動物,你會覺得它很需要同情。
hintEnglish: When you see a homeless little animal, you feel it deserves sympathy.

definition: to long for; to thirst for
exampleSimplified: 孩子们渴望早点放暑假。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們渴望早點放暑假。
exampleEnglish: The children long for summer vacation to start soon.
hintSimplified: 非常非常想得到某样东西或做某件事的心情。
hintTraditional: 非常非常想得到某樣東西或做某件事的心情。
hintEnglish: The feeling of wanting something or wanting to do something very, very much.

exampleSimplified: 这个小偷真可恶,偷了老人的钱。
exampleTraditional: 這個小偷真可惡,偷了老人的錢。
exampleEnglish: This thief is so hateful; he stole an old person's money.
hintSimplified: 有人做了很坏的事,让你非常生气时会这样说。
hintTraditional: 有人做了很壞的事,讓你非常生氣時會這樣說。
hintEnglish: You say this when someone does something bad that makes you very angry.

definition: CL:堂[tang2],節|节[jie2],門|门[men2]; course; academic program
exampleSimplified: 这个学期的课程很多,我每天都很忙。
exampleTraditional: 這個學期的課程很多,我每天都很忙。
exampleEnglish: There are many courses this semester, so I am busy every day.
hintSimplified: 学校为学生安排的一整套学习内容。
hintTraditional: 學校為學生安排的一整套學習內容。
hintEnglish: The whole set of learning content a school arranges for students.

exampleSimplified: 在课堂上,请不要玩手机。
exampleTraditional: 在課堂上,請不要玩手機。
exampleEnglish: Please don't play with your phone in class.
hintSimplified: 老师讲课、学生听讲的地方或时间。
hintTraditional: 老師講課、學生聽講的地方或時間。
hintEnglish: The place or time where teachers teach and students listen.

exampleSimplified: 老师请我们把这篇课文读三遍。
exampleTraditional: 老師請我們把這篇課文讀三遍。
exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to read this text three times.
hintSimplified: 语文或外语课本里,每一课要学的文章。
hintTraditional: 語文或外語課本里,每一課要學的文章。
hintEnglish: The article in each lesson of a language textbook that students must study.

definition: (try to) overcome (hardships etc); to conquer; to endure; to put up with
exampleSimplified: 他努力克服了对水的害怕,学会了游泳。
exampleTraditional: 他努力克服了對水的害怕,學會了游泳。
exampleEnglish: He worked hard to overcome his fear of water and learned to swim.
hintSimplified: 面对困难或害怕的事,想办法战胜它。
hintTraditional: 面對困難或害怕的事,想辦法戰勝它。
hintEnglish: Facing a difficulty or fear and finding a way to defeat it.

definition: affirmative (answer); assuredly; definitely; to be certain; to be positive; to give recognition; to affirm
exampleSimplified: 我肯定他今天会来,因为他昨天说过了。
exampleTraditional: 我肯定他今天會來,因為他昨天說過了。
exampleEnglish: I'm sure he will come today, because he said so yesterday.
hintSimplified: 心里很确定,没有一点怀疑,或回答「是的」。
hintTraditional: 心裡很確定,沒有一點懷疑,或回答「是的」。
hintEnglish: Being completely sure in your mind without doubt, or answering "yes".

definition: (astronomy) outer space; (fig.) scope; leeway; (physics, math.) space; space; room
exampleSimplified: 这个房间的空间不大,放不下沙发。
exampleTraditional: 這個房間的空間不大,放不下沙發。
exampleEnglish: This room doesn't have much space and can't fit a sofa.
hintSimplified: 房子或地方里可以放东西、让人活动的大小。
hintTraditional: 房子或地方里可以放東西、讓人活動的大小。
hintEnglish: The size in a house or place available for putting things or moving around.

gloss: (slang) to fail to catch anything (on a fishing trip); to get skunked
definition: (slang) to fail to catch anything (on a fishing trip); to get skunked; air force
exampleSimplified: 他在空军工作,每天都要开飞机。
exampleTraditional: 他在空軍工作,每天都要開飛機。
exampleEnglish: He works in the air force and flies planes every day.
hintSimplified: 军队中负责在天上保护国家、驾驶飞机的部队。
hintTraditional: 軍隊中負責在天上保護國家、駕駛飛機的部隊。
hintEnglish: The part of the armed forces that protects the country from the sky and flies planes.

definition: I'm afraid that...; fear; maybe; perhaps; to dread
exampleSimplified: 天空很黑,恐怕要下大雨了。
exampleTraditional: 天空很黑,恐怕要下大雨了。
exampleEnglish: The sky is dark; I'm afraid it's going to rain heavily.
hintSimplified: 用来说出担心或不太好的推测,语气比较客气。
hintTraditional: 用來說出擔心或不太好的推測,語氣比較客氣。
hintEnglish: Used to state a worry or an unfavorable guess, in a polite tone.

definition: a person's preferences; flavor; tastes (in food)
exampleSimplified: 每个人的口味不一样,有人爱吃辣。
exampleTraditional: 每個人的口味不一樣,有人愛吃辣。
exampleEnglish: Everyone's taste is different; some people love spicy food.
hintSimplified: 一个人喜欢吃什么味道的食物的习惯。
hintTraditional: 一個人喜歡吃什麼味道的食物的習慣。
hintEnglish: A person's habitual preference for certain flavors of food.

exampleSimplified: 这件衣服很好看,况且价钱也不贵。
exampleTraditional: 這件衣服很好看,況且價錢也不貴。
exampleEnglish: This piece of clothing looks nice; besides, the price isn't high.
hintSimplified: 用在句子中间,再补充一个更强的理由。
hintTraditional: 用在句子中間,再補充一個更強的理由。
hintEnglish: Used mid-sentence to add a further, stronger reason.

definition: (coll.) excessive; ridiculous; outrageous; hyperbole; overstated; exaggerated; to exaggerate
exampleSimplified: 你说他有一百个朋友,这太夸张了。
exampleTraditional: 你說他有一百個朋友,這太誇張了。
exampleEnglish: You say he has a hundred friends; that's too exaggerated.
hintSimplified: 说话或做事超过真实的程度,让人觉得不太可信。
hintTraditional: 說話或做事超過真實的程度,讓人覺得不太可信。
hintEnglish: Speaking or acting beyond what is real, so it seems hard to believe.

definition: to broaden one's scope; to enlarge; to expand
exampleSimplified: 公司打算明年扩大生产。
exampleTraditional: 公司打算明年擴大生產。
exampleEnglish: The company plans to expand production next year.
hintSimplified: 让范围、规模变得更大。
hintTraditional: 讓範圍、規模變得更大。
hintEnglish: To make the range or scale become larger.

exampleSimplified: 他在海边为女朋友准备了浪漫的晚餐。
exampleTraditional: 他在海邊為女朋友準備了浪漫的晚餐。
exampleEnglish: He prepared a romantic dinner for his girlfriend by the sea.
hintSimplified: 情人节烛光晚餐常给人的那种美好感觉。
hintTraditional: 情人節燭光晚餐常給人的那種美好感覺。
hintEnglish: The lovely feeling a candlelit Valentine's dinner usually gives.

definition: (coll.) eunuch; (coll.) husband; see also 老公[lao3 gong1]
exampleSimplified: 我老公今天晚上会做饭。
exampleTraditional: 我老公今天晚上會做飯。
exampleEnglish: My husband will cook tonight.
hintSimplified: 已婚的女人在口语中这样称呼自己的丈夫。
hintTraditional: 已婚的女人在口語中這樣稱呼自己的丈夫。
hintEnglish: What a married woman colloquially calls her spouse.

exampleSimplified: 动物园里的老虎看起来很大,也很可怕。
exampleTraditional: 動物園裡的老虎看起來很大,也很可怕。
exampleEnglish: The tiger in the zoo looks very big and scary.
hintSimplified: 这种大型猫科动物身上有黑色条纹,被称为森林之王。
hintTraditional: 這種大型貓科動物身上有黑色條紋,被稱為森林之王。
hintEnglish: This large feline has black stripes and is called the king of the forest.

exampleSimplified: 我老婆今天晚上要做红烧肉。
exampleTraditional: 我老婆今天晚上要做紅燒肉。
exampleEnglish: My wife is going to make braised pork tonight.
hintSimplified: 丈夫在口语中这样称呼自己结婚的女伴。
hintTraditional: 丈夫在口語中這樣稱呼自己結婚的女伴。
hintEnglish: What a husband colloquially calls his married female partner.

exampleSimplified: 他是个老实人,从来不说谎。
exampleTraditional: 他是個老實人,從來不說謊。
exampleEnglish: He is an honest person who never lies.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人诚恳、不骗人,也不耍花样。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人誠懇、不騙人,也不耍花樣。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is sincere, doesn't cheat, and plays no tricks.

exampleSimplified: 你怎么老是忘记带钥匙?
exampleTraditional: 你怎麼老是忘記帶鑰匙?
exampleEnglish: Why do you always forget to bring your keys?
hintSimplified: 副词,表示某件事一直重复发生,常带有抱怨的语气。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示某件事一直重複發生,常帶有抱怨的語氣。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning something keeps happening repeatedly, often with a tone of complaint.

exampleSimplified: 他对未来非常乐观,从不担心。
exampleTraditional: 他對未來非常樂觀,從不擔心。
exampleEnglish: He is very optimistic about the future and never worries.
hintSimplified: 遇到困难时,总是往好的方向想,充满希望。
hintTraditional: 遇到困難時,總是往好的方向想,充滿希望。
hintEnglish: When facing difficulty, always thinking positively and full of hope.

exampleSimplified: 养花给他的生活带来很多乐趣。
exampleTraditional: 養花給他的生活帶來很多樂趣。
exampleEnglish: Growing flowers brings him a lot of enjoyment in life.
hintSimplified: 做喜欢的事情时,心里感到的快乐和满足。
hintTraditional: 做喜歡的事情時,心裡感到的快樂和滿足。
hintEnglish: The happiness and satisfaction felt when doing something you like.

exampleSimplified: 她对我的态度很冷淡,好像不认识我。
exampleTraditional: 她對我的態度很冷淡,好像不認識我。
exampleEnglish: Her attitude toward me is cold, as if she doesn't know me.
hintSimplified: 形容人对别人不热情、不关心的态度。
hintTraditional: 形容人對別人不熱情、不關心的態度。
hintEnglish: Describes an attitude that is not warm or caring toward others.

definition: (romantic) love; CL:個|个[ge4],場|场[chang3]; in love; to have an affair
exampleSimplified: 他们从大学开始谈恋爱,现在已经结婚了。
exampleTraditional: 他們從大學開始談戀愛,現在已經結婚了。
exampleEnglish: They started dating in college and are now married.
hintSimplified: 两个人互相喜欢,成为男女朋友的状态。
hintTraditional: 兩個人互相喜歡,成為男女朋友的狀態。
hintEnglish: The state of two people liking each other and becoming a couple.

exampleSimplified: 他们保持着良好的关系。
exampleTraditional: 他們保持著良好的關係。
exampleEnglish: They maintain a good relationship.
hintSimplified: 形容情况或品质很不错,令人满意,常用在正式场合。
hintTraditional: 形容情況或品質很不錯,令人滿意,常用在正式場合。
hintEnglish: Describes a situation or quality that is quite satisfying, often used in formal contexts.

gloss: variant of 聯絡|联络[lian2 luo4]
definition: variant of 聯絡|联络[lian2 luo4]
exampleSimplified: 到了以后请和我连络。
exampleTraditional: 到了以後請和我連絡。
exampleEnglish: Please get in touch with me after you arrive.
hintSimplified: 和别人通电话或传消息,让对方知道你的情况。
hintTraditional: 和別人通電話或傳訊息,讓對方知道你的情況。
hintEnglish: Calling or messaging someone so they know how you are doing.

definition: (math.) connection; liaison; to contact; to get in touch with; to stay in contact (with)
exampleSimplified: 毕业以后,我们还常常互相联络。
exampleTraditional: 畢業以後,我們還常常互相聯絡。
exampleEnglish: After graduating, we still often keep in touch with each other.
hintSimplified: 和别人保持沟通,让彼此能找到对方。
hintTraditional: 和別人保持溝通,讓彼此能找到對方。
hintEnglish: Maintaining communication with others so you can reach each other.

exampleSimplified: 他们结婚五年后就离婚了。
exampleTraditional: 他們結婚五年後就離婚了。
exampleEnglish: They got divorced after being married for five years.
hintSimplified: 夫妻正式结束婚姻关系。
hintTraditional: 夫妻正式結束婚姻關係。
hintEnglish: A married couple formally ends their marriage.

exampleSimplified: 书包里边有一本书和一支笔。
exampleTraditional: 書包裡邊有一本書和一支筆。
exampleEnglish: Inside the bag there is a book and a pen.
hintSimplified: 表示在某个东西的内部,不是外面。
hintTraditional: 表示在某個東西的內部,不是外面。
hintEnglish: Indicates the interior of something, not the outside.

gloss: (of a person) stern; strict; harsh; shrewd; tough
definition: (of a person) stern; strict; harsh; shrewd; tough; (of a resemblance) striking; (of an animal) fierce; (of bacteria) virulent; (of liquor or chili pepper) strong; (used to describe sb or sth that makes a very strong impression, whether favorable or unfavorable) terrible; intense; severe; devastating; amazing; awesome; outstanding
exampleSimplified: 他篮球打得很厉害,大家都佩服他。
exampleTraditional: 他籃球打得很厲害,大家都佩服他。
exampleEnglish: He plays basketball very well, and everyone admires him.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人能力很强,或者程度很严重。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人能力很強,或者程度很嚴重。
hintEnglish: Describes a person with great ability, or something of serious degree.

exampleSimplified: 我很理解你现在的心情。
exampleTraditional: 我很理解你現在的心情。
exampleEnglish: I really understand how you feel right now.
hintSimplified: 明白别人的想法或感受,能站在对方的立场想。
hintTraditional: 明白別人的想法或感受,能站在對方的立場想。
hintEnglish: Grasping someone's thoughts or feelings and seeing from their position.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; theory; to argue; to take notice of
exampleSimplified: 这个理论可以解释很多自然现象。
exampleTraditional: 這個理論可以解釋很多自然現象。
exampleEnglish: This theory can explain many natural phenomena.
hintSimplified: 科学家根据研究提出的系统性看法,和实际做法相对。
hintTraditional: 科學家根據研究提出的系統性看法,和實際做法相對。
hintEnglish: A systematic view proposed by scientists from research, as opposed to practice.

exampleSimplified: 毕业典礼在学校的礼堂举行。
exampleTraditional: 畢業典禮在學校的禮堂舉行。
exampleEnglish: The graduation ceremony is held in the school auditorium.
hintSimplified: 学校或机关里举行大型集会、典礼的大厅。
hintTraditional: 學校或機關裡舉行大型集會、典禮的大廳。
hintEnglish: A big hall in a school or institution where large gatherings and ceremonies are held.

exampleSimplified: 大家团结起来,力量就会很大。
exampleTraditional: 大家團結起來,力量就會很大。
exampleEnglish: If everyone unites, the strength will be great.
hintSimplified: 人或事物能产生作用、推动东西的能力。
hintTraditional: 人或事物能產生作用、推動東西的能力。
hintEnglish: The ability of a person or thing to have an effect or move things.

definition: CL:位[wei4],個|个[ge4]; lead; leader; leadership; leading; to lead
exampleSimplified: 我们的领导今天要开会。
exampleTraditional: 我們的領導今天要開會。
exampleEnglish: Our boss is holding a meeting today.
hintSimplified: 在公司或机关里带领大家、地位比较高的人。
hintTraditional: 在公司或機關裡帶領大家、地位比較高的人。
hintEnglish: A person of higher rank in a company or institution who guides others.

exampleSimplified: 有人相信人死后灵魂会离开身体。
exampleTraditional: 有人相信人死後靈魂會離開身體。
exampleEnglish: Some people believe the soul leaves the body after death.
hintSimplified: 人们认为它存在于身体里,人死后仍会继续存在。
hintTraditional: 人們認為它存在於身體裡,人死後仍會繼續存在。
hintEnglish: People believe it exists inside the body and continues after death.

exampleSimplified: 他在科学领域有很大的成就。
exampleTraditional: 他在科學領域有很大的成就。
exampleEnglish: He has made great achievements in the field of science.
hintSimplified: 指某种学问、工作或活动所涉及的范围。
hintTraditional: 指某種學問、工作或活動所涉及的範圍。
hintEnglish: The scope covered by a certain discipline, job, or activity.

definition: message; to leave a message; to leave one's comments
exampleSimplified: 你可以在网站上给我留言。
exampleTraditional: 你可以在網站上給我留言。
exampleEnglish: You can leave me a message on the website.
hintSimplified: 对方不在时,把想说的话写下来或录下来给他。
hintTraditional: 對方不在時,把想說的話寫下來或錄下來給他。
hintEnglish: When the other person is absent, writing or recording what you want to say.

exampleSimplified: 他的手被刀割伤了,一直流血。
exampleTraditional: 他的手被刀割傷了,一直流血。
exampleEnglish: His hand was cut by a knife and keeps bleeding.
hintSimplified: 身体受伤时,红色的液体从伤口出来。
hintTraditional: 身體受傷時,紅色的液體從傷口出來。
hintEnglish: When the body is hurt, red liquid comes out of the wound.

exampleSimplified: 她打算明年去日本留学。
exampleTraditional: 她打算明年去日本留學。
exampleEnglish: She plans to study abroad in Japan next year.
hintSimplified: 到外国的学校读书一段时间。
hintTraditional: 到外國的學校讀書一段時間。
hintEnglish: Going to school in a foreign country for a period of time.

definition: a dream; an ideal; ideal; perfect
exampleSimplified: 他的理想是当一名医生。
exampleTraditional: 他的理想是當一名醫生。
exampleEnglish: His dream is to become a doctor.
hintSimplified: 一个人希望将来达到的美好目标。
hintTraditional: 一個人希望將來達到的美好目標。
hintEnglish: A beautiful goal a person hopes to reach in the future.

exampleSimplified: 做决定时,不能只想到自己的利益。
exampleTraditional: 做決定時,不能只想到自己的利益。
exampleEnglish: When making a decision, you can't think only of your own interests.
hintSimplified: 人们做生意或谈判时,都想为自己争取的好处。
hintTraditional: 人們做生意或談判時,都想為自己爭取的好處。
hintEnglish: In business or negotiations, people all want to secure these benefits for themselves.

exampleSimplified: 火车站里有很多拿着行李的旅客。
exampleTraditional: 火車站裡有很多拿著行李的旅客。
exampleEnglish: There are many travelers carrying luggage in the train station.
hintSimplified: 他们坐火车或飞机去外地,不是本地人。
hintTraditional: 他們坐火車或飛機去外地,不是本地人。
hintEnglish: They take trains or planes to other places and are not locals.

definition: journey; to travel; tour; tourism; travel; trip
exampleSimplified: 暑假我们打算去日本旅游。
exampleTraditional: 暑假我們打算去日本旅遊。
exampleEnglish: This summer vacation we plan to travel to Japan.
hintSimplified: 放假时到别的地方玩、看风景。
hintTraditional: 放假時到別的地方玩、看風景。
hintEnglish: Going to other places during a holiday to have fun and see the sights.

exampleSimplified: 他的哥哥是一位很有名的律师。
exampleTraditional: 他的哥哥是一位很有名的律師。
exampleEnglish: His older brother is a very famous lawyer.
hintSimplified: 这种人懂法律,在法院里帮别人打官司。
hintTraditional: 這種人懂法律,在法院裡幫別人打官司。
hintEnglish: This person knows the law and helps others in court.

gloss: to accept an applicant (prospective student, employee etc) who passes an entrance exam
definition: to accept an applicant (prospective student, employee etc) who passes an entrance exam; to admit (a student); to hire (a job candidate)
exampleSimplified: 他考上了,已经被台湾大学录取了。
exampleTraditional: 他考上了,已經被台灣大學錄取了。
exampleEnglish: He passed the exam and has been admitted by National Taiwan University.
hintSimplified: 考试成绩够好,学校或公司决定接受你。
hintTraditional: 考試成績夠好,學校或公司決定接受你。
hintEnglish: Your exam results are good enough, so a school or company decides to accept you.

definition: an audio recording (CL:段[duan4]); to record sound
exampleSimplified: 老师让我们用手机做英语录音。
exampleTraditional: 老師讓我們用手機做英語錄音。
exampleEnglish: The teacher had us make English recordings with our phones.
hintSimplified: 用机器把声音存起来,以后可以再听。
hintTraditional: 用機器把聲音存起來,以後可以再聽。
hintEnglish: Using a device to save sound so you can listen again later.

exampleSimplified: 周末我们全家去山上露营。
exampleTraditional: 週末我們全家去山上露營。
exampleEnglish: This weekend our whole family is going camping in the mountains.
hintSimplified: 在野外搭帐篷,晚上睡在外面。
hintTraditional: 在野外搭帳篷,晚上睡在外面。
hintEnglish: Setting up a tent outdoors and sleeping outside at night.

exampleSimplified: 这辆车的轮胎没气了,需要换新的。
exampleTraditional: 這輛車的輪胎沒氣了,需要換新的。
exampleEnglish: This car's tires are flat and need to be replaced with new ones.
hintSimplified: 汽车或机车装在轮子外面的黑色圆形橡胶。
hintTraditional: 汽車或機車裝在輪子外面的黑色圓形橡膠。
hintEnglish: The black round rubber fitted around the wheels of a car or scooter.

exampleSimplified: 我对这次的旅行非常满意。
exampleTraditional: 我對這次的旅行非常滿意。
exampleEnglish: I am very satisfied with this trip.
hintSimplified: 事情和你想的一样好,你觉得很高兴,没有意见。
hintTraditional: 事情和你想的一樣好,你覺得很高興,沒有意見。
hintEnglish: Things are as good as you hoped, so you're happy and have no complaints.

definition: content; satisfied; to meet (the needs of); to satisfy
exampleSimplified: 有健康的身体,他就觉得很满足了。
exampleTraditional: 有健康的身體,他就覺得很滿足了。
exampleEnglish: As long as he has a healthy body, he feels content.
hintSimplified: 得到想要的东西后,觉得够了,不再要求更多。
hintTraditional: 得到想要的東西后,覺得夠了,不再要求更多。
hintEnglish: After getting what you want, you feel it's enough and don't ask for more.

exampleSimplified: 请慢慢说,我听不太懂。
exampleTraditional: 請慢慢說,我聽不太懂。
exampleEnglish: Please speak slowly; I don't quite understand.
hintSimplified: 速度不快,一点一点地做事或说话。
hintTraditional: 速度不快,一點一點地做事或說話。
hintEnglish: Not fast; doing or saying something little by little.

gloss: same as 慢慢吃[man4 man4 chi1]
definition: same as 慢慢吃[man4 man4 chi1]
exampleSimplified: 菜都上齐了,请慢用。
exampleTraditional: 菜都上齊了,請慢用。
exampleEnglish: All the dishes have been served; please enjoy your meal.
hintSimplified: 服务员把餐点送上桌后,常对客人说的客气话。
hintTraditional: 服務員把餐點送上桌後,常對客人說的客氣話。
hintEnglish: A polite phrase a waiter often says to guests after serving the food.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷喜欢用毛笔写书法。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺喜歡用毛筆寫書法。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa likes to write calligraphy with a brush.
hintSimplified: 写书法或画国画时用的传统笔,要沾墨水。
hintTraditional: 寫書法或畫國畫時用的傳統筆,要沾墨水。
hintEnglish: A traditional pen dipped in ink, used for calligraphy or Chinese painting.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; ailment; defect; fault; shortcomings
exampleSimplified: 我的电脑有点毛病,常常自己关机。
exampleTraditional: 我的電腦有點毛病,常常自己關機。
exampleEnglish: There's something wrong with my computer; it often shuts down by itself.
hintSimplified: 机器出了小问题,或人有不好的小习惯。
hintTraditional: 機器出了小問題,或人有不好的小習慣。
hintEnglish: A small problem in a machine, or a bad little habit in a person.

exampleSimplified: 台湾和很多国家都有贸易往来。
exampleTraditional: 台灣和很多國家都有貿易往來。
exampleEnglish: Taiwan has trade relations with many countries.
hintSimplified: 国家或公司之间买卖商品的活动。
hintTraditional: 國家或公司之間買賣商品的活動。
hintEnglish: The activity of buying and selling goods between countries or companies.

definition: chamber pot; toilet bowl; wooden pan used as toilet
exampleSimplified: 浴室的马桶坏了,要请人来修。
exampleTraditional: 浴室的馬桶壞了,要請人來修。
exampleEnglish: The toilet in the bathroom is broken; we need to call someone to fix it.
hintSimplified: 浴室里坐着上厕所用的设备。
hintTraditional: 浴室裡坐著上廁所用的裝置。
hintEnglish: The fixture in the bathroom that you sit on to go to the toilet.

exampleSimplified: 船停在码头,工人正在搬货。
exampleTraditional: 船停在碼頭,工人正在搬貨。
exampleEnglish: The ship is docked at the pier, and workers are moving cargo.
hintSimplified: 海边或河边让船靠岸、上下客人和货物的地方。
hintTraditional: 海邊或河邊讓船靠岸、上下客人和貨物的地方。
hintEnglish: A place by the sea or river where boats stop and people and goods get on and off.

exampleSimplified: 桌子上有很多蚂蚁,好像在找吃的。
exampleTraditional: 桌子上有很多螞蟻,好像在找吃的。
exampleEnglish: There are many ants on the table, as if looking for food.
hintSimplified: 一种很小的黑色昆虫,喜欢吃甜的,常排成一行走。
hintTraditional: 一種很小的黑色昆蟲,喜歡吃甜的,常排成一行走。
hintEnglish: A tiny black insect that likes sweet things and often walks in a line.

definition: rose flower (CL:朵[duo3]); rugosa rose (shrub) (Rosa rugosa) (CL:棵[ke1])
exampleSimplified: 他在情人节送了她一束红玫瑰。
exampleTraditional: 他在情人節送了她一束紅玫瑰。
exampleEnglish: On Valentine's Day he gave her a bouquet of red roses.
hintSimplified: 有刺的花,常是红色,象征爱情。
hintTraditional: 有刺的花,常是紅色,象徵愛情。
hintEnglish: A thorny flower, often red, which symbolizes love.

exampleSimplified: 我们一起度过了美好的一天。
exampleTraditional: 我們一起度過了美好的一天。
exampleEnglish: We spent a wonderful day together.
hintSimplified: 形容回忆、生活或未来很好、让人愉快。
hintTraditional: 形容回憶、生活或未來很好、讓人愉快。
hintEnglish: Describes memories, life or the future as very good and pleasant.

exampleSimplified: 她的笑容非常迷人。
exampleTraditional: 她的笑容非常迷人。
exampleEnglish: Her smile is very charming.
hintSimplified: 形容人或风景很有吸引力,让人想一直看。
hintTraditional: 形容人或風景很有吸引力,讓人想一直看。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or scenery so attractive that you want to keep looking.

definition: (math.) to osculate; close; intimate; closely; intently; carefully; to strengthen (ties, cooperation etc)
exampleSimplified: 这两家公司的关系非常密切。
exampleTraditional: 這兩家公司的關係非常密切。
exampleEnglish: The relationship between these two companies is very close.
hintSimplified: 形容关系很亲近、联系很多,分不开。
hintTraditional: 形容關係很親近、聯絡很多,分不開。
hintEnglish: Describes a relationship that is very near, with lots of contact, hard to separate.

exampleSimplified: 这家博物馆星期天免费参观。
exampleTraditional: 這家博物館星期天免費參觀。
exampleEnglish: This museum is free to visit on Sundays.
hintSimplified: 不用付钱就可以使用或得到。
hintTraditional: 不用付錢就可以使用或得到。
hintEnglish: You can use or get something without paying money.

gloss: area (of a floor, piece of land etc)
definition: area (of a floor, piece of land etc); surface area; tract of land
exampleSimplified: 这间房子的面积有三十平方米。
exampleTraditional: 這間房子的面積有三十平方米。
exampleEnglish: The area of this room is thirty square meters.
hintSimplified: 用平方米来算的,表示地方有多大。
hintTraditional: 用平方米來算的,表示地方有多大。
hintEnglish: Measured in square meters, it shows how large a place is.

definition: (in the) presence (of); facing; in front of
exampleSimplified: 他站在大家面前,有点紧张。
exampleTraditional: 他站在大家面前,有點緊張。
exampleEnglish: He stood in front of everyone, feeling a bit nervous.
hintSimplified: 表示在某人或某物正对着的前方位置。
hintTraditional: 表示在某人或某物正對著的前方位置。
hintEnglish: Indicates the position directly ahead of or facing someone or something.

exampleSimplified: 我今天中午想吃一碗牛肉面条。
exampleTraditional: 我今天中午想吃一碗牛肉麵條。
exampleEnglish: I want to eat a bowl of beef noodles at lunch today.
hintSimplified: 这种食物细细长长的,可以煮汤,也可以用筷子夹着吃。
hintTraditional: 這種食物細細長長的,可以煮湯,也可以用筷子夾著吃。
hintEnglish: This food is thin and long, can be cooked in soup, and is eaten with chopsticks.

definition: depiction; portrayal; to describe; to depict; to portray
exampleSimplified: 这位作家把秋天的风景描写得很美。
exampleTraditional: 這位作家把秋天的風景描寫得很美。
exampleEnglish: This writer described the autumn scenery very beautifully.

exampleEnglish: The teacher repeatedly stresses that homework must be done carefully.
hintSimplified: 说话时特别指出某件事很重要，让大家注意。
hintTraditional: 說話時特別指出某件事很重要，讓大家注意。
hintEnglish: When speaking, to point out that something is especially important so everyone pays attention.

exampleSimplified: 他在学校常常被同学欺负。
exampleTraditional: 他在學校常常被同學欺負。
exampleEnglish: He is often bullied by classmates at school.
hintSimplified: 强壮的人用不好的方式对待比较弱小的人。
hintTraditional: 強壯的人用不好的方式對待比較弱小的人。
hintEnglish: When a stronger person treats a weaker person badly.

exampleSimplified: 首先要有计划，其次要努力去做。
exampleTraditional: 首先要有計劃，其次要努力去做。
exampleEnglish: First you need a plan, and next you need to work hard to carry it out.
hintSimplified: 列出几点时，放在“首先”后面，说第二点。
hintTraditional: 列出幾點時，放在“首先”後面，說第二點。
hintEnglish: When listing points, it comes after “first” to introduce the second one.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; period; period of time; time; time period
exampleSimplified: 暑假期间，我去打工赚钱。
exampleTraditional: 暑假期間，我去打工賺錢。
exampleEnglish: During the summer vacation, I worked part-time to earn money.
hintSimplified: 表示某一段时间之内，常放在假期或活动后面。
hintTraditional: 表示某一段時間之內，常放在假期或活動後面。
hintEnglish: Indicates within a certain stretch of time, often placed after a holiday or event.

gloss: (fig.) (of an enterprise etc) to start to develop rapidly
definition: (fig.) (of an enterprise etc) to start to develop rapidly; (of an aircraft or rocket) to take off; to lift off
exampleSimplified: 飞机准时起飞了。
exampleTraditional: 飛機準時起飛了。
exampleEnglish: The plane took off on time.
hintSimplified: 飞机离开地面，开始飞向天空。
hintTraditional: 飛機離開地面，開始飛向天空。
hintEnglish: An aircraft leaves the ground and begins to rise into the sky.

definition: amiable; close and dear; cordial; familiar
exampleSimplified: 这家店的老板对客人很亲切。
exampleTraditional: 這家店的老闆對客人很親切。
exampleEnglish: The owner of this shop is very warm and friendly to customers.
hintSimplified: 形容人的态度温和友善，让人觉得很舒服、很接近。
hintTraditional: 形容人的態度溫和友善，讓人覺得很舒服、很接近。
hintEnglish: Describes a gentle, friendly attitude that makes people feel comfortable and close.

exampleSimplified: 妈妈亲手为我做了生日蛋糕。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽親手為我做了生日蛋糕。
exampleEnglish: Mom made my birthday cake with her own hands.
hintSimplified: 不是请别人帮忙，而是用自己的双手去做。
hintTraditional: 不是請別人幫忙，而是用自己的雙手去做。
hintEnglish: Not asking others for help, but doing it using one's own two hands.

exampleSimplified: 我亲眼看到他把钱捡起来还给别人。
exampleTraditional: 我親眼看到他把錢撿起來還給別人。
exampleEnglish: I saw with my own eyes him pick up the money and return it to someone.
hintSimplified: 不是听别人说，而是自己用眼睛看到。
hintTraditional: 不是聽別人說，而是自己用眼睛看到。
hintEnglish: Not hearing it from others, but seeing it using one's own eyes.

exampleSimplified: 经理亲自去机场接客人。
exampleTraditional: 經理親自去機場接客人。
exampleEnglish: The manager went to the airport in person to pick up the guests.
hintSimplified: 不派别人，而是自己本人到场去做。
hintTraditional: 不派別人，而是自己本人到場去做。
hintEnglish: Not sending someone else, but being present and doing it oneself.

definition: the young; young person; youth; youthful years
exampleSimplified: 现在的青年很重视工作和生活的平衡。
exampleTraditional: 現在的青年很重視工作和生活的平衡。
exampleEnglish: Young people today value the balance between work and life.
hintSimplified: 指年纪大约十几岁到三十几岁的人。
hintTraditional: 指年紀大約十幾歲到三十幾歲的人。
hintEnglish: Refers to people roughly in their teens to thirties.

definition: CL:種|种[zhong3]; circumstances; state of affairs; situation
exampleSimplified: 请你说明一下现在的情况。
exampleTraditional: 請你說明一下現在的情況。
exampleEnglish: Please explain the current situation.
hintSimplified: 指事情发展的样子或目前的状态。
hintTraditional: 指事情發展的樣子或目前的狀態。
hintEnglish: Refers to how things stand or the current state of affairs.

exampleSimplified: 情人节那天，他送给情人一束花。
exampleTraditional: 情人節那天，他送給情人一束花。
exampleEnglish: On Valentine's Day, he gave his sweetheart a bouquet of flowers.
hintSimplified: 互相相爱的两个人中的另一方，常在浪漫节日收到礼物。
hintTraditional: 互相相愛的兩個人中的另一方，常在浪漫節日收到禮物。
hintEnglish: One of two people in love, who often receives gifts on a romantic holiday.

exampleSimplified: 我感冒了，想向老板请假一天。
exampleTraditional: 我感冒了，想向老闆請假一天。
exampleEnglish: I have a cold and want to ask my boss for a day off.
hintSimplified: 因为生病或有事，向学校或公司申请不去上课、上班。
hintTraditional: 因為生病或有事，向學校或公司申請不去上課、上班。
hintEnglish: Because of illness or business, to ask the school or company for permission not to attend.

definition: to ask for guidance; to consult
exampleSimplified: 我想向您请教一个问题。
exampleTraditional: 我想向您請教一個問題。
exampleEnglish: I would like to ask you for advice on a question.
hintSimplified: 很有礼貌地向懂得多的人询问，希望得到指点。
hintTraditional: 很有禮貌地向懂得多的人詢問，希望得到指點。
hintEnglish: Politely asking someone more knowledgeable, hoping to receive guidance.

definition: request (CL:個|个[ge4]); to request; to ask
exampleSimplified: 他提出了一个合理的请求。
exampleTraditional: 他提出了一個合理的請求。
exampleEnglish: He made a reasonable request.
hintSimplified: 希望别人答应或帮忙时，所提出的话。
hintTraditional: 希望別人答應或幫忙時，所提出的話。
hintEnglish: What you say when you hope someone will agree or help.

exampleSimplified: 我们一起去餐厅庆祝他的生日。
exampleTraditional: 我們一起去餐廳慶祝他的生日。
exampleEnglish: Let's go to a restaurant together to celebrate his birthday.
hintSimplified: 遇到喜事时，大家一起高兴地做活动。
hintTraditional: 遇到喜事時，大家一起高興地做活動。
hintEnglish: When something joyful happens, people do an activity together happily.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],處|处[chu4]; court; field; golf course; pitch; sports ground; stadium
exampleSimplified: 孩子们在球场上练习踢球。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們在球場上練習踢球。
exampleEnglish: The kids are practicing kicking the ball on the field.
hintSimplified: 打篮球、踢足球等比赛或练习的地方。
hintTraditional: 打籃球、踢足球等比賽或練習的地方。
hintEnglish: The place where basketball, soccer and similar games or practice take place.

exampleSimplified: 昨天的球赛非常精彩。
exampleTraditional: 昨天的球賽非常精彩。
exampleEnglish: Yesterday's ball game was very exciting.
hintSimplified: 两队用球互相比分数的活动。
hintTraditional: 兩隊用球互相比分數的活動。
hintEnglish: An event where two teams compete for points using a ball.

exampleSimplified: 这位球员每天都练习很久。
exampleTraditional: 這位球員每天都練習很久。
exampleEnglish: This player trains for a long time every day.
hintSimplified: 在球队里上场比赛的人。
hintTraditional: 在球隊裡上場比賽的人。
hintEnglish: A person who plays in games for a ball team.

exampleSimplified: 今天的气温只有十度，很冷。
exampleTraditional: 今天的氣溫只有十度，很冷。
exampleEnglish: Today the temperature is only ten degrees, which is cold.
hintSimplified: 天气预报会告诉你空气有多冷或多热的数字。
hintTraditional: 天氣預報會告訴你空氣有多冷或多熱的數字。
hintEnglish: The number a weather forecast gives for how cold or hot the air is.

exampleSimplified: 这家企业有一千多名员工。
exampleTraditional: 這家企業有一千多名員工。
exampleEnglish: This enterprise has over a thousand employees.
hintSimplified: 从事生产或买卖的大型公司或组织。
hintTraditional: 從事生產或買賣的大型公司或組織。
hintEnglish: A large company or organization engaged in production or trade.

exampleSimplified: 他的爷爷去年去世了。
exampleTraditional: 他的爺爺去年去世了。
exampleEnglish: His grandfather passed away last year.
hintSimplified: 说人不再活着的一种礼貌、委婉的说法。
hintTraditional: 說人不再活著的一種禮貌、委婉的說法。
hintEnglish: A polite, gentle way of saying a person is no longer alive.

exampleSimplified: 这个问题影响了全球的经济。
exampleTraditional: 這個問題影響了全球的經濟。
exampleEnglish: This problem has affected the economy of the whole world.
hintSimplified: 指地球上所有的国家和地方。
hintTraditional: 指地球上所有的國家和地方。
hintEnglish: Refers to all the countries and places on Earth.

exampleSimplified: 跑完步以后，我全身都是汗。
exampleTraditional: 跑完步以後，我全身都是汗。
exampleEnglish: After running, my whole body was covered in sweat.
hintSimplified: 从头到脚，整个身体。
hintTraditional: 從頭到腳，整個身體。
hintEnglish: From head to toe, the entire body.

definition: (chemistry) substitution; to replace; to supersede; to supplant
exampleSimplified: 机器人可能会取代一些简单的工作。
exampleTraditional: 機器人可能會取代一些簡單的工作。
exampleEnglish: Robots may replace some simple jobs.
hintSimplified: 用一个新的人或东西换掉原来的，自己占了它的位置。
hintTraditional: 用一個新的人或東西換掉原來的，自己佔了它的位置。
hintEnglish: When a new person or thing takes the place of the original one.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; disadvantage; fault; shortcoming; weak point
exampleSimplified: 每个人都有自己的优点和缺点。
exampleTraditional: 每個人都有自己的優點和缺點。
exampleEnglish: Everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses.
hintSimplified: 和优点相反,指人或东西不好的地方。
hintTraditional: 和優點相反,指人或東西不好的地方。
hintEnglish: The opposite of a strong point; the bad side of a person or thing.

definition: OK (on computer dialog box); certain; definite; fixed; to ascertain; to be sure; to clinch; to confirm; to determine; to ensure; to fix (on sth); to make certain; to recognize
exampleSimplified: 你确定明天会下雨吗?
exampleTraditional: 你確定明天會下雨嗎?
exampleEnglish: Are you sure it will rain tomorrow?
hintSimplified: 心里很清楚,没有怀疑,也可以指决定下来。
hintTraditional: 心裡很清楚,沒有懷疑,也可以指決定下來。
hintEnglish: To be clear and without doubt in your mind, or to settle on a decision.

exampleSimplified: 请你再确认一下我的订位。
exampleTraditional: 請你再確認一下我的訂位。
exampleEnglish: Please confirm my reservation once more.
hintSimplified: 订了机票或餐厅以后,再检查一次是不是没有问题。
hintTraditional: 訂了機票或餐廳以後,再檢查一次是不是沒有問題。
hintEnglish: After booking a flight or restaurant, you check again that everything is correct.

definition: to know; to recognize; to remember sth (or sb) on seeing it
exampleSimplified: 你认得这个字怎么念吗?
exampleTraditional: 你認得這個字怎麼念嗎?
exampleEnglish: Do you recognize how this character is pronounced?
hintSimplified: 看到人或字的时候,知道他是谁或是什么字。
hintTraditional: 看到人或字的時候,知道他是誰或是什麼字。
hintEnglish: When you see a person or a character, you know who or what it is.

exampleSimplified: 已经很晚了,他仍然在写作业。
exampleTraditional: 已經很晚了,他仍然在寫作業。
exampleEnglish: It is already late, and he is still doing his homework.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示情况和以前一样,没有改变。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示情況和以前一樣,沒有改變。
hintEnglish: An adverb showing that the situation has not changed from before.

definition: CL:戶|户[hu4],家[jia1]; I, me (referring to oneself as "one" or "people"); dwelling; family; he, she or they; house of woman's husband-to-be; household; household business; other people; sb else; sb else's house
exampleSimplified: 人家都已经道歉了,你就原谅他吧。
exampleTraditional: 人家都已經道歉了,你就原諒他吧。
exampleEnglish: He has already apologized, so just forgive him.
hintSimplified: 指别的人,不是说话的人,有时也是撒娇时说自己。
hintTraditional: 指別的人,不是說話的人,有時也是撒嬌時說自己。
hintEnglish: Refers to other people, and sometimes is used playfully to mean oneself.

exampleSimplified: 他说这里的风景像天上,不像人间。
exampleTraditional: 他說這裡的風景像天上,不像人間。
exampleEnglish: He said the scenery here is like heaven, not like the human world.
hintSimplified: 和天上相对,指人类生活的世界。
hintTraditional: 和天上相對,指人類生活的世界。
hintEnglish: The world where humans live, in contrast to heaven.

exampleSimplified: 台北的人口比台南多很多。
exampleTraditional: 台北的人口比臺南多很多。
exampleEnglish: Taipei has a much larger population than Tainan.
hintSimplified: 一个城市或国家里一共有多少人。
hintTraditional: 一個城市或國家裡一共有多少人。
hintEnglish: The total number of people living in a city or country.

exampleSimplified: 保护环境对人类很重要。
exampleTraditional: 保護環境對人類很重要。
exampleEnglish: Protecting the environment is very important to humankind.
hintSimplified: 地球上所有的人合起来的说法。
hintTraditional: 地球上所有的人合起來的說法。
hintEnglish: A term for all people on Earth taken together.

exampleSimplified: 人们都喜欢在周末出去玩。
exampleTraditional: 人們都喜歡在週末出去玩。
exampleEnglish: People all like to go out on weekends.
hintSimplified: 泛指很多人,是“人”的复数说法。
hintTraditional: 泛指很多人,是“人”的複數說法。
hintEnglish: A general term for many persons; the plural form of person.

exampleSimplified: 政府应该为人民做更多事情。
exampleTraditional: 政府應該為人民做更多事情。
exampleEnglish: The government should do more for its people.
hintSimplified: 一个国家里的普通大众,常和政府相对。
hintTraditional: 一個國家裡的普通大眾,常和政府相對。
hintEnglish: The ordinary public of a country, often contrasted with the government.

exampleSimplified: 这个好消息,人人都很高兴。
exampleTraditional: 這個好訊息,人人都很高興。
exampleEnglish: Everyone was happy about this good news.
hintSimplified: 每一个人,没有例外。
hintTraditional: 每一個人,沒有例外。
hintEnglish: Each and every person, without exception.

exampleSimplified: 参加今天活动的人数不太多。
exampleTraditional: 參加今天活動的人數不太多。
exampleEnglish: The number of people attending today's event is not very large.
hintSimplified: 用来说一共有几个人、多少个人的数字。
hintTraditional: 用來說一共有幾個人、多少個人的數字。
hintEnglish: The figure showing how many people there are in total.

gloss: (genre of traditional Chinese painting) figure painting
definition: (genre of traditional Chinese painting) figure painting; character (in a play, novel etc); person; personage; figure (esp. sb of importance)
exampleSimplified: 这本小说里的人物很有意思。
exampleTraditional: 這本小說裡的人物很有意思。
exampleEnglish: The characters in this novel are very interesting.
hintSimplified: 故事里出现的角色,或社会上重要的人。
hintTraditional: 故事裡出現的角色,或社會上重要的人。
hintEnglish: A role appearing in a story, or an important figure in society.

gloss: to endure; to put up with; to exercise patience
definition: to endure; to put up with; to exercise patience
exampleSimplified: 他忍耐了很久,最后还是生气了。
exampleTraditional: 他忍耐了很久,最後還是生氣了。
exampleEnglish: He put up with it for a long time, but finally got angry.
hintSimplified: 心里不舒服,但是控制自己,不发脾气。
hintTraditional: 心裡不舒服,但是控制自己,不發脾氣。
hintEnglish: Feeling uncomfortable but controlling yourself without losing your temper.

definition: CL:項|项[xiang4]; mission; assignment; task; duty; role
exampleSimplified: 老板给我一个很重要的任务。
exampleTraditional: 老闆給我一個很重要的任務。
exampleEnglish: The boss gave me a very important task.
hintSimplified: 上级交给你,一定要完成的工作。
hintTraditional: 上級交給你,一定要完成的工作。
hintEnglish: Work assigned to you by a superior that you must complete.

exampleSimplified: 冬天早上我喜欢喝一杯热水。
exampleTraditional: 冬天早上我喜歡喝一杯熱水。
exampleEnglish: In winter mornings I like to drink a glass of hot water.
hintSimplified: 烧开以后温度很高的水,洗澡或泡茶会用。
hintTraditional: 燒開以後溫度很高的水,洗澡或泡茶會用。
hintEnglish: Water that has been heated to a high temperature, used for baths or making tea.

exampleSimplified: 我们早上四点起床去山上看日出。
exampleTraditional: 我們早上四點起床去山上看日出。
exampleEnglish: We got up at four in the morning to watch the sunrise in the mountains.
hintSimplified: 早上太阳从东边慢慢升起来的时候。
hintTraditional: 早上太陽從東邊慢慢升起來的時候。
hintEnglish: The moment in the morning when the sun slowly rises in the east.

exampleSimplified: 请在表格上写下今天的日期。
exampleTraditional: 請在表格上寫下今天的日期。
exampleEnglish: Please write today's date on the form.
hintSimplified: 某一年某一月某一天的写法。
hintTraditional: 某一年某一月某一天的寫法。
hintEnglish: The way of writing a specific year, month and day.

exampleSimplified: 事情既然如此,我们就只好等了。
exampleTraditional: 事情既然如此,我們就只好等了。
exampleEnglish: Since that's how things are, we can only wait.
hintSimplified: 指前面说过的情况,意思是“像这样”。
hintTraditional: 指前面說過的情況,意思是“像這樣”。
hintEnglish: Refers to a situation just mentioned, meaning "like this".

exampleSimplified: 会议的时间和地点如下。
exampleTraditional: 會議的時間和地點如下。
exampleEnglish: The time and place of the meeting are as follows.
hintSimplified: 在通知里,用来引出后面要列出的内容。
hintTraditional: 在通知裡,用來引出後面要列出的內容。
hintEnglish: Used in notices to introduce the content listed afterward.

gloss: as one wants; according to one's wishes
definition: as one wants; according to one's wishes; ruyi scepter, a symbol of power and good fortune
exampleSimplified: 祝你新的一年万事如意。
exampleTraditional: 祝你新的一年萬事如意。
exampleEnglish: Wishing you everything goes as you wish in the new year.
hintSimplified: 新年常说的祝福,希望事情都照自己的想法发展。
hintTraditional: 新年常說的祝福,希望事情都照自己的想法發展。
hintEnglish: A common New Year blessing hoping things go according to your wishes.

exampleSimplified: 这片森林里住着很多小动物。
exampleTraditional: 這片森林裡住著很多小動物。
exampleEnglish: Many small animals live in this forest.
hintSimplified: 有很多很多树的大片地方。
hintTraditional: 有很多很多樹的大片地方。
hintEnglish: A large area covered with a great many trees.

gloss: to break up (in a romantic relationship)
definition: to break up (in a romantic relationship); to feel jilted; to lose one's love
exampleSimplified: 他失恋以后,好几天都不想吃饭。
exampleTraditional: 他失戀以後,好幾天都不想吃飯。
exampleEnglish: After his breakup, he didn't feel like eating for several days.
hintSimplified: 和男朋友或女朋友分手后,心里很难过。
hintTraditional: 和男朋友或女朋友分手後,心裡很難過。
hintEnglish: The sadness you feel after parting from a boyfriend or girlfriend.

exampleSimplified: 不要因为一次失败就失去信心。
exampleTraditional: 不要因為一次失敗就失去信心。
exampleEnglish: Don't lose confidence just because of one failure.
hintSimplified: 原来有的东西,现在没有了。
hintTraditional: 原來有的東西,現在沒有了。
hintEnglish: Something you used to have is no longer with you.

definition: CL:隻|只[zhi1],頭|头[tou2]; Leo (star sign); Shihtzu township in Pingtung County 屏東縣|屏东县[Ping2 dong1 Xian4], Taiwan; lion
exampleSimplified: 动物园里的狮子正在睡觉。
exampleTraditional: 動物園裡的獅子正在睡覺。
exampleEnglish: The lion in the zoo is sleeping.
hintSimplified: 这种大型猫科动物被称为百兽之王,雄的有长长的鬃毛。
hintTraditional: 這種大型貓科動物被稱為百獸之王,雄的有長長的鬃毛。
hintEnglish: This large feline is called the king of beasts, and the male has a long mane.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; Time, US weekly news magazine; age; epoch; era; period (in one's life)
exampleSimplified: 现在是网络时代,大家都用手机。
exampleTraditional: 現在是網路時代,大家都用手機。
exampleEnglish: Now is the internet age; everyone uses a mobile phone.
hintSimplified: 指历史上有某种特点的一段很长的时间,例如石器、信息这样的阶段。
hintTraditional: 指歷史上有某種特點的一段很長的時間,例如石器、資訊這樣的階段。
hintEnglish: A long period in history with a particular character, such as the stone or information stage.

definition: absolutely; completely; extremely; hundred percent; to divide into ten equal parts; utterly; very
exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅的菜十分好吃。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳的菜十分好吃。
exampleEnglish: The food at this restaurant is very delicious.
hintSimplified: 程度副词,放在形容词前面,表示程度很高。
hintTraditional: 程度副詞,放在形容詞前面,表示程度很高。
hintEnglish: A degree adverb placed before an adjective to show a very high degree.

exampleSimplified: 我跟你说实话,这件衣服不太适合你。
exampleTraditional: 我跟你說實話,這件衣服不太適合你。
exampleEnglish: To be honest, this piece of clothing doesn't suit you very well.
hintSimplified: 不说谎,把真正的想法或情况讲出来。
hintTraditional: 不說謊,把真正的想法或情況講出來。
hintEnglish: Not lying; telling what you really think or what the situation really is.

definition: actual; practical; practice; real; realistic; reality
exampleSimplified: 实际情况和我想的不一样。
exampleTraditional: 實際情況和我想的不一樣。
exampleEnglish: The actual situation is different from what I thought.
hintSimplified: 指真正的状况,不是想象或理论上的。
hintTraditional: 指真正的狀況,不是想象或理論上的。
hintEnglish: Refers to the real state of things, not what is imagined or theoretical.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],段[duan4]; always; constantly; juncture; moment; period of time; time
exampleSimplified: 这是我一生中最难忘的时刻。
exampleTraditional: 這是我一生中最難忘的時刻。
exampleEnglish: This is the most unforgettable moment of my life.
hintSimplified: 某一个特别的时间点,常说“重要的……”或“关键的……”。
hintTraditional: 某一個特別的時間點,常說“重要的……”或“關鍵的……”。
hintEnglish: A particular point in time, often described as important or crucial.

exampleSimplified: 这支球队很有实力,一定能赢。
exampleTraditional: 這支球隊很有實力,一定能贏。
exampleEnglish: This team is really strong; they will surely win.
hintSimplified: 一个人或团体真正拥有的能力和力量。
hintTraditional: 一個人或團體真正擁有的能力和力量。
hintEnglish: The real ability and power that a person or group truly possesses.

exampleSimplified: 河边有很多大石头。
exampleTraditional: 河邊有很多大石頭。
exampleEnglish: There are many big stones by the river.
hintSimplified: 山上和河边常见的又硬又重的东西。
hintTraditional: 山上和河邊常見的又硬又重的東西。
hintEnglish: A hard, heavy thing often found on mountains and by rivers.

definition: to carry out; to implement; to put into practice
exampleSimplified: 学校从下个月开始实行新的规定。
exampleTraditional: 學校從下個月開始實行新的規定。
exampleEnglish: The school will put the new rules into effect starting next month.
hintSimplified: 把计划、制度或办法真正拿来做。
hintTraditional: 把計劃、制度或辦法真正拿來做。
hintEnglish: To actually put a plan, system or method into practice.

exampleSimplified: 汽车和飞机都需要石油。
exampleTraditional: 汽車和飛機都需要石油。
exampleEnglish: Cars and airplanes all need petroleum.
hintSimplified: 从地下挖出来的黑色能源,可以做汽油。
hintTraditional: 從地下挖出來的黑色能源,可以做汽油。
hintEnglish: A black energy resource dug from underground, used to make gasoline.

definition: (philosophy) reality; actually; dependable; honest; indeed; real; really; true
exampleSimplified: 今天实在太热了,我不想出门。
exampleTraditional: 今天實在太熱了,我不想出門。
exampleEnglish: It's really too hot today; I don't want to go out.
hintSimplified: 副词,用来加强语气,表示真的、确实。
hintTraditional: 副詞,用來加強語氣,表示真的、確實。
hintEnglish: An adverb that strengthens the tone, meaning truly or indeed.

definition: feasible; workable; doable; to make; to cause; to bring about; usable; serviceable
exampleSimplified: 他的努力使得大家都很感动。
exampleTraditional: 他的努力使得大家都很感動。
exampleEnglish: His effort moved everyone deeply.
hintSimplified: 放在两个部分之间,表示前面的事情造成后面的结果。
hintTraditional: 放在兩個部分之間,表示前面的事情造成後面的結果。
hintEnglish: Placed between two parts to show the first thing causes the following result.

definition: to apply; to employ; to make use of; to use
exampleSimplified: 请小心使用这台机器。
exampleTraditional: 請小心使用這臺機器。
exampleEnglish: Please use this machine carefully.
hintSimplified: 拿工具、机器或东西来做事。
hintTraditional: 拿工具、機器或東西來做事。
hintEnglish: To take a tool, machine or thing and employ it to do something.

definition: (charitable, political or revolutionary) cause; CL:個|个[ge4]; activity; career; occupation; project; publicly funded institution, enterprise or foundation; undertaking
exampleSimplified: 他一心想把事业做大。
exampleTraditional: 他一心想把事業做大。
exampleEnglish: He is determined to make his career grow big.
hintSimplified: 一个人长期投入、希望做出成就的工作或生意。
hintTraditional: 一個人長期投入、希望做出成就的工作或生意。
hintEnglish: The work or business someone commits to long-term, hoping to achieve success.

exampleSimplified: 这是一个无法改变的事实。
exampleTraditional: 這是一個無法改變的事實。
exampleEnglish: This is a fact that cannot be changed.
hintSimplified: 真正发生或存在的事情,不是意见或猜想。
hintTraditional: 真正發生或存在的事情,不是意見或猜想。
hintEnglish: Something that really happened or exists, not an opinion or guess.

definition: to adapt; to fit; to suit
exampleSimplified: 他刚搬来,还在适应这里的天气。
exampleTraditional: 他剛搬來,還在適應這裡的天氣。
exampleEnglish: He just moved here and is still adjusting to the weather.
hintSimplified: 到了新环境后,慢慢习惯并能正常生活。
hintTraditional: 到了新環境後,慢慢習慣並能正常生活。
hintEnglish: After arriving in a new environment, gradually getting used to it and living normally.

exampleSimplified: 市长今天来参加我们学校的活动。
exampleTraditional: 市長今天來參加我們學校的活動。
exampleEnglish: The mayor came to our school's event today.
hintSimplified: 管理一个城市的最高负责人。
hintTraditional: 管理一個城市的最高負責人。
hintEnglish: The top official responsible for running a city.

exampleSimplified: 吸烟会伤害你的身体。
exampleTraditional: 吸菸會傷害你的身體。
exampleEnglish: Smoking will harm your body.
hintSimplified: 让人或东西受到损失、痛苦或不好的影响。
hintTraditional: 讓人或東西受到損失、痛苦或不好的影響。
hintEnglish: To cause a person or thing loss, pain or bad effects.

exampleSimplified: 这家店的商品又多又便宜。
exampleTraditional: 這家店的商品又多又便宜。
exampleEnglish: The goods in this store are plentiful and cheap.
hintSimplified: 商店里拿来卖的东西。
hintTraditional: 商店裡拿來賣的東西。
hintEnglish: Things in a store that are sold.

exampleSimplified: 这个地区的商业非常发达。
exampleTraditional: 這個地區的商業非常發達。
exampleEnglish: Commerce in this area is very developed.
hintSimplified: 买卖东西、做生意的活动或行业。
hintTraditional: 買賣東西、做生意的活動或行業。
hintEnglish: The activity or industry of buying and selling goods.

definition: taken in (by sb's deceit); to be duped; to be fooled
exampleSimplified: 他在网上买东西,结果上当了。
exampleTraditional: 他在網上買東西,結果上當了。
exampleEnglish: He bought something online and got fooled.
hintSimplified: 被别人骗了,才发现事情不是想的那样。
hintTraditional: 被別人騙了,才發現事情不是想的那樣。
hintEnglish: Tricked by someone, only to find things weren't as you thought.

exampleSimplified: 很多人相信上帝会保护他们。
exampleTraditional: 很多人相信上帝會保護他們。
exampleEnglish: Many people believe God will protect them.
hintSimplified: 某些宗教里相信创造世界、住在天上的神。
hintTraditional: 某些宗教裡相信創造世界、住在天上的神。
hintEnglish: In some religions, the deity believed to have created the world and to live in heaven.

definition: to go onto the streets; to go shopping
exampleSimplified: 周末我想和朋友一起上街买衣服。
exampleTraditional: 週末我想和朋友一起上街買衣服。
exampleEnglish: This weekend I want to go out shopping for clothes with my friends.
hintSimplified: 离开家,到马路或商店多的地方走走逛逛。
hintTraditional: 離開家,到馬路或商店多的地方走走逛逛。
hintEnglish: Leaving home to walk around the roads or areas with many shops.

exampleSimplified: 山区的空气很新鲜,风景也很美。
exampleTraditional: 山區的空氣很新鮮,風景也很美。
exampleEnglish: The air in the mountain area is fresh and the scenery is beautiful.
hintSimplified: 有很多高山、交通常常不太方便的地区。
hintTraditional: 有很多高山、交通常常不太方便的地區。
hintEnglish: A region with many high mountains, where transport is often not very convenient.

exampleSimplified: 这间教室的设备很新。
exampleTraditional: 這間教室的設備很新。
exampleEnglish: The equipment in this classroom is very new.
hintSimplified: 工厂、学校或医院里为了工作而准备的机器和用具。
hintTraditional: 工廠、學校或醫院裡為了工作而準備的機器和用具。
hintEnglish: Machines and tools prepared for work in a factory, school or hospital.

definition: design; plan; to design; to plan
exampleSimplified: 这个设计师设计的房子很漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 這個設計師設計的房子很漂亮。
exampleEnglish: The house this designer created is very beautiful.
hintSimplified: 建筑师或画家在做东西以前，先把想法画出来。
hintTraditional: 建築師或畫家在做東西以前，先把想法畫出來。
hintEnglish: Before making something, an architect or artist draws out their ideas.

gloss: to give birth to a child
definition: to give birth to a child; to produce; to manufacture
exampleSimplified: 这家工厂每天生产一万个杯子。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠每天生產一萬個杯子。
exampleEnglish: This factory produces ten thousand cups every day.
hintSimplified: 工厂用机器做出很多东西，就是做这件事。
hintTraditional: 工廠用機器做出很多東西，就是做這件事。
hintEnglish: Factories use machines to make lots of goods; this is what they do.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; a tone (on a Chinese syllable); note; tone
exampleSimplified: 中文有四个声调，我常常说错。
exampleTraditional: 中文有四個聲調，我常常說錯。
exampleEnglish: Chinese has four tones, and I often say them wrong.
hintSimplified: 说中文时，声音的高低变化，会让意思不一样。
hintTraditional: 說中文時，聲音的高低變化，會讓意思不一樣。
hintEnglish: When speaking Chinese, the rise and fall of the voice changes the meaning.

exampleSimplified: 老师讲的故事很生动，大家都喜欢听。
exampleTraditional: 老師講的故事很生動，大家都喜歡聽。
exampleEnglish: The story the teacher told was very vivid, and everyone liked listening.
hintSimplified: 形容文章或故事很有趣，好像画面就在眼前。
hintTraditional: 形容文章或故事很有趣，好像畫面就在眼前。
hintEnglish: Describes a story or text so interesting it feels like the scene is right before your eyes.

gloss: life (as the characteristic of living beings)
definition: life (as the characteristic of living beings); living being; creature (CL:條|条[tiao2])
exampleSimplified: 每个人的生命都很宝贵。
exampleTraditional: 每個人的生命都很寶貴。
exampleEnglish: Everyone's life is very precious.
hintSimplified: 人和动物从出生到死亡所拥有的东西。
hintTraditional: 人和動物從出生到死亡所擁有的東西。
hintEnglish: What people and animals have from birth until death.

gloss: character that is unfamiliar or not yet studied
definition: character that is unfamiliar or not yet studied; new character (in textbook)
exampleSimplified: 我每天学十个新的生字。
exampleTraditional: 我每天學十個新的生字。
exampleEnglish: I learn ten new characters every day.
hintSimplified: 课本里你还不认识、要学的字。
hintTraditional: 課本里你還不認識、要學的字。
hintEnglish: Characters in a textbook that you don't know yet and need to learn.

exampleSimplified: 我们要深入了解这个问题。
exampleTraditional: 我們要深入了解這個問題。
exampleEnglish: We need to look into this problem in depth.
hintSimplified: 不只看表面，而是往里面仔细研究。
hintTraditional: 不只看表面，而是往裡面仔細研究。
hintEnglish: Not just looking at the surface, but going further in to study carefully.

definition: among; at hand; on the body
exampleSimplified: 我身上没有带钱，你可以借我吗？
exampleTraditional: 我身上沒有帶錢，你可以借我嗎？
exampleEnglish: I don't have any money on me. Can you lend me some?
hintSimplified: 指人的身体表面，或是带在人身边的东西。
hintTraditional: 指人的身體表面，或是帶在人身邊的東西。
hintEnglish: Refers to a person's body surface, or things carried with a person.

exampleSimplified: 自己做饭比较省钱。
exampleTraditional: 自己做飯比較省錢。
exampleEnglish: Cooking for yourself is cheaper.
hintSimplified: 少花一点钱，把钱留下来。
hintTraditional: 少花一點錢，把錢留下來。
hintEnglish: Spend less and keep more of your money.

gloss: to remain; to be left over
definition: to remain; to be left over
exampleSimplified: 吃完饭，桌上只剩下一块蛋糕。
exampleTraditional: 吃完飯，桌上只剩下一塊蛋糕。
exampleEnglish: After the meal, only one piece of cake was left on the table.
hintSimplified: 大家用完或拿走以后，还留着的部分。
hintTraditional: 大家用完或拿走以後，還留著的部分。
hintEnglish: The part still there after everyone has used or taken some.

exampleSimplified: 他很忙，甚至没有时间吃饭。
exampleTraditional: 他很忙，甚至沒有時間吃飯。
exampleEnglish: He is very busy, even to the point of having no time to eat.
hintSimplified: 用来强调一个比前面更极端的例子。
hintTraditional: 用來強調一個比前面更極端的例子。
hintEnglish: Used to stress an example more extreme than the ones before.

definition: bonus; crop; gain; harvest; profit; reward; to gain; to harvest; to reap; variant of 收穫|收获[shou1 huo4]
exampleSimplified: 这次旅行让我有很多收获。
exampleTraditional: 這次旅行讓我有很多收穫。
exampleEnglish: I gained a lot from this trip.
hintSimplified: 农夫秋天得到的成果，也指努力后学到或得到的好处。
hintTraditional: 農夫秋天得到的成果，也指努力後學到或得到的好處。
hintEnglish: What a farmer gets in autumn; also the benefit you gain after effort.

gloss: to be familiar with; to know well
definition: to be familiar with; to know well
exampleSimplified: 我对这个城市很熟悉。
exampleTraditional: 我對這個城市很熟悉。
exampleEnglish: I am very familiar with this city.
hintSimplified: 对人或地方了解很多，不觉得陌生。
hintTraditional: 對人或地方了解很多，不覺得陌生。
hintEnglish: You know a person or place well and it doesn't feel strange.

exampleSimplified: 办签证的手续很麻烦。
exampleTraditional: 辦簽證的手續很麻煩。
exampleEnglish: The procedures for applying for a visa are troublesome.
hintSimplified: 去办公室办事时，要一步一步完成的流程。
hintTraditional: 去辦公室辦事時，要一步一步完成的流程。
hintEnglish: The step-by-step process you must complete when handling business at an office.

definition: harmed; to sustain injuries; wounded (in an accident etc)
exampleSimplified: 他打球的时候受伤了，现在在医院。
exampleTraditional: 他打球的時候受傷了，現在在醫院。
exampleEnglish: He got hurt while playing ball and is now in the hospital.
hintSimplified: 身体不小心被弄坏，可能流血或很痛。
hintTraditional: 身體不小心被弄壞，可能流血或很痛。
hintEnglish: The body gets accidentally damaged, perhaps bleeding or in pain.

exampleSimplified: 多吃蔬菜对身体很好。
exampleTraditional: 多吃蔬菜對身體很好。
exampleEnglish: Eating more vegetables is good for your body.
hintSimplified: 青菜、红萝卜、白菜等绿色或彩色的食物。
hintTraditional: 青菜、紅蘿蔔、白菜等綠色或彩色的食物。
hintEnglish: Green or colorful foods like leafy greens, carrots and cabbage.

exampleSimplified: 这张沙发坐起来很舒适。
exampleTraditional: 這張沙發坐起來很舒適。
exampleEnglish: This sofa is very comfortable to sit on.
hintSimplified: 身体觉得轻松、没有不舒服的感觉。
hintTraditional: 身體覺得輕鬆、沒有不舒服的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling that your body is relaxed and not uncomfortable.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; amount; digit; digital (electronics etc); figure; number; numeral
exampleSimplified: 请把这个数字写在表格里。
exampleTraditional: 請把這個數字寫在表格裡。
exampleEnglish: Please write this number in the form.
hintSimplified: 像一、二、三或1、2、3这样的符号。
hintTraditional: 像一、二、三或1、2、3這樣的符號。
hintEnglish: Symbols like one, two, three or 1, 2, 3.

exampleSimplified: 我每天早上和晚上都刷牙。
exampleTraditional: 我每天早上和晚上都刷牙。
exampleEnglish: I brush my teeth every morning and evening.
hintSimplified: 用牙膏和小刷子，让嘴巴里干净。
hintTraditional: 用牙膏和小刷子，讓嘴巴里乾淨。
hintEnglish: Using toothpaste and a small brush to keep your mouth clean.

gloss: boiled dumpling (made by wrapping a pasta skin around a filling, like ravioli)
definition: boiled dumpling (made by wrapping a pasta skin around a filling, like ravioli)
exampleSimplified: 冬天吃热热的水饺最舒服。
exampleTraditional: 冬天吃熱熱的水餃最舒服。
exampleEnglish: Eating hot dumplings in winter is the most comfortable.
hintSimplified: 用面皮包肉和菜，放进热水里煮的食物。
hintTraditional: 用麵皮包肉和菜，放進熱水裡煮的食物。
hintEnglish: Food made by wrapping meat and vegetables in dough and boiling it in water.

gloss: a standard; a level (of ability, development etc)
definition: a standard; a level (of ability, development etc); horizontal; level
exampleSimplified: 他的中文水平越来越高。
exampleTraditional: 他的中文水平越來越高。
exampleEnglish: His Chinese level is getting higher and higher.
hintSimplified: 用来说一个人的能力或程度有多高。
hintTraditional: 用來說一個人的能力或程度有多高。
hintEnglish: Used to say how high a person's ability or degree is.

exampleSimplified: 他太累了，一躺下就睡着了。
exampleTraditional: 他太累了，一躺下就睡著了。
exampleEnglish: He was so tired that he fell asleep as soon as he lay down.
hintSimplified: 闭上眼睛以后，慢慢进入梦里。
hintTraditional: 閉上眼睛以後，慢慢進入夢裡。
hintEnglish: After closing your eyes, you slowly drift into dreams.

exampleSimplified: 这所学校的教学水准很高。
exampleTraditional: 這所學校的教學水準很高。
exampleEnglish: The teaching standard of this school is very high.
hintSimplified: 用来衡量品质或成就高低的标准。
hintTraditional: 用來衡量品質或成就高低的標準。
hintEnglish: A standard used to measure how high the quality or achievement is.

exampleSimplified: 山上有很多高大的树木。
exampleTraditional: 山上有很多高大的樹木。
exampleEnglish: There are many tall trees on the mountain.
hintSimplified: 森林里一棵一棵长得很高的绿色植物。
hintTraditional: 森林裡一棵一棵長得很高的綠色植物。
hintEnglish: Tall green plants growing one by one in a forest.

definition: conveniently; in passing; without much extra effort
exampleSimplified: 你去超市的时候，顺便帮我买牛奶。
exampleTraditional: 你去超市的時候，順便幫我買牛奶。
exampleEnglish: While you're at the supermarket, please buy milk for me on the way.
hintSimplified: 做一件事的时候，不特别花力气，再做另一件小事。
hintTraditional: 做一件事的時候，不特別花力氣，再做另一件小事。
hintEnglish: While doing one thing, you take care of another small thing without extra effort.

exampleSimplified: 我的考试和面试都很顺利。
exampleTraditional: 我的考試和麵試都很順利。
exampleEnglish: My exam and interview both went very smoothly.
hintSimplified: 事情进行得没有遇到麻烦或阻碍。
hintTraditional: 事情進行得沒有遇到麻煩或阻礙。
hintEnglish: Things proceed without running into trouble or obstacles.

definition: formulation; hypothesis; interpretation; one's version (of events); statement; theory; to expound Buddhist teachings; way of speaking; wording
exampleSimplified: 关于这件事，大家有不同的说法。
exampleTraditional: 關於這件事，大家有不同的說法。
exampleEnglish: People have different accounts of this matter.
hintSimplified: 对同一件事，不同的人表达或解释的方式。
hintTraditional: 對同一件事，不同的人表達或解釋的方式。
hintEnglish: The way different people express or explain the same matter.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; caption; directions; explanation; to explain; to illustrate; to indicate; to prove; to show
exampleSimplified: 请你看一下机器的使用说明。
exampleTraditional: 請你看一下機器的使用說明。
exampleEnglish: Please take a look at the machine's instructions.
hintSimplified: 把事情或用法讲清楚，让别人明白。
hintTraditional: 把事情或用法講清楚，讓別人明白。
hintEnglish: To explain how something works or what it is so others understand.

definition: to ponder over; to reflect on
exampleSimplified: 做决定以前，你要好好思考一下。
exampleTraditional: 做決定以前，你要好好思考一下。
exampleEnglish: Before making a decision, you should think it over carefully.
hintSimplified: 在脑子里认真地想一个问题。
hintTraditional: 在腦子裡認真地想一個問題。
hintEnglish: To seriously turn a problem over in your mind.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; idea; ideology; thinking; thought
exampleSimplified: 这位老师的思想很特别。
exampleTraditional: 這位老師的思想很特別。
exampleEnglish: This teacher's way of thinking is very distinctive.
hintSimplified: 一个人或一个时代对世界和人生的系统看法。
hintTraditional: 一個人或一個時代對世界和人生的系統看法。
hintEnglish: A person's or era's systematic views about the world and life.

exampleSimplified: 天空很暗，似乎快要下雨了。
exampleTraditional: 天空很暗，似乎快要下雨了。
exampleEnglish: The sky is dark; it seems it is about to rain.
hintSimplified: 副词，表示根据情况做出不太确定的推测。
hintTraditional: 副詞，表示根據情況做出不太確定的推測。
hintEnglish: An adverb expressing an uncertain guess based on what one observes.

exampleSimplified: 周末我们去山上的寺庙参观。
exampleTraditional: 週末我們去山上的寺廟參觀。
exampleEnglish: This weekend we are visiting the temple in the mountains.
hintSimplified: 和尚或信徒拜佛、修行的地方。
hintTraditional: 和尚或信徒拜佛、修行的地方。
hintEnglish: A place where monks and believers worship and practice.

definition: forget about it; let it be; let it pass
exampleSimplified: 算了，我们别再吵了。
exampleTraditional: 算了，我們別再吵了。
exampleEnglish: Forget it, let's stop arguing.
hintSimplified: 放弃，不想再讨论或追究某件事时说的话。
hintTraditional: 放棄，不想再討論或追究某件事時說的話。
hintEnglish: What you say when you give up or no longer want to pursue a matter.

definition: as one pleases; as one wishes; at random; casual; negligent; wanton
exampleSimplified: 你想吃什么都可以，随便点吧。
exampleTraditional: 你想吃什麼都可以，隨便點吧。
exampleEnglish: Order whatever you like, anything is fine.
hintSimplified: 没有特别要求，怎么样都可以。
hintTraditional: 沒有特別要求，怎麼樣都可以。
hintEnglish: Having no particular requirement; anything goes.

gloss: at any time; at all times
definition: at any time; at all times; at the right time; whenever necessary
exampleSimplified: 有问题的话，你可以随时打电话给我。
exampleTraditional: 有問題的話，你可以隨時打電話給我。
exampleEnglish: If you have a problem, you can call me at any time.
hintSimplified: 不管什么时候，都可以。
hintTraditional: 不管什麼時候，都可以。
hintEnglish: No matter when; whenever it is.

definition: (derog.) so-called; what is meant by the expression ...; what is referred to as ...
exampleSimplified: 所谓的专家也不一定都对。
exampleTraditional: 所謂的專家也不一定都對。
exampleEnglish: So-called experts are not necessarily always right.
hintSimplified: 用来引出一个说法，有时表示对它不太认同。
hintTraditional: 用來引出一個說法，有時表示對它不太認同。
hintEnglish: Used to introduce a term or claim, sometimes with doubt about it.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; approach; attitude; bearing; manner
exampleSimplified: 他对工作的态度非常认真。
exampleTraditional: 他對工作的態度非常認真。
exampleEnglish: His attitude toward work is very serious.
hintSimplified: 一个人对事情的看法和表现出来的做法。
hintTraditional: 一個人對事情的看法和表現出來的做法。
hintEnglish: A person's outlook on things and how it shows in behavior.

definition: CL:次[ci4]; conversation; talk; to have a conversation; to talk (with sb)
exampleSimplified: 经理想和你谈话，请你现在过去。
exampleTraditional: 經理想和你談話，請你現在過去。
exampleEnglish: The manager wants to talk with you; please go over now.
hintSimplified: 两个人面对面交谈，通常比较正式。
hintTraditional: 兩個人面對面交談，通常比較正式。
hintEnglish: Two people conversing face to face, usually fairly formally.

definition: annoying; troublesome; to dislike; to loathe
exampleSimplified: 蚊子在耳边飞，真讨厌。
exampleTraditional: 蚊子在耳邊飛，真討厭。
exampleEnglish: Mosquitoes flying by my ear are really annoying.
hintSimplified: 对某人或某事感到不喜欢、很烦。
hintTraditional: 對某人或某事感到不喜歡、很煩。
hintEnglish: To feel dislike or irritation toward someone or something.

exampleSimplified: 他特地从台中来看我。
exampleTraditional: 他特地從台中來看我。
exampleEnglish: He came all the way from Taichung just to see me.
hintSimplified: 副词，表示为了某个目的而专门做某事。
hintTraditional: 副詞，表示為了某個目的而專門做某事。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning doing something specially for a certain purpose.

gloss: a characteristic; a distinctive feature or quality
definition: a characteristic; a distinctive feature or quality
exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅有自己的特色。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳有自己的特色。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant has its own distinctive character.
hintSimplified: 一个地方或东西与别的不一样、最突出的地方。
hintTraditional: 一個地方或東西與別的不一樣、最突出的地方。
hintEnglish: What makes a place or thing stand out from others.

exampleSimplified: 这是一种特殊的情况，要另外处理。
exampleTraditional: 這是一種特殊的情況，要另外處理。
exampleEnglish: This is a special situation and must be handled separately.
hintSimplified: 和一般的不同，不普通。
hintTraditional: 和一般的不同，不普通。
hintEnglish: Different from the usual; not ordinary.

exampleSimplified: 很多人相信好人死后会去天堂。
exampleTraditional: 很多人相信好人死後會去天堂。
exampleEnglish: Many people believe good people go to heaven after death.
hintSimplified: 宗教里说的美好世界，在天上。
hintTraditional: 宗教裡說的美好世界，在天上。
hintEnglish: The wonderful world in religion, said to be up in the sky.

exampleSimplified: 他天天早上六点起床跑步。
exampleTraditional: 他天天早上六點起床跑步。
exampleEnglish: He gets up at six every morning to run.
hintSimplified: 每一天都这样，没有一天例外。
hintTraditional: 每一天都這樣，沒有一天例外。
hintEnglish: Happening each and every day, with no exceptions.

definition: land under heaven; realm; rule; the whole of China; the whole world
exampleSimplified: 天下没有不散的宴席。
exampleTraditional: 天下沒有不散的宴席。
exampleEnglish: There is no feast in the world that never ends.
hintSimplified: 指整个世界，或古代整个国家的范围。
hintTraditional: 指整個世界，或古代整個國家的範圍。
hintEnglish: Refers to the whole world, or in ancient times the whole realm.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; condition; circumstance; term; factor; requirement; prerequisite; qualification; situation; state; condition
exampleSimplified: 这家公司给的条件很好。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司給的條件很好。
exampleEnglish: The terms this company offers are very good.
hintSimplified: 要做成一件事所需要满足的要求或情况。
hintTraditional: 要做成一件事所需要滿足的要求或情況。
hintEnglish: The requirements or circumstances needed to get something done.

gloss: to challenge; to take on a challenge; a challenge
definition: to challenge; to take on a challenge; a challenge
exampleSimplified: 我想接受新的挑战，学习做生意。
exampleTraditional: 我想接受新的挑戰，學習做生意。
exampleEnglish: I want to take on a new challenge and learn to do business.
hintSimplified: 困难的事，需要很大努力才能完成，也可以指向别人邀战。
hintTraditional: 困難的事，需要很大努力才能完成，也可以指向別人邀戰。
hintEnglish: A difficult task requiring great effort, or a call to compete.

exampleSimplified: 这部电影的题材很新鲜。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影的題材很新鮮。
exampleEnglish: The subject matter of this movie is very fresh.
hintSimplified: 小说、电影或文章所写的内容范围。
hintTraditional: 小說、電影或文章所寫的內容範圍。
hintEnglish: The content area that a novel, film or article deals with.

definition: to mention; to raise (a subject); to refer to
exampleSimplified: 老师刚才提到明天有考试。
exampleTraditional: 老師剛才提到明天有考試。
exampleEnglish: The teacher just mentioned that there is a test tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 说话时顺便讲到某人或某件事。
hintTraditional: 說話時順便講到某人或某件事。
hintEnglish: To bring up a person or matter briefly while speaking.

definition: to improve; to increase; to raise
exampleSimplified: 多听多说可以提高中文水平。
exampleTraditional: 多聽多說可以提高中文水平。
exampleEnglish: Listening and speaking a lot can improve your Chinese level.
hintSimplified: 让水平、质量或程度变得更好、更高。
hintTraditional: 讓水平、質量或程度變得更好、更高。
hintEnglish: To make a level, quality or degree become better or higher.

definition: to furnish; to offer; to provide; to supply
exampleSimplified: 这家饭店提供免费的早餐。
exampleTraditional: 這家飯店提供免費的早餐。
exampleEnglish: This hotel provides free breakfast.
hintSimplified: 给别人需要的东西或服务。
hintTraditional: 給別人需要的東西或服務。
hintEnglish: To give others something they need, such as an item or a service.

definition: experience; to know from experience; to learn through experience; to realize; understanding
exampleSimplified: 住在国外以后,我才体会到家人的重要。
exampleTraditional: 住在國外以後,我才體會到家人的重要。
exampleEnglish: Only after living abroad did I truly appreciate how important family is.
hintSimplified: 亲身经历后,心里才真正明白和感受到。
hintTraditional: 親身經歷後,心裡才真正明白和感受到。
hintEnglish: To truly understand and feel something in your heart after experiencing it personally.

exampleSimplified: 爬山需要很好的体力。
exampleTraditional: 爬山需要很好的體力。
exampleEnglish: Climbing mountains requires good physical stamina.
hintSimplified: 身体能做事、运动而不容易累的力量。
hintTraditional: 身體能做事、運動而不容易累的力量。
hintEnglish: The body's strength that lets you work or exercise without tiring easily.

exampleSimplified: 他很体贴,总是先想到别人的需要。
exampleTraditional: 他很體貼,總是先想到別人的需要。
exampleEnglish: He is very considerate and always thinks of others' needs first.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人会细心照顾别人的感受。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人會細心照顧別人的感受。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who carefully takes others' feelings into account.

exampleSimplified: 我最近体重增加了三公斤。
exampleTraditional: 我最近體重增加了三公斤。
exampleEnglish: My weight has gone up by three kilograms recently.
hintSimplified: 站在秤上量出来的身体数字。
hintTraditional: 站在秤上量出來的身體數字。
hintEnglish: The number you see when you step on a scale.

exampleSimplified: 这条铁路连接台北和高雄。
exampleTraditional: 這條鐵路連線台北和高雄。
exampleEnglish: This railway connects Taipei and Kaohsiung.
hintSimplified: 火车行驶的道路,由两条钢轨组成。
hintTraditional: 火車行駛的道路,由兩條鋼軌組成。
hintEnglish: The road that trains run on, made of steel tracks.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷年纪大了,听力不太好。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺年紀大了,聽力不太好。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa is old, and his hearing is not very good.
hintSimplified: 耳朵听见声音的能力;语言考试也常考这一项。
hintTraditional: 耳朵聽見聲音的能力;語言考試也常考這一項。
hintEnglish: The ability of the ears to pick up sounds; also a section in language exams.

exampleSimplified: 演讲结束后,听众热烈地鼓掌。
exampleTraditional: 演講結束後,聽眾熱烈地鼓掌。
exampleEnglish: After the speech, the audience applauded warmly.
hintSimplified: 在演讲或广播时,在现场或收音机前听的人。
hintTraditional: 在演講或廣播時,在現場或收音機前聽的人。
hintEnglish: The people who listen at a talk or to a radio broadcast.

definition: by means of; through; via; to adopt (a resolution); to pass (legislation); to pass (a test); to pass through; to get through
exampleSimplified: 他通过努力考上了理想的大学。
exampleTraditional: 他通過努力考上了理想的大學。
exampleEnglish: Through hard work, he got into his dream university.
hintSimplified: 表示用某种方法或途径来达成目的;也可指考试合格。
hintTraditional: 表示用某種方法或途徑來達成目的;也可指考試合格。
hintEnglish: Indicates using a certain method or route to reach a goal; can also mean to pass a test.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; notice; notification; to inform; to notify
exampleSimplified: 学校通知我们明天不用上课。
exampleTraditional: 學校通知我們明天不用上課。
exampleEnglish: The school notified us that there is no class tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 把消息告诉别人,让他们知道;也指这样的消息。
hintTraditional: 把訊息告訴別人,讓他們知道;也指這樣的訊息。
hintEnglish: To let people know some news; also the message itself.

exampleSimplified: 大家都很同情那位失去家园的老人。
exampleTraditional: 大家都很同情那位失去家園的老人。
exampleEnglish: Everyone sympathized with the old man who lost his home.
hintSimplified: 看到别人遇到不幸,心里替他难过。
hintTraditional: 看到別人遇到不幸,心裡替他難過。
hintEnglish: Feeling sorry for someone who has met with misfortune.

exampleSimplified: 我和同事中午一起去吃饭。
exampleTraditional: 我和同事中午一起去吃飯。
exampleEnglish: My coworkers and I go to lunch together at noon.
hintSimplified: 在同一个公司一起工作的人。
hintTraditional: 在同一個公司一起工作的人。
hintEnglish: People who work together at the same company.

exampleSimplified: 失去亲人让她非常痛苦。
exampleTraditional: 失去親人讓她非常痛苦。
exampleEnglish: Losing her loved one made her extremely miserable.
hintSimplified: 身体或心里非常难受的感觉。
hintTraditional: 身體或心裡非常難受的感覺。
hintEnglish: A feeling of great suffering in body or mind.

exampleSimplified: 他打算投资一家小公司。
exampleTraditional: 他打算投資一家小公司。
exampleEnglish: He plans to invest in a small company.
hintSimplified: 拿钱出来做生意或买股票,希望以后赚更多钱。
hintTraditional: 拿錢出來做生意或買股票,希望以後賺更多錢。
hintEnglish: To put money into a business or stocks hoping to earn more later.

exampleSimplified: 这个团体每个月都会去帮助老人。
exampleTraditional: 這個團體每個月都會去幫助老人。
exampleEnglish: This group goes to help the elderly every month.
hintSimplified: 有共同目标、由很多人组成的组织。
hintTraditional: 有共同目標、由很多人組成的組織。
hintEnglish: An organization made up of many people with a common goal.

exampleSimplified: 春节时,全家人都回来团圆。
exampleTraditional: 春節時,全家人都回來團圓。
exampleEnglish: During Chinese New Year, the whole family comes home to be reunited.
hintSimplified: 分开的家人在节日里聚在一起。
hintTraditional: 分開的家人在節日裡聚在一起。
hintEnglish: Separated family members gathering together on a holiday.

definition: CL:片[pian4],塊|块[kuai4]; genius loci; land; local god; soil; territory
exampleSimplified: 农夫在这片土地上种了很多稻米。
exampleTraditional: 農夫在這片土地上種了很多稻米。
exampleEnglish: The farmer grew a lot of rice on this land.
hintSimplified: 人们在上面盖房子或种田的大地。
hintTraditional: 人們在上面蓋房子或種田的大地。
hintEnglish: The ground on which people build houses or grow crops.

exampleSimplified: 老师推荐我们读这本小说。
exampleTraditional: 老師推薦我們讀這本小說。
exampleEnglish: The teacher recommended that we read this novel.
hintSimplified: 告诉别人某样东西很好,请他试试看。
hintTraditional: 告訴別人某樣東西很好,請他試試看。
hintEnglish: To tell someone something is good and suggest they try it.

exampleSimplified: 他的工作是向客户推销新产品。
exampleTraditional: 他的工作是向客戶推銷新產品。
exampleEnglish: His job is to promote new products to customers.
hintSimplified: 想办法让别人买自己公司的东西。
hintTraditional: 想辦法讓別人買自己公司的東西。
hintEnglish: To try to get people to buy your company's goods.

definition: backward step; fallback; leeway; room to maneuver; setback; to do less well than before; to make a concession
exampleSimplified: 他这学期没认真读书,成绩退步了。
exampleTraditional: 他這學期沒認真讀書,成績退步了。
exampleEnglish: He didn't study seriously this semester, and his grades have gotten worse.
hintSimplified: 表现比以前差,不进反退。
hintTraditional: 表現比以前差,不進反退。
hintEnglish: Performance becomes worse than before, going backward instead of forward.

gloss: to retire (from the workforce); to go into retirement
definition: to retire (from the workforce); to go into retirement
