exampleSimplified: 我爸爸明年就要退休了。
exampleTraditional: 我爸爸明年就要退休了。
exampleEnglish: My dad is going to retire next year.
hintSimplified: 年纪大了以后,不再上班工作。
hintTraditional: 年紀大了以後,不再上班工作。
hintEnglish: To stop going to work after reaching an older age.

exampleSimplified: 天空突然下起大雨来。
exampleTraditional: 天空突然下起大雨來。
exampleEnglish: It suddenly started pouring from the sky.
hintSimplified: 形容事情发生得很快,没有人预料到。
hintTraditional: 形容事情發生得很快,沒有人預料到。
hintEnglish: Describes something happening quickly and without anyone expecting it.

exampleSimplified: 这只兔子喜欢吃红萝卜。
exampleTraditional: 這隻兔子喜歡吃紅蘿蔔。
exampleEnglish: This rabbit likes to eat carrots.
hintSimplified: 耳朵很长、跳着走路的白色小动物。
hintTraditional: 耳朵很長、跳著走路的白色小動物。
hintEnglish: A small animal with long ears that hops.

definition: abroad; outer surface; outside; place other than one's home
exampleSimplified: 外边在下雨,你记得带伞。
exampleTraditional: 外邊在下雨,你記得帶傘。
exampleEnglish: It's raining outside, so remember to bring an umbrella.
hintSimplified: 不在房子或房间里面的地方。
hintTraditional: 不在房子或房間裡面的地方。
hintEnglish: The place that is not inside a house or room.

exampleSimplified: 他的外文很好,可以看原版书。
exampleTraditional: 他的外文很好,可以看原版書。
exampleEnglish: His foreign language is excellent, so he can read books in the original.
hintSimplified: 不是本国的语言,也指用这种语言写的文字。
hintTraditional: 不是本國的語言,也指用這種語言寫的文字。
hintEnglish: A language that is not one's own country's, or writing in such a language.

exampleSimplified: 他会说三种外语。
exampleTraditional: 他會說三種外語。
exampleEnglish: He can speak three foreign languages.
hintSimplified: 英文、日文、法文都属于这一类，不是本国的语言。
hintTraditional: 英文、日文、法文都屬於這一類，不是本國的語言。
hintEnglish: English, Japanese and French all belong to this category: not one's own country's language.

exampleSimplified: 我今天一定要完成这份报告。
exampleTraditional: 我今天一定要完成這份報告。
exampleEnglish: I must finish this report today.
hintSimplified: 把一件工作做到最后，没有剩下的部分。
hintTraditional: 把一件工作做到最後，沒有剩下的部分。
hintEnglish: To carry a task through to the end so nothing remains.

exampleSimplified: 弟弟有很多汽车玩具。
exampleTraditional: 弟弟有很多汽車玩具。
exampleEnglish: My younger brother has lots of toy cars.
hintSimplified: 小孩子用来玩的东西，像积木或小汽车。
hintTraditional: 小孩子用來玩的東西，像積木或小汽車。
hintEnglish: Things children play with, like building blocks or little cars.

definition: contingency; if by any chance; just in case
exampleSimplified: 万一下雨，我们就改天再去。
exampleTraditional: 萬一下雨，我們就改天再去。
exampleEnglish: If it should rain, we'll go another day.
hintSimplified: 用来说一件不太可能发生的坏情况，意思是“如果真的发生”。
hintTraditional: 用來說一件不太可能發生的壞情況，意思是“如果真的發生”。
hintEnglish: Used to introduce an unlikely, usually bad, possibility: 'if by chance it happens'.

definition: in many cases; more often than not; usually
exampleSimplified: 周末他往往在家看书。
exampleTraditional: 週末他往往在家看書。
exampleEnglish: On weekends he often stays home reading.
hintSimplified: 副词，表示在大多数情况下常常会这样。
hintTraditional: 副詞，表示在大多數情況下常常會這樣。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning that in most cases something tends to happen.

exampleSimplified: 这个娃娃的眼睛又大又圆。
exampleTraditional: 這個娃娃的眼睛又大又圓。
exampleEnglish: This doll's eyes are big and round.
hintSimplified: 小女孩常抱着的玩具，样子像小孩；也可指很小的孩子。
hintTraditional: 小女孩常抱著的玩具，樣子像小孩；也可指很小的孩子。
hintEnglish: A toy shaped like a small child that little girls hold; can also mean a small child.

gloss: to keep; to maintain; to preserve
definition: to keep; to maintain; to preserve
exampleSimplified: 他每天运动来维持健康。
exampleTraditional: 他每天運動來維持健康。
exampleEnglish: He exercises every day to maintain his health.
hintSimplified: 让一个状态继续下去，不要变坏或消失。
hintTraditional: 讓一個狀態繼續下去，不要變壞或消失。
hintEnglish: To make a state go on without getting worse or disappearing.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],絲|丝[si1]; smile; to smile
exampleSimplified: 她脸上带着温暖的微笑。
exampleTraditional: 她臉上帶著溫暖的微笑。
exampleEnglish: She had a warm smile on her face.
hintSimplified: 不出声音，嘴角往上，表示友善或高兴。
hintTraditional: 不出聲音，嘴角往上，表示友善或高興。
hintEnglish: Mouth turning upward without a sound, showing friendliness or happiness.

gloss: huge; great; grand; worthy of the greatest admiration; important (contribution etc)
definition: huge; great; grand; worthy of the greatest admiration; important (contribution etc)
exampleSimplified: 他是一位伟大的科学家。
exampleTraditional: 他是一位偉大的科學家。
exampleEnglish: He is a great scientist.
hintSimplified: 形容人或成就非常了不起，值得大家佩服。
hintTraditional: 形容人或成就非常了不起，值得大家佩服。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or achievement so remarkable that everyone admires it.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; approaching; coming; future; pending; tomorrow
exampleSimplified: 你对未来有什么计划？
exampleTraditional: 你對未來有什麼計劃？
exampleEnglish: What plans do you have for the future?
hintSimplified: 还没有到，以后会来的时间。
hintTraditional: 還沒有到，以後會來的時間。
hintEnglish: The time that hasn't arrived yet but will come later.

exampleSimplified: 这张桌子的位置不太好。
exampleTraditional: 這張桌子的位置不太好。
exampleEnglish: The position of this table isn't very good.
hintSimplified: 一个人或东西所在的地方，或座位。
hintTraditional: 一個人或東西所在的地方，或座位。
hintEnglish: The spot where a person or thing is, or a seat.

exampleSimplified: 今天的温度比昨天低很多。
exampleTraditional: 今天的溫度比昨天低很多。
exampleEnglish: Today's temperature is much lower than yesterday's.
hintSimplified: 用度数表示天气或东西有多冷多热。
hintTraditional: 用度數表示天氣或東西有多冷多熱。
hintEnglish: How hot or cold the air or an object is, expressed in degrees.

exampleSimplified: 冬天喝一杯热茶，觉得很温暖。
exampleTraditional: 冬天喝一杯熱茶，覺得很溫暖。
exampleEnglish: Drinking a cup of hot tea in winter feels very warm.
hintSimplified: 不冷也不太热，让人觉得舒服，也可形容心里的感觉。
hintTraditional: 不冷也不太熱，讓人覺得舒服，也可形容心裡的感覺。
hintEnglish: Not cold, not too hot, comfortable; can also describe a feeling in the heart.

gloss: gentle and soft; tender; sweet (commonly used to describe a girl or woman)
definition: gentle and soft; tender; sweet (commonly used to describe a girl or woman)
exampleSimplified: 我的老师说话很温柔。
exampleTraditional: 我的老師說話很溫柔。
exampleEnglish: My teacher speaks very gently.
hintSimplified: 形容人的态度或声音轻轻的、不凶，让人觉得亲切。
hintTraditional: 形容人的態度或聲音輕輕的、不兇，讓人覺得親切。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose manner or voice is soft and kind, never harsh.

exampleSimplified: 请把这个文件寄给我。
exampleTraditional: 請把這個文件寄給我。
exampleEnglish: Please send me this file.
hintSimplified: 电脑里存资料的东西，或办公室里的正式纸张。
hintTraditional: 電腦裡存資料的東西，或辦公室裡的正式紙張。
hintEnglish: Something on a computer that stores data, or official papers in an office.

exampleSimplified: 她大学时念的是中国文学。
exampleTraditional: 她大學時念的是中國文學。
exampleEnglish: She studied Chinese literature in college.
hintSimplified: 小说、诗和散文等作品的总称，也是一个大学科系。
hintTraditional: 小說、詩和散文等作品的總稱，也是一個大學科系。
hintEnglish: The general term for novels, poems and essays; also a university major.

definition: CL:篇[pian1],段[duan4],頁|页[ye4]; article; essay; hidden meaning; literary works; writings
exampleSimplified: 这篇文章写得很有意思。
exampleTraditional: 這篇文章寫得很有意思。
exampleEnglish: This article is written very interestingly.
hintSimplified: 报纸或杂志上一篇一篇的文字。
hintTraditional: 報紙或雜誌上一篇一篇的文字。
hintEnglish: A piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; character; phraseology; script; writing; writing style; written language
exampleSimplified: 这些文字我一个也看不懂。
exampleTraditional: 這些文字我一個也看不懂。
exampleEnglish: I can't understand any of this writing.
hintSimplified: 用来记录语言的符号，我们用眼睛看的。
hintTraditional: 用來記錄語言的符號，我們用眼睛看的。
hintEnglish: The symbols used to record language, which we read with our eyes.

definition: stability; stable; steady; to pacify; to stabilize
exampleSimplified: 他的工作很稳定，不用担心。
exampleTraditional: 他的工作很穩定，不用擔心。
exampleEnglish: His job is very stable, so there's nothing to worry about.
hintSimplified: 不容易改变或摇动，很安定。
hintTraditional: 不容易改變或搖動，很安定。
hintEnglish: Not easily changed or shaken; settled and steady.

definition: to say hello to; to send one's regards to
exampleSimplified: 见到长辈，要先向他们问好。
exampleTraditional: 見到長輩，要先向他們問好。
exampleEnglish: When you meet elders, you should first greet them.
hintSimplified: 见面时对别人说“你好吗”之类的话。
hintTraditional: 見面時對別人說“你好嗎”之類的話。
hintEnglish: Saying something like 'how are you' to someone when you meet.

gloss: (fig.) (coll.) to make offensive reference to (somebody dear to the person to whom one is speaking)
definition: (fig.) (coll.) to make offensive reference to (somebody dear to the person to whom one is speaking); to give one's respects; to send a greeting
exampleSimplified: 请替我向你的家人问候。
exampleTraditional: 請替我向你的家人問候。
exampleEnglish: Please give my regards to your family.
hintSimplified: 用话语或卡片表示关心，希望对方过得好。
hintTraditional: 用話語或卡片表示關心，希望對方過得好。
hintEnglish: Showing care through words or a card, wishing the other person well.

exampleSimplified: 他笑着和客人握手。
exampleTraditional: 他笑著和客人握手。
exampleEnglish: He smiled and shook hands with the guest.
hintSimplified: 两个人见面时互相伸出手，轻轻抓住。
hintTraditional: 兩個人見面時互相伸出手，輕輕抓住。
hintEnglish: When two people meet, they reach out and clasp each other's hands.

exampleSimplified: 我现在无法回答这个问题。
exampleTraditional: 我現在無法回答這個問題。
exampleEnglish: I'm unable to answer this question right now.
hintSimplified: 表示没有办法做某件事。
hintTraditional: 表示沒有辦法做某件事。
hintEnglish: Expresses that there is no way to do something.

exampleSimplified: 孩子的想象力是无穷的。
exampleTraditional: 孩子的想象力是無窮的。
exampleEnglish: Children's imagination is boundless.
hintSimplified: 形容多到没有尽头，数不完。
hintTraditional: 形容多到沒有盡頭，數不完。
hintEnglish: Describes something so much that it has no end and cannot be counted.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; misunderstanding; to mistake; to misunderstand
exampleSimplified: 对不起，这完全是个误会。
exampleTraditional: 對不起，這完全是個誤會。
exampleEnglish: I'm sorry, this is entirely a misunderstanding.
hintSimplified: 因为想错或听错，对别人的意思有了不对的了解。
hintTraditional: 因為想錯或聽錯，對別人的意思有了不對的了解。
hintEnglish: Getting someone's meaning wrong because of mistaken thinking or mishearing.

exampleSimplified: 最近物价越来越高,买菜也变贵了。
exampleTraditional: 最近物價越來越高,買菜也變貴了。
exampleEnglish: Prices have been rising lately, and even buying vegetables has become more expensive.
hintSimplified: 商店里各种东西的价钱,涨了大家会抱怨。
hintTraditional: 商店裡各種東西的價錢,漲了大家會抱怨。
hintEnglish: The cost of all kinds of things in stores; people complain when it goes up.

gloss: Northwest China (Shaanxi, Gansu, Qinghai, Ningxia, Xinjiang)
definition: Northwest China (Shaanxi, Gansu, Qinghai, Ningxia, Xinjiang); northwest
exampleSimplified: 这场雨是从西北方向来的。
exampleTraditional: 這場雨是從西北方向來的。
exampleEnglish: This rain came from the northwest.
hintSimplified: 地图上在西边和北边之间的方向。
hintTraditional: 地圖上在西邊和北邊之間的方向。
hintEnglish: The direction on a map between west and north.

exampleSimplified: 今天晚上我们去吃西餐,点了牛排。
exampleTraditional: 今天晚上我們去吃西餐,點了牛排。
exampleEnglish: Tonight we're going for Western food and ordered steak.
hintSimplified: 用刀叉吃的欧美风格的饭菜。
hintTraditional: 用刀叉吃的歐美風格的飯菜。
hintEnglish: European or American style meals eaten with a knife and fork.

definition: Western countries; the Occident; the West
exampleSimplified: 太阳从东方升起,从西方落下。
exampleTraditional: 太陽從東方升起,從西方落下。
exampleEnglish: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
hintSimplified: 太阳落下去的那一边;也可指欧美国家。
hintTraditional: 太陽落下去的那一邊;也可指歐美國家。
hintEnglish: The side where the sun goes down; also refers to Europe and America.

exampleSimplified: 台湾的西南部夏天特别热。
exampleTraditional: 台灣的西南部夏天特別熱。
exampleEnglish: The southwest of Taiwan is especially hot in summer.
hintSimplified: 地图上在西边和南边之间的方向。
hintTraditional: 地圖上在西邊和南邊之間的方向。
hintEnglish: The direction on a map between west and south.

exampleSimplified: 吸毒会严重伤害身体和家庭。
exampleTraditional: 吸毒會嚴重傷害身體和家庭。
exampleEnglish: Taking drugs seriously harms your body and family.
hintSimplified: 使用违法的药物,对健康非常危险。
hintTraditional: 使用違法的藥物,對健康非常危險。
hintEnglish: Using illegal substances, which is very dangerous to health.

definition: beast slaughtered as a sacrifice; to sacrifice (sth valued); to sacrifice one's life
exampleSimplified: 为了照顾孩子,妈妈牺牲了自己的工作。
exampleTraditional: 為了照顧孩子,媽媽犧牲了自己的工作。
exampleEnglish: To take care of her children, mother sacrificed her own career.
hintSimplified: 为了别人或重要的事,放弃自己的东西甚至生命。
hintTraditional: 為了別人或重要的事,放棄自己的東西甚至生命。
hintEnglish: To give up something of your own, even your life, for others or something important.

definition: to absorb; to assimilate; to ingest; to recruit
exampleSimplified: 海绵可以吸收很多水。
exampleTraditional: 海綿可以吸收很多水。
exampleEnglish: A sponge can absorb a lot of water.
hintSimplified: 把水、养分或知识等收进来变成自己的。
hintTraditional: 把水、養分或知識等收進來變成自己的。
hintEnglish: To take in water, nutrients or knowledge and make it your own.

gloss: to attract; to appeal to; to fascinate
definition: to attract; to appeal to; to fascinate
exampleSimplified: 这家店的蛋糕吸引了很多客人。
exampleTraditional: 這家店的蛋糕吸引了很多客人。
exampleEnglish: This shop's cakes attract many customers.
hintSimplified: 让人的注意力或脚步被拉过来。
hintTraditional: 讓人的注意力或腳步被拉過來。
hintEnglish: To draw people's attention or steps toward something.

definition: favorite; to be fond of; to like; to love
exampleSimplified: 孩子们都很喜爱这只可爱的小狗。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們都很喜愛這隻可愛的小狗。
exampleEnglish: The children all love this cute little dog.
hintSimplified: 对某人或某物有很深的好感,比喜欢更正式。
hintTraditional: 對某人或某物有很深的好感,比喜歡更正式。
hintEnglish: To have deep affection for someone or something; more formal than just liking.

exampleSimplified: 她做事很细心,从来不会出错。
exampleTraditional: 她做事很細心,從來不會出錯。
exampleEnglish: She is very careful in her work and never makes mistakes.
hintSimplified: 形容人做事注意每个小地方,不马虎。
hintTraditional: 形容人做事注意每個小地方,不馬虎。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who pays attention to every small detail and is not sloppy.

definition: a drama; a play; theater; script of a play
exampleSimplified: 我们周末去剧院看了一场戏剧。
exampleTraditional: 我們週末去劇院看了一場戲劇。
exampleEnglish: We went to the theater to see a play on the weekend.
hintSimplified: 演员在舞台上表演故事的艺术。
hintTraditional: 演員在舞台上表演故事的藝術。
hintEnglish: The art of actors performing a story on stage.

exampleSimplified: 电脑系统需要定期更新。
exampleTraditional: 電腦系統需要定期更新。
exampleEnglish: The computer system needs to be updated regularly.
hintSimplified: 由许多部分组成、一起运作的整体,电脑里也有。
hintTraditional: 由許多部分組成、一起運作的整體,電腦裡也有。
hintEnglish: A whole made of many parts working together; computers have one too.

gloss: (after verb of motion, indicates motion down and towards us, also fig.)
definition: (after verb of motion, indicates motion down and towards us, also fig.); (completed action marker); (indicates continuation from the past towards us); to be harvested (of crops); to be over (of a period of time); to come down; to go among the masses (said of leaders)
exampleSimplified: 请你从楼上走下来,我们一起吃饭。
exampleTraditional: 請你從樓上走下來,我們一起吃飯。
exampleEnglish: Please walk down from upstairs, and we'll eat together.
hintSimplified: 放在动词后面,表示动作从高处往说话人这边移动,也可以表示从动态变成安静。
hintTraditional: 放在動詞後面,表示動作從高處往說話人這邊移動,也可以表示從動態變成安靜。
hintEnglish: Placed after a verb, it shows movement from a high place toward the speaker, and can also mean going from active to calm.

definition: counterpart; opposite; relative; relatively; to oppose; to resist; vis-a-vis
exampleSimplified: 跟去年比起来,今年相对轻松一些。
exampleTraditional: 跟去年比起來,今年相對輕鬆一些。
exampleEnglish: Compared with last year, this year is relatively easier.
hintSimplified: 拿一件事和另一件事比较时才成立,不是绝对的。
hintTraditional: 拿一件事和另一件事比較時才成立,不是絕對的。
hintEnglish: Holds only when comparing one thing with another; not absolute.

exampleSimplified: 他没有生气,相反,还笑了起来。
exampleTraditional: 他沒有生氣,相反,還笑了起來。
exampleEnglish: He didn't get angry; on the contrary, he even started laughing.
hintSimplified: 指两件事的方向或情况完全不一样、正好对立。
hintTraditional: 指兩件事的方向或情況完全不一樣、正好對立。
hintEnglish: Describes two things that are completely different or exactly opposite.

definition: (statistics) correlation; pertinent; related; relevant; to be interrelated
exampleSimplified: 请把相关的资料交给我。
exampleTraditional: 請把相關的資料交給我。
exampleEnglish: Please hand the related materials to me.
hintSimplified: 和某件事有联系。
hintTraditional: 和某件事有聯絡。
hintEnglish: Having a connection to a certain matter.

exampleSimplified: 她身上喷了一点香水,味道很好闻。
exampleTraditional: 她身上噴了一點香水,味道很好聞。
exampleEnglish: She put on a little perfume, and it smells lovely.
hintSimplified: 喷在身上让人闻起来很香的液体。
hintTraditional: 噴在身上讓人聞起來很香的液體。
hintEnglish: A liquid sprayed on the body so that one smells pleasant.

exampleSimplified: 我们两个人的兴趣完全相同。
exampleTraditional: 我們兩個人的興趣完全相同。
exampleEnglish: The two of us have exactly the same interests.
hintSimplified: 两个或更多的东西一模一样,没有差别。
hintTraditional: 兩個或更多的東西一模一樣,沒有差別。
hintEnglish: Two or more things are exactly alike with no difference.

exampleSimplified: 老师详细地说明了考试的规则。
exampleTraditional: 老師詳細地說明了考試的規則。
exampleEnglish: The teacher explained the exam rules in detail.
hintSimplified: 形容说明或记录很完整,连小地方都讲到。
hintTraditional: 形容說明或記錄很完整,連小地方都講到。
hintEnglish: Describes an explanation or record that is complete, covering even small points.

definition: to anticipate; to call to mind; to think of
exampleSimplified: 我没想到你会来,真是惊喜!
exampleTraditional: 我沒想到你會來,真是驚喜!
exampleEnglish: I never expected you'd come. What a surprise!
hintSimplified: 脑子里出现某个念头,或事先料到。
hintTraditional: 腦子裡出現某個念頭,或事先料到。
hintEnglish: When an idea comes to mind, or when you foresee something.

exampleSimplified: 你可以想像一下十年后的世界吗?
exampleTraditional: 你可以想像一下十年後的世界嗎?
exampleEnglish: Can you imagine what the world will be like in ten years?
hintSimplified: 在脑中画出没有亲眼看过的画面。
hintTraditional: 在腦中畫出沒有親眼看過的畫面。
hintEnglish: To picture in your mind a scene you haven't actually seen.

exampleSimplified: 爸爸喜欢听相声,常常笑得很开心。
exampleTraditional: 爸爸喜歡聽相聲,常常笑得很開心。
exampleEnglish: Dad likes listening to crosstalk and often laughs happily.
hintSimplified: 两个人用说话的方式表演的传统搞笑节目。
hintTraditional: 兩個人用說話的方式表演的傳統搞笑節目。
hintEnglish: A traditional comedy show in which two performers joke through spoken dialogue.

definition: real; actual; realistic; pragmatic; materialistic; self-interested; reality; actuality
exampleSimplified: 梦想很美好,但现实有时很残酷。
exampleTraditional: 夢想很美好,但現實有時很殘酷。
exampleEnglish: Dreams are beautiful, but reality is sometimes harsh.
hintSimplified: 和梦想、想像相对,真正存在的情况。
hintTraditional: 和夢想、想像相對,真正存在的情況。
hintEnglish: Opposite to dreams and imagination; the situation that truly exists.

exampleSimplified: 这种现象在大城市里很常见。
exampleTraditional: 這種現象在大城市裡很常見。
exampleEnglish: This phenomenon is very common in big cities.
hintSimplified: 我们看到或感觉到的事情表现出来的样子。
hintTraditional: 我們看到或感覺到的事情表現出來的樣子。
hintEnglish: The way things appear when we see or notice them happening.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; limit; restriction; to confine; to limit; to restrict
exampleSimplified: 这个活动对年龄有限制。
exampleTraditional: 這個活動對年齡有限制。
exampleEnglish: This activity has an age restriction.
hintSimplified: 规定不能超过的范围或条件,让人不能随便做。
hintTraditional: 規定不能超過的範圍或條件,讓人不能隨便做。
hintEnglish: A rule or boundary that sets what cannot be exceeded, so people can't do as they please.

exampleSimplified: 我喜欢在睡觉前看一会儿小说。
exampleTraditional: 我喜歡在睡覺前看一會兒小說。
exampleEnglish: I like to read a novel for a while before sleeping.
hintSimplified: 一种有人物和故事的长篇文字作品,可以是虚构的。
hintTraditional: 一種有人物和故事的長篇文字作品,可以是虛構的。
hintEnglish: A long written work with characters and a plot, often fictional.

exampleSimplified: 小偷昨天晚上偷走了他的手机。
exampleTraditional: 小偷昨天晚上偷走了他的手機。
exampleEnglish: A thief stole his phone last night.
hintSimplified: 偷别人东西的人,警察常常要抓他。
hintTraditional: 偷別人東西的人,警察常常要抓他。
hintEnglish: A person who takes other people's belongings, whom the police try to catch.

exampleSimplified: 老师把我们分成五个小组讨论。
exampleTraditional: 老師把我們分成五個小組討論。
exampleEnglish: The teacher divided us into five groups for discussion.
hintSimplified: 几个人为了同一件事分成的一小队。
hintTraditional: 幾個人為了同一件事分成的一小隊。
hintEnglish: A small team of a few people formed for the same task.

definition: (theater) sound or visual effects; effect; efficacy; result
exampleSimplified: 这种药的效果很好,我已经不痛了。
exampleTraditional: 這種藥的效果很好,我已經不痛了。
exampleEnglish: This medicine works very well; my pain is already gone.
hintSimplified: 做一件事或用一个东西以后得到的结果好不好。
hintTraditional: 做一件事或用一個東西以後得到的結果好不好。
hintEnglish: How good the result is after doing something or using something.

definition: joke; jest; ridiculous; absurd; to laugh at; to mock
exampleSimplified: 他讲了一个很好笑的笑话。
exampleTraditional: 他講了一個很好笑的笑話。
exampleEnglish: He told a very funny joke.
hintSimplified: 一个短短的故事,说出来是为了让大家哈哈大笑。
hintTraditional: 一個短短的故事,說出來是為了讓大家哈哈大笑。
hintEnglish: A short story told to make everyone burst out laughing.

gloss: devoted to one's parents (and grandparents etc)
definition: devoted to one's parents (and grandparents etc); dutiful; filial; filial piety; to show filial piety towards (an older family member)
exampleSimplified: 他很孝顺,每个周末都回家陪父母。
exampleTraditional: 他很孝順,每個週末都回家陪父母。
exampleEnglish: He is very filial and goes home to be with his parents every weekend.
hintSimplified: 形容对父母很好、很尊敬、会照顾他们的人。
hintTraditional: 形容對父母很好、很尊敬、會照顧他們的人。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who treats their parents well, respects and takes care of them.

definition: (college, university) president; CL:個|个[ge4],位[wei4],名[ming2]; headmaster
exampleSimplified: 校长在开学典礼上给学生讲话。
exampleTraditional: 校長在開學典禮上給學生講話。
exampleEnglish: The principal gave a speech to the students at the opening ceremony.
hintSimplified: 一所学校里职位最高、负责管理全校的人。
hintTraditional: 一所學校裡職位最高、負責管理全校的人。
hintEnglish: The highest-ranking person in a school, in charge of running it.

exampleSimplified: 谢谢你协助我完成这份报告。
exampleTraditional: 謝謝你協助我完成這份報告。
exampleEnglish: Thank you for assisting me in completing this report.
hintSimplified: 在别人做事时给他帮忙,让事情更顺利。
hintTraditional: 在別人做事時給他幫忙,讓事情更順利。
hintEnglish: To help someone while they are working so things go more smoothly.

definition: CL:項|项[xiang4],個|个[ge4]; insight; knowledge; tips; understanding; what one has learned (through experience, reading etc)
exampleSimplified: 请你写一篇读书心得交给老师。
exampleTraditional: 請你寫一篇讀書心得交給老師。
exampleEnglish: Please write a reflection on your reading and hand it to the teacher.
hintSimplified: 学习或做完一件事以后,自己的体会和想法。
hintTraditional: 學習或做完一件事以後,自己的體會和想法。
hintEnglish: Your personal impressions and thoughts after studying or doing something.

exampleSimplified: 考试前他的心理压力很大。
exampleTraditional: 考試前他的心理壓力很大。
exampleEnglish: He was under a lot of psychological pressure before the exam.
hintSimplified: 人内心的想法和感受,也是一门研究这些的学问。
hintTraditional: 人內心的想法和感受,也是一門研究這些的學問。
hintEnglish: What goes on in a person's inner thoughts and feelings; also a field that studies them.

exampleSimplified: 这份小礼物是我的一点心意。
exampleTraditional: 這份小禮物是我的一點心意。
exampleEnglish: This little gift is a token of my goodwill.
hintSimplified: 送礼物或帮忙时,表示关心和感谢的那份情意。
hintTraditional: 送禮物或幫忙時,表示關心和感謝的那份情意。
hintEnglish: The warm feeling of care and gratitude shown when giving a gift or help.

gloss: to appreciate; to enjoy; to admire
definition: to appreciate; to enjoy; to admire
exampleSimplified: 我很欣赏他认真工作的态度。
exampleTraditional: 我很欣賞他認真工作的態度。
exampleEnglish: I really admire his serious attitude toward work.
hintSimplified: 觉得某人或某物很好、很美,并且喜欢。
hintTraditional: 覺得某人或某物很好、很美,並且喜歡。
hintEnglish: To find a person or thing good or beautiful and to like it.

definition: emerging; nascent; new; new life; new student; newborn; rebirth; regeneration
exampleSimplified: 今天学校为新生举办了说明会。
exampleTraditional: 今天學校為新生舉辦了說明會。
exampleEnglish: Today the school held an orientation for the new students.
hintSimplified: 刚刚进入学校的学生。
hintTraditional: 剛剛進入學校的學生。
hintEnglish: Students who have just entered a school.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; confidence; faith (in sb or sth)
exampleSimplified: 我对这次比赛很有信心。
exampleTraditional: 我對這次比賽很有信心。
exampleEnglish: I am very confident about this competition.
hintSimplified: 相信自己能做好某件事的感觉。
hintTraditional: 相信自己能做好某件事的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling of believing you can do something well.

exampleSimplified: 明天就要去旅行了,我兴奋得睡不着。
exampleTraditional: 明天就要去旅行了,我興奮得睡不著。
exampleEnglish: We're going on a trip tomorrow, and I'm too excited to sleep.
hintSimplified: 遇到很开心的事,心里激动、很有精神的样子。
hintTraditional: 遇到很開心的事,心裡激動、很有精神的樣子。
hintEnglish: The state of being thrilled and full of energy over something happy.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; action; mobile; operation; to move about
exampleSimplified: 光说没有用,我们要马上行动。
exampleTraditional: 光說沒有用,我們要馬上行動。
exampleEnglish: Talking is useless; we must take action right away.
hintSimplified: 不只是想或说,而是真的去做。
hintTraditional: 不只是想或說,而是真的去做。
hintEnglish: Not just thinking or talking, but actually doing it.

exampleSimplified: 这里的风景美得无法形容。
exampleTraditional: 這裡的風景美得無法形容。
exampleEnglish: The scenery here is too beautiful to describe.
hintSimplified: 用话把人或事物的样子说出来。
hintTraditional: 用話把人或事物的樣子說出來。
hintEnglish: To put into words what a person or thing is like.

exampleSimplified: 在图书馆大声说话是不好的行为。
exampleTraditional: 在圖書館大聲說話是不好的行為。
exampleEnglish: Talking loudly in the library is bad behavior.
hintSimplified: 一个人做出来的事,可以被说成好或不好。
hintTraditional: 一個人做出來的事,可以被說成好或不好。
hintEnglish: What a person does, which can be judged as good or bad.

exampleSimplified: 我今天早上六点就醒来了。
exampleTraditional: 我今天早上六點就醒來了。
exampleEnglish: I woke up at six this morning.
hintSimplified: 从睡觉的状态变成清楚的状态,眼睛睁开。
hintTraditional: 從睡覺的狀態變成清楚的狀態,眼睛睜開。
hintEnglish: To go from sleeping to being conscious, with your eyes opening.

exampleSimplified: 请在表格上填写你的姓名和性别。
exampleTraditional: 請在表格上填寫你的姓名和性別。
exampleEnglish: Please fill in your name and gender on the form.
hintSimplified: 表格上常要填的一项,分男或女。
hintTraditional: 表格上常要填的一項,分男或女。
hintEnglish: An item often found on forms, with the choices male or female.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; character; disposition; nature; temperament
exampleSimplified: 她的性格很开朗,朋友很多。
exampleTraditional: 她的性格很開朗,朋友很多。
exampleEnglish: She has a cheerful personality and many friends.
hintSimplified: 一个人比较稳定的特点,比如外向、害羞或脾气好。
hintTraditional: 一個人比較穩定的特點,比如外向、害羞或脾氣好。
hintEnglish: A person's lasting traits, such as being outgoing, shy or good-tempered.

exampleSimplified: 幸好我带了伞,没有被雨淋湿。
exampleTraditional: 幸好我帶了傘,沒有被雨淋溼。
exampleEnglish: Luckily I brought an umbrella and didn't get soaked by the rain.
hintSimplified: 用在句子开头,表示因为碰巧有好条件,避免了坏结果。
hintTraditional: 用在句子開頭,表示因為碰巧有好條件,避免了壞結果。
hintEnglish: Used at the start of a sentence to say that a lucky circumstance avoided a bad outcome.

exampleSimplified: 幸亏你提醒我,不然我就忘了。
exampleTraditional: 幸虧你提醒我,不然我就忘了。
exampleEnglish: Thankfully you reminded me; otherwise I would have forgotten.
hintSimplified: 表示多亏某个人或某件事,才没有发生不好的事。
hintTraditional: 表示多虧某個人或某件事,才沒有發生不好的事。
hintEnglish: Expresses that thanks to someone or something, a bad thing was avoided.

exampleSimplified: 我今天真幸运,抽中了第一名。
exampleTraditional: 我今天真幸運,抽中了第一名。
exampleEnglish: I'm so lucky today; I won first prize in the draw.
hintSimplified: 形容运气很好,常常碰到好事。
hintTraditional: 形容運氣很好,常常碰到好事。
hintEnglish: Describes having good fortune and often meeting good things.

exampleSimplified: 动物园里的熊猫很可爱,大家都想看。
exampleTraditional: 動物園裡的熊貓很可愛,大家都想看。
exampleEnglish: The pandas at the zoo are very cute, and everyone wants to see them.
hintSimplified: 这种黑白相间的动物爱吃竹子,是中国的代表动物。
hintTraditional: 這種黑白相間的動物愛吃竹子,是中國的代表動物。
hintEnglish: This black-and-white animal loves eating bamboo and is a symbol of China.

definition: to alter; to amend; to modify
exampleSimplified: 老师请我把报告再修改一次。
exampleTraditional: 老師請我把報告再修改一次。
exampleEnglish: The teacher asked me to revise the report once more.
hintSimplified: 写完文章后,发现有错误,要把内容改一改。
hintTraditional: 寫完文章後,發現有錯誤,要把內容改一改。
hintEnglish: After finishing an article and finding mistakes, you have to change the content.

definition: (coll.) to sort sb out; to fix; to fix sb; to prune; to repair; to trim
exampleSimplified: 我的脚踏车坏了,要送去修理。
exampleTraditional: 我的腳踏車壞了,要送去修理。
exampleEnglish: My bike is broken, so I need to take it to be repaired.
hintSimplified: 东西坏了以后,请师傅让它重新可以用。
hintTraditional: 東西壞了以後,請師傅讓它重新可以用。
hintEnglish: When something is broken, you ask a technician to make it work again.

exampleSimplified: 最近市场对手机的需求越来越大。
exampleTraditional: 最近市場對手機的需求越來越大。
exampleEnglish: Recently the market demand for mobile phones has been growing.
hintSimplified: 人们想要买某种东西的程度,和供给相对。
hintTraditional: 人們想要買某種東西的程度,和供給相對。
hintEnglish: How much people want to buy something; the counterpart of supply.

exampleSimplified: 这次选举有很多人去投票。
exampleTraditional: 這次選舉有很多人去投票。
exampleEnglish: Many people went to vote in this election.
hintSimplified: 大家投票决定谁来当市长或总统。
hintTraditional: 大家投票決定誰來當市長或總統。
hintEnglish: People vote to decide who will be mayor or president.

exampleSimplified: 这个学期的学费比去年贵一点。
exampleTraditional: 這個學期的學費比去年貴一點。
exampleEnglish: This semester's tuition is a bit more expensive than last year's.
hintSimplified: 上学时要向学校缴的钱。
hintTraditional: 上學時要向學校繳的錢。
hintEnglish: The money you pay to a school in order to study.

definition: institute; learned society; (scholarly) association; to learn; to master
exampleSimplified: 他花了三个月才学会游泳。
exampleTraditional: 他花了三個月才學會游泳。
exampleEnglish: It took him three months to learn how to swim.
hintSimplified: 经过练习以后,终于懂得怎么做一件事。
hintTraditional: 經過練習以後,終於懂得怎麼做一件事。
hintEnglish: After practice, you finally know how to do something.

gloss: a body of specialized knowledge (CL:門|门[men2]); (fig.) any activity that demands expertise, skill or experience (e.g. gathering forensic evidence, selecting clothing, managing relationships)
definition: a body of specialized knowledge (CL:門|门[men2]); (fig.) any activity that demands expertise, skill or experience (e.g. gathering forensic evidence, selecting clothing, managing relationships); learning; knowledge; scholarship
exampleSimplified: 泡茶看起来简单,其实很有学问。
exampleTraditional: 泡茶看起來簡單,其實很有學問。
exampleEnglish: Making tea seems simple, but there's actually a lot of expertise to it.
hintSimplified: 指很深的知识,或一件事里面有很多值得研究的道理。
hintTraditional: 指很深的知識,或一件事裡面有很多值得研究的道理。
hintEnglish: Deep knowledge, or something with much worth studying inside it.

exampleSimplified: 他到处寻找丢掉的钥匙。
exampleTraditional: 他到處尋找丟掉的鑰匙。
exampleEnglish: He searched everywhere for the lost keys.
hintSimplified: 东西不见了,你会四处去看,想把它找回来。
hintTraditional: 東西不見了,你會四處去看,想把它找回來。
hintEnglish: When something is missing, you look around in the hope of getting it back.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; to drill; to train; training
exampleSimplified: 球队每天早上都要训练两个小时。
exampleTraditional: 球隊每天早上都要訓練兩個小時。
exampleEnglish: The team has to train for two hours every morning.
hintSimplified: 运动员为了比赛,反复做的有计划的练习。
hintTraditional: 運動員為了比賽,反覆做的有計劃的練習。
hintEnglish: The planned, repeated practice athletes do to prepare for competitions.

exampleSimplified: 租房子的时候要先付一个月的押金。
exampleTraditional: 租房子的時候要先付一個月的押金。
exampleEnglish: When renting a place, you must first pay one month's deposit.
hintSimplified: 租东西时先交的钱,还东西后可能会退回来。
hintTraditional: 租東西時先交的錢,還東西后可能會退回來。
hintEnglish: Money paid first when renting something, which may be returned later.

exampleSimplified: 池塘里有几只鸭子在游泳。
exampleTraditional: 池塘裡有幾隻鴨子在游泳。
exampleEnglish: A few ducks are swimming in the pond.
hintSimplified: 这种鸟走路摇摇摆摆,会呱呱叫,也会游泳。
hintTraditional: 這種鳥走路搖搖擺擺,會呱呱叫,也會游泳。
hintEnglish: This bird waddles, quacks, and swims.

exampleSimplified: 吃完东西后要记得刷牙齿。
exampleTraditional: 吃完東西后要記得刷牙齒。
exampleEnglish: Remember to brush your teeth after eating.
hintSimplified: 嘴巴里用来咬东西的白色部分。
hintTraditional: 嘴巴里用來咬東西的白色部分。
hintEnglish: The white parts inside the mouth used for biting food.

definition: CL:場|场[chang3],次[ci4]; concert; performance; show; to act (in a play); to perform; to put on (a performance)
exampleSimplified: 今晚的演出七点开始,别迟到。
exampleTraditional: 今晚的演出七點開始,別遲到。
exampleEnglish: Tonight's performance starts at seven, so don't be late.
hintSimplified: 歌手或演员在舞台上给观众表演。
hintTraditional: 歌手或演員在舞台上給觀眾表演。
hintEnglish: Singers or actors perform on stage for an audience.

definition: (of personality) upbeat; energetic; sunshine; transparent (open to public scrutiny)
exampleSimplified: 早上的阳光从窗户照进房间。
exampleTraditional: 早上的陽光從窗戶照進房間。
exampleEnglish: The morning sunlight shines into the room through the window.
hintSimplified: 太阳照下来的明亮光线,让人觉得温暖。
hintTraditional: 太陽照下來的明亮光線,讓人覺得溫暖。
hintEnglish: The bright light from the sun that feels warm.

exampleSimplified: 这家店的菜样样都好吃。
exampleTraditional: 這家店的菜樣樣都好吃。
exampleEnglish: Every dish at this restaurant is delicious.
hintSimplified: 表示每一种都包括在内,没有例外。
hintTraditional: 表示每一種都包括在內,沒有例外。
hintEnglish: Means every single kind is included, without exception.

definition: (literary) beacon fire; (literary) descendants; posterity; cooked food; fireworks; smoke and fire
exampleSimplified: 跨年的时候,大家一起看烟火。
exampleTraditional: 跨年的時候,大家一起看煙火。
exampleEnglish: On New Year's Eve, everyone watches fireworks together.
hintSimplified: 节日晚上在天空中发出彩色亮光的东西。
hintTraditional: 節日晚上在天空中發出彩色亮光的東西。
hintEnglish: Something that bursts into colorful lights in the night sky on holidays.

definition: foresight; gaze; insight; vision; way of looking at things
exampleSimplified: 他很有眼光,买的房子越来越值钱。
exampleTraditional: 他很有眼光,買的房子越來越值錢。
exampleEnglish: He has good judgment; the house he bought keeps gaining value.
hintSimplified: 看事情或选东西的判断能力。
hintTraditional: 看事情或選東西的判斷能力。
hintEnglish: The ability to judge things or choose well.

gloss: to give a lecture; to make a speech
definition: to give a lecture; to make a speech
exampleSimplified: 校长明天要在礼堂演讲。
exampleTraditional: 校長明天要在禮堂演講。
exampleEnglish: The principal will give a speech in the auditorium tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 站在很多人面前,发表自己的看法。
hintTraditional: 站在很多人面前,發表自己的看法。
hintEnglish: Standing before many people to share your views.

exampleSimplified: 看到这部电影,她忍不住流下了眼泪。
exampleTraditional: 看到這部電影,她忍不住流下了眼淚。
exampleEnglish: Watching this movie, she couldn't help shedding tears.
hintSimplified: 人哭的时候,从眼睛流出来的水。
hintTraditional: 人哭的時候,從眼睛流出來的水。
hintEnglish: The water that flows from the eyes when a person cries.

exampleSimplified: 这位演员在电影里演一位老师。
exampleTraditional: 這位演員在電影裡演一位老師。
exampleEnglish: This actor plays a teacher in the movie.
hintSimplified: 在电影或戏剧里扮演角色的人。
hintTraditional: 在電影或戲劇裡扮演角色的人。
hintEnglish: A person who plays a role in a film or play.

exampleSimplified: 朋友邀请我参加他的生日派对。
exampleTraditional: 朋友邀請我參加他的生日派對。
exampleEnglish: My friend invited me to his birthday party.
hintSimplified: 请别人来参加活动或聚会。
hintTraditional: 請別人來參加活動或聚會。
hintEnglish: Asking others to come to an event or gathering.

exampleSimplified: 身体健康最要紧,工作可以慢慢做。
exampleTraditional: 身體健康最要緊,工作可以慢慢做。
exampleEnglish: Health is what matters most; work can be done slowly.
hintSimplified: 形容事情很重要,不能忽视。
hintTraditional: 形容事情很重要,不能忽視。
hintEnglish: Describes something so important it can't be ignored.

definition: (reduplicated) regardless of whether ... or ...; may as well; that's fine
exampleSimplified: 去也好,不去也好,你自己决定。
exampleTraditional: 去也好,不去也好,你自己決定。
exampleEnglish: Whether you go or not, it's up to you to decide.
hintSimplified: 常重复使用,表示不管哪一种选择都可以。
hintTraditional: 常重複使用,表示不管哪一種選擇都可以。
hintEnglish: Often used twice, meaning either choice is acceptable.

definition: at night; during the night; nighttime
exampleSimplified: 夜里外面很安静,我睡得很好。
exampleTraditional: 夜裡外面很安靜,我睡得很好。
exampleEnglish: It's very quiet outside at night, so I sleep well.
hintSimplified: 指天黑以后到天亮以前的这段时间里。
hintTraditional: 指天黑以後到天亮以前的這段時間裡。
hintEnglish: Refers to the period after dark and before dawn.

exclusionReason: Traditional form is not listed among dictionary recognized forms

exampleSimplified: 我的衣柜里有很多外套。
exampleTraditional: 我的衣櫃裡有很多外套。
exampleEnglish: There are many coats in my wardrobe.
hintSimplified: 卧室里放衣服的大家具。
hintTraditional: 臥室裡放衣服的大傢俱。
hintEnglish: A large piece of bedroom furniture where clothes are kept.

gloss: to rely on; to depend on
definition: to rely on; to depend on
exampleSimplified: 孩子小的时候,要依靠父母生活。
exampleTraditional: 孩子小的時候,要依靠父母生活。
exampleEnglish: When children are small, they have to rely on their parents to live.
hintSimplified: 自己没有能力时,需要别人帮助,不能没有他们。
hintTraditional: 自己沒有能力時,需要別人幫助,不能沒有他們。
hintEnglish: When you lack the ability yourself, you need others' help and can't do without them.

definition: in a row; in succession; running
exampleSimplified: 他一连三天都没有睡好。
exampleTraditional: 他一連三天都沒有睡好。
exampleEnglish: He hasn't slept well for three days in a row.
hintSimplified: 表示同一件事没有中断,接着发生好几次或好几天。
hintTraditional: 表示同一件事沒有中斷,接著發生好幾次或好幾天。
hintEnglish: Shows that the same thing happens without a break, several times or days one after another.

gloss: all one's life; throughout one's life
definition: all one's life; throughout one's life
exampleSimplified: 她把一生都献给了教育工作。
exampleTraditional: 她把一生都獻給了教育工作。
exampleEnglish: She devoted her whole life to education.
hintSimplified: 从出生到去世的整段时间。
hintTraditional: 從出生到去世的整段時間。
hintEnglish: The entire time from birth until death.

definition: a period of time; a while; at the same time; for a short while; momentary; temporary
exampleSimplified: 我一时想不起他的名字。
exampleTraditional: 我一時想不起他的名字。
exampleEnglish: I can't think of his name for the moment.
hintSimplified: 指很短的一段时间,常说暂时想不到或做不到。
hintTraditional: 指很短的一段時間,常說暫時想不到或做不到。
hintEnglish: Refers to a very short moment, often when you can't think of or do something for now.

exampleSimplified: 周末我们一同去爬山吧。
exampleTraditional: 週末我們一同去爬山吧。
exampleEnglish: Let's go hiking together this weekend.
hintSimplified: 和别人在一起做同一件事,比较书面。
hintTraditional: 和別人在一起做同一件事,比較書面。
hintEnglish: Doing the same thing in company with others; somewhat formal.

gloss: (indicating a period of time up to the present) all along; the whole time
definition: (indicating a period of time up to the present) all along; the whole time; a period of time in the recent past
exampleSimplified: 他一向很早起床,从不迟到。
exampleTraditional: 他一向很早起床,從不遲到。
exampleEnglish: He has always gotten up early and is never late.
hintSimplified: 表示从过去到现在一直都是这样,习惯没有变。
hintTraditional: 表示從過去到現在一直都是這樣,習慣沒有變。
hintEnglish: Indicates that from the past until now it has always been so, with no change in habit.

exampleSimplified: 桌上有苹果、香蕉以及一些饼干。
exampleTraditional: 桌上有蘋果、香蕉以及一些餅乾。
exampleEnglish: On the table are apples, bananas, and some cookies.
hintSimplified: 连词,用来把几个并列的东西接在一起,常放在最后一项前。
hintTraditional: 連詞,用來把幾個並列的東西接在一起,常放在最後一項前。
hintEnglish: A conjunction joining several items in a list, often placed before the last one.

gloss: since (used after a specified time or event)
definition: since (used after a specified time or event)
exampleSimplified: 搬到台北以来,我认识了很多朋友。
exampleTraditional: 搬到台北以來,我認識了很多朋友。
exampleEnglish: Since moving to Taipei, I have met many friends.
hintSimplified: 放在时间或事件后面,表示从那时到现在。
hintTraditional: 放在時間或事件後面,表示從那時到現在。
hintEnglish: Placed after a time or event, meaning from then until now.

definition: in order to avoid; so as not to
exampleSimplified: 出门要带伞,以免被雨淋湿。
exampleTraditional: 出門要帶傘,以免被雨淋溼。
exampleEnglish: Take an umbrella when going out so as not to get soaked by the rain.
hintSimplified: 连词,说明先做某事是为了不让不好的结果发生。
hintTraditional: 連詞,說明先做某事是為了不讓不好的結果發生。
hintEnglish: A conjunction saying you do something first so that a bad result doesn't happen.

exampleSimplified: 这个博物馆展出了许多艺术作品。
exampleTraditional: 這個博物館展出了許多藝術作品。
exampleEnglish: This museum exhibits many works of art.
hintSimplified: 画画、音乐、雕刻等有美感的创作。
hintTraditional: 畫畫、音樂、雕刻等有美感的創作。
hintEnglish: Creative works like painting, music and sculpture that have beauty.

exampleSimplified: 路上发生了一个意外,所以我迟到了。
exampleTraditional: 路上發生了一個意外,所以我遲到了。
exampleEnglish: An accident happened on the road, so I was late.
hintSimplified: 没有想到的事,常常是不好的事。
hintTraditional: 沒有想到的事,常常是不好的事。
hintEnglish: Something unexpected, often something bad.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; importance; meaning; sense; significance
exampleSimplified: 这个节日对我们有特别的意义。
exampleTraditional: 這個節日對我們有特別的意義。
exampleEnglish: This holiday has special meaning for us.
hintSimplified: 一件事的价值或所代表的含义。
hintTraditional: 一件事的價值或所代表的含義。
hintEnglish: The value or meaning that something represents.

exampleSimplified: 今天下大雨,因此比赛取消了。
exampleTraditional: 今天下大雨,因此比賽取消了。
exampleEnglish: It rained heavily today, so the game was canceled.
hintSimplified: 连词,放在后一句,说明前面的原因带来的结果。
hintTraditional: 連詞,放在後一句,說明前面的原因帶來的結果。
hintEnglish: A conjunction in the second clause giving the result of the reason just mentioned.

gloss: hi-fi system; stereo sound system (abbr. for 組合音響|组合音响[zu3 he2 yin1 xiang3])
definition: hi-fi system; stereo sound system (abbr. for 組合音響|组合音响[zu3 he2 yin1 xiang3]); sound; acoustics; audio
exampleSimplified: 这套音响的声音非常清楚。
exampleTraditional: 這套音響的聲音非常清楚。
exampleEnglish: The sound of this stereo system is very clear.
hintSimplified: 在家里听音乐用的机器和喇叭。
hintTraditional: 在家裡聽音樂用的機器和喇叭。
hintEnglish: Equipment with speakers used to listen to music at home.

gloss: to give rise to; to lead to; to cause; to arouse
definition: to give rise to; to lead to; to cause; to arouse
exampleSimplified: 这件事引起了大家的注意。
exampleTraditional: 這件事引起了大家的注意。
exampleEnglish: This matter attracted everyone's attention.
hintSimplified: 某件事让别人注意或产生某种结果。
hintTraditional: 某件事讓別人注意或產生某種結果。
hintEnglish: Something makes others notice or brings about a certain result.

exampleSimplified: 那位演员长得又高又英俊。
exampleTraditional: 那位演員長得又高又英俊。
exampleEnglish: That actor is tall and handsome.
hintSimplified: 形容男人长得好看、有精神。
hintTraditional: 形容男人長得好看、有精神。
hintEnglish: Describes a man who is good-looking and full of spirit.

exampleSimplified: 早餐要吃得有营养,身体才会健康。
exampleTraditional: 早餐要吃得有營養,身體才會健康。
exampleEnglish: Breakfast should be nutritious so that your body stays healthy.
hintSimplified: 食物里对身体有好处、让人长大和有力气的东西。
hintTraditional: 食物裡對身體有好處、讓人長大和有力氣的東西。
hintEnglish: The beneficial substances in food that help the body grow and stay strong.

definition: (Tw) video; video clip; CL:部[bu4]; a copy of a film; film; motion picture; movie
exampleSimplified: 我在网络上看了一部有趣的影片。
exampleTraditional: 我在網路上看了一部有趣的影片。
exampleEnglish: I watched an interesting video online.
hintSimplified: 可以在手机或电脑上播放的短片或电影。
hintTraditional: 可以在手機或電腦上播放的短片或電影。
hintEnglish: A short film or movie that can be played on a phone or computer.

exampleSimplified: 这个小男孩很勇敢,一点也不怕黑。
exampleTraditional: 這個小男孩很勇敢,一點也不怕黑。
exampleEnglish: This little boy is very brave and not afraid of the dark at all.
hintSimplified: 面对危险或困难时不害怕的性格。
hintTraditional: 面對危險或困難時不害怕的性格。
hintEnglish: A character trait of not being afraid when facing danger or difficulty.

gloss: to have; to possess; to own
definition: to have; to possess; to own
exampleSimplified: 他拥有一家很大的公司。
exampleTraditional: 他擁有一家很大的公司。
exampleEnglish: He owns a very large company.
hintSimplified: 表示某人有很多东西、财产或能力,比较书面。
hintTraditional: 表示某人有很多東西、財產或能力,比較書面。
hintEnglish: Means someone has a lot of things, property or abilities; fairly formal.

exampleSimplified: 我会永远记得这个夏天。
exampleTraditional: 我會永遠記得這個夏天。
exampleEnglish: I will remember this summer forever.
hintSimplified: 时间没有尽头,一直都不会改变。
hintTraditional: 時間沒有盡頭,一直都不會改變。
hintEnglish: Time without end; it will never change.

exampleSimplified: 老师正在解释这个词的用法。
exampleTraditional: 老師正在解釋這個詞的用法。
exampleEnglish: The teacher is explaining how this word is used.
hintSimplified: 一个词或一样东西应该怎么使用的方法。
hintTraditional: 一個詞或一樣東西應該怎麼使用的方法。
hintEnglish: The way a word or thing should be used.

exampleSimplified: 这家店卖各种日常用品。
exampleTraditional: 這家店賣各種日常用品。
exampleEnglish: This store sells all kinds of daily necessities.
hintSimplified: 生活或工作中需要用到的东西,例如牙刷和毛巾。
hintTraditional: 生活或工作中需要用到的東西,例如牙刷和毛巾。
hintEnglish: Things needed in life or work, such as toothbrushes and towels.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],項|项[xiang4]; advantage; benefit; merit; strong point
exampleSimplified: 这个手机的优点是电池很耐用。
exampleTraditional: 這個手機的優點是電池很耐用。
exampleEnglish: The advantage of this phone is its durable battery.
hintSimplified: 人或东西比较好的地方,和缺点相反。
hintTraditional: 人或東西比較好的地方,和缺點相反。
hintEnglish: The good aspect of a person or thing, the opposite of a weakness.

exampleSimplified: 他说话很幽默,大家都笑了。
exampleTraditional: 他說話很幽默,大家都笑了。
exampleEnglish: He speaks very humorously, and everyone laughed.
hintSimplified: 会说有趣的话,让大家开心大笑的特点。
hintTraditional: 會說有趣的話,讓大家開心大笑的特點。
hintEnglish: The quality of saying funny things that make everyone laugh happily.

exampleSimplified: 她是一位非常优秀的学生。
exampleTraditional: 她是一位非常優秀的學生。
exampleEnglish: She is an excellent student.
hintSimplified: 形容成绩或表现特别好,比一般人强很多。
hintTraditional: 形容成績或表現特別好,比一般人強很多。
hintEnglish: Describes results or performance that are much better than most people's.

exampleSimplified: 这个公园每天都有很多游客。
exampleTraditional: 這個公園每天都有很多遊客。
exampleEnglish: This park has many tourists every day.
hintSimplified: 到外地或景点玩的人。
hintTraditional: 到外地或景點玩的人。
hintEnglish: People who visit a place or attraction for fun.

definition: as a result of; because; due to; owing to; since; thanks to
exampleSimplified: 由于下大雨,比赛取消了。
exampleTraditional: 由於下大雨,比賽取消了。
exampleEnglish: Because of the heavy rain, the match was cancelled.
hintSimplified: 用来说明原因,后面常接结果。
hintTraditional: 用來說明原因,後面常接結果。
hintEnglish: Used to state a reason, usually followed by a result.

exampleSimplified: 这个方法非常有效。
exampleTraditional: 這個方法非常有效。
exampleEnglish: This method is very effective.
hintSimplified: 形容做法能真的得到好结果。
hintTraditional: 形容做法能真的得到好結果。
hintEnglish: Describes a way of doing something that really gets good results.

definition: companionship; fellowship; friendship; see 友誼縣|友谊县[You3 yi4 Xian4]
exampleSimplified: 我们的友谊已经有十年了。
exampleTraditional: 我們的友誼已經有十年了。
exampleEnglish: Our friendship has lasted ten years.
hintSimplified: 朋友之间深厚的感情。
hintTraditional: 朋友之間深厚的感情。
hintEnglish: The deep bond of feeling between friends.

exampleSimplified: 祝你有一个愉快的周末。
exampleTraditional: 祝你有一個愉快的週末。
exampleEnglish: Wishing you a pleasant weekend.
hintSimplified: 心情很好、很高兴的样子。
hintTraditional: 心情很好、很高興的樣子。
hintEnglish: Being in a good mood and feeling glad.

gloss: thereupon; as a result; consequently; thus; hence
definition: thereupon; as a result; consequently; thus; hence
exampleSimplified: 天气变冷了,于是我穿上了外套。
exampleTraditional: 天氣變冷了,於是我穿上了外套。
exampleEnglish: The weather got cold, so I put on a coat.
hintSimplified: 连接两件事,表示前面的事引起后面的行动。
hintTraditional: 連線兩件事,表示前面的事引起後面的行動。
hintEnglish: Links two events, showing the first led to the following action.

exampleSimplified: 夏天我喜欢吃烤玉米。
exampleTraditional: 夏天我喜歡吃烤玉米。
exampleEnglish: In summer I like to eat grilled corn.
hintSimplified: 一种黄色的谷物,有很多颗粒,可以煮或烤着吃。
hintTraditional: 一種黃色的穀物,有很多顆粒,可以煮或烤著吃。
hintEnglish: A yellow grain with many kernels, eaten boiled or grilled.

definition: preparation; preparatory; to make ready; to prepare
exampleSimplified: 我们要预备明天的会议。
exampleTraditional: 我們要預備明天的會議。
exampleEnglish: We need to get ready for tomorrow's meeting.
hintSimplified: 事情开始以前,先把东西或心理准备好。
hintTraditional: 事情開始以前,先把東西或心理準備好。
hintEnglish: Getting things or yourself ready before something starts.

gloss: to meet; to run into; to come across
definition: to meet; to run into; to come across
exampleSimplified: 我在路上遇到了老同学。
exampleTraditional: 我在路上遇到了老同學。
exampleEnglish: I ran into an old classmate on the road.
hintSimplified: 没有约好,突然碰见人或事情。
hintTraditional: 沒有約好,突然碰見人或事情。
hintEnglish: To come across a person or situation without planning.

exampleSimplified: 上课以前,我会先预习新课文。
exampleTraditional: 上課以前,我會先預習新課文。
exampleEnglish: Before class, I preview the new text first.
hintSimplified: 上课前先看一看新的内容。
hintTraditional: 上課前先看一看新的內容。
hintEnglish: Looking over new material before class.

exampleSimplified: 这家公司有两百多名员工。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司有兩百多名員工。
exampleEnglish: This company has over two hundred employees.
hintSimplified: 在公司里上班工作的人。
hintTraditional: 在公司裡上班工作的人。
hintEnglish: People who work for a company.

definition: to excuse; to forgive; to pardon
exampleSimplified: 请原谅我今天迟到了。
exampleTraditional: 請原諒我今天遲到了。
exampleEnglish: Please forgive me for being late today.
hintSimplified: 别人做错事后,你不再生气,也不责怪他。
hintTraditional: 別人做錯事後,你不再生氣,也不責怪他。
hintEnglish: When someone did wrong and you stop being angry or blaming them.

exampleSimplified: 他的愿望是环游世界。
exampleTraditional: 他的願望是環遊世界。
exampleEnglish: His wish is to travel around the world.
hintSimplified: 心里希望将来能实现的事。
hintTraditional: 心裡希望將來能實現的事。
hintEnglish: Something you hope will come true in the future.

exampleSimplified: 中秋节我们全家一起吃月饼。
exampleTraditional: 中秋節我們全家一起吃月餅。
exampleEnglish: At the Mid-Autumn Festival, our whole family eats mooncakes together.
hintSimplified: 中秋节常吃的圆形甜点。
hintTraditional: 中秋節常吃的圓形甜點。
hintEnglish: A round sweet pastry traditionally eaten at a autumn festival.

exampleSimplified: 多阅读可以帮助你学好中文。
exampleTraditional: 多閱讀可以幫助你學好中文。
exampleEnglish: Reading more can help you learn Chinese well.
hintSimplified: 看书、看文章,理解上面的内容。
hintTraditional: 看書、看文章,理解上面的內容。
hintEnglish: Looking at books or articles and understanding the content.

exampleSimplified: 这个乐团下个月要来台湾演出。
exampleTraditional: 這個樂團下個月要來台灣演出。
exampleEnglish: This band is coming to Taiwan to perform next month.
hintSimplified: 一群人一起演奏音乐的组织。
hintTraditional: 一群人一起演奏音樂的組織。
hintEnglish: A group of people who play music together.

exampleSimplified: 今天我的运气真好,买到了最后一张票。
exampleTraditional: 今天我的運氣真好,買到了最後一張票。
exampleEnglish: I'm really lucky today; I got the last ticket.
hintSimplified: 事情顺利或不顺利,好像不是靠努力决定的。
hintTraditional: 事情順利或不順利,好像不是靠努力決定的。
hintEnglish: Whether things go smoothly or not, as if not decided by effort.

exampleSimplified: 他一点也不在意别人怎么说。
exampleTraditional: 他一點也不在意別人怎麼說。
exampleEnglish: He doesn't care at all what others say.
hintSimplified: 把某件事放在心上,觉得很重要。
hintTraditional: 把某件事放在心上,覺得很重要。
hintEnglish: Keeping something in mind because it matters to you.

gloss: (of a matter) to be determined by; to be up to (sb)
definition: (of a matter) to be determined by; to be up to (sb); to rest with; to lie in; to be due to (a certain attribute)
exampleSimplified: 成功的关键在于不放弃。
exampleTraditional: 成功的關鍵在於不放棄。
exampleEnglish: The key to success lies in not giving up.
hintSimplified: 用来指出事情的关键或原因是什么。
hintTraditional: 用來指出事情的關鍵或原因是什麼。
hintEnglish: Used to point out what the key or reason of a matter is.

definition: soon; at an early date; the early days; the past
exampleSimplified: 祝你早日恢复健康。
exampleTraditional: 祝你早日恢復健康。
exampleEnglish: I wish you a speedy recovery.
hintSimplified: 希望事情在不久的将来尽快实现。
hintTraditional: 希望事情在不久的將來儘快實現。
hintEnglish: Hoping something will happen as soon as possible in the near future.

definition: (coll.) (this, or that) point of time; (dialect) at some time in the future; (in reference to sth that is bound to happen) sooner or later; one of these days; morning and evening
exampleSimplified: 这件事你早晚会知道的。
exampleTraditional: 這件事你早晚會知道的。
exampleEnglish: Sooner or later you will find out about this.
hintSimplified: 不管时间早或晚,事情终究会发生。
hintTraditional: 不管時間早或晚,事情終究會發生。
hintEnglish: Whether it is early or late, something will eventually happen.

gloss: to bring about; to create; to cause
definition: to bring about; to create; to cause
exampleSimplified: 大雨造成了严重的交通问题。
exampleTraditional: 大雨造成了嚴重的交通問題。
exampleEnglish: The heavy rain caused serious traffic problems.
hintSimplified: 某件事引起了某个结果,常是不好的结果。
hintTraditional: 某件事引起了某個結果,常是不好的結果。
hintEnglish: One thing leads to a result, often a bad one.

exampleSimplified: 楼下的施工噪音让我睡不着。
exampleTraditional: 樓下的施工噪音讓我睡不著。
exampleEnglish: The construction noise downstairs keeps me from sleeping.
hintSimplified: 很吵、让人不舒服的声音。
hintTraditional: 很吵、讓人不舒服的聲音。
hintEnglish: Loud, unpleasant sounds that bother people.

exampleSimplified: 最近下雨的日子增加了。
exampleTraditional: 最近下雨的日子增加了。
exampleEnglish: The number of rainy days has increased recently.
hintSimplified: 数量或程度变得更多、更大,就是这个动作。
hintTraditional: 數量或程度變得更多、更大,就是這個動作。
hintEnglish: This is what happens when a quantity or degree becomes greater.

exampleSimplified: 照顾孩子是父母的责任。
exampleTraditional: 照顧孩子是父母的責任。
exampleEnglish: Taking care of children is the parents' responsibility.
hintSimplified: 你应该做好、出了问题要负起的事情。
hintTraditional: 你應該做好、出了問題要負起的事情。
hintEnglish: What you ought to do well and must answer for if something goes wrong.

gloss: (at the beginning of a sentence) afterwards; since then
definition: (at the beginning of a sentence) afterwards; since then; after; behind
exampleSimplified: 吃完饭之后,我们去散步。
exampleTraditional: 吃完飯之後,我們去散步。
exampleEnglish: After eating, we went for a walk.
hintSimplified: 表示在某件事结束以后的时间。
hintTraditional: 表示在某件事結束以後的時間。
hintEnglish: Indicates the time after some event has ended.

definition: (after a noun) between; among; amid; (used after certain bisyllabic words to form expressions indicating a short period of time, e.g. 彈指之間|弹指之间[tan2 zhi3 zhi1 jian1])
exampleSimplified: 银行在书店和学校之间。
exampleTraditional: 銀行在書店和學校之間。
exampleEnglish: The bank is between the bookstore and the school.
hintSimplified: 放在两个人或事物后面,表示在它们中间。
hintTraditional: 放在兩個人或事物後面,表示在它們中間。
hintEnglish: Placed after two people or things to mean in the middle of them.

definition: ago; before; beforehand; previously; prior to
exampleSimplified: 睡觉之前,我喜欢喝一杯热牛奶。
exampleTraditional: 睡覺之前,我喜歡喝一杯熱牛奶。
exampleEnglish: Before going to bed, I like to drink a cup of hot milk.
hintSimplified: 表示在某件事发生以前的时间。
hintTraditional: 表示在某件事發生以前的時間。
hintEnglish: Indicates the time before some event happens.

exampleSimplified: 我等到晚上,直到他回来才睡。
exampleTraditional: 我等到晚上,直到他回來才睡。
exampleEnglish: I waited until evening and only slept when he came back.
hintSimplified: 表示一件事一直持续到某个时间点才结束。
hintTraditional: 表示一件事一直持續到某個時間點才結束。
hintEnglish: Shows that something continues up to a certain point in time before stopping.

gloss: to merit; to deserve; to be worth (doing sth)
definition: to merit; to deserve; to be worth (doing sth); worth the money
exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅很值得去试试。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳很值得去試試。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant is really worth trying.
hintSimplified: 做某件事有好处、花时间或钱也不会后悔。
hintTraditional: 做某件事有好處、花時間或錢也不會後悔。
hintEnglish: Doing something brings benefits so you won't regret the time or money.

exampleSimplified: 这个公园里有很多种植物。
exampleTraditional: 這個公園裡有很多種植物。
exampleEnglish: There are many kinds of plants in this park.
hintSimplified: 花、草、树都属于这一类生物。
hintTraditional: 花、草、樹都屬於這一類生物。
hintEnglish: Flowers, grass and trees all belong to this group of living things.

exampleSimplified: 你想选择什么职业?
exampleTraditional: 你想選擇什麼職業?
exampleEnglish: What profession do you want to choose?
hintSimplified: 医生、老师、律师都是这类工作的名称。
hintTraditional: 醫生、老師、律師都是這類工作的名稱。
hintEnglish: Doctor, teacher and lawyer are all examples of this.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],位[wei4]; office worker; staff member
exampleSimplified: 他是公司的一位职员。
exampleTraditional: 他是公司的一位職員。
exampleEnglish: He is an employee of the company.
hintSimplified: 在公司或机关上班的普通工作人员。
hintTraditional: 在公司或機關上班的普通工作人員。
hintEnglish: An ordinary person who works in an office or organization.

definition: but; however; merely; only; just; nothing but; simply
exampleSimplified: 这件衣服很漂亮,只是有点贵。
exampleTraditional: 這件衣服很漂亮,只是有點貴。
exampleEnglish: This outfit is pretty, it's just a little expensive.
hintSimplified: 用在句子中间,表示轻微的转折,补充一个小缺点。
hintTraditional: 用在句子中間,表示輕微的轉折,補充一個小缺點。
hintEnglish: Used mid-sentence for a slight contrast, adding a small drawback.

gloss: (used in combination with 才[cai2]) it is only if ... (that one can ...) (as in 只有通過治療才能痊愈|只有通过治疗才能痊愈[zhi3 you3 tong1 guo4 zhi4 liao2 cai2 neng2 quan2 yu4] "the only way to cure it is with therapy")
definition: (used in combination with 才[cai2]) it is only if ... (that one can ...) (as in 只有通過治療才能痊愈|只有通过治疗才能痊愈[zhi3 you3 tong1 guo4 zhi4 liao2 cai2 neng2 quan2 yu4] "the only way to cure it is with therapy"); (used to express lack of alternatives) can only; have no choice but to (as in 只有屈服[zhi3 you3 qu1 fu2] "the only thing you can do is give in"); it is only (someone) who ... (as in 只有男性才有此需要[zhi3 you3 nan2 xing4 cai2 you3 ci3 xu1 yao4] "only men would have such a requirement"); only have ...; there is only ...
exampleSimplified: 只有多练习,你才能说得好。
exampleTraditional: 只有多練習,你才能說得好。
exampleEnglish: Only by practicing more can you speak well.
hintSimplified: 常和“才”一起用,表示唯一的条件。
hintTraditional: 常和“才”一起用,表示唯一的條件。
hintEnglish: Often used with another word to express the one and only condition.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; institution; system (e.g. political, adminstrative etc)
exampleSimplified: 学校有新的考试制度。
exampleTraditional: 學校有新的考試制度。
exampleEnglish: The school has a new examination system.
hintSimplified: 国家、公司或学校规定大家都要遵守的办法。
hintTraditional: 國家、公司或學校規定大家都要遵守的辦法。
hintEnglish: The set of rules a country, company or school requires everyone to follow.

exampleSimplified: 老人的智慧帮我们解决了问题。
exampleTraditional: 老人的智慧幫我們解決了問題。
exampleEnglish: The elderly person's wisdom helped us solve the problem.
hintSimplified: 聪明加上丰富的经验,能做出好的判断。
hintTraditional: 聰明加上豐富的經驗,能做出好的判斷。
hintEnglish: Intelligence combined with experience that leads to good judgment.

exampleSimplified: 我每天至少喝两杯水。
exampleTraditional: 我每天至少喝兩杯水。
exampleEnglish: I drink at least two glasses of water every day.
hintSimplified: 表示数量最低也有这么多,可能更多。
hintTraditional: 表示數量最低也有這麼多,可能更多。
hintEnglish: Says the amount is this much at the minimum, possibly more.

definition: as for; as to; to go so far as to
exampleSimplified: 我会去,至于他去不去,我不知道。
exampleTraditional: 我會去,至於他去不去,我不知道。
exampleEnglish: I will go; as for whether he goes, I don't know.
hintSimplified: 用来转到另一个话题,说“关于……”。
hintTraditional: 用來轉到另一個話題,說“關於……”。
hintEnglish: Used to switch to another topic, meaning "regarding...".

gloss: temporary; provisional; for the time being
definition: temporary; provisional; for the time being
exampleSimplified: 这个问题暂时不用处理。
exampleTraditional: 這個問題暫時不用處理。
exampleEnglish: This problem doesn't need to be dealt with for now.
hintSimplified: 只在短时间内这样,以后可能会改变。
hintTraditional: 只在短時間內這樣,以後可能會改變。
hintEnglish: Only for a short while; it may change later.

exampleSimplified: 战争让很多人失去了家。
exampleTraditional: 戰爭讓很多人失去了家。
exampleEnglish: War made many people lose their homes.
hintSimplified: 国家与国家之间用军队打的大冲突。
hintTraditional: 國家與國家之間用軍隊打的大沖突。
hintEnglish: A large conflict fought with armies between countries.

definition: fluency; to control; to grasp (often fig.); to know well; to master; to seize (initiative, opportunity, destiny); to understand sth well and know how to use it
exampleSimplified: 他已经掌握了这门技术。
exampleTraditional: 他已經掌握了這門技術。
exampleEnglish: He has already mastered this technique.
hintSimplified: 学得很熟,能够完全运用或控制。
hintTraditional: 學得很熟,能夠完全運用或控制。
hintEnglish: To learn something so well that you can fully use or control it.

exampleSimplified: 语言不应该是交朋友的障碍。
exampleTraditional: 語言不應該是交朋友的障礙。
exampleEnglish: Language should not be an obstacle to making friends.
hintSimplified: 挡在前面,让事情不容易顺利完成的东西。
hintTraditional: 擋在前面,讓事情不容易順利完成的東西。
hintEnglish: Something standing in the way that keeps things from going smoothly.

definition: Taiwan pr. [zhao1ji2]; to feel a sense of urgency; to be in a hurry; to worry; to feel anxious
exampleSimplified: 别着急,时间还很多。
exampleTraditional: 別著急,時間還很多。
exampleEnglish: Don't worry, there's still plenty of time.
hintSimplified: 事情还没完成,心里很不安、想快一点的感觉。
hintTraditional: 事情還沒完成,心裡很不安、想快一點的感覺。
hintEnglish: The anxious feeling of wanting to hurry because something isn't done yet.

gloss: to hold a reception; to offer hospitality; to entertain (guests); to serve (customers)
definition: to hold a reception; to offer hospitality; to entertain (guests); to serve (customers)
exampleSimplified: 我们热情地招待了远方来的客人。
exampleTraditional: 我們熱情地招待了遠方來的客人。
exampleEnglish: We warmly entertained the guests from afar.
hintSimplified: 客人来了,用饮料和食物好好照顾他们。
hintTraditional: 客人來了,用飲料和食物好好照顧他們。
hintEnglish: When guests arrive, taking good care of them with food and drink.

definition: reputation of a business; shop sign; signboard
exampleSimplified: 这家小吃店的招牌很大。
exampleTraditional: 這家小吃店的招牌很大。
exampleEnglish: This snack shop's signboard is very big.
hintSimplified: 挂在店门口,写着店名的牌子。
hintTraditional: 掛在店門口,寫著店名的牌子。
hintEnglish: The board hung at a shop's entrance showing its name.

gloss: (dialect) to make money; to earn a living
definition: (dialect) to make money; to earn a living; to give change; to seek funding
exampleSimplified: 老板,请找钱给我。
exampleTraditional: 老闆,請找錢給我。
exampleEnglish: Boss, please give me my change.
hintSimplified: 付的钱比价格多时,店员要还给你剩下的钱。
hintTraditional: 付的錢比價格多時,店員要還給你剩下的錢。
hintEnglish: When you pay more than the price, the clerk gives back the remainder.

exampleSimplified: 这张老照片对我来说非常珍贵。
exampleTraditional: 這張老照片對我來說非常珍貴。
exampleEnglish: This old photo is very precious to me.
hintSimplified: 很稀少、很有价值,值得好好保存的。
hintTraditional: 很稀少、很有價值,值得好好儲存的。
hintEnglish: Rare and valuable, worth keeping carefully.

exampleSimplified: 科学家一直在寻找宇宙的真理。
exampleTraditional: 科學家一直在尋找宇宙的真理。
exampleEnglish: Scientists have always been searching for the truth of the universe.
hintSimplified: 哲学家和科学家都想找到的、永远正确的道理。
hintTraditional: 哲學家和科學家都想找到的、永遠正確的道理。
hintEnglish: What philosophers and scientists want to find: a principle that is always correct.

exampleSimplified: 这部电影讲的是一个真实的故事。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影講的是一個真實的故事。
exampleEnglish: This movie tells a true story.
hintSimplified: 形容事情不是假的,而是确实发生过或存在的。
hintTraditional: 形容事情不是假的,而是確實發生過或存在的。
hintEnglish: Describes something that is not fake but actually happened or exists.

definition: (coll.) (used to express disapproval, annoyance etc); indeed; truly
exampleSimplified: 你真是的,怎么又忘了带钥匙?
exampleTraditional: 你真是的,怎麼又忘了帶鑰匙?
exampleEnglish: Honestly, you! How could you forget your keys again?
hintSimplified: 口语中用来表示不满或有点生气的说法。
hintTraditional: 口語中用來表示不滿或有點生氣的說法。
hintEnglish: A spoken expression used to show displeasure or mild annoyance.

exampleSimplified: 我真心希望你能过得幸福。
exampleTraditional: 我真心希望你能過得幸福。
exampleEnglish: I sincerely hope you can live a happy life.
hintSimplified: 不是客套话,而是从心里发出的诚意。
hintTraditional: 不是客套話,而是從心裡發出的誠意。
hintEnglish: Not mere politeness, but honesty that comes from the heart.

exampleSimplified: 住在这里以后,我才真正了解了这座城市。
exampleTraditional: 住在這裡以後,我才真正了解了這座城市。
exampleEnglish: Only after living here did I truly understand this city.
hintSimplified: 表示不是表面上的,而是实实在在的、名副其实的。
hintTraditional: 表示不是表面上的,而是實實在在的、名副其實的。
hintEnglish: Indicates something is not just on the surface but genuinely what it claims to be.

definition: to arrange; to collate (data, files); to list systematically; to pack (luggage); to sort out; to straighten out; to tidy up
exampleSimplified: 周末我要把房间好好整理一下。
exampleTraditional: 週末我要把房間好好整理一下。
exampleEnglish: This weekend I'm going to tidy up my room properly.
hintSimplified: 把乱的东西收好、排好,让它变得有秩序。
hintTraditional: 把亂的東西收好、排好,讓它變得有秩序。
hintEnglish: Putting messy things away and in order so they are well organized.

exampleSimplified: 孩子们排得很整齐地走进教室。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們排得很整齊地走進教室。
exampleEnglish: The children walked into the classroom in neat lines.
hintSimplified: 形容东西或人排列得很有秩序,不乱。
hintTraditional: 形容東西或人排列得很有秩序,不亂。
hintEnglish: Describes things or people arranged in good order, not messy.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; certificate; identification; proof; testimonial; to confirm the truth of; to prove; to testify
exampleSimplified: 你要拿出证据来证明你说的是对的。
exampleTraditional: 你要拿出證據來證明你說的是對的。
exampleEnglish: You have to produce evidence to prove that what you said is right.
hintSimplified: 用事实或材料说明某件事是真的。
hintTraditional: 用事實或材料說明某件事是真的。
hintEnglish: Using facts or documents to show that something is true.

exampleSimplified: 这道题的答案是正确的。
exampleTraditional: 這道題的答案是正確的。
exampleEnglish: The answer to this question is correct.
hintSimplified: 考试时老师希望你的答案是这样的,不是错的。
hintTraditional: 考試時老師希望你的答案是這樣的,不是錯的。
hintEnglish: What a teacher hopes your exam answer will be: not wrong.

exampleSimplified: 她通过考试,拿到了英语证书。
exampleTraditional: 她透過考試,拿到了英語證書。
exampleEnglish: She passed the exam and got an English certificate.
hintSimplified: 通过考试或完成课程后,可以拿到的一张纸,证明你的能力。
hintTraditional: 透過考試或完成課程後,可以拿到的一張紙,證明你的能力。
hintEnglish: A paper you receive after passing a test or course, proving your ability.

exampleSimplified: 他对政治很感兴趣,常常看新闻。
exampleTraditional: 他對政治很感興趣,常常看新聞。
exampleEnglish: He is very interested in politics and often watches the news.
hintSimplified: 跟国家、政府和选举有关的事情。
hintTraditional: 跟國家、政府和選舉有關的事情。
hintEnglish: Matters related to the country, government and elections.

exampleSimplified: 哥哥在大学里念哲学。
exampleTraditional: 哥哥在大學裡念哲學。
exampleEnglish: My older brother studies philosophy at university.
hintSimplified: 一门研究人生、知识和世界根本问题的学问。
hintTraditional: 一門研究人生、知識和世界根本問題的學問。
hintEnglish: A field of study about life, knowledge and the fundamental questions of the world.

gloss: middle part; central section; central region
definition: middle part; central section; central region
exampleSimplified: 台中位于台湾的中部。
exampleTraditional: 台中位於台灣的中部。
exampleEnglish: Taichung is located in central Taiwan.
hintSimplified: 一个地区在北部和南部之间的位置。
hintTraditional: 一個地區在北部和南部之間的位置。
hintEnglish: The part of a region located between the north and the south.

definition: CL:份[fen4],頓|顿[dun4]; Chinese meal; Chinese food; lunch
exampleSimplified: 今天的中餐我想吃面。
exampleTraditional: 今天的中餐我想吃麵。
exampleEnglish: For today's lunch I want to eat noodles.
hintSimplified: 在中午吃的一顿饭。
hintTraditional: 在中午吃的一頓飯。
hintEnglish: The meal eaten around noon.

definition: at last; eventually; finally; in the end
exampleSimplified: 等了两个小时,公交车终于来了。
exampleTraditional: 等了兩個小時,公交車終於來了。
exampleEnglish: After waiting two hours, the bus finally came.
hintSimplified: 表示经过很久或很多困难,最后事情发生了。
hintTraditional: 表示經過很久或很多困難,最後事情發生了。
hintEnglish: Shows that after a long time or difficulty, something finally happened.

definition: important point; main point; focus; key (project etc); to focus on; to put the emphasis on; to re-evaluate; to recount (e.g. results of election)
exampleSimplified: 老师说这一课的重点是语法。
exampleTraditional: 老師說這一課的重點是語法。
exampleEnglish: The teacher said the main focus of this lesson is grammar.
hintSimplified: 一件事里最需要注意、最关键的部分。
hintTraditional: 一件事裡最需要注意、最關鍵的部分。
hintEnglish: The part of something that most needs attention; the key part.

gloss: to attach importance to sth; to value
definition: to attach importance to sth; to value
exampleSimplified: 公司很重视员工的意见。
exampleTraditional: 公司很重視員工的意見。
exampleEnglish: The company values its employees' opinions greatly.
hintSimplified: 认为某件事很重要,所以认真对待。
hintTraditional: 認為某件事很重要,所以認真對待。
hintEnglish: Considering something important and therefore taking it seriously.

exampleSimplified: 学校周围有很多小吃店。
exampleTraditional: 學校周圍有很多小吃店。
exampleEnglish: There are many snack shops around the school.
hintSimplified: 某个地方四边附近的地区。
hintTraditional: 某個地方四邊附近的地區。
hintEnglish: The area close to all sides of a certain place.

definition: active; drive (of gears and shafts etc); opposite: passive 被動|被动[bei4 dong4]; spontaneous; to do sth of one's own accord; to take the initiative
exampleSimplified: 他很主动,常常帮同学做事。
exampleTraditional: 他很主動,常常幫同學做事。
exampleEnglish: He is very proactive and often helps classmates.
hintSimplified: 不用别人要求,自己先去做的态度。
hintTraditional: 不用別人要求,自己先去做的態度。
hintEnglish: An attitude of doing things on your own without being asked.

definition: hostess; housewife; the lady of the house; woman of senior authority in a household
exampleSimplified: 我妈妈是家庭主妇,每天在家照顾我们。
exampleTraditional: 我媽媽是家庭主婦,每天在家照顧我們。
exampleEnglish: My mom is a housewife and takes care of us at home every day.
hintSimplified: 结婚后不外出上班,在家照顾家庭的女性。
hintTraditional: 結婚後不外出上班,在家照顧家庭的女性。
hintEnglish: A married woman who doesn't work outside and looks after the household.

definition: in charge; manager; person in charge; responsible for
exampleSimplified: 我的主管今天要和我们开会。
exampleTraditional: 我的主管今天要和我們開會。
exampleEnglish: My supervisor is going to have a meeting with us today.
hintSimplified: 在公司里负责带领部门、管理同事的人。
hintTraditional: 在公司裡負責帶領部門、管理同事的人。
hintEnglish: The person at a company who leads a department and manages colleagues.

exampleSimplified: 王主任正在办公室里开会。
exampleTraditional: 王主任正在辦公室裡開會。
exampleEnglish: Director Wang is having a meeting in the office.
hintSimplified: 学校或机关里负责某个部门的人的职称。
hintTraditional: 學校或機關裡負責某個部門的人的職稱。
hintEnglish: The title of a person in charge of a department in a school or organization.

exampleSimplified: 这次演讲的主题是环境保护。
exampleTraditional: 這次演講的主題是環境保護。
exampleEnglish: The theme of this speech is environmental protection.
hintSimplified: 一篇文章、一场活动或一部作品想表达的中心内容。
hintTraditional: 一篇文章、一場活動或一部作品想表達的中心內容。
hintEnglish: The central content that an article, event or work wants to express.

exampleSimplified: 他的主要工作是照顾老人。
exampleTraditional: 他的主要工作是照顧老人。
exampleEnglish: His main job is taking care of the elderly.
hintSimplified: 在许多事情里,最重要的那一个。
hintTraditional: 在許多事情裡,最重要的那一個。
hintEnglish: Among many things, the most important one.

definition: Beijing pr. [zhu2 yi5]; CL:個|个[ge4]; decision; idea; plan
exampleSimplified: 你的主意真好,我们就这么做吧。
exampleTraditional: 你的主意真好,我們就這麼做吧。
exampleEnglish: Your idea is really good; let's do it that way.
hintSimplified: 遇到问题时,心里想出来的办法或决定。
hintTraditional: 遇到問題時,心裡想出來的辦法或決定。
hintEnglish: A plan or decision you come up with in your mind when facing a problem.

exampleSimplified: 朋友结婚的时候,我送上了真心的祝福。
exampleTraditional: 朋友結婚的時候,我送上了真心的祝福。
exampleEnglish: When my friend got married, I sent my sincere blessings.
hintSimplified: 在生日或婚礼上,人们对你说的美好心愿。
hintTraditional: 在生日或婚禮上,人們對你說的美好心願。
hintEnglish: The good wishes people express to you at a birthday or wedding.

exampleSimplified: 经理的助理帮我安排了明天的会议。
exampleTraditional: 經理的助理幫我安排了明天的會議。
exampleEnglish: The manager's assistant arranged tomorrow's meeting for me.
hintSimplified: 在办公室里帮老板处理事情的人。
hintTraditional: 在辦公室裡幫老闆處理事情的人。
hintEnglish: A person in the office who helps the boss handle tasks.

exampleSimplified: 这位著名的歌手明天要来台北开演唱会。
exampleTraditional: 這位著名的歌手明天要來台北開演唱會。
exampleEnglish: This famous singer is coming to Taipei tomorrow for a concert.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人或地方很多人都知道,很有名气。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人或地方很多人都知道,很有名氣。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or place that many people know and that has a great reputation.

exampleSimplified: 我今天睡得不好,精神状态很差。
exampleTraditional: 我今天睡得不好,精神狀態很差。
exampleEnglish: I didn't sleep well today, and my condition is poor.
hintSimplified: 人或事物在某个时间所表现出来的情况。
hintTraditional: 人或事物在某個時間所表現出來的情況。
hintEnglish: The situation a person or thing is in at a certain moment.

gloss: to focus one's attention; to concentrate on (doing sth)
definition: to focus one's attention; to concentrate on (doing sth)
exampleSimplified: 上课的时候要专心听老师说话。
exampleTraditional: 上課的時候要專心聽老師說話。
exampleEnglish: You should listen attentively to the teacher during class.
hintSimplified: 做事时把注意力放在一件事上,不想别的。
hintTraditional: 做事時把注意力放在一件事上,不想別的。
hintEnglish: Putting all your attention on one thing without thinking of anything else.

definition: CL:門|门[men2],個|个[ge4]; main field of study (at university); major; professional; specialized field; specialty
exampleSimplified: 我的专业是电脑工程,毕业后想当工程师。
exampleTraditional: 我的專業是電腦工程,畢業後想當工程師。
exampleEnglish: My major is computer engineering, and I want to be an engineer after graduating.
hintSimplified: 大学生主要学习的那个科系或领域。
hintTraditional: 大學生主要學習的那個科系或領域。
hintEnglish: The department or field a university student mainly studies.

definition: to pursue (a goal etc) stubbornly; to seek after; to woo
exampleSimplified: 年轻人都在追求自己的梦想。
exampleTraditional: 年輕人都在追求自己的夢想。
exampleEnglish: Young people are all pursuing their own dreams.
hintSimplified: 努力想要得到理想、目标或喜欢的人。
hintTraditional: 努力想要得到理想、目標或喜歡的人。
hintEnglish: Striving to obtain an ideal, a goal, or someone you like.

exampleSimplified: 火车会准时开,请你不要迟到。
exampleTraditional: 火車會準時開,請你不要遲到。
exampleEnglish: The train will leave on time, so please don't be late.
hintSimplified: 不早也不晚,正好在规定的时间。
hintTraditional: 不早也不晚,正好在規定的時間。
hintEnglish: Neither early nor late, exactly at the set time.

gloss: natural resource (such as water or minerals)
definition: natural resource (such as water or minerals); resource (such as manpower or tourism); see 資源縣|资源县[Zi1 yuan2 Xian4]
exampleSimplified: 我们应该节约水资源,保护地球。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該節約水資源,保護地球。
exampleEnglish: We should conserve water resources and protect the Earth.
hintSimplified: 水、矿、人力等可以被利用的来源。
hintTraditional: 水、礦、人力等可以被利用的來源。
hintEnglish: Sources such as water, minerals or manpower that can be used.

definition: (dialect) thrifty; frugal; careful; attentive; cautious; to be careful; to look out
exampleSimplified: 写完考卷后,你要仔细检查一遍。
exampleTraditional: 寫完考卷後,你要仔細檢查一遍。
exampleEnglish: After finishing the exam, you should check it carefully.
hintSimplified: 做事很小心,注意每一个小地方。
hintTraditional: 做事很小心,注意每一個小地方。
hintEnglish: Doing things carefully, paying attention to every small detail.

exampleSimplified: 自从搬到台北,我就很少回老家了。
exampleTraditional: 自從搬到台北,我就很少回老家了。
exampleEnglish: Ever since moving to Taipei, I have rarely gone back to my hometown.
hintSimplified: 用来说明从过去某个时间点开始,一直到现在。
hintTraditional: 用來說明從過去某個時間點開始,一直到現在。
hintEnglish: Used to indicate from a certain point in the past up to now.

exampleSimplified: 这家商店的门会自动打开。
exampleTraditional: 這家商店的門會自動開啟。
exampleEnglish: The door of this store opens automatically.
hintSimplified: 不用人去操作,机器自己就会做。
hintTraditional: 不用人去操作,機器自己就會做。
hintEnglish: A machine does it by itself without anyone operating it.

definition: to attempt suicide; to commit suicide; to kill oneself
exampleSimplified: 新闻说,压力太大可能让人想自杀。
exampleTraditional: 新聞說,壓力太大可能讓人想自殺。
exampleEnglish: The news says too much stress may lead people to consider suicide.
hintSimplified: 一个人因为非常痛苦而结束自己的生命。
hintTraditional: 一個人因為非常痛苦而結束自己的生命。
hintEnglish: A person ending their own life because of extreme suffering.

definition: self-confidence; to have confidence in oneself
exampleSimplified: 她很有自信,上台演讲一点也不紧张。
exampleTraditional: 她很有自信,上臺演講一點也不緊張。
exampleEnglish: She is very confident and not nervous at all giving a speech on stage.
hintSimplified: 相信自己能做好事情的感觉。
hintTraditional: 相信自己能做好事情的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling of believing you can do things well.

exampleSimplified: 周末在家看书,我觉得很自在。
exampleTraditional: 週末在家看書,我覺得很自在。
exampleEnglish: Reading at home on weekends, I feel very at ease.
hintSimplified: 心情放松,没有压力,也不受拘束。
hintTraditional: 心情放鬆,沒有壓力,也不受拘束。
hintEnglish: Relaxed, with no pressure or constraint.

exampleSimplified: 台湾有很多不同的宗教,大家互相尊重。
exampleTraditional: 台灣有很多不同的宗教,大家互相尊重。
exampleEnglish: Taiwan has many different religions, and everyone respects each other.
hintSimplified: 佛教、基督教等,人们信仰的一种系统。
hintTraditional: 佛教、基督教等,人們信仰的一種系統。
hintEnglish: A system of belief that people follow, such as Buddhism or Christianity.

definition: at long last; finally; on the whole
exampleSimplified: 等了一个小时,公车总算来了。
exampleTraditional: 等了一個小時,公車總算來了。
exampleEnglish: After waiting an hour, the bus finally came.
hintSimplified: 经过很久的等待或努力,事情终于实现时用的副词。
hintTraditional: 經過很久的等待或努力,事情終於實現時用的副詞。
hintEnglish: An adverb used when something finally happens after long waiting or effort.

exampleSimplified: 总统明天会在电视上发表演说。
exampleTraditional: 總統明天會在電視上發表演說。
exampleEnglish: The president will give a speech on television tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 一个国家最高的领导人之一,由人民选出来。
hintTraditional: 一個國家最高的領導人之一,由人民選出來。
hintEnglish: The top leader of a country, elected by the people.

definition: in a word; in brief; in short
exampleSimplified: 总之,这次旅行让我们都很开心。
exampleTraditional: 總之,這次旅行讓我們都很開心。
exampleEnglish: In short, this trip made all of us very happy.
hintSimplified: 说了很多以后,用来做简短总结的词。
hintTraditional: 說了很多以後,用來做簡短總結的詞。
hintEnglish: A word used to give a brief conclusion after saying many things.

exclusionReason: Simplified form is not recognized by the dictionary

exampleSimplified: 我的祖父今年八十岁,身体还很好。
exampleTraditional: 我的祖父今年八十歲,身體還很好。
exampleEnglish: My grandfather is eighty this year and still in good health.
hintSimplified: 爸爸的爸爸。
hintTraditional: 爸爸的爸爸。
hintEnglish: Your father's father.

exampleSimplified: 我的祖母很会做菜,每次都做很多好吃的。
exampleTraditional: 我的祖母很會做菜,每次都做很多好吃的。
exampleEnglish: My grandmother is a great cook and always makes lots of delicious food.
hintSimplified: 爸爸的妈妈。
hintTraditional: 爸爸的媽媽。
hintEnglish: Your father's mother.

gloss: (biology) ancestral species; ancient species from which present-day species evolved
definition: (biology) ancestral species; ancient species from which present-day species evolved; ancestors; forebears
exampleSimplified: 清明节时,我们会去祭拜祖先。
exampleTraditional: 清明節時,我們會去祭拜祖先。
exampleEnglish: During Tomb Sweeping Day, we go to pay respects to our ancestors.
hintSimplified: 很久以前,和你有血缘关系的已经去世的家人。
hintTraditional: 很久以前,和你有血緣關係的已經去世的家人。
hintEnglish: Deceased family members from long ago who are your blood relatives.

definition: at first; first; initial; initially; original; originally; primary
exampleSimplified: 最初我不会说中文,现在已经进步很多了。
exampleTraditional: 最初我不會說中文,現在已經進步很多了。
exampleEnglish: At first I couldn't speak Chinese, but now I've improved a lot.
hintSimplified: 指事情刚开始的时候。
hintTraditional: 指事情剛開始的時候。
hintEnglish: Refers to the time when something had just begun.

exampleSimplified: 这间教室最多可以坐三十个人。
exampleTraditional: 這間教室最多可以坐三十個人。
exampleEnglish: This classroom can seat at most thirty people.
hintSimplified: 表示数量的上限,不能再超过了。
hintTraditional: 表示數量的上限,不能再超過了。
hintEnglish: Indicates the upper limit of a quantity, which cannot be exceeded.

definition: best (athlete, movie etc); optimal; optimum; peak
exampleSimplified: 他被选为今年的最佳男演员。
exampleTraditional: 他被選為今年的最佳男演員。
exampleEnglish: He was chosen as this year's best actor.
hintSimplified: 在比赛或评选中,表现比所有人都好的。
hintTraditional: 在比賽或評選中,表現比所有人都好的。
hintEnglish: Performing better than all others in a contest or selection.

gloss: honorable; distinguished (used on formal occasions before a term of address)
definition: honorable; distinguished (used on formal occasions before a term of address); to respect; to revere; to esteem
exampleSimplified: 我们都很尊敬这位老师。
exampleTraditional: 我們都很尊敬這位老師。
exampleEnglish: We all respect this teacher very much.
hintSimplified: 对老师或长辈有很高的敬意,觉得他们很了不起。
hintTraditional: 對老師或長輩有很高的敬意,覺得他們很了不起。
hintEnglish: To hold teachers or elders in high regard and think they are admirable.

gloss: to dream; to have a dream; (fig.) to indulge in wishful thinking
definition: to dream; to have a dream; (fig.) to indulge in wishful thinking
exampleSimplified: 我昨天晚上做梦梦到了你。
exampleTraditional: 我昨天晚上做夢夢到了你。
exampleEnglish: Last night I dreamed about you.
hintSimplified: 睡觉的时候,脑子里出现的故事或画面。
hintTraditional: 睡覺的時候,腦子裡出現的故事或畫面。
hintEnglish: Stories or images that appear in your head while sleeping.

gloss: variant of 做夢|做梦[zuo4 meng4]
definition: variant of 做夢|做梦[zuo4 meng4]
exampleSimplified: 他常常作梦,梦到自己会飞。
exampleTraditional: 他常常作夢,夢到自己會飛。
exampleEnglish: He often dreams that he can fly.
hintSimplified: 睡着以后,脑子里会出现奇怪的画面。
hintTraditional: 睡著以後,腦子裡會出現奇怪的畫面。
hintEnglish: After falling asleep, strange scenes appear in your mind.

exampleSimplified: 这位画家的作品非常有名。
exampleTraditional: 這位畫家的作品非常有名。
exampleEnglish: This painter's works are very famous.
hintSimplified: 画家、作家或音乐家完成的东西。
hintTraditional: 畫家、作家或音樂家完成的東西。
hintEnglish: What a painter, writer or musician has created.

definition: to behave with integrity; to conduct oneself
exampleSimplified: 做人要诚实,不能骗别人。
exampleTraditional: 做人要誠實,不能騙別人。
exampleEnglish: One should be honest and not deceive others.
hintSimplified: 说的是一个人的品德和处世的态度。
hintTraditional: 說的是一個人的品德和處世的態度。
hintEnglish: It refers to a person's character and how they conduct themselves in life.

definition: to handle matters; to have a job; to work
exampleSimplified: 他做事很认真,老板很放心。
exampleTraditional: 他做事很認真,老闆很放心。
exampleEnglish: He is very conscientious in his work, so the boss feels at ease.
hintSimplified: 指在工作中处理各种事情,常用来形容一个人办事的态度或方法。
hintTraditional: 指在工作中處理各種事情,常用來形容一個人辦事的態度或方法。
hintEnglish: It means handling tasks or affairs at work, often used to describe a person's attitude or way of getting things done.

exampleSimplified: 这本书的作者是一位年轻的女士。
exampleTraditional: 這本書的作者是一位年輕的女士。
exampleEnglish: The author of this book is a young woman.
hintSimplified: 写出一本书或一篇文章的人。
hintTraditional: 寫出一本書或一篇文章的人。
hintEnglish: The person who wrote a book or an article.

definition: interest; hobby; to like; to be fond of; to take pleasure in; to be keen on
exampleSimplified: 我的爱好是看电影和爬山。
exampleTraditional: 我的愛好是看電影和爬山。
exampleEnglish: My hobbies are watching movies and hiking.
hintSimplified: 空闲时你喜欢做的事情。
hintTraditional: 空閒時你喜歡做的事情。
hintEnglish: Things you like to do in your free time.

definition: to cherish; to love and protect; to take care of; to treasure
exampleSimplified: 我们应该爱护公共设施。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該愛護公共設施。
exampleEnglish: We should take good care of public facilities.
hintSimplified: 用心照顾,不让东西或人受到伤害。
hintTraditional: 用心照顧,不讓東西或人受到傷害。
hintEnglish: To look after something or someone carefully so it is not harmed.

exampleSimplified: 他的爱人是一位医生。
exampleTraditional: 他的愛人是一位醫生。
exampleEnglish: His spouse is a doctor.
hintSimplified: 结了婚的两个人,对彼此的称呼。
hintTraditional: 結了婚的兩個人,對彼此的稱呼。
hintEnglish: What a married person calls their husband or wife.

gloss: interjection of wonder, shock or admiration
definition: interjection of wonder, shock or admiration
exampleSimplified: 哎呀,我忘了带钥匙!
exampleTraditional: 哎呀,我忘了帶鑰匙!
exampleEnglish: Oh no, I forgot to bring my keys!
hintSimplified: 感到惊讶或着急时,会脱口而出的声音。
hintTraditional: 感到驚訝或著急時,會脫口而出的聲音。
