hintEnglish: A sound you blurt out when surprised or flustered.

definition: hey; interjection of pain or surprise; ouch; ow
exampleSimplified: 哎哟,我的脚好痛啊!
exampleTraditional: 哎喲,我的腳好痛啊!
exampleEnglish: Ouch, my foot hurts so much!
hintSimplified: 突然觉得疼或吃惊时发出的声音。
hintTraditional: 突然覺得疼或吃驚時發出的聲音。
hintEnglish: A sound made when you suddenly feel pain or are startled.

exampleSimplified: 早点检查,就能早点发现癌症。
exampleTraditional: 早點檢查,就能早點發現癌症。
exampleEnglish: With an early check-up, cancer can be found sooner.
hintSimplified: 一种很严重的病,身体里的细胞不正常地增加。
hintTraditional: 一種很嚴重的病,身體裡的細胞不正常地增加。
hintEnglish: A serious disease in which cells in the body grow abnormally.

gloss: (coll.) case (criminal, medical etc); matter; project; job
definition: (coll.) case (criminal, medical etc); matter; project; job; long table; counter
exampleSimplified: 这个案子我们下星期要完成。
exampleTraditional: 這個案子我們下星期要完成。
exampleEnglish: We have to finish this project next week.
hintSimplified: 公司或警察需要处理的一件工作或事件。
hintTraditional: 公司或警察需要處理的一件工作或事件。
hintEnglish: A matter or job that a company or the police need to handle.

exampleSimplified: 他的衣服又破又肮脏。
exampleTraditional: 他的衣服又破又骯髒。
exampleEnglish: His clothes are torn and filthy.
hintSimplified: 形容东西很不干净,让人不想碰。
hintTraditional: 形容東西很不乾淨,讓人不想碰。
hintEnglish: Describes something very unclean that you don't want to touch.

definition: before deadline; on schedule; on time
exampleSimplified: 请你每天按时吃药。
exampleTraditional: 請你每天按時吃藥。
exampleEnglish: Please take your medicine on time every day.
hintSimplified: 在规定的时间做事,不早也不晚。
hintTraditional: 在規定的時間做事,不早也不晚。
hintEnglish: Doing something at the set time, neither early nor late.

exampleSimplified: 朋友难过的时候,我会安慰他。
exampleTraditional: 朋友難過的時候,我會安慰他。
exampleEnglish: When my friend is sad, I comfort him.
hintSimplified: 对伤心的人说好话,让他心情好一点。
hintTraditional: 對傷心的人說好話,讓他心情好一點。
hintEnglish: Saying kind words to a sad person to make them feel better.

definition: in secret; in the dark; on the sly; surreptitiously
exampleSimplified: 他暗中帮了我很多忙。
exampleTraditional: 他暗中幫了我很多忙。
exampleEnglish: He helped me a lot in secret.
hintSimplified: 不让别人知道,偷偷地进行。
hintTraditional: 不讓別人知道,偷偷地進行。
hintEnglish: Doing something without letting others know.

definition: installation; to erect; to fix; to install; to mount
exampleSimplified: 师傅明天来安装新的冷气。
exampleTraditional: 師傅明天來安裝新的冷氣。
exampleEnglish: The technician is coming tomorrow to install the new air conditioner.
hintSimplified: 把机器或软件放好并准备使用。
hintTraditional: 把機器或軟體放好並準備使用。
hintEnglish: Setting up a machine or software so it is ready for use.

definition: a strike; to go on strike
exampleSimplified: 工人们为了加薪而罢工。
exampleTraditional: 工人們為了加薪而罷工。
exampleEnglish: The workers went on strike to get a raise.
hintSimplified: 工人们一起不上班,来表示不满。
hintTraditional: 工人們一起不上班,來表示不滿。
hintEnglish: Workers all stop working together to show their dissatisfaction.

gloss: (Tw) religious ceremony in which offerings are made to a deity
definition: (Tw) religious ceremony in which offerings are made to a deity; (coll.) to part ways (with sb); (fig.) to have nothing further to do (with sb or sth); (loanword) bye-bye; also pr. [bai1 bai1] etc; to pay one's respects by bowing with hands in front of one's chest clasping joss sticks, or with palms pressed together
exampleSimplified: 时间不早了,我要走了,拜拜!
exampleTraditional: 時間不早了,我要走了,拜拜!
exampleEnglish: It's getting late, I have to go. Bye-bye!
hintSimplified: 朋友分开时,常说的一句话。
hintTraditional: 朋友分開時,常說的一句話。
hintEnglish: What friends commonly say when they part.

gloss: to pay a visit; to call on
definition: to pay a visit; to call on
exampleSimplified: 周末我想去拜访一位老朋友。
exampleTraditional: 週末我想去拜訪一位老朋友。
exampleEnglish: This weekend I want to visit an old friend.
hintSimplified: 正式地去别人家或办公室看望他。
hintTraditional: 正式地去別人家或辦公室看望他。
hintEnglish: To go formally to someone's home or office to see them.

gloss: to pay a New Year call
definition: to pay a New Year call; to wish sb a Happy New Year
exampleSimplified: 春节时,我们全家去亲戚家拜年。
exampleTraditional: 春節時,我們全家去親戚家拜年。
exampleEnglish: During Spring Festival, our whole family visits relatives to give New Year greetings.
hintSimplified: 过农历新年时,去向亲友说祝福的话。
hintTraditional: 過農曆新年時,去向親友說祝福的話。
hintEnglish: During Lunar New Year, going to wish friends and relatives well.

definition: please!; to request sb to do sth
exampleSimplified: 拜托你帮我拿一下这个包包。
exampleTraditional: 拜託你幫我拿一下這個包包。
exampleEnglish: Please, could you hold this bag for me?
hintSimplified: 客气地请别人帮忙时会说的话。
hintTraditional: 客氣地請別人幫忙時會說的話。
hintEnglish: What you say when politely asking someone for a favor.

definition: to break away (from); to break away from; to break out (of); to cast off (old ideas etc); to extricate oneself; to free oneself from; to get rid of
exampleSimplified: 他努力想摆脱过去的坏习惯。
exampleTraditional: 他努力想擺脫過去的壞習慣。
exampleEnglish: He is trying hard to get rid of his old bad habits.
hintSimplified: 离开不好的人、事或状态,让自己自由。
hintTraditional: 離開不好的人、事或狀態,讓自己自由。
hintEnglish: To get away from a bad person, thing or situation and become free.

gloss: a modal particle indicating (don't mind it, ok)
definition: a modal particle indicating (don't mind it, ok); a modal particle indicating (that's all, only, nothing much)
exampleSimplified: 我只是随便说说罢了,你别当真。
exampleTraditional: 我只是隨便說說罷了,你別當真。
exampleEnglish: I was just talking casually, don't take it seriously.
hintSimplified: 放在句末的语气词,表示“只是这样而已”,有轻描淡写的意思。
hintTraditional: 放在句末的語氣詞,表示“只是這樣而已”,有輕描淡寫的意思。
hintEnglish: A sentence-final particle meaning "that's all", downplaying something.

definition: (derog.) Korean; club; corncob; cudgel; ear of maize; maize (corn); stick
exampleSimplified: 他拿着一根棒子,在后面追小狗。
exampleTraditional: 他拿著一根棒子,在後面追小狗。
exampleEnglish: He held a stick and chased the puppy from behind.
hintSimplified: 一种又长又硬的木头或铁做的东西,可以拿在手上打东西。
hintTraditional: 一種又長又硬的木頭或鐵做的東西,可以拿在手上打東西。
hintEnglish: A long, hard piece of wood or metal that you hold in your hand and can hit things with.

gloss: to handle official business (usu. in an office); to do (office) work
definition: to handle official business (usu. in an office); to do (office) work
exampleSimplified: 我爸爸每天都在这栋大楼里办公。
exampleTraditional: 我爸爸每天都在這棟大樓裡辦公。
exampleEnglish: My dad works in this building every day.
hintSimplified: 在公司的桌子前用电脑处理工作和文件,就是做这件事。
hintTraditional: 在公司的桌子前用電腦處理工作和檔案,就是做這件事。
hintEnglish: Sitting at a desk in a company, using a computer to handle work and documents is what you do.

definition: at dusk; at night fall; in the evening; towards evening; when night falls
exampleSimplified: 傍晚的时候,天空变成了橘红色。
exampleTraditional: 傍晚的時候,天空變成了橘紅色。
exampleEnglish: At dusk, the sky turned orange-red.
hintSimplified: 太阳快要下山、天快黑的时候。
hintTraditional: 太陽快要下山、天快黑的時候。
hintEnglish: The time when the sun is about to set and it's getting dark.

exampleSimplified: 车子走到半路突然坏了。
exampleTraditional: 車子走到半路突然壞了。
exampleEnglish: The car suddenly broke down halfway there.
hintSimplified: 从出发地到目的地的中间那一段路。
hintTraditional: 從出發地到目的地的中間那一段路。
hintEnglish: The middle part of the journey between the starting point and the destination.

exampleSimplified: 他办事很认真,大家都很放心。
exampleTraditional: 他辦事很認真,大家都很放心。
exampleEnglish: He handles things very conscientiously, so everyone feels reassured.
hintSimplified: 处理工作或别人交代的事情。
hintTraditional: 處理工作或別人交代的事情。
hintEnglish: To take care of tasks or matters that someone has entrusted to you.

exampleSimplified: 这次投票,半数以上的人都同意。
exampleTraditional: 這次投票,半數以上的人都同意。
exampleEnglish: In this vote, more than half of the people agreed.
hintSimplified: 全部人数或东西的一半。
hintTraditional: 全部人數或東西的一半。
hintEnglish: One half of the total number of people or things.

definition: to act; to play the role of
exampleSimplified: 她在这部电影里扮演一位老师。
exampleTraditional: 她在這部電影裡扮演一位老師。
exampleEnglish: In this movie she plays a teacher.
hintSimplified: 演员在戏里装成某一个角色。
hintTraditional: 演員在戲裡裝成某一個角色。
hintEnglish: What an actor does when taking on a certain role in a play or film.

gloss: (coll.) to repost (content, esp. from another platform)
definition: (coll.) to repost (content, esp. from another platform); to transport; to carry
exampleSimplified: 工人们正在把货物搬运到卡车上。
exampleTraditional: 工人們正在把貨物搬運到卡車上。
exampleEnglish: The workers are carrying the goods onto the truck.
hintSimplified: 把东西从一个地方拿到另一个地方。
hintTraditional: 把東西從一個地方拿到另一個地方。
hintEnglish: To take things from one place to another.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; class monitor; squad leader; team leader
exampleSimplified: 老师请班长把作业发给大家。
exampleTraditional: 老師請班長把作業發給大家。
exampleEnglish: The teacher asked the class leader to hand out the homework to everyone.
hintSimplified: 学生里帮老师管理全班同学的人。
hintTraditional: 學生裡幫老師管理全班同學的人。
hintEnglish: The student who helps the teacher look after the whole class.

exampleSimplified: 我们家的宝宝昨天刚学会走路。
exampleTraditional: 我們家的寶寶昨天剛學會走路。
exampleEnglish: Our baby just learned to walk yesterday.
hintSimplified: 大人对很小的孩子的亲切叫法。
hintTraditional: 大人對很小的孩子的親切叫法。
hintEnglish: An affectionate way adults refer to a very young child.

definition: to hold; to keep; to maintain; to preserve
exampleSimplified: 请保持安静,大家正在考试。
exampleTraditional: 請保持安靜,大家正在考試。
exampleEnglish: Please keep quiet, everyone is taking an exam.
hintSimplified: 让某种状态一直这样,不要改变。
hintTraditional: 讓某種狀態一直這樣,不要改變。
hintEnglish: To make a state continue as it is without changing.

exampleSimplified: 他一心想为被害的父亲报仇。
exampleTraditional: 他一心想為被害的父親報仇。
exampleEnglish: He is set on avenging his murdered father.
hintSimplified: 别人伤害了你或家人,你也要让对方付出代价。
hintTraditional: 別人傷害了你或家人,你也要讓對方付出代價。
hintEnglish: When someone has harmed you or your family, you make them pay for it.

gloss: to conserve; to preserve; to keep; to store; (computing) to save (a file etc)
definition: to conserve; to preserve; to keep; to store; (computing) to save (a file etc)
exampleSimplified: 写完报告以后,记得马上保存文件。
exampleTraditional: 寫完報告以後,記得馬上保存檔案。
exampleEnglish: After finishing the report, remember to save the file right away.
hintSimplified: 让东西或文件好好留下来,不会不见。
hintTraditional: 讓東西或檔案好好留下來,不會不見。
hintEnglish: To make sure something or a file stays safe and doesn't get lost.

exampleSimplified: 我一定会好好报答父母的养育之恩。
exampleTraditional: 我一定會好好報答父母的養育之恩。
exampleEnglish: I will definitely repay my parents for raising me.
hintSimplified: 别人帮过你,你用行动来感谢他。
hintTraditional: 別人幫過你,你用行動來感謝他。
hintEnglish: When someone has helped you, you thank them through your actions.

definition: to check in; to register; to report for duty
exampleSimplified: 新生明天上午九点到学校报到。
exampleTraditional: 新生明天上午九點到學校報到。
exampleEnglish: New students will register at school at nine tomorrow morning.
hintSimplified: 到了新的学校或公司,先告诉负责的人你已经来了。
hintTraditional: 到了新的學校或公司,先告訴負責的人你已經來了。
hintEnglish: Upon arriving at a new school or company, you tell the person in charge that you've arrived.

exampleSimplified: 根据新闻报导,明天会有大雨。
exampleTraditional: 根據新聞報導,明天會有大雨。
exampleEnglish: According to the news report, there will be heavy rain tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 记者把发生的事情写出来或讲给大家听。
hintTraditional: 記者把發生的事情寫出來或講給大家聽。
hintEnglish: What a journalist does when writing or telling the public about what happened.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; bundle; package; parcel; to bind up; to wrap up
exampleSimplified: 我在网路上买的包裹今天到了。
exampleTraditional: 我在網路上買的包裹今天到了。
exampleEnglish: The package I bought online arrived today.
hintSimplified: 用纸或袋子包好、由快递送来的东西。
hintTraditional: 用紙或袋子包好、由快遞送來的東西。
hintEnglish: Something wrapped in paper or a bag and delivered by courier.

gloss: to report sth to the police
definition: to report sth to the police; to sound an alarm
exampleSimplified: 看到小偷,他马上打电话报警。
exampleTraditional: 看到小偷,他馬上打電話報警。
exampleEnglish: Seeing the thief, he immediately called to report it to the police.
hintSimplified: 发生危险或坏事时,打电话请警察来帮忙。
hintTraditional: 發生危險或壞事時,打電話請警察來幫忙。
hintEnglish: Calling to ask the police for help when something dangerous or bad happens.

exampleSimplified: 我们不应该用暴力解决问题。
exampleTraditional: 我們不應該用暴力解決問題。
exampleEnglish: We shouldn't use violence to solve problems.
hintSimplified: 用打人或伤害别人的方式来处理事情。
hintTraditional: 用打人或傷害別人的方式來處理事情。
hintEnglish: Handling things by hitting or hurting others.

definition: to have reservations (about sth); to hold back (from saying sth); to keep; to put aside for later; to retain
exampleSimplified: 这张旧照片我想一直保留下来。
exampleTraditional: 這張舊照片我想一直保留下來。
exampleEnglish: I want to keep this old photo forever.
hintSimplified: 不丢掉、不改变,把东西或想法留着。
hintTraditional: 不丟掉、不改變,把東西或想法留著。
hintEnglish: To not throw away or change something, but keep an item or an opinion.

definition: sorry!; to be sorry; to feel apologetic
exampleSimplified: 抱歉,我来晚了,让你们久等了。
exampleTraditional: 抱歉,我來晚了,讓你們久等了。
exampleEnglish: Sorry, I'm late. I kept you waiting.
hintSimplified: 做错事或给别人添麻烦时,心里觉得不好意思会这样说。
hintTraditional: 做錯事或給別人添麻煩時,心裡覺得不好意思會這樣說。
hintEnglish: What you say when you feel bad for making a mistake or causing trouble.

exampleSimplified: 我哥哥在一家报社当记者。
exampleTraditional: 我哥哥在一家報社當記者。
exampleEnglish: My older brother works as a reporter at a newspaper office.
hintSimplified: 记者和编辑工作,每天出版新闻纸的公司。
hintTraditional: 記者和編輯工作,每天出版新聞紙的公司。
hintEnglish: A company where reporters and editors work to publish the daily paper.

exampleSimplified: 士兵们努力保卫自己的国家。
exampleTraditional: 士兵們努力保衛自己的國家。
exampleEnglish: The soldiers work hard to defend their country.
hintSimplified: 保护国家或地方,不让敌人伤害或抢走。
hintTraditional: 保護國家或地方,不讓敵人傷害或搶走。
hintEnglish: To protect a country or place from being harmed or taken by enemies.

exampleSimplified: 他最近脾气很暴躁,一点小事就生气。
exampleTraditional: 他最近脾氣很暴躁,一點小事就生氣。
exampleEnglish: He has been very irritable lately and gets angry over little things.
hintSimplified: 形容人脾气很坏,很容易发火。
hintTraditional: 形容人脾氣很壞,很容易發火。
hintEnglish: Describes a person with a bad temper who easily loses their cool.

definition: explosion; to blow up; to detonate; to explode
exampleSimplified: 工厂发生了爆炸,附近的人都听到了巨大的声音。
exampleTraditional: 工廠發生了爆炸,附近的人都聽到了巨大的聲音。
exampleEnglish: An explosion happened at the factory, and people nearby heard a huge sound.
hintSimplified: 炸弹或瓦斯突然发出巨响并炸开,就是这种现象。
hintTraditional: 炸彈或瓦斯突然發出巨響並炸開,就是這種現象。
hintEnglish: What happens when a bomb or gas suddenly bursts open with a huge bang.

definition: to ensure; to guarantee; to safeguard
exampleSimplified: 法律应该保障每个人的基本权利。
exampleTraditional: 法律應該保障每個人的基本權利。
exampleEnglish: The law should guarantee everyone's basic rights.
hintSimplified: 用制度或办法让某件事一定能得到安全和保护。
hintTraditional: 用制度或辦法讓某件事一定能得到安全和保護。
hintEnglish: To make sure, through rules or measures, that something is safe and protected.

gloss: (fig.) to present attractively; to craft an image; to package (sb or sth)
definition: (fig.) to present attractively; to craft an image; to package (sb or sth); packaging; packing materials; to wrap; to package (goods etc)
exampleSimplified: 这份礼物的包装很漂亮,朋友一定会喜欢。
exampleTraditional: 這份禮物的包裝很漂亮,朋友一定會喜歡。
exampleEnglish: The packaging of this gift is very pretty; my friend will surely like it.
hintSimplified: 商品外面的纸盒或袋子,也可以指把人或东西打扮得更好看。
hintTraditional: 商品外面的紙盒或袋子,也可以指把人或東西打扮得更好看。
hintEnglish: The box or wrapping outside a product; also making a person or thing look more appealing.

exampleSimplified: 天气变冷了,晚上要盖厚一点的被子。
exampleTraditional: 天氣變冷了,晚上要蓋厚一點的被子。
exampleEnglish: The weather got cold, so at night I need a thicker quilt.
hintSimplified: 睡觉时盖在身上保暖的东西。
hintTraditional: 睡覺時蓋在身上保暖的東西。
hintEnglish: What you put over yourself when sleeping to stay warm.

exampleSimplified: 这部电影是一出悲剧,看完很多人都哭了。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影是一出悲劇,看完很多人都哭了。
exampleEnglish: This movie is a tragedy; many people cried after watching it.
hintSimplified: 结局很伤心、让人流泪的故事或戏剧。
hintTraditional: 結局很傷心、讓人流淚的故事或戲劇。
hintEnglish: A story or play with a sad ending that makes people cry.

definition: the back; the reverse side; the wrong side
exampleSimplified: 请把名字写在纸的背面。
exampleTraditional: 請把名字寫在紙的背面。
exampleEnglish: Please write your name on the back of the paper.
hintSimplified: 和正面相反的另一边。
hintTraditional: 和正面相反的另一邊。
hintEnglish: The side opposite to the front.

exampleSimplified: 听到老师去世的消息,大家都非常悲痛。
exampleTraditional: 聽到老師去世的訊息,大家都非常悲痛。
exampleEnglish: Hearing the news of the teacher's death, everyone was extremely grief-stricken.
hintSimplified: 失去亲人或朋友时,心里非常难过的感觉。
hintTraditional: 失去親人或朋友時,心裡非常難過的感覺。
hintEnglish: The deep sorrow you feel when losing a loved one or friend.

definition: CL:件[jian4]; sleeveless garment (vest, waistcoat, singlet, tank top etc)
exampleSimplified: 夏天天气很热,我喜欢穿背心。
exampleTraditional: 夏天天氣很熱,我喜歡穿背心。
exampleEnglish: The weather is very hot in summer, so I like wearing a sleeveless vest.
hintSimplified: 这种衣服没有袖子,夏天常穿,也可以穿在衬衫里面或外面。
hintTraditional: 這種衣服沒有袖子,夏天常穿,也可以穿在襯衫裡面或外面。
hintEnglish: This garment has no sleeves, is often worn in summer, and can be worn under or over a shirt.

definition: CL:項|项[xiang4],個|个[ge4]; ability; capability; skill
exampleSimplified: 他有很多本领,什么东西都会修。
exampleTraditional: 他有很多本領,什麼東西都會修。
exampleEnglish: He has many skills; he can fix anything.
hintSimplified: 一个人真正会做事的能力或技术。
hintTraditional: 一個人真正會做事的能力或技術。
hintEnglish: A person's real ability or skill to get things done.

exampleSimplified: 孩子们在草地上快乐地奔跑。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們在草地上快樂地奔跑。
exampleEnglish: The children run happily on the grass.
hintSimplified: 用很快的速度向前跑。
hintTraditional: 用很快的速度向前跑。
hintEnglish: To move forward on foot at high speed.

exampleSimplified: 问题本身并不难,难的是时间太少。
exampleTraditional: 問題本身並不難,難的是時間太少。
exampleEnglish: The problem itself isn't hard; what's hard is that there's too little time.
hintSimplified: 指事物自己,不包括旁边其他的因素。
hintTraditional: 指事物自己,不包括旁邊其他的因素。
hintEnglish: Refers to the thing itself, apart from other surrounding factors.

definition: local; metropolitan territory; native; one's native country
exampleSimplified: 这家店卖的是本土设计师做的产品。
exampleTraditional: 這家店賣的是本土設計師做的產品。
exampleEnglish: This shop sells products made by local designers.
hintSimplified: 指自己出生或居住的地方,和外来的相对。
hintTraditional: 指自己出生或居住的地方,和外來的相對。
hintEnglish: Relating to one's own native place, as opposed to foreign.

exampleSimplified: 这台旧机器又大又笨重,一个人搬不动。
exampleTraditional: 這臺舊機器又大又笨重,一個人搬不動。
exampleEnglish: This old machine is big and bulky; one person can't move it.
hintSimplified: 东西又大又重,搬起来很不方便。
hintTraditional: 東西又大又重,搬起來很不方便。
hintEnglish: Big and heavy, and inconvenient to carry.

definition: change; fluctuation; to change; to fluctuate
exampleSimplified: 因为天气的变动,飞机的时间改了。
exampleTraditional: 因為天氣的變動,飛機的時間改了。
exampleEnglish: Because of changes in the weather, the flight time was altered.
hintSimplified: 原来的情况或安排发生了改变。
hintTraditional: 原來的情況或安排發生了改變。
hintEnglish: The original situation or arrangement has shifted.

exampleSimplified: 我家附近有地铁和商店,生活很便利。
exampleTraditional: 我家附近有地鐵和商店,生活很便利。
exampleEnglish: There are a subway and shops near my home, so life is very convenient.
hintSimplified: 做事不费力,很方便。
hintTraditional: 做事不費力,很方便。
hintEnglish: Easy to do things without much effort.

exampleSimplified: 请先填写这张表格,再交给柜台。
exampleTraditional: 請先填寫這張表格,再交給櫃檯。
exampleEnglish: Please fill out this form first, then hand it to the counter.
hintSimplified: 有很多格子,需要填写资料的纸。
hintTraditional: 有很多格子,需要填寫資料的紙。
hintEnglish: A sheet with many boxes where you fill in information.

exampleSimplified: 看她的表情,我就知道她很生气。
exampleTraditional: 看她的表情,我就知道她很生氣。
exampleEnglish: Looking at her expression, I knew she was angry.
hintSimplified: 脸上显示出高兴或难过等心情的样子。
hintTraditional: 臉上顯示出高興或難過等心情的樣子。
hintEnglish: The look on a face that shows feelings like joy or sadness.

exampleSimplified: 这篇文章的标题很吸引人。
exampleTraditional: 這篇文章的標題很吸引人。
exampleEnglish: The title of this article is very eye-catching.
hintSimplified: 放在文章或新闻最上面的那一行字。
hintTraditional: 放在文章或新聞最上面的那一行字。
hintEnglish: The line of text placed at the top of an article or news story.

exampleSimplified: 老师在全班面前表扬了他。
exampleTraditional: 老師在全班面前表揚了他。
exampleEnglish: The teacher praised him in front of the whole class.
hintSimplified: 公开说某人做得很好。
hintTraditional: 公開說某人做得很好。
hintEnglish: To publicly say that someone did well.

definition: sign; mark; symbol; logo; to symbolize; to indicate; to mark
exampleSimplified: 路口的标志告诉我们这里不能停车。
exampleTraditional: 路口的標誌告訴我們這裡不能停車。
exampleEnglish: The sign at the intersection tells us we can't park here.
hintSimplified: 用图案或符号表示意思的东西,例如路边或商品上的图案。
hintTraditional: 用圖案或符號表示意思的東西,例如路邊或商品上的圖案。
hintEnglish: A pattern or symbol that conveys meaning, like those on roadsides or products.

exampleSimplified: 我们彼此帮助,所以成了好朋友。
exampleTraditional: 我們彼此幫助,所以成了好朋友。
exampleEnglish: We help each other, so we became good friends.
hintSimplified: 指双方,你对我、我对你。
hintTraditional: 指雙方,你對我、我對你。
hintEnglish: Refers to both sides: you to me and me to you.

definition: CL:本[ben3]; a type of literature consisting mainly of short sketches; notes; to take down (in writing)
exampleSimplified: 上课时我会认真做笔记。
exampleTraditional: 上課時我會認真做筆記。
exampleEnglish: I take notes carefully in class.
hintSimplified: 学生上课时写下重点的本子或内容。
hintTraditional: 學生上課時寫下重點的本子或內容。
hintEnglish: What students write down in class to record key points.

exampleSimplified: 班上男生和女生的比例差不多。
exampleTraditional: 班上男生和女生的比例差不多。
exampleEnglish: The ratio of boys to girls in the class is about the same.
hintSimplified: 两个数量相比所得的关系,例如一比二。
hintTraditional: 兩個數量相比所得的關係,例如一比二。
hintEnglish: The relationship obtained by comparing two quantities, like one to two.

exampleSimplified: 这种病毒会通过空气传染给别人。
exampleTraditional: 這種病毒會透過空氣傳染給別人。
exampleEnglish: This virus can be spread to others through the air.
hintSimplified: 非常小的东西,会让人生病,电脑也可能被它破坏。
hintTraditional: 非常小的東西,會讓人生病,電腦也可能被它破壞。
hintEnglish: A tiny thing that makes people sick; computers can be harmed by it too.

definition: CL:間|间[jian1]; sickroom; ward (of a hospital)
exampleSimplified: 爷爷住在医院的病房里,我们每天去看他。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺住在醫院的病房裡,我們每天去看他。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa is staying in a hospital ward, and we visit him every day.
hintSimplified: 医院里让生病的人住的房间。
hintTraditional: 醫院裡讓生病的人住的房間。
hintEnglish: A room in a hospital where sick people stay.

gloss: and; besides; moreover; furthermore; in addition
definition: and; besides; moreover; furthermore; in addition
exampleSimplified: 他会说英语,并且说得很流利。
exampleTraditional: 他會說英語,並且說得很流利。
exampleEnglish: He can speak English, and he speaks it very fluently.
hintSimplified: 连词,用来在前一句话的基础上再加上另一个更进一步的意思。
hintTraditional: 連詞,用來在前一句話的基礎上再加上另一個更進一步的意思。
hintEnglish: A conjunction used to add a further, additional point to what was just said.

definition: patient's condition; state of an illness
exampleSimplified: 医生说爷爷的病情已经稳定了。
exampleTraditional: 醫生說爺爺的病情已經穩定了。
exampleEnglish: The doctor said Grandpa's condition has stabilized.
hintSimplified: 医生用来说明病人身体现在好不好、严不严重的情况。
hintTraditional: 醫生用來說明病人身體現在好不好、嚴不嚴重的情況。
hintEnglish: What a doctor describes when explaining how serious or stable a patient's illness is right now.

definition: paper test (for an applicant); written examination
exampleSimplified: 这家公司的面试分为笔试和口试两部分。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司的面試分為筆試和口試兩部分。
exampleEnglish: The interview at this company has a written test and an oral test.
hintSimplified: 用笔在纸上回答问题的考试,和口头回答的考试不同。
hintTraditional: 用筆在紙上回答問題的考試,和口頭回答的考試不同。
hintEnglish: An exam where you answer questions on paper with a pen, as opposed to speaking.

exampleSimplified: 我感冒了,一直流鼻涕。
exampleTraditional: 我感冒了,一直流鼻涕。
exampleEnglish: I have a cold and my nose keeps running.
hintSimplified: 感冒时从鼻子里流出来的东西。
hintTraditional: 感冒時從鼻子裡流出來的東西。
hintEnglish: What flows out of your nose when you have a cold.

gloss: (slang) gambling; gambler (alternative term for 博彩[bo2 cai3])
definition: (slang) gambling; gambler (alternative term for 博彩[bo2 cai3]); spinach (CL:棵[ke1])
exampleSimplified: 妈妈今天晚上炒了一盘菠菜。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽今天晚上炒了一盤菠菜。
exampleEnglish: Mom stir-fried a plate of spinach tonight.
hintSimplified: 一种绿色的叶菜,卡通里的大力水手吃了它就有力气。
hintTraditional: 一種綠色的葉菜,卡通裡的大力水手吃了它就有力氣。
hintEnglish: A green leafy vegetable that gives a famous cartoon sailor his strength.

definition: rise and fall; to fluctuate; to undulate; wave motion
exampleSimplified: 最近股市的波动很大。
exampleTraditional: 最近股市的波動很大。
exampleEnglish: The stock market has been fluctuating a lot recently.
hintSimplified: 价格、情绪等忽高忽低、不稳定的变化。
hintTraditional: 價格、情緒等忽高忽低、不穩定的變化。
hintEnglish: Unstable ups and downs in things like prices or emotions.

definition: (slang) male homosexual; CL:張|张[zhang1],塊|块[kuai4]; glass
exampleSimplified: 小心,玻璃杯很容易打破。
exampleTraditional: 小心,玻璃杯很容易打破。
exampleEnglish: Be careful, glass cups break easily.
hintSimplified: 窗户和杯子常用的透明材料,掉在地上会碎。
hintTraditional: 窗戶和杯子常用的透明材料,掉在地上會碎。
hintEnglish: A transparent material used for windows and cups that shatters when dropped.

exampleSimplified: 他的数学基础比较薄弱,需要多练习。
exampleTraditional: 他的數學基礎比較薄弱,需要多練習。
exampleEnglish: His math foundation is rather weak, so he needs more practice.
hintSimplified: 形容力量、基础或能力不够强、不够扎实。
hintTraditional: 形容力量、基礎或能力不夠強、不夠紮實。
hintEnglish: Describes strength, foundation or ability that is not solid or strong enough.

definition: disturbed; restless; uneasy; unpeaceful; unstable; worried
exampleSimplified: 考试前一天,我心里很不安。
exampleTraditional: 考試前一天,我心裡很不安。
exampleEnglish: The day before the exam, I felt very uneasy.
hintSimplified: 心里担心、紧张,觉得不平静的感觉。
hintTraditional: 心裡擔心、緊張,覺得不平靜的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling of being worried and restless inside, unable to feel calm.

exampleSimplified: 公司决定补偿客户的损失。
exampleTraditional: 公司決定補償客戶的損失。
exampleEnglish: The company decided to compensate the customers for their losses.
hintSimplified: 给别人钱或东西,来弥补对方受到的损失。
hintTraditional: 給別人錢或東西,來彌補對方受到的損失。
hintEnglish: To give money or something to make up for someone else's loss.

gloss: (at the end of a rhetorical question) can that be?
definition: (at the end of a rhetorical question) can that be?; unable to; won't do
exampleSimplified: 难道你想一个人去不成?
exampleTraditional: 難道你想一個人去不成?
exampleEnglish: Don't tell me you want to go all by yourself?
hintSimplified: 放在反问句最后,表示猜测或不相信的语气。
hintTraditional: 放在反問句最後,表示猜測或不相信的語氣。
hintEnglish: Placed at the end of a rhetorical question to express guessing or disbelief.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; additional; supplementary; to complement; to replenish; to supplement
exampleSimplified: 老师又补充了一些新的资料。
exampleTraditional: 老師又補充了一些新的資料。
exampleEnglish: The teacher added some more new material.
hintSimplified: 在已经有的内容上再加一点,让它更完整。
hintTraditional: 在已經有的內容上再加一點,讓它更完整。
hintEnglish: To add a little more to what already exists so it becomes more complete.

definition: not often; infrequently; not very (clear, far away etc); not too
exampleSimplified: 我不大喜欢吃辣的东西。
exampleTraditional: 我不大喜歡吃辣的東西。
exampleEnglish: I don't really like spicy food.
hintSimplified: 放在动词或形容词前,表示程度不高或次数不多。
hintTraditional: 放在動詞或形容詞前,表示程度不高或次數不多。
hintEnglish: Placed before a verb or adjective to say the degree or frequency is low.

exampleSimplified: 他在会议上的说法很不当。
exampleTraditional: 他在會議上的說法很不當。
exampleEnglish: What he said in the meeting was very inappropriate.
hintSimplified: 形容做法或话语不合适,不应该这样。
hintTraditional: 形容做法或話語不合適,不應該這樣。
hintEnglish: Describes an action or remark that is not suitable and shouldn't have been done.

definition: insufficient; less than; not reaching; not to arrive
exampleSimplified: 他来台湾还不到一个月。
exampleTraditional: 他來台灣還不到一個月。
exampleEnglish: He has been in Taiwan for less than a month.
hintSimplified: 表示没有达到某个数量或时间。
hintTraditional: 表示沒有達到某個數量或時間。
hintEnglish: Indicates that a certain amount or length of time has not been reached.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; armed forces; army; force; troops; unit
exampleSimplified: 这支部队正在山里进行训练。
exampleTraditional: 這支部隊正在山裡進行訓練。
exampleEnglish: This military unit is training in the mountains.
hintSimplified: 由很多穿制服的人组成的军事组织。
hintTraditional: 由很多穿制服的人組成的軍事組織。
hintEnglish: A military organization made up of many uniformed people.

definition: bulletin; notice; posting on a bulletin board; to announce
exampleSimplified: 学校把考试时间贴在布告栏上了。
exampleTraditional: 學校把考試時間貼在布告欄上了。
exampleEnglish: The school posted the exam schedule on the bulletin board.
hintSimplified: 贴在公共地方,让大家都能看到的正式通知。
hintTraditional: 貼在公共地方,讓大家都能看到的正式通知。
hintEnglish: An official notice posted in a public place for everyone to see.

exampleSimplified: 他不顾家人的反对,决定出国留学。
exampleTraditional: 他不顧家人的反對,決定出國留學。
exampleEnglish: Despite his family's objections, he decided to study abroad.
hintSimplified: 不考虑别人的意见或危险,还是坚持去做。
hintTraditional: 不考慮別人的意見或危險,還是堅持去做。
hintEnglish: Not taking others' opinions or dangers into account, and doing it anyway.

gloss: (as a correlative conjunction) not only (..., but also ...)
definition: (as a correlative conjunction) not only (..., but also ...); not just; not limited to
exampleSimplified: 她不仅聪明,而且很努力。
exampleTraditional: 她不僅聰明,而且很努力。
exampleEnglish: She is not only smart but also very hardworking.
hintSimplified: 常和“而且”一起用,表示除了这一点,还有更多。
hintTraditional: 常和“而且”一起用,表示除了這一點,還有更多。
hintEnglish: Often used together with “moreover” to say that besides this, there is more.

definition: to make up missed lesson; to reschedule a class
exampleSimplified: 我生病请假了,所以周末要去补课。
exampleTraditional: 我生病請假了,所以週末要去補課。
exampleEnglish: I was sick and took leave, so I have to make up the lessons this weekend.
hintSimplified: 因为缺席了上课,之后另外找时间把内容学回来。
hintTraditional: 因為缺席了上課,之後另外找時間把內容學回來。
hintEnglish: Because you missed class, you find another time to catch up on the content.

gloss: (of a device, connection, material etc) defective; faulty
definition: (of a device, connection, material etc) defective; faulty; bad; harmful; unhealthy
exampleSimplified: 抽烟是一种不良的习惯。
exampleTraditional: 抽菸是一種不良的習慣。
exampleEnglish: Smoking is a bad habit.
hintSimplified: 形容习惯、影响等不好、有害。
hintTraditional: 形容習慣、影響等不好、有害。
hintEnglish: Describes habits, effects, etc. that are bad or harmful.

definition: dissatisfied; grievance; indignant; injustice; uneven; unfairness; wrong
exampleSimplified: 他觉得老板对他不公平,心里很不平。
exampleTraditional: 他覺得老闆對他不公平,心裡很不平。
exampleEnglish: He felt the boss was unfair to him and was very resentful.
hintSimplified: 觉得事情不公平,心里生气或不满。
hintTraditional: 覺得事情不公平,心裡生氣或不滿。
hintEnglish: Feeling that something is unfair, and being angry or discontent inside.

definition: How about ...?; if not; no; not so; or else; otherwise
exampleSimplified: 快点走吧,不然我们会迟到。
exampleTraditional: 快點走吧,不然我們會遲到。
exampleEnglish: Hurry up, otherwise we'll be late.
hintSimplified: 连词,表示如果不是前面说的那样,就会有不好的结果。
hintTraditional: 連詞,表示如果不是前面說的那樣,就會有不好的結果。
hintEnglish: A conjunction meaning that if things aren't as just described, there will be a bad result.

gloss: to take extra lessons in a cram school or with a private tutor
definition: to take extra lessons in a cram school or with a private tutor
exampleSimplified: 很多学生放学后还要去补习英文。
exampleTraditional: 很多學生放學後還要去補習英文。
exampleEnglish: Many students still go to cram school for English after school.
hintSimplified: 放学后到另外的地方上课,加强功课。
hintTraditional: 放學後到另外的地方上課,加強功課。
hintEnglish: Going to extra classes somewhere else after school to strengthen one's studies.

definition: can't; must not; not to allow
exampleSimplified: 图书馆里不许大声说话。
exampleTraditional: 圖書館裡不許大聲說話。
exampleEnglish: Speaking loudly is not allowed in the library.
hintSimplified: 用来表示规定或命令,说某件事是禁止的。
hintTraditional: 用來表示規定或命令,說某件事是禁止的。
hintEnglish: Used to express a rule or command that something is forbidden.

exampleSimplified: 这个时间不宜打电话给他,他可能在睡觉。
exampleTraditional: 這個時間不宜打電話給他,他可能在睡覺。
exampleEnglish: This is not a good time to call him; he may be sleeping.
hintSimplified: 表示做某件事不太合适,最好不要做。
hintTraditional: 表示做某件事不太合適,最好不要做。
hintEnglish: It means doing something is not appropriate and it's better not to.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],位[wei4],名[ming2]; head of a (government etc) department; minister; secretary; section chief; section head
exampleSimplified: 教育部长明天会来我们学校参观。
exampleTraditional: 教育部長明天會來我們學校參觀。
exampleEnglish: The Minister of Education will visit our school tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 政府里一个部门的最高负责人。
hintTraditional: 政府裡一個部門的最高負責人。
hintEnglish: The highest head of a government department.

definition: incessantly; more than; not limited to; without end
exampleSimplified: 来参加活动的人不止一百个。
exampleTraditional: 來參加活動的人不止一百個。
exampleEnglish: More than one hundred people came to the event.
hintSimplified: 表示数量或范围超过某个数目,不只是那样。
hintTraditional: 表示數量或範圍超過某個數目,不只是那樣。
hintEnglish: It means the amount or range goes beyond a certain number, not just that.

exampleSimplified: 政府每个月给他们一笔生活补助。
exampleTraditional: 政府每個月給他們一筆生活補助。
exampleEnglish: The government gives them a living allowance every month.
hintSimplified: 政府或公司给需要的人的一笔钱,帮忙减轻负担。
hintTraditional: 政府或公司給需要的人的一筆錢,幫忙減輕負擔。
hintEnglish: Money given by the government or a company to those in need to ease their burden.

exampleSimplified: 他把所有财产都留给了孩子。
exampleTraditional: 他把所有財產都留給了孩子。
exampleEnglish: He left all his property to his children.
hintSimplified: 一个人拥有的钱、房子和土地等东西。
hintTraditional: 一個人擁有的錢、房子和土地等東西。
hintEnglish: The money, houses, land and other things a person owns.

exampleSimplified: 健康比财富更重要。
exampleTraditional: 健康比財富更重要。
exampleEnglish: Health is more important than wealth.
hintSimplified: 指很多的钱和有价值的东西。
hintTraditional: 指很多的錢和有價值的東西。
hintEnglish: It refers to a large amount of money and valuable things.

definition: to procure (for an enterprise etc); to purchase
exampleSimplified: 公司的采购部门负责买办公用品。
exampleTraditional: 公司的採購部門負責買辦公用品。
exampleEnglish: The company's purchasing department is in charge of buying office supplies.
hintSimplified: 公司或机构大量买进需要的东西。
hintTraditional: 公司或機構大量買進需要的東西。
hintEnglish: When a company or organization buys needed goods in large quantities.

exampleSimplified: 她有音乐方面的才能,从小就会弹钢琴。
exampleTraditional: 她有音樂方面的才能,從小就會彈鋼琴。
exampleEnglish: She has musical talent and has played piano since childhood.
hintSimplified: 一个人天生或学来的特别本领。
hintTraditional: 一個人天生或學來的特別本領。
hintEnglish: A special skill a person is born with or has acquired.

gloss: (law) to judge; to adjudicate; verdict; judgement
definition: (law) to judge; to adjudicate; verdict; judgement; (sports) to referee; (sports) umpire; referee; judge
exampleSimplified: 裁判吹哨子,比赛就开始了。
exampleTraditional: 裁判吹哨子,比賽就開始了。
exampleEnglish: The referee blew the whistle and the game began.
hintSimplified: 在比赛中负责看规则、决定输赢的人。
hintTraditional: 在比賽中負責看規則、決定輸贏的人。
hintEnglish: The person in a game who watches the rules and decides the result.

exampleSimplified: 我想买一台彩色打印机。
exampleTraditional: 我想買一臺彩色印表機。
exampleEnglish: I want to buy a color printer.
hintSimplified: 和黑白相对,有很多种颜色的。
hintTraditional: 和黑白相對,有很多種顏色的。
hintEnglish: The opposite of black and white; having many hues.

definition: to cut staff; to lay off employees
exampleSimplified: 经济不好,这家公司决定裁员一百人。
exampleTraditional: 經濟不好,這家公司決定裁員一百人。
exampleEnglish: The economy is bad, so this company decided to lay off one hundred people.
hintSimplified: 公司为了省钱,让一部分员工离开工作。
hintTraditional: 公司為了省錢,讓一部分員工離開工作。
hintEnglish: A company, to save money, makes some employees leave their jobs.

exampleSimplified: 货物都放在仓库里。
exampleTraditional: 貨物都放在倉庫裡。
exampleEnglish: The goods are all kept in the warehouse.
hintSimplified: 用来存放大量货物的大房子。
hintTraditional: 用來存放大量貨物的大房子。
hintEnglish: A large building used to store lots of goods.

exampleSimplified: 我没帮上忙,觉得很惭愧。
exampleTraditional: 我沒幫上忙,覺得很慚愧。
exampleEnglish: I wasn't able to help, so I feel very ashamed.
hintSimplified: 做错事或做得不够好时,心里觉得不好意思。
hintTraditional: 做錯事或做得不夠好時,心裡覺得不好意思。
hintEnglish: The uneasy feeling inside when you did wrong or not well enough.

exampleSimplified: 同学们都积极参与这次活动。
exampleTraditional: 同學們都積極參與這次活動。
exampleEnglish: The students all actively took part in this event.
hintSimplified: 加入一件事,和大家一起做。
hintTraditional: 加入一件事,和大家一起做。
hintEnglish: To join in something and do it together with others.

exampleSimplified: 你不用为我操心,我自己可以处理。
exampleTraditional: 你不用為我操心,我自己可以處理。
exampleEnglish: You don't need to worry about me; I can handle it myself.
hintSimplified: 父母常为孩子的事这样,花心思去担心和照顾。
hintTraditional: 父母常為孩子的事這樣,花心思去擔心和照顧。
hintEnglish: Parents often do this for their children, spending effort worrying and caring.

definition: to manipulate; to operate; to work
exampleSimplified: 这台机器的操作方法很简单。
exampleTraditional: 這臺機器的操作方法很簡單。
exampleEnglish: The way to operate this machine is very simple.
hintSimplified: 按照步骤使用机器或设备。
hintTraditional: 按照步驟使用機器或裝置。
hintEnglish: Using a machine or device by following steps.

definition: survey; to determine; to gauge; to measure
exampleSimplified: 工人正在测量这块地的大小。
exampleTraditional: 工人正在測量這塊地的大小。
exampleEnglish: Workers are measuring the size of this piece of land.
hintSimplified: 用工具知道长度、高度或面积是多少。
hintTraditional: 用工具知道長度、高度或面積是多少。
hintEnglish: Using tools to find out the length, height or area of something.

exampleSimplified: 公司需要新的销售策略。
exampleTraditional: 公司需要新的銷售策略。
exampleEnglish: The company needs a new sales strategy.
hintSimplified: 为了达到目标而想出的方法和计划。
hintTraditional: 為了達到目標而想出的方法和計劃。
hintEnglish: The methods and plans thought up to reach a goal.

definition: (computing) beta (version of software); a test; to test (a person's skill in a particular area); to test (machinery etc)
exampleSimplified: 老师说下星期要测试我们的听力。
exampleTraditional: 老師說下星期要測試我們的聽力。
exampleEnglish: The teacher said she will test our listening next week.
hintSimplified: 用题目或工具检查能力或功能好不好。
hintTraditional: 用題目或工具檢查能力或功能好不好。
hintEnglish: Using questions or tools to check how good an ability or function is.

exampleSimplified: 今天的数学测验很难。
exampleTraditional: 今天的數學測驗很難。
exampleEnglish: Today's math quiz was very hard.
hintSimplified: 学校里比考试小的一种检查学习的方式。
hintTraditional: 學校裡比考試小的一種檢查學習的方式。
hintEnglish: A way of checking learning at school, smaller than an exam.

definition: accident; mishap; mistake; slip-up; fault; error
exampleSimplified: 这次活动的安排不能出一点差错。
exampleTraditional: 這次活動的安排不能出一點差錯。
exampleEnglish: There must not be even a single mistake in the arrangements for this event.
hintSimplified: 工作中不小心发生的错误或意外。
hintTraditional: 工作中不小心發生的錯誤或意外。
hintEnglish: A mistake or mishap that accidentally happens in work.

exampleSimplified: 妈妈周末去上插花课。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽週末去上插花課。
exampleEnglish: Mom goes to a flower arranging class on weekends.
hintSimplified: 把花和叶子摆成漂亮造型的一种艺术。
hintTraditional: 把花和葉子擺成漂亮造型的一種藝術。
hintEnglish: An art of arranging flowers and leaves into a beautiful shape.

exampleSimplified: 下午学校有一场茶会,大家可以边喝茶边聊天。
exampleTraditional: 下午學校有一場茶會,大家可以邊喝茶邊聊天。
exampleEnglish: There is a tea party at school this afternoon where everyone can chat while drinking tea.
hintSimplified: 大家聚在一起喝茶、吃点心、聊天的聚会。
hintTraditional: 大家聚在一起喝茶、吃點心、聊天的聚會。
hintEnglish: A gathering where people drink tea, eat snacks and chat.

exampleSimplified: 城市和乡村的收入差距越来越大。
exampleTraditional: 城市和鄉村的收入差距越來越大。
exampleEnglish: The income gap between cities and villages is getting bigger and bigger.
hintSimplified: 两个人或两件事在水平、数量上相差的程度。
hintTraditional: 兩個人或兩件事在水平、數量上相差的程度。
hintEnglish: The degree of difference in level or amount between two people or things.

exampleSimplified: 每个人都有自己的长处和短处。
exampleTraditional: 每個人都有自己的長處和短處。
exampleEnglish: Everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses.
hintSimplified: 一个人或东西比较好、比较强的地方,和短处相对。
hintTraditional: 一個人或東西比較好、比較強的地方,和短處相對。
hintEnglish: The place where a person or thing is better or stronger, opposite of weak points.

exampleSimplified: 这个场地很大,可以举办很多活动。
exampleTraditional: 這個場地很大,可以舉辦很多活動。
exampleEnglish: This venue is very big and can host many events.
hintSimplified: 举办比赛或活动的一块空间。
hintTraditional: 舉辦比賽或活動的一塊空間。
hintEnglish: A space where a game or event is held.

exampleSimplified: 请量一下这条绳子的长度。
exampleTraditional: 請量一下這條繩子的長度。
exampleEnglish: Please measure the length of this rope.
hintSimplified: 用尺量东西从头到尾有多远。
hintTraditional: 用尺量東西從頭到尾有多遠。
hintEnglish: How far something measures from one end to the other.

exampleSimplified: 在正式的场合,你应该穿西装。
exampleTraditional: 在正式的場合,你應該穿西裝。

definition: doctor; physician; senior official (in imperial China)
exampleSimplified: 我头很痛,明天要去看大夫。
exampleTraditional: 我頭很痛,明天要去看大夫。
exampleEnglish: I have a bad headache; I'm going to see a doctor tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 生病时去医院找的人,会帮你检查和开药。
hintTraditional: 生病時去醫院找的人,會幫你檢查和開藥。
hintEnglish: The person you see at the hospital when you're sick, who examines you and prescribes medicine.

exampleSimplified: 爸爸和我之间有很大的代沟。
exampleTraditional: 爸爸和我之間有很大的代溝。
exampleEnglish: There is a big generation gap between my dad and me.
hintSimplified: 老一辈和年轻人因为想法不同而难以沟通的情况。
hintTraditional: 老一輩和年輕人因為想法不同而難以溝通的情況。
hintEnglish: The difficulty older and younger people have understanding each other because of different ideas.

definition: stop a while; wait a minute
exampleSimplified: 我现在有点忙,待会再打给你。
exampleTraditional: 我現在有點忙,待會再打給你。
exampleEnglish: I'm a bit busy now; I'll call you back in a little while.
hintSimplified: 指现在之后不久的时间,不是马上。
hintTraditional: 指現在之後不久的時間,不是馬上。
hintEnglish: Refers to a short time from now, not immediately.

exampleSimplified: 成功需要付出很大的代价。
exampleTraditional: 成功需要付出很大的代價。
exampleEnglish: Success requires paying a great price.
hintSimplified: 为了得到某样东西而必须失去或付出的东西。
hintTraditional: 為了得到某樣東西而必須失去或付出的東西。
hintEnglish: What you must give up or sacrifice in order to obtain something.

definition: CL:筆|笔[bi3]; a loan; to provide a loan (e.g. bank); to raise a loan (from e.g. a bank)
exampleSimplified: 他向银行申请了一笔贷款来买房子。
exampleTraditional: 他向銀行申請了一筆貸款來買房子。
exampleEnglish: He applied to the bank for a loan to buy a house.
hintSimplified: 向银行借钱,以后要连本带利还回去。
hintTraditional: 向銀行借錢,以後要連本帶利還回去。
hintEnglish: Borrowing money from a bank that must be repaid later with interest.

definition: (computing) proxy; surrogate; to act as an agent or proxy; to act on behalf of sb in a responsible position
exampleSimplified: 经理出国了,由王小姐代理他的工作。
exampleTraditional: 經理出國了,由王小姐代理他的工作。
exampleEnglish: The manager went abroad, so Ms. Wang is handling his work in his place.
hintSimplified: 别人不在时,替他处理事情或负责工作。
hintTraditional: 別人不在時,替他處理事情或負責工作。
hintEnglish: To handle matters or take charge of work on behalf of someone who is absent.

definition: (fig.) to instruct; to lead the way; to guide; to show the way
exampleSimplified: 我不认识路,请你帮我带路好吗?
exampleTraditional: 我不認識路,請你幫我帶路好嗎?
exampleEnglish: I don't know the way; could you lead the way for me?
hintSimplified: 走在前面,让不认识地方的人跟着你走。
hintTraditional: 走在前面,讓不認識地方的人跟著你走。
hintEnglish: Walking ahead so someone who doesn't know the place can follow you.

exampleSimplified: 这家公司的待遇很好,员工都很满意。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司的待遇很好,員工都很滿意。
exampleEnglish: This company's pay and benefits are good, and the employees are all satisfied.
hintSimplified: 公司给员工的薪水、假期和福利等条件。
hintTraditional: 公司給員工的薪水、假期和福利等條件。
hintEnglish: The salary, vacation and benefits that a company gives its employees.

exampleSimplified: 周末的大街上有很多人在逛街。
exampleTraditional: 週末的大街上有很多人在逛街。
exampleEnglish: On weekends there are many people strolling on the main street.
hintSimplified: 城市里又宽又热闹的路,两边有很多商店。
hintTraditional: 城市裡又寬又熱鬧的路,兩邊有很多商店。
hintEnglish: A wide, busy road in the city with many shops on both sides.

exampleSimplified: 政府大力推动环保政策。
exampleTraditional: 政府大力推動環保政策。
exampleEnglish: The government is vigorously promoting environmental policies.
hintSimplified: 形容做事时非常用心、投入很多力量。
hintTraditional: 形容做事時非常用心、投入很多力量。
hintEnglish: Describes doing something with great effort and strong commitment.

definition: bulk; generous; great amount; large quantity; magnanimous; numerous
exampleSimplified: 这个工厂每天使用大量的水。
exampleTraditional: 這個工廠每天使用大量的水。
exampleEnglish: This factory uses a large amount of water every day.
hintSimplified: 形容数目非常多,不是一点点。
hintTraditional: 形容數目非常多,不是一點點。
hintEnglish: Describes a very large amount, not just a little.

definition: (functional programming or philosophy) monad; bedsheet; bill; form; list of items; the only son of a family
exampleSimplified: 请把购物的单子放在桌子上。
exampleTraditional: 請把購物的單子放在桌子上。
exampleEnglish: Please put the shopping list on the table.
hintSimplified: 一张纸,上面写着要买的东西或账目。
hintTraditional: 一張紙,上面寫著要買的東西或賬目。
hintEnglish: A sheet of paper listing items to buy or charges.

exampleSimplified: 睡眠不足会影响大脑的运作。
exampleTraditional: 睡眠不足會影響大腦的運作。
exampleEnglish: Lack of sleep affects how the brain functions.
hintSimplified: 在头里面,负责思考和记忆的器官。
hintTraditional: 在頭裡面,負責思考和記憶的器官。
hintEnglish: The organ inside the head responsible for thinking and memory.

exampleSimplified: 我可以担保他是一个诚实的人。
exampleTraditional: 我可以擔保他是一個誠實的人。
exampleEnglish: I can vouch that he is an honest person.
hintSimplified: 明确表示某人或某事可靠,如果出问题自己负责。
hintTraditional: 明確表示某人或某事可靠,如果出問題自己負責。
hintEnglish: To state that someone or something is reliable and take responsibility if anything goes wrong.

exampleSimplified: 每天吃同样的东西,生活太单调了。
exampleTraditional: 每天吃同樣的東西,生活太單調了。
exampleEnglish: Eating the same things every day makes life too monotonous.
hintSimplified: 形容事情一直重复,没有变化,很无聊。
hintTraditional: 形容事情一直重複,沒有變化,很無聊。
hintEnglish: Describes something repetitive, without variety, and boring.

exclusionReason: Answer is in the hint
exampleSimplified: 这些旧档案都放在办公室的柜子里。
exampleTraditional: 這些舊檔案都放在辦公室的櫃子裡。
exampleEnglish: These old files are all kept in the cabinet in the office.
hintSimplified: 机关或公司保存的重要文件和资料。
hintTraditional: 機關或公司儲存的重要檔案和資料。
hintEnglish: Important documents and records kept by an organization or company.

exampleSimplified: 当初我真不应该相信他。
exampleTraditional: 當初我真不應該相信他。
exampleEnglish: I really shouldn't have trusted him back then.
hintSimplified: 回想过去事情刚开始的那个时候。
hintTraditional: 回想過去事情剛開始的那個時候。
hintEnglish: Recalling the time in the past when something first began.

gloss: to be elected; to be selected
definition: to be elected; to be selected
exampleSimplified: 他在这次选举中当选为市长。
exampleTraditional: 他在這次選舉中當選為市長。
exampleEnglish: He was elected mayor in this election.
hintSimplified: 投票之后,得到最多支持而成为代表或领导者。
hintTraditional: 投票之後,得到最多支援而成為代表或領導者。
hintEnglish: After a vote, getting the most support and becoming a representative or leader.

exampleSimplified: 他很有胆量,敢一个人走夜路。
exampleTraditional: 他很有膽量,敢一個人走夜路。
exampleEnglish: He is very brave; he dares to walk alone at night.
hintSimplified: 面对危险或困难时,敢去做的勇气。
hintTraditional: 面對危險或困難時,敢去做的勇氣。
hintEnglish: The courage to act when facing danger or difficulty.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市里诞生了许多有名的艺术家。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市裡誕生了許多有名的藝術家。
exampleEnglish: Many famous artists were born in this city.
hintSimplified: 人或新事物来到这个世界,比较正式的说法。
hintTraditional: 人或新事物來到這個世界,比較正式的說法。
hintEnglish: A formal way to say a person or new thing comes into the world.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; unit (group of people as a whole); unit (of measure); work unit (place of employment, esp. in the PRC prior to economic reform)
exampleSimplified: 你在哪个单位工作?
exampleTraditional: 你在哪個單位工作?
exampleEnglish: Which organization do you work for?
hintSimplified: 人们工作的机关、学校或公司;也是计算数量的标准,如公斤、公尺。
hintTraditional: 人們工作的機關、學校或公司;也是計算數量的標準,如公斤、公尺。
hintEnglish: The organization where people work; also a standard of measurement such as kilograms or meters.

definition: to delay; to hold up; to interfere with; to waste time
exampleSimplified: 对不起,我不想耽误你的时间。
exampleTraditional: 對不起,我不想耽誤你的時間。
exampleEnglish: Sorry, I don't want to waste your time.
hintSimplified: 因为拖延或出问题,使事情不能按时完成。
hintTraditional: 因為拖延或出問題,使事情不能按時完成。
hintEnglish: When delays or problems keep something from being done on time.

exampleSimplified: 弟弟很胆小,晚上不敢一个人睡觉。
exampleTraditional: 弟弟很膽小,晚上不敢一個人睡覺。
exampleEnglish: My little brother is timid and doesn't dare sleep alone at night.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人很容易害怕,不敢做事。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人很容易害怕,不敢做事。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who is easily scared and afraid to do things.

exampleSimplified: 火车预计下午三点到达台北。
exampleTraditional: 火車預計下午三點到達台北。
exampleEnglish: The train is expected to arrive in Taipei at three in the afternoon.
hintSimplified: 坐车或坐飞机后，终于来到目的地。
hintTraditional: 坐車或坐飛機後，終於來到目的地。
hintEnglish: After traveling by car or plane, you finally come to your destination.

exampleSimplified: 这条道路很宽，车子很多。
exampleTraditional: 這條道路很寬，車子很多。
exampleEnglish: This road is wide and has a lot of cars.
hintSimplified: 车子和行人走的地方，可以通到别的地方。
hintTraditional: 車子和行人走的地方，可以通到別的地方。
hintEnglish: The place where cars and pedestrians travel, leading to other places.

exampleSimplified: 今天出门就下雨，真倒楣！
exampleTraditional: 今天出門就下雨，真倒楣！
exampleEnglish: It started raining as soon as I went out today, what bad luck!
hintSimplified: 遇到不好的事情，运气很差的时候会这样说。
hintTraditional: 遇到不好的事情，運氣很差的時候會這樣說。
hintEnglish: What you say when you meet with bad things and have poor luck.

definition: to expire (visa etc); to fall due (loan etc); to mature (investment bond etc)
exampleSimplified: 我的护照下个月就要到期了。
exampleTraditional: 我的護照下個月就要到期了。
exampleEnglish: My passport will expire next month.
hintSimplified: 规定的时间已经结束，证件或合约不能再用了。
hintTraditional: 規定的時間已經結束，證件或合約不能再用了。
hintEnglish: The set time has ended, and a document or contract can no longer be used.

definition: guidebook; to conduct a tour; tour guide
exampleSimplified: 导游带我们参观了很多有名的地方。
exampleTraditional: 導遊帶我們參觀了很多有名的地方。
exampleEnglish: The tour guide took us to see many famous places.
hintSimplified: 旅行团里负责带大家、介绍景点的人。
hintTraditional: 旅行團裡負責帶大家、介紹景點的人。
hintEnglish: The person in a tour group who leads everyone and explains the sights.

definition: to bother; to disturb; to trouble
exampleSimplified: 不好意思，打扰你一下，请问洗手间在哪里？
exampleTraditional: 不好意思，打擾你一下，請問洗手間在哪裡？
exampleEnglish: Sorry to bother you, where is the restroom?
hintSimplified: 你在忙的时候，别人来打断你，让你不方便。
hintTraditional: 你在忙的時候，別人來打斷你，讓你不方便。
hintEnglish: When you are busy and someone interrupts you, making things inconvenient.

gloss: elder sister (respectful appellation for an older married woman)
definition: elder sister (respectful appellation for an older married woman); older brother's wife; sister-in-law
exampleSimplified: 大嫂做的菜很好吃，大家都喜欢。
exampleTraditional: 大嫂做的菜很好吃，大家都喜歡。
exampleEnglish: My sister-in-law's cooking is delicious, and everyone likes it.
hintSimplified: 哥哥的太太，家人这样称呼她。
hintTraditional: 哥哥的太太，家人這樣稱呼她。
hintEnglish: The wife of one's older brother, as family members call her.

exampleSimplified: 跑了一整天，我的大腿很酸。
exampleTraditional: 跑了一整天，我的大腿很酸。
exampleEnglish: After running all day, my thighs are sore.
hintSimplified: 身体的一部分，在膝盖和腰之间。
hintTraditional: 身體的一部分，在膝蓋和腰之間。
hintEnglish: A part of the body between the knee and the hip.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市今年要办一场大型音乐会。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市今年要辦一場大型音樂會。
exampleEnglish: This city will hold a large-scale concert this year.
hintSimplified: 形容规模很大的活动、机器或设备。
hintTraditional: 形容規模很大的活動、機器或裝置。
hintEnglish: Describes an event, machine or equipment of great scale.

exampleSimplified: 考试的时候不要大意，要仔细检查。
exampleTraditional: 考試的時候不要大意，要仔細檢查。
exampleEnglish: Don't be careless during the exam; check carefully.
hintSimplified: 做事不小心、不注意，容易出错的态度。
hintTraditional: 做事不小心、不注意，容易出錯的態度。
hintEnglish: An attitude of not being careful or attentive, which easily leads to mistakes.

definition: (literary) bumper harvest; abundance; there is a great deal of ... (typically followed by a bisyllabic word, as in 大有希望[da4 you3 xi1 wang4])
exampleSimplified: 多运动对身体大有好处。
exampleTraditional: 多運動對身體大有好處。
exampleEnglish: Exercising more is greatly beneficial to the body.
hintSimplified: 常和“好处”“帮助”连用，表示程度很高，有很多。
hintTraditional: 常和“好處”“幫助”連用，表示程度很高，有很多。
hintEnglish: Often used with "benefit" or "help" to show a high degree, a lot of it.

gloss: to give or get an injection
definition: to give or get an injection
exampleSimplified: 孩子生病了，医生说要打针。
exampleTraditional: 孩子生病了，醫生說要打針。
exampleEnglish: The child is sick, and the doctor said he needs a shot.
hintSimplified: 在医院，护士用针把药放进身体里。
hintTraditional: 在醫院，護士用針把藥放進身體裡。
hintEnglish: At the hospital, a nurse uses a needle to put medicine into your body.

exampleSimplified: 这件事我只知道大致的情况。
exampleTraditional: 這件事我只知道大致的情況。
exampleEnglish: I only know the rough situation of this matter.
hintSimplified: 不是很精确，只说主要的部分或差不多的样子。
hintTraditional: 不是很精確，只說主要的部分或差不多的樣子。
hintEnglish: Not very precise; giving only the main part or roughly how things are.

definition: Volkswagen (automobile manufacturer); popular (of music, science etc); the great bulk of the population; the masses
exampleSimplified: 捷运是大众常用的交通工具。
exampleTraditional: 捷運是大眾常用的交通工具。
exampleEnglish: The MRT is a means of transport commonly used by the public.
hintSimplified: 指社会上一般的人，很多普通人。
hintTraditional: 指社會上一般的人，很多普通人。
hintEnglish: Refers to ordinary people in society, the general masses.

gloss: to type (using a keyboard, typewriter or phone etc)
definition: to type (using a keyboard, typewriter or phone etc)
exampleSimplified: 他打字很快，一分钟能打八十个字。
exampleTraditional: 他打字很快，一分鐘能打八十個字。
exampleEnglish: He types very fast, eighty characters a minute.
hintSimplified: 用电脑键盘把文字输入进去。
hintTraditional: 用電腦鍵盤把文字輸入進去。
hintEnglish: Entering text by using a computer keyboard.

definition: score; rating; grade; to score a point (in a competition, test etc)
exampleSimplified: 他在比赛的最后一分钟得分了。
exampleTraditional: 他在比賽的最後一分鐘得分了。
exampleEnglish: He scored in the last minute of the game.
hintSimplified: 比赛中拿到分数，让队伍领先。
hintTraditional: 比賽中拿到分數，讓隊伍領先。
hintEnglish: Getting points in a game, putting the team ahead.

exampleSimplified: 这部电影得奖了，很多人去看。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影得獎了，很多人去看。
exampleEnglish: This movie won an award, and many people went to see it.
hintSimplified: 表现很好，被评审选中，拿到奖杯或奖状。
hintTraditional: 表現很好，被評審選中，拿到獎盃或獎狀。
hintEnglish: Performing very well and being chosen by judges to receive a trophy or certificate.

definition: (emphatically, in rhetorical questions) possible; all right!; that's enough!
exampleSimplified: 孩子一个人在外面,要是出了事还得了?
exampleTraditional: 孩子一個人在外面,要是出了事還得了?
exampleEnglish: The child is outside alone; if something happened, how could that be okay?
hintSimplified: 常用在反问句里,表示事情很严重,后果不堪设想。
hintTraditional: 常用在反問句裡,表示事情很嚴重,後果不堪設想。
hintEnglish: Often used in rhetorical questions to show that something is serious and the consequences would be unthinkable.

exampleSimplified: 请你坐在那张凳子上等一下。
exampleTraditional: 請你坐在那張凳子上等一下。
exampleEnglish: Please sit on that stool and wait a moment.
hintSimplified: 可以坐的小家具，通常没有靠背。
hintTraditional: 可以坐的小傢俱，通常沒有靠背。
hintEnglish: A small piece of furniture to sit on, usually without a back.

exampleSimplified: 这家饭店的等级很高，价钱也不便宜。
exampleTraditional: 這家飯店的等級很高，價錢也不便宜。
exampleEnglish: This hotel is of a high class, and the price isn't cheap.
hintSimplified: 按照好坏或高低分出来的层次，例如一级、二级。
hintTraditional: 按照好壞或高低分出來的層次，例如一級、二級。
hintEnglish: Levels divided by quality or height, such as first, second.

exampleSimplified: 你要先登记，才能参加这个课程。
exampleTraditional: 你要先登記，才能參加這個課程。
exampleEnglish: You have to register first before you can join this course.
hintSimplified: 把名字和资料写在表上，让别人知道你要参加。
hintTraditional: 把名字和資料寫在表上，讓別人知道你要參加。
hintEnglish: Writing your name and information on a form so others know you will take part.

definition: climbing; mountaineering; to climb a mountain
exampleSimplified: 周末我们全家一起去登山。
exampleTraditional: 週末我們全家一起去登山。
exampleEnglish: This weekend our whole family is going mountain climbing.
hintSimplified: 一种运动，走路爬到山上去。
hintTraditional: 一種運動，走路爬到山上去。
hintEnglish: A sport in which you walk and climb up a mountain.

definition: to be tantamount to; to equal
exampleSimplified: 一加一等于二。
exampleTraditional: 一加一等於二。
exampleEnglish: One plus one equals two.
hintSimplified: 数学里用来表示两边的数量一样；也表示“就像是”。
hintTraditional: 數學裡用來表示兩邊的數量一樣；也表示“就像是”。
hintEnglish: Used in math to show both sides are the same amount; also means "it's as good as".

definition: a faux pas; excuse me! (formal); see also 得罪[de2 zui4]; see also 得罪[de2 zui5]; to commit an offense; to make a faux pas; to offend sb; to violate the law
exampleSimplified: 我说错话，不小心得罪了朋友。
exampleTraditional: 我說錯話，不小心得罪了朋友。
exampleEnglish: I said the wrong thing and accidentally offended my friend.
hintSimplified: 说话或做事让别人不高兴，甚至生气。
hintTraditional: 說話或做事讓別人不高興，甚至生氣。
hintEnglish: Saying or doing something that makes others unhappy or even angry.

exampleSimplified: 以前的人用电报传送紧急消息。
exampleTraditional: 以前的人用電報傳送緊急訊息。
exampleEnglish: People in the past used telegrams to send urgent messages.
hintSimplified: 很久以前用电信号很快传送的简短消息。
hintTraditional: 很久以前用電訊號很快傳送的簡短訊息。
hintEnglish: A short message sent quickly by electric signals a long time ago.

exampleSimplified: 我弟弟每天晚上都玩电动。
exampleTraditional: 我弟弟每天晚上都玩電動。
exampleEnglish: My younger brother plays video games every night.
hintSimplified: 年轻人喜欢在电脑或游戏机上玩的娱乐。
hintTraditional: 年輕人喜歡在電腦或遊戲機上玩的娛樂。
hintEnglish: A kind of entertainment young people like to play on a computer or console.

exampleSimplified: 毕业典礼在下午两点开始。
exampleTraditional: 畢業典禮在下午兩點開始。
exampleEnglish: The graduation ceremony starts at two in the afternoon.
