exampleEnglish: This school has a good study culture; students all work hard.
hintSimplified: 指一个地方或一个时代中,大家普遍的习惯和态度。
hintTraditional: 指一個地方或一個時代中,大家普遍的習慣和態度。
hintEnglish: The general habits and attitudes shared by people in a place or era.

exampleSimplified: 他说话很风趣,大家都喜欢听他讲笑话。
exampleTraditional: 他說話很風趣,大家都喜歡聽他講笑話。
exampleEnglish: He speaks in a witty way, and everyone likes hearing his jokes.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人说话有意思,让人觉得轻松愉快。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人說話有意思,讓人覺得輕鬆愉快。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose talk is interesting and makes others feel relaxed and happy.

exampleSimplified: 投资股票有一定的风险,你要想清楚。
exampleTraditional: 投資股票有一定的風險,你要想清楚。
exampleEnglish: Investing in stocks carries some risk, so think it over carefully.
hintSimplified: 做一件事可能会遭到损失或危险的可能性。
hintTraditional: 做一件事可能會遭到損失或危險的可能性。
hintEnglish: The possibility of loss or danger when doing something.

exampleSimplified: 路上有个疯子大声唱歌,孩子们都很害怕。
exampleTraditional: 路上有個瘋子大聲唱歌,孩子們都很害怕。
exampleEnglish: A madman was singing loudly on the street, and the children were scared.
hintSimplified: 指精神不正常、行为让人觉得奇怪的人。
hintTraditional: 指精神不正常、行為讓人覺得奇怪的人。
hintEnglish: A person whose mind is unwell and whose behavior seems strange.

exampleSimplified: 她今天穿了一件粉红色的外套,很可爱。
exampleTraditional: 她今天穿了一件粉紅色的外套,很可愛。
exampleEnglish: She wore a pink coat today, and it looks cute.
hintSimplified: 这是红色和白色混合的颜色,很多女孩子喜欢。
hintTraditional: 這是紅色和白色混合的顏色,很多女孩子喜歡。
hintEnglish: A color mixing red and white, liked by many girls.

exampleSimplified: 这张照片黑白分明,看起来很有味道。
exampleTraditional: 這張照片黑白分明,看起來很有味道。
exampleEnglish: The black and white in this photo are sharply distinct, giving it character.
hintSimplified: 形容两种东西之间的界线很清楚,不会混在一起。
hintTraditional: 形容兩種東西之間的界線很清楚,不會混在一起。
hintEnglish: Describes a boundary between two things that is clear and not mixed.

exampleSimplified: 听到这个消息,大家都感到非常愤怒。
exampleTraditional: 聽到這個訊息,大家都感到非常憤怒。
exampleEnglish: Hearing this news, everyone felt extremely indignant.
hintSimplified: 遇到不公平的事时,心里产生的很强烈的生气情绪。
hintTraditional: 遇到不公平的事時,心裡產生的很強烈的生氣情緒。
hintEnglish: A very intense feeling of anger on encountering something unfair.

definition: to allocate; to assign; to distribute; to partition (a hard drive)
exampleSimplified: 老师把工作分配给每一位同学。
exampleTraditional: 老師把工作分配給每一位同學。
exampleEnglish: The teacher assigned the work to each student.
hintSimplified: 把东西或任务按照安排交给不同的人。
hintTraditional: 把東西或任務按照安排交給不同的人。
hintEnglish: To hand out things or tasks to different people according to a plan.

definition: to disperse; to distribute; to scatter
exampleSimplified: 下课后,学生们很快就分散到各个地方去了。
exampleTraditional: 下課後,學生們很快就分散到各個地方去了。
exampleEnglish: After class, the students quickly scattered to different places.
hintSimplified: 原来在一起的人或东西,向不同的方向离开。
hintTraditional: 原來在一起的人或東西,向不同的方向離開。
hintEnglish: People or things that were together move off in different directions.

definition: to break up; to part company; to split up
exampleSimplified: 他们交往了三年,最后还是分手了。
exampleTraditional: 他們交往了三年,最後還是分手了。
exampleEnglish: They dated for three years but eventually broke up.
hintSimplified: 男女朋友决定不再继续交往。
hintTraditional: 男女朋友決定不再繼續交往。
hintEnglish: A couple decides not to continue their relationship.

exampleSimplified: 这次考试他的分数比上次高很多。
exampleTraditional: 這次考試他的分數比上次高很多。
exampleEnglish: His score on this exam was much higher than last time.
hintSimplified: 考试后老师给你的数字,代表你考得好不好。
hintTraditional: 考試後老師給你的數字,代表你考得好不好。
hintEnglish: The number a teacher gives you after a test showing how well you did.

exampleSimplified: 医生仔细分析了他的病情。
exampleTraditional: 醫生仔細分析了他的病情。
exampleEnglish: The doctor carefully analyzed his condition.
hintSimplified: 把一件复杂的事情拆开,一部分一部分地研究。
hintTraditional: 把一件複雜的事情拆開,一部分一部分地研究。
hintEnglish: To break down a complex matter and study it part by part.

gloss: to share (esp. sth enjoyable, useful or beneficial)
definition: to share (esp. sth enjoyable, useful or beneficial)
exampleSimplified: 我想和大家分享这次旅行的照片。
exampleTraditional: 我想和大家分享這次旅行的照片。
exampleEnglish: I'd like to share the photos from this trip with everyone.
hintSimplified: 把好东西或快乐的经验告诉别人,让别人也能得到。
hintTraditional: 把好東西或快樂的經驗告訴別人,讓別人也能得到。
hintEnglish: To tell others about good things or happy experiences so they get them too.

definition: negation; negative (answer); to deny; to negate; to reject
exampleSimplified: 你不能一开始就否定别人的想法。
exampleTraditional: 你不能一開始就否定別人的想法。
exampleEnglish: You shouldn't dismiss other people's ideas right from the start.
hintSimplified: 认为某件事不对、不成立,不同意它。
hintTraditional: 認為某件事不對、不成立,不同意它。
hintEnglish: To consider something incorrect or invalid and not accept it.

definition: to declare to be untrue; to deny
exampleSimplified: 他否认自己打破了窗户。
exampleTraditional: 他否認自己打破了窗戶。
exampleEnglish: He denied that he had broken the window.
hintSimplified: 别人说你做了某件事,你却说没有这回事。
hintTraditional: 別人說你做了某件事,你卻說沒有這回事。
hintEnglish: Others say you did something, but you say it isn't true.

gloss: to guide; to mentor; to counsel; to coach; to tutor
definition: to guide; to mentor; to counsel; to coach; to tutor
exampleSimplified: 放学后,老师会辅导成绩比较差的学生。
exampleTraditional: 放學後,老師會輔導成績比較差的學生。
exampleEnglish: After school, the teacher tutors students whose grades are weaker.
hintSimplified: 老师在课外额外帮助学生学习。
hintTraditional: 老師在課外額外幫助學生學習。
hintEnglish: A teacher gives students extra help with studying outside of class.

exampleSimplified: 数学课本里有很多特别的符号。
exampleTraditional: 數學課本里有很多特別的符號。
exampleEnglish: There are many special symbols in the math textbook.
hintSimplified: 像加号、问号这样,用来表示某种意思的小图形或记号。
hintTraditional: 像加號、問號這樣,用來表示某種意思的小圖形或記號。
hintEnglish: Small figures or marks, like plus or question marks, that stand for a meaning.

exampleSimplified: 如果要快递,需要付附加费用。
exampleTraditional: 如果要快遞,需要付附加費用。
exampleEnglish: If you want express delivery, you need to pay an additional fee.
hintSimplified: 在原来的基础上再多加上去的。
hintTraditional: 在原來的基礎上再多加上去的。
hintEnglish: Added on top of what was originally there.

exampleSimplified: 这个活动是为了帮助需要照顾的妇女。
exampleTraditional: 這個活動是為了幫助需要照顧的婦女。
exampleEnglish: This event is meant to help women who need care.
hintSimplified: 对成年女性的比较正式的称呼。
hintTraditional: 對成年女性的比較正式的稱呼。
hintEnglish: A rather formal way to refer to adult females.

exampleSimplified: 这对夫妻结婚已经三十年了。
exampleTraditional: 這對夫妻結婚已經三十年了。
exampleEnglish: This married couple has been married for thirty years.
hintSimplified: 结了婚的一男一女,住在一起。
hintTraditional: 結了婚的一男一女,住在一起。
hintEnglish: A man and a woman who are married and live together.

exampleSimplified: 王先生和他的夫人一起参加了晚宴。
exampleTraditional: 王先生和他的夫人一起參加了晚宴。
exampleEnglish: Mr. Wang attended the dinner together with his wife.
hintSimplified: 礼貌地称呼别人的太太,或地位较高男士的妻子。
hintTraditional: 禮貌地稱呼別人的太太,或地位較高男士的妻子。
hintEnglish: A polite way to refer to someone's wife, especially of a man of status.

definition: prosperous; well-to-do; well-off; see 富裕縣|富裕县[Fu4 yu4 Xian4]
exampleSimplified: 这个国家越来越富裕,人民生活得很好。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家越來越富裕,人民生活得很好。
exampleEnglish: This country is getting more and more prosperous, and its people live well.
hintSimplified: 形容家庭或国家钱很多、生活条件很好。
hintTraditional: 形容家庭或國家錢很多、生活條件很好。
hintEnglish: Describes a family or country with plenty of money and a good standard of living.

exampleSimplified: 这个问题很复杂,我需要想一想。
exampleTraditional: 這個問題很複雜,我需要想一想。
exampleEnglish: This problem is very complicated; I need to think about it.
hintSimplified: 形容事情有很多部分,不容易弄清楚。
hintTraditional: 形容事情有很多部分,不容易弄清楚。
hintEnglish: Describes something with many parts that is not easy to understand.

definition: to clone; to copy; to duplicate; to make a copy of; to reproduce
exampleSimplified: 请把这个文件复制到你的电脑里。
exampleTraditional: 請把這個檔案複製到你的電腦裡。
exampleEnglish: Please copy this file onto your computer.
hintSimplified: 在电脑上按一个键,就能做出一模一样的文件。
hintTraditional: 在電腦上按一個鍵,就能做出一模一樣的檔案。
hintEnglish: On a computer, press a key to make an identical file.

exampleSimplified: 锅子的盖子不见了,我找不到。
exampleTraditional: 鍋子的蓋子不見了,我找不到。
exampleEnglish: The lid of the pot is missing; I can't find it.
hintSimplified: 放在杯子或锅子上面,用来把东西盖住的东西。
hintTraditional: 放在杯子或鍋子上面,用來把東西蓋住的東西。
hintEnglish: Something placed on top of a cup or pot to cover it.

definition: CL:次[ci4],種|种[zhong3],項|项[xiang4]; reform; to reform
exampleSimplified: 政府决定进行教育改革。
exampleTraditional: 政府決定進行教育改革。
exampleEnglish: The government decided to carry out education reform.
hintSimplified: 把旧的制度或方法大幅度改变,让它变得更好。
hintTraditional: 把舊的制度或方法大幅度改變,讓它變得更好。
hintEnglish: To make big changes to an old system or method to improve it.

definition: to reform; to remodel; to remold; to transform
exampleSimplified: 他们把旧工厂改造成了一家咖啡馆。
exampleTraditional: 他們把舊工廠改造成了一家咖啡館。
exampleEnglish: They transformed the old factory into a café.
hintSimplified: 把原来的建筑或东西改变,变成新的样子或用途。
hintTraditional: 把原來的建築或東西改變,變成新的樣子或用途。
hintEnglish: To change an existing building or thing into a new form or use.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; correction; to amend; to correct; to put right
exampleSimplified: 老师请我们把作业里的错误改正过来。
exampleTraditional: 老師請我們把作業裡的錯誤改正過來。
exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to correct the mistakes in our homework.
hintSimplified: 发现错误以后,把它变成对的。
hintTraditional: 發現錯誤以後,把它變成對的。
hintEnglish: After finding a mistake, you make it right.

definition: Bottoms up!; Cheers! (proposing a toast); Here's to you!; lit. dry cup; to drink a toast
exampleSimplified: 新年快乐,大家一起干杯吧!
exampleTraditional: 新年快樂,大家一起乾杯吧!
exampleEnglish: Happy New Year, let's all raise our glasses together!
hintSimplified: 聚会时大家举起杯子,把里面的酒或饮料喝完。
hintTraditional: 聚會時大家舉起杯子,把裡面的酒或飲料喝完。
hintEnglish: At a party, everyone raises their glasses and drinks them down.

exampleSimplified: 他是公司里的一位高级干部。
exampleTraditional: 他是公司裡的一位高階幹部。
exampleEnglish: He is a senior official in the company.
hintSimplified: 在机关或组织里负责管理工作的人。
hintTraditional: 在機關或組織裡負責管理工作的人。
hintEnglish: A person who holds a management role in an organization or institution.

definition: candid; direct and to the point; just; might as well; simply
exampleSimplified: 你干脆直接告诉他吧,不要再等了。
exampleTraditional: 你乾脆直接告訴他吧,不要再等了。
exampleEnglish: You might as well just tell him directly; don't wait any longer.
hintSimplified: 用来表示不想再犹豫,直接选择最简单的办法。
hintTraditional: 用來表示不想再猶豫,直接選擇最簡單的辦法。
hintEnglish: Used to show you'd rather stop hesitating and just take the simplest way.

gloss: to feel; to sense; to perceive
definition: to feel; to sense; to perceive
exampleSimplified: 听到这个消息,我感到很高兴。
exampleTraditional: 聽到這個訊息,我感到很高興。
exampleEnglish: Hearing this news, I felt very happy.
hintSimplified: 后面常接心情或身体的感觉,表示心里有了某种体验。
hintTraditional: 後面常接心情或身體的感覺,表示心裡有了某種體驗。
hintEnglish: Often followed by a mood or physical sensation, meaning to experience it.

exampleSimplified: 我们要对帮助过我们的人怀着感恩的心。
exampleTraditional: 我們要對幫助過我們的人懷著感恩的心。
exampleEnglish: We should have grateful hearts toward those who have helped us.
hintSimplified: 记住别人对你的好,心里很感谢。
hintTraditional: 記住別人對你的好,心裡很感謝。
hintEnglish: Remembering others' kindness to you and being thankful in your heart.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷喜欢用钢笔写信。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺喜歡用鋼筆寫信。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa likes to write letters with a fountain pen.
hintSimplified: 一种用墨水写字的笔,笔尖是金属做的。
hintTraditional: 一種用墨水寫字的筆,筆尖是金屬做的。
hintEnglish: A pen that uses ink and has a metal tip.

definition: Hong Kong currency; Hong Kong dollar
exampleSimplified: 我去香港旅行以前,先换了一些港币。
exampleTraditional: 我去香港旅行以前,先換了一些港幣。
exampleEnglish: Before traveling to Hong Kong, I first exchanged some Hong Kong dollars.
hintSimplified: 在香港买东西时使用的钱。
hintTraditional: 在香港買東西時使用的錢。
hintEnglish: The money used when buying things in a certain southern Chinese city-region.

exampleSimplified: 高雄是台湾最大的港口城市。
exampleTraditional: 高雄是台灣最大的港口城市。
exampleEnglish: Kaohsiung is Taiwan's largest port city.
hintSimplified: 大船在海边停靠、装卸货物的地方。
hintTraditional: 大船在海邊停靠、裝卸貨物的地方。
hintEnglish: A place by the sea where large ships dock and load or unload cargo.

definition: thankful; to appreciate; to be grateful
exampleSimplified: 谢谢你在我最困难的时候帮我,我非常感激。
exampleTraditional: 謝謝你在我最困難的時候幫我,我非常感激。
exampleEnglish: Thank you for helping me when I was in the greatest difficulty; I'm very grateful.
hintSimplified: 别人帮了你大忙,你心里充满谢意。
hintTraditional: 別人幫了你大忙,你心裡充滿謝意。
hintEnglish: When someone has helped you greatly, you are full of thanks.

exampleSimplified: 快下雨了,我们赶紧回家吧。
exampleTraditional: 快下雨了,我們趕緊回家吧。
exampleEnglish: It's about to rain; let's hurry home.
hintSimplified: 表示不要浪费时间,马上很快地去做某件事。
hintTraditional: 表示不要浪費時間,馬上很快地去做某件事。
hintEnglish: Means not wasting time and doing something right away and quickly.

definition: what are you doing?; whatever for?; why on earth?
exampleSimplified: 你干嘛一直看着我?
exampleTraditional: 你幹嘛一直看著我?
exampleEnglish: Why do you keep staring at me?
hintSimplified: 口语中用来问别人在做什么,或者为什么这样做。
hintTraditional: 口語中用來問別人在做什麼,或者為什麼這樣做。
hintEnglish: In casual speech, used to ask what someone is doing or why they do something.

definition: affection; feelings between two persons; emotion; sentiment
exampleSimplified: 他们俩的感情很好,从来不吵架。
exampleTraditional: 他們倆的感情很好,從來不吵架。
exampleEnglish: The two of them have a very good relationship and never argue.
hintSimplified: 人与人之间喜欢、爱或关心的心情。
hintTraditional: 人與人之間喜歡、愛或關心的心情。
hintEnglish: The feelings of liking, love or care between people.

exampleSimplified: 他在医院里感染了一种病毒。
exampleTraditional: 他在醫院裡感染了一種病毒。
exampleEnglish: He was infected with a virus at the hospital.
hintSimplified: 病菌进入身体,让人生病;也可指情绪影响别人。
hintTraditional: 病菌進入身體,讓人生病;也可指情緒影響別人。
hintEnglish: When germs enter the body and make you sick; also when a mood spreads to others.

definition: a feeling; an experience; an impression; perception; to experience; to feel (through the senses); to sense
exampleSimplified: 请说一说你对这次旅行的感受。
exampleTraditional: 請說一說你對這次旅行的感受。
exampleEnglish: Please tell us your impressions of this trip.
hintSimplified: 经历一件事以后,你心里的想法和体会。
hintTraditional: 經歷一件事以後,你心裡的想法和體會。
hintEnglish: The thoughts and impressions you have inside after going through something.

gloss: climax (of a story, a competition etc)
definition: climax (of a story, a competition etc); high tide; high water; to have an orgasm; upsurge; peak of activity
exampleSimplified: 这部电影的高潮让观众都紧张极了。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影的高潮讓觀眾都緊張極了。
exampleEnglish: The climax of this movie made the audience extremely tense.
hintSimplified: 故事或比赛里最精彩、最紧张的部分。
hintTraditional: 故事或比賽裡最精彩、最緊張的部分。
hintEnglish: The most exciting and tense part of a story or game.

definition: to say goodbye; to take one's leave
exampleSimplified: 天色已晚,我该告辞了,谢谢您的招待。
exampleTraditional: 天色已晚,我該告辭了,謝謝您的招待。
exampleEnglish: It's late; I should take my leave. Thank you for your hospitality.
hintSimplified: 在别人家做客后,礼貌地向主人说再见离开。
hintTraditional: 在別人家做客後,禮貌地向主人說再見離開。
hintEnglish: Politely saying goodbye to the host and leaving after visiting.

exampleSimplified: 他长得高大,篮球打得很好。
exampleTraditional: 他長得高大,籃球打得很好。
exampleEnglish: He is tall and big, and plays basketball very well.
hintSimplified: 形容人或树、建筑又高又大。
hintTraditional: 形容人或樹、建築又高又大。
hintEnglish: Describes a person, tree or building that is both tall and big.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; altitude; elevation; height; high degree; highly
exampleSimplified: 老师对我们的表现给予了高度的评价。
exampleTraditional: 老師對我們的表現給予了高度的評價。
exampleEnglish: The teacher gave our performance a very high evaluation.
hintSimplified: 表示程度很高;也可以指物体离地面有多高。
hintTraditional: 表示程度很高;也可以指物體離地面有多高。
hintEnglish: Expresses a very high degree; can also mean how far something is above the ground.

exampleSimplified: 早上八点是上班的交通高峰。
exampleTraditional: 早上八點是上班的交通高峰。
exampleEnglish: Eight in the morning is the rush hour for commuting.
hintSimplified: 路上车最多、人最挤的那段时间,或者山最高的地方。
hintTraditional: 路上車最多、人最擠的那段時間,或者山最高的地方。
hintEnglish: The time when roads are most crowded with cars and people, or the highest point of a mountain.

exampleSimplified: 她穿着白色长裙,看起来非常高贵。
exampleTraditional: 她穿著白色長裙,看起來非常高貴。
exampleEnglish: Wearing a long white dress, she looks very noble and elegant.
hintSimplified: 形容人的气质优雅,让人觉得地位很高、很有品味。
hintTraditional: 形容人的氣質優雅,讓人覺得地位很高、很有品味。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose manner is elegant and seems of high status and refined taste.

definition: brilliant; superior; wise; see 高明區|高明区[Gao1 ming2 Qu1]
exampleSimplified: 这位医生的医术很高明。
exampleTraditional: 這位醫生的醫術很高明。
exampleEnglish: This doctor's medical skill is very impressive.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人的技术或想法比别人聪明、厉害。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人的技術或想法比別人聰明、厲害。
hintEnglish: Describes someone whose skill or ideas are smarter and better than others'.

exampleSimplified: 他是我们公司里的电脑高手。
exampleTraditional: 他是我們公司裡的電腦高手。
exampleEnglish: He is the computer expert in our company.
hintSimplified: 在某方面技术特别好、比一般人强很多的人。
hintTraditional: 在某方面技術特別好、比一般人強很多的人。
hintEnglish: A person who is far better than ordinary people at some skill.

exampleSimplified: 青藏高原的空气比较稀薄。
exampleTraditional: 青藏高原的空氣比較稀薄。
exampleEnglish: The air on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau is relatively thin.
hintSimplified: 海拔很高、地面比较平的大片地方。
hintTraditional: 海拔很高、地面比較平的大片地方。
hintEnglish: A large, fairly flat area of land at a very high altitude.

definition: individually; one by one; just one or two; exceptional; rare
exampleSimplified: 只有个别学生没有交作业。
exampleTraditional: 只有個別學生沒有交作業。
exampleEnglish: Only a few individual students did not hand in their homework.
hintSimplified: 表示不是全部,只是很少数的某几个。
hintTraditional: 表示不是全部,只是很少數的某幾個。
hintEnglish: Means not all, just a very small number of particular ones.

exampleSimplified: 孩子们在台上快乐地歌唱。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們在臺上快樂地歌唱。
exampleEnglish: The children are singing happily on the stage.
hintSimplified: 用声音唱出音乐和歌曲。
hintTraditional: 用聲音唱出音樂和歌曲。
hintEnglish: Producing music and songs with one's voice.

exampleSimplified: 我们周末去剧院看了一场歌剧。
exampleTraditional: 我們週末去劇院看了一場歌劇。
exampleEnglish: We went to the theater on the weekend to see an opera.
hintSimplified: 一种舞台表演,演员用唱歌的方式讲故事,有乐队伴奏。
hintTraditional: 一種舞台表演,演員用唱歌的方式講故事,有樂隊伴奏。
hintEnglish: A stage performance where actors tell a story by singing, accompanied by an orchestra.

definition: (not) at all; CL:個|个[ge4]; absolutely (not); basic; fundamental; root; simply
exampleSimplified: 他根本不知道这件事。
exampleTraditional: 他根本不知道這件事。
exampleEnglish: He doesn't know about this at all.
hintSimplified: 常用在否定句里,加强语气,表示完全不是这样。
hintTraditional: 常用在否定句裡,加強語氣,表示完全不是這樣。
hintEnglish: Used in negative sentences to stress that something is not so at all.

exampleSimplified: 这位歌手的声音非常好听。
exampleTraditional: 這位歌手的聲音非常好聽。
exampleEnglish: This singer's voice is very pleasant.
hintSimplified: 以唱歌为工作的人,常开演唱会、出唱片。
hintTraditional: 以唱歌為工作的人,常開演唱會、出唱片。
hintEnglish: A person who sings for a living, often giving concerts and releasing albums.

exampleSimplified: 她的个性很开朗,朋友很多。
exampleTraditional: 她的個性很開朗,朋友很多。
exampleEnglish: She has a cheerful personality and many friends.
hintSimplified: 一个人和别人不一样的特点和脾气。
hintTraditional: 一個人和別人不一樣的特點和脾氣。
hintEnglish: The special traits and temperament that make a person different from others.

exampleSimplified: 吃完饭以后,大家各自回家了。
exampleTraditional: 吃完飯以後,大家各自回家了。
exampleEnglish: After the meal, everyone went home on their own.
hintSimplified: 表示每个人分别做自己的事,不是一起。
hintTraditional: 表示每個人分別做自己的事,不是一起。
hintEnglish: Indicates that each person does their own thing separately, not together.

gloss: to announce; to make public; to publish
definition: to announce; to make public; to publish; variant of 公布[gong1 bu4]
exampleSimplified: 学校明天会公布考试成绩。
exampleTraditional: 學校明天會公布考試成績。
exampleEnglish: The school will announce the exam results tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 把消息正式告诉大家,让所有人都知道。
hintTraditional: 把訊息正式告訴大家,讓所有人都知道。
hintEnglish: To formally tell everyone some news so that all know.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],項|项[xiang4]; an engineering project; engineering; project; undertaking
exampleSimplified: 这个工程要花两年才能完成。
exampleTraditional: 這個工程要花兩年才能完成。
exampleEnglish: This construction project will take two years to complete.
hintSimplified: 盖大楼、修桥或修路这类大型的建设工作。
hintTraditional: 蓋大樓、修橋或修路這類大型的建設工作。
hintEnglish: A large building job such as constructing a tower, bridge or road.

definition: (old) laborer; effort; labor; period of time (may be months, or mere seconds); skill; spare time
exampleSimplified: 我今天没有工夫陪你逛街。
exampleTraditional: 我今天沒有工夫陪你逛街。
exampleEnglish: I don't have the time to go shopping with you today.
hintSimplified: 指做某件事需要的时间,或者空闲的时间。
hintTraditional: 指做某件事需要的時間,或者空閒的時間。
hintEnglish: The time needed for doing something, or free time.

gloss: (old) form of address for a eunuch
definition: (old) form of address for a eunuch; grandpa; grandad; husband's father; father-in-law
exampleSimplified: 我先生的爸爸,我叫他公公。
exampleTraditional: 我先生的爸爸,我叫他公公。
exampleEnglish: My husband's father, I call him gonggong (father-in-law).
hintSimplified: 已婚女人对丈夫的爸爸的称呼。
hintTraditional: 已婚女人對丈夫的爸爸的稱呼。
hintEnglish: What a married woman calls her husband's father.

exampleSimplified: 工会帮工人争取更好的待遇。
exampleTraditional: 工會幫工人爭取更好的待遇。
exampleEnglish: The labor union fights for better treatment for workers.
hintSimplified: 由工人组成、保护工人权利的团体。
hintTraditional: 由工人組成、保護工人權利的團體。
hintEnglish: An organization made up of workers that protects their rights.

definition: open; overt; public; to make public; to release
exampleSimplified: 公司会公开这次活动的名单。
exampleTraditional: 公司會公開這次活動的名單。
exampleEnglish: The company will make the list for this event public.
hintSimplified: 不隐藏,让大家都可以看到或知道。
hintTraditional: 不隱藏,讓大家都可以看到或知道。
hintEnglish: Not hidden; something everyone is allowed to see or know.

exampleSimplified: 他在一所公立学校当老师。
exampleTraditional: 他在一所公立學校當老師。
exampleEnglish: He is a teacher at a public school.
hintSimplified: 由政府设立和管理的,不是私人开的。
hintTraditional: 由政府設立和管理的,不是私人開的。
hintEnglish: Set up and run by the government, not privately owned.

exampleSimplified: 老师给每个学生的机会都很公平。
exampleTraditional: 老師給每個學生的機會都很公平。
exampleEnglish: The teacher gives every student a fair chance.
hintSimplified: 对每个人都一样,没有偏心。
hintTraditional: 對每個人都一樣,沒有偏心。
hintEnglish: Treating everyone the same, with no favoritism.

exampleSimplified: 老板按时付给他一个月的工钱。
exampleTraditional: 老闆按時付給他一個月的工錢。
exampleEnglish: The boss paid him a month's wages on time.
hintSimplified: 做工以后,老板给工人的钱。
hintTraditional: 做工以後,老闆給工人的錢。
hintEnglish: The money a boss pays a worker after the work is done.

exampleSimplified: 数学课上老师教我们一个新公式。
exampleTraditional: 數學課上老師教我們一個新公式。
exampleEnglish: In math class the teacher taught us a new formula.
hintSimplified: 用数字和符号写成的规则,可以拿来算题目。
hintTraditional: 用數字和符號寫成的規則,可以拿來算題目。
hintEnglish: A rule written with numbers and symbols, used to solve problems.

gloss: to supply; to provide (goods, services etc)
definition: to supply; to provide (goods, services etc)
exampleSimplified: 这家工厂供应全国的牛奶。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠供應全國的牛奶。
exampleEnglish: This factory supplies milk to the whole country.
hintSimplified: 把需要的东西或服务持续地提供给别人。
hintTraditional: 把需要的東西或服務持續地提供給別人。
hintEnglish: To continuously provide needed goods or services to others.

exampleSimplified: 这台电脑是公用的,大家都可以用。
exampleTraditional: 這臺電腦是公用的,大家都可以用。
exampleEnglish: This computer is for public use; everyone can use it.
hintSimplified: 不是个人的,是大家一起使用的。
hintTraditional: 不是個人的,是大家一起使用的。
hintEnglish: Not belonging to one person; used by everyone together.

definition: AD (Anno Domini); CE (Common Era); Christian Era
exampleSimplified: 这座古城建于公元前两百年。
exampleTraditional: 這座古城建於公元前兩百年。
exampleEnglish: This ancient city was built in 200 BC.
hintSimplified: 世界上通用的纪年方法,以耶稣出生那年为起点。
hintTraditional: 世界上通用的紀年方法,以耶穌出生那年為起點。
hintEnglish: The year-numbering system used worldwide, counting from the traditional birth year of Jesus.

exampleSimplified: 他每个月的工资都存一部分起来。
exampleTraditional: 他每個月的工資都存一部分起來。
exampleEnglish: He saves part of his wages every month.
hintSimplified: 每个月老板付给员工的钱。
hintTraditional: 每個月老闆付給員工的錢。
hintEnglish: The money a boss pays employees every month.

definition: to compose; to configure (computing); to constitute; to form; to make up
exampleSimplified: 水是由氢和氧构成的。
exampleTraditional: 水是由氫和氧構成的。
exampleEnglish: Water is made up of hydrogen and oxygen.
hintSimplified: 表示几个部分合起来形成一个整体。
hintTraditional: 表示幾個部分合起來形成一個整體。
hintEnglish: Describes several parts coming together to form a whole.

exampleSimplified: 这台机器的内部构造很复杂。
exampleTraditional: 這臺機器的內部構造很複雜。
exampleEnglish: The internal structure of this machine is very complex.
hintSimplified: 指一个东西各部分如何组合和安排。
hintTraditional: 指一個東西各部分如何組合和安排。
hintEnglish: How the parts of something are put together and arranged.

exampleSimplified: 妈妈把饼干放在罐子里。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽把餅乾放在罐子裡。
exampleEnglish: Mom put the cookies in the jar.
hintSimplified: 一种圆圆的容器,有盖子,可以装东西。
hintTraditional: 一種圓圓的容器,有蓋子,可以裝東西。
hintEnglish: A round container with a lid used to hold things.

exampleSimplified: 厨房的水管道坏了,水流不出来。
exampleTraditional: 廚房的水管道壞了,水流不出來。
exampleEnglish: The water pipe in the kitchen is broken, so water won't come out.
hintSimplified: 地下或墙里让水、瓦斯通过的长长的管子。
hintTraditional: 地下或牆裡讓水、瓦斯透過的長長的管子。
hintEnglish: Long tubes in the ground or walls that let water or gas pass through.

definition: government; official (approved or issued by an authority)
exampleSimplified: 这个消息是官方公布的。
exampleTraditional: 這個訊息是官方公佈的。
exampleEnglish: This news was announced officially.
hintSimplified: 代表政府或正式机构,不是个人的说法。
hintTraditional: 代表政府或正式機構,不是個人的說法。
hintEnglish: Representing the government or an institution, not an individual.

definition: (of an area) vast or extensive; (of people) numerous; large-scale; widespread
exampleSimplified: 广大的民众都支持这个活动。
exampleTraditional: 廣大的民眾都支援這個活動。
exampleEnglish: The broad public supports this event.
hintSimplified: 形容范围很大,或人数非常多。
hintTraditional: 形容範圍很大,或人數非常多。
hintEnglish: Describes a very large scope or a huge number of people.

exampleSimplified: 这种手机在年轻人中被广泛使用。
exampleTraditional: 這種手機在年輕人中被廣泛使用。
exampleEnglish: This kind of phone is widely used among young people.
hintSimplified: 形容涉及的范围很大,到处都有。
hintTraditional: 形容涉及的範圍很大,到處都有。
hintEnglish: Describes something covering a large range, found everywhere.

exampleSimplified: 站在山顶,可以看到广阔的海面。
exampleTraditional: 站在山頂,可以看到廣闊的海面。
exampleEnglish: Standing on the mountaintop, you can see the vast sea.
hintSimplified: 形容草原、海洋或天空又大又开阔。
hintTraditional: 形容草原、海洋或天空又大又開闊。
hintEnglish: Describes a grassland, ocean or sky that is big and open.

exampleSimplified: 他把皮鞋擦得光亮光亮的。
exampleTraditional: 他把皮鞋擦得光亮光亮的。
exampleEnglish: He polished his leather shoes until they were shiny.
hintSimplified: 形容东西表面干净、会反光。
hintTraditional: 形容東西表面乾淨、會反光。
hintEnglish: Describes a surface that is clean and reflects light.

definition: (formal) to honor with one's presence; to attend
exampleSimplified: 欢迎光临,请问几位?
exampleTraditional: 歡迎光臨,請問幾位?
exampleEnglish: Welcome! How many people, please?
hintSimplified: 店员对走进店里的客人常说的客气话。
hintTraditional: 店員對走進店裡的客人常說的客氣話。
hintEnglish: A polite phrase shop staff say to customers who walk in.

exampleSimplified: 只要努力,你的未来一定很光明。
exampleTraditional: 只要努力,你的未來一定很光明。
exampleEnglish: As long as you work hard, your future will surely be bright.
hintSimplified: 形容前途充满希望,也可以指有亮光。
hintTraditional: 形容前途充滿希望,也可以指有亮光。
hintEnglish: Describes a future full of hope; also means full of light.

exampleSimplified: 能代表学校比赛,我觉得很光荣。
exampleTraditional: 能代表學校比賽,我覺得很光榮。
exampleEnglish: I feel it's an honor to represent the school in the competition.
hintSimplified: 做了值得骄傲的事,得到大家尊敬的感觉。
hintTraditional: 做了值得驕傲的事,得到大家尊敬的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling of doing something to be proud of and being respected.

exampleSimplified: 光是买机票就花了一万块。
exampleTraditional: 光是買機票就花了一萬塊。
exampleEnglish: Just buying the plane tickets cost ten thousand dollars.
hintSimplified: 用来强调只算一项,就已经很多了。
hintTraditional: 用來強調只算一項,就已經很多了。
hintEnglish: Used to stress that counting just one item is already a lot.

exampleSimplified: 很多外国人来台湾观光。
exampleTraditional: 很多外國人來台灣觀光。
exampleEnglish: Many foreigners come to Taiwan for sightseeing.
hintSimplified: 到别的地方参观有名的风景。
hintTraditional: 到別的地方參觀有名的風景。
hintEnglish: Visiting famous scenery in another place.

definition: CL:條|条[tiao2],道[dao4]; illumination; light; light ray; lighting (for a photograph)
exampleSimplified: 这个房间的光线很好。
exampleTraditional: 這個房間的光線很好。
exampleEnglish: The lighting in this room is very good.
hintSimplified: 从太阳或灯来的,让我们看见东西的东西。
hintTraditional: 從太陽或燈來的,讓我們看見東西的東西。
hintEnglish: What comes from the sun or a lamp and lets us see things.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; crucial; crucial point; crux; key; pivotal
exampleSimplified: 这次考试的关键是认真复习。
exampleTraditional: 這次考試的關鍵是認真複習。
exampleEnglish: The key to this exam is reviewing carefully.
hintSimplified: 指事情成功或失败最重要的部分。
hintTraditional: 指事情成功或失敗最重要的部分。
hintEnglish: The most important part deciding success or failure.

exampleSimplified: 他在比赛中拿到了冠军。
exampleTraditional: 他在比賽中拿到了冠軍。
exampleEnglish: He won the championship in the competition.
hintSimplified: 比赛中的第一名。
hintTraditional: 比賽中的第一名。
hintEnglish: The person who comes first in a competition.

exampleSimplified: 按照惯例,新年大家会回家吃团圆饭。
exampleTraditional: 按照慣例,新年大家會回家吃團圓飯。
exampleEnglish: By convention, everyone goes home for a reunion dinner at New Year.
hintSimplified: 大家长期一直这样做的做法或规矩。
hintTraditional: 大家長期一直這樣做的做法或規矩。
hintEnglish: A practice or rule people have long followed.

definition: to close (a door); to turn off (light, electrical equipment etc)
exampleSimplified: 出门前请把门关上。
exampleTraditional: 出門前請把門關上。
exampleEnglish: Please close the door before going out.
hintSimplified: 把门或窗户合起来的动作。
hintTraditional: 把門或窗戶合起來的動作。
hintEnglish: The action of shutting a door or window.

exampleSimplified: 我家里常备几个罐头,以防万一。
exampleTraditional: 我家裡常備幾個罐頭,以防萬一。
exampleEnglish: I keep a few cans of food at home just in case.
hintSimplified: 装在金属盒里、可以放很久的食物。
hintTraditional: 裝在金屬盒裡、可以放很久的食物。
hintEnglish: Food sealed in a metal container that keeps for a long time.

definition: a matter of; about; concerning; pertaining to; with regard to
exampleSimplified: 关于这个问题,我们明天再讨论。
exampleTraditional: 關於這個問題,我們明天再討論。
exampleEnglish: Regarding this problem, let's discuss it tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 用来引出话题或讨论的内容。
hintTraditional: 用來引出話題或討論的內容。
hintEnglish: Used to introduce the topic being talked about.

definition: administrator; official (in an organization or government)
exampleSimplified: 那位官员在会议上发表了谈话。
exampleTraditional: 那位官員在會議上發表了談話。
exampleEnglish: That official gave a speech at the meeting.
hintSimplified: 在政府机关工作、有职位的人。
hintTraditional: 在政府機關工作、有職位的人。
hintEnglish: A person with a position working in a government agency.

gloss: (PRC law) non-custodial sentence with specified restrictions on one's activities for up to 3 years (e.g. not to participate in demonstrations)
definition: (PRC law) non-custodial sentence with specified restrictions on one's activities for up to 3 years (e.g. not to participate in demonstrations); to control; to restrict
exampleSimplified: 因为台风,这条路暂时交通管制。
exampleTraditional: 因為颱風,這條路暫時交通管制。
exampleEnglish: Because of the typhoon, traffic on this road is temporarily controlled.
hintSimplified: 政府或单位用规定限制人或车的活动。
hintTraditional: 政府或單位用規定限制人或車的活動。
hintEnglish: When authorities restrict the movement of people or vehicles.

definition: melon seed; seeds of pumpkin, watermelon or sunflower etc, roasted and flavored, consumed as a snack
exampleSimplified: 他一边看电视一边嗑瓜子。
exampleTraditional: 他一邊看電視一邊嗑瓜子。
exampleEnglish: He cracks open sunflower seeds while watching TV.
hintSimplified: 一种小小的零食,要用牙齿咬开壳来吃。
hintTraditional: 一種小小的零食,要用牙齒咬開殼來吃。
hintEnglish: A small snack whose shell you crack open with your teeth.

exampleSimplified: 他一个人住在国外,常常觉得很孤单。
exampleTraditional: 他一個人住在國外,常常覺得很孤單。
exampleEnglish: He lives abroad alone and often feels very lonely.
hintSimplified: 身边没有朋友或家人陪伴时,心里会有的感觉。
hintTraditional: 身邊沒有朋友或家人陪伴時,心裡會有的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling you have when no friends or family are around you.

exampleSimplified: 我喜欢听古典音乐,这样可以放松心情。
exampleTraditional: 我喜歡聽古典音樂,這樣可以放鬆心情。
exampleEnglish: I like listening to classical music; it helps me relax.
hintSimplified: 形容很久以前流传下来、很有传统价值的音乐或文学。
hintTraditional: 形容很久以前流傳下來、很有傳統價值的音樂或文學。
hintEnglish: Describes music or literature handed down from long ago with lasting traditional value.

definition: fixed; regular; set; to fasten; to fix; to set rigidly in place
exampleSimplified: 他每个星期六都有固定的运动时间。
exampleTraditional: 他每個星期六都有固定的運動時間。
exampleEnglish: He has a set time for exercise every Saturday.
hintSimplified: 形容不会随便改变,总是一样的。
hintTraditional: 形容不會隨便改變,總是一樣的。
hintEnglish: Describes something that doesn't change easily and stays the same.

definition: regulations; rules; provisions; stipulations; to stipulate; to specify; to prescribe; to fix (a price); to set (a quota)
exampleSimplified: 学校规定上课时不能使用手机。
exampleTraditional: 學校規定上課時不能使用手機。
exampleEnglish: The school stipulates that phones can't be used during class.
hintSimplified: 学校或公司用来告诉大家可以做什么、不可以做什么的话。
hintTraditional: 學校或公司用來告訴大家可以做什麼、不可以做什麼的話。
hintEnglish: What a school or company sets down to say what is and isn't allowed.

exclusionReason: Simplified form is not recognized by the dictionary

definition: to accord with; to conform to
exampleSimplified: 这个价格合乎我的预算。
exampleTraditional: 這個價格合乎我的預算。
exampleEnglish: This price fits my budget.
hintSimplified: 表示符合某种要求、标准或规定。
hintTraditional: 表示符合某種要求、標準或規定。
hintEnglish: Means to match a certain requirement, standard or rule.

exampleSimplified: 停电以后,整个房间一片黑暗。
exampleTraditional: 停電以後,整個房間一片黑暗。
exampleEnglish: After the power went out, the whole room was pitch dark.
hintSimplified: 没有光线,什么都看不见的样子。
hintTraditional: 沒有光線,什麼都看不見的樣子。
hintEnglish: The state of having no light, where you can't see anything.

exampleSimplified: 黑夜里,星星显得特别亮。
exampleTraditional: 黑夜裡,星星顯得特別亮。
exampleEnglish: In the dark of night, the stars look especially bright.
hintSimplified: 太阳下山以后,天空很暗的那段时间。
hintTraditional: 太陽下山以後,天空很暗的那段時間。
hintEnglish: The dark period after the sun goes down.

definition: besides; let alone; to say nothing of; what's more
exampleSimplified: 这道题老师都不会,何况是学生呢?
exampleTraditional: 這道題老師都不會,何況是學生呢?
exampleEnglish: Even the teacher can't do this problem, let alone the students.
hintSimplified: 用在句子里,表示前面的情况都这样,更进一步的情况当然更是如此。
hintTraditional: 用在句子裡,表示前面的情況都這樣,更進一步的情況當然更是如此。
hintEnglish: Used to say that if the first case is so, a further case is even more so.

exampleSimplified: 老板的要求很合理,大家都同意。
exampleTraditional: 老闆的要求很合理,大家都同意。
exampleEnglish: The boss's request is very reasonable, and everyone agrees.
hintSimplified: 说一件事符合道理,让人觉得公平、说得通。
hintTraditional: 說一件事符合道理,讓人覺得公平、說得通。
hintEnglish: Describes something that makes sense and seems fair.

exampleSimplified: 这条河流从山里流到海边。
exampleTraditional: 這條河流從山裡流到海邊。
exampleEnglish: This river flows from the mountains to the sea.
hintSimplified: 水从高处流向大海的一条长长的自然水道。
hintTraditional: 水從高處流向大海的一條長長的自然水道。
hintEnglish: A long natural channel of water flowing toward the sea.

exampleSimplified: 墙上还留着小孩画画的痕迹。
exampleTraditional: 牆上還留著小孩畫畫的痕跡。
exampleEnglish: There are still traces of the child's drawing on the wall.
hintSimplified: 事情发生后留下来的印子或线索。
hintTraditional: 事情發生後留下來的印子或線索。
hintEnglish: Marks or clues left behind after something happened.

exampleSimplified: 人们都希望世界永远和平。
exampleTraditional: 人們都希望世界永遠和平。
exampleEnglish: Everyone hopes the world will be at peace forever.
hintSimplified: 国家与国家之间没有战争的状态。
hintTraditional: 國家與國家之間沒有戰爭的狀態。
hintEnglish: The state in which there is no war between countries.

exampleSimplified: 王老板对客人总是和和气气的。
exampleTraditional: 王老闆對客人總是和和氣氣的。
exampleEnglish: Boss Wang is always friendly and polite to customers.
hintSimplified: 形容人态度温和,不容易生气,让人觉得好相处。
hintTraditional: 形容人態度溫和,不容易生氣,讓人覺得好相處。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is gentle, easygoing and pleasant to deal with.

definition: to be a bargain; to be a good deal; to calculate; to reckon up; worthwhile
exampleSimplified: 这个套餐很便宜,买起来很合算。
exampleTraditional: 這個套餐很便宜,買起來很合算。
exampleEnglish: This set meal is cheap, so it's a good deal.
hintSimplified: 花的钱不多,却得到很多,觉得很划得来。
hintTraditional: 花的錢不多,卻得到很多,覺得很划得來。
hintEnglish: You spend little but get a lot, so it feels worthwhile.

exampleSimplified: 我们下个月要和公司签合约。
exampleTraditional: 我們下個月要和公司籤合約。
exampleEnglish: We will sign a contract with the company next month.
hintSimplified: 双方同意并签名的书面文件,写着各自要做的事。
hintTraditional: 雙方同意並簽名的書面檔案,寫著各自要做的事。
hintEnglish: A written document signed by both sides stating what each will do.

exampleSimplified: 动物园里的猴子喜欢吃香蕉。
exampleTraditional: 動物園裡的猴子喜歡吃香蕉。
exampleEnglish: The monkeys at the zoo like to eat bananas.
hintSimplified: 会爬树、很灵活的动物,长得有点像人。
hintTraditional: 會爬樹、很靈活的動物,長得有點像人。
hintEnglish: An agile, tree-climbing animal that looks a bit like humans.

definition: descendant; progeny; posterity; later ages; later generations
exampleSimplified: 他希望把这些传统留给后代。
exampleTraditional: 他希望把這些傳統留給後代。
exampleEnglish: He hopes to pass these traditions on to future generations.
hintSimplified: 一个人以后生下来的子孙们。
hintTraditional: 一個人以後生下來的子孫們。
hintEnglish: The children and grandchildren born later in a family line.

definition: far behind the front line; the rear
exampleSimplified: 医院和物资都在后方,很安全。
exampleTraditional: 醫院和物資都在後方,很安全。
exampleEnglish: The hospital and supplies are in the rear area, which is safe.
hintSimplified: 离前线很远、比较安全的地方;也可以指后面的方向。
hintTraditional: 離前線很遠、比較安全的地方;也可以指後面的方向。
hintEnglish: A place far from the front line and safer; also the area behind.

exampleSimplified: 不写作业的后果,你要自己负责。
exampleTraditional: 不寫作業的後果,你要自己負責。
exampleEnglish: You must take responsibility for the consequences of not doing your homework.
hintSimplified: 某件事做完以后,最后带来的结果,常常不太好。
hintTraditional: 某件事做完以後,最後帶來的結果,常常不太好。
hintEnglish: The result that follows an action, often a bad one.

exampleSimplified: 我很后悔昨天没有去参加聚会。
exampleTraditional: 我很後悔昨天沒有去參加聚會。
exampleEnglish: I really regret not going to the party yesterday.
hintSimplified: 做错事或没做某事之后,心里觉得想重来一次。
hintTraditional: 做錯事或沒做某事之後,心裡覺得想重來一次。
hintEnglish: The feeling after doing wrong or missing something, wishing you could redo it.

exampleSimplified: 我感冒了,喉咙又痛又干。
exampleTraditional: 我感冒了,喉嚨又痛又幹。
exampleEnglish: I have a cold, and my throat is sore and dry.
hintSimplified: 身体里嘴巴后面,吞东西和说话都要经过的地方。
hintTraditional: 身體裡嘴巴後面,吞東西和說話都要經過的地方。
hintEnglish: The part of the body behind the mouth that food and voice pass through.

definition: (in) the future; afterwards; behind; later; the back; the rear
exampleSimplified: 他走在前面,我们跟在后头。
exampleTraditional: 他走在前面,我們跟在後頭。
exampleEnglish: He walked in front while we followed behind.
hintSimplified: 表示在某个东西或人的背面或后面的位置。
hintTraditional: 表示在某個東西或人的背面或後面的位置。
hintEnglish: Indicates the position at the back of or behind something or someone.

gloss: to recoil; to draw back; to fall back; to retreat
definition: to recoil; to draw back; to fall back; to retreat
exampleSimplified: 前面有危险,请大家往后退。
exampleTraditional: 前面有危險,請大家往後退。
exampleEnglish: There is danger ahead; everyone please step back.
hintSimplified: 身体或车子向后面的方向移动。
hintTraditional: 身體或車子向後面的方向移動。
hintEnglish: To move your body or a vehicle toward the back.

definition: back garden; backyard (also fig.); rear court
exampleSimplified: 奶奶在后院种了很多青菜。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶在後院種了很多青菜。
exampleEnglish: Grandma grows lots of vegetables in the backyard.
hintSimplified: 房子后面的一块空地,常常可以种花或晒衣服。
hintTraditional: 房子後面的一塊空地,常常可以種花或曬衣服。
hintEnglish: An open area behind a house, often for plants or drying clothes.

definition: (coll.) bandit; CL:撮[zuo3],根[gen1]; beard; facial hair; mustache or whiskers
exampleSimplified: 爷爷留了一脸白胡子。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺留了一臉白鬍子。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa has grown a full white beard.
hintSimplified: 男人嘴巴周围或下巴上长出来的毛。
hintTraditional: 男人嘴巴周圍或下巴上長出來的毛。
hintEnglish: Hair that grows around a man's mouth and chin.

exampleSimplified: 爸爸每个周末都会照顾院子里的花草。
exampleTraditional: 爸爸每個週末都會照顧院子裡的花草。
exampleEnglish: Dad takes care of the flowers and plants in the yard every weekend.
hintSimplified: 院子或公园里常见的、绿色的小植物和美丽的植物。
hintTraditional: 院子或公園裡常見的、綠色的小植物和美麗的植物。
hintEnglish: Small green plants and pretty blossoms commonly seen in yards or parks.

definition: cost; expenditure; expense; to spend (time or money)
exampleSimplified: 这次旅行的花费比我想的还要多。
exampleTraditional: 這次旅行的花費比我想的還要多。
exampleEnglish: The cost of this trip was more than I expected.
hintSimplified: 做一件事所用掉的钱或时间。
hintTraditional: 做一件事所用掉的錢或時間。
hintEnglish: The money or time used up in doing something.

exampleSimplified: 那个坏蛋偷了老人的钱包。
exampleTraditional: 那個壞蛋偷了老人的錢包。
exampleEnglish: That scoundrel stole the old man's wallet.
hintSimplified: 骂那些做坏事、让人讨厌的人时可以这样叫他。
hintTraditional: 罵那些做壞事、讓人討厭的人時可以這樣叫他。
hintEnglish: A word for scolding someone who does bad things and is disliked.

definition: to cherish the memory of; to reminisce; to think of
exampleSimplified: 我很怀念小时候在乡下的生活。
exampleTraditional: 我很懷念小時候在鄉下的生活。
exampleEnglish: I really miss my childhood life in the countryside.
hintSimplified: 对过去的人或事一直记在心里，希望能再回到那时候。
hintTraditional: 對過去的人或事一直記在心裡，希望能再回到那時候。
hintEnglish: Keeping past people or times in your heart, wishing to return to them.

gloss: to doubt (sth); to be skeptical of
definition: to doubt (sth); to be skeptical of; to have one's doubts; to harbor suspicions; to suspect that
exampleSimplified: 我怀疑他没有说实话。
exampleTraditional: 我懷疑他沒有說實話。
exampleEnglish: I suspect he didn't tell the truth.
hintSimplified: 不太相信某件事是真的，心里有问号。
hintTraditional: 不太相信某件事是真的，心裡有問號。
hintEnglish: Not quite believing something is true; having a question mark in your mind.

definition: gestation; pregnancy; pregnant; to have conceived
exampleSimplified: 她怀孕五个月了，走路要小心。
exampleTraditional: 她懷孕五個月了，走路要小心。
exampleEnglish: She is five months pregnant and must walk carefully.
hintSimplified: 女人肚子里有了小宝宝。
hintTraditional: 女人肚子裡有了小寶寶。
hintEnglish: When a woman has a baby growing in her belly.

definition: (motion picture) frame; field of view; image; picture; scene; screen (displayed by a computer); tableau
exampleSimplified: 这部电影的画面非常漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影的畫面非常漂亮。
exampleEnglish: The visuals of this movie are very beautiful.
hintSimplified: 在电影或屏幕上看到的景象。
hintTraditional: 在電影或螢幕上看到的景象。
hintEnglish: What you see on a movie or a screen.

exampleSimplified: 古代的皇帝住在很大的宫殿里。
exampleTraditional: 古代的皇帝住在很大的宮殿裡。
exampleEnglish: In ancient times, the emperor lived in a huge palace.
hintSimplified: 古代统治整个国家的最高的人。
hintTraditional: 古代統治整個國家的最高的人。
hintEnglish: The supreme ruler of a whole country in ancient times.

exampleSimplified: 早上我喜欢喝一杯热黄豆浆。
exampleTraditional: 早上我喜歡喝一杯熱黃豆漿。
exampleEnglish: In the morning I like to drink a cup of hot soy milk.
hintSimplified: 一种黄色的小豆子，可以做成豆浆和豆腐。
hintTraditional: 一種黃色的小豆子，可以做成豆漿和豆腐。
hintEnglish: A small yellow bean used to make soy milk and tofu.

exampleSimplified: 黄昏的时候，天空变成了橘红色。
exampleTraditional: 黃昏的時候，天空變成了橘紅色。
exampleEnglish: At dusk, the sky turned orange-red.
hintSimplified: 太阳快要下山、天快黑的时候。
hintTraditional: 太陽快要下山、天快黑的時候。
hintEnglish: The time when the sun is about to set and it is getting dark.

definition: to allay; to alleviate; to ease (tension); to make more mild; to moderate
exampleSimplified: 听了他的话，紧张的气氛缓和了一些。
exampleTraditional: 聽了他的話，緊張的氣氛緩和了一些。
exampleEnglish: After hearing his words, the tense atmosphere eased a bit.
hintSimplified: 让紧张或严重的情况变得比较轻松。
hintTraditional: 讓緊張或嚴重的情況變得比較輕鬆。
hintEnglish: To make a tense or serious situation more relaxed.

exampleSimplified: 球赢了以后，大家一起欢呼起来。
exampleTraditional: 球贏了以後，大家一起歡呼起來。
exampleEnglish: After winning the game, everyone cheered together.
hintSimplified: 高兴的时候，大声叫喊来表示开心。
hintTraditional: 高興的時候，大聲叫喊來表示開心。
hintEnglish: Shouting loudly to show joy when happy.

definition: gaiety; gay; gladness; glee; happy; joyous; merriment; pleasure
exampleSimplified: 孩子们的笑声带来了很多欢乐。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們的笑聲帶來了很多歡樂。
exampleEnglish: The children's laughter brought a lot of joy.
hintSimplified: 形容很开心、很热闹的心情或气氛。
hintTraditional: 形容很開心、很熱鬧的心情或氣氛。
hintEnglish: Describes a very happy and lively mood or atmosphere.

exampleSimplified: 这条河的水流得很缓慢。
exampleTraditional: 這條河的水流得很緩慢。
exampleEnglish: The water in this river flows very slowly.
hintSimplified: 形容速度不快，一点也不着急。
hintTraditional: 形容速度不快，一點也不著急。
hintEnglish: Describes a speed that is not fast and not hurried at all.

definition: delighted; happy; joyous; to be fond of; to like
exampleSimplified: 收到礼物，她心里满是欢喜。
exampleTraditional: 收到禮物，她心裡滿是歡喜。
exampleEnglish: Receiving the gift, her heart was full of delight.
hintSimplified: 心里非常高兴、满意的样子。
hintTraditional: 心裡非常高興、滿意的樣子。
hintEnglish: Feeling very happy and pleased inside.

definition: an illusion; a fantasy; to fantasize; to imagine
exampleSimplified: 他常常幻想自己是一个大明星。
exampleTraditional: 他常常幻想自己是一個大明星。
exampleEnglish: He often fantasizes that he is a big star.
hintSimplified: 想一些不真实、很难实现的美好事情。
hintTraditional: 想一些不真實、很難實現的美好事情。
hintEnglish: Thinking about wonderful things that are unreal and hard to achieve.

exampleSimplified: 阳台上有三个花盆，种着小花。
exampleTraditional: 陽臺上有三個花盆，種著小花。
exampleEnglish: There are three flowerpots on the balcony with small flowers planted.
hintSimplified: 装着泥土，用来种植物的容器。
hintTraditional: 裝著泥土，用來種植物的容器。
hintEnglish: A container filled with soil for growing plants.

gloss: (fig.) female employee considered to be just a pretty face (attractive but not very competent)
definition: (fig.) female employee considered to be just a pretty face (attractive but not very competent); flower vase
exampleSimplified: 桌上的花瓶里插着几朵玫瑰。
exampleTraditional: 桌上的花瓶裡插著幾朵玫瑰。
exampleEnglish: A few roses are in the vase on the table.
hintSimplified: 可以装水，把剪下来的花放进去的东西。
hintTraditional: 可以裝水，把剪下來的花放進去的東西。
hintEnglish: A thing that holds water for putting cut flowers in.

gloss: (in a restricted sense) Chinese emigrant who still retains Chinese nationality
definition: (in a restricted sense) Chinese emigrant who still retains Chinese nationality; CL:個|个[ge4],位[wei4],名[ming2]; overseas Chinese
exampleSimplified: 这位华侨已经在国外住了三十年。
exampleTraditional: 這位華僑已經在國外住了三十年。
exampleEnglish: This overseas Chinese has lived abroad for thirty years.
hintSimplified: 住在外国，但还是拥有中国国籍的人。
hintTraditional: 住在外國，但還是擁有中國國籍的人。
hintEnglish: A person living in a foreign country but still holding Chinese nationality.

exampleSimplified: 世界各地都有华人社区。
exampleTraditional: 世界各地都有華人社群。
exampleEnglish: There are ethnic Chinese communities all over the world.
hintSimplified: 有中国血统的人，不一定住在中国。
hintTraditional: 有中國血統的人，不一定住在中國。
hintEnglish: People of Chinese ancestry, not necessarily living in China.

exampleSimplified: 这种布有很多不同的花色可以选择。
exampleTraditional: 這種布有很多不同的花色可以選擇。
exampleEnglish: This cloth comes in many different patterns to choose from.
hintSimplified: 布或东西上面的图案和颜色。
hintTraditional: 布或東西上面的圖案和顏色。
hintEnglish: The patterns and colors on cloth or items.

exampleSimplified: 我对花生过敏，不能吃这道菜。
exampleTraditional: 我對花生過敏，不能吃這道菜。
exampleEnglish: I'm allergic to peanuts and can't eat this dish.
hintSimplified: 一种长在土里、有硬壳的小坚果，常用来做零食。
hintTraditional: 一種長在土裡、有硬殼的小堅果，常用來做零食。
hintEnglish: A small nut with a hard shell that grows underground, often a snack.

exampleSimplified: 他在大学里学化学，以后想当研究员。
exampleTraditional: 他在大學裡學化學，以後想當研究員。
exampleEnglish: He studies chemistry at university and wants to be a researcher.
hintSimplified: 研究物质如何变化的学科，常常在实验室里做实验。
hintTraditional: 研究物質如何變化的學科，常常在實驗室裡做實驗。
hintEnglish: A subject studying how substances change, often experiments in a lab.

exampleSimplified: 她每天出门前都要化妆。
exampleTraditional: 她每天出門前都要化妝。
exampleEnglish: She puts on makeup every day before going out.
hintSimplified: 用口红、粉底等东西让脸看起来更漂亮。
hintTraditional: 用口紅、粉底等東西讓臉看起來更漂亮。
hintEnglish: Using lipstick, foundation, etc. to make your face look prettier.

definition: (of actors) to make up; to disguise oneself
exampleSimplified: 万圣节时，孩子们化装成小鬼出门玩。
exampleTraditional: 萬聖節時，孩子們化裝成小鬼出門玩。
exampleEnglish: At Halloween, children dress up as ghosts and go out to play.
hintSimplified: 为了扮演别的人或角色而改变自己的样子。
hintTraditional: 為了扮演別的人或角色而改變自己的樣子。
hintEnglish: Changing your appearance to play another person or character.

exampleSimplified: 一只美丽的蝴蝶停在花上。
exampleTraditional: 一隻美麗的蝴蝶停在花上。
exampleEnglish: A beautiful butterfly rested on the flower.
hintSimplified: 有两对漂亮翅膀的小昆虫，常在花园里飞。
hintTraditional: 有兩對漂亮翅膀的小昆蟲，常在花園裡飛。
hintEnglish: A small insect with colorful wings that flies around gardens.

exampleSimplified: 老师和学生在课堂上有很多互动。
exampleTraditional: 老師和學生在課堂上有很多互動。
exampleEnglish: The teacher and students have a lot of interaction in class.
hintSimplified: 双方互相交流、互相影响。
hintTraditional: 雙方互相交流、互相影響。
hintEnglish: Both sides communicate with and influence each other.

definition: a reply telegram; a return call; to call sb back (on the phone); to reply to a telegram; to wire back
exampleSimplified: 我现在有事,晚一点再给你回电。
exampleTraditional: 我現在有事,晚一點再給你回電。
exampleEnglish: I'm busy now; I'll call you back a bit later.
hintSimplified: 别人打电话给你但你没接,你之后打过去。
hintTraditional: 別人打電話給你但你沒接,你之後打過去。
hintEnglish: Someone called you but you missed it, so you call them afterwards.

exampleSimplified: 他是回教徒,所以不吃猪肉。
exampleTraditional: 他是回教徒,所以不吃豬肉。
exampleEnglish: He is a Muslim, so he doesn't eat pork.
hintSimplified: 一种世界宗教,信徒在清真寺祈祷,信仰真主。
hintTraditional: 一種世界宗教,信徒在清真寺祈禱,信仰真主。
hintEnglish: A world religion whose followers pray in mosques and believe in Allah.

exampleSimplified: 我每个月都会向银行汇款给家人。
exampleTraditional: 我每個月都會向銀行匯款給家人。
exampleEnglish: Every month I send money to my family through the bank.
hintSimplified: 通过银行把钱转给别的地方的人。
hintTraditional: 透過銀行把錢轉給別的地方的人。
hintEnglish: Sending money through a bank to someone elsewhere.

definition: ambiguous; ash gray; dispirited; gloomy; gray; grizzly; pessimistic
exampleSimplified: 他今天穿了一件灰色的外套。
exampleTraditional: 他今天穿了一件灰色的外套。
exampleEnglish: He is wearing a gray jacket today.
hintSimplified: 介于黑色和白色之间的颜色,像阴天的云。
hintTraditional: 介於黑色和白色之間的顏色,像陰天的雲。
hintEnglish: A color between black and white, like cloudy skies.

definition: to recall (a defective product); to reclaim; to recover; to recycle; to retrieve
exampleSimplified: 这些旧报纸和瓶子可以拿去回收。
exampleTraditional: 這些舊報紙和瓶子可以拿去回收。
exampleEnglish: These old newspapers and bottles can be taken to be recycled.
hintSimplified: 把用过的纸、瓶子收集起来,再拿去利用。
hintTraditional: 把用過的紙、瓶子收集起來,再拿去利用。
hintEnglish: Collecting used paper and bottles so they can be reused.

definition: later; by and by; to turn round; to turn one's head
exampleSimplified: 我现在很忙,回头再跟你联络。
exampleTraditional: 我現在很忙,回頭再跟你聯絡。
exampleEnglish: I'm busy now; I'll get in touch with you later.
hintSimplified: 表示不是现在,而是过一会儿或以后再做某事。
hintTraditional: 表示不是現在,而是過一會兒或以後再做某事。
hintEnglish: Means not now, but a little while later you will do something.

definition: to be discouraged; to lose heart
exampleSimplified: 考试没通过,但你不要灰心,再试一次。
exampleTraditional: 考試沒透過,但你不要灰心,再試一次。
exampleEnglish: You failed the exam, but don't lose heart; try again.
hintSimplified: 遇到失败后觉得没有信心,想要放弃。
hintTraditional: 遇到失敗後覺得沒有信心,想要放棄。
hintEnglish: After a failure, feeling you lack confidence and want to give up.

exampleSimplified: 这张老照片让我想起许多童年的回忆。
exampleTraditional: 這張老照片讓我想起許多童年的回憶。
exampleEnglish: This old photo brings back many childhood memories.
hintSimplified: 想起过去发生的事情,或那些留在脑中的往事。
hintTraditional: 想起過去發生的事情,或那些留在腦中的往事。
hintEnglish: Thinking back on past events, or those past things kept in your mind.

exampleSimplified: 成为会员以后,买东西可以打九折。
exampleTraditional: 成為會員以後,買東西可以打九折。
exampleEnglish: After becoming a member, you can get 10% off your purchases.
hintSimplified: 加入俱乐部或商店后,你就有这种身份和优惠。
hintTraditional: 加入俱樂部或商店後,你就有這種身份和優惠。
hintEnglish: The status and discounts you get after joining a club or store.

gloss: to neglect; to overlook; to ignore
definition: to neglect; to overlook; to ignore
exampleSimplified: 我们不能忽略这个小问题。
exampleTraditional: 我們不能忽略這個小問題。
exampleEnglish: We can't overlook this small problem.
hintSimplified: 没有注意到,或没有把某件事放在心上。
hintTraditional: 沒有注意到,或沒有把某件事放在心上。
hintEnglish: Not noticing something, or not taking it to heart.

exampleSimplified: 天气太热,他在路上昏倒了。
exampleTraditional: 天氣太熱,他在路上昏倒了。
exampleEnglish: The weather was too hot, and he fainted on the road.
hintSimplified: 突然失去意识,身体倒在地上。
hintTraditional: 突然失去意識,身體倒在地上。
hintEnglish: Suddenly losing consciousness and falling to the ground.

definition: hybrid; composite; to mix; to blend
exampleSimplified: 把红色和黄色混合,就会变成橙色。
exampleTraditional: 把紅色和黃色混合,就會變成橙色。
exampleEnglish: Mix red and yellow and you get orange.
hintSimplified: 把两种或多种东西放在一起,弄在一起。
hintTraditional: 把兩種或多種東西放在一起,弄在一起。
hintEnglish: Putting two or more things together so they become one.

definition: coma; disoriented; stunned; stupor; to be in a coma; to lose consciousness
exampleSimplified: 他出车祸后昏迷了三天才醒来。
exampleTraditional: 他出車禍後昏迷了三天才醒來。
exampleEnglish: After the car accident he was unconscious for three days before waking.
hintSimplified: 病人长时间失去意识,叫也叫不醒。
hintTraditional: 病人長時間失去意識,叫也叫不醒。
hintEnglish: A patient is unconscious for a long time and cannot be woken.

exampleSimplified: 没有打火机的话,可以用火柴点蜡烛。
exampleTraditional: 沒有打火機的話,可以用火柴點蠟燭。
exampleEnglish: If you have no lighter, you can light the candle with a match.
hintSimplified: 一根小木棒,在盒子边上一擦就能点火。
hintTraditional: 一根小木棒,在盒子邊上一擦就能點火。
hintEnglish: A small stick that lights when struck on the side of a box.

gloss: to obtain; to receive; to get
definition: to obtain; to receive; to get
exampleSimplified: 她在比赛中获得了第一名。
exampleTraditional: 她在比賽中獲得了第一名。
exampleEnglish: She won first place in the competition.
hintSimplified: 经过努力后得到奖项、成绩或机会。
hintTraditional: 經過努力後得到獎項、成績或機會。
hintEnglish: Getting a prize, result or opportunity after effort.

definition: (coll.) serve sb right; deservedly; ought; should
exampleSimplified: 你天天熬夜,生病了也是活该。
exampleTraditional: 你天天熬夜,生病了也是活該。
exampleEnglish: You stay up late every day; you deserve it if you get sick.
hintSimplified: 别人遇到坏事是自己造成的,所以不值得同情。
hintTraditional: 別人遇到壞事是自己造成的,所以不值得同情。
hintEnglish: When someone's misfortune is their own doing, so they get no sympathy.

exampleSimplified: 孩子们充满活力,一整天都在玩。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們充滿活力,一整天都在玩。
exampleEnglish: The children are full of energy and play all day.
hintSimplified: 年轻人身上那种精神饱满、不容易累的力量。
hintTraditional: 年輕人身上那種精神飽滿、不容易累的力量。
hintEnglish: The lively, tireless strength found in young people.

exampleSimplified: 我的小女儿很活泼,喜欢唱歌跳舞。
exampleTraditional: 我的小女兒很活潑,喜歡唱歌跳舞。
exampleEnglish: My little daughter is lively and likes singing and dancing.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人开朗、爱动、爱说话。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人開朗、愛動、愛說話。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is cheerful, active and talkative.

exampleSimplified: 这艘船载着很多货物去美国。
exampleTraditional: 這艘船載著很多貨物去美國。
exampleEnglish: This ship carries lots of goods to America.
hintSimplified: 卡车、火车或船运送的商品。
hintTraditional: 卡車、火車或船運送的商品。
hintEnglish: Merchandise carried by trucks, trains or ships.

definition: active; excited; lively; to brighten up; to enliven
exampleSimplified: 他在社团里很活跃,常常帮忙办活动。
exampleTraditional: 他在社團裡很活躍,常常幫忙辦活動。
exampleEnglish: He is very active in the club and often helps organize events.
hintSimplified: 形容人常常参加活动、表现积极。
hintTraditional: 形容人常常參加活動、表現積極。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who often joins in and takes part eagerly.

gloss: serious fire (in a city or a forest etc)
definition: serious fire (in a city or a forest etc)
exampleSimplified: 昨晚那场火灾烧毁了好几间房子。
exampleTraditional: 昨晚那場火災燒燬了好幾間房子。
exampleEnglish: Last night's fire destroyed several houses.
hintSimplified: 房子或森林着火,消防队赶来灭火的大灾难。
hintTraditional: 房子或森林著火,消防隊趕來滅火的大災難。
hintEnglish: A big disaster where a house or forest burns and firefighters rush in.

gloss: to neglect; to overlook; to disregard; to ignore
definition: to neglect; to overlook; to disregard; to ignore
exampleSimplified: 不要忽视身体发出的警告。
exampleTraditional: 不要忽視身體發出的警告。
exampleEnglish: Don't ignore the warnings your body gives.
hintSimplified: 对重要的事不够重视,没有认真对待。
hintTraditional: 對重要的事不夠重視,沒有認真對待。
hintEnglish: Not giving an important matter enough attention or seriousness.

exampleSimplified: 周末天气好,我们想去户外烤肉。
exampleTraditional: 週末天氣好,我們想去戶外烤肉。
exampleEnglish: The weather's nice this weekend; we want to barbecue outdoors.
hintSimplified: 不在房子里面,而是在外面的空间。
hintTraditional: 不在房子裡面,而是在外面的空間。
hintEnglish: Not inside a building, but in the open space outside.

exampleSimplified: 山上的空气很新鲜,我深深地呼吸。
exampleTraditional: 山上的空氣很新鮮,我深深地呼吸。
exampleEnglish: The mountain air is fresh, and I breathe deeply.
hintSimplified: 用鼻子和肺吸进空气再吐出来。
hintTraditional: 用鼻子和肺吸進空氣再吐出來。
hintEnglish: Taking air in and out through the nose and lungs.

gloss: see 互助土族自治縣|互助土族自治县[Hu4 zhu4 Tu3 zu2 Zi4 zhi4 xian4]
definition: see 互助土族自治縣|互助土族自治县[Hu4 zhu4 Tu3 zu2 Zi4 zhi4 xian4]; to help each other
exampleSimplified: 邻居之间应该互助,有困难就帮忙。
exampleTraditional: 鄰居之間應該互助,有困難就幫忙。
exampleEnglish: Neighbors should help each other and lend a hand in difficulty.
hintSimplified: 大家彼此帮忙,你帮我、我也帮你。
hintTraditional: 大家彼此幫忙,你幫我、我也幫你。
hintEnglish: Everyone helps one another: you help me and I help you.

gloss: abbr. for 家用電器|家用电器
definition: abbr. for 家用電器|家用电器; household electric appliance
exampleSimplified: 我们家的家电都是新买的。
exampleTraditional: 我們家的家電都是新買的。
exampleEnglish: All the appliances in our home are newly bought.
hintSimplified: 冰箱、洗衣机和电视这些东西的总称。
hintTraditional: 冰箱、洗衣機和電視這些東西的總稱。
hintEnglish: A general term for things like refrigerators, washing machines and TVs.

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂专门加工水果,做成果汁。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠專門加工水果,做成果汁。
exampleEnglish: This factory specializes in processing fruit into juice.
hintSimplified: 工厂把原料做成成品的过程。
hintTraditional: 工廠把原料做成成品的過程。
hintEnglish: What a factory does to turn raw materials into finished products.

exampleSimplified: 请把剪刀借我,我要剪纸。
exampleTraditional: 請把剪刀借我,我要剪紙。
exampleEnglish: Please lend me the scissors, I want to cut paper.
hintSimplified: 有两片刀刃,可以用来剪纸或布的工具。
hintTraditional: 有兩片刀刃,可以用來剪紙或布的工具。
hintEnglish: A tool with two blades used to cut paper or cloth.

exampleSimplified: 他坚定地说:“我一定会成功。”
exampleTraditional: 他堅定地說:“我一定會成功。”
exampleEnglish: He said firmly, "I will definitely succeed."
hintSimplified: 形容一个人的想法或态度很稳,不会动摇。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人的想法或態度很穩,不會動搖。
hintEnglish: Describes someone's attitude or belief that is steady and does not waver.

definition: to cut the price; to drive down the price; to get cheaper
exampleSimplified: 这家店的手机下个月要降价。
exampleTraditional: 這家店的手機下個月要降價。
exampleEnglish: The phones at this store will drop in price next month.
hintSimplified: 商店把东西的价钱变得比较便宜。
hintTraditional: 商店把東西的價錢變得比較便宜。
hintEnglish: When a shop makes the price of something cheaper.

exampleSimplified: 年底公司会发奖金给大家。
exampleTraditional: 年底公司會發獎金給大家。
exampleEnglish: At year's end the company gives everyone a bonus.
hintSimplified: 工作表现好时,除了薪水以外额外得到的钱。
hintTraditional: 工作表現好時,除了薪水以外額外得到的錢。
hintEnglish: Extra money received besides salary for good work performance.

exampleSimplified: 比赛的奖品是一台新电脑。
exampleTraditional: 比賽的獎品是一臺新電腦。
exampleEnglish: The prize for the contest is a new computer.
hintSimplified: 比赛或活动中,赢的人可以拿到的东西。
hintTraditional: 比賽或活動中,贏的人可以拿到的東西。
hintEnglish: The thing winners get in a contest or event.

definition: nation-building; the foundation of PRC by Mao Zedong in 1949; to found a country
exampleSimplified: 这个国家建国已经一百多年了。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家建國已經一百多年了。
exampleEnglish: This country was founded more than a hundred years ago.
hintSimplified: 一个国家刚开始成立的那件事。
hintTraditional: 一個國家剛開始成立的那件事。
hintEnglish: The event of a country being first established.

definition: shall; to be going to; will
exampleSimplified: 火车将要开了,请大家快上车。
exampleTraditional: 火車將要開了,請大家快上車。
exampleEnglish: The train is about to leave, so everyone please board quickly.
hintSimplified: 表示某件事不久之后就会发生的副词。
hintTraditional: 表示某件事不久之後就會發生的副詞。
hintEnglish: An adverb showing something will happen very soon.

exampleSimplified: 天气渐渐变冷了,要多穿一点。
exampleTraditional: 天氣漸漸變冷了,要多穿一點。
exampleEnglish: The weather is gradually getting colder, so wear more.
hintSimplified: 表示变化一点一点地发生,不是突然的。
hintTraditional: 表示變化一點一點地發生,不是突然的。
hintEnglish: Shows that change happens little by little, not suddenly.

exampleSimplified: 我是通过朋友间接认识他的。
exampleTraditional: 我是透過朋友間接認識他的。
exampleEnglish: I got to know him indirectly through a friend.
hintSimplified: 不是直接来的,中间要经过别人或别的东西。
hintTraditional: 不是直接來的,中間要經過別人或別的東西。
hintEnglish: Not direct; it passes through someone or something in between.

exampleSimplified: 他坚决不肯放弃自己的梦想。
exampleTraditional: 他堅決不肯放棄自己的夢想。
exampleEnglish: He resolutely refuses to give up his dream.
hintSimplified: 形容态度很强硬,决定了就不改变。
hintTraditional: 形容態度很強硬,決定了就不改變。
hintEnglish: Describes a strong attitude of not changing a decision once made.

exampleSimplified: 这个键盘用起来很舒服。
exampleTraditional: 這個鍵盤用起來很舒服。
exampleEnglish: This keyboard is very comfortable to use.
hintSimplified: 电脑上有很多按键,用来打字的设备。
hintTraditional: 電腦上有很多按鍵,用來打字的裝置。
hintEnglish: A device on a computer with many keys, used for typing.

exampleSimplified: 一个国家需要健全的法律制度。
exampleTraditional: 一個國家需要健全的法律制度。
exampleEnglish: A country needs a sound legal system.
hintSimplified: 形容制度或设备很完整,没有缺点。
hintTraditional: 形容制度或裝置很完整,沒有缺點。
hintEnglish: Describes a system or setup that is complete and without gaps.

exampleSimplified: 她尖锐的声音让大家吓了一跳。
exampleTraditional: 她尖銳的聲音讓大家嚇了一跳。
exampleEnglish: Her shrill voice startled everyone.
hintSimplified: 形容声音很刺耳,或者东西的头很细很利。
hintTraditional: 形容聲音很刺耳,或者東西的頭很細很利。
hintEnglish: Describes a piercing sound, or something with a very sharp point.

definition: surveillance; to keep a close watch over; to monitor
exampleSimplified: 商店里装了摄像头来监视小偷。
exampleTraditional: 商店裡裝了攝像頭來監視小偷。
exampleEnglish: The store installed cameras to keep watch on thieves.
hintSimplified: 在旁边一直注意看某个人或某个地方的动作。
hintTraditional: 在旁邊一直注意看某個人或某個地方的動作。
hintEnglish: Keeping a close eye on a person or place all the time.

definition: to examine; to inspect; to test
exampleSimplified: 工厂要检验每一件产品的质量。
exampleTraditional: 工廠要檢驗每一件產品的質量。
exampleEnglish: The factory must inspect the quality of every product.
hintSimplified: 用仪器或方法检查东西有没有问题。
hintTraditional: 用儀器或方法檢查東西有沒有問題。
hintEnglish: Using tools or methods to check whether something has problems.

exampleSimplified: 那个坏人被关进了监狱。
exampleTraditional: 那個壞人被關進了監獄。
exampleEnglish: That bad man was locked up in prison.
hintSimplified: 犯了法的人被关起来的地方。
hintTraditional: 犯了法的人被關起來的地方。
hintEnglish: The place where people who broke the law are locked up.

exampleSimplified: 这座建筑已经有一百年的历史了。
exampleTraditional: 這座建築已經有一百年的歷史了。
exampleEnglish: This building has a history of a hundred years.
hintSimplified: 房子、大楼、桥等盖起来的东西。
hintTraditional: 房子、大樓、橋等蓋起來的東西。
hintEnglish: Things built, such as houses, towers or bridges.

exampleSimplified: 我听到楼上有人的脚步声。
exampleTraditional: 我聽到樓上有人的腳步聲。
exampleEnglish: I heard someone's footsteps upstairs.
hintSimplified: 走路时脚每一次落地的动作或声音。
hintTraditional: 走路時腳每一次落地的動作或聲音。
hintEnglish: The movement or sound of each foot landing when walking.

gloss: (jocular) to come to a bad end
definition: (jocular) to come to a bad end; to confess; to account for oneself; to explain; to give an account; to brief; to give instructions; to tell (sb to do sth); to transfer (duties to sb else)
exampleSimplified: 老师交代我们明天要带课本。
exampleTraditional: 老師交代我們明天要帶課本。
exampleEnglish: The teacher instructed us to bring our textbooks tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 把工作或事情清楚地告诉别人,请他去做。
hintTraditional: 把工作或事情清楚地告訴別人,請他去做。
hintEnglish: To tell someone clearly about a task so they will do it.

exampleSimplified: 外面传来孩子们的叫喊声。
exampleTraditional: 外面傳來孩子們的叫喊聲。
exampleEnglish: The shouts of children came from outside.
hintSimplified: 大声地叫,通常因为兴奋、害怕或想让人听见。
hintTraditional: 大聲地叫,通常因為興奮、害怕或想讓人聽見。
hintEnglish: To call out loudly, from excitement, fear or to be heard.

definition: commutative (math); to commute; to exchange; to swap; to switch (telecom)
exampleSimplified: 我们交换了电话号码。
exampleTraditional: 我們交換了電話號碼。
exampleEnglish: We exchanged phone numbers.
hintSimplified: 你给我一样东西,我也给你一样东西。
hintTraditional: 你給我一樣東西,我也給你一樣東西。
hintEnglish: You give me something and I give you something in return.

definition: Christian church; to show; to teach
exampleSimplified: 每个星期天她都去教会做礼拜。
exampleTraditional: 每個星期天她都去教會做禮拜。
exampleEnglish: Every Sunday she goes to church for worship.
hintSimplified: 信仰基督的人聚在一起的组织或地方。
hintTraditional: 信仰基督的人聚在一起的組織或地方。
hintEnglish: The organization or place where Christian believers gather.

exampleSimplified: 他很会交际,朋友非常多。
exampleTraditional: 他很會交際,朋友非常多。
exampleEnglish: He is very sociable and has lots of friends.
hintSimplified: 与人来往、认识新朋友的社会活动。
hintTraditional: 與人來往、認識新朋友的社會活動。
hintEnglish: Social activity of mixing with people and meeting new friends.

definition: (fig.) remote spot; nook; corner (of a room, courtyard etc)
exampleSimplified: 小猫躲在房间的角落里睡觉。
exampleTraditional: 小貓躲在房間的角落裡睡覺。
exampleEnglish: The kitten is hiding in the corner of the room sleeping.
hintSimplified: 房间里两面墙相遇的地方,常常很少有人注意。
hintTraditional: 房間裡兩面牆相遇的地方,常常很少有人注意。
hintEnglish: The place in a room where two walls meet, which people often overlook.

exampleSimplified: 他住在城市的郊外,空气很好。
exampleTraditional: 他住在城市的郊外,空氣很好。
exampleEnglish: He lives on the outskirts of the city, where the air is good.
hintSimplified: 城市中心以外,比较安静、靠近田野的地区。
hintTraditional: 城市中心以外,比較安靜、靠近田野的地區。
hintEnglish: The area beyond the city center, quieter and close to fields.

definition: (interpersonal) relationship; association; contact; to associate (with); to date; to hang out (with); to have contact (with)
exampleSimplified: 她和同事的交往一直很愉快。
exampleTraditional: 她和同事的交往一直很愉快。

gloss: to be jealous of; to envy
definition: to be jealous of; to envy

exampleTraditional: 他忌妒哥哥得到更多的禮物。

definition: answer; resolution; solution; to provide an answer; to resolve (a difficulty); to solve (a problem)
