exampleSimplified: 看到国旗升起,士兵们立刻向前敬礼。
exampleTraditional: 看到國旗升起,士兵們立刻向前敬禮。
exampleEnglish: Seeing the flag rise, the soldiers immediately saluted.
hintSimplified: 军人或学生举起右手,对长官或国旗表示尊敬的动作。
hintTraditional: 軍人或學生舉起右手,對長官或國旗表示尊敬的動作。
hintEnglish: The gesture of raising one's right hand to show respect to an officer or flag.

exampleSimplified: 他每天工作十几个小时,精力真充沛。
exampleTraditional: 他每天工作十幾個小時,精力真充沛。
exampleEnglish: He works over ten hours every day; he has so much energy.
hintSimplified: 一个人做事时身体和脑力上的力量,累了就会用完。
hintTraditional: 一個人做事時身體和腦力上的力量,累了就會用完。
hintEnglish: The physical and mental strength a person has for doing things, which runs out when tired.

definition: experience (CL:段[duan4],次[ci4]); to experience; to go through
exampleSimplified: 这段在国外生活的经历让我成长了很多。
exampleTraditional: 這段在國外生活的經歷讓我成長了很多。
exampleEnglish: This experience of living abroad helped me grow a lot.
hintSimplified: 你亲自遇到或做过的事情,会成为你的记忆和收获。
hintTraditional: 你親自遇到或做過的事情,會成為你的記憶和收穫。
hintEnglish: Things you personally went through, which become your memories and lessons.

definition: actually; in spite of everything; in that crazy way; to go as far as to; to one's surprise; unexpectedly
exampleSimplified: 他竟然一个人把这么多菜都吃完了。
exampleTraditional: 他竟然一個人把這麼多菜都吃完了。
exampleEnglish: He actually ate all this food by himself.
hintSimplified: 表示结果出乎意料,让人觉得惊讶的副词。
hintTraditional: 表示結果出乎意料,讓人覺得驚訝的副詞。
hintEnglish: An adverb showing the result was unexpected and surprising.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市的发展速度很惊人。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市的發展速度很驚人。
exampleEnglish: This city's rate of development is astonishing.
hintSimplified: 形容某事非常特别,让大家都吓一跳、很佩服。
hintTraditional: 形容某事非常特別,讓大家都嚇一跳、很佩服。
hintEnglish: Describes something so remarkable that everyone is startled and impressed.

exampleSimplified: 山上的景色太美了,我拍了很多照片。
exampleTraditional: 山上的景色太美了,我拍了很多照片。
exampleEnglish: The scenery on the mountain was so beautiful that I took many photos.
hintSimplified: 你站在山上或海边,眼前看到的美丽风光。
hintTraditional: 你站在山上或海邊,眼前看到的美麗風光。
hintEnglish: The beautiful view you see in front of you on a mountain or by the sea.

exampleSimplified: 这件手工艺品做得非常精细。
exampleTraditional: 這件手工藝品做得非常精細。
exampleEnglish: This handicraft is made with great delicacy.
hintSimplified: 形容做东西或做事很仔细,连小地方都处理得很好。
hintTraditional: 形容做東西或做事很仔細,連小地方都處理得很好。
hintEnglish: Describes work done so carefully that even tiny details are handled well.

gloss: to engage in (business etc); to run; to operate
definition: to engage in (business etc); to run; to operate
exampleSimplified: 他在台北经营一家小咖啡店。
exampleTraditional: 他在台北經營一家小咖啡店。
exampleEnglish: He runs a small coffee shop in Taipei.
hintSimplified: 老板管理店铺或公司,让生意继续进行。
hintTraditional: 老闆管理店鋪或公司,讓生意繼續進行。
hintEnglish: What a boss does to manage a shop or company so that business continues.

exampleSimplified: 现在市场上的竞争越来越激烈。
exampleTraditional: 現在市場上的競爭越來越激烈。
exampleEnglish: Competition in the market is getting fiercer and fiercer.
hintSimplified: 几家公司或几个人都想得到第一名或同一个机会。
hintTraditional: 幾家公司或幾個人都想得到第一名或同一個機會。
hintEnglish: Several companies or people all want to be first or get the same opportunity.

definition: from now on; henceforth; hereafter; in the future
exampleSimplified: 今后我会更努力学习中文。
exampleTraditional: 今後我會更努力學習中文。
exampleEnglish: From now on, I will study Chinese more diligently.
hintSimplified: 指从现在开始往后的一段时间。
hintTraditional: 指從現在開始往後的一段時間。
hintEnglish: Refers to the period of time starting from the present and going forward.

exampleSimplified: 遇到紧急情况,请马上打电话给警察。
exampleTraditional: 遇到緊急情況,請馬上打電話給警察。
exampleEnglish: In an emergency, please call the police right away.
hintSimplified: 形容事情很危险或很急,必须马上处理。
hintTraditional: 形容事情很危險或很急,必須馬上處理。
hintEnglish: Describes a situation so dangerous or urgent that it must be dealt with immediately.

definition: entrance; imported; inlet (for the intake of air, water etc); to import
exampleSimplified: 这瓶红酒是从法国进口的。
exampleTraditional: 這瓶紅酒是從法國進口的。
exampleEnglish: This bottle of red wine is imported from France.
hintSimplified: 把外国的商品买进本国来,和出口相反。
hintTraditional: 把外國的商品買進本國來,和出口相反。
hintEnglish: Bringing foreign goods into one's own country; the opposite of exporting.

exampleSimplified: 近来天气变化很大,大家要小心感冒。
exampleTraditional: 近來天氣變化很大,大家要小心感冒。
exampleEnglish: Lately the weather has been changing a lot, so be careful not to catch a cold.
hintSimplified: 指过去不久到现在的这段时间。
hintTraditional: 指過去不久到現在的這段時間。
hintEnglish: Refers to the short period from a little while ago until now.

gloss: to strive one's hardest; to spare no effort
definition: to strive one's hardest; to spare no effort
exampleSimplified: 我会尽力帮你解决这个问题。
exampleTraditional: 我會盡力幫你解決這個問題。
exampleEnglish: I will do my best to help you solve this problem.
hintSimplified: 用上自己全部的力量去做一件事,不保留。
hintTraditional: 用上自己全部的力量去做一件事,不保留。
hintEnglish: To use all of one's strength on something without holding back.

definition: as much as possible; to the greatest extent
exampleSimplified: 明天早上请尽量早一点到办公室。
exampleTraditional: 明天早上請盡量早一點到辦公室。
exampleEnglish: Please try to arrive at the office as early as possible tomorrow morning.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示在可能的范围内做到最多或最好。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示在可能的範圍內做到最多或最好。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning to do as much or as well as possible within one's limits.

exampleSimplified: 金钱不是生活中最重要的东西。
exampleTraditional: 金錢不是生活中最重要的東西。
exampleEnglish: Money is not the most important thing in life.
hintSimplified: 人们用来买东西、付账的东西,有人说它不能买到幸福。
hintTraditional: 人們用來買東西、付賬的東西,有人說它不能買到幸福。
hintEnglish: What people use to buy things and pay bills; some say it can't buy happiness.

exampleSimplified: 他大学毕业后进入一家金融公司工作。
exampleTraditional: 他大學畢業後進入一家金融公司工作。
exampleEnglish: After graduating from college, he joined a financial company.
hintSimplified: 跟银行、股票、投资和资金流动有关的行业。
hintTraditional: 跟銀行、股票、投資和資金流動有關的行業。
hintEnglish: The field related to banks, stocks, investment and the flow of funds.

exampleSimplified: 请大家安静地进入教室。
exampleTraditional: 請大家安靜地進入教室。
exampleEnglish: Everyone, please enter the classroom quietly.
hintSimplified: 从外面走到里面,比如走过门或来到一个地方。
hintTraditional: 從外面走到裡面,比如走過門或來到一個地方。
hintEnglish: To go from outside to inside, such as passing through a door.

exampleSimplified: 他有六百度的近视,所以一直戴眼镜。
exampleTraditional: 他有六百度的近視,所以一直戴眼鏡。
exampleEnglish: He is quite nearsighted, so he always wears glasses.
hintSimplified: 眼睛的毛病,看近处清楚,看远处很模糊。
hintTraditional: 眼睛的毛病,看近處清楚,看遠處很模糊。
hintEnglish: An eye problem where near things are clear but distant things are blurry.

exampleSimplified: 铁和铜都是常见的金属。
exampleTraditional: 鐵和銅都是常見的金屬。
exampleEnglish: Iron and copper are both common metals.
hintSimplified: 又硬又亮、能导电的材料,例如铁、铜和铝。
hintTraditional: 又硬又亮、能導電的材料,例如鐵、銅和鋁。
hintEnglish: Hard, shiny materials that conduct electricity, such as iron, copper and aluminum.

definition: to ban; to forbid; to prohibit
exampleSimplified: 图书馆里禁止大声说话。
exampleTraditional: 圖書館裡禁止大聲說話。
exampleEnglish: Talking loudly is prohibited in the library.
hintSimplified: 规定不可以做某件事,常写在告示牌上。
hintTraditional: 規定不可以做某件事,常寫在告示牌上。
hintEnglish: To rule that something may not be done, often written on a sign.

definition: CL:張|张[zhang1]; plane ticket; airline ticket
exampleSimplified: 我已经在网上订好了去东京的机票。
exampleTraditional: 我已經在網上訂好了去東京的機票。
exampleEnglish: I've already booked my ticket to Tokyo online.
hintSimplified: 坐飞机旅行前必须买的东西。
hintTraditional: 坐飛機旅行前必須買的東西。
hintEnglish: Something you must buy before traveling by plane.

exampleSimplified: 这次考试极其困难,很多人都没通过。
exampleTraditional: 這次考試極其困難,很多人都沒透過。
exampleEnglish: This exam was extremely difficult, and many people didn't pass.
hintSimplified: 程度副词,表示达到最高的程度,比“很”更强。
hintTraditional: 程度副詞,表示達到最高的程度,比“很”更強。
hintEnglish: A degree adverb meaning the highest level, stronger than "very".

gloss: since; as; this being the case
definition: since; as; this being the case
exampleSimplified: 既然你不舒服,就早点回家休息吧。
exampleTraditional: 既然你不舒服,就早點回家休息吧。
exampleEnglish: Since you're not feeling well, go home and rest early.
hintSimplified: 连词,先说出已经确定的事实,再根据它提出建议或结论。
hintTraditional: 連詞,先說出已經確定的事實,再根據它提出建議或結論。
hintEnglish: A conjunction that states an established fact, then draws a suggestion or conclusion from it.

exampleSimplified: 他常去健身房运动,所以肌肉很结实。
exampleTraditional: 他常去健身房運動,所以肌肉很結實。
exampleEnglish: He often goes to the gym, so his muscles are very firm.
hintSimplified: 身体里让人能够活动、用力的部分,健身的人会特别练它。
hintTraditional: 身體裡讓人能夠活動、用力的部分,健身的人會特別練它。
hintEnglish: The part of the body that lets you move and exert force; people who work out train it.

exampleSimplified: 即使下雨,我们也要去爬山。
exampleTraditional: 即使下雨,我們也要去爬山。
exampleEnglish: Even if it rains, we will still go hiking.
hintSimplified: 连词,表示假设一种情况,但结果不会因此改变。
hintTraditional: 連詞,表示假設一種情況,但結果不會因此改變。
hintEnglish: A conjunction that supposes a situation, but the result won't change because of it.

definition: CL:門|门[men2],種|种[zhong3],項|项[xiang4]; technology; technique; skill
exampleSimplified: 这家公司的技术在世界上很有名。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司的技術在世界上很有名。
exampleEnglish: This company's technology is famous around the world.
hintSimplified: 工程师或工人掌握的专业方法和本领。
hintTraditional: 工程師或工人掌握的專業方法和本領。
hintEnglish: The specialized methods and skills that engineers or workers master.

definition: to calculate; to compute; to consider; to think over; to plot; to scheme
exampleSimplified: 这道数学题很难,我用计算器才算出答案。
exampleTraditional: 這道數學題很難,我用計算器才算出答案。
exampleEnglish: This math problem is hard; I only got the answer by using a calculator.
hintSimplified: 用数字和公式算出结果,比如加、减、乘、除。
hintTraditional: 用數字和公式算出結果,比如加、減、乘、除。
hintEnglish: To work out a result with numbers and formulas, such as adding, subtracting, multiplying or dividing.

exampleSimplified: 公司明天晚上有一个酒会,大家都要参加。
exampleTraditional: 公司明天晚上有一個酒會,大家都要參加。
exampleEnglish: The company has a cocktail party tomorrow night, and everyone has to attend.
hintSimplified: 一种比较正式的聚会,大家站着喝饮料、聊天、认识新朋友。
hintTraditional: 一種比較正式的聚會,大家站著喝飲料、聊天、認識新朋友。
hintEnglish: A fairly formal gathering where people stand, drink, chat and meet new people.

definition: firefighting; to put out a fire
exampleSimplified: 消防员冒着危险进去救火。
exampleTraditional: 消防員冒著危險進去救火。
exampleEnglish: The firefighters went in at great risk to put out the fire.
hintSimplified: 房子着火时,消防员要做的事。
hintTraditional: 房子著火時,消防員要做的事。
hintEnglish: What firefighters do when a building is burning.

definition: (in an interrogative sentence) finally; after all; outcome; result; to go to the bottom of a matter; when all is said and done
exampleSimplified: 你究竟想去哪里?快告诉我吧。
exampleTraditional: 你究竟想去哪裡?快告訴我吧。
exampleEnglish: Where on earth do you want to go? Tell me quickly.
hintSimplified: 用在疑问句里,表示想问出最后的真正答案,语气比较强。
hintTraditional: 用在疑問句裡,表示想問出最後的真正答案,語氣比較強。
hintEnglish: Used in questions to press for the real, final answer, with a strong tone.

exampleSimplified: 现在年轻人的就业机会比以前多。
exampleTraditional: 現在年輕人的就業機會比以前多。
exampleEnglish: Young people now have more job opportunities than before.
hintSimplified: 毕业以后找到工作并开始上班。
hintTraditional: 畢業以後找到工作並開始上班。
hintEnglish: Finding a job and starting to work after graduating.

exampleSimplified: 老师纠正了我的发音。
exampleTraditional: 老師糾正了我的發音。
exampleEnglish: The teacher corrected my pronunciation.
hintSimplified: 发现别人有错误,把它改成对的。
hintTraditional: 發現別人有錯誤,把它改成對的。
hintEnglish: Noticing someone's mistake and changing it to what is right.

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂买了很多新的机械。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠買了很多新的機械。
exampleEnglish: This factory bought a lot of new machinery.
hintSimplified: 工厂或工地里用来做工作的各种机器和设备。
hintTraditional: 工廠或工地裡用來做工作的各種機器和裝置。
hintEnglish: The various machines and equipment used for work in factories or construction sites.

exampleSimplified: 我的记性不好,常常忘记带钥匙。
exampleTraditional: 我的記性不好,常常忘記帶鑰匙。
exampleEnglish: My memory is bad, and I often forget to bring my keys.
hintSimplified: 一个人把事情记在脑子里的能力,有人好,有人差。
hintTraditional: 一個人把事情記在腦子裡的能力,有人好,有人差。
hintEnglish: A person's ability to keep things in the head; some have a good one, some a poor one.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷的爱好是集邮,他有很多漂亮的收藏。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺的愛好是集郵,他有很多漂亮的收藏。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa's hobby is stamp collecting, and he has many beautiful items.
hintSimplified: 一种爱好,把信封上贴的小纸片收集起来。
hintTraditional: 一種愛好,把信封上貼的小紙片收集起來。
hintEnglish: A hobby of gathering the little pieces of paper stuck on envelopes.

definition: to record; to write down; written account
exampleSimplified: 这本书记载了很多古代的故事。
exampleTraditional: 這本書記載了很多古代的故事。
exampleEnglish: This book records many ancient stories.
hintSimplified: 把事情写下来,让后人可以知道。
hintTraditional: 把事情寫下來,讓後人可以知道。
hintEnglish: To write things down so that later generations can know them.

gloss: emergency treatment (at a hospital emergency department or from a doctor on a house call)
definition: emergency treatment (at a hospital emergency department or from a doctor on a house call); to give or receive urgent medical treatment
exampleSimplified: 他半夜发高烧,家人马上带他去看急诊。
exampleTraditional: 他半夜發高燒,家人馬上帶他去看急診。
exampleEnglish: He had a high fever in the middle of the night, so his family took him to the emergency room right away.
hintSimplified: 生病很严重或突然受伤时,晚上也能去医院看的门诊。
hintTraditional: 生病很嚴重或突然受傷時,晚上也能去醫院看的門診。
hintEnglish: The hospital service you go to for sudden, serious illness or injury, even at night.

definition: centralized; concentrated; to centralize; to concentrate; to focus; to put together
exampleSimplified: 上课的时候,请大家集中注意力。
exampleTraditional: 上課的時候,請大家集中注意力。
exampleEnglish: During class, please everyone concentrate your attention.
hintSimplified: 把分散的人、东西或注意力放到同一个地方或一件事上。
hintTraditional: 把分散的人、東西或注意力放到同一個地方或一件事上。
hintEnglish: To gather scattered people, things or attention into one place or one thing.

definition: to bear in mind; to learn by heart; to remember
exampleSimplified: 请记住明天早上八点要开会。
exampleTraditional: 請記住明天早上八點要開會。
exampleEnglish: Please remember that there's a meeting at eight tomorrow morning.
hintSimplified: 把事情牢牢放在脑子里,不要忘记。
hintTraditional: 把事情牢牢放在腦子裡,不要忘記。
hintEnglish: To keep something firmly in your mind so you don't forget.

definition: contribution (of money); donation; to contribute funds; to donate money
exampleSimplified: 很多人为受灾的地区捐款。
exampleTraditional: 很多人為受災的地區捐款。
exampleEnglish: Many people donated money to the disaster-stricken area.
hintSimplified: 为了帮助别人或做好事,拿出钱来给机构。
hintTraditional: 為了幫助別人或做好事,拿出錢來給機構。
hintEnglish: To give money to an organization in order to help others or do good.

definition: able to fulfill (conditions or requirements); equipped with; to have; to possess
exampleSimplified: 当老师必须具备耐心和爱心。
exampleTraditional: 當老師必須具備耐心和愛心。
exampleEnglish: To be a teacher, one must have patience and love.
hintSimplified: 拥有某种条件、能力或资格。
hintTraditional: 擁有某種條件、能力或資格。
hintEnglish: To possess a certain condition, ability or qualification.

gloss: to get together for a meal; to dine together
definition: to get together for a meal; to dine together
exampleSimplified: 我们每个月都会和同事聚餐一次。
exampleTraditional: 我們每個月都會和同事聚餐一次。
exampleEnglish: Every month we have a meal together with our colleagues.
hintSimplified: 朋友或同事约好一起去吃饭、聊天。
hintTraditional: 朋友或同事約好一起去吃飯、聊天。
hintEnglish: Friends or colleagues arranging to eat and chat together.

exampleSimplified: 这座剧场可以坐一千个人。
exampleTraditional: 這座劇場可以坐一千個人。
exampleEnglish: This theater can seat a thousand people.
hintSimplified: 演员在舞台上表演,观众坐着看的建筑。
hintTraditional: 演員在舞台上表演,觀眾坐著看的建築。
hintEnglish: A building where actors perform on stage and the audience sits to watch.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市这几年发生了巨大的变化。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市這幾年發生了巨大的變化。
exampleEnglish: This city has undergone huge changes in recent years.
hintSimplified: 形容体积、数量或影响非常非常大。
hintTraditional: 形容體積、數量或影響非常非常大。
hintEnglish: Describes size, quantity or impact that is extremely great.

gloss: in no way; not in the least; absolutely not
definition: in no way; not in the least; absolutely not
exampleSimplified: 我绝不会忘记你对我的帮助。
exampleTraditional: 我絕不會忘記你對我的幫助。
exampleEnglish: I will never forget your help to me.
hintSimplified: 放在否定前面,表示态度非常坚决,没有一点可能。
hintTraditional: 放在否定前面,表示態度非常堅決,沒有一點可能。
hintEnglish: Placed before a negation to show a very firm stance, with no possibility at all.

definition: Buddhist enlightenment (Sanskrit: cittotpāda); awareness; consciousness; to come to understand; to realize
exampleSimplified: 他的环保觉悟很高,出门总是自己带杯子。
exampleTraditional: 他的環保覺悟很高,出門總是自己帶杯子。
exampleEnglish: His environmental awareness is high, and he always brings his own cup when going out.
hintSimplified: 对道理或责任的认识和明白,尤其是思想上的提高。
hintTraditional: 對道理或責任的認識和明白,尤其是思想上的提高。
hintEnglish: Understanding of a principle or responsibility, especially a rise in awareness.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; determination; determined; firm and resolute; resolution; to make up one's mind
exampleSimplified: 他下定决心要在今年考上大学。
exampleTraditional: 他下定決心要在今年考上大學。
exampleEnglish: He made up his mind to get into university this year.
hintSimplified: 对一件事情很坚定的想法,一定要做到。
hintTraditional: 對一件事情很堅定的想法,一定要做到。
hintEnglish: A firm determination about something that you are sure to carry through.

exampleSimplified: 演出结束后,他向观众鞠躬致谢。
exampleTraditional: 演出結束後,他向觀眾鞠躬致謝。
exampleEnglish: After the performance ended, he bowed to thank the audience.
hintSimplified: 见面或感谢别人时,把上半身向前弯下去表示尊敬。
hintTraditional: 見面或感謝別人時,把上半身向前彎下去表示尊敬。
hintEnglish: Bending the upper body forward to show respect when meeting or thanking someone.

exampleSimplified: 下课后,很多学生聚集在操场上。
exampleTraditional: 下課後,很多學生聚集在操場上。
exampleEnglish: After class, many students gathered on the playground.
hintSimplified: 许多人从不同地方来到同一个地方。
hintTraditional: 許多人從不同地方來到同一個地方。
hintEnglish: Many people come from different places to the same spot.

exampleSimplified: 老师请我们举例说明这个句子的意思。
exampleTraditional: 老師請我們舉例說明這個句子的意思。
exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to give an example to explain the meaning of this sentence.
hintSimplified: 为了让别人更容易明白,说出一个具体的例子。
hintTraditional: 為了讓別人更容易明白,說出一個具體的例子。
hintEnglish: To say a concrete case so that others understand more easily.

exampleSimplified: 他运动后感到胸口一阵剧烈的疼痛。
exampleTraditional: 他運動後感到胸口一陣劇烈的疼痛。
exampleEnglish: After exercising, he felt a sharp, intense pain in his chest.
hintSimplified: 形容疼痛、运动或变化非常强烈、很厉害。
hintTraditional: 形容疼痛、運動或變化非常強烈、很厲害。
hintEnglish: Describes pain, movement or change that is extremely strong and intense.

exampleSimplified: 这个社区的居民都很友善。
exampleTraditional: 這個社群的居民都很友善。
exampleEnglish: The residents of this neighborhood are all very friendly.
hintSimplified: 长期住在某个地区的人。
hintTraditional: 長期住在某個地區的人。
hintEnglish: People who live long-term in a certain area.

exampleSimplified: 他对军事历史很有兴趣。
exampleTraditional: 他對軍事歷史很有興趣。
exampleEnglish: He is very interested in military history.
hintSimplified: 和军队、作战、国防有关的事务。
hintTraditional: 和軍隊、作戰、國防有關的事務。
hintEnglish: Matters related to the army, warfare and national defense.

definition: go so far as to; to one's surprise; unexpectedly
exampleSimplified: 他居然忘了今天是自己的生日。
exampleTraditional: 他居然忘了今天是自己的生日。
exampleEnglish: He actually forgot that today was his own birthday.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示结果出乎意料,让人很惊讶。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示結果出乎意料,讓人很驚訝。
hintEnglish: An adverb showing the result was unexpected and surprising.

exampleSimplified: 据说这家店的牛肉面很好吃。
exampleTraditional: 據說這家店的牛肉麵很好吃。
exampleEnglish: It is said that this shop's beef noodles are delicious.
hintSimplified: 用在句子开头,表示消息是听别人说的,不一定亲眼见过。
hintTraditional: 用在句子開頭,表示訊息是聽別人說的,不一定親眼見過。
hintEnglish: Used at the start of a sentence to show the information was heard from others.

exampleSimplified: 请你说得具体一点,我才听得懂。
exampleTraditional: 請你說得具體一點,我才聽得懂。
exampleEnglish: Please be more specific so that I can understand.
hintSimplified: 和“抽象”相反,清楚、不模糊、有细节。
hintTraditional: 和“抽象”相反,清楚、不模糊、有細節。
hintEnglish: The opposite of abstract: clear, not vague, with details.

exampleSimplified: 我们周末去剧院看了一场话剧。
exampleTraditional: 我們週末去劇院看了一場話劇。
exampleEnglish: We went to the theater on the weekend to see a play.
hintSimplified: 可以在里面看戏剧或表演的大建筑。
hintTraditional: 可以在裡面看戲劇或表演的大建築。
hintEnglish: A large building where you can watch plays or performances.

gloss: to expel (a member of an organization)
definition: to expel (a member of an organization); to fire (an employee)
exampleSimplified: 他因为常常迟到,被公司开除了。
exampleTraditional: 他因為常常遲到,被公司開除了。
exampleEnglish: Because he was often late, he was fired by the company.
hintSimplified: 公司或学校因为某人犯错,让他离开,不能再留下。
hintTraditional: 公司或學校因為某人犯錯,讓他離開,不能再留下。
hintEnglish: A company or school makes someone leave for a mistake, so he cannot stay.

gloss: (of a patient) to have an operation
definition: (of a patient) to have an operation; (of a surgeon) to perform an operation; to behead; to decapitate; to single out as a point of attack
exampleSimplified: 医生说爷爷下个月必须开刀。
exampleTraditional: 醫生說爺爺下個月必須開刀。
exampleEnglish: The doctor said Grandpa must have an operation next month.
hintSimplified: 病人在医院接受手术治疗。
hintTraditional: 病人在醫院接受手術治療。
hintEnglish: A patient undergoes surgical treatment in the hospital.

definition: to dig in (eating); to march; to move; to set in motion; to start; to tuck in (eating)
exampleSimplified: 菜都上齐了,大家开动吧!
exampleTraditional: 菜都上齊了,大家開動吧!
exampleEnglish: All the dishes are served, let's dig in, everyone!
hintSimplified: 饭菜准备好了,大家可以开始吃时说的话。
hintTraditional: 飯菜準備好了,大家可以開始吃時說的話。
hintEnglish: What you say when the meal is ready and everyone can start eating.

gloss: to exploit (a resource); to open up (for development); to develop
definition: to exploit (a resource); to open up (for development); to develop
exampleSimplified: 这家公司正在开发一个新的手机应用程序。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司正在開發一個新的手機應用程式。
exampleEnglish: This company is developing a new mobile app.
hintSimplified: 利用资源或花时间做出新产品、新技术或新土地用途。
hintTraditional: 利用資源或花時間做出新產品、新技術或新土地用途。
hintEnglish: Using resources or time to create a new product, technology or land use.

exampleSimplified: 我想去银行开户,需要带什么证件?
exampleTraditional: 我想去銀行開戶,需要帶什麼證件?
exampleEnglish: I want to open an account at the bank. What documents do I need?
hintSimplified: 去银行办理手续,得到一个存钱用的账号。
hintTraditional: 去銀行辦理手續,得到一個存錢用的賬號。
hintEnglish: Going through procedures at a bank to get an account for saving money.

definition: give a course; school begins; teach a subject
exampleSimplified: 这个学期学校开课的时间是九月一号。
exampleTraditional: 這個學期學校開課的時間是九月一號。
exampleEnglish: This semester, the school's courses start on September 1st.
hintSimplified: 学校或老师安排一门课,让学生开始上课。
hintTraditional: 學校或老師安排一門課,讓學生開始上課。
hintEnglish: A school or teacher offers a course and students begin attending it.

exampleSimplified: 他的父母很开明,不会干涉他的选择。
exampleTraditional: 他的父母很開明,不會干涉他的選擇。
exampleEnglish: His parents are open-minded and don't interfere with his choices.
hintSimplified: 形容人思想不保守,愿意接受新观念。
hintTraditional: 形容人思想不保守,願意接受新觀念。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who isn't conservative and accepts new ideas.

definition: to offer (goods or services); to open (for business etc)
exampleSimplified: 这所大学今年新开设了人工智能课程。
exampleTraditional: 這所大學今年新開設了人工智慧課程。
exampleEnglish: This university newly set up an artificial intelligence course this year.
hintSimplified: 学校、公司等设立新的课程、服务或部门。
hintTraditional: 學校、公司等設立新的課程、服務或部門。
hintEnglish: A school or company sets up a new course, service or department.

definition: fig. to open up (new horizons); to break new ground (for agriculture); to develop (border regions); to open up (a new seam)
exampleSimplified: 公司想努力开拓海外市场。
exampleTraditional: 公司想努力開拓海外市場。
exampleEnglish: The company wants to work hard to open up overseas markets.
hintSimplified: 努力扩大范围,找到新的领域或机会。
hintTraditional: 努力擴大範圍,找到新的領域或機會。
hintEnglish: Working hard to expand the scope and find new fields or opportunities.

gloss: (of a play, movie etc) to begin
definition: (of a play, movie etc) to begin
exampleSimplified: 电影八点开演,我们快一点吧。
exampleTraditional: 電影八點開演,我們快一點吧。
exampleEnglish: The movie starts at eight o'clock, let's hurry.
hintSimplified: 电影院或剧场里,表演正式开始。
hintTraditional: 電影院或劇場裡,表演正式開始。
hintEnglish: In a cinema or theater, the show officially begins.

exampleSimplified: 居民向政府提出抗议,希望改善交通。
exampleTraditional: 居民向政府提出抗議,希望改善交通。
exampleEnglish: Residents lodged a protest with the government, hoping to improve traffic.
hintSimplified: 对不满意的事公开表示反对。
hintTraditional: 對不滿意的事公開表示反對。
hintEnglish: Publicly expressing opposition to something one is unhappy with.

definition: (of skill, ability) special; outstanding; to look after the house
exampleSimplified: 这道红烧肉是他的看家菜。
exampleTraditional: 這道紅燒肉是他的看家菜。
exampleEnglish: This braised pork is his signature dish.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人最拿手、最擅长的本领或菜。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人最拿手、最擅長的本領或菜。
hintEnglish: Describes the skill or dish a person is best at and most proud of.

definition: (coll.) pretty soon; to examine; to survey; to take a look at
exampleSimplified: 看看就要过年了,我们得准备年货。
exampleTraditional: 看看就要過年了,我們得準備年貨。
exampleEnglish: The New Year is coming very soon; we must prepare the festive goods.
hintSimplified: 口语中表示某件事马上就要发生,时间很快到了。
hintTraditional: 口語中表示某件事馬上就要發生,時間很快到了。
hintEnglish: In speech, shows something is about to happen, as time passes quickly.

exampleSimplified: 看来明天会下雨,我们带伞吧。
exampleTraditional: 看來明天會下雨,我們帶傘吧。
exampleEnglish: It looks like it will rain tomorrow, so let's bring umbrellas.
hintSimplified: 根据情况做出判断或推测时用的词。
hintTraditional: 根據情況做出判斷或推測時用的詞。
hintEnglish: A word used when making a judgment or guess based on the situation.

definition: on-the-spot investigation; to inspect; to observe and study
exampleSimplified: 经理到工厂实地考察了三天。
exampleTraditional: 經理到工廠實地考察了三天。
exampleEnglish: The manager inspected the factory on site for three days.
hintSimplified: 亲自到现场仔细看、了解情况。
hintTraditional: 親自到現場仔細看、了解情況。
hintEnglish: Going to the site in person to look carefully and understand the situation.

definition: to approach; to draw near; to be close to
exampleSimplified: 请不要靠近那只狗,它可能会咬人。
exampleTraditional: 請不要靠近那隻狗,它可能會咬人。
exampleEnglish: Please don't get close to that dog; it might bite.
hintSimplified: 和某个人或地方的距离变得越来越小。
hintTraditional: 和某個人或地方的距離變得越來越小。
hintEnglish: The distance between you and a person or place becomes smaller and smaller.

exampleSimplified: 老师今天把考卷发给大家了。
exampleTraditional: 老師今天把考卷發給大家了。
exampleEnglish: The teacher handed out the exam papers to everyone today.
hintSimplified: 考试时发给学生写答案的那张纸。
hintTraditional: 考試時發給學生寫答案的那張紙。
hintEnglish: The sheet of paper given to students during a test to write answers on.

definition: consideration; to consider; to think over
exampleSimplified: 这个决定很重要,你要好好考虑一下。
exampleTraditional: 這個決定很重要,你要好好考慮一下。
exampleEnglish: This decision is very important, so you should think it over carefully.
hintSimplified: 做重要决定以前,你会先在脑子里反复想各种好处和坏处。
hintTraditional: 做重要決定以前,你會先在腦子裡反覆想各種好處和壞處。
hintEnglish: Before making an important decision, you turn over the pros and cons in your mind.

definition: to be admitted to; to pass an entrance exam
exampleSimplified: 他终于考取了理想的大学。
exampleTraditional: 他終於考取了理想的大學。
exampleEnglish: He finally got into the university of his dreams.
hintSimplified: 通过入学考试,被学校录用。
hintTraditional: 透過入學考試,被學校錄用。
hintEnglish: After passing an entrance exam, you are accepted by a school.

exampleSimplified: 小朋友们都喜欢看卡通。
exampleTraditional: 小朋友們都喜歡看卡通。
exampleEnglish: Children all like watching cartoons.
hintSimplified: 小孩子常在电视上看的画出来的动画节目。
hintTraditional: 小孩子常在電視上看的畫出來的動畫節目。
hintEnglish: Animated drawn programs that kids often watch on TV.

exampleSimplified: 我们家有一间客房,朋友来时可以住。
exampleTraditional: 我們家有一間客房,朋友來時可以住。
exampleEnglish: Our home has a guest room where friends can stay when they visit.
hintSimplified: 家里或旅馆里给来访的人睡觉的房间。
hintTraditional: 家裡或旅館裡給來訪的人睡覺的房間。
hintEnglish: A room in a home or hotel for visitors to sleep in.

exampleSimplified: 看事情要客观,不能只看自己喜欢的部分。
exampleTraditional: 看事情要客觀,不能只看自己喜歡的部分。
exampleEnglish: You should look at things objectively, not only the parts you like.
hintSimplified: 不带个人感情或偏见,按照事实来看。
hintTraditional: 不帶個人感情或偏見,按照事實來看。
hintEnglish: Looking at facts without personal feelings or bias.

exampleSimplified: 这家公司有很多外国客户。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司有很多外國客戶。
exampleEnglish: This company has many foreign clients.
hintSimplified: 向公司买东西或使用服务的人或单位。
hintTraditional: 向公司買東西或使用服務的人或單位。
hintEnglish: A person or organization that buys goods or uses services from a company.

exampleSimplified: 数学是我最喜欢的科目。
exampleTraditional: 數學是我最喜歡的科目。
exampleEnglish: Math is my favorite subject.
hintSimplified: 学校里的数学、历史、英文等,每一种都是一个这样的东西。
hintTraditional: 學校裡的數學、歷史、英文等,每一種都是一個這樣的東西。
hintEnglish: Math, history, English and so on at school are each one of these.

exampleSimplified: 他下课后常常参加课外活动。
exampleTraditional: 他下課後常常參加課外活動。
exampleEnglish: After class he often takes part in extracurricular activities.
hintSimplified: 指在正式上课时间以外的。
hintTraditional: 指在正式上課時間以外的。
hintEnglish: Referring to things outside of regular class time.

exampleSimplified: 他的成绩进步很多,真是可喜的事。
exampleTraditional: 他的成績進步很多,真是可喜的事。
exampleEnglish: His grades have improved a lot; that's truly something to be happy about.
hintSimplified: 形容一件好事让人觉得高兴、值得庆祝。
hintTraditional: 形容一件好事讓人覺得高興、值得慶祝。
hintEnglish: Describes a good thing that makes people glad and worth celebrating.

exampleSimplified: 他说的话太可笑了,大家都笑了起来。
exampleTraditional: 他說的話太可笑了,大家都笑了起來。
exampleEnglish: What he said was so ridiculous that everyone started laughing.
hintSimplified: 形容事情很奇怪或不合理,让人想笑。
hintTraditional: 形容事情很奇怪或不合理,讓人想笑。
hintEnglish: Describes something so odd or unreasonable that it makes people laugh.

exampleTraditional: 昨晚看的那部電影真的很恐怖。
exampleEnglish: The movie I watched last night was really terrifying.

hintTraditional: 讓人心裡非常害怕,晚上可能睡不著。
hintEnglish: Makes people feel very afraid, maybe unable to sleep at night.

exampleSimplified: 这次活动吸引了空前多的人参加。

exampleEnglish: This event attracted an unprecedented number of participants.

hintTraditional: 形容以前從來沒有過,是第一次這麼大或這麼多。
hintEnglish: Describes something never seen before, the biggest or most ever.

exampleSimplified: 他很难控制自己的脾气。
exampleTraditional: 他很難控制自己的脾氣。
exampleEnglish: He finds it hard to control his temper.
hintSimplified: 让人或事情照着自己的想法走,不乱来。
hintTraditional: 讓人或事情照著自己的想法走,不亂來。
hintEnglish: To make people or things follow your will and not run wild.

definition: in the air; in the sky

exampleTraditional: 一隻鳥在空中慢慢地飛。
exampleEnglish: A bird flies slowly in the air.
hintSimplified: 离开地面的上方,鸟和飞机所在的地方。
hintTraditional: 離開地面的上方,鳥和飛機所在的地方。
hintEnglish: The area above the ground where birds and planes are.

exampleSimplified: 他口才很好,很会说服别人。
exampleTraditional: 他口才很好,很會說服別人。
exampleEnglish: He has great eloquence and is very good at persuading others.

hintTraditional: 說話清楚、流利又有說服力的能力。
hintEnglish: The ability to speak clearly, fluently and persuasively.

exampleSimplified: 球迷们大声喊着加油的口号。
exampleTraditional: 球迷們大聲喊著加油的口號。
exampleEnglish: The fans shouted cheering slogans loudly.

hintTraditional: 遊行或比賽時大家一起喊的簡短有力的話。
hintEnglish: Short, powerful words shouted together at a march or a game.

exampleSimplified: 她今天擦了一支新买的口红。
exampleTraditional: 她今天擦了一支新買的口紅。
exampleEnglish: She put on a newly bought lipstick today.
hintSimplified: 女生化妆时涂在嘴唇上的东西。
hintTraditional: 女生化妝時塗在嘴唇上的東西。
hintEnglish: What women apply on their lips when putting on makeup.

definition: manner of expression; the way one speaks; tone; tone of voice

exampleTraditional: 聽他的口氣,他好像不太高興。
exampleEnglish: Judging from his tone, he doesn't seem very happy.
hintSimplified: 说话时表现出来的态度或感情。
hintTraditional: 說話時表現出來的態度或感情。
hintEnglish: The attitude or feeling shown in the way someone speaks.

exampleSimplified: 明天的中文口试,我有点紧张。
exampleTraditional: 明天的中文口試,我有點緊張。
exampleEnglish: I'm a bit nervous about tomorrow's Chinese oral exam.
hintSimplified: 不是用笔写,而是用嘴巴回答问题的考试。
hintTraditional: 不是用筆寫,而是用嘴巴回答問題的考試。
hintEnglish: An exam where you answer questions by speaking instead of writing.

exampleSimplified: 看到好吃的蛋糕,他差点流口水。
exampleTraditional: 看到好吃的蛋糕,他差點流口水。
exampleEnglish: Seeing the delicious cake, he almost drooled.
hintSimplified: 看到好吃的东西时,嘴里会出现的液体。
hintTraditional: 看到好吃的東西時,嘴裡會出現的液體。
hintEnglish: The liquid that appears in your mouth when you see tasty food.

exampleSimplified: 听他的口音,我知道他是南方人。
exampleTraditional: 聽他的口音,我知道他是南方人。
exampleEnglish: From his accent, I can tell he is from the south.
hintSimplified: 每个地方的人说话时,发音上的特别味道。
hintTraditional: 每個地方的人說話時,發音上的特別味道。
hintEnglish: The distinctive way of pronouncing words that people from a place have.

definition: CL:門|门[men2]; colloquial speech; gossip; slander; spoken language; vernacular language
exampleSimplified: 他的英文口语非常流利。
exampleTraditional: 他的英文口語非常流利。
exampleEnglish: His spoken English is very fluent.
hintSimplified: 日常说话时用的语言,和书面文字不同。
hintTraditional: 日常說話時用的語言,和書面文字不同。
hintEnglish: The language used in everyday talking, different from written text.

exampleSimplified: 我姐姐在一家公司当会计。

exampleEnglish: My older sister works as an accountant at a company.
hintSimplified: 负责管理公司钱的收入和支出的工作或人。
hintTraditional: 負責管理公司錢的收入和支出的工作或人。
hintEnglish: The job or person that manages a company's income and expenses.

exampleSimplified: 这辆高铁的速度非常快速。
exampleTraditional: 這輛高鐵的速度非常快速。
exampleEnglish: This high-speed train is very fast.
hintSimplified: 形容动作或变化的速度很高,一下子就完成了。
hintTraditional: 形容動作或變化的速度很高,一下子就完成了。
hintEnglish: Describes an action or change that happens at high speed, finished in no time.

definition: to applaud; to compliment; to praise
exampleSimplified: 老师夸奖他这次考试进步很多。
exampleTraditional: 老師誇獎他這次考試進步很多。
exampleEnglish: The teacher praised him for improving a lot on this exam.
hintSimplified: 别人做得好的时候,我们对他说好话表示肯定。
hintTraditional: 別人做得好的時候,我們對他說好話表示肯定。
hintEnglish: When someone does well, we say nice things to show approval.

exampleSimplified: 请你量一下这张桌子的宽度。
exampleTraditional: 請你量一下這張桌子的寬度。
exampleEnglish: Please measure the width of this table.
hintSimplified: 东西从左边到右边的长短,和长度不同。
hintTraditional: 東西從左邊到右邊的長短,和長度不同。
hintEnglish: The measurement of something from one side to the other, different from length.

definition: CL:種|种[zhong3]; design; elegance; elegant; good taste; pattern; style
exampleSimplified: 这家店的衣服款式很多,也很新潮。
exampleTraditional: 這家店的衣服款式很多,也很新潮。
exampleEnglish: This shop has many styles of clothes, and they're very trendy.
hintSimplified: 衣服、手机或家具外观设计的样子或种类。
hintTraditional: 衣服、手機或傢俱外觀設計的樣子或種類。
hintEnglish: The design or type of appearance of clothes, phones or furniture.

definition: brass wind instrument; horn (automobile etc); loudspeaker; suona 鎖吶|锁呐[suo3 na4]; trumpet
exampleSimplified: 外面的汽车一直按喇叭,吵死了。
exampleTraditional: 外面的汽車一直按喇叭,吵死了。
exampleEnglish: The car outside keeps honking its horn; it's so noisy.
hintSimplified: 汽车上按一下会发出很大声音的东西,也是一种乐器的名字。
hintTraditional: 汽車上按一下會發出很大聲音的東西,也是一種樂器的名字。
hintEnglish: The thing on a car that makes a loud sound when pressed; also the name of a type of instrument.

definition: back and forth; repeatedly; return journey; to and fro; to make a round trip
exampleSimplified: 他在房间里来回走了很久。
exampleTraditional: 他在房間裡來回走了很久。
exampleEnglish: He paced back and forth in the room for a long time.
hintSimplified: 从一个地方到另一个地方,再回到原来的地方,重复很多次。
hintTraditional: 從一個地方到另一個地方,再回到原來的地方,重複很多次。
hintEnglish: Going from one place to another and back again, repeated many times.

exampleSimplified: 新年来临,大家都很开心。
exampleTraditional: 新年來臨,大家都很開心。
exampleEnglish: As the New Year arrives, everyone is happy.
hintSimplified: 某个重要的时间或节日快要到了,或刚刚到了。
hintTraditional: 某個重要的時間或節日快要到了,或剛剛到了。
hintEnglish: An important time or festival is about to arrive, or has just arrived.

definition: to be in relation with; to come and go; to have dealings with
exampleSimplified: 我们两家人来往很密切。
exampleTraditional: 我們兩家人來往很密切。
exampleEnglish: Our two families are in close contact.
hintSimplified: 人与人之间互相拜访、联系,保持关系。
hintTraditional: 人與人之間互相拜訪、聯絡,保持關係。
hintEnglish: People visiting and contacting each other, maintaining a relationship.

definition: incoming letter; to send us a letter
exampleSimplified: 我昨天收到了朋友的来信。
exampleTraditional: 我昨天收到了朋友的來信。
exampleEnglish: Yesterday I received a letter from my friend.
hintSimplified: 别人寄给你的一封信。
hintTraditional: 別人寄給你的一封信。
hintEnglish: A letter that someone sent to you.

exampleSimplified: 你知道这个消息的来源吗?
exampleTraditional: 你知道這個訊息的來源嗎?
exampleEnglish: Do you know the source of this news?
hintSimplified: 事情、消息或东西最开始是从哪里来的。
hintTraditional: 事情、訊息或東西最開始是從哪裡來的。
hintEnglish: Where a piece of news or a thing first came from.

definition: From: (in email header); to come from (a place)
exampleSimplified: 这位同学来自法国,会说中文。
exampleTraditional: 這位同學來自法國,會說中文。
exampleEnglish: This classmate comes from France and can speak Chinese.
hintSimplified: 说明一个人或东西原本从哪个地方、国家出来的。
hintTraditional: 說明一個人或東西原本從哪個地方、國家出來的。
hintEnglish: Tells which place or country a person or thing originally comes from.

exampleSimplified: 他不太敢吃辣椒,一吃就流汗。
exampleTraditional: 他不太敢吃辣椒,一吃就流汗。
exampleEnglish: He doesn't dare eat chili peppers; he sweats as soon as he does.
hintSimplified: 一种红色或绿色的蔬菜,吃起来很辣。
hintTraditional: 一種紅色或綠色的蔬菜,吃起來很辣。
hintEnglish: A red or green vegetable that tastes very spicy.

gloss: to not feel like (doing sth); to be disinclined to
definition: to not feel like (doing sth); to be disinclined to
exampleSimplified: 今天太累了,我懒得做饭。
exampleTraditional: 今天太累了,我懶得做飯。
exampleEnglish: I'm too tired today; I can't be bothered to cook.
hintSimplified: 因为觉得麻烦或没力气,不想去做某件事。
hintTraditional: 因為覺得麻煩或沒力氣,不想去做某件事。
hintEnglish: Not wanting to do something because it seems troublesome or you have no energy.

exampleSimplified: 不要浪费食物,吃多少拿多少。
exampleTraditional: 不要浪費食物,吃多少拿多少。
exampleEnglish: Don't waste food; take only as much as you eat.
hintSimplified: 把钱、时间或东西用在没有用的地方。
hintTraditional: 把錢、時間或東西用在沒有用的地方。
hintEnglish: Using money, time or things in a useless way.

exampleSimplified: 我们不能滥用抗生素。
exampleTraditional: 我們不能濫用抗生素。
exampleEnglish: We must not misuse antibiotics.
hintSimplified: 不按规定、过度或随便地使用东西或权力。
hintTraditional: 不按規定、過度或隨便地使用東西或權力。
hintEnglish: Using things or power excessively, carelessly or against the rules.

definition: boss; captain of a boat; eldest child in a family; leader of a criminal gang; leader of a group; old age; very
exampleSimplified: 他是我们这一群朋友的老大。
exampleTraditional: 他是我們這一群朋友的老大。
exampleEnglish: He is the leader of our group of friends.
hintSimplified: 一个团体里最有地位、大家听他的人;也指家里最先出生的孩子。
hintTraditional: 一個團體裡最有地位、大家聽他的人;也指家裡最先出生的孩子。
hintEnglish: The person with the most standing whom others follow; also the firstborn child in a family.

definition: garrulous; nagging; to chatter away; to nag; to prattle
exampleSimplified: 妈妈总是唠叨我要早点睡觉。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽總是嘮叨我要早點睡覺。
exampleEnglish: Mom always nags me to go to bed earlier.
hintSimplified: 同样的话说了又说,让人觉得烦。
hintTraditional: 同樣的話說了又說,讓人覺得煩。
hintEnglish: Saying the same things over and over until people find it annoying.

exampleSimplified: 劳动可以让身体更健康。
exampleTraditional: 勞動可以讓身體更健康。
exampleEnglish: Physical labor can make the body healthier.
hintSimplified: 用身体或力气做事、工作,例如种田或打扫。
hintTraditional: 用身體或力氣做事、工作,例如種田或打掃。
hintEnglish: Doing work with the body or strength, such as farming or cleaning.

exampleSimplified: 许多外籍劳工在工厂里工作。
exampleTraditional: 許多外籍勞工在工廠裡工作。
exampleEnglish: Many foreign laborers work in factories.
hintSimplified: 靠体力工作赚钱的人,常在工厂或工地。
hintTraditional: 靠體力工作賺錢的人,常在工廠或工地。
hintEnglish: People who earn a living by physical work, often in factories or construction sites.

definition: home state or region; native place; place of origin
exampleSimplified: 过年的时候,我要回老家看爷爷奶奶。
exampleTraditional: 過年的時候,我要回老家看爺爺奶奶。
exampleEnglish: During the New Year, I'm going back to my hometown to see my grandparents.
hintSimplified: 一个人出生或家人长期住的地方,过节时常回去。
hintTraditional: 一個人出生或家人長期住的地方,過節時常回去。
hintEnglish: The place where a person was born or whose family has long lived, often visited during festivals.

definition: able-bodied worker; labor; laborer; work force
exampleSimplified: 这个工厂缺少劳力,需要多请一些人。
exampleTraditional: 這個工廠缺少勞力,需要多請一些人。
exampleEnglish: This factory lacks manpower and needs to hire more people.
hintSimplified: 能够工作的人力,特别是需要体力的工作。
hintTraditional: 能夠工作的人力,特別是需要體力的工作。
hintEnglish: People power available for work, especially work requiring physical strength.

definition: autumn of one's years; elderly; old age
exampleSimplified: 他希望老年的生活过得平静又快乐。
exampleTraditional: 他希望老年的生活過得平靜又快樂。
exampleEnglish: He hopes his old age will be peaceful and happy.
hintSimplified: 人生中头发变白、退休以后的那段时间。
hintTraditional: 人生中頭髮變白、退休以後的那段時間。
hintEnglish: The stage of life when hair turns white and one has retired.

exampleSimplified: 他一下班就对同事发牢骚。
exampleTraditional: 他一下班就對同事發牢騷。
exampleEnglish: As soon as he gets off work, he grumbles to his colleagues.
hintSimplified: 对不满意的事情不停地抱怨说出来的话。
hintTraditional: 對不滿意的事情不停地抱怨說出來的話。
hintEnglish: Words said when you keep complaining about things you're unhappy with.

exampleSimplified: 停电了,我们点了一根蜡烛。
exampleTraditional: 停電了,我們點了一根蠟燭。
exampleEnglish: The power went out, so we lit a candle.
hintSimplified: 生日蛋糕上常有的东西,点火后会发光,会慢慢变短。
hintTraditional: 生日蛋糕上常有的東西,點火後會發光,會慢慢變短。
hintEnglish: Often found on a birthday cake; when lit it gives light and slowly gets shorter.

exampleSimplified: 这两件衣服的颜色很类似。
exampleTraditional: 這兩件衣服的顏色很類似。
exampleEnglish: The colors of these two pieces of clothing are very similar.
hintSimplified: 两个东西不完全一样,但是有很多相同的地方。
hintTraditional: 兩個東西不完全一樣,但是有很多相同的地方。
hintEnglish: Two things aren't exactly the same, but share many features.

exampleSimplified: 你喜欢哪一种类型的电影?
exampleTraditional: 你喜歡哪一種類型的電影?
exampleEnglish: What type of movies do you like?
hintSimplified: 把很多东西按特点分成的一种一种。
hintTraditional: 把很多東西按特點分成的一種一種。
hintEnglish: The kinds or categories into which many things are sorted by their features.

definition: (of a place) deserted; quiet; calm; cool-headed; dispassionate
exampleSimplified: 遇到问题时,我们要先冷静下来。
exampleTraditional: 遇到問題時,我們要先冷靜下來。
exampleEnglish: When we run into problems, we should first calm down.
hintSimplified: 遇到紧急的事,不慌张也不生气的样子。
hintTraditional: 遇到緊急的事,不慌張也不生氣的樣子。
hintEnglish: Not panicking or getting angry when something urgent happens.

gloss: a neglected branch (of arts, science, sports etc)
definition: a neglected branch (of arts, science, sports etc); fig. a complete unknown who wins a competition
exampleSimplified: 他选了一个很冷门的专业。
exampleTraditional: 他選了一個很冷門的專業。
exampleEnglish: He chose a very unpopular major.
hintSimplified: 形容很少人关注或选择的领域、专业。
hintTraditional: 形容很少人關注或選擇的領域、專業。
hintEnglish: Describes a field or subject that few people pay attention to or choose.

exampleSimplified: 夏天我常常点一杯冷饮。
exampleTraditional: 夏天我常常點一杯冷飲。
exampleEnglish: In summer I often order a cold drink.
hintSimplified: 天气热时,店里卖的加了冰的饮料。
hintTraditional: 天氣熱時,店裡賣的加了冰的飲料。
hintEnglish: Iced beverages sold in shops when the weather is hot.

definition: content; satisfied; to be happy to do sth; to be ready to do sth; to be willing to do sth

exampleTraditional: 只要你需要,我很樂意幫忙。
exampleEnglish: As long as you need it, I'm happy to help.
hintSimplified: 心里愿意做某件事,不觉得勉强。
hintTraditional: 心裡願意做某件事,不覺得勉強。
hintEnglish: Being inwardly willing to do something without feeling forced.

exampleTraditional: 這個梨子又甜又多汁。

hintTraditional: 一種黃綠色的水果,吃起來脆脆甜甜的,有很多水分。
hintEnglish: A yellow-green fruit that is crisp, sweet and watery.

definition: to make allowances for; to understand; understanding
exampleSimplified: 谢谢你的谅解,我下次会早点到。
exampleTraditional: 謝謝你的諒解,我下次會早點到。
exampleEnglish: Thank you for your understanding; I'll arrive earlier next time.
hintSimplified: 明白别人的难处,不责怪他。
hintTraditional: 明白別人的難處,不責怪他。
hintEnglish: Understanding someone's difficulties and not blaming them.

exampleSimplified: 这个地区今年的粮食收成很好。
exampleTraditional: 這個地區今年的糧食收成很好。
exampleEnglish: This region's grain harvest is very good this year.
hintSimplified: 米、麦等人们每天主要吃的东西。
hintTraditional: 米、麥等人們每天主要吃的東西。
hintEnglish: Rice, wheat and other staples that people eat every day.

definition: alliance; to combine; to join; unite
exampleSimplified: 几个国家联合起来解决这个问题。
exampleTraditional: 幾個國家聯合起來解決這個問題。
exampleEnglish: Several countries joined together to solve this problem.
hintSimplified: 几个人或团体结合在一起,共同做一件事。
hintTraditional: 幾個人或團體結合在一起,共同做一件事。
hintEnglish: Several people or groups come together to do something jointly.

gloss: to link; to join; to connect
definition: to link; to join; to connect
exampleSimplified: 请把手机连接到无线网络。
exampleTraditional: 請把手機連接到無線網路。
exampleEnglish: Please connect your phone to the wireless network.
hintSimplified: 让两个东西接在一起,像网络或电线那样。
hintTraditional: 讓兩個東西接在一起,像網路或電線那樣。
hintEnglish: Making two things join together, like a network or a cable.

exampleSimplified: 看到老人上车,他连忙站起来让座。
exampleTraditional: 看到老人上車,他連忙站起來讓座。
exampleEnglish: Seeing an elderly person board, he quickly stood up to give up his seat.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示很快地做出反应,动作马上发生。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示很快地做出反應,動作馬上發生。
hintEnglish: An adverb showing someone reacts quickly and acts right away.

definition: consecutive; continuous; in a row; serial
exampleSimplified: 这个城市已经连续下了三天雨。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市已經連續下了三天雨。
exampleEnglish: It has rained in this city for three days in a row.
hintSimplified: 一次接着一次,中间没有停。
hintTraditional: 一次接著一次,中間沒有停。
hintEnglish: One after another without a break.

exampleSimplified: 在这个问题上,我们的立场不一样。
exampleTraditional: 在這個問題上,我們的立場不一樣。
exampleEnglish: On this issue, our positions are different.
hintSimplified: 对一件事所站的看法和态度。
hintTraditional: 對一件事所站的看法和態度。
hintEnglish: The view and attitude one takes toward a matter.

exampleSimplified: 听到消息后,他立即回家了。
exampleTraditional: 聽到訊息後,他立即回家了。
exampleEnglish: After hearing the news, he went home immediately.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示事情一发生,马上就做。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示事情一發生,馬上就做。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning to act right as soon as something happens.

definition: in the wee hours; very early in the morning
exampleSimplified: 他凌晨三点才睡觉。
exampleTraditional: 他凌晨三點才睡覺。
exampleEnglish: He didn't go to sleep until three in the early morning.
hintSimplified: 半夜过后、天还没亮的时候。
hintTraditional: 半夜過後、天還沒亮的時候。
hintEnglish: The time after midnight before the sky gets light.

exampleSimplified: 面试时,他系了一条蓝色的领带。
exampleTraditional: 面試時,他繫了一條藍色的領帶。
exampleEnglish: At the interview, he wore a blue tie.
hintSimplified: 男士穿西装时,挂在衬衫领口前面的长布条。
hintTraditional: 男士穿西裝時,掛在襯衫領口前面的長布條。
hintEnglish: A long strip of cloth worn at the shirt collar with a suit.

exampleSimplified: 他的脑筋很灵活,总有好办法。
exampleTraditional: 他的腦筋很靈活,總有好辦法。
exampleEnglish: His mind is very flexible, and he always has good ideas.
hintSimplified: 形容人或动作不死板,反应快,会变通。
hintTraditional: 形容人或動作不死板,反應快,會變通。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or movement that is not rigid, quick and adaptable.

exampleSimplified: 这台机器少了一个零件,不能用。
exampleTraditional: 這臺機器少了一個零件,不能用。
exampleEnglish: This machine is missing a part and can't be used.
hintSimplified: 组成机器的一个个小部分。
hintTraditional: 組成機器的一個個小部分。
hintEnglish: The small individual pieces that make up a machine.

gloss: to retail; to sell in small quantities
definition: to retail; to sell in small quantities
exampleSimplified: 这家店只做零售,不做批发。
exampleTraditional: 這家店只做零售,不做批發。
exampleEnglish: This store only does retail, not wholesale.
hintSimplified: 商店把东西一件一件卖给一般顾客。
hintTraditional: 商店把東西一件一件賣給一般顧客。
hintEnglish: Shops selling items one by one to ordinary customers.

exampleSimplified: 每个国家都要保护自己的领土。
exampleTraditional: 每個國家都要保護自己的領土。
exampleEnglish: Every country must protect its own territory.
hintSimplified: 一个国家所拥有的土地范围。
hintTraditional: 一個國家所擁有的土地範圍。
hintEnglish: The area of land that belongs to a country.

exampleSimplified: 冬天山上的气温常常在零下五度。
exampleTraditional: 冬天山上的氣溫常常在零下五度。
exampleEnglish: In winter the mountain temperature is often five degrees below zero.
hintSimplified: 比结冰的温度还要低。
hintTraditional: 比結冰的溫度還要低。
hintEnglish: Colder than the temperature at which water freezes.

definition: to be in front; to lead
exampleSimplified: 比赛中,我们队一直领先。
exampleTraditional: 比賽中,我們隊一直領先。
exampleEnglish: Our team has been in the lead throughout the game.
hintSimplified: 在比赛或发展中,走在别人前面。
hintTraditional: 在比賽或發展中,走在別人前面。
hintEnglish: Being ahead of others in a competition or in development.

exampleSimplified: 他是这个团体的精神领袖。
exampleTraditional: 他是這個團體的精神領袖。
exampleEnglish: He is the spiritual leader of this group.
hintSimplified: 带领一大群人前进、很有影响力的人。
hintTraditional: 帶領一大群人前進、很有影響力的人。
hintEnglish: A very influential person who guides a large group of people.

definition: ad hoc; as the time draws near; at the last moment; interim; temporary
exampleSimplified: 老师临时决定取消明天的考试。
exampleTraditional: 老師臨時決定取消明天的考試。
exampleEnglish: The teacher decided at the last minute to cancel tomorrow's exam.
hintSimplified: 事情快发生时才决定,不是早就计划好的。
hintTraditional: 事情快發生時才決定,不是早就計劃好的。
hintEnglish: Decided only when the event is about to happen, not planned in advance.

exampleSimplified: 这份礼品是我送给妈妈的生日礼物。
exampleTraditional: 這份禮品是我送給媽媽的生日禮物。
exampleEnglish: This gift is a birthday present I'm giving to my mom.
hintSimplified: 送给别人表示心意的东西,常用漂亮的纸包起来。
hintTraditional: 送給別人表示心意的東西,常用漂亮的紙包起來。

exampleEnglish: The farmer works hard growing vegetables in the field.

exampleSimplified: 这些蔬菜没有用农药，吃起来很安心。

exampleEnglish: We met by a chance opportunity.

definition: to eliminate; to exclude; to reject; to remove; to repel

exampleSimplified: 你要自己判断这个消息是不是真的。

exampleEnglish: You have to judge for yourself whether this news is true.

exampleSimplified: 他弄坏了邻居的车，所以要赔偿。

exampleEnglish: He damaged the neighbor's car, so he has to pay compensation.

hintTraditional: 做錯事造成損失後，用錢或東西補給對方。

exampleSimplified: 我真佩服你，能一个人完成这么多工作。

exampleEnglish: I really admire you for finishing so much work alone.
hintSimplified: 觉得别人很厉害，心里很尊敬。

exampleEnglish: The manager accompanied the guests on a tour of the factory.

hintTraditional: 跟著重要的人一起去，常用在正式場合。

definition: to bump into; to meet (unexpectedly); to run into

exampleTraditional: 我昨天在路上碰見了老同學。
exampleEnglish: Yesterday I ran into an old classmate on the street.

definition: to expand; to inflate; to swell

gloss: (indicating that sb or a group is singled out) precisely; only; of all people

hintTraditional: 只看到事情的一部分，不夠完整。
hintEnglish: Seeing only part of a matter, not complete.

definition: X-ray image; film; film reel; movie; phonograph record; small piece; thin flake

gloss: (of a relationship etc) to break down

gloss: to agree to and sign (a treaty etc)

exampleTraditional: 兩家公司昨天簽訂了合作合同。
exampleEnglish: The two companies signed a cooperation contract yesterday.
hintSimplified: 双方谈好以后,在正式文件上写名字表示同意。
hintTraditional: 雙方談好以後,在正式檔案上寫名字表示同意。
hintEnglish: After both sides agree, writing their names on an official document.

exampleSimplified: 前方有一辆车停在路中间。
exampleTraditional: 前方有一輛車停在路中間。
exampleEnglish: Up ahead, a car is stopped in the middle of the road.
hintSimplified: 自己面对的那一边,离自己还有一段距离的地方。
hintTraditional: 自己面對的那一邊,離自己還有一段距離的地方。
hintEnglish: The side you are facing, at some distance from you.

exampleSimplified: 他在客厅的墙壁上挂了一幅画。
exampleTraditional: 他在客廳的牆壁上掛了一幅畫。
exampleEnglish: He hung a painting on the wall of the living room.
hintSimplified: 房子里围住房间的立面,可以挂照片或画。
hintTraditional: 房子裡圍住房間的立面,可以掛照片或畫。
hintEnglish: The vertical surface enclosing a room, where you can hang photos or paintings.

exampleSimplified: 这个国家的经济越来越强大。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家的經濟越來越強大。
exampleEnglish: This country's economy is growing ever more powerful.
hintSimplified: 形容力量很多,别人很难打败或比得上。
hintTraditional: 形容力量很多,別人很難打敗或比得上。
hintEnglish: Describes having so much strength that others can hardly defeat or match it.

exampleSimplified: 这种材料的强度很高,不容易断。
exampleTraditional: 這種材料的強度很高,不容易斷。
exampleEnglish: This material has high strength and does not break easily.
hintSimplified: 形容材料或力量有多大、多坚固的程度。
hintTraditional: 形容材料或力量有多大、多堅固的程度。
hintEnglish: Describes how great or solid the force or resistance of a material is.

exampleSimplified: 医生用尽办法抢救受伤的病人。
exampleTraditional: 醫生用盡辦法搶救受傷的病人。
exampleEnglish: The doctors used every method to rescue the injured patient.
hintSimplified: 情况很危险时,赶快想办法救人或救东西。
hintTraditional: 情況很危險時,趕快想辦法救人或救東西。
hintEnglish: When things are dangerous, hurrying to save a person or something.

exampleSimplified: 今天的阳光很强烈,出门要戴帽子。
exampleTraditional: 今天的陽光很強烈,出門要戴帽子。
exampleEnglish: The sunlight is very intense today, so wear a hat when you go out.
hintSimplified: 形容感情、光线或反应非常大、很猛。
hintTraditional: 形容感情、光線或反應非常大、很猛。
hintEnglish: Describes feelings, light or reactions that are very great and powerful.

exampleSimplified: 没有人可以强迫你做不想做的事。
exampleTraditional: 沒有人可以強迫你做不想做的事。
exampleEnglish: No one can force you to do something you don't want to do.
hintSimplified: 用压力让别人不得不做某件事。
hintTraditional: 用壓力讓別人不得不做某件事。
hintEnglish: Using pressure so that someone has no choice but to do something.

gloss: (in the workplace, esp. of a woman) a highly capable person
definition: (in the workplace, esp. of a woman) a highly capable person; (old) robber; (politics) strongman
exampleSimplified: 她是公司里有名的女强人。
exampleTraditional: 她是公司裡有名的女強人。
exampleEnglish: She is a well-known high-achieving woman in the company.
hintSimplified: 指在工作上能力特别好、很成功的人。
hintTraditional: 指在工作上能力特別好、很成功的人。
hintEnglish: A person who is exceptionally capable and successful at work.

definition: onward; to advance; to forge ahead; to go forward
exampleSimplified: 遇到困难也不要放弃,要继续往目标前进。
exampleTraditional: 遇到困難也不要放棄,要繼續往目標前進。
exampleEnglish: Even when you meet difficulties, don't give up; keep moving toward your goal.
hintSimplified: 朝着前面的方向走,或者不断进步。
hintTraditional: 朝著前面的方向走,或者不斷進步。
hintEnglish: To move in the direction ahead, or to keep making progress.

definition: above; ahead; at the head; in front
exampleSimplified: 车子停在大楼前头,你看到了吗?
exampleTraditional: 車子停在大樓前頭,你看到了嗎?
exampleEnglish: The car is parked in front of the building; do you see it?
hintSimplified: 表示在某个东西面对的那一边,和后面相反。
hintTraditional: 表示在某個東西面對的那一邊,和後面相反。
hintEnglish: Indicates the side something faces, the opposite of the back.

exampleSimplified: 这个年轻人很努力,前途一片光明。
exampleTraditional: 這個年輕人很努力,前途一片光明。
exampleEnglish: This young man works hard and has a bright future ahead.
hintSimplified: 指一个人以后发展得好不好的可能性。
hintTraditional: 指一個人以後發展得好不好的可能性。
hintEnglish: How well a person's later development may turn out.

definition: countless; many; one must by all means; ten million
exampleSimplified: 开车的时候千万不要喝酒。
exampleTraditional: 開車的時候千萬不要喝酒。
exampleEnglish: Whatever you do, never drink when driving.
hintSimplified: 副词,放在劝告或提醒前面,表示一定要这样。
hintTraditional: 副詞,放在勸告或提醒前面,表示一定要這樣。
hintEnglish: An adverb placed before advice or warnings, meaning it is absolutely necessary.

gloss: to leave for; to proceed towards; to go to
definition: to leave for; to proceed towards; to go to
exampleSimplified: 我们明天早上搭飞机前往日本。
exampleTraditional: 我們明天早上搭飛機前往日本。
exampleEnglish: We will take a plane to Japan tomorrow morning.
hintSimplified: 比较正式的说法,指向某个地方去。
hintTraditional: 比較正式的說法,指向某個地方去。
hintEnglish: A rather formal way to say heading toward a place.

exampleSimplified: 他写了一封信,表达对朋友的歉意。
exampleTraditional: 他寫了一封信,表達對朋友的歉意。
exampleEnglish: He wrote a letter to express his apology to his friend.
hintSimplified: 做错事后,心里觉得对不起别人的感觉。
hintTraditional: 做錯事後,心裡覺得對不起別人的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling of being sorry toward others after doing something wrong.

exampleSimplified: 他们家的前院种了很多花。
exampleTraditional: 他們家的前院種了很多花。
exampleEnglish: Their front yard is planted with many flowers.
hintSimplified: 房子正门前面的那块空地。
hintTraditional: 房子正門前面的那塊空地。
hintEnglish: The open area in front of a house's main entrance.

gloss: to sign a contract or agreement
definition: to sign a contract or agreement
exampleSimplified: 这位球员昨天和球队正式签约了。
exampleTraditional: 這位球員昨天和球隊正式簽約了。
exampleEnglish: The player officially signed a contract with the team yesterday.
hintSimplified: 双方同意条件后,在合同上写下名字。
hintTraditional: 雙方同意條件後,在合同上寫下名字。
hintEnglish: After both sides agree on terms, putting names on a contract.

exampleSimplified: 请在这里签字,然后交给我。
exampleTraditional: 請在這裡簽字,然後交給我。
exampleEnglish: Please sign here and then hand it to me.
hintSimplified: 在文件上亲手写下自己的名字。
hintTraditional: 在檔案上親手寫下自己的名字。
hintEnglish: Writing your own name by hand on a document.

exampleSimplified: 他巧妙地解决了这个难题。
exampleTraditional: 他巧妙地解決了這個難題。
exampleEnglish: He solved this difficult problem in a clever way.
hintSimplified: 形容方法很聪明、很特别,效果又好。
hintTraditional: 形容方法很聰明、很特別,效果又好。
hintEnglish: Describes a method that is smart and unusual and works well.

definition: Taiwan pr. [qiao3qiao3]; anxious; worried; quiet; making little or no noise; surreptitious; stealthy
exampleSimplified: 孩子睡着了,她悄悄地走出房间。
exampleTraditional: 孩子睡著了,她悄悄地走出房間。
exampleEnglish: The child fell asleep, so she quietly walked out of the room.
hintSimplified: 形容动作声音很小,不想让人发现。
hintTraditional: 形容動作聲音很小,不想讓人發現。
hintEnglish: Describes doing something with very little noise so as not to be noticed.

exampleSimplified: 学校买了新的运动器材。
exampleTraditional: 學校買了新的運動器材。
exampleEnglish: The school bought new sports equipment.
hintSimplified: 做某种活动或实验时需要用的各种工具和设备。
hintTraditional: 做某種活動或實驗時需要用的各種工具和裝置。
hintEnglish: The various tools and gear needed for an activity or experiment.

gloss: originally; at first; at the outset
definition: originally; at first; at the outset
exampleSimplified: 起初我不习惯,后来就慢慢适应了。
exampleTraditional: 起初我不習慣,後來就慢慢適應了。
exampleEnglish: At first I wasn't used to it, but later I gradually adapted.
hintSimplified: 表示事情刚开始的时候,后来常常有变化。
hintTraditional: 表示事情剛開始的時候,後來常常有變化。
hintEnglish: Refers to when something had just begun, often followed by a change.

definition: expectation; to await; to look forward to
exampleSimplified: 孩子们都很期待明天的旅行。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們都很期待明天的旅行。
exampleEnglish: The children are all looking forward to tomorrow's trip.
hintSimplified: 希望好事快点发生,心里很盼望。
hintTraditional: 希望好事快點發生,心裡很盼望。
hintEnglish: Hoping that something good will happen soon, with eager anticipation.

exampleSimplified: 听到这个消息,大家都非常气愤。
exampleTraditional: 聽到這個訊息,大家都非常氣憤。
exampleEnglish: Hearing this news, everyone was extremely indignant.
hintSimplified: 遇到不公平的事,心里非常生气。
hintTraditional: 遇到不公平的事,心裡非常生氣。
hintEnglish: Feeling very angry upon encountering something unfair.

exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅的气氛很浪漫。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳的氣氛很浪漫。
exampleEnglish: The atmosphere of this restaurant is very romantic.
hintSimplified: 一个场合给人的整体感觉,比如轻松或紧张。
hintTraditional: 一個場合給人的整體感覺,比如輕鬆或緊張。
hintEnglish: The overall feeling a place or occasion gives, such as relaxed or tense.

exampleSimplified: 心脏是人体很重要的器官。
exampleTraditional: 心臟是人體很重要的器官。
exampleEnglish: The heart is a very important organ of the human body.
hintSimplified: 身体里负责某种功能的部分,例如心、肺、胃。
hintTraditional: 身體裡負責某種功能的部分,例如心、肺、胃。
hintEnglish: A part inside the body with a specific function, like the heart, lungs or stomach.

definition: (fig.) climate; prevailing conditions (in human affairs); (meteorology) climate
exampleSimplified: 台湾的气候温暖潮湿。
exampleTraditional: 台灣的氣候溫暖潮溼。
exampleEnglish: Taiwan's climate is warm and humid.
hintSimplified: 一个地方长时间的天气情况。
hintTraditional: 一個地方長時間的天氣情況。
hintEnglish: The long-term weather conditions of a place.

definition: to catch fire; to cook; to get angry
exampleSimplified: 半夜隔壁的房子突然起火了。
exampleTraditional: 半夜隔壁的房子突然起火了。
exampleEnglish: The house next door suddenly caught fire in the middle of the night.
hintSimplified: 房子或东西开始燃烧,需要打一一九。
hintTraditional: 房子或東西開始燃燒,需要打一一九。
hintEnglish: When a house or thing begins to burn and you need to call the fire department.

exampleSimplified: 亲爱的朋友,最近过得好吗?
exampleTraditional: 親愛的朋友,最近過得好嗎?
exampleEnglish: Dear friend, how have you been lately?
hintSimplified: 写信时放在称呼前面,表示关系亲近、很喜欢的人。
hintTraditional: 寫信時放在稱呼前面,表示關係親近、很喜歡的人。
hintEnglish: Placed before a name in letters to show someone is close and liked.

exampleSimplified: 清晨的空气很新鲜,很多人在公园跑步。
exampleTraditional: 清晨的空氣很新鮮,很多人在公園跑步。
exampleEnglish: The air is fresh in the early morning, and many people jog in the park.
hintSimplified: 这是一天中太阳刚升起、天刚亮的时候。
hintTraditional: 這是一天中太陽剛升起、天剛亮的時候。
hintEnglish: This is the time of day when the sun has just risen and it is just getting light.

definition: to clear away; to eliminate; to get rid of
exampleSimplified: 请把桌子上的垃圾清除干净。
exampleTraditional: 請把桌子上的垃圾清除乾淨。
exampleEnglish: Please clear all the trash off the table.
hintSimplified: 把不需要或不好的东西完全弄走,让地方变干净。
hintTraditional: 把不需要或不好的東西完全弄走,讓地方變乾淨。
hintEnglish: To get rid of unwanted or bad things completely so a place becomes clean.

definition: insipid; light (of food, not greasy or strongly flavored); slack (sales)
exampleSimplified: 我最近胃不舒服,只想吃清淡的食物。
exampleTraditional: 我最近胃不舒服,只想吃清淡的食物。
exampleEnglish: My stomach has been upset lately, so I only want to eat light food.
hintSimplified: 形容食物不油腻、味道不重。
hintTraditional: 形容食物不油膩、味道不重。
hintEnglish: Describes food that is not greasy and not strongly flavored.

exampleSimplified: 这次车祸只有两个人受了轻伤。
exampleTraditional: 這次車禍只有兩個人受了輕傷。
exampleEnglish: In this car accident, only two people suffered minor injuries.
hintSimplified: 受的伤不严重,不用住院太久。
hintTraditional: 受的傷不嚴重,不用住院太久。
hintEnglish: An injury that is not serious and does not need a long hospital stay.

definition: contempt; contemptuous; scornful; to despise; to scorn
exampleSimplified: 不要轻视任何一个对手。
exampleTraditional: 不要輕視任何一個對手。
exampleEnglish: Don't underestimate any opponent.
hintSimplified: 觉得别人或某件事不重要,看不起它。
hintTraditional: 覺得別人或某件事不重要,看不起它。
hintEnglish: To think someone or something is unimportant and look down on it.

exampleSimplified: 他写了一封情书给喜欢的女孩。
exampleTraditional: 他寫了一封情書給喜歡的女孩。
exampleEnglish: He wrote a love letter to the girl he likes.
hintSimplified: 喜欢一个人时,用笔写下心意交给对方的信。
hintTraditional: 喜歡一個人時,用筆寫下心意交給對方的信。
hintEnglish: A letter written by hand to express your feelings to someone you love.

exampleSimplified: 这张照片非常清晰,连小字都看得见。
exampleTraditional: 這張照片非常清晰,連小字都看得見。
exampleEnglish: This photo is very clear; even the small text can be seen.
hintSimplified: 形容图像或声音很清楚,不模糊。
hintTraditional: 形容影象或聲音很清楚,不模糊。
hintEnglish: Describes an image or sound that is sharp and not blurry.

exampleSimplified: 现在的年轻人有晚婚的倾向。
exampleTraditional: 現在的年輕人有晚婚的傾向。
exampleEnglish: Young people today have a tendency to marry late.
hintSimplified: 事情慢慢朝某个方向发展,或人偏向某种想法。
hintTraditional: 事情慢慢朝某個方向發展,或人偏向某種想法。
hintEnglish: When things gradually develop in a certain direction, or someone leans toward an idea.

exampleSimplified: 喝了咖啡以后,我整个人都清醒了。
exampleTraditional: 喝了咖啡以後,我整個人都清醒了。
exampleEnglish: After drinking coffee, I became fully awake.
hintSimplified: 不再想睡觉,头脑很清楚。
hintTraditional: 不再想睡覺,頭腦很清楚。
hintEnglish: No longer sleepy, with a clear mind.

definition: CL:種|种[zhong3]; mood; moodiness; state of mind
exampleSimplified: 考试前他的情绪很紧张。
exampleTraditional: 考試前他的情緒很緊張。
exampleEnglish: His mood was very tense before the exam.
hintSimplified: 人心里高兴、生气或难过的状态。
hintTraditional: 人心裡高興、生氣或難過的狀態。
hintEnglish: The state of feeling happy, angry or sad inside.

definition: to encroach on; to infringe on
exampleSimplified: 这种行为侵害了消费者的权利。
exampleTraditional: 這種行為侵害了消費者的權利。
exampleEnglish: This kind of behavior infringes on consumers' rights.
hintSimplified: 用不对的方式伤害别人的权利或利益。
hintTraditional: 用不對的方式傷害別人的權利或利益。
hintEnglish: To harm someone's rights or interests in an improper way.

definition: fig. in one's own words; one's own mouth; to say sth personally
exampleSimplified: 这件事是他亲口告诉我的。
exampleTraditional: 這件事是他親口告訴我的。
exampleEnglish: He told me this himself.
hintSimplified: 不是别人转告,而是本人用嘴巴直接说出来。
hintTraditional: 不是別人轉告,而是本人用嘴巴直接說出來。
hintEnglish: Not passed on by others, but said directly by the person himself.

exampleSimplified: 我的奶奶是一位勤劳的农妇。
exampleTraditional: 我的奶奶是一位勤勞的農婦。
exampleEnglish: My grandmother is a hardworking farm woman.
hintSimplified: 形容人不怕辛苦,总是认真工作。
hintTraditional: 形容人不怕辛苦,總是認真工作。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is not afraid of hardship and always works earnestly.

definition: CL:門|门[men2],個|个[ge4],位[wei4]; a relative (i.e. family relation)
exampleSimplified: 过年的时候,我们会去拜访亲戚。
exampleTraditional: 過年的時候,我們會去拜訪親戚。
exampleEnglish: During the New Year, we visit relatives.
hintSimplified: 和你有血缘或婚姻关系,但不一定住在一起的人。
hintTraditional: 和你有血緣或婚姻關係,但不一定住在一起的人。
hintEnglish: People related to you by blood or marriage, but who don't necessarily live with you.

exampleSimplified: 在国外生活,他很想念自己的亲人。
exampleTraditional: 在國外生活,他很想念自己的親人。
exampleEnglish: Living abroad, he misses his family very much.
hintSimplified: 和你关系最近的家人。
hintTraditional: 和你關係最近的家人。
hintEnglish: The family members closest to you.

definition: to gain unauthorized access (computing); to intrude into; to invade; to make (military) incursions; to trespass
exampleSimplified: 有人侵入公司的电脑系统,偷走了资料。
exampleTraditional: 有人侵入公司的電腦系統,偷走了資料。
exampleEnglish: Someone broke into the company's computer system and stole data.
hintSimplified: 没有得到允许就进入别人的地方或系统。
hintTraditional: 沒有得到允許就進入別人的地方或系統。
hintEnglish: To enter someone else's place or system without permission.

exampleSimplified: 学校的寝室里住着四个学生。
exampleTraditional: 學校的寢室裡住著四個學生。
exampleEnglish: Four students live in the school dormitory room.
hintSimplified: 学校或公司里,供人晚上睡觉的房间。
hintTraditional: 學校或公司裡,供人晚上睡覺的房間。
hintEnglish: A room at a school or company where people sleep at night.

gloss: cheongsam, a traditional Chinese dress for women, originally a long robe worn by Manchu women, later modernized in 20th-century Shanghai into a close-fitting dress with a high collar and side slits
definition: cheongsam, a traditional Chinese dress for women, originally a long robe worn by Manchu women, later modernized in 20th-century Shanghai into a close-fitting dress with a high collar and side slits
exampleSimplified: 她穿着一件红色的旗袍,看起来很优雅。
exampleTraditional: 她穿著一件紅色的旗袍,看起來很優雅。
exampleEnglish: She wore a red cheongsam and looked very elegant.
hintSimplified: 一种有中国特色的女性长衣服,身体部分很合身。
hintTraditional: 一種有中國特色的女性長衣服,身體部分很合身。
hintEnglish: A traditional long Chinese dress for women, fitted at the body.

exampleSimplified: 他欺骗了朋友,大家都不再相信他。
exampleTraditional: 他欺騙了朋友,大家都不再相信他。
exampleEnglish: He deceived his friends, and nobody trusts him anymore.
hintSimplified: 说假话让别人相信,好得到好处。
hintTraditional: 說假話讓別人相信,好得到好處。
hintEnglish: To tell lies so that others believe you, in order to gain an advantage.

exampleSimplified: 这家商店的商品很齐全,什么都买得到。
exampleTraditional: 這家商店的商品很齊全,什麼都買得到。
exampleEnglish: This store has a complete range of goods; you can buy anything.
hintSimplified: 需要的东西都有,一样不缺。
hintTraditional: 需要的東西都有,一樣不缺。
hintEnglish: Everything needed is there; nothing is missing.

exampleSimplified: 我们不应该因为肤色而歧视别人。
exampleTraditional: 我們不應該因為膚色而歧視別人。
exampleEnglish: We should not discriminate against others because of skin color.
hintSimplified: 因为偏见而不公平地对待某些人。
hintTraditional: 因為偏見而不公平地對待某些人。
hintEnglish: To treat certain people unfairly because of prejudice.

definition: CL:種|种[zhong3]; attempt; to attempt; to try
exampleSimplified: 他企图隐瞒真相,但是失败了。
exampleTraditional: 他企圖隱瞞真相,但是失敗了。
exampleEnglish: He attempted to hide the truth, but failed.
hintSimplified: 心里打算做某件事,常常是不好的或很难的事。
hintTraditional: 心裡打算做某件事,常常是不好的或很難的事。
hintEnglish: To plan in one's mind to do something, often something bad or difficult.

exampleSimplified: 我们学校的球队今年得了冠军。
exampleTraditional: 我們學校的球隊今年得了冠軍。
exampleEnglish: Our school's ball team won the championship this year.
hintSimplified: 一群人组成,一起比赛打篮球或踢足球。
hintTraditional: 一群人組成,一起比賽打籃球或踢足球。
hintEnglish: A group of people who play basketball or soccer matches together.

exampleSimplified: 他在餐厅里拿着戒指向女朋友求婚。
exampleTraditional: 他在餐廳裡拿著戒指向女朋友求婚。
exampleEnglish: He proposed to his girlfriend at the restaurant with a ring.
hintSimplified: 请对方嫁给自己或和自己结为夫妻。
hintTraditional: 請對方嫁給自己或和自己結為夫妻。
hintEnglish: To ask someone to become your spouse.

exampleSimplified: 秋季的天气凉爽,很适合去爬山。
exampleTraditional: 秋季的天氣涼爽,很適合去爬山。
exampleEnglish: The weather in autumn is cool and perfect for hiking.
hintSimplified: 夏天过后、冬天以前的季节,树叶会变黄。
hintTraditional: 夏天過後、冬天以前的季節,樹葉會變黃。
hintEnglish: The season after summer and before winter, when leaves turn yellow.

exampleSimplified: 我每天早上穿球鞋去公园跑步。
exampleTraditional: 我每天早上穿球鞋去公園跑步。
exampleEnglish: Every morning I wear sneakers to go jogging in the park.
hintSimplified: 做运动的时候脚上穿的鞋子。
hintTraditional: 做運動的時候腳上穿的鞋子。
hintEnglish: The shoes you wear on your feet when you do sports.

definition: expectation; hope; to earnestly hope; to have expectations
exampleSimplified: 父母对孩子的期望很高。
exampleTraditional: 父母對孩子的期望很高。
exampleEnglish: Parents have high expectations of their children.
hintSimplified: 希望别人以后能做到某件好事的心情。
hintTraditional: 希望別人以後能做到某件好事的心情。
hintEnglish: The feeling of hoping that someone will achieve something good in the future.

exampleSimplified: 厨房里有一股很香的气味。
exampleTraditional: 廚房裡有一股很香的氣味。
exampleEnglish: There is a very fragrant smell in the kitchen.
hintSimplified: 鼻子闻到的东西,可以是香的,也可以是臭的。
hintTraditional: 鼻子聞到的東西,可以是香的,也可以是臭的。
hintEnglish: What your nose picks up; it can be pleasant or foul.

exampleSimplified: 这里充满了春天的气息。
exampleTraditional: 這裡充滿了春天的氣息。
exampleEnglish: This place is full of the feel of spring.
hintSimplified: 一个地方或季节给人的特别感觉,也可以指呼吸时的空气。
hintTraditional: 一個地方或季節給人的特別感覺,也可以指呼吸時的空氣。
hintEnglish: The special feeling a place or season gives; also the air of one's breathing.

exampleSimplified: 这份报告的期限是下星期五。
exampleTraditional: 這份報告的期限是下星期五。
exampleEnglish: The deadline for this report is next Friday.
hintSimplified: 事情必须在这个时间以前做完。
hintTraditional: 事情必須在這個時間以前做完。
hintEnglish: The time before which a task must be finished.

definition: atmosphere; ambience; scene; meteorological condition; weather; meteorology
exampleSimplified: 气象报告说明天会下大雨。
exampleTraditional: 氣象報告說明天會下大雨。
exampleEnglish: The weather report says it will rain heavily tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 电视上预报天气的专业,常和报告一起用。
hintTraditional: 電視上預報天氣的專業,常和報告一起用。
hintEnglish: The field behind TV forecasts about the sky and rain, often used with 'report'.

exampleSimplified: 最近汽油的价格又涨了。
exampleTraditional: 最近汽油的價格又漲了。
exampleEnglish: The price of gasoline has gone up again recently.
hintSimplified: 机车和汽车需要它才能跑,在加油站买。
hintTraditional: 機車和汽車需要它才能跑,在加油站買。
hintEnglish: Cars and scooters need it to run; you buy it at a station.

definition: apart from them; remainder; remaining; the others; the rest
exampleSimplified: 我先做数学,其余的作业明天再写。
exampleTraditional: 我先做數學,其餘的作業明天再寫。
exampleEnglish: I'll do math first and write the rest of the homework tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 说完一部分以后,用来指剩下的部分。
hintTraditional: 說完一部分以後,用來指剩下的部分。
hintEnglish: Used after naming one part to refer to everything that remains.

exampleSimplified: 周末我们全家一起去海边玩。
exampleTraditional: 週末我們全家一起去海邊玩。
exampleEnglish: This weekend our whole family is going to the beach together.
hintSimplified: 爸爸、妈妈、孩子,一个家里所有的人。
hintTraditional: 爸爸、媽媽、孩子,一個家裡所有的人。
hintEnglish: Dad, mom, kids: everyone in a household.

definition: (classical) power and wealth; right (i.e. an entitlement to sth)
exampleSimplified: 每个人都有受教育的权利。
exampleTraditional: 每個人都有受教育的權利。
exampleEnglish: Everyone has the right to receive an education.
hintSimplified: 法律或社会给人的、可以做某件事的自由和资格。
hintTraditional: 法律或社會給人的、可以做某件事的自由和資格。
hintEnglish: The freedom and entitlement that law or society grants you to do something.

exampleSimplified: 医生帮我做了全面的检查。
exampleTraditional: 醫生幫我做了全面的檢查。
exampleEnglish: The doctor gave me a comprehensive checkup.
hintSimplified: 形容考虑或检查得很完整,没有漏掉哪一方面。
hintTraditional: 形容考慮或檢查得很完整,沒有漏掉哪一方面。
hintEnglish: Describes something complete, leaving no aspect out.

exampleSimplified: 全体同学都参加了毕业典礼。
exampleTraditional: 全體同學都參加了畢業典禮。
exampleEnglish: All the students attended the graduation ceremony.
hintSimplified: 一个团体里每一个人,一个都不少。
hintTraditional: 一個團體裡每一個人,一個都不少。
hintEnglish: Every single person in a group, nobody missing.

gloss: (of a product, service, project etc) flagship; key; core
definition: (of a product, service, project etc) flagship; key; core; fist
exampleSimplified: 他生气地握紧了拳头。
exampleTraditional: 他生氣地握緊了拳頭。
exampleEnglish: He angrily clenched his fist.
hintSimplified: 手指弯起来握紧以后的样子。
hintTraditional: 手指彎起來握緊以後的樣子。
hintEnglish: What the hand looks like when the fingers are curled tight.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; difference; to discriminate; to distinguish; to make a distinction
exampleSimplified: 这两个字的区别很小。
exampleTraditional: 這兩個字的區別很小。
exampleEnglish: The difference between these two characters is very small.
hintSimplified: 两样东西不一样的地方。
hintTraditional: 兩樣東西不一樣的地方。
hintEnglish: The place where two things are not the same.

gloss: to acquire; to get; to obtain
definition: to acquire; to get; to obtain
exampleSimplified: 经过努力,他取得了好成绩。
exampleTraditional: 經過努力,他取得了好成績。
exampleEnglish: After hard work, he achieved good results.
hintSimplified: 通过努力得到成绩、资格或成功。
hintTraditional: 透過努力得到成績、資格或成功。
hintEnglish: To end up with a result, qualification or success through effort.

gloss: to lack; to be short of
definition: to lack; to be short of
exampleSimplified: 现在的年轻人缺乏耐心。
exampleTraditional: 現在的年輕人缺乏耐心。
exampleEnglish: Young people today lack patience.
hintSimplified: 需要的东西不够,常用在经验、信心、水等抽象的东西上。
hintTraditional: 需要的東西不夠,常用在經驗、信心、水等抽象的東西上。
hintEnglish: Not having enough of what is needed, often for abstract things like experience or confidence.

definition: lack; shortage of; shortfall; to be short (of); to lack
exampleSimplified: 这个房间缺少一张桌子。
exampleTraditional: 這個房間缺少一張桌子。
exampleEnglish: This room is missing a table.
hintSimplified: 应该有的东西现在没有,或者数量不够。
hintTraditional: 應該有的東西現在沒有,或者數量不夠。
hintEnglish: Something that should be there is not, or not enough of it.

exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅的菜确实很好吃。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳的菜確實很好吃。
exampleEnglish: The food at this restaurant is indeed delicious.
hintSimplified: 表示事情真的是这样,同意或肯定别人说的话。
hintTraditional: 表示事情真的是這樣,同意或肯定別人說的話。
hintEnglish: Shows that something is truly the case, confirming what has been said.

exampleSimplified: 他生病了,所以今天缺席会议。
exampleTraditional: 他生病了,所以今天缺席會議。
exampleEnglish: He is sick, so he is absent from today's meeting.
hintSimplified: 开会或上课时,你应该来但是没有来。
hintTraditional: 開會或上課時,你應該來但是沒有來。
hintEnglish: You should have come to a meeting or class, but you didn't.

exampleSimplified: 广场上聚集了很多群众。
exampleTraditional: 廣場上聚集了很多群眾。
exampleEnglish: Many people gathered in the square.
hintSimplified: 指一般的很多人,不是官员或特别的人。
hintTraditional: 指一般的很多人,不是官員或特別的人。
hintEnglish: Ordinary people in large numbers, not officials or special figures.

gloss: to tease; to make fun of
definition: to tease; to make fun of
exampleSimplified: 同学们常常取笑他的新发型。
exampleTraditional: 同學們常常取笑他的新發型。
exampleEnglish: His classmates often make fun of his new hairstyle.
hintSimplified: 用话让别人觉得不好意思,拿别人开玩笑。
hintTraditional: 用話讓別人覺得不好意思,拿別人開玩笑。
hintEnglish: Using words to embarrass someone, joking at their expense.

gloss: to cancel; to call off; to revoke; to rescind
definition: to cancel; to call off; to revoke; to rescind
exampleSimplified: 因为下大雨,比赛被取消了。
exampleTraditional: 因為下大雨,比賽被取消了。
exampleEnglish: Because of heavy rain, the match was canceled.
hintSimplified: 原来说好要做的事,后来决定不做了。
hintTraditional: 原來說好要做的事,後來決定不做了。
hintEnglish: Something planned is later decided not to happen.

exampleSimplified: 这个区域禁止停车。
exampleTraditional: 這個區域禁止停車。
exampleEnglish: Parking is forbidden in this area.
hintSimplified: 地图上划出来的一块地方或范围。
hintTraditional: 地圖上劃出來的一塊地方或範圍。
hintEnglish: A section or range marked out on a map.

exampleSimplified: 这个故事的情节非常曲折。
exampleTraditional: 這個故事的情節非常曲折。
exampleEnglish: The plot of this story is very twisting and complicated.
hintSimplified: 形容路不直,或事情发展有很多变化和困难。
hintTraditional: 形容路不直,或事情發展有很多變化和困難。
hintEnglish: Describes a road that isn't straight, or events with many turns and difficulties.

exampleSimplified: 他很聪明,然而并不努力。
exampleTraditional: 他很聰明,然而並不努力。
exampleEnglish: He is very smart; however, he doesn't work hard.
hintSimplified: 放在后一句,表示和前面说的意思相反。
hintTraditional: 放在後一句,表示和前面說的意思相反。
hintEnglish: Placed in the second clause to signal a contrast with what came before.

definition: (linguistics) concessive; a concession; to concede; to give in; to yield
exampleSimplified: 为了达成协议,双方都必须让步。
exampleTraditional: 為了達成協議,雙方都必須讓步。
exampleEnglish: To reach an agreement, both sides must make concessions.
hintSimplified: 谈判时,为了解决问题,放弃一部分自己的要求。
hintTraditional: 談判時,為了解決問題,放棄一部分自己的要求。
hintEnglish: In negotiations, giving up part of your demands in order to solve a problem.

exampleSimplified: 汽车需要燃料才能开动。
exampleTraditional: 汽車需要燃料才能開動。
exampleEnglish: Cars need fuel in order to run.
hintSimplified: 汽油、煤炭、天然气都属于这种东西,可以提供能量。
hintTraditional: 汽油、煤炭、天然氣都屬於這種東西,可以提供能量。
hintEnglish: Gasoline, coal and natural gas are all this kind of thing, providing energy.

definition: combustion; flaming; to burn; to combust; to ignite
exampleSimplified: 木头在火里燃烧,发出温暖的光。
exampleTraditional: 木頭在火裡燃燒,發出溫暖的光。
exampleEnglish: The wood burns in the fire, giving off a warm light.
hintSimplified: 火把东西烧起来的过程。
hintTraditional: 火把東西燒起來的過程。
hintEnglish: The process of fire consuming something.

exampleSimplified: 她非常热爱自己的工作。
exampleTraditional: 她非常熱愛自己的工作。
exampleEnglish: She passionately loves her work.
hintSimplified: 对某件事或某个人有很深很强烈的喜爱。
hintTraditional: 對某件事或某個人有很深很強烈的喜愛。
hintEnglish: To have a deep and intense fondness for something or someone.

definition: calorific value; heat; quantity of heat
exampleSimplified: 这种蛋糕的热量很高,不要吃太多。
exampleTraditional: 這種蛋糕的熱量很高,不要吃太多。
exampleEnglish: This kind of cake is high in calories, so don't eat too much.
hintSimplified: 减肥的人会注意食物里有多少这种东西。
hintTraditional: 減肥的人會注意食物裡有多少這種東西。
hintEnglish: People on a diet pay attention to how much of this food contains.

exampleSimplified: 观众给了他们热烈的掌声。
exampleTraditional: 觀眾給了他們熱烈的掌聲。
exampleEnglish: The audience gave them enthusiastic applause.
hintSimplified: 形容气氛或感情非常活跃、强烈。
hintTraditional: 形容氣氛或感情非常活躍、強烈。
hintEnglish: Describes an atmosphere or emotion that is very lively and intense.

exampleSimplified: 这是今年最热门的旅游景点。
exampleTraditional: 這是今年最熱門的旅遊景點。
exampleEnglish: This is the most popular tourist spot this year.
hintSimplified: 形容很多人都关注、很受欢迎的事物。
hintTraditional: 形容很多人都關注、很受歡迎的事物。
hintEnglish: Describes something that many people pay attention to and like.

definition: attractive looks; looks; talent; talented person
exampleSimplified: 公司正在寻找优秀的人才。
exampleTraditional: 公司正在尋找優秀的人才。
exampleEnglish: The company is looking for outstanding talent.
hintSimplified: 有能力、有专长,公司很想招聘的人。
hintTraditional: 有能力、有專長,公司很想招聘的人。
hintEnglish: People with ability and expertise whom companies want to hire.

exampleSimplified: 我们应该尊重每个人的人格。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該尊重每個人的人格。
exampleEnglish: We should respect everyone's character and dignity.
hintSimplified: 一个人的品德和尊严,代表他是怎样的人。
hintTraditional: 一個人的品德和尊嚴,代表他是怎樣的人。
hintEnglish: A person's moral character and dignity, showing what kind of person they are.

exampleSimplified: 这个湖是人工挖出来的。
exampleTraditional: 這個湖是人工挖出來的。
exampleEnglish: This lake was dug by humans.
hintSimplified: 不是自然形成,而是由人做出来的。
hintTraditional: 不是自然形成,而是由人做出來的。
hintEnglish: Not formed naturally, but made by people.

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂需要很多人力。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠需要很多人力。
exampleEnglish: This factory needs a lot of manpower.
hintSimplified: 做事时需要的工作者和他们的力量。
hintTraditional: 做事時需要的工作者和他們的力量。
hintEnglish: The workers and their strength needed to get things done.

exampleSimplified: 每个人都应该享有基本的人权。
exampleTraditional: 每個人都應該享有基本的人權。
exampleEnglish: Everyone should enjoy basic human rights.
hintSimplified: 每个人生来就应该有的自由和平等等权利。
hintTraditional: 每個人生來就應該有的自由和平等等權利。
hintEnglish: Rights such as freedom and equality that every person should have from birth.

exampleSimplified: 人生有快乐,也有痛苦。
exampleTraditional: 人生有快樂,也有痛苦。
exampleEnglish: Life has joy as well as pain.
hintSimplified: 一个人从出生到去世的整个过程。
hintTraditional: 一個人從出生到去世的整個過程。
hintEnglish: The whole course from a person's birth until death.

definition: (euphemism) sexuality; human affairs; human resources; personnel; the facts of life; ways of the world
exampleSimplified: 他在公司的人事部门工作。
exampleTraditional: 他在公司的人事部門工作。
exampleEnglish: He works in the company's personnel department.
hintSimplified: 公司里负责招聘、员工管理的工作。
hintTraditional: 公司裡負責招聘、員工管理的工作。
hintEnglish: Work in a company that handles hiring and staff management.

exampleSimplified: 他再也无法忍受这么吵的环境了。
exampleTraditional: 他再也無法忍受這麼吵的環境了。
exampleEnglish: He can no longer stand such a noisy environment.
hintSimplified: 遇到很痛苦或不愉快的事,还能耐着性子承受下去。
hintTraditional: 遇到很痛苦或不愉快的事,還能耐著性子承受下去。
hintEnglish: When facing something painful or unpleasant, you manage to put up with it patiently and carry on.

exampleSimplified: 人体大约有百分之七十是水。
exampleTraditional: 人體大約有百分之七十是水。
exampleEnglish: About seventy percent of the human body is water.
hintSimplified: 医学课常研究的,包括头、手、脚和器官的整体。
hintTraditional: 醫學課常研究的,包括頭、手、腳和器官的整體。
hintEnglish: What medical classes often study: the whole including head, hands, feet and organs.

definition: popular feeling; the will of the people
exampleSimplified: 这个好消息让人心大振。
exampleTraditional: 這個好訊息讓人心大振。
exampleEnglish: This good news greatly lifted people's spirits.
hintSimplified: 大众的想法和感情。
hintTraditional: 大眾的想法和感情。
