exampleTraditional: 跑完步以後洗個澡,真痛快!
exampleEnglish: Taking a shower after running feels so refreshing!
hintSimplified: 形容心情非常舒畅、满意,没有烦恼。
hintTraditional: 形容心情非常舒暢、滿意,沒有煩惱。
hintEnglish: Describes feeling very comfortable and satisfied, free of worries.

definition: to correspond (by letter, email etc); to send or receive messages through telecommunications
exampleSimplified: 他们以前常常用写信的方式通信。
exampleTraditional: 他們以前常常用寫信的方式通信。
exampleEnglish: They used to keep in touch by writing letters.
hintSimplified: 两个人用信件或电子邮件互相联系。
hintTraditional: 兩個人用信件或電子郵件互相聯絡。
hintEnglish: Two people contacting each other by letters or email.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; communications; dispatch; news story
exampleSimplified: 现代通讯技术让世界变得更小。
exampleTraditional: 現代通訊技術讓世界變得更小。
exampleEnglish: Modern communication technology makes the world smaller.
hintSimplified: 用电话、网络等传递消息的方式。
hintTraditional: 用電話、網路等傳遞訊息的方式。
hintEnglish: Ways of passing messages by phone, internet and so on.

definition: to unify; to integrate; unified; integrated
exampleSimplified: 老师要我们统一用蓝色的笔写字。
exampleTraditional: 老師要我們統一用藍色的筆寫字。
exampleEnglish: The teacher wants us all to write with blue pens uniformly.
hintSimplified: 让不同的东西变成一样,或合成一个整体。
hintTraditional: 讓不同的東西變成一樣,或合成一個整體。
hintEnglish: To make different things the same, or combine them into one whole.

exampleSimplified: 这位同志,请问图书馆怎么走?
exampleTraditional: 這位同志,請問圖書館怎麼走?
exampleEnglish: Excuse me, comrade, how do I get to the library?
hintSimplified: 一些地方用来称呼志向相同的人,有时也当作礼貌的称呼。
hintTraditional: 一些地方用來稱呼志向相同的人,有時也當作禮貌的稱呼。
hintEnglish: A term used in some places for people sharing the same goals, sometimes a polite address.

definition: regime; rule; to govern; to rule (a country)
exampleSimplified: 这个国家被同一个家族统治了三百年。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家被同一個家族統治了三百年。
exampleEnglish: This country was ruled by the same family for three hundred years.
hintSimplified: 国王或政府用权力管理一个国家和人民。
hintTraditional: 國王或政府用權力管理一個國家和人民。
hintEnglish: A king or government uses power to control a country and its people.

definition: covertly; furtively; on the sly; secretly; stealthily
exampleSimplified: 他偷偷地把礼物放在妈妈的桌子上。
exampleTraditional: 他偷偷地把禮物放在媽媽的桌子上。
exampleEnglish: He secretly put the gift on his mom's desk.
hintSimplified: 不想让别人看见或知道,安静地做某件事。
hintTraditional: 不想讓別人看見或知道,安靜地做某件事。
hintEnglish: Doing something quietly so that others do not see or know.

definition: by means of; to pass through; to penetrate; via
exampleSimplified: 透过窗户,我看见外面下雪了。
exampleTraditional: 透過窗戶,我看見外面下雪了。
exampleEnglish: Through the window, I saw that it was snowing outside.
hintSimplified: 表示经过某个东西或某种方法来看见、了解事情。
hintTraditional: 表示經過某個東西或某種方法來看見、了解事情。
hintEnglish: Shows that you see or understand something via some medium or method.

definition: (fig.) gist (of a matter); boss; brains; leader; mind; skull
exampleSimplified: 他很有头脑,做生意总是很成功。
exampleTraditional: 他很有頭腦,做生意總是很成功。
exampleEnglish: He is very smart and always succeeds in business.
hintSimplified: 指一个人思考和解决问题的能力。
hintTraditional: 指一個人思考和解決問題的能力。
hintEnglish: A person's ability to think and solve problems.

gloss: to vote; to cast a vote
definition: to vote; to cast a vote
exampleSimplified: 今天是选举日,我们全家都去投票。
exampleTraditional: 今天是選舉日,我們全家都去投票。
exampleEnglish: Today is election day, and our whole family is going to vote.
hintSimplified: 选举时,在纸上写下或选出你支持的人。
hintTraditional: 選舉時,在紙上寫下或選出你支援的人。
hintEnglish: At an election, you choose the person you support on a ballot.

definition: absorbed; engrossed; to invest in; to participate in; to put into; to throw into; to throw oneself into
exampleSimplified: 他看电影看得很投入,连电话响了都没听到。
exampleTraditional: 他看電影看得很投入,連電話響了都沒聽到。
exampleEnglish: He was so absorbed in the movie that he didn't even hear the phone ring.
hintSimplified: 把全部的心思和精力放在一件事上。
hintTraditional: 把全部的心思和精力放在一件事上。
hintEnglish: Putting all your attention and energy into one thing.

exampleSimplified: 敌人打不赢了,只好举起手投降。
exampleTraditional: 敵人打不贏了,只好舉起手投降。
exampleEnglish: Unable to win, the enemy had no choice but to raise their hands and surrender.
hintSimplified: 打仗输了以后,承认失败,不再抵抗。
hintTraditional: 打仗輸了以後,承認失敗,不再抵抗。
hintEnglish: After losing a fight, admitting defeat and no longer resisting.

exampleSimplified: 我们班同学很团结,大家互相帮助。
exampleTraditional: 我們班同學很團結,大家互相幫助。
exampleEnglish: The students in our class are very united and help one another.
hintSimplified: 大家心在一起,互相支持,一起努力。
hintTraditional: 大家心在一起,互相支援,一起努力。
hintEnglish: Everyone is of one heart, supporting each other and working together.

definition: outstanding; prominent; to give prominence to; to project; to protrude
exampleSimplified: 他的数学成绩在班上特别突出。
exampleTraditional: 他的數學成績在班上特別突出。
exampleEnglish: His math grades stand out especially in the class.
hintSimplified: 比别人明显更好,一下子就被注意到。
hintTraditional: 比別人明顯更好,一下子就被注意到。
hintEnglish: Clearly better than others, noticed right away.

exampleSimplified: 墙上挂着一幅漂亮的图画。
exampleTraditional: 牆上掛著一幅漂亮的圖畫。
exampleEnglish: A beautiful picture is hanging on the wall.
hintSimplified: 用笔和颜色画出来的东西,可以挂起来看。
hintTraditional: 用筆和顏色畫出來的東西,可以掛起來看。
hintEnglish: Something made with pens and colors that can be hung up to look at.

definition: to abort; to log out (computing); to quit; to withdraw
exampleSimplified: 他因为太忙,决定退出这个社团。
exampleTraditional: 他因為太忙,決定退出這個社團。
exampleEnglish: Because he was too busy, he decided to quit this club.
hintSimplified: 离开一个团体、比赛或程序,不再参加。
hintTraditional: 離開一個團體、比賽或程式,不再參加。
hintEnglish: To leave a group, contest or program and no longer take part.

gloss: to push (e.g. for acceptance of a plan); to promote; to give impetus to
definition: to push (e.g. for acceptance of a plan); to promote; to give impetus to
exampleSimplified: 政府正在推动新的环保政策。
exampleTraditional: 政府正在推動新的環保政策。
exampleEnglish: The government is promoting a new environmental policy.
hintSimplified: 用力量或行动让一件事更快进步或开始实行。
hintTraditional: 用力量或行動讓一件事更快進步或開始實行。
hintEnglish: Using effort or action to make something progress or get started.

exampleSimplified: 人民起来推翻了不公平的政府。
exampleTraditional: 人民起來推翻了不公平的政府。
exampleEnglish: The people rose up and overthrew the unfair government.
hintSimplified: 使原来的政权或看法完全失败、不再存在。
hintTraditional: 使原來的政權或看法完全失敗、不再存在。
hintEnglish: To make an existing regime or opinion fail completely and no longer exist.

definition: generalization; promotion (of a product etc); to extend; to popularize; to spread
exampleSimplified: 公司想把这个新产品推广到全世界。
exampleTraditional: 公司想把這個新產品推廣到全世界。
exampleEnglish: The company wants to promote this new product worldwide.
hintSimplified: 把好的东西或方法让更多的人知道和使用。
hintTraditional: 把好的東西或方法讓更多的人知道和使用。
hintEnglish: Letting more people know about and use a good product or method.

definition: to go back; to return (an item); to send back
exampleSimplified: 这件衣服太小了,我想把它退回去。
exampleTraditional: 這件衣服太小了,我想把它退回去。
exampleEnglish: This piece of clothing is too small, so I want to send it back.
hintSimplified: 把收到的东西送回给原来的人或商店。
hintTraditional: 把收到的東西送回給原來的人或商店。
hintEnglish: Sending something you received back to the original person or store.

exampleSimplified: 上网是了解新闻的重要途径。
exampleTraditional: 上網是了解新聞的重要途徑。
exampleEnglish: Going online is an important way to learn the news.
hintSimplified: 达到目的所走的路或所用的方法。
hintTraditional: 達到目的所走的路或所用的方法。
hintEnglish: The path or method taken to reach a goal.

exampleSimplified: 这件事你处理得很妥当。
exampleTraditional: 這件事你處理得很妥當。
exampleEnglish: You handled this matter very appropriately.
hintSimplified: 形容事情做得合适,没有问题。
hintTraditional: 形容事情做得合適,沒有問題。
hintEnglish: Describes something done suitably, with no problems.

definition: abjunction (botany); abscission; diastasis (medicine); to break away from; to separate oneself from
exampleSimplified: 病人已经脱离了生命危险。
exampleTraditional: 病人已經脫離了生命危險。
exampleEnglish: The patient is already out of life-threatening danger.
hintSimplified: 离开原来的环境、危险或关系,不再有联系。
hintTraditional: 離開原來的環境、危險或關係,不再有聯絡。
hintEnglish: Leaving a former environment, danger or relationship, no longer connected.

exampleSimplified: 请把这些文件妥善保管。
exampleTraditional: 請把這些檔案妥善保管。
exampleEnglish: Please keep these documents safely and properly.
hintSimplified: 形容安排或处理得周到、完整,让人放心。
hintTraditional: 形容安排或處理得周到、完整,讓人放心。
hintEnglish: Describes arrangements made thoroughly so that people feel reassured.

definition: a compromise; to compromise; to reach terms
exampleSimplified: 双方都让了一步,最后终于妥协了。
exampleTraditional: 雙方都讓了一步,最後終於妥協了。
exampleEnglish: Both sides gave way a little and finally reached a compromise.
hintSimplified: 吵架或谈判时,各自让步,不再坚持自己的要求。
hintTraditional: 吵架或談判時,各自讓步,不再堅持自己的要求。
hintEnglish: In an argument or negotiation, each side gives in and stops insisting on its demands.

gloss: (sports) to break through the opponent's defense
definition: (sports) to break through the opponent's defense; to break through; to make a breakthrough; to surmount (an obstacle)
exampleSimplified: 这位科学家在研究上有了重大突破。
exampleTraditional: 這位科學家在研究上有了重大突破。
exampleEnglish: This scientist made a major breakthrough in his research.
hintSimplified: 克服困难或限制,得到很大的进步。
hintTraditional: 克服困難或限制,得到很大的進步。
hintEnglish: Overcoming difficulties or limits to make great progress.

definition: CL:本[ben3],冊|册[ce4],部[bu4]; books (in a library or bookstore)
exampleSimplified: 学校的图书很多,我们可以免费借回家看。
exampleTraditional: 學校的圖書很多,我們可以免費借回家看。
exampleEnglish: The school has many books, and we can borrow them for free to read at home.
hintSimplified: 学校或公共的馆里收藏的书籍,大家可以去借来看。
hintTraditional: 學校或公共的館裡收藏的書籍,大家可以去借來看。
hintEnglish: The books kept in a school or public library that people can go and borrow to read.

exampleSimplified: 请在这张表格上盖一个图章。
exampleTraditional: 請在這張表格上蓋一個圖章。
exampleEnglish: Please stamp a seal on this form.
hintSimplified: 沾上红色印泥后,盖在纸上表示名字或同意的小工具。
hintTraditional: 沾上紅色印泥後,蓋在紙上表示名字或同意的小工具。
hintEnglish: A small tool dipped in red ink and pressed onto paper to show a name or approval.

exampleSimplified: 不要只看外表,内在更重要。
exampleTraditional: 不要只看外表,內在更重要。
exampleEnglish: Don't only look at appearances; what's inside is more important.
hintSimplified: 一个人或东西表面上看起来的样子。
hintTraditional: 一個人或東西表面上看起來的樣子。
hintEnglish: How a person or thing looks on the surface.

exampleSimplified: 这个问题是由外部原因造成的。
exampleTraditional: 這個問題是由外部原因造成的。
exampleEnglish: This problem was caused by outside factors.
hintSimplified: 和“内部”相对,指范围以外的地方。
hintTraditional: 和“內部”相對,指範圍以外的地方。
hintEnglish: The opposite of inside; the area beyond a given boundary.

gloss: to go away (on a trip etc)
definition: to go away (on a trip etc); to go out
exampleSimplified: 他今天早上外出办事,还没回来。
exampleTraditional: 他今天早上外出辦事,還沒回來。
exampleEnglish: He went out this morning to run an errand and hasn't come back yet.
hintSimplified: 离开家或办公室,到别的地方去。
hintTraditional: 離開家或辦公室,到別的地方去。
hintEnglish: To leave home or the office and go somewhere else.

gloss: parts of the country other than where one is
definition: parts of the country other than where one is
exampleSimplified: 他在外地工作,过年才回家。
exampleTraditional: 他在外地工作,過年才回家。
exampleEnglish: He works in another part of the country and only comes home for New Year.
hintSimplified: 不是你现在住的城市,而是国内别的地方。
hintTraditional: 不是你現在住的城市,而是國內別的地方。
hintEnglish: Not the city where you live, but another place within the country.

exampleSimplified: 这栋大楼的外观很特别。
exampleTraditional: 這棟大樓的外觀很特別。
exampleEnglish: The exterior look of this building is very special.
hintSimplified: 东西从外面看起来的样子。
hintTraditional: 東西從外面看起來的樣子。
hintEnglish: How something looks from the outside.

exampleSimplified: 我对电脑是外行,你别问我。
exampleTraditional: 我對電腦是外行,你別問我。
exampleEnglish: I'm a layman when it comes to computers, so don't ask me.
hintSimplified: 对某件事不懂,不是专家的人。
hintTraditional: 對某件事不懂,不是專家的人。
hintEnglish: Someone who doesn't know a field well and is not an expert.

exampleSimplified: 出国前,我先去银行换了一些外汇。
exampleTraditional: 出國前,我先去銀行換了一些外匯。
exampleEnglish: Before going abroad, I went to the bank to get some foreign currency.
hintSimplified: 去外国旅行时,要把本国钱换成别国的钱。
hintTraditional: 去外國旅行時,要把本國錢換成別國的錢。
hintEnglish: When traveling abroad, you swap your own money for another country's money.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; diplomacy; diplomatic; foreign affairs
exampleSimplified: 他在政府里负责外交工作。
exampleTraditional: 他在政府裡負責外交工作。
exampleEnglish: He is in charge of diplomatic work in the government.
hintSimplified: 国家和国家之间来往、谈判的事务。
hintTraditional: 國家和國家之間來往、談判的事務。
hintEnglish: The business of dealing and negotiating between countries.

exampleSimplified: 外界对这件事有很多不同的看法。
exampleTraditional: 外界對這件事有很多不同的看法。
exampleEnglish: The outside world has many different opinions about this matter.
hintSimplified: 指某个团体或圈子以外的人和环境。
hintTraditional: 指某個團體或圈子以外的人和環境。
hintEnglish: Refers to people and things outside a certain group or circle.

exampleSimplified: 他的腿受伤了,要去医院看外科。
exampleTraditional: 他的腿受傷了,要去醫院看外科。
exampleEnglish: His leg is injured, so he has to see the surgery department at the hospital.
hintSimplified: 医院里需要动手术的那一科。
hintTraditional: 醫院裡需要動手術的那一科。
hintEnglish: The hospital department that performs operations.

definition: the younger generation; those who come after
exampleSimplified: 我们要多关心家里的晚辈。
exampleTraditional: 我們要多關心家裡的晚輩。
exampleEnglish: We should show more care for the younger members of the family.
hintSimplified: 年纪比你小、辈分比你低的人。
hintTraditional: 年紀比你小、輩分比你低的人。
hintEnglish: People who are younger than you and lower in family rank.

definition: to complete; to end; to finish
exampleSimplified: 检查完毕,你可以回家了。
exampleTraditional: 檢查完畢,你可以回家了。
exampleEnglish: The examination is finished; you can go home now.
hintSimplified: 事情已经做完,常在正式的场合说。
hintTraditional: 事情已經做完,常在正式的場合說。
hintEnglish: The matter is done; often said in formal situations.

exampleSimplified: 这场演出非常完美,大家都鼓掌了。
exampleTraditional: 這場演出非常完美,大家都鼓掌了。
exampleEnglish: This performance was perfect, and everyone applauded.
hintSimplified: 没有任何缺点,好得不能再好。
hintTraditional: 沒有任何缺點,好得不能再好。
hintEnglish: Without any flaw; as good as it can possibly be.

definition: (of systems, facilities etc) comprehensive; excellent; to improve; to refine; well-developed
exampleSimplified: 这家医院的设备很完善。
exampleTraditional: 這家醫院的裝置很完善。
exampleEnglish: This hospital's equipment is very comprehensive.
hintSimplified: 制度或设备样样齐全,而且很周到。
hintTraditional: 制度或裝置樣樣齊全,而且很周到。
hintEnglish: A system or facilities that have everything and are well thought out.

exampleSimplified: 你别生气,我只是开个玩笑。
exampleTraditional: 你別生氣,我只是開個玩笑。
exampleEnglish: Don't be angry, I was just making a joke.
hintSimplified: 为了让大家开心而说的话,不是认真的。
hintTraditional: 為了讓大家開心而說的話,不是認真的。
hintEnglish: Words said to amuse people, not meant seriously.

exampleSimplified: 他弯腰捡起地上的钱包。
exampleTraditional: 他彎腰撿起地上的錢包。
exampleEnglish: He bent down and picked up the wallet on the ground.
hintSimplified: 身体向前低下,比如要捡地上的东西时。
hintTraditional: 身體向前低下,比如要撿地上的東西時。
hintEnglish: Lowering your upper body forward, such as to pick something up from the floor.

exampleSimplified: 请把这个故事完整地讲一遍。
exampleTraditional: 請把這個故事完整地講一遍。
exampleEnglish: Please tell this story completely from start to finish.
hintSimplified: 东西或内容没有缺少任何部分。
hintTraditional: 東西或內容沒有缺少任何部分。
hintEnglish: Nothing is missing; all the parts are there.

exampleSimplified: 做完饭后,记得关掉瓦斯。
exampleTraditional: 做完飯後,記得關掉瓦斯。
exampleEnglish: After cooking, remember to turn off the gas.
hintSimplified: 厨房炉子用的燃料,用完要关好。
hintTraditional: 廚房爐子用的燃料,用完要關好。
hintEnglish: The fuel used by a kitchen stove, which must be turned off after use.

exampleSimplified: 小狗高兴得一直摇尾巴。
exampleTraditional: 小狗高興得一直搖尾巴。
exampleEnglish: The puppy was so happy it kept wagging its tail.
hintSimplified: 很多动物身体后面长的那一部分,狗高兴时会摇它。
hintTraditional: 很多動物身體後面長的那一部分,狗高興時會搖它。
hintEnglish: The part at the back of many animals' bodies; dogs wag it when happy.

exampleSimplified: 开车超速是违反交通规则的。
exampleTraditional: 開車超速是違反交通規則的。
exampleEnglish: Speeding goes against traffic rules.
hintSimplified: 做了规则或法律不允许的事。
hintTraditional: 做了規則或法律不允許的事。
hintEnglish: Doing something that rules or laws do not allow.

exampleSimplified: 你为何今天没来上课?
exampleTraditional: 你為何今天沒來上課?
exampleEnglish: Why didn't you come to class today?
hintSimplified: 书面语里用来问原因的疑问词。
hintTraditional: 書面語裡用來問原因的疑問詞。
hintEnglish: A question word used in written language to ask for a reason.

definition: to defend; to maintain; to protect; to safeguard; to uphold
exampleSimplified: 我们应该维护自己的权利。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該維護自己的權利。
exampleEnglish: We should defend our own rights.
hintSimplified: 保护某样东西,让它不受伤害或保持良好。
hintTraditional: 保護某樣東西,讓它不受傷害或保持良好。
hintEnglish: Protecting something so it isn't harmed and stays in good condition.

exampleSimplified: 表格上要填写已婚还是未婚。
exampleTraditional: 表格上要填寫已婚還是未婚。
exampleEnglish: On the form you need to fill in whether you are married or unmarried.
hintSimplified: 还没有结婚的状态。
hintTraditional: 還沒有結婚的狀態。
hintEnglish: The state of not having gotten married yet.

exampleSimplified: 公司现在遇到了很大的危机。
exampleTraditional: 公司現在遇到了很大的危機。
exampleEnglish: The company is now facing a serious crisis.
hintSimplified: 情况非常危险,可能出大问题的时刻。
hintTraditional: 情況非常危險,可能出大問題的時刻。
hintEnglish: A very dangerous moment when big problems might occur.

exampleSimplified: 妈妈做汤的时候不放味精。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽做湯的時候不放味精。
exampleEnglish: Mom doesn't put MSG in when she makes soup.
hintSimplified: 一种白色小颗粒,放进菜里可以让味道更鲜。
hintTraditional: 一種白色小顆粒,放進菜裡可以讓味道更鮮。
hintEnglish: A white crystalline seasoning that makes dishes taste more savory.

definition: to feel embarrassed or awkward; to find things difficult (to do or manage); to make things difficult (for someone)
exampleSimplified: 你别为难他了,他也没有办法。
exampleTraditional: 你別為難他了,他也沒有辦法。
exampleEnglish: Don't make things difficult for him; he has no way out either.
hintSimplified: 让别人觉得很难办,不知道该怎么做。
hintTraditional: 讓別人覺得很難辦,不知道該怎麼做。
hintEnglish: Putting someone in a spot where they don't know what to do.

definition: sense of being wronged; to inconvenience; to put (sb) at a disadvantage; to do sb wrong; wronged; aggrieved
exampleSimplified: 明明不是我的错,却被骂了,我觉得很委屈。
exampleTraditional: 明明不是我的錯,卻被罵了,我覺得很委屈。
exampleEnglish: It clearly wasn't my fault but I got scolded, so I feel wronged.
hintSimplified: 被误会或不公平对待时,心里难过的感觉。
hintTraditional: 被誤會或不公平對待時,心裡難過的感覺。
hintEnglish: The sad feeling when you are misunderstood or treated unfairly.

exampleSimplified: 饭前要洗手,这是好的卫生习惯。
exampleTraditional: 飯前要洗手,這是好的衛生習慣。
exampleEnglish: Washing your hands before meals is a good hygiene habit.
hintSimplified: 保持干净,不让细菌和疾病传开的状况。
hintTraditional: 保持乾淨,不讓細菌和疾病傳開的狀況。
hintEnglish: Keeping things clean so germs and disease don't spread.

definition: to commission; to entrust; to trust
exampleSimplified: 他把这件事委托给律师处理。
exampleTraditional: 他把這件事委託給律師處理。
exampleEnglish: He entrusted this matter to a lawyer to handle.
hintSimplified: 自己不做,正式请别人代替你去办事。
hintTraditional: 自己不做,正式請別人代替你去辦事。
hintEnglish: Formally asking someone else to handle a task on your behalf.

gloss: to express sympathy, greetings, consolation etc
definition: to express sympathy, greetings, consolation etc
exampleSimplified: 老师去医院慰问生病的同学。
exampleTraditional: 老師去醫院慰問生病的同學。
exampleEnglish: The teacher went to the hospital to visit and comfort the sick classmate.
hintSimplified: 去看望遇到困难或生病的人,说些关心安慰的话。
hintTraditional: 去看望遇到困難或生病的人,說些關心安慰的話。
hintEnglish: Visiting someone in trouble or ill and offering caring, comforting words.

exampleSimplified: 空气污染威胁着我们的健康。
exampleTraditional: 空氣汙染威脅著我們的健康。
exampleEnglish: Air pollution threatens our health.
hintSimplified: 让人觉得会有危险或受到伤害,感到不安全。
hintTraditional: 讓人覺得會有危險或受到傷害,感到不安全。
hintEnglish: Making someone feel they may be in danger or harmed.

exampleSimplified: 这颗卫星每天绕着地球转。
exampleTraditional: 這顆衛星每天繞著地球轉。
exampleEnglish: This satellite orbits the Earth every day.
hintSimplified: 人造的东西,在太空中绕着地球转,可以传送信号。
hintTraditional: 人造的東西,在太空中繞著地球轉,可以傳送訊號。
hintEnglish: A man-made object in space circling the Earth, relaying signals.

exampleSimplified: 这是我唯一的机会,一定要好好把握。
exampleTraditional: 這是我唯一的機會,一定要好好把握。
exampleEnglish: This is my only chance; I must seize it.
hintSimplified: 表示只有一个,没有别的了。
hintTraditional: 表示只有一個,沒有別的了。
hintEnglish: Means there is just one and no others.

definition: to be located at; to be situated at; to lie
exampleSimplified: 这家医院位于台北市中心。
exampleTraditional: 這家醫院位於台北市中心。
exampleEnglish: This hospital is located in downtown Taipei.
hintSimplified: 用来说明某个地方在什么位置。
hintTraditional: 用來說明某個地方在什麼位置。
hintEnglish: Used to say where a place is situated.

exampleSimplified: 他是学校委员会的委员。
exampleTraditional: 他是學校委員會的委員。
exampleEnglish: He is a member of the school committee.
hintSimplified: 在一个小组或会议里负责讨论和决定事情的人。
hintTraditional: 在一個小組或會議裡負責討論和決定事情的人。
hintEnglish: A person in a panel or board who discusses and decides matters.

exampleSimplified: 她的个性很温和,从不生气。
exampleTraditional: 她的個性很溫和,從不生氣。
exampleEnglish: She has a gentle personality and never gets angry.
hintSimplified: 形容人的性格或天气,不激烈,让人觉得舒服。
hintTraditional: 形容人的性格或天氣,不激烈,讓人覺得舒服。
hintEnglish: Describes a person's manner or climate that is mild and not harsh.

gloss: item of stationery (pen, pencil, eraser, pencil sharpener etc)
definition: item of stationery (pen, pencil, eraser, pencil sharpener etc); stationery
exampleSimplified: 我去文具店买了笔和橡皮擦。
exampleTraditional: 我去文具店買了筆和橡皮擦。
exampleEnglish: I went to the stationery store and bought pens and erasers.
hintSimplified: 笔、尺、橡皮擦这些学习时用的东西。
hintTraditional: 筆、尺、橡皮擦這些學習時用的東西。
hintEnglish: Things like pens, rulers and erasers used for studying.

exampleSimplified: 他拿到了大学的文凭。
exampleTraditional: 他拿到了大學的文憑。
exampleEnglish: He received his university diploma.
hintSimplified: 毕业时学校给的证明,找工作时常要用。
hintTraditional: 畢業時學校給的證明,找工作時常要用。
hintEnglish: A certificate from school at graduation, often needed for job hunting.

definition: CL:件[jian4],個|个[ge4]; cultural relic; historical relic
exampleSimplified: 博物馆里有很多珍贵的文物。
exampleTraditional: 博物館裡有很多珍貴的文物。
exampleEnglish: The museum has many precious cultural relics.
hintSimplified: 古代留下来的有历史价值的东西,常在博物馆里看到。
hintTraditional: 古代留下來的有歷史價值的東西,常在博物館裡看到。
hintEnglish: Valuable historical items left from ancient times, seen in museums.

exampleSimplified: 她很喜欢文艺活动,常去看展览。
exampleTraditional: 她很喜歡文藝活動,常去看展覽。
exampleEnglish: She loves arts and literature activities and often goes to exhibitions.
hintSimplified: 跟文学、音乐、绘画这些艺术有关的。
hintTraditional: 跟文學、音樂、繪畫這些藝術有關的。
hintEnglish: Related to literature, music, painting and other arts.

exampleSimplified: 她从小就学习民族舞蹈。
exampleTraditional: 她從小就學習民族舞蹈。
exampleEnglish: She has studied folk dance since she was little.
hintSimplified: 用身体配合音乐做出的优美动作艺术。
hintTraditional: 用身體配合音樂做出的優美動作藝術。
hintEnglish: An art of graceful body movements set to music.

definition: behind schedule; delayed; late (public transport, airlines); not on time; overdue
exampleSimplified: 因为下大雨,火车误点了。
exampleTraditional: 因為下大雨,火車誤點了。
exampleEnglish: Because of heavy rain, the train was late.
hintSimplified: 火车或飞机没有按时间表到达或出发。
hintTraditional: 火車或飛機沒有按時間表到達或出發。
hintEnglish: When a train or plane doesn't arrive or leave on schedule.

gloss: physical; relating to the material world
definition: physical; relating to the material world; physics
exampleSimplified: 我最喜欢上物理课,因为很有趣。
exampleTraditional: 我最喜歡上物理課,因為很有趣。
exampleEnglish: I like physics class best because it's interesting.
hintSimplified: 研究力、光、热、运动的科学课程。
hintTraditional: 研究力、光、熱、運動的科學課程。
hintEnglish: A science subject studying force, light, heat and motion.

definition: no matter what or how; regardless of whether...
exampleSimplified: 无论天气好不好,我都要去跑步。
exampleTraditional: 無論天氣好不好,我都要去跑步。
exampleEnglish: No matter whether the weather is good or not, I will go running.
hintSimplified: 表示不管什么条件,结果都一样,后面常接“都”。
hintTraditional: 表示不管什麼條件,結果都一樣,後面常接“都”。
hintEnglish: Indicates that whatever the condition, the result is the same; often followed by 都.

exampleSimplified: 警察发现他身上带着武器。
exampleTraditional: 警察發現他身上帶著武器。
exampleEnglish: The police found he was carrying a weapon.
hintSimplified: 枪、刀这类用来打仗或攻击的工具。
hintTraditional: 槍、刀這類用來打仗或攻擊的工具。
hintEnglish: Tools like guns or knives used in fighting or attack.

exampleSimplified: 时间对每个人都很无情。
exampleTraditional: 時間對每個人都很無情。
exampleEnglish: Time is merciless to everyone.
hintSimplified: 形容没有同情心,不管别人感受的样子。
hintTraditional: 形容沒有同情心,不管別人感受的樣子。
hintEnglish: Describes someone without compassion who ignores others' feelings.

exampleSimplified: 夜空中有无数颗星星。
exampleTraditional: 夜空中有無數顆星星。
exampleEnglish: There are countless stars in the night sky.
hintSimplified: 多到数不清。
hintTraditional: 多到數不清。
hintEnglish: So many that they cannot be counted.

definition: CL:種|种[zhong3]; all kinds of martial art sports (some claiming spiritual development); also called kungfu 功夫; military skill or technique (in former times); self-defense; tradition of choreographed fights from opera and film (recent usage)
exampleSimplified: 他从小跟着爷爷学武术。
exampleTraditional: 他從小跟著爺爺學武術。
exampleEnglish: He has learned martial arts with his grandfather since childhood.
hintSimplified: 中国传统的打拳、练功夫的运动。
hintTraditional: 中國傳統的打拳、練功夫的運動。
hintEnglish: Traditional Chinese fighting and kung fu training.

exampleSimplified: 歌手站在舞台上唱歌。
exampleTraditional: 歌手站在舞台上唱歌。
exampleEnglish: The singer stands on the stage and sings.
hintSimplified: 演员或歌手表演时站的高高的地方。
hintTraditional: 演員或歌手錶演時站的高高的地方。
hintEnglish: The raised place where actors or singers perform.

exampleSimplified: 周末他们常去舞厅跳舞。
exampleTraditional: 週末他們常去舞廳跳舞。
exampleEnglish: On weekends they often go dancing at the dance hall.
hintSimplified: 一个有音乐、大家可以跳舞的室内场所。
hintTraditional: 一個有音樂、大家可以跳舞的室內場所。
hintEnglish: An indoor venue with music where people go to dance.

exampleSimplified: 孩子的想象力是无限的。
exampleTraditional: 孩子的想象力是無限的。
exampleEnglish: Children's imagination is unlimited.
hintSimplified: 没有尽头,没有范围的限制。
hintTraditional: 沒有盡頭,沒有範圍的限制。
hintEnglish: Having no end and no boundary.

definition: accidental; inadvertent; to have no intention of (doing sth)
exampleSimplified: 我无意中听到了他们的谈话。
exampleTraditional: 我無意中聽到了他們的談話。
exampleEnglish: I accidentally overheard their conversation.
hintSimplified: 不是故意的,事先没有打算。
hintTraditional: 不是故意的,事先沒有打算。
hintEnglish: Not on purpose; without prior intention.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; material; materialistic; matter; substance
exampleSimplified: 随着生活水平提高,人们对物质的要求也越来越高。
exampleTraditional: 隨著生活水平提高,人們對物質的要求也越來越高。
exampleEnglish: As living standards rise, people's material demands are getting higher and higher.
hintSimplified: 和精神相对,指看得见、摸得着的东西。
hintTraditional: 和精神相對,指看得見、摸得著的東西。
hintEnglish: The opposite of spirit; it refers to things you can see and touch.

exampleSimplified: 我晚上想吃炒虾子。
exampleTraditional: 我晚上想吃炒蝦子。
exampleEnglish: I want to eat stir-fried shrimp tonight.
hintSimplified: 一种海里的小动物,身体弯弯的,煮熟后变红。
hintTraditional: 一種海里的小動物,身體彎彎的,煮熟後變紅。
hintEnglish: A small sea creature with a curved body that turns red when cooked.

exampleSimplified: 他的下巴上长了一颗痘痘。
exampleTraditional: 他的下巴上長了一顆痘痘。
exampleEnglish: He has a pimple on his chin.
hintSimplified: 脸最下面的部分,在嘴巴的下方。
hintTraditional: 臉最下面的部分,在嘴巴的下方。
hintEnglish: The lowest part of the face, below the mouth.

definition: to decline; to decrease; to drop; to fall; to go down
exampleSimplified: 今年的气温明显下降了。
exampleTraditional: 今年的氣溫明顯下降了。
exampleEnglish: The temperature has dropped noticeably this year.
hintSimplified: 数量、价格或温度变得比以前低。
hintTraditional: 數量、價格或溫度變得比以前低。
hintEnglish: When a number, price or temperature becomes lower than before.

gloss: (Tw) (coll.) what (from Taiwanese 啥物, Tai-lo pr. [siánn-mih], equivalent to Mandarin 什麼|什么[shen2 me5])
definition: (Tw) (coll.) what (from Taiwanese 啥物, Tai-lo pr. [siánn-mih], equivalent to Mandarin 什麼|什么[shen2 me5]); small shrimp; dried, shelled shrimps
exampleSimplified: 你刚刚说虾米?我没听清楚。
exampleTraditional: 你剛剛說蝦米?我沒聽清楚。
exampleEnglish: What did you just say? I didn't hear clearly.
hintSimplified: 台湾人聊天时常用的口语,来自闽南语,用来问事情。
hintTraditional: 台灣人聊天時常用的口語,來自閩南語,用來問事情。
hintEnglish: A colloquial word from Taiwanese Hokkien that Taiwanese use in chat to ask about something.

definition: (at) the site; (on) the spot; the scene (of a crime, accident etc)
exampleSimplified: 记者正在事故现场报道。
exampleTraditional: 記者正在事故現場報道。
exampleEnglish: The reporter is reporting live from the scene of the accident.
hintSimplified: 事情发生的那个地方,电视记者常常站在这里。
hintTraditional: 事情發生的那個地方,電視記者常常站在這裡。
hintEnglish: The place where something happens, where TV reporters often stand.

exampleSimplified: 冰箱里有现成的饭菜,你自己热一下吧。
exampleTraditional: 冰箱裡有現成的飯菜,你自己熱一下吧。
exampleEnglish: There is ready-made food in the fridge; just heat it up yourself.
hintSimplified: 不用再准备或制作,马上就可以用的。
hintTraditional: 不用再準備或製作,馬上就可以用的。
hintEnglish: Needing no further preparation; ready to use right away.

definition: to appear; to look; to seem
exampleSimplified: 她穿上这件衣服显得很年轻。
exampleTraditional: 她穿上這件衣服顯得很年輕。
exampleEnglish: She looks very young in this outfit.
hintSimplified: 表示给人某种看起来的感觉或样子。
hintTraditional: 表示給人某種看起來的感覺或樣子。
hintEnglish: Indicates the impression or look that something gives.

exampleSimplified: 这家小店藏在一条安静的巷子里。
exampleTraditional: 這家小店藏在一條安靜的巷子裡。
exampleEnglish: This little shop is hidden in a quiet alley.
hintSimplified: 大马路旁边又窄又小的路。
hintTraditional: 大馬路旁邊又窄又小的路。
hintEnglish: A narrow, small road beside a main street.

exampleSimplified: 动物园里的大象鼻子很长。
exampleTraditional: 動物園裡的大象鼻子很長。
exampleEnglish: The elephant at the zoo has a very long trunk.
hintSimplified: 陆地上最大的动物,有长鼻子和大耳朵。
hintTraditional: 陸地上最大的動物,有長鼻子和大耳朵。
hintEnglish: The largest land animal, with a long trunk and big ears.

exampleSimplified: 夜市里的烤香肠很好吃。
exampleTraditional: 夜市裡的烤香腸很好吃。
exampleEnglish: The grilled sausages at the night market are delicious.
hintSimplified: 用肉做成的长条形食物,常常烤着吃。
hintTraditional: 用肉做成的長條形食物,常常烤著吃。
hintEnglish: A long, shaped food made of meat, often eaten grilled.

definition: to associate; to be in contact (with sb); to get along (well, poorly); to interact
exampleSimplified: 我和室友相处得很愉快。
exampleTraditional: 我和室友相處得很愉快。
exampleEnglish: I get along very happily with my roommate.
hintSimplified: 人和人在一起生活或来往的方式。
hintTraditional: 人和人在一起生活或來往的方式。
hintEnglish: How people live or interact together.

exampleSimplified: 我爷爷奶奶住在安静的乡村。
exampleTraditional: 我爺爺奶奶住在安靜的鄉村。
exampleEnglish: My grandparents live in a quiet countryside village.
hintSimplified: 离城市很远,有田地和农民的地方。
hintTraditional: 離城市很遠,有田地和農民的地方。
hintEnglish: A place far from the city, with fields and farmers.

exampleSimplified: 同学们应该相互帮助。
exampleTraditional: 同學們應該相互幫助。
exampleEnglish: Classmates should help each other.
hintSimplified: 表示双方都做同样的事,彼此之间。
hintTraditional: 表示雙方都做同樣的事,彼此之間。
hintEnglish: Indicates both sides do the same thing to one another.

exampleSimplified: 他向来不喜欢吃辣的东西。
exampleTraditional: 他向來不喜歡吃辣的東西。
exampleEnglish: He has never liked spicy food.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示从过去到现在一直都是这样。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示從過去到現在一直都是這樣。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning it has been that way from the past until now.

exampleSimplified: 这个项目下个月就要完成了。
exampleTraditional: 這個項目下個月就要完成了。
exampleEnglish: This project has to be finished next month.
hintSimplified: 公司里一件有计划、有目标的工作。
hintTraditional: 公司裡一件有計劃、有目標的工作。
hintEnglish: A planned piece of work with a goal in a company.

definition: to long to see again; to miss; to remember with longing
exampleSimplified: 出国以后,我很想念家人。
exampleTraditional: 出國以後,我很想念家人。
exampleEnglish: Since going abroad, I miss my family a lot.
hintSimplified: 离开家人或朋友后,心里常常想起他们。
hintTraditional: 離開家人或朋友後,心裡常常想起他們。
hintEnglish: The feeling of often thinking about family or friends after being apart.

gloss: arranged interview to evaluate a proposed marriage partner (Taiwan pr. [xiang4 qin1])
definition: arranged interview to evaluate a proposed marriage partner (Taiwan pr. [xiang4 qin1]); blind date; to be deeply attached to each other
exampleSimplified: 周末她要去相亲。
exampleTraditional: 週末她要去相親。
exampleEnglish: She is going on a matchmaking date this weekend.
hintSimplified: 经人介绍,和陌生人见面,看能不能结婚。
hintTraditional: 經人介紹,和陌生人見面,看能不能結婚。
hintEnglish: Meeting a stranger through an introduction to see if marriage is possible.

definition: CL:種|种[zhong3]; pleasure; to enjoy; to live it up
exampleSimplified: 我喜欢在假期里享受安静的时光。
exampleTraditional: 我喜歡在假期裡享受安靜的時光。
exampleEnglish: I like to enjoy quiet moments during holidays.
hintSimplified: 对美好的事物感到快乐,慢慢体会。
hintTraditional: 對美好的事物感到快樂,慢慢體會。
hintEnglish: To feel pleasure in good things and savor them slowly.

exampleSimplified: 这对双胞胎的长相非常相似。
exampleTraditional: 這對雙胞胎的長相非常相似。
exampleEnglish: The twins look very similar.
hintSimplified: 两个东西有很多地方差不多,但不完全一样。
hintTraditional: 兩個東西有很多地方差不多,但不完全一樣。
hintEnglish: Two things share many features but are not exactly the same.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; answer; to respond to
exampleSimplified: 很多人响应政府的环保活动。
exampleTraditional: 很多人響應政府的環保活動。
exampleEnglish: Many people responded to the environmental campaign.
hintSimplified: 听到别人的号召后,用行动表示支持。
hintTraditional: 聽到別人的號召後,用行動表示支援。
hintEnglish: After hearing a call, showing support through action.

exampleSimplified: 每个公民都享有受教育的权利。
exampleTraditional: 每個公民都享有受教育的權利。
exampleEnglish: Every citizen enjoys the right to education.
hintSimplified: 拥有权利或好处,常用于法律或社会。
hintTraditional: 擁有權利或好處,常用於法律或社會。
hintEnglish: To possess rights or benefits, often in law or society.

exampleSimplified: 他买了一束鲜花送给妈妈。
exampleTraditional: 他買了一束鮮花送給媽媽。
exampleEnglish: He bought a bunch of fresh flowers for his mother.
hintSimplified: 刚摘下来、还没有枯萎的花。
hintTraditional: 剛摘下來、還沒有枯萎的花。
hintEnglish: Blossoms that were just picked and have not withered.

exampleSimplified: 这家店只收现金,不能刷卡。
exampleTraditional: 這家店只收現金,不能刷卡。
exampleEnglish: This shop only accepts cash, not cards.
hintSimplified: 可以直接拿在手上付钱的纸币和硬币。
hintTraditional: 可以直接拿在手上付錢的紙幣和硬幣。
hintEnglish: Paper money and coins you can hand over directly to pay.

definition: meritorious; exemplary (deeds etc); sophisticated; advanced (technology etc)
exampleSimplified: 这家医院有很先进的设备。
exampleTraditional: 這家醫院有很先進的裝置。
exampleEnglish: This hospital has very advanced equipment.
hintSimplified: 技术或想法比一般的更新、更好。
hintTraditional: 技術或想法比一般的更新、更好。
hintEnglish: Technology or ideas that are newer and better than usual.

exampleSimplified: 我很羡慕你可以去国外念书。
exampleTraditional: 我很羨慕你可以去國外唸書。
exampleEnglish: I really envy that you can go study abroad.
hintSimplified: 看到别人拥有自己没有的东西时,心里希望也能像他一样的感觉。
hintTraditional: 看到別人擁有自己沒有的東西時,心裡希望也能像他一樣的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling when you see someone has something you lack and you wish you could be like them.

exampleSimplified: 我每天早上都喝一杯鲜奶。
exampleTraditional: 我每天早上都喝一杯鮮奶。
exampleEnglish: I drink a glass of fresh milk every morning.
hintSimplified: 刚从牛身上取得、没有放很久的白色饮料。
hintTraditional: 剛從牛身上取得、沒有放很久的白色飲料。
hintEnglish: A white drink recently taken from cows, not stored for long.

exampleSimplified: 他显然没有听懂老师的话。
exampleTraditional: 他顯然沒有聽懂老師的話。
exampleEnglish: He obviously did not understand what the teacher said.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示事情很清楚、大家一看就知道。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示事情很清楚、大家一看就知道。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning something is so clear that anyone can see it.

definition: to demonstrate; to display; to illustrate; to show
exampleSimplified: 屏幕上显示现在的温度是三十度。
exampleTraditional: 螢幕上顯示現在的溫度是三十度。
exampleEnglish: The screen shows that the current temperature is 30 degrees.
hintSimplified: 机器或数据把结果让人看到。
hintTraditional: 機器或資料把結果讓人看到。
hintEnglish: When a machine or data lets people see a result.

exampleSimplified: 他的手受伤了,流出了鲜血。
exampleTraditional: 他的手受傷了,流出了鮮血。
exampleEnglish: His hand was hurt and bright red blood flowed out.
hintSimplified: 受伤时从身体流出来的红色液体,颜色很亮。
hintTraditional: 受傷時從身體流出來的紅色液體,顏色很亮。
hintEnglish: The bright red liquid that flows from the body when you are injured.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市的空气品质有显著的改善。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市的空氣品質有顯著的改善。
exampleEnglish: This city's air quality has improved noticeably.
hintSimplified: 形容变化或差别很大,很容易被注意到。
hintTraditional: 形容變化或差別很大,很容易被注意到。
hintEnglish: Describes a change or difference so big it is easily noticed.

definition: (euphemism) penis or vulva; to urinate; urine
exampleSimplified: 孩子说他想去上厕所小便。
exampleTraditional: 孩子說他想去上廁所小便。
exampleEnglish: The child said he wanted to go to the toilet to urinate.
hintSimplified: 去厕所时排出身体里黄色液体的委婉说法。
hintTraditional: 去廁所時排出身體裡黃色液體的委婉說法。
hintEnglish: A polite term for passing liquid waste from the body at the toilet.

exampleSimplified: 每天早上,校车都会准时来接孩子。
exampleTraditional: 每天早上,校車都會準時來接孩子。
exampleEnglish: Every morning the school bus comes on time to pick up the children.
hintSimplified: 一种黄色的大车,接送学生上下学。
hintTraditional: 一種黃色的大車,接送學生上下學。
hintEnglish: A big, often yellow vehicle that takes students to and from class.

exampleSimplified: 运动可以帮助你消除压力。
exampleTraditional: 運動可以幫助你消除壓力。
exampleEnglish: Exercise can help you eliminate stress.
hintSimplified: 把不好的东西去掉,让它不再存在。
hintTraditional: 把不好的東西去掉,讓它不再存在。
hintEnglish: To get rid of something bad so it no longer exists.

exampleSimplified: 你晓得他住在哪里吗?
exampleTraditional: 你曉得他住在哪裡嗎?
exampleEnglish: Do you know where he lives?
hintSimplified: 口语里表示对某件事情有了解、知道。
hintTraditional: 口語裡表示對某件事情有了解、知道。
hintEnglish: A colloquial verb meaning to be aware of or understand something.

exampleSimplified: 夜市里的小贩大声叫卖着水果。
exampleTraditional: 夜市裡的小販大聲叫賣著水果。
exampleEnglish: The vendors in the night market loudly hawk fruit.
hintSimplified: 在路边或夜市摆摊卖东西的人。
hintTraditional: 在路邊或夜市擺攤賣東西的人。
hintEnglish: A person who sells goods from a stall on the street or at a night market.

gloss: to consume (goods and services, resources etc)
definition: to consume (goods and services, resources etc)
exampleSimplified: 年轻人喜欢在网络上消费。
exampleTraditional: 年輕人喜歡在網路上消費。
exampleEnglish: Young people like to spend money online.
hintSimplified: 花钱买东西或使用服务。
hintTraditional: 花錢買東西或使用服務。
hintEnglish: To spend money on goods or services.

gloss: (fig.) to absorb (information etc); to assimilate; to process
definition: (fig.) to absorb (information etc); to assimilate; to process; to digest (food)
exampleSimplified: 吃完饭后,走一走可以帮助消化。
exampleTraditional: 吃完飯後,走一走可以幫助消化。
exampleEnglish: After eating, walking a bit can help digestion.
hintSimplified: 胃把吃下去的食物变成身体可用的东西;也可以指把学到的内容弄懂。
hintTraditional: 胃把吃下去的食物變成身體可用的東西;也可以指把學到的內容弄懂。
hintEnglish: The stomach turning food into usable nutrients; also taking in what you learned.

exampleSimplified: 遇到困难时,不要用消极的态度面对。
exampleTraditional: 遇到困難時,不要用消極的態度面對。
exampleEnglish: When you meet difficulties, don't face them with a negative attitude.
hintSimplified: 形容人的想法不乐观,不想努力,和「积极」相反。
hintTraditional: 形容人的想法不樂觀,不想努力,和「積極」相反。
hintEnglish: Describes a pessimistic, unmotivated attitude; the opposite of proactive.

exampleSimplified: 用新软件以后,我们的工作效率提高了。
exampleTraditional: 用新軟體以後,我們的工作效率提高了。
exampleEnglish: After using the new software, our work efficiency improved.
hintSimplified: 在一定时间里做完多少事的程度。
hintTraditional: 在一定時間裡做完多少事的程度。
hintEnglish: How much gets done within a given amount of time.

definition: market; sale; sales event; state of the market
exampleSimplified: 这种新产品的销路很好。
exampleTraditional: 這種新產品的銷路很好。
exampleEnglish: This new product sells very well.
hintSimplified: 商品能不能卖出去的渠道和情况。
hintTraditional: 商品能不能賣出去的渠道和情況。
hintEnglish: The channels and extent to which a product can be sold.

exampleSimplified: 面粉是用小麦做成的。
exampleTraditional: 麵粉是用小麥做成的。
exampleEnglish: Flour is made from wheat.
hintSimplified: 一种农作物,磨成粉后可以做面包和面条。
hintTraditional: 一種農作物,磨成粉後可以做麵包和麵條。
hintEnglish: A grain crop that is ground into flour for bread and noodles.

definition: annihilation (in quantum field theory); to annihilate; to cause to perish; to perish; to put an end to
exampleSimplified: 他们用药把家里的蟑螂都消灭了。
exampleTraditional: 他們用藥把家裡的蟑螂都消滅了。
exampleEnglish: They used poison to wipe out all the cockroaches in the house.
hintSimplified: 把敌人或害虫完全除掉,一个也不留。
hintTraditional: 把敵人或害蟲完全除掉,一個也不留。
hintEnglish: To completely wipe out enemies or pests so none remain.

exampleSimplified: 他很小气,从来不请朋友吃饭。
exampleTraditional: 他很小氣,從來不請朋友吃飯。
exampleEnglish: He is stingy and never treats his friends to a meal.
hintSimplified: 形容人不喜欢花钱或分享东西。
hintTraditional: 形容人不喜歡花錢或分享東西。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who dislikes spending money or sharing.

exampleSimplified: 她脸上带着温暖的笑容。
exampleTraditional: 她臉上帶著溫暖的笑容。
exampleEnglish: She had a warm smile on her face.
hintSimplified: 高兴时脸上露出的样子。
hintTraditional: 高興時臉上露出的樣子。
hintEnglish: The look on a face when someone is happy.

exampleSimplified: 太阳出来后,雾慢慢消失了。
exampleTraditional: 太陽出來後,霧慢慢消失了。
exampleEnglish: After the sun came out, the fog slowly disappeared.
hintSimplified: 原本看得到的东西慢慢变得看不见,不再存在。
hintTraditional: 原本看得到的東西慢慢變得看不見,不再存在。
hintEnglish: When something once visible gradually can no longer be seen.

definition: sales (representative, agreement etc); to market; to sell
exampleSimplified: 他在一家公司做销售工作。
exampleTraditional: 他在一家公司做銷售工作。
exampleEnglish: He works in sales at a company.
hintSimplified: 把商品或服务卖给客户的工作。
hintTraditional: 把商品或服務賣給客戶的工作。
hintEnglish: The work of selling products or services to customers.

definition: lower leg (from knee to ankle); shank
exampleSimplified: 跑了很久以后,我的小腿很酸。
exampleTraditional: 跑了很久以後,我的小腿很酸。
exampleEnglish: After running for a long time, my calves were very sore.
hintSimplified: 身体上膝盖和脚踝之间的部分。
hintTraditional: 身體上膝蓋和腳踝之間的部分。
hintEnglish: The part of the body between the knee and the ankle.

exampleSimplified: 我们看完电影后去吃消夜。
exampleTraditional: 我們看完電影后去吃消夜。
exampleEnglish: After the movie we went for a late-night snack.
hintSimplified: 晚饭很久以后、睡觉前吃的东西。
hintTraditional: 晚飯很久以後、睡覺前吃的東西。
hintEnglish: Food eaten long after dinner, before going to bed.

exampleSimplified: 夜市里有很多好吃的宵夜。
exampleTraditional: 夜市裡有很多好吃的宵夜。
exampleEnglish: The night market has lots of delicious late-night snacks.
hintSimplified: 深夜肚子饿时吃的小吃。
hintTraditional: 深夜肚子餓時吃的小吃。
hintEnglish: Snacks eaten when you are hungry late at night.

exampleSimplified: 今天我们学校的校友回来参加庆祝活动。
exampleTraditional: 今天我們學校的校友回來參加慶祝活動。
exampleEnglish: Today our school's alumni came back to join the celebration.
hintSimplified: 从同一所学校毕业的人，彼此会这样称呼。
hintTraditional: 從同一所學校畢業的人，彼此會這樣稱呼。
hintEnglish: What people who graduated from the same school are called in relation to each other.

definition: (coll.) boy; (derog.) joker; (despicable) fellow; (literary) youngster; (old) I, me (used in speaking to one's elders); (old) young fellow (term of address used by the older generation); guy
exampleSimplified: 这个小子很聪明，一学就会。
exampleTraditional: 這個小子很聰明，一學就會。
exampleEnglish: This kid is very smart and learns things right away.
hintSimplified: 口语里用来称呼年轻男孩或年轻男人，有时带一点随便的语气。
hintTraditional: 口語裡用來稱呼年輕男孩或年輕男人，有時帶一點隨便的語氣。
hintEnglish: A casual way to refer to a young boy or young man, sometimes slightly informal in tone.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷每天下午都在公园里和朋友下棋。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺每天下午都在公園裡和朋友下棋。
exampleEnglish: Every afternoon Grandpa plays chess with friends in the park.
hintSimplified: 两个人在棋盘上轮流走子，比谁先赢，这是一种安静的游戏。
hintTraditional: 兩個人在棋盤上輪流走子，比誰先贏，這是一種安靜的遊戲。
hintEnglish: Two people take turns moving pieces on a board to see who wins; a quiet game.

definition: (of a servant) to withdraw; to continue; to descend; to go down; to go on
exampleSimplified: 这个故事太有趣了，我想继续听下去。
exampleTraditional: 這個故事太有趣了，我想繼續聽下去。
exampleEnglish: This story is so interesting that I want to keep listening.
hintSimplified: 放在动词后面，表示动作会继续进行，或者表示从高处往低处离开说话人。
hintTraditional: 放在動詞後面，表示動作會繼續進行，或者表示從高處往低處離開說話人。
hintEnglish: Placed after a verb, it shows an action continues, or movement downward away from the speaker.

definition: downstream; lower echelon; lower level; lower reaches (of a river)
exampleSimplified: 这条河的下游有一座很大的城市。
exampleTraditional: 這條河的下游有一座很大的城市。
exampleEnglish: There is a very large city on the lower part of this river.
hintSimplified: 河流靠近出海口的那一段，水往这里流。
hintTraditional: 河流靠近出海口的那一段，水往這裡流。
hintEnglish: The section of a river closer to the sea, where the water flows toward.

exampleSimplified: 人体是由很多细胞组成的。
exampleTraditional: 人體是由很多細胞組成的。
exampleEnglish: The human body is made up of many cells.
hintSimplified: 生物最小的基本单位，要用显微镜才能看到。
hintTraditional: 生物最小的基本單位，要用顯微鏡才能看到。
hintEnglish: The smallest basic unit of living things, visible only under a microscope.

exampleSimplified: 血液在血管里流动，把氧气送到全身。
exampleTraditional: 血液在血管裡流動，把氧氣送到全身。
exampleEnglish: Blood flows through the vessels and carries oxygen to the whole body.
hintSimplified: 身体里像细长管子的东西，血在里面流动。
hintTraditional: 身體裡像細長管子的東西，血在裡面流動。
hintEnglish: Thin tube-like structures in the body through which blood flows.

exampleSimplified: 医生问我是什么血型。
exampleTraditional: 醫生問我是什麼血型。
exampleEnglish: The doctor asked me what my blood type is.
hintSimplified: 捐血或输血以前,一定要知道的自己血液的分类。
hintTraditional: 捐血或輸血以前,一定要知道的自己血液的分類。
hintEnglish: The classification of your blood that you must know before donating or receiving a transfusion.

exampleSimplified: 医生请他抽血，检查血液有没有问题。
exampleTraditional: 醫生請他抽血，檢查血液有沒有問題。
exampleEnglish: The doctor had him give a blood sample to check for problems.
hintSimplified: 在身体里循环的红色液体，医生常常抽出来检验。
hintTraditional: 在身體裡迴圈的紅色液體，醫生常常抽出來檢驗。
hintEnglish: The red fluid circulating in the body, which doctors often draw to test.

definition: to compose; to write; writing; written works
exampleSimplified: 她很喜欢写作，常常在网络上发表文章。
exampleTraditional: 她很喜歡寫作，常常在網路上發表文章。
exampleEnglish: She loves writing and often publishes articles online.
hintSimplified: 用文字创作文章、小说或诗，是作家的工作。
hintTraditional: 用文字創作文章、小說或詩，是作家的工作。
hintEnglish: Creating articles, novels or poems with words; the work of an author.

definition: (dialect) wife; (dialect) young married woman; daughter-in-law; wife of a younger brother or relative of the younger generation
exampleSimplified: 他的媳妇是一位很温柔的老师。
exampleTraditional: 他的媳婦是一位很溫柔的老師。
exampleEnglish: His wife is a very gentle teacher.
hintSimplified: 口语里，丈夫有时这样称呼自己的太太；也可指儿子的妻子。
hintTraditional: 口語裡，丈夫有時這樣稱呼自己的太太；也可指兒子的妻子。
hintEnglish: In speech, a husband may call his spouse this; it can also mean a son's wife.

exampleSimplified: 签合约以前，你要先看清楚每个细节。
exampleTraditional: 籤合約以前，你要先看清楚每個細節。
exampleEnglish: Before signing a contract, you should read every detail carefully.
hintSimplified: 整件事里很小、很不明显的部分，不注意就会漏掉。
hintTraditional: 整件事裡很小、很不明顯的部分，不注意就會漏掉。
hintEnglish: The small, easily overlooked parts of something that you might miss if not careful.

gloss: liquor drunk at a wedding feast
definition: liquor drunk at a wedding feast; wedding feast
exampleSimplified: 下个月我表哥结婚，大家都要去喝他的喜酒。
exampleTraditional: 下個月我表哥結婚，大家都要去喝他的喜酒。
exampleEnglish: My cousin gets married next month, and everyone will go to his wedding banquet.
hintSimplified: 结婚时请客人喝的酒；受邀参加婚宴也常用这个词来说。
hintTraditional: 結婚時請客人喝的酒；受邀參加婚宴也常用這個詞來說。
hintEnglish: The drink offered to guests at a wedding; also used to refer to attending a wedding banquet.

exampleSimplified: 我喜欢看喜剧，因为可以让心情变好。
exampleTraditional: 我喜歡看喜劇，因為可以讓心情變好。
exampleEnglish: I like watching comedies because they lift my mood.
hintSimplified: 一种电影或戏剧，内容好笑，结局通常很快乐。
hintTraditional: 一種電影或戲劇，內容好笑，結局通常很快樂。
hintEnglish: A type of film or play that is funny and usually has a happy ending.

exampleSimplified: 吃东西以前要先洗手，才能减少细菌。
exampleTraditional: 吃東西以前要先洗手，才能減少細菌。
exampleEnglish: Wash your hands before eating to reduce germs.
hintSimplified: 非常小的生物，眼睛看不到，有些会让人生病。
hintTraditional: 非常小的生物，眼睛看不到，有些會讓人生病。
hintEnglish: Tiny organisms invisible to the eye, some of which make people sick.

exampleSimplified: 学校为学生安排了一系列有趣的活动。
exampleTraditional: 學校為學生安排了一系列有趣的活動。
exampleEnglish: The school arranged a series of interesting activities for the students.
hintSimplified: 指一组互相有关、接连出现的事物。
hintTraditional: 指一組互相有關、接連出現的事物。
hintEnglish: Refers to a group of related things that come one after another.

definition: (Tw) (computing) process; course (of history); distance of travel; journey; travel route; itinerary; stroke (of a piston)
exampleSimplified: 这次旅行的行程很满，每天都有新的景点。
exampleTraditional: 這次旅行的行程很滿，每天都有新的景點。
exampleEnglish: The itinerary for this trip is packed, with new attractions every day.
hintSimplified: 旅行前先安排好的路线和时间表。
hintTraditional: 旅行前先安排好的路線和時間表。
hintEnglish: The route and schedule planned in advance before a trip.

exampleSimplified: 好习惯需要长时间才能慢慢形成。
exampleTraditional: 好習慣需要長時間才能慢慢形成。
exampleEnglish: Good habits take a long time to gradually form.
hintSimplified: 某种东西经过一段时间，慢慢出现或建立起来。
hintTraditional: 某種東西經過一段時間，慢慢出現或建立起來。
hintEnglish: Something gradually comes into being or is established over time.

exampleSimplified: 山上没有灯，只有微弱的星光照着路。
exampleTraditional: 山上沒有燈，只有微弱的星光照著路。
exampleEnglish: There are no lights on the mountain, only faint starlight lighting the path.
hintSimplified: 晚上从天空中许多小亮点照下来的光。
hintTraditional: 晚上從天空中許多小亮點照下來的光。
hintEnglish: The light shining down at night from the many small bright dots in the sky.

gloss: official responsible for arranging audiences with the emperor
definition: official responsible for arranging audiences with the emperor; passer-by; pedestrian; traveler on foot
exampleSimplified: 马路上的行人要等绿灯再过去。
exampleTraditional: 馬路上的行人要等綠燈再過去。
exampleEnglish: Pedestrians on the road must wait for the green light to cross.
hintSimplified: 在路上走的人，不是开车或骑车的人。
hintTraditional: 在路上走的人，不是開車或騎車的人。
hintEnglish: People walking along the road, not driving or riding.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; form; formality; outer appearance; shape
exampleSimplified: 这次比赛的形式和去年不一样。
exampleTraditional: 這次比賽的形式和去年不一樣。
exampleEnglish: The format of this competition is different from last year's.
hintSimplified: 事情表现出来或进行的方式，不是内容本身。
hintTraditional: 事情表現出來或進行的方式，不是內容本身。
hintEnglish: The manner in which something is presented or carried out, not its content.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; figure; form; image; visualization; vivid

hintTraditional: 形容人表情認真、不笑,讓氣氛很緊張。
hintEnglish: Describes a person with a stern, unsmiling face that makes the mood tense.

definition: disgusted with sth; to hate; to loathe
exampleSimplified: 我很厌恶那种说谎骗人的行为。
exampleTraditional: 我很厭惡那種說謊騙人的行為。
exampleEnglish: I really detest that kind of lying and cheating behavior.
hintSimplified: 对某人或某事非常不喜欢,心里觉得反感。
hintTraditional: 對某人或某事非常不喜歡,心裡覺得反感。
hintEnglish: To strongly dislike someone or something and feel repelled by it.

gloss: to perform on a musical instrument
definition: to perform on a musical instrument
exampleSimplified: 她在音乐会上演奏了一首钢琴曲。
exampleTraditional: 她在音樂會上演奏了一首鋼琴曲。
exampleEnglish: She played a piano piece at the concert.
hintSimplified: 用钢琴、小提琴等乐器给观众表演音乐。
hintTraditional: 用鋼琴、小提琴等樂器給觀眾表演音樂。
hintEnglish: To perform music for an audience on an instrument like piano or violin.

definition: to sway; to waver; to wobble
exampleSimplified: 风吹过来,树枝轻轻地摇摆。
exampleTraditional: 風吹過來,樹枝輕輕地搖擺。
exampleEnglish: The wind blew, and the branches swayed gently.
hintSimplified: 树枝或身体左右来回动,就是这个动作。
hintTraditional: 樹枝或身體左右來回動,就是這個動作。
hintEnglish: This is the movement when branches or a body move back and forth from side to side.

definition: either... (or...); how about...?; or else; otherwise
exampleSimplified: 今天太累了,要不我们明天再去吧。
exampleTraditional: 今天太累了,要不我們明天再去吧。
exampleEnglish: I'm too tired today; otherwise, let's go tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 提出另一个办法或建议时,常用这个词开头。
hintTraditional: 提出另一個辦法或建議時,常用這個詞開頭。
hintEnglish: Often used at the start of a sentence to propose an alternative or suggestion.

exampleSimplified: 医生给我开了一张药方。
exampleTraditional: 醫生給我開了一張藥方。
exampleEnglish: The doctor wrote me a prescription.
hintSimplified: 医生写在纸上,告诉你该吃什么药的东西。
hintTraditional: 醫生寫在紙上,告訴你該吃什麼藥的東西。
hintEnglish: What a doctor writes on paper telling you which medicine to take.

definition: striving for self-improvement; to be close friends; to be on good terms
exampleSimplified: 他们两个从小就很要好。
exampleTraditional: 他們兩個從小就很要好。
exampleEnglish: The two of them have been close friends since childhood.
hintSimplified: 形容两个人关系很亲近,感情很好。
hintTraditional: 形容兩個人關係很親近,感情很好。
hintEnglish: Describes two people whose relationship is very close and warm.

gloss: (used in complaining about sth) to be a nuisance
definition: (used in complaining about sth) to be a nuisance; extremely; terribly; to cause sb's death
exampleSimplified: 今天热得要命,我一点也不想出门。
exampleTraditional: 今天熱得要命,我一點也不想出門。
exampleEnglish: It's insanely hot today; I don't want to go out at all.
hintSimplified: 放在形容词后面,表示程度非常严重,让人受不了。
hintTraditional: 放在形容詞後面,表示程度非常嚴重,讓人受不了。
hintEnglish: Placed after an adjective to show an extreme degree that is hard to bear.

definition: bottled medicine; lotion; medicine in liquid form
exampleSimplified: 小朋友不喜欢喝这种药水,因为很苦。
exampleTraditional: 小朋友不喜歡喝這種藥水,因為很苦。
exampleEnglish: Kids don't like drinking this liquid medicine because it's bitter.
hintSimplified: 装在瓶子里、可以喝下去的液体药。
hintTraditional: 裝在瓶子裡、可以喝下去的液體藥。
hintEnglish: Medicine in liquid form, kept in a bottle, that you drink.

exampleSimplified: 他听了我的建议,只是摇头,没有说话。
exampleTraditional: 他聽了我的建議,只是搖頭,沒有說話。
exampleEnglish: He heard my suggestion and just shook his head without speaking.
hintSimplified: 左右转动脑袋,表示不同意或不相信。
hintTraditional: 左右轉動腦袋,表示不同意或不相信。
hintEnglish: Turning your head left and right to show disagreement or disbelief.

exampleSimplified: 这种药物每天只能吃两次。
exampleTraditional: 這種藥物每天只能吃兩次。
exampleEnglish: This medication can only be taken twice a day.
hintSimplified: 用来治病的化学东西的总称,有些要医生同意才能用。
hintTraditional: 用來治病的化學東西的總稱,有些要醫生同意才能用。
hintEnglish: A general term for substances used to treat illness, some requiring a doctor's approval.

definition: oppression; stress (physics); to constrict; to oppress; to repress
exampleSimplified: 人们不愿意再受到压迫,所以站出来说话。
exampleTraditional: 人們不願意再受到壓迫,所以站出來說話。
exampleEnglish: People no longer wanted to be oppressed, so they stood up and spoke out.
hintSimplified: 用权力或力量让别人不能自由,感到很痛苦。
hintTraditional: 用權力或力量讓別人不能自由,感到很痛苦。
hintEnglish: Using power or force to deprive others of freedom and make them suffer.

exampleSimplified: 秋天到了,院子里满地都是黄色的叶子。
exampleTraditional: 秋天到了,院子裡滿地都是黃色的葉子。
exampleEnglish: Autumn has arrived, and the yard is covered with yellow leaves.
hintSimplified: 长在树上,春夏是绿色的,秋天会掉下来。
hintTraditional: 長在樹上,春夏是綠色的,秋天會掉下來。
hintEnglish: They grow on trees, are green in spring and summer, and fall in autumn.

exampleSimplified: 从山上看台北的夜景,真的很漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 從山上看台北的夜景,真的很漂亮。
exampleEnglish: The night view of Taipei from the mountain is really beautiful.
hintSimplified: 晚上灯亮起来时,城市里看到的风景。
hintTraditional: 晚上燈亮起來時,城市裡看到的風景。
hintEnglish: The scenery of a city seen when the lights come on at night.

exampleSimplified: 森林里可能有凶猛的野兽,不要一个人进去。
exampleTraditional: 森林裡可能有兇猛的野獸,不要一個人進去。
exampleEnglish: There may be fierce wild beasts in the forest; don't go in alone.
hintSimplified: 住在山林里、不是人养的凶猛动物。
hintTraditional: 住在山林裡、不是人養的兇猛動物。
hintEnglish: Fierce animals living in the wild, not kept by people.

definition: CL:項|项[xiang4]; business; professional work; service
exampleSimplified: 他刚进公司,还不太熟悉这里的业务。
exampleTraditional: 他剛進公司,還不太熟悉這裡的業務。
exampleEnglish: He just joined the company and isn't yet familiar with the business here.
hintSimplified: 一家公司或一个人工作中负责处理的事情。
hintTraditional: 一家公司或一個人工作中負責處理的事情。
hintEnglish: The matters a company or person handles as part of their job.

exampleSimplified: 这个年轻人很有野心,想当大公司的老板。
exampleTraditional: 這個年輕人很有野心,想當大公司的老闆。
exampleEnglish: This young man is very ambitious and wants to become the boss of a big company.
hintSimplified: 想得到很高的地位或很大成功的强烈愿望。
hintTraditional: 想得到很高的地位或很大成功的強烈願望。
hintEnglish: A strong desire to achieve high status or great success.

definition: amateur (historian etc); in one's spare time; outside working hours
exampleSimplified: 我的业余爱好是拍照和爬山。
exampleTraditional: 我的業餘愛好是拍照和爬山。
exampleEnglish: My hobbies in my spare time are photography and hiking.
hintSimplified: 工作或上课以外的时间,或不是靠这个吃饭的人。
hintTraditional: 工作或上課以外的時間,或不是靠這個吃飯的人。
hintEnglish: Outside of work or class time, or describing someone who doesn't do this for a living.

definition: in order to; so as to; so that
exampleSimplified: 请留下电话号码,以便我们和你联络。
exampleTraditional: 請留下電話號碼,以便我們和你聯絡。
exampleEnglish: Please leave your phone number so that we can contact you.
hintSimplified: 连接两个句子,说明前面做的事是为了让后面的事更容易。
hintTraditional: 連線兩個句子,說明前面做的事是為了讓後面的事更容易。
hintEnglish: Connects two clauses, showing the first is done to make the second easier.

exampleSimplified: 他家就住在火车站一带。
exampleTraditional: 他家就住在火車站一帶。
exampleEnglish: His home is somewhere around the train station area.
hintSimplified: 指某个地方附近的一整片地区,不是很准确的位置。
hintTraditional: 指某個地方附近的一整片地區,不是很準確的位置。
hintEnglish: Refers to the whole area around a place, not an exact spot.

definition: if; in a short time; in case (sth happens); in one day; once (sth happens, then...); when
exampleSimplified: 一旦下雨,比赛就会取消。
exampleTraditional: 一旦下雨,比賽就會取消。
exampleEnglish: Once it rains, the game will be canceled.
hintSimplified: 表示假如某件事发生,就会有后面的结果。
hintTraditional: 表示假如某件事發生,就會有後面的結果。
hintEnglish: Indicates that if something happens, a certain result will follow.

definition: migration; mobile; movement; portable; to move
exampleSimplified: 请把这张桌子移动到窗户旁边。
exampleTraditional: 請把這張桌子移動到窗戶旁邊。
exampleEnglish: Please move this table next to the window.
hintSimplified: 东西从一个位置换到另一个位置。
hintTraditional: 東西從一個位置換到另一個位置。
hintEnglish: When something changes from one position to another.

exampleSimplified: 市议会今天讨论了新的交通计划。
exampleTraditional: 市議會今天討論了新的交通計劃。
exampleEnglish: The city council discussed a new transportation plan today.
hintSimplified: 由选出来的人组成,负责讨论并决定法律或政策的机构。
hintTraditional: 由選出來的人組成,負責討論並決定法律或政策的機構。
hintEnglish: A body of elected people that discusses and decides laws or policies.

exampleSimplified: 填表格时,请选择未婚还是已婚。
exampleTraditional: 填表格時,請選擇未婚還是已婚。
exampleEnglish: When filling out the form, please choose single or married.
hintSimplified: 表格上的一个选项,表示已经有了丈夫或妻子。
hintTraditional: 表格上的一個選項,表示已經有了丈夫或妻子。
hintEnglish: An option on a form meaning one already has a husband or wife.

exampleSimplified: 法官依据证据做出了决定。
exampleTraditional: 法官依據證據做出了決定。
exampleEnglish: The judge made a decision based on the evidence.
hintSimplified: 做判断或决定时所根据的东西,或表示“按照”。
hintTraditional: 做判斷或決定時所根據的東西,或表示“按照”。
hintEnglish: What a judgment or decision is based on, or meaning 'in accordance with'.

definition: one aspect; one side; one's whole face; simultaneously... (and...)
exampleSimplified: 他一面走路,一面看手机。
exampleTraditional: 他一面走路,一面看手機。
exampleEnglish: He looks at his phone while walking.
hintSimplified: 常成对出现,表示两个动作同时进行。
hintTraditional: 常成對出現,表示兩個動作同時進行。
hintEnglish: Often used in pairs to show two actions happening at the same time.

definition: emigrant; immigrant; to immigrate; to migrate
exampleSimplified: 他们一家人去年移民到加拿大了。
exampleTraditional: 他們一家人去年移民到加拿大了。
exampleEnglish: His family immigrated to Canada last year.
hintSimplified: 离开自己的国家,到别的国家长期住下来的人或这种行为。
hintTraditional: 離開自己的國家,到別的國家長期住下來的人或這種行為。
hintEnglish: A person, or the act, of leaving one's country to settle long-term in another.

definition: and as a result, ...; as a result; therefore; thus
exampleSimplified: 他每天认真练习,因而进步很快。
exampleTraditional: 他每天認真練習,因而進步很快。
exampleEnglish: He practices seriously every day, and therefore improves quickly.
hintSimplified: 用在后半句,表示前面的原因带来这个结果。
hintTraditional: 用在後半句,表示前面的原因帶來這個結果。
hintEnglish: Used in the second clause to show the result of the reason just mentioned.

definition: to cause; to evoke (emotions); to initiate; to lead to; to trigger
exampleSimplified: 这个新闻引发了很多人的讨论。
exampleTraditional: 這個新聞引發了很多人的討論。
exampleEnglish: This news triggered a lot of discussion.
hintSimplified: 一件事情造成另一件事情开始出现,例如争论或问题。
hintTraditional: 一件事情造成另一件事情開始出現,例如爭論或問題。
hintEnglish: When one thing makes another thing start to happen, such as a debate or problem.

definition: (fig.) hint; CL:個|个[ge4]; indication; influence; reflection; shadow
exampleSimplified: 太阳下山了,树的影子变得很长。
exampleTraditional: 太陽下山了,樹的影子變得很長。
exampleEnglish: The sun was setting, and the tree's shadow became very long.
hintSimplified: 光被东西挡住后,地上出现的黑色形状。
hintTraditional: 光被東西擋住後,地上出現的黑色形狀。
hintEnglish: The dark shape that appears on the ground when something blocks light.

gloss: book with model calligraphy for copying
definition: book with model calligraphy for copying; copy (of a document)
exampleSimplified: 老师请我把这份文件的影本交给他。
exampleTraditional: 老師請我把這份檔案的影本交給他。
exampleEnglish: The teacher asked me to hand him a copy of this document.
hintSimplified: 把原来的文件或资料复印出来的那一份。
hintTraditional: 把原來的檔案或資料復印出來的那一份。
hintEnglish: The duplicate you get after photocopying an original document.

exampleSimplified: 学生应当按时交作业。
exampleTraditional: 學生應當按時交作業。
exampleEnglish: Students should hand in their homework on time.
hintSimplified: 表示照道理或规定,一个人必须这样做。
hintTraditional: 表示照道理或規定,一個人必須這樣做。
hintEnglish: Expresses that by reason or rule, one is supposed to do something.

exampleSimplified: 他的努力赢得了大家的尊敬。
exampleTraditional: 他的努力贏得了大家的尊敬。
exampleEnglish: His hard work earned everyone's respect.
hintSimplified: 经过努力后,得到别人的支持、尊敬或比赛的胜利。
hintTraditional: 經過努力後,得到別人的支援、尊敬或比賽的勝利。
hintEnglish: To obtain support, respect or victory after making an effort.

exampleSimplified: 这个婴儿睡得很香。
exampleTraditional: 這個嬰兒睡得很香。
exampleEnglish: This baby is sleeping soundly.
hintSimplified: 刚出生不久、还不会说话的小孩。
hintTraditional: 剛出生不久、還不會說話的小孩。
hintEnglish: A very young child who was just born and cannot talk yet.

exampleSimplified: 他很会应付各种突然出现的问题。
exampleTraditional: 他很會應付各種突然出現的問題。
exampleEnglish: He is good at handling all kinds of sudden problems.
hintSimplified: 面对困难或麻烦时,想办法处理过去。
hintTraditional: 面對困難或麻煩時,想辦法處理過去。
hintEnglish: To find a way to get through a difficulty or trouble.

exampleSimplified: 我们到机场迎接远道而来的朋友。
exampleTraditional: 我們到機場迎接遠道而來的朋友。
exampleEnglish: We went to the airport to welcome our friend who came from afar.
hintSimplified: 客人到达时,你去门口或车站见他并欢迎他。
hintTraditional: 客人到達時,你去門口或車站見他並歡迎他。
hintEnglish: When a guest arrives, you go to meet them and greet them warmly.

exampleSimplified: 孩子们都把消防员看作英雄。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們都把消防員看作英雄。
exampleEnglish: The children all regard firefighters as heroes.
hintSimplified: 做了勇敢又了不起的事,让人佩服的人。
hintTraditional: 做了勇敢又了不起的事,讓人佩服的人。
hintEnglish: A person who did something brave and admirable.

exampleSimplified: 总统应邀出席了这场活动。
exampleTraditional: 總統應邀出席了這場活動。
exampleEnglish: The president attended the event at the invitation of the organizers.
hintSimplified: 因为别人请他,所以去参加。
hintTraditional: 因為別人請他,所以去參加。
hintEnglish: Going somewhere because someone invited you.

exampleSimplified: 这家商店每天早上九点开始营业。
exampleTraditional: 這家商店每天早上九點開始營業。
exampleEnglish: This store opens for business at nine every morning.
hintSimplified: 商店或餐厅开门,可以让客人来买东西。
hintTraditional: 商店或餐廳開門,可以讓客人來買東西。
hintEnglish: When a shop or restaurant is open and serving customers.

exampleSimplified: 请帮我影印这三页资料。
exampleTraditional: 請幫我影印這三頁資料。
exampleEnglish: Please photocopy these three pages of material for me.
hintSimplified: 用机器把纸上的内容复制到另一张纸上。
hintTraditional: 用機器把紙上的內容複製到另一張紙上。
hintEnglish: Using a machine to copy what's on a sheet onto another sheet.

definition: (computing) app; application; practical use; practical; applied (science, linguistics etc); to put to use; to apply
exampleSimplified: 这项技术已经应用在很多手机上。
exampleTraditional: 這項技術已經應用在很多手機上。
exampleEnglish: This technology has already been applied in many phones.
hintSimplified: 把知识或技术拿来实际使用。
hintTraditional: 把知識或技術拿來實際使用。
hintEnglish: To put knowledge or technology into practical use.

definition: eating and drinking; food and drink; diet
exampleSimplified: 健康的饮食对身体很重要。
exampleTraditional: 健康的飲食對身體很重要。
exampleEnglish: A healthy diet is very important for the body.
hintSimplified: 每天吃什么、喝什么的习惯。
hintTraditional: 每天吃什麼、喝什麼的習慣。
hintEnglish: The habits of what one eats and drinks every day.

exampleSimplified: 这本书的印刷非常清楚。
exampleTraditional: 這本書的印刷非常清楚。
exampleEnglish: The printing of this book is very clear.
hintSimplified: 用机器把文字和图片做到纸上,做成书或报纸。
hintTraditional: 用機器把文字和圖片做到紙上,做成書或報紙。
hintEnglish: Using machines to put text and pictures onto paper to make books or newspapers.

exampleSimplified: 天气是影响比赛的重要因素。
exampleTraditional: 天氣是影響比賽的重要因素。
exampleEnglish: Weather is an important factor affecting the game.
hintSimplified: 会让事情变成某种结果的原因或条件。
hintTraditional: 會讓事情變成某種結果的原因或條件。
hintEnglish: A cause or condition that leads to a certain result.

definition: a memory; impression (sth that stays in one's mind)
exampleSimplified: 这个城市给我留下了很好的印象。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市給我留下了很好的印象。
exampleEnglish: This city left me with a very good impression.
hintSimplified: 见过某人或某地后,留在心里的感觉。
hintTraditional: 見過某人或某地後,留在心裡的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling left in your mind after meeting someone or visiting a place.

exampleSimplified: 请在文件上盖一个印章。
exampleTraditional: 請在檔案上蓋一個印章。
exampleEnglish: Please stamp a seal on the document.
hintSimplified: 沾上红色印泥后,盖在文件上代表名字的小东西。
hintTraditional: 沾上紅色印泥後,蓋在檔案上代表名字的小東西。
hintEnglish: A small item dipped in red ink and pressed on documents to stand for a name.

exampleSimplified: 他站在一旁,静静地看着我们玩。
exampleTraditional: 他站在一旁,靜靜地看著我們玩。
exampleEnglish: He stood to one side, quietly watching us play.
hintSimplified: 不在中间,而是在旁边的位置。
hintTraditional: 不在中間,而是在旁邊的位置。
hintEnglish: Not in the middle, but at the side.

exampleSimplified: 实验室里有很多精密的仪器。
exampleTraditional: 實驗室裡有很多精密的儀器。
exampleEnglish: There are many precision instruments in the laboratory.
hintSimplified: 科学或医疗工作中用来测量、检查的设备。
hintTraditional: 科學或醫療工作中用來測量、檢查的裝置。
hintEnglish: Equipment used for measuring or testing in science or medicine.

exampleSimplified: 听到老师的话,同学们一齐笑了起来。
exampleTraditional: 聽到老師的話,同學們一齊笑了起來。
exampleEnglish: Hearing the teacher's words, the students all burst out laughing together.
hintSimplified: 很多人在同一个时间一起做某件事。
hintTraditional: 很多人在同一個時間一起做某件事。
hintEnglish: Many people doing something together at the same moment.

exampleSimplified: 过了十年,他依然住在那个小镇。
exampleTraditional: 過了十年,他依然住在那個小鎮。
exampleEnglish: Ten years later, he still lives in that small town.
hintSimplified: 表示情况经过一段时间后,还是跟以前一样。
hintTraditional: 表示情況經過一段時間後,還是跟以前一樣。
hintEnglish: Shows that after some time, the situation is still the same as before.

exampleSimplified: 天气冷了,你多穿一件衣裳吧。
exampleTraditional: 天氣冷了,你多穿一件衣裳吧。
exampleEnglish: It's getting cold; put on another piece of clothing.
hintSimplified: 人穿在身上的东西,口语里的说法。
hintTraditional: 人穿在身上的東西,口語裡的說法。
hintEnglish: What people wear on their bodies, in a colloquial way.

exampleSimplified: 毕业典礼的仪式非常隆重。
exampleTraditional: 畢業典禮的儀式非常隆重。
exampleEnglish: The graduation ceremony was very solemn.
hintSimplified: 婚礼、毕业等重要场合按照一定程序举行的活动。
hintTraditional: 婚禮、畢業等重要場合按照一定程式舉行的活動。
hintEnglish: An event held in a set procedure on important occasions like weddings or graduations.

gloss: (usu. followed by 到[dao4]) to be aware of; to realize
definition: (usu. followed by 到[dao4]) to be aware of; to realize; consciousness; awareness
exampleSimplified: 他没有意识到自己犯了错。
exampleTraditional: 他沒有意識到自己犯了錯。
exampleEnglish: He didn't realize that he had made a mistake.
hintSimplified: 心里清楚地发现或感觉到某件事的存在。
hintTraditional: 心裡清楚地發現或感覺到某件事的存在。
hintEnglish: To clearly notice or sense in one's mind that something exists.

exampleSimplified: 以往他每天都骑车上班,现在改开车了。
exampleTraditional: 以往他每天都騎車上班,現在改開車了。
exampleEnglish: In the past he rode a bike to work every day, but now he drives.
hintSimplified: 指过去的时候,和现在相对。
hintTraditional: 指過去的時候,和現在相對。
hintEnglish: Refers to earlier times, in contrast with now.

exampleSimplified: 如果你对这个问题有疑问,可以马上问老师。
exampleTraditional: 如果你對這個問題有疑問,可以馬上問老師。
exampleEnglish: If you have any doubts about this problem, you can ask the teacher right away.
hintSimplified: 心里不太确定、不太相信,想要问清楚的感觉。
hintTraditional: 心裡不太確定、不太相信,想要問清楚的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling of being unsure or unconvinced and wanting to ask for clarification.

exampleSimplified: 照顾年老的父母是子女的义务。
exampleTraditional: 照顧年老的父母是子女的義務。
exampleEnglish: Taking care of aging parents is a duty of children.
hintSimplified: 按照法律或道德,你应该做、不能不做的事。
hintTraditional: 按照法律或道德,你應該做、不能不做的事。
hintEnglish: Something you must do according to law or morals; you can't avoid it.

definition: medical science; medicine; study of medicine
exampleSimplified: 她大学读的是医学,以后想当医生。
exampleTraditional: 她大學讀的是醫學,以後想當醫生。
exampleEnglish: She studied medicine at university and wants to become a doctor.
hintSimplified: 研究人体、疾病和怎么治病的学问。
hintTraditional: 研究人體、疾病和怎麼治病的學問。
hintEnglish: The field of study about the human body, diseases, and how to treat them.

gloss: one by one; one after another
definition: one by one; one after another
exampleSimplified: 老师把同学的名字一一念了一遍。
exampleTraditional: 老師把同學的名字一一唸了一遍。
exampleEnglish: The teacher read out the students' names one by one.
hintSimplified: 表示按照顺序,一个接着一个地做。
hintTraditional: 表示按照順序,一個接著一個地做。
hintEnglish: Describes doing things in order, one after another.

exampleSimplified: 他有出国留学的意愿,但是还没有决定。
exampleTraditional: 他有出國留學的意願,但是還沒有決定。
exampleEnglish: He has the desire to study abroad, but hasn't decided yet.
hintSimplified: 心里想做某件事的愿望或打算。
hintTraditional: 心裡想做某件事的願望或打算。
hintEnglish: An inner wish or inclination to do something.

exampleSimplified: 医生一再提醒他不要熬夜。
exampleTraditional: 醫生一再提醒他不要熬夜。
exampleEnglish: The doctor repeatedly reminded him not to stay up late.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示同样的事情一次又一次地发生。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示同樣的事情一次又一次地發生。
hintEnglish: An adverb showing the same thing happens again and again.

exampleSimplified: 他靠坚强的意志完成了马拉松。
exampleTraditional: 他靠堅強的意志完成了馬拉松。
exampleEnglish: He finished the marathon through strong willpower.
hintSimplified: 遇到困难时,让人坚持下去的心理力量。
hintTraditional: 遇到困難時,讓人堅持下去的心理力量。
hintEnglish: The mental strength that keeps a person going when facing difficulties.

definition: consistent; unanimous; in agreement; together; in unison
exampleSimplified: 大家的看法完全一致,没有人反对。
exampleTraditional: 大家的看法完全一致,沒有人反對。
exampleEnglish: Everyone's views are completely the same; nobody objects.
hintSimplified: 大家的想法或做法相同,没有不同意见。
hintTraditional: 大家的想法或做法相同,沒有不同意見。
hintEnglish: Everyone's ideas or actions are the same, with no disagreement.

exampleSimplified: 机场里,妈妈紧紧地拥抱着回国的女儿。
exampleTraditional: 機場裡,媽媽緊緊地擁抱著回國的女兒。
exampleEnglish: At the airport, the mother held her returning daughter tightly in her arms.
hintSimplified: 张开双臂把人抱住,表示亲近或欢迎。
hintTraditional: 張開雙臂把人抱住,表示親近或歡迎。
hintEnglish: Opening your arms and holding someone close to show affection or welcome.

exampleSimplified: 这个旧盒子还有用处,先别丢掉。
exampleTraditional: 這個舊盒子還有用處,先別丟掉。
exampleEnglish: This old box still has some use, so don't throw it away yet.
hintSimplified: 一样东西能帮上忙、发挥作用的地方。
hintTraditional: 一樣東西能幫上忙、發揮作用的地方。
hintEnglish: The way in which something can be helpful or serve a purpose.

exampleSimplified: 大多数市民都拥护这个新政策。
exampleTraditional: 大多數市民都擁護這個新政策。
exampleEnglish: Most citizens support this new policy.
hintSimplified: 赞成并支持某个人或某个主张。
hintTraditional: 贊成並支援某個人或某個主張。
hintEnglish: To approve of and back a person or proposal.

exampleSimplified: 下班时间捷运非常拥挤,几乎没有位子。
exampleTraditional: 下班時間捷運非常擁擠,幾乎沒有位子。
exampleEnglish: The MRT is very crowded at rush hour, with almost no seats.
hintSimplified: 人或车太多,空间不够,很难移动。
hintTraditional: 人或車太多,空間不夠,很難移動。
hintEnglish: Too many people or vehicles in too little space, making it hard to move.

exampleSimplified: 这家店卖各种运动用具。
exampleTraditional: 這家店賣各種運動用具。
exampleEnglish: This shop sells all kinds of sports equipment.
hintSimplified: 做某件事时需要使用的工具或东西。
hintTraditional: 做某件事時需要使用的工具或東西。
hintEnglish: Tools or items needed for doing a certain activity.

exampleSimplified: 门很重,你要用力推才打得开。
exampleTraditional: 門很重,你要用力推才打得開。
exampleEnglish: The door is heavy; you have to push hard to open it.
hintSimplified: 做动作时使出很大的力气。
hintTraditional: 做動作時使出很大的力氣。
hintEnglish: To put a lot of strength into a movement.

exampleSimplified: 她鼓起勇气,在大家面前唱了一首歌。
exampleTraditional: 她鼓起勇氣,在大家面前唱了一首歌。
exampleEnglish: She summoned her courage and sang a song in front of everyone.
hintSimplified: 面对危险或困难时不害怕的心理力量。
hintTraditional: 面對危險或困難時不害怕的心理力量。
hintEnglish: The inner strength to not be afraid when facing danger or difficulty.

definition: careful; intention; motive; to be diligent or attentive
exampleSimplified: 这个学生上课很用心,成绩一直很好。
exampleTraditional: 這個學生上課很用心,成績一直很好。
exampleEnglish: This student is very attentive in class, and his grades are always good.
hintSimplified: 做事时把注意力和心思都放进去,很认真。
hintTraditional: 做事時把注意力和心思都放進去,很認真。
hintEnglish: Putting full attention and effort into what you do; being diligent.

exampleSimplified: 邮差每天早上都会来送信。
exampleTraditional: 郵差每天早上都會來送信。
exampleEnglish: The mailman comes to deliver letters every morning.
hintSimplified: 骑车挨家挨户送信和包裹的人。
hintTraditional: 騎車挨家挨戶送信和包裹的人。
hintEnglish: The person who goes door to door delivering letters and parcels.

definition: concerning; related to; to concern; to have sth to do with; to relate to
exampleSimplified: 你可以上网查一下有关这个活动的信息。
exampleTraditional: 你可以上網查一下有關這個活動的資訊。
exampleEnglish: You can go online and look up information about this event.
hintSimplified: 表示和某件事情有联系、涉及到它。
hintTraditional: 表示和某件事情有聯絡、涉及到它。
hintEnglish: Indicates something is connected to or concerns a certain matter.

definition: close friend; friendly; amicable; see 友好區|友好区[You3 hao3 Qu1]
exampleSimplified: 邻居们对新搬来的家庭很友好。
exampleTraditional: 鄰居們對新搬來的家庭很友好。
exampleEnglish: The neighbors are very friendly to the newly moved-in family.
hintSimplified: 形容人对别人亲切、不敌对的态度。
hintTraditional: 形容人對別人親切、不敵對的態度。
hintEnglish: Describes a kind, non-hostile attitude toward others.

exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅周末有优惠,全部菜单打八折。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳週末有優惠,全部選單打八折。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant has a special offer on weekends: 20% off the whole menu.
hintSimplified: 商店为了吸引客人,让价格比平常便宜。
hintTraditional: 商店為了吸引客人,讓價格比平常便宜。
hintEnglish: When a store makes prices lower than usual to attract customers.

exampleSimplified: 他提出了很有力的证据来支持自己的看法。
exampleTraditional: 他提出了很有力的證據來支援自己的看法。
exampleEnglish: He offered strong evidence to support his view.
hintSimplified: 形容话语或证据很有说服力,让人不容易反驳。
hintTraditional: 形容話語或證據很有說服力,讓人不容易反駁。
hintEnglish: Describes words or evidence that are convincing and hard to refute.

exampleSimplified: 这个消息对我们的计划很有利。
exampleTraditional: 這個訊息對我們的計劃很有利。
exampleEnglish: This news is very favorable to our plan.
hintSimplified: 对某人或某件事有好处、条件很好。
hintTraditional: 對某人或某件事有好處、條件很好。
hintEnglish: Beneficial to someone or something; conditions are good.

exampleSimplified: 这所学校有优良的传统,学生都很有礼貌。
exampleTraditional: 這所學校有優良的傳統,學生都很有禮貌。
exampleEnglish: This school has a fine tradition, and the students are all very polite.
hintSimplified: 形容品质、成绩或传统非常好。
hintTraditional: 形容品質、成績或傳統非常好。
hintEnglish: Describes quality, results, or traditions that are very good.

exampleSimplified: 山里的风景优美,空气也很新鲜。
exampleTraditional: 山裡的風景優美,空氣也很新鮮。
exampleEnglish: The mountain scenery is graceful and beautiful, and the air is fresh too.
hintSimplified: 形容风景、音乐或姿势美好又舒服。
hintTraditional: 形容風景、音樂或姿勢美好又舒服。
hintEnglish: Describes scenery, music, or movements that are lovely and pleasing.

gloss: (neologism, attested by 2017) (of a middle-aged man) obnoxious; pretentious; vulgar
definition: (neologism, attested by 2017) (of a middle-aged man) obnoxious; pretentious; vulgar; (of food) greasy; oily; fatty; greasy food; oily food
exampleSimplified: 他才三十多岁,说话的方式却有点油腻。
exampleTraditional: 他才三十多歲,說話的方式卻有點油膩。
exampleEnglish: He's only in his thirties, but the way he talks is a bit greasy and off-putting.
hintSimplified: 形容中年男人自以为很有魅力,却让人觉得讨厌、不舒服。
hintTraditional: 形容中年男人自以為很有魅力,卻讓人覺得討厭、不舒服。
hintEnglish: Describes a middle-aged man who thinks he is charming but comes across as annoying and cringeworthy.

exampleSimplified: 今天有些同学没有来上课。
exampleTraditional: 今天有些同學沒有來上課。
exampleEnglish: Some students didn't come to class today.
hintSimplified: 表示不是全部,只是一部分人或东西。
hintTraditional: 表示不是全部,只是一部分人或東西。
hintEnglish: Indicates not all, just a portion of people or things.

definition: procession; march; demonstration; to march; to parade; to demonstrate; to travel around; to roam
exampleSimplified: 很多人走上街头参加游行。
exampleTraditional: 很多人走上街頭參加遊行。
exampleEnglish: Many people took to the streets to join the march.
hintSimplified: 很多人一起在街上走,表达意见或庆祝。
hintTraditional: 很多人一起在街上走,表達意見或慶祝。
hintEnglish: Many people walk together along the street to express opinions or celebrate.

exampleSimplified: 他犹豫了很久,还是没有买那双鞋。
exampleTraditional: 他猶豫了很久,還是沒有買那雙鞋。
exampleEnglish: He hesitated for a long time and still didn't buy those shoes.
hintSimplified: 不能马上做决定,心里想来想去。
hintTraditional: 不能馬上做決定,心裡想來想去。
hintEnglish: You can't make a decision right away and keep going back and forth in your mind.

exampleSimplified: 下雨天,她的心情总是很忧郁。
exampleTraditional: 下雨天,她的心情總是很憂鬱。
exampleEnglish: On rainy days, she always feels melancholy.
hintSimplified: 心里不开心,总是安静又有点难过的样子。
hintTraditional: 心裡不開心,總是安靜又有點難過的樣子。
hintEnglish: Feeling unhappy inside, quiet and a little sad.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市有优越的地理位置和便利的交通。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市有優越的地理位置和便利的交通。
exampleEnglish: This city has a superior location and convenient transportation.
hintSimplified: 形容条件特别好,比别的更好。
hintTraditional: 形容條件特別好,比別的更好。
hintEnglish: Describes conditions that are especially good, better than others.

definition: originally; the original; original copy; original version
exampleSimplified: 我原本想去海边,但是后来下雨了。
exampleTraditional: 我原本想去海邊,但是後來下雨了。
exampleEnglish: I originally wanted to go to the beach, but then it rained.
hintSimplified: 表示一开始的计划或情况,后来常常改变了。
hintTraditional: 表示一開始的計劃或情況,後來常常改變了。
hintEnglish: Indicates the initial plan or situation, which often changed later.

exampleSimplified: 他从小就有远大的理想。
exampleTraditional: 他從小就有遠大的理想。
exampleEnglish: He has had great ambitions since he was little.
hintSimplified: 形容理想或目标很高、很有未来性。
hintTraditional: 形容理想或目標很高、很有未來性。
hintEnglish: Describes ideals or goals that are lofty and forward-looking.

exampleSimplified: 元旦那天,我们一起去看烟火。
exampleTraditional: 元旦那天,我們一起去看煙火。
exampleEnglish: On New Year's Day, we went together to watch the fireworks.
hintSimplified: 一月一日,新的一年的第一天。
hintTraditional: 一月一日,新的一年的第一天。
hintEnglish: January 1st, the first day of a new year.

exampleSimplified: 不知道是什么缘故,他今天没有来。
exampleTraditional: 不知道是什麼緣故,他今天沒有來。
exampleEnglish: I don't know the reason, but he didn't come today.
hintSimplified: 事情发生的原因,常说「不知道是什么……」。
hintTraditional: 事情發生的原因,常說「不知道是什麼……」。
hintEnglish: The reason something happens, often used in "I don't know what the ... is."

exampleSimplified: 老师给我们讲了飞机飞行的原理。
exampleTraditional: 老師給我們講了飛機飛行的原理。
exampleEnglish: The teacher explained to us the principle of how airplanes fly.
hintSimplified: 科学或机器背后最基本的道理。
hintTraditional: 科學或機器背後最基本的道理。
hintEnglish: The most basic reasoning behind a science or a machine.

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂每天都要进口大量原料。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠每天都要進口大量原料。
exampleEnglish: This factory has to import a large amount of raw materials every day.
hintSimplified: 工厂用来做成产品的最初材料。
hintTraditional: 工廠用來做成產品的最初材料。
hintEnglish: The initial materials a factory uses to make products.

exampleSimplified: 这次活动圆满成功,大家都很高兴。
exampleTraditional: 這次活動圓滿成功,大家都很高興。
exampleEnglish: The event was a complete success and everyone was happy.
hintSimplified: 形容事情结束得很好,没有遗憾。
hintTraditional: 形容事情結束得很好,沒有遺憾。
hintEnglish: Describes something that ended very well, without regrets.

exampleSimplified: 他们住在原始森林里,生活很简单。
exampleTraditional: 他們住在原始森林裡,生活很簡單。
exampleEnglish: They live in a primeval forest and their life is simple.
hintSimplified: 形容很古老、还没有被现代人改变的样子。
hintTraditional: 形容很古老、還沒有被現代人改變的樣子。
hintEnglish: Describes something very ancient and not yet changed by modern people.

definition: injustice; not worthwhile; to accuse wrongly; to treat unjustly; wronged
exampleSimplified: 我没有拿你的钱,你不要冤枉我。
exampleTraditional: 我沒有拿你的錢,你不要冤枉我。
exampleEnglish: I didn't take your money, so don't accuse me wrongly.
hintSimplified: 明明没做错事,却被别人说成有错。
hintTraditional: 明明沒做錯事,卻被別人說成有錯。
hintEnglish: You did nothing wrong, yet others say you did.

exampleSimplified: 这家店原先是卖衣服的,现在改卖咖啡了。
exampleTraditional: 這家店原先是賣衣服的,現在改賣咖啡了。
exampleEnglish: This shop originally sold clothes, but now it sells coffee.
hintSimplified: 指以前的情况,和现在不一样。
hintTraditional: 指以前的情況,和現在不一樣。
hintEnglish: Refers to the earlier situation, which differs from now.

exampleSimplified: 这张圆形的桌子可以坐八个人。
exampleTraditional: 這張圓形的桌子可以坐八個人。
exampleEnglish: This round table can seat eight people.
hintSimplified: 像盘子或月亮那样,没有角的样子。
hintTraditional: 像盤子或月亮那樣,沒有角的樣子。
hintEnglish: Shaped like a plate or the moon, with no corners.

exampleSimplified: 做人要有自己的原则,不能随便改变。
exampleTraditional: 做人要有自己的原則,不能隨便改變。
exampleEnglish: A person should have their own principles and shouldn't change them casually.
hintSimplified: 一个人做事时一直遵守的基本规矩或想法。
hintTraditional: 一個人做事時一直遵守的基本規矩或想法。
hintEnglish: The basic rules or beliefs a person consistently follows when acting.

exampleSimplified: 天气预报说明天会下大雨。
exampleTraditional: 天氣預報說明天會下大雨。
exampleEnglish: The weather forecast says it will rain heavily tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 事先告诉大家以后天气或情况会怎样。
hintTraditional: 事先告訴大家以後天氣或情況會怎樣。
