hintEnglish: Telling people in advance how the weather or situation will be.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; intonation; tone of voice
exampleSimplified: 他说中文时,语调很自然。
exampleTraditional: 他說中文時,語調很自然。
exampleEnglish: When he speaks Chinese, his intonation is very natural.
hintSimplified: 说话时声音的高低变化。
hintTraditional: 說話時聲音的高低變化。
hintEnglish: The rise and fall of the voice when speaking.

exampleSimplified: 会议预定在下午三点开始。
exampleTraditional: 會議預定在下午三點開始。
exampleEnglish: The meeting is scheduled to begin at three in the afternoon.
hintSimplified: 事先决定好时间或计划。
hintTraditional: 事先決定好時間或計劃。
hintEnglish: Deciding a time or plan beforehand.

definition: to book ahead; to place an order
exampleSimplified: 我已经预订了周末的饭店房间。
exampleTraditional: 我已經預訂了週末的飯店房間。
exampleEnglish: I have already booked a hotel room for the weekend.
hintSimplified: 去饭店、买票以前,先留下位子或房间。
hintTraditional: 去飯店、買票以前,先留下位子或房間。
hintEnglish: Reserving a seat or room before going to a hotel or buying a ticket.

exampleSimplified: 这个月分的天气特别舒服。
exampleTraditional: 這個月分的天氣特別舒服。
exampleEnglish: The weather this month is especially pleasant.
hintSimplified: 一年十二个里面的某一个,常和「这个」连用。
hintTraditional: 一年十二個裡面的某一個,常和「這個」連用。
hintEnglish: One of the twelve parts of a year, often used after "this".

exampleSimplified: 晚上的月光照在湖面上,非常美。
exampleTraditional: 晚上的月光照在湖面上,非常美。
exampleEnglish: The moonlight shining on the lake at night is very beautiful.
hintSimplified: 晚上从天空中那个圆圆的东西照下来的亮光。
hintTraditional: 晚上從天空中那個圓圓的東西照下來的亮光。
hintEnglish: The light shining down at night from that round object in the sky.

exampleSimplified: 人类第一次登上月球是在一九六九年。
exampleTraditional: 人類第一次登上月球是在一九六九年。
exampleEnglish: Humans first landed on the moon in 1969.
hintSimplified: 绕着地球转的天体,太空人曾经登上去。
hintTraditional: 繞著地球轉的天體,太空人曾經登上去。
hintEnglish: The celestial body that orbits the Earth, where astronauts have landed.

definition: to estimate; to forecast; to predict
exampleSimplified: 我们预计下个月会完成这个工作。
exampleTraditional: 我們預計下個月會完成這個工作。
exampleEnglish: We expect to finish this work next month.
hintSimplified: 根据现在的情况，先想一想以后大概会怎么样。
hintTraditional: 根據現在的情況，先想一想以後大概會怎麼樣。
hintEnglish: Based on the current situation, think ahead about roughly how things will turn out.

exampleSimplified: 我在路上遇见了很久没见的老同学。
exampleTraditional: 我在路上遇見了很久沒見的老同學。
exampleEnglish: I ran into an old classmate I hadn't seen in a long time on the street.
hintSimplified: 没有约好，却在某个地方碰到了某个人。
hintTraditional: 沒有約好，卻在某個地方碰到了某個人。
hintEnglish: Without having arranged it, you come across someone somewhere.

definition: amusement; entertainment; fun; hobby; joy; recreation; to amuse; to entertain
exampleSimplified: 看电影和唱歌都是我喜欢的娱乐。
exampleTraditional: 看電影和唱歌都是我喜歡的娛樂。
exampleEnglish: Watching movies and singing are both entertainment I enjoy.
hintSimplified: 让人放松、开心的活动，例如玩游戏或看表演。
hintTraditional: 讓人放鬆、開心的活動，例如玩遊戲或看錶演。
hintEnglish: Activities that relax people and make them happy, such as playing games or watching shows.

exampleSimplified: 这些水果是用船运输到国外的。
exampleTraditional: 這些水果是用船運輸到國外的。
exampleEnglish: These fruits are shipped abroad by boat.
hintSimplified: 用车、船或飞机把大量货物从一个地方送到另一个地方。
hintTraditional: 用車、船或飛機把大量貨物從一個地方送到另一個地方。
hintEnglish: Using trucks, ships or planes to move large amounts of goods from one place to another.

exampleSimplified: 卡车把新鲜的蔬菜运送到市场。
exampleTraditional: 卡車把新鮮的蔬菜運送到市場。
exampleEnglish: The truck delivers fresh vegetables to the market.
hintSimplified: 用交通工具把人或东西带到目的地。
hintTraditional: 用交通工具把人或東西帶到目的地。
hintEnglish: Using a vehicle to take people or things to their destination.

exampleSimplified: 这里不允许大声说话。
exampleTraditional: 這裡不允許大聲說話。
exampleEnglish: Talking loudly is not allowed here.
hintSimplified: 别人同意你做某件事，不会反对。
hintTraditional: 別人同意你做某件事，不會反對。
hintEnglish: Others agree that you may do something and do not object.

definition: to put to use; to use
exampleSimplified: 老师希望我们能把学到的知识运用在生活中。
exampleTraditional: 老師希望我們能把學到的知識運用在生活中。
exampleEnglish: The teacher hopes we can apply the knowledge we've learned in daily life.
hintSimplified: 把学过的方法或知识拿来实际使用。
hintTraditional: 把學過的方法或知識拿來實際使用。
hintEnglish: Taking methods or knowledge you've learned and actually putting them into practice.

definition: to operate; to revolve; to turn around; to work
exampleSimplified: 这台机器已经正常运转了三年。
exampleTraditional: 這臺機器已經正常運轉了三年。
exampleEnglish: This machine has been running normally for three years.
hintSimplified: 机器或组织一直在工作，没有停下来。
hintTraditional: 機器或組織一直在工作，沒有停下來。
hintEnglish: A machine or organization keeps working without stopping.

gloss: rather than... (used in expressions of the form 與其|与其[yu3 qi2] + {verb1} + 不如[bu4 ru2] + {verb2} "rather than {verb1}, better to {verb2}")
definition: rather than... (used in expressions of the form 與其|与其[yu3 qi2] + {verb1} + 不如[bu4 ru2] + {verb2} "rather than {verb1}, better to {verb2}")
exampleSimplified: 与其在家里生气，不如出去走走。
exampleTraditional: 與其在家裡生氣，不如出去走走。
exampleEnglish: Rather than being angry at home, you might as well go out for a walk.
hintSimplified: 常和“不如”一起用，比较两种做法，说明后一种更好。
hintTraditional: 常和“不如”一起用，比較兩種做法，說明後一種更好。
hintEnglish: Often used together with a phrase meaning “better to”, comparing two choices and saying the latter is better.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; manner of speaking; mood; tone
exampleSimplified: 他说话的语气很温和，让人觉得很舒服。
exampleTraditional: 他說話的語氣很溫和，讓人覺得很舒服。
exampleEnglish: His tone of voice is very gentle and makes people feel comfortable.
hintSimplified: 说话时表现出来的感觉，例如生气、客气或开玩笑。
hintTraditional: 說話時表現出來的感覺，例如生氣、客氣或開玩笑。
hintEnglish: The feeling shown when speaking, such as anger, politeness or joking.

exampleSimplified: 我们的旅行预算只有两万块。
exampleTraditional: 我們的旅行預算只有兩萬塊。
exampleEnglish: Our travel budget is only twenty thousand dollars.
hintSimplified: 事情开始以前，先计划好总共可以花多少钱。
hintTraditional: 事情開始以前，先計劃好總共可以花多少錢。
hintEnglish: The plan of how much money can be spent in total before something begins.

exampleSimplified: 参加活动的人要预先报名。
exampleTraditional: 參加活動的人要預先報名。
exampleEnglish: People who want to join the event must register in advance.
hintSimplified: 在事情发生以前就先做好。
hintTraditional: 在事情發生以前就先做好。
hintEnglish: Doing something before the event takes place.

definition: (Internet) to voice chat; audio; colloquial (rather than literary) pronunciation of a Chinese character; phonetic; pronunciation; speech sounds; voice; voice message
exampleSimplified: 他发了一段语音给我，说他晚点到。
exampleTraditional: 他發了一段語音給我，說他晚點到。
exampleEnglish: He sent me a voice message saying he would arrive later.
hintSimplified: 手机上不用打字，直接用声音传给别人的东西。
hintTraditional: 手機上不用打字，直接用聲音傳給別人的東西。
hintEnglish: On a phone, something sent to others with your voice instead of typing.

gloss: once more; once again; one more time
definition: once more; once again; one more time
exampleSimplified: 这位歌手再度来到台湾开演唱会。
exampleTraditional: 這位歌手再度來到台灣開演唱會。
exampleEnglish: This singer has come to Taiwan again to hold a concert.
hintSimplified: 表示同样的事情又发生了一次，比较正式。
hintTraditional: 表示同樣的事情又發生了一次，比較正式。
hintEnglish: Indicates that the same thing happens one more time; fairly formal.

exampleSimplified: 台风和地震都是常见的自然灾害。
exampleTraditional: 颱風和地震都是常見的自然災害。
exampleEnglish: Typhoons and earthquakes are both common natural disasters.
hintSimplified: 由洪水、地震等造成的严重损失。
hintTraditional: 由洪水、地震等造成的嚴重損失。
hintEnglish: Serious damage caused by floods, earthquakes and the like.

gloss: (often used in the negative) to care about
definition: (often used in the negative) to care about; to rest with; to lie in; to be due to (a certain attribute)
exampleSimplified: 他一点也不在乎别人怎么看他。
exampleTraditional: 他一點也不在乎別人怎麼看他。
exampleEnglish: He doesn't care at all what others think of him.
hintSimplified: 把某件事放在心上，觉得很重要；常用否定句。
hintTraditional: 把某件事放在心上，覺得很重要；常用否定句。
hintEnglish: Taking something to heart as important; often used in the negative.

exampleSimplified: 战争给人们带来了巨大的灾难。
exampleTraditional: 戰爭給人們帶來了巨大的災難。
exampleEnglish: War brought enormous catastrophe to people.
hintSimplified: 让很多人受苦的非常不幸的大事件。
hintTraditional: 讓很多人受苦的非常不幸的大事件。
hintEnglish: A very unfortunate major event that makes many people suffer.

definition: again and again; over and over again
exampleSimplified: 妈妈再三提醒我出门要带伞。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽再三提醒我出門要帶傘。
exampleEnglish: Mom reminded me over and over to take an umbrella when going out.
hintSimplified: 表示一次又一次，做了很多遍。
hintTraditional: 表示一次又一次，做了很多遍。
hintEnglish: Means time after time, done many times.

definition: besides; moreover; to put off a discussion until later; to say again; what's more
exampleSimplified: 这家店太远了，再说价钱也不便宜。
exampleTraditional: 這家店太遠了，再說價錢也不便宜。
exampleEnglish: This shop is too far, and besides, the prices aren't cheap.
hintSimplified: 说完一个理由后，用来再补充另一个理由。
hintTraditional: 說完一個理由後，用來再補充另一個理由。
hintEnglish: Used after giving one reason to add another one.

definition: (literary) to help bring about; to approve of; to agree with
exampleSimplified: 大部分同学都赞成明天去郊游。
exampleTraditional: 大部分同學都贊成明天去郊遊。
exampleEnglish: Most classmates agree to go on an outing tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 对别人的想法或计划表示同意和支持。
hintTraditional: 對別人的想法或計劃表示同意和支援。
hintEnglish: Showing agreement and support for someone's idea or plan.

exampleSimplified: 很多亲戚朋友都来参加爷爷的葬礼。
exampleTraditional: 很多親戚朋友都來參加爺爺的葬禮。
exampleEnglish: Many relatives and friends came to attend grandfather's funeral.
hintSimplified: 人去世以后，大家聚在一起向他告别的仪式。
hintTraditional: 人去世以後，大家聚在一起向他告別的儀式。
hintEnglish: A ceremony where people gather to say farewell after someone has died.

definition: to admire; to eulogize; to praise
exampleSimplified: 大家都赞美她的歌声很动人。
exampleTraditional: 大家都讚美她的歌聲很動人。
exampleEnglish: Everyone praised her singing voice as very moving.
hintSimplified: 用好听的话说出对人或事物的欣赏和称许。
hintTraditional: 用好聽的話說出對人或事物的欣賞和稱許。
hintEnglish: To express admiration and approval of a person or thing with kind words.

gloss: (dialect) (in a coaxing or familiar way) you
definition: (dialect) (in a coaxing or familiar way) you; (dialect) I or me; also pr. [za2 men5]; we or us (including both the speaker and the person(s) spoken to)
exampleSimplified: 天快黑了，咱们回家吧。
exampleTraditional: 天快黑了，咱們回家吧。
exampleEnglish: It's getting dark, let's go home.
hintSimplified: 说话的人把听话的人也包括在内的“我们”，语气比较亲近。
hintTraditional: 說話的人把聽話的人也包括在內的“我們”，語氣比較親近。
hintEnglish: A friendly “we” in which the speaker includes the listener.

gloss: to approve of; to agree with (an opinion, action etc); to endorse
definition: to approve of; to agree with (an opinion, action etc); to endorse; variant of 贊同|赞同[zan4 tong2]
exampleSimplified: 经理赞同我的看法，决定照这个方法做。
exampleTraditional: 經理贊同我的看法，決定照這個方法做。
exampleEnglish: The manager agreed with my view and decided to follow this method.
hintSimplified: 认为别人的意见是对的，并且同意。
hintTraditional: 認為別人的意見是對的，並且同意。
hintEnglish: Thinking someone else's opinion is right and agreeing with it.

exampleSimplified: 早晨的空气很新鲜，很适合运动。
exampleTraditional: 早晨的空氣很新鮮，很適合運動。
exampleEnglish: The morning air is fresh and very suitable for exercise.
hintSimplified: 天刚亮不久的时候，太阳刚出来。
hintTraditional: 天剛亮不久的時候，太陽剛出來。
hintEnglish: The time shortly after daybreak, when the sun has just come up.

definition: to meet with (sth unfortunate); to suffer
exampleSimplified: 这家店遭到客人的批评。
exampleTraditional: 這家店遭到客人的批評。
exampleEnglish: This shop was criticized by customers.
hintSimplified: 碰上不好的事,例如被批评或被攻击。
hintTraditional: 碰上不好的事,例如被批評或被攻擊。
hintEnglish: To run into something unpleasant, such as criticism or an attack.

definition: bad; how terrible; terrible; too bad; what bad luck
exampleSimplified: 糟糕!我忘了带钥匙。
exampleTraditional: 糟糕!我忘了帶鑰匙。
exampleEnglish: Oh no! I forgot to bring my keys.
hintSimplified: 事情不顺利或情况很差时,你会这样说。
hintTraditional: 事情不順利或情況很差時,你會這樣說。
hintEnglish: What you say when things go wrong or the situation is very bad.

exampleSimplified: 老师要我们用这个词语造句。
exampleTraditional: 老師要我們用這個詞語造句。
exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to make a sentence with this word.
hintSimplified: 学语文时,用一个新词写出完整的话。
hintTraditional: 學語文時,用一個新詞寫出完整的話。
hintEnglish: In language class, using a new word to write a complete sentence.

exampleSimplified: 那个地区遭受了严重的水灾。
exampleTraditional: 那個地區遭受了嚴重的水災。
exampleEnglish: That region suffered a serious flood.
hintSimplified: 承受损失、灾难或痛苦。
hintTraditional: 承受損失、災難或痛苦。
hintEnglish: To endure loss, disaster, or pain.

definition: (dialect) in the past; for a long time; long since
exampleSimplified: 他早已经搬到国外去住了。
exampleTraditional: 他早已經搬到國外去住了。
exampleEnglish: He moved abroad long ago.
hintSimplified: 表示事情在很久以前就已经发生。
hintTraditional: 表示事情在很久以前就已經發生。
hintEnglish: Shows that something happened a long time ago already.

definition: an experience (esp. adverse); to meet with; to encounter (esp. misfortune or hardship)
exampleSimplified: 他把自己的遭遇写成了一本书。
exampleTraditional: 他把自己的遭遇寫成了一本書。
exampleEnglish: He wrote his experiences into a book.
hintSimplified: 一个人生活中碰到的事,常常是不幸的。
hintTraditional: 一個人生活中碰到的事,常常是不幸的。
hintEnglish: What happens to a person in life, often unfortunate things.

exampleSimplified: 买手机就送一个赠品。
exampleTraditional: 買手機就送一個贈品。
exampleEnglish: You get a free gift when you buy a phone.
hintSimplified: 买东西时店家免费给你的小东西。
hintTraditional: 買東西時店家免費給你的小東西。
hintEnglish: A small item a shop gives you for free when you buy something.

exampleSimplified: 这家店赠送客人一杯饮料。
exampleTraditional: 這家店贈送客人一杯飲料。
exampleEnglish: This shop gives customers a free drink.
hintSimplified: 免费把东西给别人,不收钱。
hintTraditional: 免費把東西給別人,不收錢。
hintEnglish: To give something to others for free, without charging.

exampleSimplified: 今年公司的收入增长了百分之十。
exampleTraditional: 今年公司的收入增長了百分之十。
exampleEnglish: The company's revenue grew by ten percent this year.
hintSimplified: 数量或程度一点一点变多、变大。
hintTraditional: 數量或程度一點一點變多、變大。
hintEnglish: Quantity or degree becoming greater little by little.

exampleSimplified: 这部电影讲的是战场上的故事。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影講的是戰場上的故事。
exampleEnglish: This movie tells a story set on the battlefield.
hintSimplified: 军队互相打仗的地方。
hintTraditional: 軍隊互相打仗的地方。
hintEnglish: The place where armies fight each other.

definition: to be on show; to exhibit; to put on display
exampleSimplified: 他的画作将在美术馆展出。
exampleTraditional: 他的畫作將在美術館展出。
exampleEnglish: His paintings will be exhibited at the art museum.
hintSimplified: 把作品拿出来给大家参观。
hintTraditional: 把作品拿出來給大家參觀。
hintEnglish: To put works out for the public to view.

exampleSimplified: 过年时要向长辈拜年。
exampleTraditional: 過年時要向長輩拜年。
exampleEnglish: During New Year you should greet your elders.
hintSimplified: 家里年纪比你大、辈分比你高的人。
hintTraditional: 家裡年紀比你大、輩分比你高的人。
hintEnglish: People in the family who are older and of a higher generation than you.

gloss: variant of 賬單|账单[zhang4 dan1]
definition: variant of 賬單|账单[zhang4 dan1]
exampleSimplified: 服务生,请把帐单拿给我。
exampleTraditional: 服務生,請把帳單拿給我。
exampleEnglish: Waiter, please bring me the bill.
hintSimplified: 吃完饭后,店员给你的写着要付多少钱的纸。
hintTraditional: 吃完飯後,店員給你的寫著要付多少錢的紙。
hintEnglish: The paper a waiter gives you after a meal showing how much to pay.

exampleSimplified: 她的丈夫在医院工作。
exampleTraditional: 她的丈夫在醫院工作。
exampleEnglish: Her husband works at a hospital.
hintSimplified: 已经结婚的女人称呼她的另一半。
hintTraditional: 已經結婚的女人稱呼她的另一半。
hintEnglish: What a married woman calls her male spouse.

definition: to appreciate (in value); to increase in price
exampleSimplified: 最近蔬菜又涨价了。
exampleTraditional: 最近蔬菜又漲價了。
exampleEnglish: Vegetable prices have gone up again recently.
hintSimplified: 东西的价钱变得更贵。
hintTraditional: 東西的價錢變得更貴。
hintEnglish: The price of something becomes higher.

definition: to extend; to open up; to spread
exampleSimplified: 医生请他张开嘴巴。
exampleTraditional: 醫生請他張開嘴巴。
exampleEnglish: The doctor asked him to open his mouth.
hintSimplified: 把嘴巴或双手等向外打开。
hintTraditional: 把嘴巴或雙手等向外開啟。
hintEnglish: To open up something like the mouth or arms wide.

exampleSimplified: 演出结束后,大家热烈地鼓起了掌声。
exampleTraditional: 演出結束後,大家熱烈地鼓起了掌聲。
exampleEnglish: After the show ended, everyone burst into warm applause.
hintSimplified: 表演结束后,观众用双手拍出来的声音。
hintTraditional: 表演結束後,觀眾用雙手拍出來的聲音。
hintEnglish: The sound the audience makes with their hands after a performance.

definition: to launch; to carry out; to unfold; to spread out; to open up
exampleSimplified: 我们明天将展开新的计划。
exampleTraditional: 我們明天將展開新的計劃。
exampleEnglish: We will launch a new plan tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 开始进行一项活动或工作,或把折起来的东西打开。
hintTraditional: 開始進行一項活動或工作,或把折起來的東西開啟。
hintEnglish: To begin an activity or work, or to unfold something folded.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],次[ci4]; exhibition; show; to exhibit; to put on display
exampleSimplified: 周末我想去看那个摄影展览。
exampleTraditional: 週末我想去看那個攝影展覽。
exampleEnglish: This weekend I want to go see that photography exhibition.
hintSimplified: 在美术馆或会场摆出作品给人参观的活动。
hintTraditional: 在美術館或會場擺出作品給人參觀的活動。
hintEnglish: An event in a gallery or hall where works are displayed for visitors.

gloss: to reveal; to display; to show; to exhibit
definition: to reveal; to display; to show; to exhibit
exampleSimplified: 公司向大家展示了新产品。
exampleTraditional: 公司向大家展示了新產品。
exampleEnglish: The company showed everyone its new product.
hintSimplified: 清楚地把东西或成果给别人看。
hintTraditional: 清楚地把東西或成果給別人看。
hintEnglish: To clearly present something or results for others to see.

gloss: to account for (a high proportion etc)
definition: to account for (a high proportion etc); to have; to hold; to occupy; to own; to possess
exampleSimplified: 这家公司占有很大的市场。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司占有很大的市場。
exampleEnglish: This company holds a large share of the market.
hintSimplified: 拥有一定的比例、地位或空间。
hintTraditional: 擁有一定的比例、地位或空間。
hintEnglish: To hold a certain proportion, position, or amount of space.

gloss: (fig.) to hold one's ground; to gain a firm foothold
definition: (fig.) to hold one's ground; to gain a firm foothold; (of an assertion etc) to hold up; to be tenable; to come to a stop; to halt; to keep one's footing; to stay upright
exampleSimplified: 警察大声说:“站住!”
exampleTraditional: 警察大聲說:“站住!”
exampleEnglish: The policeman shouted, "Stop right there!"
hintSimplified: 叫跑的人停下脚步不要动。
hintTraditional: 叫跑的人停下腳步不要動。
hintEnglish: What you shout to make a running person stop moving.

exampleSimplified: 下大雨,但是公司照常上班。
exampleTraditional: 下大雨,但是公司照常上班。
exampleEnglish: It's raining heavily, but the company is open as usual.
hintSimplified: 表示事情没有改变,和平常一样。
hintTraditional: 表示事情沒有改變,和平常一樣。
hintEnglish: Shows that nothing has changed and things go on the same as usual.

definition: to call out to; to greet; to inform; to say hello to; to take care of; to take care that one does not
exampleSimplified: 看到老师,他马上过去打招呼。
exampleTraditional: 看到老師,他馬上過去打招呼。
exampleEnglish: Seeing the teacher, he went over right away to say hello.
hintSimplified: 见面时用话或动作向人问好。
hintTraditional: 見面時用話或動作向人問好。
hintEnglish: To greet someone with words or gestures when meeting.

definition: to call together; to convene (a conference or meeting); to convoke
exampleSimplified: 公司下星期要召开重要的会议。
exampleTraditional: 公司下星期要召開重要的會議。
exampleEnglish: The company will hold an important meeting next week.
hintSimplified: 把大家聚在一起,正式举行会议。
hintTraditional: 把大家聚在一起,正式舉行會議。
hintEnglish: To gather people and formally hold a meeting.

exampleSimplified: 他向我招手,叫我过去。
exampleTraditional: 他向我招手,叫我過去。
exampleEnglish: He waved at me to come over.
hintSimplified: 用手向别人挥动,请对方走过来或打招呼。
hintTraditional: 用手向別人揮動,請對方走過來或打招呼。
hintEnglish: Moving your hand toward someone to call them over or greet them.

definition: to amount to; to be equivalent to; to convert into
exampleSimplified: 这些外币折合新台币大约一万元。
exampleTraditional: 這些外幣折合新臺幣大約一萬元。
exampleEnglish: This foreign currency converts to about ten thousand NT dollars.
hintSimplified: 把一种货币或单位换算成另一种,得出总数。
hintTraditional: 把一種貨幣或單位換算成另一種,得出總數。
hintEnglish: To convert one currency or unit into another and get a total.

exampleSimplified: 这家店周年庆的时候有很大的折扣。
exampleTraditional: 這家店週年慶的時候有很大的折扣。
exampleEnglish: This store offers big discounts during its anniversary sale.
hintSimplified: 买东西时,店家把价钱算得比原来便宜。
hintTraditional: 買東西時,店家把價錢算得比原來便宜。
hintEnglish: When shopping, the store makes the price lower than the original.

exampleSimplified: 长期失眠把他折磨得很痛苦。
exampleTraditional: 長期失眠把他折磨得很痛苦。
exampleEnglish: Long-term insomnia has tormented him greatly.
hintSimplified: 让人身体或心里长时间很痛苦。
hintTraditional: 讓人身體或心裡長時間很痛苦。
hintEnglish: To make someone suffer in body or mind for a long time.

definition: shock; to shake; to strongly affect; to vibrate; vibration
exampleSimplified: 手机在桌上震动了一下。
exampleTraditional: 手機在桌上震動了一下。
exampleEnglish: The phone vibrated once on the table.
hintSimplified: 东西快速地抖动,手机静音时来电会这样。
hintTraditional: 東西快速地抖動,手機靜音時來電會這樣。
hintEnglish: When something shakes rapidly, as a silenced phone does when it rings.

gloss: to target; to focus on; to be aimed at or against; in response to
definition: to target; to focus on; to be aimed at or against; in response to
exampleSimplified: 这个活动是针对小学生设计的。
exampleTraditional: 這個活動是針對小學生設計的。
exampleEnglish: This event is designed for elementary school students.
hintSimplified: 表示把重点放在某个对象或问题上。
hintTraditional: 表示把重點放在某個物件或問題上。
hintEnglish: Shows that the focus is placed on a certain target or problem.

exampleSimplified: 新的政策让很多人受益。
exampleTraditional: 新的政策讓很多人受益。
exampleEnglish: The new policy benefits many people.
hintSimplified: 政府为了解决问题而订出的办法或方针。
hintTraditional: 政府為了解決問題而訂出的辦法或方針。
hintEnglish: The methods or guidelines set by authorities to solve problems.

exampleSimplified: 选举时,每个政党都会提出自己的主张。
exampleTraditional: 選舉時,每個政黨都會提出自己的主張。
exampleEnglish: During elections, every political party presents its own platform.
hintSimplified: 一群想参加选举、管理国家的人组成的团体。
hintTraditional: 一群想參加選舉、管理國家的人組成的團體。
hintEnglish: A group of people who organize to run in elections and govern a country.

exampleSimplified: 政府决定增加公共交通的预算。
exampleTraditional: 政府決定增加公共交通的預算。
exampleEnglish: The government decided to increase the public transport budget.
hintSimplified: 管理国家或城市公共事务的机构。
hintTraditional: 管理國家或城市公共事務的機構。
hintEnglish: The institution that manages the public affairs of a country or city.

exampleSimplified: 这家是正规的旅行社,你可以放心。
exampleTraditional: 這家是正規的旅行社,你可以放心。
exampleEnglish: This is a legitimate travel agency, so you can rest assured.
hintSimplified: 符合标准和规定,不是随便乱来的。
hintTraditional: 符合標準和規定,不是隨便亂來的。
hintEnglish: Meeting standards and rules, not done in a sloppy or illegal way.

exampleSimplified: 进大楼之前,请出示你的证件。
exampleTraditional: 進大樓之前,請出示你的證件。
exampleEnglish: Please show your ID before entering the building.
hintSimplified: 能证明你是谁的卡片或文件,例如身分证。
hintTraditional: 能證明你是誰的卡片或檔案,例如身分證。
hintEnglish: A card or document that proves who you are.

exampleSimplified: 他的房间总是很整洁。
exampleTraditional: 他的房間總是很整潔。
exampleEnglish: His room is always neat and tidy.
hintSimplified: 形容环境或外表干净又有条理。
hintTraditional: 形容環境或外表乾淨又有條理。
hintEnglish: Describes a place or appearance that is clean and orderly.

definition: according to standards; decent; honorable; proper; serious
exampleSimplified: 他说话很正经,一点也不像在开玩笑。
exampleTraditional: 他說話很正經,一點也不像在開玩笑。
exampleEnglish: He speaks very seriously, not at all like he's joking.
hintSimplified: 形容人态度认真,不随便开玩笑;也指正当的。
hintTraditional: 形容人態度認真,不隨便開玩笑;也指正當的。
hintEnglish: Describes someone serious who doesn't joke around; also means proper or decent.

exampleSimplified: 警察还没有找到足够的证据。
exampleTraditional: 警察還沒有找到足夠的證據。
exampleEnglish: The police haven't found enough evidence yet.
hintSimplified: 可以用来证明某件事是真的东西。
hintTraditional: 可以用來證明某件事是真的東西。
hintEnglish: Something that can be used to prove that a matter is true.

definition: CL:次[ci4],場|场[chang3]; argument; contention; controversy; debate; to argue; to contend; to debate
exampleSimplified: 他们为了这个问题争论了一个晚上。
exampleTraditional: 他們為了這個問題爭論了一個晚上。
exampleEnglish: They argued about this issue all night.
hintSimplified: 几个人因为意见不同而互相说理,常常很激烈。
hintTraditional: 幾個人因為意見不同而互相說理,常常很激烈。
hintEnglish: People with different opinions debating each other, often heatedly.

definition: direct; front; obverse side; open; positive; right side
exampleSimplified: 遇到问题时,要正面面对,不要逃避。
exampleTraditional: 遇到問題時,要正面面對,不要逃避。
exampleEnglish: When you meet a problem, face it head-on and don't run away.
hintSimplified: 和“背面”相对的一边;也指直接、乐观的一面。
hintTraditional: 和“背面”相對的一邊;也指直接、樂觀的一面。
hintEnglish: The side opposite the back; also the direct or positive side of things.

definition: to petition; to request (opinions, feedback etc); to seek; to solicit
exampleSimplified: 公司正在征求大家对新计划的意见。
exampleTraditional: 公司正在徵求大家對新計劃的意見。
exampleEnglish: The company is seeking everyone's opinions on the new plan.
hintSimplified: 公开向别人询问,希望得到意见或同意。
hintTraditional: 公開向別人詢問,希望得到意見或同意。
hintEnglish: To ask others openly in hopes of getting opinions or consent.

definition: to fight for; to strive for; to win over
exampleSimplified: 我会努力争取这次出国交流的机会。
exampleTraditional: 我會努力爭取這次出國交流的機會。
exampleEnglish: I will work hard to win this chance to study abroad.
hintSimplified: 努力去得到想要的机会或结果。
hintTraditional: 努力去得到想要的機會或結果。
hintEnglish: To make an effort to obtain a desired opportunity or result.

definition: to confirm (sth to be true); to verify
exampleSimplified: 医生证实了这个消息是真的。
exampleTraditional: 醫生證實了這個訊息是真的。
exampleEnglish: The doctor confirmed that the news was true.
hintSimplified: 经过检查或调查,确定某件事是真的。
hintTraditional: 經過檢查或調查,確定某件事是真的。
hintEnglish: After checking or investigating, to establish that something is true.

exampleSimplified: 三、五、十都是整数,二点五不是。
exampleTraditional: 三、五、十都是整數,二點五不是。
exampleEnglish: Three, five and ten are integers; 2.5 is not.
hintSimplified: 数学里没有小数点或分数的数字,例如一、二、三。
hintTraditional: 數學裡沒有小數點或分數的數字,例如一、二、三。
hintEnglish: In math, a number without decimals or fractions, like one, two, three.

definition: on the whole; overall; overall; whole; general; whole; entirety
exampleSimplified: 整体来说,这次旅行很愉快。
exampleTraditional: 整體來說,這次旅行很愉快。
exampleEnglish: On the whole, this trip was very pleasant.
hintSimplified: 把所有部分合在一起来看,而不是只看一小块。
hintTraditional: 把所有部分合在一起來看,而不是隻看一小塊。
hintEnglish: Looking at all the parts together rather than just a small piece.

gloss: first month of the lunar year
definition: first month of the lunar year
exampleSimplified: 正月里,家人会一起吃饭、拜年。
exampleTraditional: 正月裡,家人會一起吃飯、拜年。
exampleEnglish: In the first lunar month, families eat together and exchange New Year greetings.
hintSimplified: 农历的第一个月,春节就在这个月。
hintTraditional: 農曆的第一個月,春節就在這個月。
hintEnglish: The first month of the lunar calendar, which includes Spring Festival.

exampleSimplified: 发烧和咳嗽是感冒常见的症状。
exampleTraditional: 發燒和咳嗽是感冒常見的症狀。
exampleEnglish: Fever and coughing are common symptoms of a cold.
hintSimplified: 生病时身体表现出来的不舒服,医生会问你有哪些。
hintTraditional: 生病時身體表現出來的不舒服,醫生會問你有哪些。
hintEnglish: The discomforts your body shows when sick, which doctors ask you about.

exampleSimplified: 这位侦探很快就找到了真正的小偷。
exampleTraditional: 這位偵探很快就找到了真正的小偷。
exampleEnglish: The detective quickly found the real thief.
hintSimplified: 专门调查案件、寻找真相的人,小说里常出现。
hintTraditional: 專門調查案件、尋找真相的人,小說裡常出現。
hintEnglish: A person who investigates cases and looks for the truth, common in novels.

definition: to cherish; to treasure; to value
exampleSimplified: 我们要珍惜和家人在一起的时间。
exampleTraditional: 我們要珍惜和家人在一起的時間。
exampleEnglish: We should cherish the time we spend with family.
hintSimplified: 觉得某人或某物很宝贵,所以好好爱护它。
hintTraditional: 覺得某人或某物很寶貴,所以好好愛護它。
hintEnglish: To treat someone or something as precious and take good care of it.

exampleSimplified: 我最喜欢喝加了珍珠的奶茶。
exampleTraditional: 我最喜歡喝加了珍珠的奶茶。
exampleEnglish: I like milk tea with tapioca pearls the most.
hintSimplified: 台湾奶茶里常见的黑色圆形小颗粒,嚼起来很有弹性。
hintTraditional: 台灣奶茶裡常見的黑色圓形小顆粒,嚼起來很有彈性。
hintEnglish: The small, black, chewy round balls often found in Taiwanese milk tea.

exampleSimplified: 这阵子我工作很忙,没有时间休息。
exampleTraditional: 這陣子我工作很忙,沒有時間休息。
exampleEnglish: I've been busy with work lately and have no time to rest.
hintSimplified: 指最近的一段时间,不是很长。
hintTraditional: 指最近的一段時間,不是很長。
hintEnglish: Refers to a stretch of time recently, not very long.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; backing; support; to back; to be in favor of; to stand by; to support
exampleSimplified: 谢谢你一直支持我的决定。
exampleTraditional: 謝謝你一直支持我的決定。
exampleEnglish: Thank you for always supporting my decision.
hintSimplified: 站在别人这一边,给他鼓励或帮助。
hintTraditional: 站在別人這一邊,給他鼓勵或幫助。
hintEnglish: To stand on someone's side and give them encouragement or help.

exampleSimplified: 老师指出了我作文里的错误。
exampleTraditional: 老師指出了我作文裡的錯誤。
exampleEnglish: The teacher pointed out the mistakes in my essay.
hintSimplified: 明白地说出问题或重点,让大家注意到。
hintTraditional: 明白地說出問題或重點,讓大家注意到。
hintEnglish: To clearly state a problem or key point so people notice it.

definition: expenses; expenditure; to spend; to pay out
exampleSimplified: 这个月的支出比收入多。
exampleTraditional: 這個月的支出比收入多。
exampleEnglish: This month's expenses are greater than income.
hintSimplified: 一段时间里花掉的钱,和收入相反。
hintTraditional: 一段時間裡花掉的錢,和收入相反。
hintEnglish: The money spent over a period; the opposite of income.

definition: coach; trainer; to guide; to direct; to instruct
exampleSimplified: 王教授指导我完成了毕业论文。
exampleTraditional: 王教授指導我完成了畢業論文。
exampleEnglish: Professor Wang guided me in finishing my graduation thesis.
hintSimplified: 老师或前辈在旁边告诉你该怎么做。
hintTraditional: 老師或前輩在旁邊告訴你該怎麼做。
hintEnglish: A teacher or senior person tells you how to do something and guides you.

exampleSimplified: 公司制定了新的工作计划。
exampleTraditional: 公司制定了新的工作計劃。
exampleEnglish: The company drew up a new work plan.
hintSimplified: 经过考虑后,把计划或规则正式写出来。
hintTraditional: 經過考慮後,把計劃或規則正式寫出來。
hintEnglish: After consideration, to formally work out a plan or rule.

exampleSimplified: 学校正在制订明年的课程安排。
exampleTraditional: 學校正在制訂明年的課程安排。
exampleEnglish: The school is drawing up next year's course schedule.
hintSimplified: 为规则、计划或办法拟出内容并确定下来。
hintTraditional: 為規則、計劃或辦法擬出內容並確定下來。
hintEnglish: To draft the content of rules or plans and settle on them.

definition: designated; to appoint; to assign; to indicate clearly and with certainty
exampleSimplified: 请在指定的时间到指定的地点集合。
exampleTraditional: 請在指定的時間到指定的地點集合。
exampleEnglish: Please gather at the designated place at the designated time.
hintSimplified: 事先决定好、不能随便改的。
hintTraditional: 事先決定好、不能隨便改的。
hintEnglish: Decided in advance and not to be changed freely.

exampleSimplified: 我喜欢苹果、香蕉之类的水果。
exampleTraditional: 我喜歡蘋果、香蕉之類的水果。
exampleEnglish: I like fruits such as apples and bananas.
hintSimplified: 举几个例子后,用来表示还有别的同类东西。
hintTraditional: 舉幾個例子後,用來表示還有別的同類東西。
hintEnglish: Used after a few examples to show there are other similar things.

exampleSimplified: 他开了一张支票付房租。
exampleTraditional: 他開了一張支票付房租。
exampleEnglish: He wrote a check to pay the rent.
hintSimplified: 写上金额和签名,可以代替现金付款的纸。
hintTraditional: 寫上金額和簽名,可以代替現金付款的紙。
hintEnglish: A paper with an amount and signature that can be used instead of cash.

exampleSimplified: 他很有志气,一定要考上好大学。
exampleTraditional: 他很有志氣,一定要考上好大學。
exampleEnglish: He is full of ambition and is determined to get into a good university.
hintSimplified: 形容人有决心,不甘心落后,想做出一番成绩。
hintTraditional: 形容人有決心,不甘心落後,想做出一番成績。
hintEnglish: Describes someone determined, unwilling to fall behind, wanting to achieve something.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; directives; instructions; to indicate; to instruct; to point out
exampleSimplified: 经理给了我们一些重要的指示。
exampleTraditional: 經理給了我們一些重要的指示。
exampleEnglish: The manager gave us some important instructions.
hintSimplified: 上级告诉下面的人应该怎么做。
hintTraditional: 上級告訴下面的人應該怎麼做。
hintEnglish: What a superior tells subordinates about what to do.

exampleSimplified: 他在公司里的职位越来越高。
exampleTraditional: 他在公司裡的職位越來越高。
exampleEnglish: His position in the company keeps getting higher.
hintSimplified: 在公司里的位置,比如经理或职员。
hintTraditional: 在公司裡的位置,比如經理或職員。
hintEnglish: One's place in a company, such as manager or staff.

exampleSimplified: 用尺可以画出一条直线。
exampleTraditional: 用尺可以畫出一條直線。
exampleEnglish: You can draw a straight line with a ruler.
hintSimplified: 不弯曲的线;也可以形容数字很快地上升或下降。
hintTraditional: 不彎曲的線;也可以形容數字很快地上升或下降。
hintEnglish: A line that doesn't bend; also describes numbers rising or falling sharply.

definition: to carry out; to execute; to implement; to run
exampleSimplified: 我们必须认真执行这个计划。
exampleTraditional: 我們必須認真執行這個計劃。
exampleEnglish: We must carry out this plan seriously.
hintSimplified: 把决定好的计划或命令真正做出来。
hintTraditional: 把決定好的計劃或命令真正做出來。
hintEnglish: To actually do a plan or order that has been decided.

gloss: order; orderliness (in society, in the classroom, on the roads etc)
definition: order; orderliness (in society, in the classroom, on the roads etc)
exampleSimplified: 警察负责维持街上的秩序。
exampleTraditional: 警察負責維持街上的秩序。
exampleEnglish: The police are responsible for maintaining order on the streets.
hintSimplified: 大家守规则,事情有条理、不混乱的状态。
hintTraditional: 大家守規則,事情有條理、不混亂的狀態。
hintEnglish: The state in which people follow rules and things are not chaotic.

exampleSimplified: 你填好大学的志愿了吗?
exampleTraditional: 你填好大學的志願了嗎?
exampleEnglish: Have you filled in your university preferences yet?
hintSimplified: 考试后,学生按自己的愿望填写想读的学校和科系。
hintTraditional: 考試後,學生按自己的願望填寫想讀的學校和科系。
hintEnglish: After exams, what students write down as the schools and majors they wish to attend.

definition: to back; to provide assistance; to support
exampleSimplified: 许多人捐钱支援受灾的地区。
exampleTraditional: 許多人捐錢支援受災的地區。
exampleEnglish: Many people donated money to support the disaster-hit area.
hintSimplified: 在别人有困难时,送去人力、物资或金钱帮忙。
hintTraditional: 在別人有困難時,送去人力、物資或金錢幫忙。
hintEnglish: To send people, supplies or money to help when others are in trouble.

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂专门制造汽车零件。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠專門製造汽車零件。
exampleEnglish: This factory specializes in manufacturing car parts.
hintSimplified: 工厂用材料做出产品。
hintTraditional: 工廠用材料做出產品。
hintEnglish: What a factory does with materials to produce goods.

definition: to criticize; to denounce; to find fault with
exampleSimplified: 大家都指责他不守信用。
exampleTraditional: 大家都指責他不守信用。
exampleEnglish: Everyone criticized him for not keeping his word.
hintSimplified: 公开说别人做错了,并表示不满。
hintTraditional: 公開說別人做錯了,並表示不滿。
hintEnglish: To say openly that someone did wrong and express disapproval.

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂每天生产大量纸张。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠每天生產大量紙張。
exampleEnglish: This factory produces large amounts of paper every day.
hintSimplified: 用来写字、印刷或包东西的薄薄材料的总称。
hintTraditional: 用來寫字、印刷或包東西的薄薄材料的總稱。
hintEnglish: General term for the thin material used for writing, printing or wrapping.

definition: to check; to curb; to limit; to put a stop to; to stop
exampleSimplified: 老师及时制止了他们打架。
exampleTraditional: 老師及時制止了他們打架。
exampleEnglish: The teacher promptly stopped them from fighting.
hintSimplified: 不让别人继续做不好的事。
hintTraditional: 不讓別人繼續做不好的事。
hintEnglish: To not let someone continue doing something bad.

exampleSimplified: 他们正在制作一部新的动画电影。
exampleTraditional: 他們正在製作一部新的動畫電影。
exampleEnglish: They are making a new animated film.
hintSimplified: 用心把电影、手工品或节目做出来。
hintTraditional: 用心把電影、手工品或節目做出來。
hintEnglish: To carefully make a film, handicraft or program.

exampleSimplified: 这是一个影响很大的重大决定。
exampleTraditional: 這是一個影響很大的重大決定。
exampleEnglish: This is a major decision with a big impact.
hintSimplified: 形容事情意义大、很重要、影响深远。
hintTraditional: 形容事情意義大、很重要、影響深遠。
hintEnglish: Describes something of great significance, important and far-reaching.

exampleSimplified: 他吃了不干净的东西,不小心中毒了。
exampleTraditional: 他吃了不乾淨的東西,不小心中毒了。
exampleEnglish: He ate something unclean and accidentally got poisoned.
hintSimplified: 吃了或吸入有害的东西,身体受到伤害,要赶快送医院。
hintTraditional: 吃了或吸入有害的東西,身體受到傷害,要趕快送醫院。
hintEnglish: You eat or breathe in something harmful and your body is hurt, so you must rush to the hospital.

exampleSimplified: 我的中文已经学到中级班了。
exampleTraditional: 我的中文已經學到中級班了。
exampleEnglish: I have already reached the intermediate class in Chinese.
hintSimplified: 程度在初级和高级之间的等级。
hintTraditional: 程度在初級和高階之間的等級。
hintEnglish: A level that lies between beginner and advanced.

definition: category; class; genus; kind; sort; species; type; variety
exampleSimplified: 这家书店的书种类很多。
exampleTraditional: 這家書店的書種類很多。
exampleEnglish: This bookstore has many kinds of books.
hintSimplified: 把东西按特点分成的不同类别,比如水果有很多这样的分法。
hintTraditional: 把東西按特點分成的不同類別,比如水果有很多這樣的分法。
hintEnglish: The different groups things are divided into according to their features.

exampleSimplified: 这个行李箱的重量不能超过二十公斤。
exampleTraditional: 這個行李箱的重量不能超過二十公斤。
exampleEnglish: The weight of this suitcase cannot exceed twenty kilograms.
hintSimplified: 东西有多重,可以用秤或体重计量出来的数字。
hintTraditional: 東西有多重,可以用秤或體重計量出來的數字。
hintEnglish: How heavy something is, a number you can measure with a scale.

exampleSimplified: 这位中年男子每天早上都去跑步。
exampleTraditional: 這位中年男子每天早上都去跑步。
exampleEnglish: This middle-aged man goes jogging every morning.
hintSimplified: 人生的一个阶段,大约四五十岁,不年轻也还不算老。
hintTraditional: 人生的一個階段,大約四五十歲,不年輕也還不算老。
hintEnglish: A stage of life, around forty or fifty, not young but not yet old.

exampleSimplified: 这次车祸中,有两个人重伤住院。
exampleTraditional: 這次車禍中,有兩個人重傷住院。
exampleEnglish: In this car accident, two people were seriously injured and hospitalized.
hintSimplified: 受到很严重的伤,需要长时间治疗。
hintTraditional: 受到很嚴重的傷,需要長時間治療。
hintEnglish: Being hurt very badly, needing a long time to be treated.

gloss: partway through; midway; along the way
definition: partway through; midway; along the way
exampleSimplified: 他在旅行中途下车去买水。
exampleTraditional: 他在旅行中途下車去買水。
exampleEnglish: He got off partway through the trip to buy water.
hintSimplified: 事情或旅程进行到一半,还没到终点的时候。
hintTraditional: 事情或旅程進行到一半,還沒到終點的時候。
hintEnglish: The moment when a trip or task is half done and the end hasn't been reached.

definition: (geometry) centroid; (physics) center of gravity; focus; emphasis; priority
exampleSimplified: 他把生活的重心放在工作上。
exampleTraditional: 他把生活的重心放在工作上。
exampleEnglish: He puts the focus of his life on work.
hintSimplified: 最主要、最要紧的部分;物体保持平衡的那个点也这样叫。
hintTraditional: 最主要、最要緊的部分;物體保持平衡的那個點也這樣叫。
hintEnglish: The main, most important part; also the point where an object balances.

definition: center; central; central authorities (of a state); middle
exampleSimplified: 广场的中央有一个大喷水池。
exampleTraditional: 廣場的中央有一個大噴水池。
exampleEnglish: There is a big fountain in the center of the square.
hintSimplified: 一个地方正中间的位置。
hintTraditional: 一個地方正中間的位置。
hintEnglish: The position right in the middle of a place.

exampleSimplified: 奶奶感冒的时候喜欢喝中药。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶感冒的時候喜歡喝中藥。
exampleEnglish: When grandma has a cold, she likes to drink traditional Chinese medicine.
hintSimplified: 用草根、树皮等材料煮成的传统药,味道常常很苦。
hintTraditional: 用草根、樹皮等材料煮成的傳統藥,味道常常很苦。
hintEnglish: Traditional medicine boiled from herbs and roots, often bitter in taste.

exampleSimplified: 春天到了,我在花盆里种下了种子。
exampleTraditional: 春天到了,我在花盆裡種下了種子。
exampleEnglish: Spring has come, and I planted seeds in the flowerpot.
hintSimplified: 埋进土里,浇水以后会长出植物的小东西。
hintTraditional: 埋進土裡,澆水以後會長出植物的小東西。
hintEnglish: A small thing buried in soil that grows into a plant after watering.

exampleSimplified: 这个国家有很多不同的种族。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家有很多不同的種族。
exampleEnglish: This country has many different ethnic groups.
hintSimplified: 根据肤色、血统和文化分出来的人群。
hintTraditional: 根據膚色、血統和文化分出來的人群。
hintEnglish: Groups of people divided by skin color, ancestry and culture.

definition: also pr. [zhou1 dao5]; attentive; considerate; thorough; thoughtful
exampleSimplified: 这家饭店的服务很周到。
exampleTraditional: 這家飯店的服務很周到。
exampleEnglish: The service at this restaurant is very thoughtful and thorough.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人做事细心,各方面都照顾到,没有疏忽。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人做事細心,各方面都照顧到,沒有疏忽。
hintEnglish: Describes someone careful who takes care of every aspect without oversight.

exampleSimplified: 熊猫最爱吃竹子。
exampleTraditional: 熊貓最愛吃竹子。
exampleEnglish: Pandas love eating bamboo most.
hintSimplified: 一种又高又细、中间是空的植物,熊猫的主要食物。
hintTraditional: 一種又高又細、中間是空的植物,熊貓的主要食物。
hintEnglish: A tall, thin, hollow plant that is the main food of pandas.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; shift; to change; to transform; transformation
exampleSimplified: 他的想法最近有了很大的转变。
exampleTraditional: 他的想法最近有了很大的轉變。
exampleEnglish: His way of thinking has changed a lot recently.
hintSimplified: 从一种情况、态度变成另一种,变化通常比较大。
hintTraditional: 從一種情況、態度變成另一種,變化通常比較大。
hintEnglish: Going from one situation or attitude to another, usually a big shift.

exampleSimplified: 这场球赛会在电视上现场转播。
exampleTraditional: 這場球賽會在電視上現場轉播。
exampleEnglish: This ball game will be broadcast live on TV.
hintSimplified: 电视台把比赛或节目的画面同时送给观众看。
hintTraditional: 電視臺把比賽或節目的畫面同時送給觀眾看。
hintEnglish: A TV station sends the picture of a game or show to viewers at the same time.

definition: to communicate; to convey; to pass on
exampleSimplified: 请你把我的谢意转达给老师。
exampleTraditional: 請你把我的謝意轉達給老師。
exampleEnglish: Please convey my thanks to the teacher.
hintSimplified: 受别人的委托,把话或心意传给另一个人。
hintTraditional: 受別人的委託,把話或心意傳給另一個人。
hintEnglish: Passing on someone's words or feelings to another person on their behalf.

definition: to communicate; to pass on; to transmit
exampleSimplified: 麻烦你把这件事转告他。
exampleTraditional: 麻煩你把這件事轉告他。
exampleEnglish: Please pass this matter on to him.
hintSimplified: 自己听到消息后,再告诉另一个没听到的人。
hintTraditional: 自己聽到訊息後,再告訴另一個沒聽到的人。
hintEnglish: After hearing news yourself, telling it to someone who hasn't heard it.

exampleSimplified: 医生说他的身体状况越来越好。
exampleTraditional: 醫生說他的身體狀況越來越好。
exampleEnglish: The doctor said his physical condition is getting better and better.
hintSimplified: 人或事情在某个时候的样子和情形。
hintTraditional: 人或事情在某個時候的樣子和情形。
hintEnglish: The way a person or matter is at a certain time.

exampleSimplified: 圣诞节时,我们用彩灯装饰房间。
exampleTraditional: 聖誕節時,我們用彩燈裝飾房間。
exampleEnglish: At Christmas, we decorate the room with colored lights.
hintSimplified: 用花、灯等东西把地方变得更漂亮。
hintTraditional: 用花、燈等東西把地方變得更漂亮。
hintEnglish: Using flowers, lights and such to make a place prettier.

gloss: (to take) a turn for the better
definition: (to take) a turn for the better; to change planes
exampleSimplified: 这次面试给了他事业的转机。
exampleTraditional: 這次面試給了他事業的轉機。
exampleEnglish: This interview gave his career a turning point for the better.
hintSimplified: 坏情况中出现的好变化,让人重新有希望。
hintTraditional: 壞情況中出現的好變化,讓人重新有希望。
hintEnglish: A good change in a bad situation that brings hope again.

exampleSimplified: 他是研究地震的专家。
exampleTraditional: 他是研究地震的專家。
exampleEnglish: He is an expert who studies earthquakes.
hintSimplified: 对某个领域有深入研究、很有经验的人。
hintTraditional: 對某個領域有深入研究、很有經驗的人。
hintEnglish: A person with deep study and much experience in a certain field.

definition: monopoly; patent; sth uniquely enjoyed (or possessed etc) by a certain group of people
exampleSimplified: 这家公司申请了一项新技术的专利。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司申請了一項新技術的專利。
exampleEnglish: This company applied for a patent on a new technology.
hintSimplified: 政府给发明者的权利,别人不能随便使用他的发明。
hintTraditional: 政府給發明者的權利,別人不能隨便使用他的發明。
hintEnglish: A right given by the government so others can't freely use an inventor's invention.

gloss: (of institutions, personnel etc) designated or assigned for a specific task; special
definition: (of institutions, personnel etc) designated or assigned for a specific task; special; specialized; dedicated (to a particular field or purpose); specially; specifically (for a particular purpose)
exampleSimplified: 这家店专门卖手工巧克力。
exampleTraditional: 這家店專門賣手工巧克力。
exampleEnglish: This shop specializes in selling handmade chocolate.
hintSimplified: 表示只为某一个目的或某一种事情而做。
hintTraditional: 表示只為某一個目的或某一種事情而做。
hintEnglish: Indicates doing something only for one particular purpose or kind of thing.

definition: person appointed for specific task; specialist
exampleSimplified: 公司派专人去机场接客户。
exampleTraditional: 公司派專人去機場接客戶。
exampleEnglish: The company sent a dedicated person to pick up the client at the airport.
hintSimplified: 被安排只负责某件事的人。
hintTraditional: 被安排只負責某件事的人。
hintEnglish: A person assigned to be responsible only for a certain matter.

definition: (of a person) to turn round; (of a widow) to remarry (archaic); to face about
exampleSimplified: 他转身看了我一眼,然后走开了。
exampleTraditional: 他轉身看了我一眼,然後走開了。
exampleEnglish: He turned around, glanced at me, and then walked away.
hintSimplified: 站着不动,让身体面向相反的方向。
hintTraditional: 站著不動,讓身體面向相反的方向。
hintEnglish: Standing in place and making your body face the opposite direction.

definition: fig. to change one's stance; to change direction; to get lost; to lose one's way
exampleSimplified: 这家公司最近转向网络销售。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司最近轉向網路銷售。
exampleEnglish: This company has recently shifted toward online sales.
hintSimplified: 方向、方针或做法改变,开始朝另一边发展。
hintTraditional: 方向、方針或做法改變,開始朝另一邊發展。
hintEnglish: When direction or approach changes and things start heading another way.

gloss: to host (a conference or sports event)
definition: to host (a conference or sports event); to organize
exampleSimplified: 这次运动会由我们学校主办。
exampleTraditional: 這次運動會由我們學校主辦。
exampleEnglish: This sports meet is hosted by our school.
hintSimplified: 负责举办一场大型活动或比赛的单位所做的事。
hintTraditional: 負責舉辦一場大型活動或比賽的單位所做的事。
hintEnglish: What an organization does when it is in charge of putting on a big event.

exampleSimplified: 你要先注册,才能使用这个网站。
exampleTraditional: 你要先註冊,才能使用這個網站。
exampleEnglish: You need to register first before you can use this website.
hintSimplified: 使用网站或入学前,要先填资料、建立帐号。
hintTraditional: 使用網站或入學前,要先填資料、建立帳號。
hintEnglish: Before using a website or enrolling, you fill in your information and create an account.

definition: (TV) anchor; to host (a TV or radio program etc); to manage or direct; to preside over; to stand for (justice etc); to take charge of; to uphold
exampleSimplified: 他在晚会上主持节目,非常幽默。
exampleTraditional: 他在晚會上主持節目,非常幽默。
exampleEnglish: He hosted the show at the party and was very funny.
hintSimplified: 在会议或节目中负责掌控流程、介绍内容的人所做的事。
hintTraditional: 在會議或節目中負責掌控流程、介紹內容的人所做的事。
hintEnglish: What the person in charge of running a meeting or show does, guiding its flow.

exampleSimplified: 你不能只凭主观想法做决定。
exampleTraditional: 你不能只憑主觀想法做決定。
exampleEnglish: You can't make decisions based only on subjective ideas.
hintSimplified: 只根据自己的感觉和看法,不是根据事实。
hintTraditional: 只根據自己的感覺和看法,不是根據事實。
hintEnglish: Based only on your own feelings and views, not on facts.

exampleSimplified: 朋友结婚了,我打电话向他祝贺。
exampleTraditional: 朋友結婚了,我打電話向他祝賀。
exampleEnglish: My friend got married, so I called to congratulate him.
hintSimplified: 别人有喜事或成功时,你对他表示高兴的话。
hintTraditional: 別人有喜事或成功時,你對他表示高興的話。
hintEnglish: What you express to someone when they have good news or success.

exampleSimplified: 这栋大楼的住户都很友善。
exampleTraditional: 這棟大樓的住戶都很友善。
exampleEnglish: The residents of this building are all friendly.
hintSimplified: 住在同一栋楼或小区里的每一个家庭。
hintTraditional: 住在同一棟樓或小區裡的每一個家庭。
hintEnglish: Each family living in the same building or neighborhood.

exampleSimplified: 天气逐渐变冷了,要多穿一点衣服。
exampleTraditional: 天氣逐漸變冷了,要多穿一點衣服。
exampleEnglish: The weather is gradually getting colder; wear more clothes.
hintSimplified: 表示事情一点一点地慢慢变化,不是突然的。
hintTraditional: 表示事情一點一點地慢慢變化,不是突然的。
hintEnglish: Shows that something changes little by little, not suddenly.

exampleSimplified: 她是这部电影的女主角。
exampleTraditional: 她是這部電影的女主角。
exampleEnglish: She is the female lead of this movie.
hintSimplified: 电影或戏剧里最重要的那个角色。
hintTraditional: 電影或戲劇裡最重要的那個角色。
hintEnglish: The most important character in a movie or play.

exampleSimplified: 他的时间算得很准确,一分钟也不差。
exampleTraditional: 他的時間算得很準確,一分鐘也不差。
exampleEnglish: His timing was very accurate, not off by even a minute.
hintSimplified: 说数字、答案或判断完全没有错误。
hintTraditional: 說數字、答案或判斷完全沒有錯誤。
hintEnglish: Said of numbers, answers or judgments that contain no errors at all.

exampleSimplified: 医生说你需要注射疫苗。
exampleTraditional: 醫生說你需要注射疫苗。
exampleEnglish: The doctor says you need to get a vaccine injection.
hintSimplified: 用针把药水打进身体里。
hintTraditional: 用針把藥水打進身體裡。
hintEnglish: Using a needle to put liquid medicine into the body.

exampleSimplified: 主席在会议上发表了简短的讲话。
exampleTraditional: 主席在會議上發表了簡短的講話。
exampleEnglish: The chairperson gave a short speech at the meeting.
hintSimplified: 一个会议或组织中地位最高、负责领导的人。
hintTraditional: 一個會議或組織中地位最高、負責領導的人。
hintEnglish: The person with the highest position leading a meeting or organization.

gloss: to stay in hospital; to be hospitalized
definition: to stay in hospital; to be hospitalized
exampleSimplified: 爷爷生病了,需要住院一个星期。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺生病了,需要住院一個星期。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa is sick and needs to stay in the hospital for a week.
hintSimplified: 病得比较重,晚上也要留在医院里治疗。
hintTraditional: 病得比較重,晚上也要留在醫院裡治療。
hintEnglish: When one is quite ill and stays at the medical facility overnight for treatment.

exampleSimplified: 这一带是安静的住宅区。
exampleTraditional: 這一帶是安靜的住宅區。
exampleEnglish: This area is a quiet residential district.
hintSimplified: 供人居住生活的房子,不是商店或工厂。
hintTraditional: 供人居住生活的房子,不是商店或工廠。
hintEnglish: Buildings for people to live in, not shops or factories.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; assertion; position; proposition; stand; to advocate; to stand for; view; viewpoint
exampleSimplified: 他主张大家应该少用塑料袋。
exampleTraditional: 他主張大家應該少用塑膠袋。
exampleEnglish: He advocates that everyone should use fewer plastic bags.
hintSimplified: 明确表达自己的看法,并认为应该这样做。
hintTraditional: 明確表達自己的看法,並認為應該這樣做。
hintEnglish: To state your view clearly and insist that this is what should be done.

exampleSimplified: 开一家公司需要足够的资本。
exampleTraditional: 開一家公司需要足夠的資本。
exampleEnglish: Starting a company requires enough capital.
hintSimplified: 做生意时,用来开始投资的钱或财产。
hintTraditional: 做生意時,用來開始投資的錢或財產。
hintEnglish: The money or assets used to start investing in a business.

exampleSimplified: 你有资格参加这次比赛吗?
exampleTraditional: 你有資格參加這次比賽嗎?
exampleEnglish: Are you qualified to take part in this competition?
hintSimplified: 做某件事所需要的条件或身分。
hintTraditional: 做某件事所需要的條件或身分。
hintEnglish: The conditions or status needed in order to do something.

exampleSimplified: 这个计划还缺少一些资金。
exampleTraditional: 這個計劃還缺少一些資金。
exampleEnglish: This project still lacks some funds.
hintSimplified: 用于计划、事业或公司运作的一笔钱。
hintTraditional: 用於計劃、事業或公司運作的一筆錢。
hintEnglish: A sum of money used for a project, business or company to operate.

exampleSimplified: 我看外国电影时喜欢打开字幕。
exampleTraditional: 我看外國電影時喜歡開啟字幕。
exampleEnglish: When I watch foreign movies, I like to turn on the subtitles.
hintSimplified: 出现在电影或影片下方,让你看懂对话的文字。
hintTraditional: 出現在電影或影片下方,讓你看懂對話的文字。
hintEnglish: Text at the bottom of a film that helps you follow the dialogue.

exampleSimplified: 这个字母表里一共有二十六个字母。
exampleTraditional: 這個字母表裡一共有二十六個字母。
exampleEnglish: There are twenty-six letters in this alphabet.
hintSimplified: 学外语时,你要先学会这些组成单词的最小书写符号。
hintTraditional: 學外語時,你要先學會這些組成單詞的最小書寫符號。
hintEnglish: When learning a foreign language, you first learn these smallest written symbols that make up words.

exampleSimplified: 父母都希望子女过得幸福。
exampleTraditional: 父母都希望子女過得幸福。
exampleEnglish: Parents all hope their children live happily.
hintSimplified: 父母的儿子和女儿的合称。
hintTraditional: 父母的兒子和女兒的合稱。
hintEnglish: A collective term for a parent's sons and daughters.

exampleSimplified: 他很自私,从来不愿意分享东西。
exampleTraditional: 他很自私,從來不願意分享東西。
exampleEnglish: He is very selfish and never wants to share things.
hintSimplified: 只想到自己的好处,不顾别人的人。

exampleSimplified: 写自我介绍时,不要太紧张。

exampleSimplified: 网络上有很多最新的资讯。

exampleSimplified: 这次活动是自愿参加的,不需要报名费。

gloss: to act independently; to be autonomous; to be in control of one's own affairs
definition: to act independently; to be autonomous; to be in control of one's own affairs

exampleTraditional: 長大以後,他想過自主的生活。
exampleEnglish: After growing up, he wants to live an independent life.
hintSimplified: 自己做决定,不受别人控制。
hintTraditional: 自己做決定,不受別人控制。
hintEnglish: Making your own decisions without being controlled by others.

gloss: altogether; in sum; in all; in total
definition: altogether; in sum; in all; in total

exampleEnglish: Our class has thirty students in total.

hintTraditional: 把所有的數量加在一起時,可以用這個副詞。

definition: composite; comprehensive; mixed; synthesized; to integrate; to sum up; to synthesize
exampleSimplified: 老师根据综合成绩决定谁得奖。
exampleTraditional: 老師根據綜合成績決定誰得獎。
exampleEnglish: The teacher decides who wins the prize based on overall results.
hintSimplified: 把很多不同的部分放在一起来看或来分析。
hintTraditional: 把很多不同的部分放在一起來看或來分析。
hintEnglish: To put many different parts together to look at or analyze them.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],位[wei4],名[ming2]; premier; prime minister
exampleSimplified: 总理今天上午会见了外国客人。

definition: aisle; footpath; path; pavement; sidewalk; walk

hintEnglish: The narrow path between seats in a cinema or on a plane.

definition: to have an illicit affair; to smuggle
exampleSimplified: 他因为走私香烟被海关抓到了。

exampleEnglish: He was caught by customs for smuggling cigarettes.

hintTraditional: 偷偷把東西帶過海關,不想交稅,是違法的。
hintEnglish: Secretly bringing goods past customs to avoid taxes; it is illegal.

definition: hindrance; obstruction; to block; to hinder; to obstruct
exampleSimplified: 语言不通阻碍了他们的交流。

exampleEnglish: The language barrier hindered their communication.
hintSimplified: 让事情不能顺利进行的东西或做法。
hintTraditional: 讓事情不能順利進行的東西或做法。
hintEnglish: Something that keeps things from going smoothly.

exampleSimplified: 他送给女朋友一颗漂亮的钻石。
exampleTraditional: 他送給女朋友一顆漂亮的鑽石。
exampleEnglish: He gave his girlfriend a beautiful diamond.
hintSimplified: 一种很硬、很亮、很贵的宝石,常用在戒指上。
hintTraditional: 一種很硬、很亮、很貴的寶石,常用在戒指上。
hintEnglish: A very hard, sparkling, expensive gem often set in rings.

exampleSimplified: 我们带的水足够喝两天。
exampleTraditional: 我們帶的水足夠喝兩天。
exampleEnglish: The water we brought is enough to drink for two days.
hintSimplified: 数量刚好满足需要,不会不够。
hintTraditional: 數量剛好滿足需要,不會不夠。
hintEnglish: The amount meets the need, with no shortage.

exampleSimplified: 他在国外工作多年,一直想念祖国。
exampleTraditional: 他在國外工作多年,一直想念祖國。

hintTraditional: 出生或成長的國家,人們常對它有深厚的感情。
hintEnglish: The country where one was born or raised, to which people feel deep attachment.

exampleSimplified: 你最少要睡七个小时,身体才会健康。

hintSimplified: 表示数量的下限,不能再低了。
hintTraditional: 表示數量的下限,不能再低了。
hintEnglish: Indicates the lower limit of a quantity; it can't be any lower.

gloss: to comply with; to abide by; to respect (an agreement)
definition: to comply with; to abide by; to respect (an agreement)

hintSimplified: 按照法律或规定去做,不违反。
hintTraditional: 按照法律或規定去做,不違反。
hintEnglish: To act according to laws or rules without breaking them.

definition: eminent; proper; serious; to esteem; to honor; to respect; to value

exampleTraditional: 我們應該尊重每個人的想法。
exampleEnglish: We should respect everyone's ideas.
hintSimplified: 认为别人很重要,不随便批评或看不起他们。
hintTraditional: 認為別人很重要,不隨便批評或看不起他們。
hintEnglish: To consider others important and not look down on or carelessly criticize them.

exampleSimplified: 这位作家写过很多有名的小说。

exampleEnglish: This writer has written many famous novels.

hintTraditional: 以寫小說、散文等作品為職業的人。
hintEnglish: A person whose profession is writing novels, essays, and the like.

gloss: to be a guest or visitor
definition: to be a guest or visitor
exampleSimplified: 周末我要去朋友家做客。

exampleEnglish: This weekend I'm going to visit my friend's home as a guest.

hintTraditional: 受邀到別人家裡拜訪,並受到招待。

gloss: to live somewhere as a visitor; to stay with sb as a guest; to sojourn
definition: to live somewhere as a visitor; to stay with sb as a guest; to sojourn

exampleTraditional: 他到外地朋友家作客,住了三天。
exampleEnglish: He visited a friend out of town and stayed for three days.
hintSimplified: 暂时住在别人家,以客人的身份被招待。
hintTraditional: 暫時住在別人家,以客人的身份被招待。
hintEnglish: To stay temporarily at someone's home as a hosted visitor.

definition: accomplishment; achievement; activity; as (in the capacity of); deed; one's conduct; qua; to act as; to look upon (sth as); to take sth to be; to view as

exampleTraditional: 作為學生,你應該認真讀書。
exampleEnglish: As a student, you should study seriously.
hintSimplified: 表示以某种身份或立场来说话或做事。
hintTraditional: 表示以某種身份或立場來說話或做事。
hintEnglish: Indicates speaking or acting in a certain role or capacity.

gloss: (suffix) -ation, -tion etc, as in 抑制作用[yi4 zhi4 zuo4 yong4], inhibition

exampleEnglish: This medicine is very effective for headaches.

hintTraditional: 一件事物對另一件事物產生的影響或效果。
hintEnglish: The influence or effect one thing has on another.

hintTraditional: 不讓別人繼續做某件事,或不讓事情發生。

hintEnglish: A group formed for a common goal; it can also mean arranging things.

definition: love and respect; to love and respect

hintEnglish: Describes a person's expression or manner as calm and peaceful, looking at ease.

definition: grip; handle; knob; to shake hands
