exampleSimplified: 别给自己太大的心理包袱。
exampleTraditional: 別給自己太大的心理包袱。
exampleEnglish: Don't put too much mental burden on yourself.
hintSimplified: 原指用布包起来的行李,也比喻让人心里沉重的负担。
hintTraditional: 原指用布包起來的行李,也比喻讓人心裡沉重的負擔。
hintEnglish: Originally a bundle of belongings wrapped in cloth; also a figurative burden weighing on one's mind.

gloss: to surround; to encircle; to hem in
definition: to surround; to encircle; to hem in
exampleSimplified: 警察把整栋大楼包围起来了。
exampleTraditional: 警察把整棟大樓包圍起來了。
exampleEnglish: The police surrounded the whole building.
hintSimplified: 从四面八方围住,让人或东西无法出去。
hintTraditional: 從四面八方圍住,讓人或東西無法出去。
hintEnglish: To enclose from all sides so that no one or nothing can get out.

exampleSimplified: 她的戒指上镶着一颗蓝色的宝石。
exampleTraditional: 她的戒指上鑲著一顆藍色的寶石。
exampleEnglish: Her ring is set with a blue gem.
hintSimplified: 又美丽又珍贵的矿石,常用来做首饰,例如钻石。
hintTraditional: 又美麗又珍貴的礦石,常用來做首飾,例如鑽石。
hintEnglish: A beautiful and precious mineral often used in jewelry, such as a diamond.

exampleSimplified: 市场已经饱和,新公司很难赚钱。
exampleTraditional: 市場已經飽和,新公司很難賺錢。
exampleEnglish: The market is already saturated, so it's hard for new companies to make money.
hintSimplified: 达到最大的量,再也装不下或容纳不了更多。
hintTraditional: 達到最大的量,再也裝不下或容納不了更多。
hintEnglish: Having reached the maximum amount, unable to hold or take in any more.

exampleSimplified: 这颗葡萄又大又饱满。
exampleTraditional: 這顆葡萄又大又飽滿。
exampleEnglish: This grape is big and plump.
hintSimplified: 形容东西圆润、充实,里面装得很满;也可形容精神很好。
hintTraditional: 形容東西圓潤、充實,裡面裝得很滿;也可形容精神很好。
hintEnglish: Describes something round and well-filled; can also describe a person full of spirit.

definition: Bonan ethnic group; public security; security guard; to ensure public security; to ensure safety (for workers engaged in production)
exampleSimplified: 大楼门口有一位保安,他每天都很认真地工作。
exampleTraditional: 大樓門口有一位保安,他每天都很認真地工作。
exampleEnglish: There is a security guard at the building entrance, and he works very seriously every day.
hintSimplified: 他站在大楼或学校门口,负责看守,让大家平安。
hintTraditional: 他站在大樓或學校門口,負責看守,讓大家平安。
hintEnglish: He stands at the entrance of a building or school, watching over it to keep everyone safe.

definition: certainly; surely; custodian; curator; to guarantee; to hold in safekeeping; to have in one's care
exampleSimplified: 这些贵重的东西请你替我保管一下。
exampleTraditional: 這些貴重的東西請你替我保管一下。
exampleEnglish: Please keep these valuable things safe for me.
hintSimplified: 别人把东西交给你,你要小心地收好,不让它丢失或坏掉。
hintTraditional: 別人把東西交給你,你要小心地收好,不讓它丟失或壞掉。
hintEnglish: When someone gives you something, you store it carefully so it won't be lost or damaged.

exampleSimplified: 他们请了一位保姆来照顾孩子。
exampleTraditional: 他們請了一位保姆來照顧孩子。
exampleEnglish: They hired a nanny to look after the child.
hintSimplified: 受雇到别人家里,帮忙照顾小孩和做家事的人。
hintTraditional: 受僱到別人家裡,幫忙照顧小孩和做家事的人。
hintEnglish: A person hired to work in a home, looking after children and doing housework.

definition: (Tw) security guard; to keep in good repair; to maintain; to preserve; to save from damage
exampleSimplified: 公司的保全晚上会在大楼里巡逻。
exampleTraditional: 公司的保全晚上會在大樓裡巡邏。
exampleEnglish: The company's security staff patrol the building at night.
hintSimplified: 台湾常用的说法,指负责大楼或公司安全的工作人员。
hintTraditional: 台灣常用的說法,指負責大樓或公司安全的工作人員。
hintEnglish: A term commonly used in Taiwan for staff who take care of the safety of a building or company.

exampleSimplified: 奶奶每天都向神明祈祷,希望神明保佑全家平安。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶每天都向神明祈禱,希望神明保佑全家平安。
exampleEnglish: Every day Grandma prays to the gods, hoping they will bless and protect the whole family.
hintSimplified: 人们向神明祈求,希望神明用力量守护自己平安。
hintTraditional: 人們向神明祈求,希望神明用力量守護自己平安。
hintEnglish: People pray to the gods, hoping their power will watch over them and keep them safe.

exampleSimplified: 天气变冷了,你出门要多保重。
exampleTraditional: 天氣變冷了,你出門要多保重。
exampleEnglish: It's getting cold, so take good care of yourself when you go out.
hintSimplified: 跟要离开或生病的人道别时,常说这句话,请他注意身体。
hintTraditional: 跟要離開或生病的人道別時,常說這句話,請他注意身體。
hintEnglish: What you say when parting from someone or when they're ill, asking them to look after their health.

gloss: to report a case to the authorities
definition: to report a case to the authorities
exampleSimplified: 我的手机被偷了,所以我去警察局报案。
exampleTraditional: 我的手機被偷了,所以我去警察局報案。
exampleEnglish: My phone was stolen, so I went to the police station to report the case.
hintSimplified: 发生坏事或被偷以后,到警察局说明情况。
hintTraditional: 發生壞事或被偷以後,到警察局說明情況。
hintEnglish: After something bad happens or something is stolen, you go to the police to explain what happened.

definition: forms for reporting statistics; report forms
exampleSimplified: 经理要我今天下班前交出这份月报表。
exampleTraditional: 經理要我今天下班前交出這份月報表。
exampleEnglish: The manager wants me to hand in this monthly report sheet before I leave work today.
hintSimplified: 公司里用来整理数字和资料的表格,让主管看工作结果。
hintTraditional: 公司裡用來整理數字和資料的表格,讓主管看工作結果。
hintEnglish: A table used in companies to organize figures and data so the boss can see the results.

exampleSimplified: 这份工作的报酬很不错,所以很多人想做。
exampleTraditional: 這份工作的報酬很不錯,所以很多人想做。
exampleEnglish: The pay for this job is quite good, so many people want to do it.
hintSimplified: 做完事情或工作以后,别人给你的钱或东西。
hintTraditional: 做完事情或工作以後,別人給你的錢或東西。
hintEnglish: The money or goods given to you after you've done a task or job.

definition: revenge; retaliation; to make reprisals; to retaliate
exampleSimplified: 他怕那个人会报复,所以不敢说出真相。
exampleTraditional: 他怕那個人會報復,所以不敢說出真相。
exampleEnglish: He was afraid that person would take revenge, so he didn't dare tell the truth.
hintSimplified: 别人伤害了你,你也用行动去伤害对方。
hintTraditional: 別人傷害了你,你也用行動去傷害對方。
hintEnglish: When someone has hurt you and you hurt them back in return.

exampleSimplified: 这批货要先报关,才能运出国外。
exampleTraditional: 這批貨要先報關,才能運出國外。
exampleEnglish: This shipment must be declared at customs before it can be sent abroad.
hintSimplified: 货物进出国境时,要向海关申报的手续。
hintTraditional: 貨物進出國境時,要向海關申報的手續。
hintEnglish: The procedure of declaring goods to the authorities at the border when they enter or leave a country.

definition: quote; quoted price; to quote a price
exampleSimplified: 工厂已经把新的报价寄给我们了。
exampleTraditional: 工廠已經把新的報價寄給我們了。
exampleEnglish: The factory has already sent us the new price quote.
hintSimplified: 卖方在交易前告诉买方的价钱。
hintTraditional: 賣方在交易前告訴買方的價錢。
hintEnglish: The price a seller tells a buyer before a deal is made.

exampleSimplified: 图书馆里有很多报刊,可以免费阅读。
exampleTraditional: 圖書館裡有很多報刊,可以免費閱讀。
exampleEnglish: The library has many newspapers and periodicals that you can read for free.
hintSimplified: 每天、每周或每月出版的印刷读物的总称。
hintTraditional: 每天、每週或每月出版的印刷讀物的總稱。
hintEnglish: A general term for printed reading material published daily, weekly or monthly.

exampleSimplified: 他做了太多坏事,现在得到报应了。
exampleTraditional: 他做了太多壞事,現在得到報應了。
exampleEnglish: He did too many bad things, and now he's getting what he deserves.
hintSimplified: 佛教认为做了坏事,以后一定会得到相应的结果。
hintTraditional: 佛教認為做了壞事,以後一定會得到相應的結果。
hintEnglish: In Buddhist belief, the idea that bad deeds will surely bring matching consequences later.

exampleSimplified: 这件事在各大报章上都有报道。
exampleTraditional: 這件事在各大報章上都有報道。
exampleEnglish: This matter was reported in all the major newspapers.
hintSimplified: 每天印出来,让人了解新闻的纸本读物,书面说法。
hintTraditional: 每天印出來,讓人了解新聞的紙本讀物,書面說法。
hintEnglish: Printed daily sheets that let people learn the news; a written-style term.

definition: CL:場|场[chang2],陣|阵[zhen4]; rainstorm; torrential rain
exampleSimplified: 昨天下了一场暴雨,路上到处都是水。
exampleTraditional: 昨天下了一場暴雨,路上到處都是水。
exampleEnglish: There was a heavy rainstorm yesterday, and there was water everywhere on the roads.
hintSimplified: 又大又急的雨,可能让街道淹水。
hintTraditional: 又大又急的雨,可能讓街道淹水。
hintEnglish: Rain that is both heavy and sudden, which may flood the streets.

gloss: to break out; to erupt; to explode; to burst out
definition: to break out; to erupt; to explode; to burst out
exampleSimplified: 火山突然爆发,附近的居民都紧急离开了。
exampleTraditional: 火山突然爆發,附近的居民都緊急離開了。
exampleEnglish: The volcano suddenly erupted, and nearby residents all evacuated urgently.
hintSimplified: 火山、战争或情绪突然猛烈地出现。
hintTraditional: 火山、戰爭或情緒突然猛烈地出現。
hintEnglish: When a volcano, a conflict or an emotion suddenly appears with great force.

exampleSimplified: 这个年轻人很有抱负,希望将来能开自己的公司。
exampleTraditional: 這個年輕人很有抱負,希望將來能開自己的公司。
exampleEnglish: This young man is very ambitious and hopes to open his own company someday.
hintSimplified: 心里对未来有远大的理想和目标。
hintTraditional: 心裡對未來有遠大的理想和目標。
hintEnglish: Having lofty ideals and goals in one's heart about the future.

exampleSimplified: 失去亲人以后,他的心里充满了悲哀。
exampleTraditional: 失去親人以後,他的心裡充滿了悲哀。
exampleEnglish: After losing his family member, his heart was filled with sorrow.
hintSimplified: 心里非常难过、伤心的感觉。
hintTraditional: 心裡非常難過、傷心的感覺。
hintEnglish: A feeling of being very sad and heartbroken inside.

exampleSimplified: 你不要太悲观,事情也许没有那么糟。
exampleTraditional: 你不要太悲觀,事情也許沒有那麼糟。
exampleEnglish: Don't be too pessimistic; things may not be that bad.
hintSimplified: 对未来总是往坏处想,和乐观相反。
hintTraditional: 對未來總是往壞處想,和樂觀相反。
hintEnglish: Always thinking the worst about the future; the opposite of being optimistic.

exampleSimplified: 我们在海边捡了很多漂亮的贝壳。
exampleTraditional: 我們在海邊撿了很多漂亮的貝殼。
exampleEnglish: We picked up lots of pretty shells at the seaside.
hintSimplified: 海边沙滩上常见,是某些软体小动物坚硬的外皮。
hintTraditional: 海邊沙灘上常見,是某些軟體小動物堅硬的外皮。
hintEnglish: Commonly found on the beach, it is the hard outer covering of certain soft-bodied sea animals.

exampleSimplified: 十二是三的倍数,也是四的倍数。
exampleTraditional: 十二是三的倍數,也是四的倍數。
exampleEnglish: Twelve is a multiple of three and also a multiple of four.
hintSimplified: 数学里,一个数乘以整数后得到的结果,比如二、四、六都是二的这种数。
hintTraditional: 數學裡,一個數乘以整數後得到的結果,比如二、四、六都是二的這種數。
hintEnglish: In math, a number you get by multiplying another by a whole number; for example, 2, 4 and 6 are such numbers of 2.

definition: to recite; to repeat from memory
exampleSimplified: 老师要我们把这首唐诗背诵下来。
exampleTraditional: 老師要我們把這首唐詩背誦下來。
exampleEnglish: The teacher wants us to recite this Tang poem from memory.
hintSimplified: 不看书,把记住的课文或诗大声念出来。
hintTraditional: 不看書,把記住的課文或詩大聲念出來。
hintEnglish: Saying aloud a text or poem you've memorized, without looking at the book.

definition: (of waves) to surge forward; Pentium (Intel microprocessor brand); to gallop; to roll on in waves
exampleSimplified: 黄河的河水奔腾向前,声音非常大。
exampleTraditional: 黃河的河水奔騰向前,聲音非常大。
exampleEnglish: The waters of the Yellow River surge forward with a tremendous roar.
hintSimplified: 形容河水或马群气势很大,快速向前冲。
hintTraditional: 形容河水或馬群氣勢很大,快速向前衝。
hintEnglish: Describes a river or a herd of horses rushing forward quickly with great force.

definition: ability; original story; skill; source material
exampleSimplified: 他很有本事,一个人就能修好整台机器。
exampleTraditional: 他很有本事,一個人就能修好整臺機器。
exampleEnglish: He is very capable; he can fix the whole machine by himself.
hintSimplified: 一个人做事的能力或技术,有这个的人很厉害。
hintTraditional: 一個人做事的能力或技術,有這個的人很厲害。
hintEnglish: A person's skill or capability at doing things; someone who has it is impressive.

gloss: (economics) standard; benchmark (as in 金本位[jin1 ben3 wei4] "gold standard")
definition: (economics) standard; benchmark (as in 金本位[jin1 ben3 wei4] "gold standard"); central reference point; fundamental frame of reference (used after a noun N, indicates an N-centered outlook, as in 學校本位|学校本位[xue2 xiao4 ben3 wei4] "school-centered approach"); one's own department or unit
exampleSimplified: 他做事总是以客户的利益为本位。
exampleTraditional: 他做事總是以客戶的利益為本位。
exampleEnglish: He always puts the customers' interests first when he works.
hintSimplified: 以某个人或事物为中心和出发点来考虑问题。
hintTraditional: 以某個人或事物為中心和出發點來考慮問題。
hintEnglish: Taking a certain person or thing as the center and starting point when considering a problem.

exampleSimplified: 猫喜欢抓老鼠是它的本性。
exampleTraditional: 貓喜歡抓老鼠是它的本性。
exampleEnglish: Cats liking to catch mice is in their nature.
hintSimplified: 一个人或动物天生就有、不容易改变的性格。
hintTraditional: 一個人或動物天生就有、不容易改變的性格。
hintEnglish: The character a person or animal is born with and that is hard to change.

definition: essence; innate character; intrinsic quality; nature
exampleSimplified: 我们要看清问题的本质，不要只看表面。
exampleTraditional: 我們要看清問題的本質，不要只看表面。
exampleEnglish: We should see the essence of the problem, not just the surface.
hintSimplified: 事物最根本的特点，和表面现象相对。
hintTraditional: 事物最根本的特點，和表面現象相對。
hintEnglish: The most fundamental characteristic of a thing, as opposed to its surface appearance.

gloss: to collapse; to crumble; to fall apart
definition: to collapse; to crumble; to fall apart
exampleSimplified: 压力太大时，他差点崩溃了。
exampleTraditional: 壓力太大時，他差點崩潰了。
exampleEnglish: When the pressure was too great, he almost fell apart.
hintSimplified: 房子倒塌，或者人的情绪再也撑不住了。
hintTraditional: 房子倒塌，或者人的情緒再也撐不住了。
hintEnglish: A building caving in, or a person's emotions no longer able to hold on.

definition: compiler; editor; to compile; to edit
exampleSimplified: 这位编辑每天都要修改很多文章。
exampleTraditional: 這位編輯每天都要修改很多文章。
exampleEnglish: This editor revises many articles every day.
hintSimplified: 在报社或出版社负责修改和整理稿件的人，或这种工作。
hintTraditional: 在報社或出版社負責修改和整理稿件的人，或這種工作。
hintEnglish: The person at a newspaper or publisher who revises and organizes manuscripts, or this kind of work.

exampleSimplified: 老师正在编写一本新的汉语课本。
exampleTraditional: 老師正在編寫一本新的漢語課本。
exampleEnglish: The teacher is writing a new Chinese textbook.
hintSimplified: 把资料整理起来，写成书、教材或程序。
hintTraditional: 把資料整理起來，寫成書、教材或程式。
hintEnglish: To gather materials and put them into a book, textbook or program.

gloss: (fig.) to create (sth abstract, e.g. a dream, a lie etc)
definition: (fig.) to create (sth abstract, e.g. a dream, a lie etc); to weave; to knit; to plait; to braid
exampleSimplified: 奶奶用毛线编织了一条围巾。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶用毛線編織了一條圍巾。
exampleEnglish: Grandma knitted a scarf from wool yarn.
hintSimplified: 用线或草一条一条交叉做成东西，也可以比喻想出梦想。
hintTraditional: 用線或草一條一條交叉做成東西，也可以比喻想出夢想。
hintEnglish: Crossing strands of thread or straw to make something; also used figuratively for building dreams.

gloss: authorized staffing allocation in government or public institutions (excluding temporary or contract staff)
definition: authorized staffing allocation in government or public institutions (excluding temporary or contract staff); to compile; to put together (a lesson plan, budget etc); to establish (a unit or department); to weave; to plait
exampleSimplified: 这家公司今年增加了十个人的编制。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司今年增加了十個人的編制。
exampleEnglish: This organization added ten staff positions this year.
hintSimplified: 机关或单位里正式规定的人员名额。
hintTraditional: 機關或單位里正式規定的人員名額。
hintEnglish: The officially set number of staff positions in an agency or institution.

exampleSimplified: 这条河是两个国家的边界。
exampleTraditional: 這條河是兩個國家的邊界。
exampleEnglish: This river is the border between two countries.
hintSimplified: 两个国家或地区之间分开的线。
hintTraditional: 兩個國家或地區之間分開的線。
hintEnglish: The line separating two countries or regions.

definition: edge; fringe; verge; brink; periphery; marginal; borderline
exampleSimplified: 他站在悬崖的边缘，不敢往下看。
exampleTraditional: 他站在懸崖的邊緣，不敢往下看。
exampleEnglish: He stood at the edge of the cliff and did not dare look down.
hintSimplified: 最外面靠近尽头的地方，也指不属于中心的位置。
hintTraditional: 最外面靠近盡頭的地方，也指不屬於中心的位置。
hintEnglish: The outermost area near the limit; also a position away from the center.

definition: to become devaluated; to depreciate; to devaluate
exampleSimplified: 通货膨胀会让钱慢慢贬值。
exampleTraditional: 通貨膨脹會讓錢慢慢貶值。
exampleEnglish: Inflation makes money gradually lose value.
hintSimplified: 钱或东西的价值变低了，买到的东西变少。
hintTraditional: 錢或東西的價值變低了，買到的東西變少。
hintEnglish: When the worth of money or goods goes down and buys less.

exampleSimplified: 庙门上挂着一块古老的匾额。
exampleTraditional: 廟門上掛著一塊古老的匾額。
exampleEnglish: An old inscribed plaque hangs above the temple gate.
hintSimplified: 挂在门上方或厅堂里、写着字的长方形木板。
hintTraditional: 掛在門上方或廳堂裡、寫著字的長方形木板。
hintEnglish: A rectangular wooden board with writing hung above a door or in a hall.

exampleSimplified: 照片太模糊了，我无法辨认他是谁。
exampleTraditional: 照片太模糊了，我無法辨認他是誰。
exampleEnglish: The photo is too blurry; I can't make out who he is.
hintSimplified: 仔细看后，找出或确定某人某物是什么。
hintTraditional: 仔細看後，找出或確定某人某物是什麼。
hintEnglish: After looking carefully, to figure out or confirm what or who something is.

exampleSimplified: 这个手机有人脸辨识的功能。
exampleTraditional: 這個手機有人臉辨識的功能。
exampleEnglish: This phone has a face recognition feature.
hintSimplified: 分辨并认出事物的特征，常用在电脑和机器上。
hintTraditional: 分辨並認出事物的特徵，常用在電腦和機器上。
hintEnglish: Telling apart and recognizing features of things, often used for computers and machines.

definition: to argue in favor of; to defend; to plead; to speak in defense of
exampleSimplified: 律师在法庭上为他辩护。
exampleTraditional: 律師在法庭上為他辯護。
exampleEnglish: The lawyer defended him in court.
hintSimplified: 在法庭上或争论中，说理由来保护某个人或看法。
hintTraditional: 在法庭上或爭論中，說理由來保護某個人或看法。
hintEnglish: To give reasons to protect a person or opinion in court or in an argument.

definition: CL:場|场[chang3],次[ci4]; argument; debate; to argue over
exampleSimplified: 同学们就这个问题展开了热烈的辩论。
exampleTraditional: 同學們就這個問題展開了熱烈的辯論。
exampleEnglish: The students held a heated debate on this issue.
hintSimplified: 两方用不同的看法互相说理，想说服对方。
hintTraditional: 兩方用不同的看法互相說理，想說服對方。
hintEnglish: Two sides with different views reason against each other, trying to persuade.

exampleSimplified: 这个国家的教育制度正在进行变革。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家的教育制度正在進行變革。
exampleEnglish: This country's education system is undergoing reform.
hintSimplified: 把旧的制度或做法大幅度改成新的。
hintTraditional: 把舊的制度或做法大幅度改成新的。
hintEnglish: To greatly change an old system or practice into a new one.

exampleSimplified: 这座老城的变迁让人感慨万千。
exampleTraditional: 這座老城的變遷讓人感慨萬千。
exampleEnglish: The changes in this old city make one deeply reflective.
hintSimplified: 随着时间，社会或地方一点一点发生的改变。
hintTraditional: 隨著時間，社會或地方一點一點發生的改變。
hintEnglish: Gradual changes in a society or place over time.

definition: flexible; pragmatic; to accommodate to circumstances; to act differently in different situations
exampleSimplified: 遇到困难时，要学会变通，不要太死板。
exampleTraditional: 遇到困難時，要學會變通，不要太死板。
exampleEnglish: When facing difficulties, learn to be flexible and not too rigid.
hintSimplified: 不死守规定，根据情况想别的办法。
hintTraditional: 不死守規定，根據情況想別的辦法。
hintEnglish: Not sticking rigidly to rules, but finding other ways according to the situation.

gloss: to become deformed; to change shape; to morph
definition: to become deformed; to change shape; to morph
exampleSimplified: 塑料杯放在高温下会变形。
exampleTraditional: 塑膠杯放在高溫下會變形。
exampleEnglish: Plastic cups will lose their shape under high heat.
hintSimplified: 东西原来的样子被改变，不再是本来的形状。
hintTraditional: 東西原來的樣子被改變，不再是本來的形狀。
hintEnglish: When something's original shape is altered and it's no longer what it was.

exampleSimplified: 衣服上的标签写着价格和尺寸。
exampleTraditional: 衣服上的標籤寫著價格和尺寸。
exampleEnglish: The label on the clothes shows the price and size.
hintSimplified: 贴或挂在东西上，用来说明名称、价钱或类别的小纸片。
hintTraditional: 貼或掛在東西上，用來說明名稱、價錢或類別的小紙片。
hintEnglish: A small piece of paper attached to things showing name, price or category.

definition: CL:幅[fu2],張|张[zhang1],條|条[tiao2]; placard; written slogan
exampleSimplified: 墙上贴着一条环保的标语。
exampleTraditional: 牆上貼著一條環保的標語。
exampleEnglish: A slogan about environmental protection is posted on the wall.
hintSimplified: 写在墙上或布条上，用来宣传或号召大家的短句。
hintTraditional: 寫在牆上或布條上，用來宣傳或號召大家的短句。
hintEnglish: A short phrase written on a wall or banner to promote or call on people.

definition: confession; declaration; to explain oneself; to express; to reveal one's thoughts or feelings
exampleSimplified: 他鼓起勇气，向喜欢的女孩表白。
exampleTraditional: 他鼓起勇氣，向喜歡的女孩表白。
exampleEnglish: He mustered his courage and confessed his feelings to the girl he liked.
hintSimplified: 把心里喜欢某人的感情说出来。
hintTraditional: 把心裡喜歡某人的感情說出來。
hintEnglish: To say out loud the love you feel for someone.

definition: known; to indicate; to make clear; to make known; to state clearly
exampleSimplified: 调查结果表明，大多数人支持这个计划。
exampleTraditional: 調查結果表明，大多數人支援這個計劃。
exampleEnglish: The survey results show that most people support this plan.
hintSimplified: 用事实或行动清楚地让人知道某种情况或态度。
hintTraditional: 用事實或行動清楚地讓人知道某種情況或態度。
hintEnglish: To make a situation or attitude clearly known through facts or actions.

exampleSimplified: 感冒的时候，我的鼻孔总是不通。
exampleTraditional: 感冒的時候，我的鼻孔總是不通。
exampleEnglish: When I have a cold, my nostrils are always blocked.
hintSimplified: 脸上用来呼吸的两个小洞。
hintTraditional: 臉上用來呼吸的兩個小洞。
hintEnglish: The two small holes on the face used for breathing.

definition: record; to put down in writing; to take down notes; transcript
exampleSimplified: 警察把他说的话都写进了笔录。
exampleTraditional: 警察把他說的話都寫進了筆錄。
exampleEnglish: The police wrote everything he said into the written record.
hintSimplified: 警察或法院把别人说的话写下来的文件。
hintTraditional: 警察或法院把別人說的話寫下來的檔案。
hintEnglish: A document in which police or the court write down what someone said.

exampleSimplified: 我有一个住在法国的笔友,我们常常写信。
exampleTraditional: 我有一個住在法國的筆友,我們常常寫信。
exampleEnglish: I have a friend living in France, and we often write letters to each other.
hintSimplified: 没见过面,但是常常用写信的方式联络的朋友。
hintTraditional: 沒見過面,但是常常用寫信的方式聯絡的朋友。
hintEnglish: A friend you may never have met, with whom you keep in touch by writing letters.

exampleSimplified: 这个班男生和女生的比率是一比二。
exampleTraditional: 這個班男生和女生的比率是一比二。
exampleEnglish: The ratio of boys to girls in this class is one to two.
hintSimplified: 两个数量相比所得到的数字关系,比如百分比。
hintTraditional: 兩個數量相比所得到的數字關係,比如百分比。
hintEnglish: The numerical relationship obtained by comparing two quantities, like a percentage.

definition: analogy; comparison; metaphor; to compare; to draw a parallel; to match
exampleSimplified: 他的音乐才华无人能比拟。
exampleTraditional: 他的音樂才華無人能比擬。
exampleEnglish: His musical talent is beyond compare.
hintSimplified: 拿一个东西和另一个东西相比,说两者差不多好。
hintTraditional: 拿一個東西和另一個東西相比,說兩者差不多好。
hintEnglish: To set one thing beside another and say they are on a par.

definition: analogy; figuratively; figure of speech; metaphor; to compare; to liken to
exampleSimplified: 老师用“时间就是金钱”来做比喻。
exampleTraditional: 老師用“時間就是金錢”來做比喻。
exampleEnglish: The teacher used "time is money" as a metaphor.
hintSimplified: 写文章时,用另一个东西来说明某件事的方法。
hintTraditional: 寫文章時,用另一個東西來說明某件事的方法。
hintEnglish: A way of writing in which you use one thing to explain another.

exampleSimplified: 教育在政府预算中所占的比重越来越大。
exampleTraditional: 教育在政府預算中所佔的比重越來越大。
exampleEnglish: Education takes up a growing share of the government budget.
hintSimplified: 某部分在整体中占的重要程度或大小。
hintTraditional: 某部分在整體中佔的重要程度或大小。
hintEnglish: How large or important a part is within the whole.

exampleSimplified: 护照是出国旅行的必备证件。
exampleTraditional: 護照是出國旅行的必備證件。
exampleEnglish: A passport is an essential document for traveling abroad.
hintSimplified: 一定要准备好,不能没有的。
hintTraditional: 一定要準備好,不能沒有的。
hintEnglish: Something you must have ready and cannot do without.

gloss: to be bound to; to be sure to
definition: to be bound to; to be sure to
exampleSimplified: 只要你努力,必定会成功。
exampleTraditional: 只要你努力,必定會成功。
exampleEnglish: As long as you work hard, you will surely succeed.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示说话的人很肯定,事情一定会这样。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示說話的人很肯定,事情一定會這樣。
hintEnglish: An adverb showing the speaker is very sure something will happen.

exampleSimplified: 科技进步必然会改变人们的生活。
exampleTraditional: 科技進步必然會改變人們的生活。
exampleEnglish: Technological progress will inevitably change people's lives.
hintSimplified: 根据道理,事情一定会这样发生,不可避免。
hintTraditional: 根據道理,事情一定會這樣發生,不可避免。
hintEnglish: By reason, it is bound to happen and cannot be avoided.

definition: lower the curtain; the curtain falls; to come to an end (of a meeting)
exampleSimplified: 电影节在昨晚正式闭幕了。
exampleTraditional: 電影節在昨晚正式閉幕了。
exampleEnglish: The film festival officially came to a close last night.
hintSimplified: 会议或比赛等活动结束时,舞台的幕布放下来。
hintTraditional: 會議或比賽等活動結束時,舞台的幕布放下來。
hintEnglish: What happens when the curtain falls at the end of an event or festival.

definition: blocking; hard to get to; inaccessible; out of the way; to close up; to stop up; unenlightened
exampleSimplified: 那个山村交通不便,消息很闭塞。
exampleTraditional: 那個山村交通不便,訊息很閉塞。
exampleEnglish: That mountain village has poor transport, and news hardly reaches it.
hintSimplified: 形容地方偏僻,交通不方便,和外面很少来往。
hintTraditional: 形容地方偏僻,交通不方便,和外面很少來往。
hintEnglish: Describes a remote place with poor transport and little contact with the outside.

gloss: to take refuge; to seek asylum
definition: to take refuge; to seek asylum
exampleSimplified: 地震后,居民都到学校去避难。
exampleTraditional: 地震後,居民都到學校去避難。
exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, residents went to the school to take shelter.
hintSimplified: 遇到灾害或危险时,躲到安全的地方去。
hintTraditional: 遇到災害或危險時,躲到安全的地方去。
hintEnglish: To hide in a safe place when disaster or danger strikes.

exampleSimplified: 医生教他们怎么正确避孕。
exampleTraditional: 醫生教他們怎麼正確避孕。
exampleEnglish: The doctor taught them how to practice contraception properly.
hintSimplified: 用药或方法,让女性不会怀上宝宝。
hintTraditional: 用藥或方法,讓女性不會懷上寶寶。
hintEnglish: Using medicine or methods so that a woman does not become pregnant.

gloss: one's whole life; throughout one's life
definition: one's whole life; throughout one's life
exampleSimplified: 他毕生的心血都用在教育上。
exampleTraditional: 他畢生的心血都用在教育上。
exampleEnglish: He devoted his whole life's effort to education.
hintSimplified: 从年轻到老,整个一辈子。
hintTraditional: 從年輕到老,整個一輩子。
hintEnglish: From youth to old age, an entire lifetime.

exampleSimplified: 通货膨胀会让币值下降。
exampleTraditional: 通貨膨脹會讓幣值下降。
exampleEnglish: Inflation causes the value of a currency to fall.
hintSimplified: 一个国家的钱能买到多少东西的价值。
hintTraditional: 一個國家的錢能買到多少東西的價值。
hintEnglish: How much a country's money is worth in terms of what it can buy.

exampleSimplified: 他们在山上买了一栋别墅。
exampleTraditional: 他們在山上買了一棟別墅。
exampleEnglish: They bought a villa on the mountain.
hintSimplified: 有花园的独立大房子,常在郊外,有钱人度假住。
hintTraditional: 有花園的獨立大房子,常在郊外,有錢人度假住。
hintEnglish: A large detached house with a garden, often in the countryside, used for vacations.

exampleSimplified: 我们订了一家海边的宾馆。
exampleTraditional: 我們訂了一家海邊的賓館。
exampleEnglish: We booked a hotel by the sea.
hintSimplified: 旅行时可以付钱住一晚的地方。
hintTraditional: 旅行時可以付錢住一晚的地方。
hintEnglish: A place where you pay to stay overnight when traveling.

gloss: to stand side by side; to be juxtaposed
definition: to stand side by side; to be juxtaposed
exampleSimplified: 这两个句子是并列关系。
exampleTraditional: 這兩個句子是並列關係。
exampleEnglish: These two sentences are in a coordinate relationship.
hintSimplified: 几个东西不分先后高低,排在一起。
hintTraditional: 幾個東西不分先後高低,排在一起。
hintEnglish: Several things placed together with no order of rank.

gloss: to give equal emphasis to; to attach equal importance to
definition: to give equal emphasis to; to attach equal importance to
exampleSimplified: 学校主张学习和运动并重。
exampleTraditional: 學校主張學習和運動並重。
exampleEnglish: The school advocates giving equal weight to study and exercise.
hintSimplified: 两件事都同样重要,都要重视。
hintTraditional: 兩件事都同樣重要,都要重視。
hintEnglish: Two things are both equally important and both deserve attention.

definition: (computing) concurrent; (medicine) (of one disease) to be complicated by (another); (of another disease) to erupt simultaneously; to happen simultaneously
exampleSimplified: 网站同时上线,可能会并发大量请求。
exampleTraditional: 網站同時上線,可能會併發大量請求。
exampleEnglish: When the website goes live, it may receive a large number of concurrent requests.
hintSimplified: 电脑系统里,好几件事在同一时间发生。
hintTraditional: 電腦系統裡,好幾件事在同一時間發生。
hintEnglish: In computer systems, several things happening at the same time.

exampleSimplified: 医院里的病床都住满了人。
exampleTraditional: 醫院裡的病床都住滿了人。
exampleEnglish: All the beds in the hospital are occupied.
hintSimplified: 医院里给生病的人躺的床。
hintTraditional: 醫院裡給生病的人躺的床。
hintEnglish: The bed in a hospital where sick people lie.

exampleSimplified: 洗手可以减少病菌的传播。
exampleTraditional: 洗手可以減少病菌的傳播。
exampleEnglish: Washing hands can reduce the spread of germs.
hintSimplified: 很小的生物,看不见,会让人生病。
hintTraditional: 很小的生物,看不見,會讓人生病。
hintEnglish: Tiny living things, invisible to the eye, that make people ill.

exampleSimplified: 医生每天要照顾很多病患。
exampleTraditional: 醫生每天要照顧很多病患。
exampleEnglish: Doctors have to take care of many patients every day.
hintSimplified: 去医院看医生的、生了病的人。
hintTraditional: 去醫院看醫生的、生了病的人。
hintEnglish: People who are ill and go to the hospital to see a doctor.

definition: to affect; to involve; to spread to
exampleSimplified: 这场大火波及了附近的几栋房子。
exampleTraditional: 這場大火波及了附近的幾棟房子。
exampleEnglish: The big fire spread to and affected several nearby buildings.
hintSimplified: 一件事的影响扩大,连旁边的人或地方也受到牵连。
hintTraditional: 一件事的影響擴大,連旁邊的人或地方也受到牽連。
hintEnglish: When the effects of something spread so that nearby people or places are also hit.

exampleSimplified: 海上的波浪一阵一阵地打到岸边。
exampleTraditional: 海上的波浪一陣一陣地打到岸邊。
exampleEnglish: Waves on the sea crashed against the shore one after another.
hintSimplified: 海面上被风吹起、一起一伏的水。
hintTraditional: 海面上被風吹起、一起一伏的水。
hintEnglish: Water on the sea surface rising and falling, pushed by the wind.

exampleSimplified: 这家公司剥削员工,让他们长时间工作却只给很低的薪水。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司剝削員工,讓他們長時間工作卻只給很低的薪水。
exampleEnglish: This company exploits its employees, making them work long hours for very low pay.
hintSimplified: 老板利用别人的劳力赚钱,却不给合理的报酬。
hintTraditional: 老闆利用別人的勞力賺錢,卻不給合理的報酬。
hintEnglish: A boss uses other people's labor to make money without giving fair pay.

gloss: to wrestle; to fight; to struggle
definition: to wrestle; to fight; to struggle
exampleSimplified: 警察和小偷在黑暗的巷子里搏斗了很久。
exampleTraditional: 警察和小偷在黑暗的巷子裡搏鬥了很久。
exampleEnglish: The police officer and the thief fought hand to hand in the dark alley for a long time.
hintSimplified: 两个人或动物用力气互相打斗、纠缠在一起。
hintTraditional: 兩個人或動物用力氣互相打鬥、糾纏在一起。
hintEnglish: Two people or animals physically struggle and fight each other with force.

definition: to air (a TV program etc); to broadcast
exampleSimplified: 这部电视剧明天晚上八点会在电视台播出。
exampleTraditional: 這部電視劇明天晚上八點會在電視臺播出。
exampleEnglish: This TV drama will be aired on the TV station at eight tomorrow evening.
hintSimplified: 电视或广播把节目送出去让观众看到或听到。
hintTraditional: 電視或廣播把節目送出去讓觀眾看到或聽到。
hintEnglish: A TV or radio station sends a program out so audiences can watch or hear it.

exampleSimplified: 登山队在半山腰等待直升机运来补给。
exampleTraditional: 登山隊在半山腰等待直升機運來補給。
exampleEnglish: The climbing team waited halfway up the mountain for a helicopter to bring supplies.
hintSimplified: 军队或探险队需要的食物、水和物品,用完了要再送来。
hintTraditional: 軍隊或探險隊需要的食物、水和物品,用完了要再送來。
hintEnglish: Food, water and goods that an army or expedition needs and that must be sent again when used up.

exampleSimplified: 犯了错以后,你要赶快想办法补救。
exampleTraditional: 犯了錯以後,你要趕快想辦法補救。
exampleEnglish: After making a mistake, you should quickly find a way to remedy it.
hintSimplified: 事情出问题后,设法做些事让损失变小或情况变好。
hintTraditional: 事情出問題後,設法做些事讓損失變小或情況變好。
hintEnglish: After something goes wrong, take steps to reduce the damage or improve the situation.

definition: inappropriate; inconvenient; short of cash; unsuitable
exampleSimplified: 他的腿受伤了,行动很不便。
exampleTraditional: 他的腿受傷了,行動很不便。
exampleEnglish: His leg is injured, so moving around is very inconvenient.
hintSimplified: 形容做事时遇到困难,不方便或不合适。
hintTraditional: 形容做事時遇到困難,不方便或不合適。
hintEnglish: Describes when doing something is difficult, inconvenient or not suitable.

definition: cannot; may not; must not; not to be allowed
exampleSimplified: 图书馆里不得大声说话。
exampleTraditional: 圖書館裡不得大聲說話。
exampleEnglish: Speaking loudly is not allowed in the library.
hintSimplified: 常用在规定里,表示不被允许做某事。
hintTraditional: 常用在規定裡,表示不被允許做某事。
hintEnglish: Often used in rules to say something is not permitted.

exampleSimplified: 这些苹果的大小不等,价钱也不一样。
exampleTraditional: 這些蘋果的大小不等,價錢也不一樣。
exampleEnglish: These apples vary in size, and their prices differ too.
hintSimplified: 形容几样东西的数量、大小或程度并不相同。
hintTraditional: 形容幾樣東西的數量、大小或程度並不相同。
hintEnglish: Describes several things whose amount, size or degree are not the same.

exampleSimplified: 警方抓到了一群不法分子。
exampleTraditional: 警方抓到了一群不法分子。
exampleEnglish: The police caught a group of lawbreakers.
hintSimplified: 形容做了违反法律规定的事。
hintTraditional: 形容做了違反法律規定的事。
hintEnglish: Describes doing something that goes against the law.

exampleSimplified: 这位年轻的画家气度不凡,作品也很特别。
exampleTraditional: 這位年輕的畫家氣度不凡,作品也很特別。
exampleEnglish: This young painter has an extraordinary bearing, and his works are special too.
hintSimplified: 形容人或东西和普通的很不一样,特别出色。
hintTraditional: 形容人或東西和普通的很不一樣,特別出色。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or thing that is very different from the ordinary and especially outstanding.

gloss: there is no harm in; might as well
definition: there is no harm in; might as well
exampleSimplified: 你不妨先试试看,说不定会喜欢。
exampleTraditional: 你不妨先試試看,說不定會喜歡。
exampleEnglish: You might as well try it first; maybe you'll like it.
hintSimplified: 用来温和地建议别人做某事,因为这样做没有坏处。
hintTraditional: 用來溫和地建議別人做某事,因為這樣做沒有壞處。
hintEnglish: Used to gently suggest doing something because there's no harm in it.

exampleSimplified: 同样的工作薪水却不一样,这太不公了。
exampleTraditional: 同樣的工作薪水卻不一樣,這太不公了。
exampleEnglish: The same job with different pay is really unfair.
hintSimplified: 形容对人的待遇不平等,没有公平对待大家。
hintTraditional: 形容對人的待遇不平等,沒有公平對待大家。
hintEnglish: Describes people being treated unequally, not fairly.

definition: not as good as; to fall short of; too late
exampleSimplified: 我的中文还不及他的好。
exampleTraditional: 我的中文還不及他的好。
exampleEnglish: My Chinese is still not as good as his.
hintSimplified: 用来比较,表示某一方比另一方差一些。
hintTraditional: 用來比較,表示某一方比另一方差一些。
hintEnglish: Used in comparisons to say one side falls short of the other.

definition: can't help (doing sth); can't refrain from
exampleSimplified: 听到这个好消息,她不禁笑了起来。
exampleTraditional: 聽到這個好訊息,她不禁笑了起來。
exampleEnglish: Hearing the good news, she couldn't help laughing.
hintSimplified: 感情太强烈,自己控制不住就做出某个动作。
hintTraditional: 感情太強烈,自己控制不住就做出某個動作。
hintEnglish: Emotion is so strong that you can't control yourself and just react.

definition: cannot bear; cannot stand; extremely; utterly
exampleSimplified: 连续加班一个月,他累得疲惫不堪。
exampleTraditional: 連續加班一個月,他累得疲憊不堪。
exampleEnglish: After a month of continuous overtime, he was utterly exhausted.
hintSimplified: 常放在形容词后面,表示程度太严重,让人受不了。
hintTraditional: 常放在形容詞後面,表示程度太嚴重,讓人受不了。
hintEnglish: Often placed after an adjective to show something is so severe it's unbearable.

definition: not to do one's best; not to exert oneself
exampleSimplified: 经理因为办事不力,被老板批评了。
exampleTraditional: 經理因為辦事不力,被老闆批評了。
exampleEnglish: The manager was criticized by the boss for handling things ineffectively.
hintSimplified: 形容做事不够努力,没有尽全力,结果不好。
hintTraditional: 形容做事不夠努力,沒有盡全力,結果不好。
hintEnglish: Describes working without enough effort, not giving one's all, with poor results.

exampleSimplified: 我本来想出去玩,不料突然下起大雨。
exampleTraditional: 我本來想出去玩,不料突然下起大雨。
exampleEnglish: I originally wanted to go out, but unexpectedly it suddenly started pouring.
hintSimplified: 用在句子里,表示事情的发展和原来想的不一样,让人意外。
hintTraditional: 用在句子裡,表示事情的發展和原來想的不一樣,讓人意外。
hintEnglish: Used in a sentence to show events turned out differently than expected, a surprise.

exampleSimplified: 第一次上台演讲,他不免有点紧张。
exampleTraditional: 第一次上臺演講,他不免有點緊張。
exampleEnglish: Giving a speech on stage for the first time, he was inevitably a bit nervous.
hintSimplified: 表示在某种情况下,很难避免会出现某种结果。
hintTraditional: 表示在某種情況下,很難避免會出現某種結果。
hintEnglish: Shows that in a certain situation a certain result is hard to avoid.

definition: cannot; cannot tolerate; must not; to not allow
exampleSimplified: 这件事很重要,不容马虎。
exampleTraditional: 這件事很重要,不容馬虎。
exampleEnglish: This matter is important and allows no carelessness.
hintSimplified: 表示不允许、不让某种情况发生。
hintTraditional: 表示不允許、不讓某種情況發生。
hintEnglish: Means not allowing or permitting a certain situation to happen.

definition: frequently; from time to time; now and then; occasionally
exampleSimplified: 他一边开车,一边不时看看手机上的地图。
exampleTraditional: 他一邊開車,一邊不時看看手機上的地圖。
exampleEnglish: While driving, he glanced at the map on his phone from time to time.
hintSimplified: 表示动作每隔一小段时间就出现一次,不是一直不停。
hintTraditional: 表示動作每隔一小段時間就出現一次,不是一直不停。
hintEnglish: Shows an action happens every so often, not continuously.

definition: not hesitate (to do sth); not scruple (to do sth); not spare; not stint
exampleSimplified: 为了救孩子,她不惜付出任何代价。
exampleTraditional: 為了救孩子,她不惜付出任何代價。
exampleEnglish: To save her child, she would not hesitate to pay any price.
hintSimplified: 为了达到目的,即使要付出很大的代价也愿意。
hintTraditional: 為了達到目的,即使要付出很大的代價也願意。
hintEnglish: To reach a goal, being willing to pay even a very high cost.

gloss: to be not less than (a certain quantity, amount etc)
definition: to be not less than (a certain quantity, amount etc)
exampleSimplified: 今天来参加活动的人不下一千个。
exampleTraditional: 今天來參加活動的人不下一千個。
exampleEnglish: No fewer than a thousand people came to the event today.
hintSimplified: 用在数字前面,表示实际数量至少有这么多,甚至更多。
hintTraditional: 用在數字前面,表示實際數量至少有這麼多,甚至更多。
hintEnglish: Used before a number to show the actual amount is at least that much, maybe more.

exampleSimplified: 他赌博败光了家产,真是个不肖子孙。
exampleTraditional: 他賭博敗光了家產,真是個不肖子孫。
exampleEnglish: He gambled away the family fortune; he's truly an unworthy descendant.
hintSimplified: 形容子女品行不好,比不上父母,让家人失望。
hintTraditional: 形容子女品行不好,比不上父母,讓家人失望。
hintEnglish: Describes children whose conduct is poor, who fall short of their parents and disappoint the family.

exampleSimplified: 经过不懈的努力,他终于通过了考试。
exampleTraditional: 經過不懈的努力,他終於透過了考試。
exampleEnglish: Through tireless effort, he finally passed the exam.
hintSimplified: 形容人一直努力,从不放松,也不放弃。
hintTraditional: 形容人一直努力,從不放鬆,也不放棄。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who keeps working hard, never relaxing or giving up.

exampleSimplified: 他已经戒烟了,不再抽烟。
exampleTraditional: 他已經戒菸了,不再抽菸。
exampleEnglish: He has quit smoking and no longer smokes.
hintSimplified: 表示以前有的事情或状态,从现在起结束了。
hintTraditional: 表示以前有的事情或狀態,從現在起結束了。
hintEnglish: Shows that something that used to happen or be true has ended from now on.

gloss: not in such a way as to; not likely to
definition: not in such a way as to; not likely to
exampleSimplified: 只要小心一点,就不致出错。
exampleTraditional: 只要小心一點,就不致出錯。
exampleEnglish: As long as you are a bit careful, you won't make a mistake.
hintSimplified: 这个词表示事情不太可能发展到坏的结果。
hintTraditional: 這個詞表示事情不太可能發展到壞的結果。
hintEnglish: This word expresses that things are unlikely to turn out badly.

exampleSimplified: 这个古老的部落住在山上,生活很简单。
exampleTraditional: 這個古老的部落住在山上,生活很簡單。
exampleEnglish: This ancient tribe lives in the mountains and has a simple life.
hintSimplified: 由很多家族组成、住在一起的原始或传统群体。
hintTraditional: 由很多家族組成、住在一起的原始或傳統群體。
hintEnglish: A traditional group made up of many families living together.

exampleSimplified: 经理正在部署下个月的工作计划。
exampleTraditional: 經理正在部署下個月的工作計劃。
exampleEnglish: The manager is arranging next month's work plan.
hintSimplified: 对人员或工作做出整体安排和分配。
hintTraditional: 對人員或工作做出整體安排和分配。
hintEnglish: To make an overall arrangement and assignment of people or tasks.

exampleSimplified: 大家的步调一致,工作很顺利。
exampleTraditional: 大家的步調一致,工作很順利。
exampleEnglish: Everyone moves at the same pace, so work goes smoothly.
hintSimplified: 走路或做事时的速度和节奏。
hintTraditional: 走路或做事時的速度和節奏。
hintEnglish: The speed and rhythm at which one walks or does things.

exampleSimplified: 请按照这些步骤一步一步做。
exampleTraditional: 請按照這些步驟一步一步做。
exampleEnglish: Please follow these steps and do it one at a time.
hintSimplified: 做一件事时,先后排列的各个阶段。
hintTraditional: 做一件事時,先後排列的各個階段。
hintEnglish: The stages arranged in order when doing something.

definition: to conjecture; to guess; to surmise
exampleSimplified: 大家都在猜测他为什么没来。
exampleTraditional: 大家都在猜測他為什麼沒來。
exampleEnglish: Everyone is speculating about why he didn't come.
hintSimplified: 没有确定的答案时,凭想法去推想原因或结果。
hintTraditional: 沒有確定的答案時,憑想法去推想原因或結果。
hintEnglish: Without a certain answer, to reason about causes or results based on ideas.

gloss: to be suspicious and jealous of
definition: to be suspicious and jealous of
exampleSimplified: 夫妻之间如果互相猜忌,感情就会变坏。
exampleTraditional: 夫妻之間如果互相猜忌,感情就會變壞。
exampleEnglish: If a couple is suspicious of each other, their relationship will get worse.
hintSimplified: 不信任别人,总觉得对方有问题,心里不舒服。
hintTraditional: 不信任別人,總覺得對方有問題,心裡不舒服。
hintEnglish: Not trusting others and always feeling something is wrong with them.

definition: (math.) conjecture; hypothesis; to guess; to conjecture; to suppose
exampleSimplified: 这只是我的猜想,还没有证据。
exampleTraditional: 這只是我的猜想,還沒有證據。
exampleEnglish: This is just my conjecture; there is no evidence yet.
hintSimplified: 还没被证明的想法或推测。
hintTraditional: 還沒被證明的想法或推測。
hintEnglish: An idea or guess that has not yet been proven.

definition: dressmaker; tailor; to make an item of clothing; to tailor
exampleSimplified: 这位裁缝做的衣服又合身又好看。
exampleTraditional: 這位裁縫做的衣服又合身又好看。
exampleEnglish: The clothes made by this tailor fit well and look nice.
hintSimplified: 专门帮人量身体尺寸、做衣服的人。
hintTraditional: 專門幫人量身體尺寸、做衣服的人。
hintEnglish: A person who measures people and makes clothes for them.

definition: to cut down; to lessen; to reduce
exampleSimplified: 公司为了省钱,决定裁减一百个员工。
exampleTraditional: 公司為了省錢,決定裁減一百個員工。
exampleEnglish: To save money, the company decided to cut one hundred employees.
hintSimplified: 公司把人员或经费减少。
hintTraditional: 公司把人員或經費減少。
hintEnglish: A company reduces its staff or budget.

exampleSimplified: 这家大财团投资了很多行业。
exampleTraditional: 這家大財團投資了很多行業。
exampleEnglish: This large conglomerate has invested in many industries.
hintSimplified: 拥有大量资金、控制很多公司的大型集团。
hintTraditional: 擁有大量資金、控制很多公司的大型集團。
hintEnglish: A large group with huge funds that controls many companies.

exampleSimplified: 政府的财政出现了问题。
exampleTraditional: 政府的財政出現了問題。
exampleEnglish: The government's finances have run into problems.
hintSimplified: 国家或政府收入和支出的管理。
hintTraditional: 國家或政府收入和支出的管理。
hintEnglish: The management of a state's or government's income and spending.

exampleSimplified: 他用才智解决了这个难题。
exampleTraditional: 他用才智解決了這個難題。
exampleEnglish: He used his talent and intelligence to solve this difficult problem.
hintSimplified: 一个人聪明的头脑和做事的本领。
hintTraditional: 一個人聰明的頭腦和做事的本領。
hintEnglish: A person's clever mind and ability to get things done.

definition: to cover; to gather news; to hunt for and collect; to interview
exampleSimplified: 记者去现场采访了很多市民。
exampleTraditional: 記者去現場採訪了很多市民。
exampleEnglish: The reporter went to the scene and interviewed many citizens.
hintSimplified: 记者为了写新闻,向别人提问并收集资料。
hintTraditional: 記者為了寫新聞,向別人提問並收集資料。
hintEnglish: What a journalist does when asking people questions to gather material for news.

gloss: to get natural light (e.g. through a window)
definition: to get natural light (e.g. through a window)
exampleSimplified: 这间房子窗户很大,采光非常好。
exampleTraditional: 這間房子窗戶很大,採光非常好。
exampleEnglish: This room has big windows, so the natural light is very good.
hintSimplified: 房间能让太阳光照进来的程度。
hintTraditional: 房間能讓太陽光照進來的程度。
hintEnglish: The degree to which a room lets sunlight in.

exampleSimplified: 老板采纳了我的建议。
exampleTraditional: 老闆採納了我的建議。
exampleEnglish: The boss accepted my suggestion.
hintSimplified: 听了别人的意见后,觉得很好并接受。
hintTraditional: 聽了別人的意見後,覺得很好並接受。
hintEnglish: After hearing someone's opinion, finding it good and taking it on.

gloss: to adopt or carry out (measures, policies, course of action)
definition: to adopt or carry out (measures, policies, course of action); to take
exampleSimplified: 政府采取了新的措施来解决问题。
exampleTraditional: 政府採取了新的措施來解決問題。
exampleEnglish: The government adopted new measures to solve the problem.
hintSimplified: 选择并使用某种办法或行动。
hintTraditional: 選擇並使用某種辦法或行動。
hintEnglish: To choose and use a certain method or action.

exampleSimplified: 墙上的彩绘让这条街变得很漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 牆上的彩繪讓這條街變得很漂亮。
exampleEnglish: The painted designs on the wall make this street very pretty.
hintSimplified: 用多种颜色画在墙或物品上的图案。
hintTraditional: 用多種顏色畫在牆或物品上的圖案。
hintEnglish: Patterns painted in many colors on walls or objects.

exampleSimplified: 这套餐具是妈妈从国外买回来的。
exampleTraditional: 這套餐具是媽媽從國外買回來的。
exampleEnglish: Mom bought this set of tableware from abroad.
hintSimplified: 吃饭时用的碗、盘、刀叉等东西的总称。
hintTraditional: 吃飯時用的碗、盤、刀叉等東西的總稱。
hintEnglish: The general name for bowls, plates, knives, forks and so on used when eating.

exampleSimplified: 他是将军身边最重要的参谋。
exampleTraditional: 他是將軍身邊最重要的參謀。
exampleEnglish: He is the most important adviser at the general's side.
hintSimplified: 帮领导出主意、做计划的人。
hintTraditional: 幫領匯出主意、做計劃的人。
hintEnglish: A person who gives ideas and makes plans for a leader.

exampleSimplified: 这个国王对人民非常残暴。
exampleTraditional: 這個國王對人民非常殘暴。
exampleEnglish: This king was extremely brutal to his people.
hintSimplified: 形容人的行为凶狠,一点也不同情别人。
hintTraditional: 形容人的行為兇狠,一點也不同情別人。
hintEnglish: Describes someone fierce in behavior, with no pity for others.

exampleSimplified: 现实有时候很残酷,但我们必须面对。
exampleTraditional: 現實有時候很殘酷,但我們必須面對。
exampleEnglish: Reality is sometimes harsh, but we must face it.
hintSimplified: 形容事情或对待方式很无情,让人难受。
hintTraditional: 形容事情或對待方式很無情,讓人難受。
hintEnglish: Describes things or treatment that are merciless and painful.

exampleSimplified: 这些动物被人类残杀,数量越来越少。
exampleTraditional: 這些動物被人類殘殺,數量越來越少。
exampleEnglish: These animals are being slaughtered by humans and their numbers keep falling.
hintSimplified: 用很狠的方法大量杀害生命。
hintTraditional: 用很狠的方法大量殺害生命。
hintEnglish: To kill lives in large numbers by cruel means.

exampleSimplified: 这场地震造成了惨重的损失。
exampleTraditional: 這場地震造成了慘重的損失。
exampleEnglish: This earthquake caused heavy losses.
hintSimplified: 形容损失或失败非常大,让人难过。
hintTraditional: 形容損失或失敗非常大,讓人難過。
hintEnglish: Describes a loss or defeat that is very great and sad.

exampleSimplified: 她脸上露出灿烂的笑容。
exampleTraditional: 她臉上露出燦爛的笑容。
exampleEnglish: A bright smile appeared on her face.
hintSimplified: 形容阳光、笑容或光彩非常明亮美丽。
hintTraditional: 形容陽光、笑容或光彩非常明亮美麗。
hintEnglish: Describes sunshine, a smile or colors that are very bright and beautiful.

exampleSimplified: 他生病了,脸色看起来很苍白。
exampleTraditional: 他生病了,臉色看起來很蒼白。
exampleEnglish: He is sick, and his face looks very pale.
hintSimplified: 形容人生病或害怕时,脸上没有血色的样子。
hintTraditional: 形容人生病或害怕時,臉上沒有血色的樣子。
hintEnglish: Describes a face with no color in it when someone is sick or scared.

exampleSimplified: 房间里有一只苍蝇,飞来飞去很烦人。
exampleTraditional: 房間裡有一隻蒼蠅,飛來飛去很煩人。
exampleEnglish: There is a fly in the room, buzzing around and being annoying.
hintSimplified: 一种小小的黑色昆虫,常在垃圾或食物旁边飞,很讨厌。
hintTraditional: 一種小小的黑色昆蟲,常在垃圾或食物旁邊飛,很討厭。
hintEnglish: A small black insect that flies around garbage or food and is annoying.

definition: to control; to manipulate; to operate; to rig
exampleSimplified: 他用遥控器操纵这架小飞机。
exampleTraditional: 他用遙控器操縱這架小飛機。
exampleEnglish: He uses a remote control to operate this little plane.
hintSimplified: 用手或工具控制机器、设备,或者在背后掌控别人或事情。
hintTraditional: 用手或工具控制機器、裝置,或者在背後掌控別人或事情。
hintEnglish: To handle a machine with your hands, or to secretly control people or events.

exampleSimplified: 这份草案下星期会交给大家讨论。
exampleTraditional: 這份草案下星期會交給大家討論。
exampleEnglish: This draft will be given to everyone for discussion next week.
hintSimplified: 法律或计划还没有正式决定之前,先写出来的初步版本。
hintTraditional: 法律或計劃還沒有正式決定之前,先寫出來的初步版本。
hintEnglish: A first version of a law or plan written before it is officially decided.

exampleSimplified: 一只小蛇从草丛里爬了出来。
exampleTraditional: 一隻小蛇從草叢裡爬了出來。
exampleEnglish: A small snake crawled out of the thick grass.
hintSimplified: 野外长在一起、又高又密的草,小动物常躲在里面。
hintTraditional: 野外長在一起、又高又密的草,小動物常躲在裡面。
hintEnglish: Tall, dense grass growing together outdoors where small animals hide.

exampleSimplified: 这么重要的事,不能草率决定。
exampleTraditional: 這麼重要的事,不能草率決定。
exampleEnglish: Such an important matter must not be decided carelessly.
hintSimplified: 形容做事不仔细、没有认真想就匆忙决定。
hintTraditional: 形容做事不仔細、沒有認真想就匆忙決定。
hintEnglish: Describes doing something hastily without thinking or care.

exampleSimplified: 奶奶喜欢喝用草药煮的汤。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶喜歡喝用草藥煮的湯。
exampleEnglish: Grandma likes to drink soup cooked with medicinal herbs.
hintSimplified: 用植物做成的传统药材,常常煮来喝。
hintTraditional: 用植物做成的傳統藥材,常常煮來喝。
hintEnglish: Traditional medicine made from plants, often boiled and drunk.

gloss: variant of 策劃|策划[ce4 hua4]
definition: variant of 策劃|策划[ce4 hua4]
exampleSimplified: 他正在策画一场生日惊喜派对。
exampleTraditional: 他正在策畫一場生日驚喜派對。
exampleEnglish: He is planning a surprise birthday party.
hintSimplified: 事情开始前先想好方法和步骤,安排一个活动或计划。
hintTraditional: 事情開始前先想好方法和步驟,安排一個活動或計劃。
hintEnglish: To think out methods and steps in advance to arrange an event or plan.

definition: planner; planning; producer; to bring about; to engineer; to plot; to scheme
exampleSimplified: 这次演唱会是由她负责策划的。
exampleTraditional: 這次演唱會是由她負責策劃的。
exampleEnglish: She was in charge of planning this concert.
hintSimplified: 为活动或计划想办法、安排细节,是幕后的重要工作。
hintTraditional: 為活動或計劃想辦法、安排細節,是幕後的重要工作。
hintEnglish: Working behind the scenes to come up with ideas and arrange the details of an event.

definition: balance (financial); difference; discrepancy (in a sum or quota)
exampleSimplified: 这两个月的收入有一大笔差额。
exampleTraditional: 這兩個月的收入有一大筆差額。
exampleEnglish: There is a big difference in income between these two months.
hintSimplified: 两个数字相比之后,多出来或少掉的钱数。
hintTraditional: 兩個數字相比之後,多出來或少掉的錢數。
hintEnglish: The amount of money by which two figures differ.

definition: (fig.) incident; episode; incidental music; music played during a movie, play etc; music played in a theatrical interlude
exampleSimplified: 迷路只是这次旅行中的一个小插曲。
exampleTraditional: 迷路只是這次旅行中的一個小插曲。
exampleEnglish: Getting lost was just a small episode during this trip.
hintSimplified: 在主要事情进行中,突然出现的小小事件。
hintTraditional: 在主要事情進行中,突然出現的小小事件。
hintEnglish: A small event that happens unexpectedly in the middle of something bigger.

definition: to butt in; to cut into a conversation; to interrupt (sb talking)

hintTraditional: 跟之前比,數字沒有增加也沒有減少。
hintEnglish: Compared with before, the numbers have neither risen nor fallen.

definition: (old) stalls (front rows in a theater); bathhouse pool; dance floor of a ballroom; pond
exampleSimplified: 孩子们在公园的池子里玩水。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們在公園的池子裡玩水。
exampleEnglish: The children play in the water in the park's pond.
hintSimplified: 一个不太大、可以装水的地方,有时可以洗澡或养鱼。
hintTraditional: 一個不太大、可以裝水的地方,有時可以洗澡或養魚。
hintEnglish: A not-so-large place that holds water, sometimes used for bathing or keeping fish.

definition: slow in one's reactions; sluggish (in movement or thought)
exampleSimplified: 他反应有点迟钝,常常听不懂笑话。
exampleTraditional: 他反應有點遲鈍,常常聽不懂笑話。
exampleEnglish: He is a bit slow to react and often doesn't get jokes.
hintSimplified: 形容人的头脑或感觉不够灵敏,反应很慢。
hintTraditional: 形容人的頭腦或感覺不夠靈敏,反應很慢。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose mind or senses are not sharp and who reacts slowly.

definition: to be full of; to congest; to flood
exampleSimplified: 网络上充斥着各种假消息。
exampleTraditional: 網路上充斥著各種假訊息。
exampleEnglish: The internet is flooded with all kinds of fake news.
hintSimplified: 某种不好的东西到处都是,多得让人不舒服。
hintTraditional: 某種不好的東西到處都是,多得讓人不舒服。
hintEnglish: Some unwelcome thing is everywhere, so much that it is unpleasant.

exampleSimplified: 我们的时间很充裕,不用赶。
exampleTraditional: 我們的時間很充裕,不用趕。
exampleEnglish: We have plenty of time, so there's no need to rush.
hintSimplified: 形容钱、时间或东西很多,完全够用。
hintTraditional: 形容錢、時間或東西很多,完全夠用。
hintEnglish: Describes money, time or things being plentiful and more than enough.

exampleSimplified: 时间慢慢冲淡了他心中的悲伤。
exampleTraditional: 時間慢慢沖淡了他心中的悲傷。
exampleEnglish: Time slowly diluted the sadness in his heart.
hintSimplified: 让浓的味道、气氛或感情变得比较轻、比较弱。
hintTraditional: 讓濃的味道、氣氛或感情變得比較輕、比較弱。
hintEnglish: To make a strong flavor, atmosphere or emotion become lighter and weaker.

gloss: (lit. and fig.) to soar; to shoot upwards
definition: (lit. and fig.) to soar; to shoot upwards
exampleSimplified: 烟火冲天而起,夜空变得很亮。
exampleTraditional: 煙火沖天而起,夜空變得很亮。
exampleEnglish: The fireworks shot into the sky, making the night sky bright.
hintSimplified: 形容火焰、气势等猛烈地向天空上升。
hintTraditional: 形容火焰、氣勢等猛烈地向天空上升。
hintEnglish: Describes flames or spirit surging fiercely up toward the sky.

definition: impulse; to be impetuous; to have an urge; urge
exampleSimplified: 他一时冲动,买了很贵的东西。
exampleTraditional: 他一時衝動,買了很貴的東西。
exampleEnglish: On a sudden impulse, he bought something very expensive.
hintSimplified: 没有仔细想,心里突然有一股力量让人马上去做。
hintTraditional: 沒有仔細想,心裡突然有一股力量讓人馬上去做。
hintEnglish: Without thinking carefully, a sudden urge makes a person act immediately.

definition: (of waves) to pound against; impact; shock; to attack; to batter; variant of 衝擊|冲击[chong1 ji1]
exampleSimplified: 网络对传统商店造成了很大的冲击。
exampleTraditional: 網路對傳統商店造成了很大的衝擊。
exampleEnglish: The internet has had a big impact on traditional stores.
hintSimplified: 某件新事物对原来的情况带来强烈的影响或打击。
hintTraditional: 某件新事物對原來的情況帶來強烈的影響或打擊。
hintEnglish: When something new brings a strong effect or blow to the existing situation.

gloss: to long for; to look forward to
definition: to long for; to look forward to
exampleSimplified: 她憧憬着未来的幸福生活。
exampleTraditional: 她憧憬著未來的幸福生活。
exampleEnglish: She longs for a happy life in the future.
hintSimplified: 对美好的未来充满向往和期待。
hintTraditional: 對美好的未來充滿嚮往和期待。
hintEnglish: Being full of yearning and expectation for a beautiful future.

definition: an overlap; one over another; redundancy; reduplication (in Chinese grammar, e.g. 散散步[san4 san4 bu4] to have a stroll); superposition; to duplicate; to overlap; to run together; to superimpose; to telescope
exampleSimplified: 这两个活动的时间重叠了。
exampleTraditional: 這兩個活動的時間重疊了。
exampleEnglish: The times of these two events overlap.
hintSimplified: 两样东西或两段时间有一部分放在同一个位置上。
hintTraditional: 兩樣東西或兩段時間有一部分放在同一個位置上。
hintEnglish: Two things or two periods of time partly occupy the same place.

definition: to advocate; to hold in esteem; to hold up (as an model); to revere
exampleSimplified: 这个社会崇尚自由和平等。
exampleTraditional: 這個社會崇尚自由和平等。
exampleEnglish: This society values freedom and equality.
hintSimplified: 非常推崇某种想法或风气,认为它很好。
hintTraditional: 非常推崇某種想法或風氣,認為它很好。
hintEnglish: To hold a certain idea or custom in high esteem and think it is excellent.

exampleSimplified: 奶奶特别宠爱最小的孙子。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶特別寵愛最小的孫子。
exampleEnglish: Grandma especially dotes on her youngest grandson.
hintSimplified: 对某个人特别疼爱,常常什么都答应他。
hintTraditional: 對某個人特別疼愛,常常什麼都答應他。
hintEnglish: To love someone especially much, often granting them whatever they want.

exampleSimplified: 她养了一只可爱的宠物狗。
exampleTraditional: 她養了一隻可愛的寵物狗。
exampleEnglish: She keeps a cute pet dog.
hintSimplified: 人们养在家里陪伴自己的小动物,像猫或狗。
hintTraditional: 人們養在家裡陪伴自己的小動物,像貓或狗。
hintEnglish: A small animal people keep at home as company, like a cat or dog.

definition: random inspection; to do a spot check
exampleSimplified: 卫生局会不定时到餐厅抽查。
exampleTraditional: 衛生局會不定時到餐廳抽查。
exampleEnglish: The health bureau irregularly makes spot checks at restaurants.
hintSimplified: 不是全部都看,只随机挑一部分来检查。
hintTraditional: 不是全部都看,只隨機挑一部分來檢查。
hintEnglish: Not examining everything, only picking a portion at random to inspect.

gloss: to find the time to do sth
definition: to find the time to do sth
exampleSimplified: 你有空的时候,请抽空来看看我。
exampleTraditional: 你有空的時候,請抽空來看看我。
exampleEnglish: When you're free, please find time to come see me.
hintSimplified: 虽然很忙,还是特别安排出一点时间去做某件事。
hintTraditional: 雖然很忙,還是特別安排出一點時間去做某件事。
hintEnglish: Although very busy, you still set aside a bit of time to do something.

exampleSimplified: 这个概念太抽象了,我听不懂。
exampleTraditional: 這個概念太抽象了,我聽不懂。
exampleEnglish: This concept is too abstract; I can't understand it.
hintSimplified: 和具体相反,看不见也摸不到,只存在于思想中。
hintTraditional: 和具體相反,看不見也摸不到,只存在於思想中。
hintEnglish: The opposite of concrete; can't be seen or touched, existing only in thought.

exampleSimplified: 公司用随机的方法进行抽样调查。
exampleTraditional: 公司用隨機的方法進行抽樣調查。
exampleEnglish: The company conducted a survey using random sampling.
hintSimplified: 从很多对象中选出一小部分来做检查或调查。
hintTraditional: 從很多物件中選出一小部分來做檢查或調查。
hintEnglish: Selecting a small part from many items to inspect or survey.

exampleSimplified: 战争让两个家族之间充满了仇恨。
exampleTraditional: 戰爭讓兩個家族之間充滿了仇恨。
exampleEnglish: The war filled the two families with hatred toward each other.
hintSimplified: 对伤害过自己的人长期怀有的强烈恨意。
hintTraditional: 對傷害過自己的人長期懷有的強烈恨意。
hintEnglish: A strong, lasting ill feeling toward someone who harmed you.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市的人口非常稠密。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市的人口非常稠密。
exampleEnglish: This city's population is very dense.
hintSimplified: 形容人、树木或东西聚在一起,数量很多、很挤。
hintTraditional: 形容人、樹木或東西聚在一起,數量很多、很擠。
hintEnglish: Describes people, trees or things packed closely together in large numbers.

definition: favorable balance of trade; trade surplus
exampleSimplified: 今年我国的对外贸易出现了出超。
exampleTraditional: 今年我國的對外貿易出現了出超。
exampleEnglish: This year our country's foreign trade showed a surplus.
hintSimplified: 一个国家卖到外国的东西比买进来的东西价值更高。
hintTraditional: 一個國家賣到外國的東西比買進來的東西價值更高。
hintEnglish: When a country sells more value abroad than it buys from abroad.

exampleSimplified: 电脑突然出错,我的文件不见了。
exampleTraditional: 電腦突然出錯,我的檔案不見了。
exampleEnglish: The computer suddenly malfunctioned and my file disappeared.
hintSimplified: 事情进行时发生了问题,结果不对。
hintTraditional: 事情進行時發生了問題,結果不對。
hintEnglish: A problem happens while doing something, so the result is wrong.

gloss: (fig.) to be weeded out; to get the chop (in a competitive environment)
definition: (fig.) to be weeded out; to get the chop (in a competitive environment); (of a batter) to be put out (in baseball); to be dismissed (in cricket); (of a player or team) to be eliminated from a competition
exampleSimplified: 他在第一轮比赛就被淘汰出局了。
exampleTraditional: 他在第一輪比賽就被淘汰出局了。
exampleEnglish: He was knocked out in the very first round of the competition.
hintSimplified: 在比赛或竞争中输了,不能再继续参加。
hintTraditional: 在比賽或競爭中輸了,不能再繼續參加。
hintEnglish: Losing in a contest and no longer being able to continue.

exampleSimplified: 搬家的时候,大家都出力帮忙。
exampleTraditional: 搬家的時候,大家都出力幫忙。
exampleEnglish: When we moved, everyone pitched in and helped.
hintSimplified: 用自己的体力或努力去帮助做事。
hintTraditional: 用自己的體力或努力去幫助做事。
hintEnglish: Using your own strength or effort to help get something done.

definition: a way out (lit. and fig.); opportunity for advancement; a way forward; outlet (for one's products)
exampleSimplified: 学好外语,你的出路会更宽广。
exampleTraditional: 學好外語,你的出路會更寬廣。
exampleEnglish: If you learn foreign languages well, your prospects will be broader.
hintSimplified: 遇到困难时能走的方向,或毕业后未来发展的方向。
hintTraditional: 遇到困難時能走的方向,或畢業後未來發展的方向。
hintEnglish: The direction you can take when in trouble, or for your future after graduation.

definition: to set out (on a campaign); to stand for election; to throw one's cap in the ring
exampleSimplified: 这件事太难了,还是请经理亲自出马吧。
exampleTraditional: 這件事太難了,還是請經理親自出馬吧。
exampleEnglish: This matter is too hard; let's ask the manager to step in personally.
hintSimplified: 重要的人亲自去处理困难的事情。
hintTraditional: 重要的人親自去處理困難的事情。
hintEnglish: An important person personally goes to deal with a difficult matter.

gloss: to offer for sale; to sell
definition: to offer for sale; to sell; to sell out; to betray
exampleSimplified: 他为了钱,出卖了自己的好朋友。
exampleTraditional: 他為了錢,出賣了自己的好朋友。
exampleEnglish: For money, he betrayed his good friend.
hintSimplified: 为了自己的好处而背叛别人,或把东西卖掉。
hintTraditional: 為了自己的好處而背叛別人,或把東西賣掉。
hintEnglish: Betraying someone for your own gain, or selling something off.

definition: to appear personally; to show up; to step forth; to step in
exampleSimplified: 两家吵架了,最后请老师出面解决。
exampleTraditional: 兩家吵架了,最後請老師出面解決。
exampleEnglish: The two families quarreled, and in the end the teacher stepped in to resolve it.
hintSimplified: 亲自站出来,代表某人去处理问题。
hintTraditional: 親自站出來,代表某人去處理問題。
hintEnglish: To step forward in person to handle a problem on someone's behalf.

definition: to become well known; to lend one's name (to an event, endeavor etc); to make one's mark; well-known for sth
exampleSimplified: 这位歌手一夜之间就出名了。
exampleTraditional: 這位歌手一夜之間就出名了。
exampleEnglish: This singer became famous overnight.
hintSimplified: 很多人都认识你,知道你的名字。
hintTraditional: 很多人都認識你,知道你的名字。
hintEnglish: Many people know you and recognize your name.

definition: items that are produced; output; to produce an item
exampleSimplified: 这部电影是由一家台湾公司出品的。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影是由一家台灣公司出品的。
exampleEnglish: This movie was produced by a Taiwanese company.
hintSimplified: 工厂或公司制造并推出的产品,常见于电影或商品上。
hintTraditional: 工廠或公司製造並推出的產品,常見於電影或商品上。
hintEnglish: What a factory or company makes and releases, often seen on films or goods.

definition: to display; to show; to take out and show to others
exampleSimplified: 进门时请出示你的身份证。
exampleTraditional: 進門時請出示你的身份證。
exampleEnglish: Please show your ID card when entering.
hintSimplified: 把证件或证据拿出来给别人看。
hintTraditional: 把證件或證據拿出來給別人看。
hintEnglish: Take out a document or evidence and let others see it.

definition: to dispose of; to spend (money); to undertake a task
exampleSimplified: 他一出手就赢得了比赛。
exampleTraditional: 他一出手就贏得了比賽。
exampleEnglish: The moment he made his move, he won the match.
hintSimplified: 开始行动、动手做事,或把东西卖掉、送出去。
hintTraditional: 開始行動、動手做事,或把東西賣掉、送出去。
hintEnglish: To start acting or make a move, or to sell something off.

definition: a little more than; remaining odd fraction after a division; to get out of a predicament; to stick out; to take the initiative
exampleSimplified: 他今年三十出头,已经当上经理了。
exampleTraditional: 他今年三十出頭,已經當上經理了。
exampleEnglish: He's just over thirty this year and has already become a manager.
hintSimplified: 放在整数的年龄后面,表示比这个数字稍微多一点。
hintTraditional: 放在整數的年齡後面,表示比這個數字稍微多一點。
hintEnglish: Placed after a round age number to mean slightly more than it.

definition: to appear in an excavation; to come up out of the ground; to dig up; unearthed
exampleSimplified: 考古学家在这里发现了很多出土文物。
exampleTraditional: 考古學家在這裡發現了很多出土文物。
exampleEnglish: Archaeologists found many unearthed artifacts here.
hintSimplified: 古代的东西从地下被挖出来。
hintTraditional: 古代的東西從地下被挖出來。
hintEnglish: Ancient objects being dug up from underground.

definition: future prospects; profit; to exhale (Buddhism); to grow up; to mature; to yield interest, profit etc
exampleSimplified: 他努力读书,希望将来有出息。
exampleTraditional: 他努力讀書,希望將來有出息。
exampleEnglish: He studies hard, hoping to amount to something in the future.
hintSimplified: 父母希望孩子长大后有成就、有好的发展。
hintTraditional: 父母希望孩子長大後有成就、有好的發展。
hintEnglish: What parents hope for a child: to achieve success and a bright future.

gloss: (fig.) to spend money in large amounts
definition: (fig.) to spend money in large amounts; to bleed; bleeding
exampleSimplified: 他的手受伤了,一直在出血。
exampleTraditional: 他的手受傷了,一直在出血。
exampleEnglish: His hand is hurt and keeps bleeding.
hintSimplified: 身体受伤后,红色的液体从伤口流出来。
hintTraditional: 身體受傷後,紅色的液體從傷口流出來。
hintEnglish: After an injury, red liquid flows out of the wound.

exampleSimplified: 这种病在初期很难被发现。
exampleTraditional: 這種病在初期很難被發現。
exampleEnglish: This disease is hard to detect in its early stage.
hintSimplified: 一件事情刚开始的那一段时间。
hintTraditional: 一件事情剛開始的那一段時間。
hintEnglish: The stretch of time when something has just begun.

exampleSimplified: 政府在冬天来临前储备了大量的粮食。
exampleTraditional: 政府在冬天來臨前儲備了大量的糧食。
exampleEnglish: The government stockpiled a large amount of grain before winter.
hintSimplified: 为了以后可能需要,先把东西或钱存起来。
hintTraditional: 為了以後可能需要,先把東西或錢存起來。
hintEnglish: Storing up goods or money in advance in case they're needed later.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷拿着锄头在田里工作。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺拿著鋤頭在田裡工作。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa is working in the field with a hoe.
hintSimplified: 农夫用来松土、除草的工具,有长木柄。
hintTraditional: 農夫用來鬆土、除草的工具,有長木柄。
hintEnglish: A farming tool with a long handle, used to loosen soil and remove weeds.

definition: (fig.) recommendation; advice; medical prescription; to write out a prescription
exampleSimplified: 医生开了处方,请你去药房拿药。
exampleTraditional: 醫生開了處方,請你去藥房拿藥。
exampleEnglish: The doctor wrote a prescription; please go to the pharmacy to get the medicine.
hintSimplified: 医生写在纸上,告诉病人该吃什么药的单子。
hintTraditional: 醫生寫在紙上,告訴病人該吃什麼藥的單子。
hintEnglish: A paper from the doctor telling the patient which medicine to take.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; disciplinary action; to deal with (a matter); to discipline sb; to punish
exampleSimplified: 他因为作弊,受到了学校的处分。
exampleTraditional: 他因為作弊,受到了學校的處分。
exampleEnglish: He received a disciplinary penalty from the school for cheating.
hintSimplified: 学校或公司对犯错的人做出的惩罚决定。
hintTraditional: 學校或公司對犯錯的人做出的懲罰決定。
hintEnglish: A punishment decided by a school or company against someone who did wrong.

exampleSimplified: 他现在的处境很困难,需要大家的帮助。
exampleTraditional: 他現在的處境很困難,需要大家的幫助。
exampleEnglish: His situation is very difficult now, and he needs everyone's help.
hintSimplified: 指一个人目前所面对的情况和环境,常常是好或不好的状态。
hintTraditional: 指一個人目前所面對的情況和環境,常常是好或不好的狀態。
hintEnglish: Refers to the circumstances a person is currently facing, whether good or bad.

gloss: to handle affairs; to deal with matters
definition: to handle affairs; to deal with matters
exampleSimplified: 他处事很谨慎,从不随便做决定。
exampleTraditional: 他處事很謹慎,從不隨便做決定。
exampleEnglish: He is very careful in how he handles things and never makes decisions casually.
hintSimplified: 一个人面对各种事情时,处理和应对的方式与态度。
hintTraditional: 一個人面對各種事情時,處理和應對的方式與態度。
hintEnglish: The way and attitude with which a person deals with various matters.

gloss: to be in (some state, position, or condition)
definition: to be in (some state, position, or condition)
exampleSimplified: 这家公司目前处于发展的关键时期。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司目前處於發展的關鍵時期。
exampleEnglish: This company is currently at a critical stage of development.
hintSimplified: 表示某人或某事物正好在某种状态、位置或阶段中。
hintTraditional: 表示某人或某事物正好在某種狀態、位置或階段中。
hintEnglish: Indicates that someone or something is in a certain state, position or stage.

definition: maiden (voyage etc); virgin (land); (a novelist's) first (work); virgin; maiden
exampleSimplified: 这是那位作家的处女作,卖得非常好。
exampleTraditional: 這是那位作家的處女作,賣得非常好。
exampleEnglish: This is that writer's first work, and it sold very well.
hintSimplified: 在“作”、“航”这些词前面,表示第一次做的事。
hintTraditional: 在“作”、“航”這些詞前面,表示第一次做的事。
hintEnglish: Placed before words like "work" or "voyage" to mean the very first time something is done.

exampleSimplified: 下班时间,捷运里到处都是穿梭的人群。
exampleTraditional: 下班時間,捷運裡到處都是穿梭的人群。
exampleEnglish: At rush hour, the MRT is full of crowds moving back and forth.
hintSimplified: 像织布的工具一样,在两个地方之间来来去去、很快地移动。
hintTraditional: 像織布的工具一樣,在兩個地方之間來來去去、很快地移動。
hintEnglish: Like a weaver's tool, moving quickly back and forth between places.

definition: (math.) transitive; to transmit; to pass on to sb else
exampleSimplified: 请把这份文件传递给下一位同学。
exampleTraditional: 請把這份檔案傳遞給下一位同學。
exampleEnglish: Please pass this document on to the next classmate.
hintSimplified: 把东西或消息一个接一个地送到下一个人手上。
hintTraditional: 把東西或訊息一個接一個地送到下一個人手上。
hintEnglish: To hand an item or message along, one person after another.

definition: fantasy saga; legendary; romance; short stories of the Tang and Song Dynasty
exampleSimplified: 这位老先生的一生充满了传奇色彩。
exampleTraditional: 這位老先生的一生充滿了傳奇色彩。
exampleEnglish: This old gentleman's life was full of legendary color.
hintSimplified: 指很不平常、很神奇、让人津津乐道的故事或人物。
hintTraditional: 指很不平常、很神奇、讓人津津樂道的故事或人物。
hintEnglish: Refers to an extraordinary, marvelous story or person that people love to talk about.

exampleSimplified: 这幅画把老人的表情画得非常传神。
exampleTraditional: 這幅畫把老人的表情畫得非常傳神。
exampleEnglish: This painting depicts the old man's expression very vividly.
hintSimplified: 形容画像或表演把人物的精神和样子表现得非常生动。
hintTraditional: 形容畫像或表演把人物的精神和樣子表現得非常生動。
hintEnglish: Describes a portrait or performance that captures a person's spirit very vividly.

gloss: to impart; to pass on; to teach
definition: to impart; to pass on; to teach
exampleSimplified: 师傅把多年的经验传授给了年轻人。
exampleTraditional: 師傅把多年的經驗傳授給了年輕人。
exampleEnglish: The master passed on his years of experience to the young people.
hintSimplified: 老师或前辈把知识和技术教给下一代。
hintTraditional: 老師或前輩把知識和技術教給下一代。
hintEnglish: A teacher or elder hands down knowledge and skills to the next generation.

exampleSimplified: 港口里停着许多来往的船只。
exampleTraditional: 港口裡停著許多來往的船隻。
exampleEnglish: Many ships coming and going are docked in the harbor.
hintSimplified: 在海上或河上行驶的交通工具的总称。
hintTraditional: 在海上或河上行駛的交通工具的總稱。
hintEnglish: A general term for vehicles that travel on the sea or rivers.

exampleSimplified: 那次意外给他留下了心理上的创伤。
exampleTraditional: 那次意外給他留下了心理上的創傷。
exampleEnglish: That accident left him with a psychological trauma.
hintSimplified: 身体受到伤害,或心里受到很大打击后留下的痛苦。
hintTraditional: 身體受到傷害,或心裡受到很大打擊後留下的痛苦。
hintEnglish: The harm left after the body is hurt or the heart is badly shaken.

exampleSimplified: 这所大学是一百年前由一位商人创办的。
exampleTraditional: 這所大學是一百年前由一位商人創辦的。
exampleEnglish: This university was founded a hundred years ago by a businessman.
hintSimplified: 第一次建立一所学校、一家公司或一个组织。
hintTraditional: 第一次建立一所學校、一家公司或一個組織。
hintEnglish: To set up a school, company or organization for the first time.

gloss: to establish; to set up; to found
definition: to establish; to set up; to found
exampleSimplified: 他在二十年前创立了这个基金会。
exampleTraditional: 他在二十年前創立了這個基金會。
exampleEnglish: He established this foundation twenty years ago.
hintSimplified: 首次建立起一个国家、团体或学派,比较正式。
hintTraditional: 首次建立起一個國家、團體或學派,比較正式。
hintEnglish: To formally set up for the first time a group, school of thought or institution.

definition: entrepreneurship; to begin an undertaking; to start an enterprise
exampleSimplified: 毕业后,他决定自己创业开一家咖啡店。
exampleTraditional: 畢業後,他決定自己創業開一家咖啡店。
exampleEnglish: After graduating, he decided to start his own business and open a coffee shop.
hintSimplified: 自己出来开创新的事业,不是替别人工作。
hintTraditional: 自己出來開創新的事業,不是替別人工作。
hintEnglish: To start a new enterprise of your own rather than work for someone else.

definition: (dialect) to chat idly; to talk big; to brag; to shoot off one's mouth
exampleSimplified: 他很爱吹牛,说自己认识很多名人。
exampleTraditional: 他很愛吹牛,說自己認識很多名人。
exampleEnglish: He loves to brag, claiming to know many celebrities.
hintSimplified: 说大话,把事情讲得比实际上更厉害。
hintTraditional: 說大話,把事情講得比實際上更厲害。
hintEnglish: To talk big, making things sound more impressive than they really are.

exampleSimplified: 这两条线互相垂直,形成一个直角。
exampleTraditional: 這兩條線互相垂直,形成一個直角。
exampleEnglish: These two lines are perpendicular to each other and form a right angle.
hintSimplified: 和地面成九十度,像旗杆站在地上的方向。
hintTraditional: 和地面成九十度,像旗杆站在地上的方向。
hintEnglish: At ninety degrees to the ground, like a flagpole standing upright.

exampleSimplified: 明天就要出国了,他今天去向老师辞行。
exampleTraditional: 明天就要出國了,他今天去向老師辭行。
exampleEnglish: He's going abroad tomorrow, so today he went to say goodbye to his teacher.
hintSimplified: 远行之前,去向亲友或长辈正式告别。
hintTraditional: 遠行之前,去向親友或長輩正式告別。
hintEnglish: Before a long journey, formally taking leave of relatives, friends or elders.

exampleSimplified: 她经常参加慈善活动,帮助贫困的家庭。
exampleTraditional: 她經常參加慈善活動,幫助貧困的家庭。
exampleEnglish: She often takes part in charity events to help poor families.
hintSimplified: 形容有爱心,愿意无偿帮助穷人和需要帮助的人。
hintTraditional: 形容有愛心,願意無償幫助窮人和需要幫助的人。
hintEnglish: Describes a kind heart that willingly helps the poor and needy without payment.

exampleSimplified: 此刻,我心里充满了感谢。
exampleTraditional: 此刻,我心裡充滿了感謝。
exampleEnglish: At this moment, my heart is full of gratitude.
hintSimplified: 指说话的这一个时间点,就是现在。
hintTraditional: 指說話的這一個時間點,就是現在。
hintEnglish: Refers to this very point in time as one speaks; right now.

exampleSimplified: 这个问题比较次要,我们可以以后再讨论。
exampleTraditional: 這個問題比較次要,我們可以以後再討論。
exampleEnglish: This issue is relatively minor, so we can discuss it later.
hintSimplified: 形容事情的重要性排在后面,不是最主要的。
hintTraditional: 形容事情的重要性排在後面,不是最主要的。
hintEnglish: Describes something whose importance ranks lower, not the main thing.

exampleSimplified: 她每天辛苦地伺候生病的婆婆。
exampleTraditional: 她每天辛苦地伺候生病的婆婆。
exampleEnglish: Every day she works hard to take care of her sick mother-in-law.
hintSimplified: 在旁边照顾别人的生活,为对方做各种事情。
hintTraditional: 在旁邊照顧別人的生活,為對方做各種事情。
hintEnglish: To stay at someone's side and attend to their needs, doing things for them.

definition: (baseball) to put out (a baserunner); (military) to fight with a bayonet; to assassinate
exampleSimplified: 历史上有一位国王被人刺杀了。
exampleTraditional: 歷史上有一位國王被人刺殺了。
exampleEnglish: In history, a king was assassinated.
hintSimplified: 用刀等尖锐的东西秘密攻击重要的人,使他死亡。
hintTraditional: 用刀等尖銳的東西秘密攻擊重要的人,使他死亡。
hintEnglish: To secretly attack an important person with a blade or sharp weapon, causing death.

exampleSimplified: 他走得很匆忙,连伞都忘了带。
exampleTraditional: 他走得很匆忙,連傘都忘了帶。
exampleEnglish: He left in such a hurry that he even forgot to bring his umbrella.
hintSimplified: 形容时间很紧,动作很快,没有时间慢慢来。
hintTraditional: 形容時間很緊,動作很快,沒有時間慢慢來。
hintEnglish: Describes being short on time and moving fast, with no chance to take it slowly.

definition: Taiwan pr. [cong1 rong2]; calm; to go easy; unhurried
exampleSimplified: 面对记者的提问,她回答得很从容。
exampleTraditional: 面對記者的提問,她回答得很從容。
exampleEnglish: Facing the reporters' questions, she answered calmly and unhurriedly.
hintSimplified: 形容态度镇定,不紧张,也不着急。
hintTraditional: 形容態度鎮定,不緊張,也不著急。
hintEnglish: Describes a composed manner, neither nervous nor rushed.

exampleSimplified: 他每天认真练习,从而提高了自己的口语能力。
exampleTraditional: 他每天認真練習,從而提高了自己的口語能力。
exampleEnglish: He practiced seriously every day and thereby improved his spoken ability.
hintSimplified: 连接词,用在前一件事之后,引出由此得到的结果。
hintTraditional: 連線詞,用在前一件事之後,引出由此得到的結果。
hintEnglish: A conjunction placed after a first action to introduce the result obtained from it.

definition: as chance has it; fortuitously; luckily
exampleSimplified: 我正想找你,你就凑巧来了。
exampleTraditional: 我正想找你,你就湊巧來了。
exampleEnglish: I was just about to look for you, and you happened to show up.
hintSimplified: 形容事情发生的时间或情况刚好合适,没有事先安排。
hintTraditional: 形容事情發生的時間或情況剛好合適,沒有事先安排。
hintEnglish: Describes something happening at just the right moment, without being planned.

exampleSimplified: 这张桌子的表面很粗糙,摸起来不舒服。
exampleTraditional: 這張桌子的表面很粗糙,摸起來不舒服。
exampleEnglish: The surface of this table is very rough and uncomfortable to touch.
hintSimplified: 形容东西表面不平滑,或者做工不细致。
hintTraditional: 形容東西表面不平滑,或者做工不細緻。
hintEnglish: Describes a surface that is not smooth, or work that is not carefully done.

exampleSimplified: 他说话很粗鲁,大家都不喜欢他。
exampleTraditional: 他說話很粗魯,大家都不喜歡他。
exampleEnglish: He speaks very rudely, and nobody likes him.
hintSimplified: 形容人的言语或行为没有礼貌,很不文雅。
hintTraditional: 形容人的言語或行為沒有禮貌,很不文雅。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose speech or behavior is impolite and not refined.

gloss: to facilitate; to help bring about
definition: to facilitate; to help bring about
exampleSimplified: 这次会议促成了两家公司的合作。
exampleTraditional: 這次會議促成了兩家公司的合作。
exampleEnglish: This meeting helped bring about cooperation between the two companies.
hintSimplified: 通过努力或推动,让一件好事得以实现。
hintTraditional: 透過努力或推動,讓一件好事得以實現。
hintEnglish: To push through effort so that a good thing comes to be realized.

gloss: to prompt; to induce; to spur
definition: to prompt; to induce; to spur
exampleSimplified: 价格上涨促使人们少买东西。
exampleTraditional: 價格上漲促使人們少買東西。
exampleEnglish: Rising prices push people to buy less.
hintSimplified: 某种原因推动人去做某件事,常用在“原因+人+行动”的句子里。
hintTraditional: 某種原因推動人去做某件事,常用在“原因+人+行動”的句子裡。
hintEnglish: A cause that drives someone to do something; used in 'cause + person + action' sentences.

exampleSimplified: 这家商店周年庆有很多促销活动。
exampleTraditional: 這家商店週年慶有很多促銷活動。
exampleEnglish: This store has many promotional events for its anniversary.
hintSimplified: 商店用打折或送礼物等方式,让顾客多买东西。
hintTraditional: 商店用打折或送禮物等方式,讓顧客多買東西。
hintEnglish: Stores use discounts or gifts to get customers to buy more.

exampleSimplified: 歌手被粉丝簇拥着走进了大楼。
exampleTraditional: 歌手被粉絲簇擁著走進了大樓。
exampleEnglish: The singer walked into the building surrounded by a crowd of fans.
hintSimplified: 很多人紧紧围在一个重要的人旁边,一起往前走。
hintTraditional: 很多人緊緊圍在一個重要的人旁邊,一起往前走。
hintEnglish: Many people gather closely around an important person as they move along.

exampleSimplified: 长期熬夜会摧残你的身体。
exampleTraditional: 長期熬夜會摧殘你的身體。
exampleEnglish: Staying up late for a long time will ruin your body.
hintSimplified: 让身体或心灵受到严重的伤害和破坏。
hintTraditional: 讓身體或心靈受到嚴重的傷害和破壞。
hintEnglish: To cause serious harm and damage to the body or spirit.

exampleSimplified: 台风摧毁了海边的许多房子。
exampleTraditional: 颱風摧毀了海邊的許多房子。
exampleEnglish: The typhoon destroyed many houses by the sea.
hintSimplified: 用很大的力量把东西完全破坏掉。
hintTraditional: 用很大的力量把東西完全破壞掉。
hintEnglish: To completely break something down with great force.

definition: to hypnotize; to lull to sleep
exampleSimplified: 医生用催眠的方法帮他放松。
exampleTraditional: 醫生用催眠的方法幫他放鬆。
exampleEnglish: The doctor used hypnosis to help him relax.
hintSimplified: 用特别的方法或声音,让人进入像睡着的状态。
hintTraditional: 用特別的方法或聲音,讓人進入像睡著的狀態。
hintEnglish: Using special methods or sounds to put someone into a sleep-like state.

exampleSimplified: 失败以后,他的心变得很脆弱。
exampleTraditional: 失敗以後,他的心變得很脆弱。
exampleEnglish: After failing, his heart became very fragile.
hintSimplified: 形容人或东西不坚强,容易受到伤害或破裂。
hintTraditional: 形容人或東西不堅強,容易受到傷害或破裂。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or thing that is not strong and is easily hurt or broken.

exampleSimplified: 仓库里还有很多存货,可以马上出货。
exampleTraditional: 倉庫裡還有很多存貨,可以馬上出貨。
exampleEnglish: There is still a lot of stock in the warehouse, so we can ship right away.
hintSimplified: 商店或工厂仓库里还没有卖出去的商品。
hintTraditional: 商店或工廠倉庫裡還沒有賣出去的商品。
hintEnglish: Goods in a shop or factory warehouse that have not yet been sold.

definition: consultations; negotiations; to confer; to consult; to discuss seriously; to negotiate
exampleSimplified: 双方经过多次磋商,终于达成了协议。
exampleTraditional: 雙方經過多次磋商,終於達成了協議。
exampleEnglish: After many rounds of negotiation, the two sides finally reached an agreement.
hintSimplified: 双方为了解决问题,认真地互相讨论和商量。
hintTraditional: 雙方為了解決問題,認真地互相討論和商量。
hintEnglish: Two sides seriously discuss and confer to solve a problem.

definition: to act as a middleman; to play matchmaker
exampleSimplified: 朋友想撮合他们两个人,让他们认识。
exampleTraditional: 朋友想撮合他們兩個人,讓他們認識。
exampleEnglish: A friend wants to play matchmaker and get the two of them acquainted.
hintSimplified: 在中间帮忙介绍,让两个人或两方可以成功在一起。
hintTraditional: 在中間幫忙介紹,讓兩個人或兩方可以成功在一起。
hintEnglish: To help from the middle by introducing, so two people or parties can get together.

gloss: to add sth into a group
definition: to add sth into a group; to arrange in pairs; to match; to pair up
exampleSimplified: 这件外套和那条裤子搭配得很好看。
exampleTraditional: 這件外套和那條褲子搭配得很好看。
exampleEnglish: This jacket and those pants look great together.
hintSimplified: 把不同的东西放在一起,使它们看起来或用起来很合适。
hintTraditional: 把不同的東西放在一起,使它們看起來或用起來很合適。
hintEnglish: To put different things together so they look or work well as a set.

definition: Reply to: (in email header); to answer; to reply; variant of 答覆|答复[da2 fu4]
exampleSimplified: 请你尽快答复我,好吗?
exampleTraditional: 請你儘快答覆我,好嗎?
exampleEnglish: Please reply to me as soon as possible, okay?
hintSimplified: 别人提出问题或要求后,你给出的正式回应。
hintTraditional: 別人提出問題或要求後,你給出的正式回應。
hintEnglish: The formal response you give after someone raises a question or request.

exampleSimplified: 电影里有很多精彩的打斗场面。
exampleTraditional: 電影裡有很多精彩的打鬥場面。
exampleEnglish: The movie has many exciting fight scenes.
hintSimplified: 人和人用拳头或武器互相攻击,电影里常常出现。
hintTraditional: 人和人用拳頭或武器互相攻擊,電影裡常常出現。
hintEnglish: People attacking each other with fists or weapons, often seen in movies.

definition: a wager; to bet; to make a bet
exampleSimplified: 我和他打赌,明天一定不会下雨。
exampleTraditional: 我和他打賭,明天一定不會下雨。
exampleEnglish: I bet him that it definitely won't rain tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 两个人对某件事有不同看法,约定输的人要给对方东西。
hintTraditional: 兩個人對某件事有不同看法,約定輸的人要給對方東西。
hintEnglish: Two people disagree on something and agree that the loser gives the other a prize.

definition: (old) to bestow (alms etc); (old) to make arrangements; to dispatch sb to do sth; to make sb leave; to pass (the time)
exampleSimplified: 他一个人在家,只好看电视打发时间。
exampleTraditional: 他一個人在家,只好看電視打發時間。
exampleEnglish: He was alone at home, so he had to watch TV to pass the time.
hintSimplified: 做一些事情让无聊的时间过去,或者请不重要的人离开。
hintTraditional: 做一些事情讓無聊的時間過去,或者請不重要的人離開。
hintEnglish: To do something to get through boring time, or to send away an unimportant person.

definition: (psychological) shock; blow; percussion (music); to attack; to crack down on sth; to hit; to strike
exampleSimplified: 考试失败对他是很大的打击。
exampleTraditional: 考試失敗對他是很大的打擊。
exampleEnglish: Failing the exam was a heavy blow to him.
hintSimplified: 让人在心理上很难过、失去信心的坏事。
hintTraditional: 讓人在心理上很難過、失去信心的壞事。
hintEnglish: A bad event that leaves someone sad and short of confidence.

gloss: to look sb up and down
definition: to look sb up and down; to reckon; to size sb up; to suppose; to take the measure of
exampleSimplified: 她从头到脚打量了我一遍。
exampleTraditional: 她從頭到腳打量了我一遍。
exampleEnglish: She looked me up and down from head to toe.
hintSimplified: 用眼睛仔细地看一个陌生人,想了解他的样子。
hintTraditional: 用眼睛仔細地看一個陌生人,想了解他的樣子。
hintEnglish: To look carefully at a stranger with the eyes, trying to size them up.

exampleSimplified: 他爷爷年轻的时候常常去山里打猎。
exampleTraditional: 他爺爺年輕的時候常常去山裡打獵。
exampleEnglish: When his grandfather was young, he often went hunting in the mountains.
hintSimplified: 到森林或山上去捉野生动物。
hintTraditional: 到森林或山上去捉野生動物。
