hintEnglish: Going into the forest or mountains to catch wild animals.

exampleSimplified: 过年的时候,全家人聚在一起打牌。
exampleTraditional: 過年的時候,全家人聚在一起打牌。
exampleEnglish: During the New Year, the whole family gets together to play cards.
hintSimplified: 几个人围着桌子,用纸牌或麻将玩的娱乐活动。
hintTraditional: 幾個人圍著桌子,用紙牌或麻將玩的娛樂活動。
hintEnglish: An entertainment where several people sit around a table playing with cards or tiles.

exampleSimplified: 老板雇了几个打手去吓唬欠钱的人。
exampleTraditional: 老闆僱了幾個打手去嚇唬欠錢的人。
exampleEnglish: The boss hired a few thugs to scare the people who owed money.
hintSimplified: 被人花钱雇来用暴力对付别人的人。
hintTraditional: 被人花錢僱來用暴力對付別人的人。
hintEnglish: A person paid to use force against others.

definition: also pr. [da3 yang2]; to close shop in the evening
exampleSimplified: 这家商店晚上十点才打烊。
exampleTraditional: 這家商店晚上十點才打烊。
exampleEnglish: This store doesn't close until ten at night.
hintSimplified: 商店每天营业结束,关门不再接待客人。
hintTraditional: 商店每天營業結束,關門不再接待客人。
hintEnglish: When a shop finishes its business for the day and closes its doors to customers.

exampleSimplified: 这条大道两旁种满了高大的树。
exampleTraditional: 這條大道兩旁種滿了高大的樹。
exampleEnglish: Both sides of this avenue are lined with tall trees.
hintSimplified: 城市里又宽又长、可以让很多车通过的路。
hintTraditional: 城市裡又寬又長、可以讓很多車透過的路。
hintEnglish: A wide, long road in a city that lets many vehicles pass.

definition: a large body of; group; military group; production brigade
exampleSimplified: 一大队警察很快赶到了现场。
exampleTraditional: 一大隊警察很快趕到了現場。
exampleEnglish: A large squad of police quickly arrived at the scene.
hintSimplified: 指由很多人组成的一支队伍,比小组规模大得多。
hintTraditional: 指由很多人組成的一支隊伍,比小組規模大得多。
hintEnglish: A team made up of many people, much larger than a small group.

exampleSimplified: 新来的大使今天向总统递交了国书。
exampleTraditional: 新來的大使今天向總統遞交了國書。
exampleEnglish: The newly arrived ambassador presented his credentials to the president today.
hintSimplified: 一个国家派到另一个国家,代表本国的高级外交官。
hintTraditional: 一個國家派到另一個國家,代表本國的高階外交官。
hintEnglish: A senior diplomat sent by one country to represent it in another.

exampleSimplified: 明年将举行大选,大家都很关心结果。
exampleTraditional: 明年將舉行大選,大家都很關心結果。
exampleEnglish: A general election will be held next year, and everyone cares about the result.
hintSimplified: 全国人民一起投票,决定领导人是谁的活动。
hintTraditional: 全國人民一起投票,決定領導人是誰的活動。
hintEnglish: An event where the whole nation votes to decide who the leader will be.

exampleSimplified: 警察终于抓到了那名持刀的歹徒。
exampleTraditional: 警察終於抓到了那名持刀的歹徒。
exampleEnglish: The police finally caught the knife-wielding criminal.
hintSimplified: 做坏事、伤害别人或抢东西的人。
hintTraditional: 做壞事、傷害別人或搶東西的人。
hintEnglish: A person who does bad things, harms others or robs them.

definition: Taiwan pr. [dai3bu3]; to arrest; to apprehend; to take into custody
exampleSimplified: 警方昨天晚上逮捕了三名嫌犯。
exampleTraditional: 警方昨天晚上逮捕了三名嫌犯。
exampleEnglish: The police arrested three suspects last night.
hintSimplified: 警察依法把犯了罪的人抓起来。
hintTraditional: 警察依法把犯了罪的人抓起來。
hintEnglish: What the police do when they legally take a criminal into custody.

gloss: to teach as substitute for absent teacher
definition: to teach as substitute for absent teacher
exampleSimplified: 王老师生病了,今天由李老师代课。
exampleTraditional: 王老師生病了,今天由李老師代課。
exampleEnglish: Teacher Wang is sick, so Teacher Li is filling in for the class today.
hintSimplified: 老师不能来时,别的老师暂时替他上课。
hintTraditional: 老師不能來時,別的老師暫時替他上課。
hintEnglish: When a teacher can't come, another teacher temporarily takes over the lesson.

exampleSimplified: 对不起,客人来了,我们怠慢了您。
exampleTraditional: 對不起,客人來了,我們怠慢了您。
exampleEnglish: Sorry, we have neglected you as our guest.
hintSimplified: 对客人或别人不够热情、不够用心,是一种有礼貌的道歉说法。
hintTraditional: 對客人或別人不夠熱情、不夠用心,是一種有禮貌的道歉說法。
hintEnglish: To treat someone with too little warmth or attention; a polite phrase used in apologies.

definition: to assume; to take upon oneself
exampleSimplified: 他很有担当,出了问题都自己负责。
exampleTraditional: 他很有擔當,出了問題都自己負責。
exampleEnglish: He is very responsible and takes charge himself when problems arise.
hintSimplified: 敢于接受责任和任务,不推给别人。
hintTraditional: 敢於接受責任和任務,不推給別人。
hintEnglish: Willing to accept responsibility and duties without pushing them onto others.

definition: to bear; to shoulder; to undertake
exampleSimplified: 她一个人担负着照顾全家的责任。
exampleTraditional: 她一個人擔負著照顧全家的責任。
exampleEnglish: She alone bears the responsibility of taking care of the whole family.
hintSimplified: 把责任或工作扛在自己身上。
hintTraditional: 把責任或工作扛在自己身上。
hintEnglish: To carry a responsibility or task on one's own shoulders.

definition: alone; by oneself; on one's own
exampleSimplified: 我想单独跟你谈一谈。
exampleTraditional: 我想單獨跟你談一談。
exampleEnglish: I'd like to talk with you alone.
hintSimplified: 不和别人在一起,只有一个人或一件事。
hintTraditional: 不和別人在一起,只有一個人或一件事。
hintEnglish: Not together with others; just one person or one thing on its own.

exampleSimplified: 这种水果的单价比去年高了很多。
exampleTraditional: 這種水果的單價比去年高了很多。
exampleEnglish: The unit price of this fruit is much higher than last year.
hintSimplified: 买东西时,每一个或每一公斤的价钱。
hintTraditional: 買東西時,每一個或每一公斤的價錢。
hintEnglish: When shopping, the price of each single item or each kilogram.

exampleSimplified: 请把这些单据收好,以后报销要用。
exampleTraditional: 請把這些單據收好,以後報銷要用。
exampleEnglish: Please keep these receipts safe; you'll need them for reimbursement later.
hintSimplified: 买卖或付款后得到的纸,可以证明交易。
hintTraditional: 買賣或付款後得到的紙,可以證明交易。
hintEnglish: Papers received after buying or paying that serve as proof of a transaction.

exampleSimplified: 她在单亲家庭中长大,妈妈很辛苦。
exampleTraditional: 她在單親家庭中長大,媽媽很辛苦。
exampleEnglish: She grew up in a single-parent family, and her mother worked very hard.
hintSimplified: 家里只有爸爸或妈妈一个人照顾孩子的情况。
hintTraditional: 家裡只有爸爸或媽媽一個人照顧孩子的情況。
hintEnglish: A situation where only a father or a mother raises the children at home.

definition: off season; see also 旺季[wang4 ji4]; slow business season
exampleSimplified: 冬天是这个海边旅游区的淡季。
exampleTraditional: 冬天是這個海邊旅遊區的淡季。
exampleEnglish: Winter is the off season for this seaside tourist area.
hintSimplified: 生意不好、客人比较少的时期。
hintTraditional: 生意不好、客人比較少的時期。
hintEnglish: The period when business is slow and there are fewer customers.

gloss: Tamsui or Danshui, district of New Taipei City 新北市[Xin1 bei3 shi4], Taiwan
definition: Tamsui or Danshui, district of New Taipei City 新北市[Xin1 bei3 shi4], Taiwan; freshwater
exampleSimplified: 这种鱼只生活在淡水里,不能住在海里。
exampleTraditional: 這種魚只生活在淡水裡,不能住在海里。
exampleEnglish: This kind of fish lives only in fresh water and cannot live in the sea.
hintSimplified: 河流和湖泊里不咸的水。
hintTraditional: 河流和湖泊裡不鹹的水。
hintEnglish: The non-salty water found in rivers and lakes.

exampleSimplified: 我的导师建议我多读一些相关的论文。
exampleTraditional: 我的導師建議我多讀一些相關的論文。
exampleEnglish: My advisor suggested that I read more related papers.
hintSimplified: 在大学里指导研究生做研究和写论文的老师。
hintTraditional: 在大學裡指導研究生做研究和寫論文的老師。
hintEnglish: A teacher at university who guides graduate students in research and thesis writing.

gloss: to lead to; to create; to cause; to bring about
definition: to lead to; to create; to cause; to bring about
exampleSimplified: 大雨导致山路出现了严重的塌方。
exampleTraditional: 大雨導致山路出現了嚴重的塌方。
exampleEnglish: Heavy rain led to a serious landslide on the mountain road.
hintSimplified: 某件事是原因,最后造成了另一个结果。
hintTraditional: 某件事是原因,最後造成了另一個結果。
hintEnglish: When one thing is the cause that eventually brings about another result.

exampleSimplified: 太平洋上有许多美丽的岛屿。
exampleTraditional: 太平洋上有許多美麗的島嶼。
exampleEnglish: There are many beautiful islands in the Pacific Ocean.
hintSimplified: 四周都是海水的小块陆地,通常不止一个。
hintTraditional: 四周都是海水的小塊陸地,通常不止一個。
hintEnglish: Small pieces of land surrounded by sea, usually more than one.

definition: to pay a farewell call; to say goodbye; to bid farewell
exampleSimplified: 离开公司前,他向每位同事道别。
exampleTraditional: 離開公司前,他向每位同事道別。
exampleEnglish: Before leaving the company, he said goodbye to each colleague.
hintSimplified: 要离开时,对别人说再见,表示告别。
hintTraditional: 要離開時,對別人說再見,表示告別。
hintEnglish: When about to leave, to say farewell to people.

exampleSimplified: 这家店的牛肉面味道很道地。
exampleTraditional: 這家店的牛肉麵味道很道地。
exampleEnglish: The beef noodles in this shop taste very authentic.
hintSimplified: 形容东西很正宗,有原来地方的特色。
hintTraditional: 形容東西很正宗,有原來地方的特色。
hintEnglish: Describes something genuine that has the true flavor of its place of origin.

exampleSimplified: 庙里的道士正在为信徒念经。
exampleTraditional: 廟裡的道士正在為信徒唸經。
exampleEnglish: The Daoist priest in the temple is chanting scriptures for believers.
hintSimplified: 在道教庙里修行、主持仪式的人。
hintTraditional: 在道教廟裡修行、主持儀式的人。
hintEnglish: A person who practices and conducts ceremonies in a Daoist temple.

exampleSimplified: 帮助有困难的人是我们的道义责任。
exampleTraditional: 幫助有困難的人是我們的道義責任。
exampleEnglish: Helping people in difficulty is our moral duty.
hintSimplified: 人与人之间应该遵守的正确道理和责任感。
hintTraditional: 人與人之間應該遵守的正確道理和責任感。
hintEnglish: The right principles and sense of duty people ought to uphold toward each other.

definition: from the back (rows of seats); from the bottom (lines on a page); inverse number; reciprocal (math.); to count backwards (from 10 down to 0); to count down
exampleSimplified: 他的成绩在班上倒数第三名。
exampleTraditional: 他的成績在班上倒數第三名。
exampleEnglish: His grades rank third from the bottom in the class.
hintSimplified: 从最后面开始往前算的顺序。
hintTraditional: 從最後面開始往前算的順序。
hintEnglish: Counting the order starting from the very end and going forward.

definition: to be a soldier; to serve in the army
exampleSimplified: 男生满十八岁以后可能要去当兵。
exampleTraditional: 男生滿十八歲以後可能要去當兵。
exampleEnglish: Boys may have to go do military service after they turn eighteen.
hintSimplified: 加入军队,穿上军服为国家服务。
hintTraditional: 加入軍隊,穿上軍服為國家服務。
hintEnglish: To join the army and wear a uniform to serve the country.

definition: the contemporary era; the present age
exampleSimplified: 他是当代最有名的作家之一。
exampleTraditional: 他是當代最有名的作家之一。
exampleEnglish: He is one of the most famous writers of our time.
hintSimplified: 指我们现在生活的这个时代，不是古代。
hintTraditional: 指我們現在生活的這個時代，不是古代。
hintEnglish: It refers to the era we are living in now, not ancient times.

exampleSimplified: 当局已经决定明天关闭这条路。
exampleTraditional: 當局已經決定明天關閉這條路。
exampleEnglish: The authorities have decided to close this road tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 负责管理和做决定的政府部门或人员。
hintTraditional: 負責管理和做決定的政府部門或人員。
hintEnglish: The government departments or people in charge of managing and making decisions.

definition: the present time; to be faced with
exampleSimplified: 当前最重要的是先把问题解决。
exampleTraditional: 當前最重要的是先把問題解決。
exampleEnglish: The most important thing at present is to solve the problem first.
hintSimplified: 指现在这个时候，眼前的阶段。
hintTraditional: 指現在這個時候，眼前的階段。
hintEnglish: Refers to this moment, the stage right in front of us.

definition: to look out; to take care
exampleSimplified: 地板很滑，你要当心一点。
exampleTraditional: 地板很滑，你要當心一點。
exampleEnglish: The floor is slippery, so you should be careful.
hintSimplified: 有危险的时候，别人提醒你要小心注意。
hintTraditional: 有危險的時候，別人提醒你要小心注意。
hintEnglish: What someone tells you to do when there is danger: pay attention and be careful.

exampleSimplified: 各个党派对这个问题有不同的看法。
exampleTraditional: 各個黨派對這個問題有不同的看法。
exampleEnglish: The different parties have different views on this issue.
hintSimplified: 政治上由不同团体分出来的各个组织。
hintTraditional: 政治上由不同團體分出來的各個組織。
hintEnglish: The various groups into which political organizations are divided.

exampleSimplified: 他已经当了十年的党员。
exampleTraditional: 他已經當了十年的黨員。
exampleEnglish: He has been a party member for ten years.
hintSimplified: 加入某个政治组织的人。
hintTraditional: 加入某個政治組織的人。
hintEnglish: A person who has joined a certain political organization.

definition: able to; enabling; finally in a position to; in order to; so that sb can; with sth in view
exampleSimplified: 多亏朋友帮忙，我才得以完成工作。
exampleTraditional: 多虧朋友幫忙，我才得以完成工作。
exampleEnglish: Thanks to my friend's help, I was able to finish the work.
hintSimplified: 书面语，表示因为某个条件，所以有机会做成某事。
hintTraditional: 書面語，表示因為某個條件，所以有機會做成某事。
hintEnglish: Written style; shows that thanks to some condition, one gets the chance to accomplish something.

gloss: fig. to appear on the scene
definition: fig. to appear on the scene; to go on stage; used in advertising to mean new product
exampleSimplified: 最后，这位歌手终于登场了。
exampleTraditional: 最後，這位歌手終於登場了。
exampleEnglish: In the end, the singer finally came on stage.
hintSimplified: 演员或重要的人走到舞台上，大家开始看到他。
hintTraditional: 演員或重要的人走到舞台上，大家開始看到他。
hintEnglish: When an actor or important person walks onto the stage and people start to see them.

definition: to come ashore; to land; to log in (frequently used erroneous variant of 登錄|登录[deng1 lu4]); to make landfall (of typhoon etc)
exampleSimplified: 台风预计明天晚上会登陆。
exampleTraditional: 颱風預計明天晚上會登陸。
exampleEnglish: The typhoon is expected to make landfall tomorrow night.
hintSimplified: 台风或军队从海上来到陆地上。
hintTraditional: 颱風或軍隊從海上來到陸地上。
hintEnglish: What a typhoon or an army does when coming from the sea onto land.

exampleSimplified: 夜晚的城市里到处都是灯火。
exampleTraditional: 夜晚的城市裡到處都是燈火。
exampleEnglish: At night the city is full of lights everywhere.
hintSimplified: 夜里房子和街道上亮着的许多光。
hintTraditional: 夜裡房子和街道上亮著的許多光。
hintEnglish: The many glowing lights in houses and streets at night.

exampleSimplified: 元宵节时，街上挂满了红色的灯笼。
exampleTraditional: 元宵節時，街上掛滿了紅色的燈籠。
exampleEnglish: During the Lantern Festival, the streets are hung with red lanterns.
hintSimplified: 节日时挂着的、用纸或布做的、里面有光的装饰。
hintTraditional: 節日時掛著的、用紙或布做的、裡面有光的裝飾。
hintEnglish: A festival decoration made of paper or cloth with a light inside.

exampleSimplified: 请在这里等候，医生马上就来。
exampleTraditional: 請在這裡等候，醫生馬上就來。
exampleEnglish: Please wait here; the doctor will be right with you.
hintSimplified: 留在一个地方，直到想见的人或事情出现。
hintTraditional: 留在一個地方，直到想見的人或事情出現。
hintEnglish: To stay in a place until the person or thing you expect shows up.

exampleSimplified: 这两种商品的价值是等价的。
exampleTraditional: 這兩種商品的價值是等價的。
exampleEnglish: These two goods are equal in value.
hintSimplified: 两样东西的价钱或价值一样。
hintTraditional: 兩樣東西的價錢或價值一樣。
hintEnglish: Two things having the same price or worth.

exampleSimplified: 他在旁边小声嘀咕，我听不清楚。
exampleTraditional: 他在旁邊小聲嘀咕，我聽不清楚。
exampleEnglish: He muttered quietly beside me, and I couldn't hear clearly.
hintSimplified: 小声地自己说话，别人听不清楚，常因为不满或担心。
hintTraditional: 小聲地自己說話，別人聽不清楚，常因為不滿或擔心。
hintEnglish: To speak in a low voice to oneself, hard to hear, often out of dissatisfaction or worry.

exampleSimplified: 这张旧照片的底片还在抽屉里。
exampleTraditional: 這張舊照片的底片還在抽屜裡。
exampleEnglish: The negative of this old photo is still in the drawer.
hintSimplified: 老式相机拍照后，用来洗出照片的那种胶片。
hintTraditional: 老式相機拍照後，用來洗出照片的那種膠片。
hintEnglish: The film from an old camera used to print photographs.

gloss: to provide (an asset) as security for a loan
definition: to provide (an asset) as security for a loan; to put up collateral
exampleSimplified: 他把房子拿去抵押，向银行借了钱。
exampleTraditional: 他把房子拿去抵押，向銀行借了錢。
exampleEnglish: He mortgaged his house to borrow money from the bank.
hintSimplified: 借钱时，把房子等东西交给对方作保证。
hintTraditional: 借錢時，把房子等東西交給對方作保證。
hintEnglish: When borrowing money, handing over something like a house as a guarantee.

definition: refusal; resistance; to boycott; to refuse (to cooperate); to reject; to resist
exampleSimplified: 很多消费者抵制这家公司的产品。
exampleTraditional: 很多消費者抵制這家公司的產品。
exampleEnglish: Many consumers boycott this company's products.
hintSimplified: 大家不接受、不购买，用来表示反对。
hintTraditional: 大家不接受、不購買，用來表示反對。
hintEnglish: When people refuse to accept or buy something to show opposition.

exampleSimplified: 地震时，地表出现了很深的裂缝。
exampleTraditional: 地震時，地表出現了很深的裂縫。
exampleEnglish: During the earthquake, deep cracks appeared on the earth's surface.
hintSimplified: 地球最外面、我们站在上面的那一层。
hintTraditional: 地球最外面、我們站在上面的那一層。
hintEnglish: The outermost layer of the earth, the one we stand on.

definition: a (usu. bad) situation; leeway; stage; degree (to which a situation has evolved)
exampleSimplified: 事情怎么会发展到这种地步？
exampleTraditional: 事情怎麼會發展到這種地步？
exampleEnglish: How could things have developed to this point?
hintSimplified: 指事情发展到的程度或情况，常常是不好的。
hintTraditional: 指事情發展到的程度或情況，常常是不好的。
hintEnglish: The degree or state that things have reached, often a bad one.

exampleSimplified: 这个地区地势很高，天气比较冷。
exampleTraditional: 這個地區地勢很高，天氣比較冷。
exampleEnglish: This area has high terrain, and the weather is rather cold.
hintSimplified: 一个地方高低起伏的样子，比如山地或平原。
hintTraditional: 一個地方高低起伏的樣子，比如山地或平原。
hintEnglish: How high or low and uneven a place is, such as mountains or plains.

exampleSimplified: 不同地域的人，饮食习惯也不一样。
exampleTraditional: 不同地域的人，飲食習慣也不一樣。
exampleEnglish: People from different regions have different eating habits.
hintSimplified: 指有一定范围的一块土地或区域。
hintTraditional: 指有一定範圍的一塊土地或區域。
hintEnglish: A stretch of land or a zone with a certain extent.

gloss: (coll.) (of humor, jokes, content etc) extremely dark or morally transgressive
definition: (coll.) (of humor, jokes, content etc) extremely dark or morally transgressive; hell; underworld; (Buddhism) Naraka
exampleSimplified: 传说坏人死后会掉进地狱。
exampleTraditional: 傳說壞人死後會掉進地獄。
exampleEnglish: Legend says that bad people fall into hell after death.
hintSimplified: 传说中人死后受苦的可怕地方，和天堂相反。
hintTraditional: 傳說中人死後受苦的可怕地方，和天堂相反。
hintEnglish: In legend, the terrible place of suffering after death, the opposite of paradise.

exampleSimplified: 他在大学里学地质，常去山上研究石头。
exampleTraditional: 他在大學裡學地質，常去山上研究石頭。
exampleEnglish: He studies geology at university and often goes up the mountains to study rocks.
hintSimplified: 研究地球的岩石和土地构造的学科。
hintTraditional: 研究地球的岩石和土地構造的學科。
hintEnglish: The field that studies the earth's rocks and the structure of the ground.

exampleSimplified: 作为地主，他热情地招待远来的朋友。
exampleTraditional: 作為地主，他熱情地招待遠來的朋友。
exampleEnglish: As the host, he warmly entertained the friends who came from afar.
hintSimplified: 拥有很多土地的人，或在当地招待客人的人。
hintTraditional: 擁有很多土地的人，或在當地招待客人的人。
hintEnglish: A person who owns a lot of land, or who receives guests in their own area.

exampleSimplified: 两国代表正式缔结了和平条约。
exampleTraditional: 兩國代表正式締結了和平條約。
exampleEnglish: The representatives of the two countries formally concluded a peace treaty.
hintSimplified: 国家或团体正式签订条约、协议。
hintTraditional: 國家或團體正式簽訂條約、協議。
hintEnglish: When countries or groups formally sign a treaty or agreement.

exampleSimplified: 这位企业家缔造了一个庞大的商业王国。
exampleTraditional: 這位企業家締造了一個龐大的商業王國。
exampleEnglish: This entrepreneur created a huge business empire.
hintSimplified: 用心力从无到有建立起一番大事业或一个伟大的成果。
hintTraditional: 用心力從無到有建立起一番大事業或一個偉大的成果。
hintEnglish: To build up something great from nothing through great effort.

exampleSimplified: 他们几个弟兄从小感情就很好。
exampleTraditional: 他們幾個弟兄從小感情就很好。
exampleEnglish: The brothers have been very close since they were little.
hintSimplified: 指兄和弟,也可以用来称呼关系亲近的男性朋友或同伙。
hintTraditional: 指兄和弟,也可以用來稱呼關係親近的男性朋友或同夥。
hintEnglish: Refers to older and younger male siblings, or close male friends.

gloss: fig. to overturn (a regime, by plotting or subversion)
definition: fig. to overturn (a regime, by plotting or subversion); to capsize; to subvert; to topple (i.e. knock over); to undermine
exampleSimplified: 这项新发明颠覆了人们对手机的想象。
exampleTraditional: 這項新發明顛覆了人們對手機的想象。
exampleEnglish: This new invention overturned people's idea of what a phone is.
hintSimplified: 把原来的东西或想法完全推翻,使它彻底改变。
hintTraditional: 把原來的東西或想法完全推翻,使它徹底改變。
hintEnglish: To completely upend something that existed so that it totally changes.

exampleSimplified: 这家咖啡店的装潢非常典雅。
exampleTraditional: 這家咖啡店的裝潢非常典雅。
exampleEnglish: The decor of this café is very elegant.
hintSimplified: 形容东西或风格优美、有品味,不俗气。
hintTraditional: 形容東西或風格優美、有品味,不俗氣。
hintEnglish: Describes something beautiful and tasteful, not vulgar.

definition: crux; dot; drop (of liquid); droplet; idea; indication; point; point (of argument); pointer; speck; spot
exampleSimplified: 他总是有很多好点子,大家都愿意听他的意见。
exampleTraditional: 他總是有很多好點子,大家都願意聽他的意見。
exampleEnglish: He always has lots of good ideas, and everyone likes to hear his opinions.
hintSimplified: 开会讨论时,有人想出一个新颖巧妙的办法或主意。
hintTraditional: 開會討論時,有人想出一個新穎巧妙的辦法或主意。
hintEnglish: In a meeting, someone comes up with a clever, original idea.

definition: to establish; to fix; to settle
exampleSimplified: 这次比赛为他以后的成功奠定了基础。
exampleTraditional: 這次比賽為他以後的成功奠定了基礎。
exampleEnglish: This competition laid the foundation for his later success.
hintSimplified: 盖房子要先打好地基,比喻为将来的发展建立稳固的基础。
hintTraditional: 蓋房子要先打好地基,比喻為將來的發展建立穩固的基礎。
hintEnglish: Like laying a foundation for a building; to set up a solid base for future development.

definition: to be concerned about; to keep thinking about; to think of
exampleSimplified: 妈妈总是惦记着在外地工作的儿子。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽總是惦記著在外地工作的兒子。
exampleEnglish: Mom is always thinking about her son working far away.
hintSimplified: 心里一直想着某人或某事,放不下心。
hintTraditional: 心裡一直想著某人或某事,放不下心。
hintEnglish: To keep thinking about someone or something and not be able to stop worrying.

definition: electrical engineering; electrical work (in a house); electrician
exampleSimplified: 我家的灯坏了,请了一位电工来修。
exampleTraditional: 我家的燈壞了,請了一位電工來修。
exampleEnglish: The light at my home was broken, so I called an electrician to fix it.
hintSimplified: 这种工人专门安装和修理线路、插座和电器设备。
hintTraditional: 這種工人專門安裝和修理線路、插座和電器裝置。
hintEnglish: This kind of worker installs and repairs wiring, sockets and electrical equipment.

exampleSimplified: 夏天用电量大,电力供应有时会不足。
exampleTraditional: 夏天用電量大,電力供應有時會不足。
exampleEnglish: In summer electricity use is high, and the power supply is sometimes insufficient.
hintSimplified: 发电厂供应给城市和工厂使用的能源。
hintTraditional: 發電廠供應給城市和工廠使用的能源。
hintEnglish: The energy that power plants supply to cities and factories.

exampleSimplified: 电线太细,不能通过太大的电流。
exampleTraditional: 電線太細,不能透過太大的電流。
exampleEnglish: The wire is too thin and cannot carry too large a current.
hintSimplified: 电荷在导线中移动形成的东西,单位是安培。
hintTraditional: 電荷在導線中移動形成的東西,單位是安培。
hintEnglish: What forms when electric charges move through a wire; measured in amperes.

exampleSimplified: 台湾家用电器的电压是一百一十伏特。
exampleTraditional: 台灣家用電器的電壓是一百一十伏特。
exampleEnglish: The voltage of household appliances in Taiwan is 110 volts.
hintSimplified: 推动电在线路中流动的力量,单位是伏特。
hintTraditional: 推動電線上路中流動的力量,單位是伏特。
hintEnglish: The force that pushes electricity through a circuit; measured in volts.

definition: to decay; to fade; to wither; wilted; withered
exampleSimplified: 秋天一到,树上的叶子慢慢凋零了。
exampleTraditional: 秋天一到,樹上的葉子慢慢凋零了。
exampleEnglish: When autumn comes, the leaves on the trees slowly wither and fall.
hintSimplified: 花草树叶枯萎掉落,也可比喻人或事物逐渐衰败消失。
hintTraditional: 花草樹葉枯萎掉落,也可比喻人或事物逐漸衰敗消失。
hintEnglish: Flowers and leaves wither and fall; also figuratively, things fade away and decline.

definition: dispatcher; scheduler; to dispatch (vehicles, staff etc); to manage; to schedule
exampleSimplified: 公司的调度员会安排每辆货车的行程。
exampleTraditional: 公司的調度員會安排每輛貨車的行程。
exampleEnglish: The company's dispatcher arranges the route of each truck.
hintSimplified: 统一安排和指挥人员、车辆或资源的工作。
hintTraditional: 統一安排和指揮人員、車輛或資源的工作。
hintEnglish: The job of arranging and directing people, vehicles or resources in a unified way.

exampleSimplified: 古城堡前面有一座可以升起来的吊桥。
exampleTraditional: 古城堡前面有一座可以升起來的吊橋。
exampleEnglish: In front of the old castle there is a drawbridge that can be raised.
hintSimplified: 城堡护城河上的桥,可以用链子拉起来挡住敌人。
hintTraditional: 城堡護城河上的橋,可以用鏈子拉起來擋住敵人。
hintEnglish: A bridge over a castle moat that can be pulled up with chains to keep enemies out.

exampleSimplified: 工厂每个月都有固定的生产定额。
exampleTraditional: 工廠每個月都有固定的生產定額。
exampleEnglish: The factory has a fixed production quota every month.
hintSimplified: 事先规定好的数量或金额,要达到这个标准。
hintTraditional: 事先規定好的數量或金額,要達到這個標準。
hintEnglish: A number or amount set in advance that must be reached.

exampleSimplified: 老师请我们自己写出这个词的定义。
exampleTraditional: 老師請我們自己寫出這個詞的定義。
exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to write the definition of this word ourselves.
hintSimplified: 对一个词或概念的意思所作的清楚说明,字典里常有。
hintTraditional: 對一個詞或概念的意思所作的清楚說明,字典裡常有。
hintEnglish: A clear explanation of the meaning of a word or concept, often found in dictionaries.

exampleSimplified: 请不要随意丢弃用过的电池。
exampleTraditional: 請不要隨意丟棄用過的電池。
exampleEnglish: Please do not carelessly throw away used batteries.
hintSimplified: 把不要的东西扔掉,或不再照顾某个人或东西。
hintTraditional: 把不要的東西扔掉,或不再照顧某個人或東西。
hintEnglish: To throw away something unwanted, or to leave someone or something behind.

definition: (fig.) to freeze (assets, prices etc); to freeze (water etc)
exampleSimplified: 银行冻结了他账户里的所有存款。
exampleTraditional: 銀行凍結了他賬戶裡的所有存款。
exampleEnglish: The bank froze all the deposits in his account.
hintSimplified: 规定资金或价格暂时不能动用或改变。
hintTraditional: 規定資金或價格暫時不能動用或改變。
hintEnglish: To decide that money or prices temporarily cannot be used or changed.

exampleSimplified: 探险队在山里发现了一个很深的洞穴。
exampleTraditional: 探險隊在山裡發現了一個很深的洞穴。
exampleEnglish: The expedition team found a very deep cave in the mountains.
hintSimplified: 山里或岩石中天然形成的大洞,古人或蝙蝠可能住在里面。
hintTraditional: 山裡或岩石中天然形成的大洞,古人或蝙蝠可能住在裡面。
hintEnglish: A large natural hole in a mountain or rock where ancient people or bats might live.

exampleSimplified: 汽车和珠宝都属于动产,房子则是不动产。
exampleTraditional: 汽車和珠寶都屬於動產,房子則是不動產。
exampleEnglish: Cars and jewelry are movable property, while houses are real estate.
hintSimplified: 法律上指可以搬动的财产,和土地、房屋相对。
hintTraditional: 法律上指可以搬動的財產,和土地、房屋相對。
hintEnglish: In law, property that can be moved, as opposed to land and buildings.

exampleSimplified: 警察正在调查他做这件事的动机。
exampleTraditional: 警察正在調查他做這件事的動機。
exampleEnglish: The police are investigating his motive for doing this.
hintSimplified: 一个人做某件事背后的原因或目的。
hintTraditional: 一個人做某件事背後的原因或目的。
hintEnglish: The reason or purpose behind why someone does something.

definition: (detectable) movement; (sign of) activity; movement and stillness
exampleSimplified: 隔壁房间一点动静都没有,大家可能都睡了。
exampleTraditional: 隔壁房間一點動靜都沒有,大家可能都睡了。
exampleEnglish: There isn't a sound from the next room; everyone may be asleep.
hintSimplified: 别人活动时发出的声音或表现出来的迹象。
hintTraditional: 別人活動時發出的聲音或表現出來的跡象。
hintEnglish: The sounds or signs that show someone is active.

exampleSimplified: 家人的支持是我努力学习的最大动力。
exampleTraditional: 家人的支援是我努力學習的最大動力。
exampleEnglish: My family's support is my greatest driving force for studying hard.
hintSimplified: 推动人继续努力向前的力量,也指让机器运转的力量。
hintTraditional: 推動人繼續努力向前的力量,也指讓機器運轉的力量。
hintEnglish: The force that pushes a person to keep striving; also what makes machines run.

exampleSimplified: 那个国家发生动乱后,许多人离开了家乡。
exampleTraditional: 那個國家發生動亂後,許多人離開了家鄉。
exampleEnglish: After unrest broke out in that country, many people left their hometowns.
hintSimplified: 社会秩序很不安定、混乱的情况。
hintTraditional: 社會秩序很不安定、混亂的情況。
hintEnglish: A situation in which social order is very unstable and chaotic.

exampleSimplified: 医生说他的动脉有一点硬化。
exampleTraditional: 醫生說他的動脈有一點硬化。
exampleEnglish: The doctor said his arteries are slightly hardened.
hintSimplified: 把血液从心脏送到全身的血管。
hintTraditional: 把血液從心臟送到全身的血管。
hintEnglish: The blood vessels that carry blood from the heart to the whole body.

exampleSimplified: 记者一直关注这家公司的最新动态。
exampleTraditional: 記者一直關注這家公司的最新動態。
exampleEnglish: The reporter has been following this company's latest developments.
hintSimplified: 新闻常报道某件事或某个人最近的变化和进展情况。
hintTraditional: 新聞常報道某件事或某個人最近的變化和進展情況。
hintEnglish: News often reports on the recent changes and progress of a matter or person.

exampleSimplified: 专家正在研究市场的未来动向。
exampleTraditional: 專家正在研究市場的未來動向。
exampleEnglish: Experts are studying the future direction of the market.
hintSimplified: 指事情发展变化的方向，比如经济或人群的趋势。
hintTraditional: 指事情發展變化的方向，比如經濟或人群的趨勢。
hintEnglish: The direction in which things are developing, such as in the economy or among people.

exampleSimplified: 学校动员全体学生参加环保活动。
exampleTraditional: 學校動員全體學生參加環保活動。
exampleEnglish: The school mobilized all students to take part in the environmental activity.
hintSimplified: 号召很多人一起行动，参加某件大事。
hintTraditional: 號召很多人一起行動，參加某件大事。
hintEnglish: To call on many people to act together and join in something big.

gloss: to stay for a while; to sojourn
definition: to stay for a while; to sojourn
exampleSimplified: 我们在京都逗留了三天。
exampleTraditional: 我們在京都逗留了三天。
exampleEnglish: We stayed in Kyoto for three days.
hintSimplified: 旅行时在一个地方暂时停下来，住一小段时间。
hintTraditional: 旅行時在一個地方暫時停下來，住一小段時間。
hintEnglish: When travelling, to stop in one place and remain there for a short time.

exampleSimplified: 输了比赛以后，他的斗志反而更强了。
exampleTraditional: 輸了比賽以後，他的鬥志反而更強了。
exampleEnglish: After losing the match, his fighting spirit became even stronger.
hintSimplified: 面对困难或对手时，想要努力战胜的那种精神。
hintTraditional: 面對困難或對手時，想要努力戰勝的那種精神。
hintEnglish: The spirit of wanting to fight hard and win when facing difficulties or opponents.

gloss: to supervise and urge completion of a task
definition: to supervise and urge completion of a task; to urge on
exampleSimplified: 老师每天督促学生按时完成作业。
exampleTraditional: 老師每天督促學生按時完成作業。
exampleEnglish: The teacher urges students every day to finish their homework on time.
hintSimplified: 在旁边看着并催别人把事情做好。
hintTraditional: 在旁邊看著並催別人把事情做好。
hintEnglish: To watch over others and urge them to get a task done.

definition: innovation; to come up with (an innovation)
exampleSimplified: 这是他独创的一种绘画方法。
exampleTraditional: 這是他獨創的一種繪畫方法。
exampleEnglish: This is a painting method that he originated himself.
hintSimplified: 自己第一个想出来，不是模仿别人的。
hintTraditional: 自己第一個想出來，不是模仿別人的。
hintEnglish: Thought up first by oneself, not copied from others.

exampleSimplified: 她对这个问题有很独到的看法。
exampleTraditional: 她對這個問題有很獨到的看法。
exampleEnglish: She has a very original view on this issue.
hintSimplified: 形容想法或眼光特别，和一般人不一样而且很高明。
hintTraditional: 形容想法或眼光特別，和一般人不一樣而且很高明。
hintEnglish: Describes ideas or insight that are special, different from ordinary people and quite clever.

gloss: to have all to oneself; to monopolize
definition: to have all to oneself; to monopolize; variant of 獨占|独占[du2 zhan4]
exampleSimplified: 这家公司想独占整个市场。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司想獨占整個市場。
exampleEnglish: This company wants to monopolize the entire market.
hintSimplified: 自己一个人拥有全部，不让别人分享。
hintTraditional: 自己一個人擁有全部，不讓別人分享。
hintEnglish: To own everything oneself and not let others share.

exampleSimplified: 图书馆里有很多适合儿童的读物。
exampleTraditional: 圖書館裡有很多適合兒童的讀物。
exampleEnglish: The library has many reading materials suitable for children.
hintSimplified: 书、杂志等可以拿来看的东西的总称。
hintTraditional: 書、雜誌等可以拿來看的東西的總稱。
hintEnglish: A general term for books, magazines and other things to read.

exampleSimplified: 下雨天，市中心的交通常常堵塞。
exampleTraditional: 下雨天，市中心的交通常常堵塞。
exampleEnglish: On rainy days, traffic in the city center is often blocked.
hintSimplified: 管子或道路被东西挡住，不能通过。
hintTraditional: 管子或道路被東西擋住，不能透過。
hintEnglish: When a pipe or road is blocked by something and nothing can pass.

exampleSimplified: 他因为赌博输光了所有的钱。
exampleTraditional: 他因為賭博輸光了所有的錢。
exampleEnglish: He lost all his money because of gambling.
hintSimplified: 用钱打赌，希望靠运气赢更多钱，常让人上瘾。
hintTraditional: 用錢打賭，希望靠運氣贏更多錢，常讓人上癮。
hintEnglish: Betting money hoping to win more by luck, which can become addictive.

exampleSimplified: 他们周末去澳门的赌场玩。
exampleTraditional: 他們週末去澳門的賭場玩。
exampleEnglish: They went to a casino in Macau for the weekend.
hintSimplified: 人们在里面用钱玩牌或机器碰运气的地方。
hintTraditional: 人們在裡面用錢玩牌或機器碰運氣的地方。
hintEnglish: A place where people play cards or machines with money, trusting luck.

exampleSimplified: 这个孩子坐得很端正，一动也不动。
exampleTraditional: 這個孩子坐得很端正，一動也不動。
exampleEnglish: This child sits properly upright without moving at all.
hintSimplified: 形容姿势、五官或态度不歪斜，很正。
hintTraditional: 形容姿勢、五官或態度不歪斜，很正。
hintEnglish: Describes posture, features or attitude that is not crooked, very upright.

exampleSimplified: 这个地区的水资源非常短缺。
exampleTraditional: 這個地區的水資源非常短缺。
exampleEnglish: Water resources in this region are extremely scarce.
hintSimplified: 需要的东西不够用，数量不足。
hintTraditional: 需要的東西不夠用，數量不足。
hintEnglish: Not enough of what is needed; the quantity is insufficient.

exampleSimplified: 人生很短暂，我们要好好珍惜。
exampleTraditional: 人生很短暫，我們要好好珍惜。
exampleEnglish: Life is brief, so we should cherish it.
hintSimplified: 形容时间很短，一下子就过去了。
hintTraditional: 形容時間很短，一下子就過去了。
hintEnglish: Describes time that is very short and passes in a moment.

exampleSimplified: 他和家人断绝了来往。
exampleTraditional: 他和家人斷絕了來往。
exampleEnglish: He cut off contact with his family.
hintSimplified: 完全结束彼此的关系或联系。
hintTraditional: 完全結束彼此的關係或聯絡。
hintEnglish: To completely end a relationship or connection with someone.

definition: accumulation; to heap; to pile up
exampleSimplified: 桌上堆积了很多没洗的碗。
exampleTraditional: 桌上堆積了很多沒洗的碗。
exampleEnglish: A lot of unwashed bowls have piled up on the table.
hintSimplified: 东西一层一层越放越多，聚在一起。
hintTraditional: 東西一層一層越放越多，聚在一起。
hintEnglish: Things gather layer by layer, growing in amount.

gloss: (in video games or fantasy settings etc) party
definition: (in video games or fantasy settings etc) party; line; procession; ranks; contingent; force; staff; team; troops; army
exampleSimplified: 游行的队伍从火车站一直排到公园。
exampleTraditional: 遊行的隊伍從火車站一直排到公園。
exampleEnglish: The line of marchers stretched from the train station all the way to the park.
hintSimplified: 排成一行一起走的一群人，也可指军人的集体。
hintTraditional: 排成一行一起走的一群人，也可指軍人的集體。
hintEnglish: A group of people walking together in a line, or a body of soldiers.

definition: (of a check etc) to cash; to honor a commitment
exampleSimplified: 老板终于兑现了他的承诺。
exampleTraditional: 老闆終於兌現了他的承諾。
exampleEnglish: The boss finally honored his promise.
hintSimplified: 答应的事情真正做到，或把票据换成现金。
hintTraditional: 答應的事情真正做到，或把票據換成現金。
hintEnglish: To really carry out what was promised, or to exchange a note for cash.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; contrast; ratio; to contrast
exampleSimplified: 两张照片的对比非常明显。
exampleTraditional: 兩張照片的對比非常明顯。
exampleEnglish: The contrast between the two photos is very obvious.
hintSimplified: 把两个东西放在一起看它们有什么不同。
hintTraditional: 把兩個東西放在一起看它們有什麼不同。
hintEnglish: Putting two things together to see how they differ.

definition: to check; to compare; to contrast; to place side by side for comparison (as parallel texts)
exampleSimplified: 请把译文和原文对照着看。
exampleTraditional: 請把譯文和原文對照著看。
exampleEnglish: Please read the translation alongside the original text.
hintSimplified: 把两份东西放在一起，一项一项地比较检查。
hintTraditional: 把兩份東西放在一起，一項一項地比較檢查。
hintEnglish: Putting two items together and comparing or checking them item by item.

definition: (fig.) to confront each other; (of mountains etc) to stand facing each other
exampleSimplified: 两支军队在河的两岸对峙了很久。
exampleTraditional: 兩支軍隊在河的兩岸對峙了很久。
exampleEnglish: The two armies stood in confrontation on opposite banks of the river for a long time.
hintSimplified: 双方互不让步，面对面僵持着。
hintTraditional: 雙方互不讓步，面對面僵持著。
hintEnglish: Two sides refuse to yield and stand facing each other in a stalemate.

exampleSimplified: 灯一关，房间顿时变得很安静。
exampleTraditional: 燈一關，房間頓時變得很安靜。
exampleEnglish: As soon as the light went off, the room suddenly became very quiet.
hintSimplified: 表示一件事发生后，马上出现了变化。
hintTraditional: 表示一件事發生後，馬上出現了變化。
hintEnglish: Indicates that right after something happened, a change appeared instantly.

exampleSimplified: 礼物的价值不能只看数量的多寡。
exampleTraditional: 禮物的價值不能只看數量的多寡。
exampleEnglish: A gift's value shouldn't be judged only by how much or how little there is.
hintSimplified: 指数量是多还是少。
hintTraditional: 指數量是多還是少。
hintEnglish: Refers to whether the quantity is large or small.

exampleSimplified: 多亏你提醒我,我才没有忘记带钥匙。
exampleTraditional: 多虧你提醒我,我才沒有忘記帶鑰匙。
exampleEnglish: Thanks to your reminder, I didn't forget to bring my keys.
hintSimplified: 别人帮了忙,事情才有好结果时,用来表示感谢或庆幸。
hintTraditional: 別人幫了忙,事情才有好結果時,用來表示感謝或慶幸。
hintEnglish: Used to express thanks or relief when someone's help led to a good outcome.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市的文化非常多元,什么人都有。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市的文化非常多元,什麼人都有。
exampleEnglish: This city's culture is very diverse, with all kinds of people.
hintSimplified: 形容事物有很多不同的种类、方面或来源,不是只有一种。
hintTraditional: 形容事物有很多不同的種類、方面或來源,不是隻有一種。
hintEnglish: Describes something with many different kinds, aspects or sources, not just one.

gloss: to win the championship; to take first place
definition: to win the championship; to take first place
exampleSimplified: 他在这次比赛中夺魁,大家都为他鼓掌。
exampleTraditional: 他在這次比賽中奪魁,大家都為他鼓掌。
exampleEnglish: He took first place in this competition, and everyone applauded him.
hintSimplified: 在比赛中打败所有人,得到第一名。
hintTraditional: 在比賽中打敗所有人,得到第一名。
hintEnglish: To beat everyone in a competition and get first place.

definition: to avoid (difficulties); to dodge; to evade; to hide; to take shelter
exampleSimplified: 下雨了,我们快躲避到那棵大树下面吧。
exampleTraditional: 下雨了,我們快躲避到那棵大樹下面吧。
exampleEnglish: It's raining, so let's quickly take shelter under that big tree.
hintSimplified: 为了不被危险、麻烦或雨淋到,走到别的地方或离开。
hintTraditional: 為了不被危險、麻煩或雨淋到,走到別的地方或離開。
hintEnglish: To move away or hide so as not to be hit by danger, trouble or rain.

definition: induced abortion; to induce an abortion
exampleSimplified: 医生建议她认真考虑后再决定要不要堕胎。
exampleTraditional: 醫生建議她認真考慮後再決定要不要墮胎。
exampleEnglish: The doctor advised her to think carefully before deciding whether to have an abortion.
hintSimplified: 一种医疗手术,在婴儿出生以前结束怀孕。
hintTraditional: 一種醫療手術,在嬰兒出生以前結束懷孕。
hintEnglish: A medical procedure that ends a pregnancy before the baby is born.

exampleSimplified: 加班的话,公司会给我额外的奖金。
exampleTraditional: 加班的話,公司會給我額外的獎金。
exampleEnglish: If I work overtime, the company gives me an extra bonus.
hintSimplified: 形容在原来规定的数量或范围之外,另外多出来的。
hintTraditional: 形容在原來規定的數量或範圍之外,另外多出來的。
hintEnglish: Describes something beyond the original amount or scope, added on top.

exampleSimplified: 天气越来越冷,他的病情也恶化了。
exampleTraditional: 天氣越來越冷,他的病情也惡化了。
exampleEnglish: The weather is getting colder, and his condition has worsened too.
hintSimplified: 情况从不好变得更不好。
hintTraditional: 情況從不好變得更不好。
hintEnglish: A situation going from bad to even worse.

definition: malignant; producing evil; rapid (decline); runaway (inflation); vicious (circle); wicked
exampleSimplified: 医生说这个肿瘤是恶性的,必须马上治疗。
exampleTraditional: 醫生說這個腫瘤是惡性的,必須馬上治療。
exampleEnglish: The doctor said this tumor is malignant and must be treated right away.
hintSimplified: 医学上形容很危险、会扩散、不容易治好的疾病。
hintTraditional: 醫學上形容很危險、會擴散、不容易治好的疾病。
hintEnglish: In medicine, describes a disease that is dangerous, spreads and is hard to cure.

exampleSimplified: 他在网络上留下恶意的评论,伤害了很多人。
exampleTraditional: 他在網路上留下惡意的評論,傷害了很多人。
exampleEnglish: He left malicious comments online and hurt many people.
hintSimplified: 想要伤害别人或让别人难过的坏心思。
hintTraditional: 想要傷害別人或讓別人難過的壞心思。
hintEnglish: A bad intention to hurt others or make them unhappy.

definition: conjugal love; loving affection (in a couple)
exampleSimplified: 爷爷和奶奶结婚五十年了,一直很恩爱。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺和奶奶結婚五十年了,一直很恩愛。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa and Grandma have been married for fifty years and are still very loving.
hintSimplified: 形容夫妻感情很好,彼此关心、很亲密。
hintTraditional: 形容夫妻感情很好,彼此關心、很親密。
hintEnglish: Describes a married couple who are very close and affectionate.

exampleSimplified: 父母对我的恩情,我一辈子都报答不完。
exampleTraditional: 父母對我的恩情,我一輩子都報答不完。
exampleEnglish: I could never finish repaying my parents for their kindness and love.
hintSimplified: 别人帮助或养育你,让你心里一直感激的深厚感情。
hintTraditional: 別人幫助或養育你,讓你心裡一直感激的深厚感情。
hintEnglish: The deep feeling of gratitude toward someone who helped or raised you.

definition: a benefactor; a person who has significantly helped sb else
exampleSimplified: 他在我最困难的时候帮助我,是我的恩人。
exampleTraditional: 他在我最困難的時候幫助我,是我的恩人。
exampleEnglish: He helped me when I was in the greatest difficulty; he is my benefactor.
hintSimplified: 在你很需要的时候,给你重要帮助的人。
hintTraditional: 在你很需要的時候,給你重要幫助的人。
hintEnglish: A person who gave you important help when you needed it most.

definition: gratitude and grudges; grievances; grudges; resentment
exampleSimplified: 两家人多年的恩怨,终于在今天化解了。
exampleTraditional: 兩家人多年的恩怨,終於在今天化解了。
exampleEnglish: The years of grievances and favors between the two families were finally resolved today.
hintSimplified: 人与人之间过去的感激与仇恨混在一起的关系。
hintTraditional: 人與人之間過去的感激與仇恨混在一起的關係。
hintEnglish: The mixed history of gratitude and resentment between people.

exampleSimplified: 我不是不想去,而是今天真的太累了。
exampleTraditional: 我不是不想去,而是今天真的太累了。
exampleEnglish: It's not that I don't want to go, but that I'm really too tired today.
hintSimplified: 常跟“不是”一起用,否定前面的说法,再说出真正的情况。
hintTraditional: 常跟“不是”一起用,否定前面的說法,再說出真正的情況。
hintEnglish: Often used after a negation to deny one idea and state the real situation.

gloss: (typically preceded by 就…[jiu4 xx5] or 對…|对…[dui4 xx5] etc) as far as ... is concerned; speaking in terms of ...
definition: (typically preceded by 就…[jiu4 xx5] or 對…|对…[dui4 xx5] etc) as far as ... is concerned; speaking in terms of ...
exampleSimplified: 就学生而言,最重要的是养成好习惯。
exampleTraditional: 就學生而言,最重要的是養成好習慣。
exampleEnglish: As far as students are concerned, the most important thing is to form good habits.
hintSimplified: 放在句中,表示从某个人或某个角度来看这件事。
hintTraditional: 放在句中,表示從某個人或某個角度來看這件事。
hintEnglish: Used in a sentence to introduce the viewpoint of a person or perspective.

gloss: a young man and a young woman (in love)
definition: a young man and a young woman (in love); children; sons and daughters
exampleSimplified: 父母辛苦工作,就是为了儿女能过得更好。
exampleTraditional: 父母辛苦工作,就是為了兒女能過得更好。
exampleEnglish: Parents work hard so that their sons and daughters can live better.
hintSimplified: 指父母所生的男孩和女孩,合起来的说法。
hintTraditional: 指父母所生的男孩和女孩,合起來的說法。
hintEnglish: A collective word for a person's sons and daughters.

definition: CL:記|记[ji4]; a slap on the face
exampleSimplified: 他生气地打了对方一耳光。
exampleTraditional: 他生氣地打了對方一耳光。
exampleEnglish: He angrily slapped the other person in the face.
hintSimplified: 用手掌打在别人脸颊上,发出很响的声音。
hintTraditional: 用手掌打在別人臉頰上,發出很響的聲音。
hintEnglish: A hit with the palm on someone's cheek that makes a loud sound.

definition: to generate electricity; to send a telegram
exampleSimplified: 这座水坝可以发电,供应附近的城市使用。
exampleTraditional: 這座水壩可以發電,供應附近的城市使用。
exampleEnglish: This dam can generate electricity for the nearby cities.
hintSimplified: 利用水力、风力或燃料,制造出家里和工厂用的能源。
hintTraditional: 利用水力、風力或燃料,製造出家裡和工廠用的能源。
hintEnglish: Using water, wind or fuel to produce the energy that homes and factories use.

definition: to go crazy; to go mad; to lose one's mind
exampleSimplified: 听到这个坏消息,他差点发疯。
exampleTraditional: 聽到這個壞訊息,他差點發瘋。
exampleEnglish: Hearing this bad news, he nearly went crazy.
hintSimplified: 因为压力或情绪太大,行为变得不正常,像失去理智。
hintTraditional: 因為壓力或情緒太大,行為變得不正常,像失去理智。
hintEnglish: Behaving abnormally, as if losing reason, because of too much pressure or emotion.

definition: (fig.) to unearth; to excavate; to explore; to tap into
exampleSimplified: 老师善于发掘学生的才能。
exampleTraditional: 老師善於發掘學生的才能。
exampleEnglish: The teacher is good at discovering students' talents.
hintSimplified: 把藏起来、还没被人注意的人才或东西找出来。
hintTraditional: 把藏起來、還沒被人注意的人才或東西找出來。
hintEnglish: To find talent or things that were hidden and not yet noticed.

definition: to pledge; to swear; to vow
exampleSimplified: 他发誓以后再也不迟到了。
exampleTraditional: 他發誓以後再也不遲到了。
exampleEnglish: He swore he would never be late again.
hintSimplified: 很认真地说出自己一定会做到某件事的话。
hintTraditional: 很認真地說出自己一定會做到某件事的話。
hintEnglish: To solemnly say that you will definitely do something.

definition: (sexually) mature; development; growth; to develop; to mature
exampleSimplified: 青少年正在发育,需要充足的睡眠和营养。
exampleTraditional: 青少年正在發育,需要充足的睡眠和營養。
exampleEnglish: Teenagers are developing and need enough sleep and nutrition.
hintSimplified: 人或动植物的身体慢慢长大、成熟的过程。
hintTraditional: 人或動植物的身體慢慢長大、成熟的過程。
hintEnglish: The process by which a person, animal or plant grows and matures.

gloss: to flare up; to break out
definition: to flare up; to break out
exampleSimplified: 他的胃病又发作了,疼得睡不着觉。
exampleTraditional: 他的胃病又發作了,疼得睡不著覺。
exampleEnglish: His stomach trouble flared up again, and the pain kept him from sleeping.
hintSimplified: 病痛或坏脾气突然出现,让人受不了。
hintTraditional: 病痛或壞脾氣突然出現,讓人受不了。
hintEnglish: When an illness or a bad temper suddenly appears and is hard to bear.

exampleSimplified: 在台湾,法定结婚年龄是十八岁。
exampleTraditional: 在台灣,法定結婚年齡是十八歲。
exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, the legal age for marriage is eighteen.
hintSimplified: 形容由法律规定的,不是个人随便决定的。
hintTraditional: 形容由法律規定的,不是個人隨便決定的。
hintEnglish: Describes something set by law, not decided by individuals.

exampleSimplified: 法官仔细听完双方的说法,才做出判决。
exampleTraditional: 法官仔細聽完雙方的說法,才做出判決。
exampleEnglish: The judge listened carefully to both sides before making a ruling.
hintSimplified: 在法庭上听案子并做出决定的人。
hintTraditional: 在法庭上聽案子並做出決定的人。
hintEnglish: The person in a courtroom who hears a case and makes the decision.

exampleSimplified: 政府发布了新的法令，禁止在公园里抽烟。
exampleTraditional: 政府釋出了新的法令，禁止在公園裡抽菸。
exampleEnglish: The government issued a new decree banning smoking in parks.
hintSimplified: 政府正式公布、大家必须遵守的规定。
hintTraditional: 政府正式公佈、大家必須遵守的規定。
hintEnglish: A rule officially announced by the government that everyone must obey.

definition: corporation; legal person; see also 自然人[zi4 ran2 ren2]
exampleSimplified: 这家公司是一个法人，可以自己签合约。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司是一個法人，可以自己籤合約。
exampleEnglish: This company is a legal entity and can sign contracts by itself.
hintSimplified: 在法律上像一个人一样，可以拥有财产和签约的组织。
hintTraditional: 在法律上像一個人一樣，可以擁有財產和簽約的組織。
hintEnglish: An organization that, in law, is treated like a person able to own property and sign contracts.

exampleSimplified: 科学家一直在寻找自然界的法则。
exampleTraditional: 科學家一直在尋找自然界的法則。
exampleEnglish: Scientists are always searching for the laws of nature.
hintSimplified: 事物运行或发展时固定的规律或准则。
hintTraditional: 事物執行或發展時固定的規律或準則。
hintEnglish: A fixed principle or regularity by which things operate or develop.

definition: legal system and institutions; made in France
exampleSimplified: 一个国家需要健全的法制，社会才会安定。
exampleTraditional: 一個國家需要健全的法制，社會才會安定。
exampleEnglish: A country needs a sound legal system for society to be stable.
hintSimplified: 一个国家的法律和相关制度的总称。
hintTraditional: 一個國家的法律和相關制度的總稱。
hintEnglish: The laws and related institutions of a country taken together.

definition: rule of law; to rule by law
exampleSimplified: 法治的精神是人人在法律面前平等。
exampleTraditional: 法治的精神是人人在法律面前平等。
exampleEnglish: The spirit of the rule of law is that everyone is equal before the law.
hintSimplified: 用法律而不是个人权力来管理国家的方式。
hintTraditional: 用法律而不是個人權力來管理國家的方式。
hintEnglish: A way of governing a country by law rather than by personal power.

gloss: to fall out with sb; to become hostile
definition: to fall out with sb; to become hostile
exampleSimplified: 他们为了钱的事吵了一架，后来就翻脸了。
exampleTraditional: 他們為了錢的事吵了一架，後來就翻臉了。
exampleEnglish: They argued over money and later fell out with each other.
hintSimplified: 朋友之间突然变得不友好，关系破裂。
hintTraditional: 朋友之間突然變得不友好，關係破裂。
hintEnglish: When friends suddenly turn unfriendly and their relationship breaks down.

definition: (fig.) to free oneself; to bring about a change of one's fortunes; to emancipate oneself; to turn over (when lying)
exampleSimplified: 经过多年努力，他终于翻身，不再那么穷了。
exampleTraditional: 經過多年努力，他終於翻身，不再那麼窮了。
exampleEnglish: After years of effort, he finally turned his life around and was no longer so poor.
hintSimplified: 从困难或不好的处境中摆脱出来；睡觉时也可以转动身体。
hintTraditional: 從困難或不好的處境中擺脫出來；睡覺時也可以轉動身體。
hintEnglish: To escape from a difficult situation; also what you do in bed to turn over.

definition: a face-lift; newly emerging; to refurbish (old clothes); to retread (a tire); to revamp
exampleSimplified: 这间老房子翻新以后，看起来像新的一样。
exampleTraditional: 這間老房子翻新以後，看起來像新的一樣。
exampleEnglish: After being renovated, this old house looks like new.
hintSimplified: 把旧的东西整理修补，让它看起来像新的。
hintTraditional: 把舊的東西整理修補，讓它看起來像新的。
hintEnglish: To fix up something old so it looks like new.

definition: many and varied; of many different kinds
exampleSimplified: 夜市里的小吃种类繁多，让人不知道怎么选。
exampleTraditional: 夜市裡的小吃種類繁多，讓人不知道怎麼選。
exampleEnglish: The snacks at the night market are so varied that you don't know how to choose.
hintSimplified: 形容种类或数量非常多、很复杂。
hintTraditional: 形容種類或數量非常多、很複雜。
hintEnglish: Describes things that are very numerous in kind and complicated.

gloss: traditional form of Chinese, as opposed to simplified form 簡體|简体[jian3 ti3]
definition: traditional form of Chinese, as opposed to simplified form 簡體|简体[jian3 ti3]
exampleSimplified: 台湾平常使用繁体字，不用简体字。
exampleTraditional: 台灣平常使用繁體字，不用簡體字。
exampleEnglish: Taiwan normally uses traditional characters, not simplified ones.
hintSimplified: 笔画比较多的中文字形，和简化字相对。
hintTraditional: 筆畫比較多的中文字形，和簡化字相對。
hintEnglish: The form of Chinese characters with more strokes, as opposed to the simplified ones.

exampleSimplified: 网络打破了国家之间的藩篱，让大家更容易交流。
exampleTraditional: 網路打破了國家之間的藩籬，讓大家更容易交流。
exampleEnglish: The internet has broken down barriers between countries and made communication easier.
hintSimplified: 比喻阻碍人们往来或交流的界线或限制。
hintTraditional: 比喻阻礙人們往來或交流的界線或限制。
hintEnglish: Figuratively, a boundary or limit that keeps people from interacting.

gloss: each and every; every; all; any
definition: each and every; every; all; any
exampleSimplified: 凡是迟到的同学，都要在门口登记。
exampleTraditional: 凡是遲到的同學，都要在門口登記。
exampleEnglish: Every student who is late must sign in at the door.
hintSimplified: 用在句首，表示符合某个条件的全部人或事都一样。
hintTraditional: 用在句首，表示符合某個條件的全部人或事都一樣。
hintEnglish: Used at the start of a sentence to say that everyone or everything meeting a condition is treated the same.

gloss: to strike back; to beat back; to counterattack
definition: to strike back; to beat back; to counterattack
exampleSimplified: 对方先攻击，我们的球队马上展开反击。
exampleTraditional: 對方先攻擊，我們的球隊馬上展開反擊。
exampleEnglish: The other side attacked first, and our team immediately counterattacked.
hintSimplified: 被攻击以后，用力打回去。
hintTraditional: 被攻擊以後，用力打回去。
hintEnglish: After being attacked, to hit back hard.

definition: reflection (from a mirror etc); reflex (i.e. automatic reaction of organism); to reflect
exampleSimplified: 阳光照在湖面上，产生了强烈的反射。
exampleTraditional: 陽光照在湖面上，產生了強烈的反射。
exampleEnglish: Sunlight shining on the lake surface produced a strong reflection.
hintSimplified: 光碰到镜子或水面后又弹回来的现象。
hintTraditional: 光碰到鏡子或水面後又彈回來的現象。
hintEnglish: The phenomenon of light bouncing back after hitting a mirror or water surface.

definition: to examine one's conscience; to question oneself; to reflect upon oneself; to search one's soul
exampleSimplified: 做错事以后，你应该好好反省一下。
exampleTraditional: 做錯事以後，你應該好好反省一下。
exampleEnglish: After doing something wrong, you should reflect on yourself carefully.
hintSimplified: 回头想想自己做错了什么，思考如何改进。
hintTraditional: 回頭想想自己做錯了什麼，思考如何改進。
hintEnglish: To think back on what you did wrong and consider how to improve.

exampleSimplified: 多运动对身体好；反之，常常不动会影响健康。
exampleTraditional: 多運動對身體好；反之，常常不動會影響健康。
exampleEnglish: Exercising more is good for the body; conversely, rarely moving harms health.
hintSimplified: 用来引出和前面意思相反的情况的连接词。
hintTraditional: 用來引出和前面意思相反的情況的連線詞。
hintEnglish: A connecting word that introduces the opposite of what was just said.

definition: a foul; an illegality; to break the rules
exampleSimplified: 他在比赛中犯规，裁判给了他一张黄牌。
exampleTraditional: 他在比賽中犯規，裁判給了他一張黃牌。
exampleEnglish: He committed a foul in the match and the referee gave him a yellow card.
hintSimplified: 比赛时做了规则不允许的动作。
hintTraditional: 比賽時做了規則不允許的動作。
hintEnglish: To do something in a game that the rules do not allow.

definition: drugs trade; opium trade; to traffic narcotics
exampleSimplified: 警察抓到了一个贩毒的集团。
exampleTraditional: 警察抓到了一個販毒的集團。
exampleEnglish: The police caught a gang involved in drug trafficking.
hintSimplified: 非法买卖危害健康的违禁药品。
hintTraditional: 非法買賣危害健康的違禁藥品。
hintEnglish: The illegal buying and selling of harmful banned substances.

definition: to peddle; to sell; to traffic
exampleSimplified: 这家商店不能贩卖酒给未成年的孩子。
exampleTraditional: 這家商店不能販賣酒給未成年的孩子。
exampleEnglish: This store may not sell alcohol to minors.
hintSimplified: 把东西买进来再卖出去赚钱，常用于商品。
hintTraditional: 把東西買進來再賣出去賺錢，常用於商品。
hintEnglish: To buy goods and resell them for profit.

definition: azimuth; bearing; direction; points of the compass; position
exampleSimplified: 请告诉我这个地点的具体方位，我想在地图上找到它。
exampleTraditional: 請告訴我這個地點的具體方位，我想在地圖上找到它。
exampleEnglish: Please tell me the exact position of this place; I want to find it on the map.
hintSimplified: 东、南、西、北等表示物体所在位置的方向。
hintTraditional: 東、南、西、北等表示物體所在位置的方向。
hintEnglish: The direction, such as east, south, west or north, in which something is located.

exampleSimplified: 学校制定了新的教育方针，重视孩子的兴趣。
exampleTraditional: 學校制定了新的教育方針，重視孩子的興趣。
exampleEnglish: The school set a new educational policy that values children's interests.
hintSimplified: 国家或机构为了达到目标而定的行动方向和原则。
hintTraditional: 國家或機構為了達到目標而定的行動方向和原則。
hintEnglish: The guiding direction and principles set by a country or organization to reach its goals.

definition: clear and square; neat; see 方正縣|方正县[Fang1 zheng4 Xian4]; square (person)
exampleSimplified: 他有一张方正的脸，看起来很可靠。
exampleTraditional: 他有一張方正的臉，看起來很可靠。
exampleEnglish: He has a squarish face and looks very reliable.
hintSimplified: 形容形状端正、四四方方，也可形容人正直。
hintTraditional: 形容形狀端正、四四方方，也可形容人正直。
hintEnglish: Describes a shape that is neat and squared, or a person who is upright.

exampleSimplified: 请不要停在路口，这样会妨碍交通。
exampleTraditional: 請不要停在路口，這樣會妨礙交通。
exampleEnglish: Please don't park at the intersection; it will obstruct traffic.
hintSimplified: 让别人的事情不能顺利进行。
hintTraditional: 讓別人的事情不能順利進行。
hintEnglish: To keep someone else's affairs from going smoothly.

exampleSimplified: 出门带把伞，以防备突然下雨。
exampleTraditional: 出門帶把傘，以防備突然下雨。
exampleEnglish: Take an umbrella when you go out to be prepared in case it suddenly rains.
hintSimplified: 事先做好准备，小心可能发生的坏事。
hintTraditional: 事先做好準備，小心可能發生的壞事。
hintEnglish: To prepare in advance and be careful about bad things that might happen.

definition: preventive; to be on guard; to guard against; wariness
exampleSimplified: 大家要提高警觉，防范网络诈骗。
exampleTraditional: 大家要提高警覺，防範網路詐騙。
exampleEnglish: Everyone should be more alert and guard against online scams.
hintSimplified: 事先小心，避免坏事或犯罪发生。
hintTraditional: 事先小心，避免壞事或犯罪發生。
hintEnglish: To be careful in advance to keep bad events or crimes from happening.

exampleSimplified: 这款手表可以防水，游泳的时候也能戴。
exampleTraditional: 這款手錶可以防水，游泳的時候也能戴。
exampleEnglish: This watch is waterproof, so you can wear it even when swimming.
hintSimplified: 雨衣和某些手机有这种功能，水不会渗进去。
hintTraditional: 雨衣和某些手機有這種功能，水不會滲進去。
hintEnglish: Raincoats and some phones have this feature: water cannot get inside.

exampleSimplified: 他为了保护家人，不得不正当防卫。
exampleTraditional: 他為了保護家人，不得不正當防衛。
exampleEnglish: To protect his family, he had no choice but to act in legitimate self-defense.
hintSimplified: 保护自己或别人，不让坏人伤害，常和法律有关。
hintTraditional: 保護自己或別人，不讓壞人傷害，常和法律有關。
hintEnglish: Protecting oneself or others from being harmed by bad people; often related to the law.

exampleSimplified: 这支球队的防御很强，对手很难得分。
exampleTraditional: 這支球隊的防禦很強，對手很難得分。
exampleEnglish: This team's defense is very strong, and it is hard for opponents to score.
hintSimplified: 球赛或军事中，抵挡对方进攻的做法。
hintTraditional: 球賽或軍事中，抵擋對方進攻的做法。
hintEnglish: In a ball game or the military, the act of resisting the other side's attack.

definition: prevention and cure; to prevent and cure
exampleSimplified: 政府正在努力防治登革热。
exampleTraditional: 政府正在努力防治登革熱。
exampleEnglish: The government is working hard to prevent and control dengue fever.
hintSimplified: 对疾病或虫害，先预防，再想办法处理。
hintTraditional: 對疾病或蟲害，先預防，再想辦法處理。
hintEnglish: For diseases or pests: first prevent them, then find ways to deal with them.

exampleSimplified: 这个包是仿冒品，不是真正的名牌。
exampleTraditional: 這個包是仿冒品，不是真正的名牌。
exampleEnglish: This bag is a counterfeit, not a real brand-name product.
hintSimplified: 假装成有名牌子的东西来卖，是不合法的。
hintTraditional: 假裝成有名牌子的東西來賣，是不合法的。
hintEnglish: Pretending to be a famous brand in order to sell things; it is illegal.

definition: to copy; to counterfeit; to produce sth after a model
exampleSimplified: 这座古董花瓶是后人仿造的。
exampleTraditional: 這座古董花瓶是後人仿造的。
exampleEnglish: This antique vase was made as an imitation by later people.
hintSimplified: 照着原来的东西做出一个很像的。
hintTraditional: 照著原來的東西做出一個很像的。
hintEnglish: Making something that looks very much like the original, following it as a model.

exampleSimplified: 台湾的纺织工业以前非常发达。
exampleTraditional: 台灣的紡織工業以前非常發達。
exampleEnglish: Taiwan's textile industry used to be very developed.
hintSimplified: 把棉花或线做成布的工业。
hintTraditional: 把棉花或線做成布的工業。
hintEnglish: The industry that turns cotton or thread into cloth.

exampleSimplified: 他年轻时过着放荡的生活，什么都不在乎。
exampleTraditional: 他年輕時過著放蕩的生活，什麼都不在乎。
exampleEnglish: When young, he lived a dissolute life and cared about nothing.
hintSimplified: 形容人行为不检点，不受规矩约束，生活很随便。
hintTraditional: 形容人行為不檢點，不受規矩約束，生活很隨便。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose behavior is unrestrained and undisciplined, with a very loose lifestyle.

definition: to broaden; to ease (restrictions); to expand; to extend (a time limit); to let out (a garment); to relax (a rule)
exampleSimplified: 政府决定放宽签证的限制。
exampleTraditional: 政府決定放寬簽證的限制。
exampleEnglish: The government decided to relax visa restrictions.
hintSimplified: 把原来很严格的规定变得没那么严。
hintTraditional: 把原來很嚴格的規定變得沒那麼嚴。
hintEnglish: Making a formerly strict rule less strict.

gloss: to lend money (as a commercial loan)
definition: to lend money (as a commercial loan)
exampleSimplified: 银行今年放款给很多小公司。
exampleTraditional: 銀行今年放款給很多小公司。
exampleEnglish: This year the bank lent money to many small companies.
hintSimplified: 银行把钱借给客户，以后要收利息。
hintTraditional: 銀行把錢借給客戶，以後要收利息。
hintEnglish: A bank lends money to customers and will collect interest later.

definition: to ignore; to indulge; to let alone
exampleSimplified: 父母不能放任孩子整天玩手机。
exampleTraditional: 父母不能放任孩子整天玩手機。
exampleEnglish: Parents shouldn't let their children play on their phones all day unchecked.
hintSimplified: 看到问题也不管，让事情自己发展。
hintTraditional: 看到問題也不管，讓事情自己發展。
hintEnglish: Seeing a problem but not stepping in, letting things take their own course.

gloss: to project (an image onto a screen); to show (a movie, slide etc)
definition: to project (an image onto a screen); to show (a movie, slide etc)
exampleSimplified: 这部电影下个月在全台湾戏院放映。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影下個月在全台灣戲院放映。
exampleEnglish: This movie will be shown in theaters across Taiwan next month.
hintSimplified: 电影院把影片打在大银幕上给观众看。
hintTraditional: 電影院把影片打在大銀幕上給觀眾看。
hintEnglish: A cinema puts a film on the big screen for the audience.

definition: to banish; to be marooned; to deport; to send into exile
exampleSimplified: 古代的官员犯了错，可能会被放逐到很远的地方。
exampleTraditional: 古代的官員犯了錯，可能會被放逐到很遠的地方。
exampleEnglish: In ancient times, officials who made mistakes might be banished to faraway places.
hintSimplified: 把人赶出家乡或国家，让他不能回来。
hintTraditional: 把人趕出家鄉或國家，讓他不能回來。
hintEnglish: Driving a person out of his homeland or country so he cannot return.

definition: out of the ordinary; unusually (good, talented etc)
exampleSimplified: 这位钢琴家的表演非常非凡，观众都站起来鼓掌。
exampleTraditional: 這位鋼琴家的表演非常非凡，觀眾都站起來鼓掌。
exampleEnglish: This pianist's performance was extraordinary, and the audience stood up to applaud.
hintSimplified: 形容人或事情特别好，和一般的很不一样。
hintTraditional: 形容人或事情特別好，和一般的很不一樣。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or thing that is especially good and very different from the usual.

exampleSimplified: 新闻说军队正在测试一种新型飞弹。
exampleTraditional: 新聞說軍隊正在測試一種新型飛彈。
exampleEnglish: The news says the military is testing a new type of missile.
hintSimplified: 一种可以飞很远、用来攻击目标的武器。
hintTraditional: 一種可以飛很遠、用來攻擊目標的武器。
hintEnglish: A weapon that can fly a long distance and is used to strike a target.

definition: (coll.) razor-sharp; at lightning speed; very fast
exampleSimplified: 时间过得飞快，一转眼就到了年底。
exampleTraditional: 時間過得飛快，一轉眼就到了年底。
exampleEnglish: Time flies by; before we knew it, it was the end of the year.
hintSimplified: 形容速度非常高，几乎看不清楚。
hintTraditional: 形容速度非常高，幾乎看不清楚。
hintEnglish: Describes a very high speed, so fast you can hardly see it.

definition: to circle in the air; to soar
exampleSimplified: 老鹰在蓝天里自由地飞翔。
exampleTraditional: 老鷹在藍天裡自由地飛翔。
exampleEnglish: The eagle soars freely in the blue sky.
hintSimplified: 鸟张开翅膀在天空中轻松地移动。
hintTraditional: 鳥張開翅膀在天空中輕鬆地移動。
hintEnglish: A bird spreads its wings and moves effortlessly through the sky.

exampleSimplified: 从台北到东京的飞行时间大约三个小时。
exampleTraditional: 從台北到東京的飛行時間大約三個小時。
exampleEnglish: The flight time from Taipei to Tokyo is about three hours.
hintSimplified: 飞机在空中前进的过程。
hintTraditional: 飛機在空中前進的過程。
hintEnglish: The process of an airplane moving forward in the air.

exampleSimplified: 农夫在田里撒了很多肥料，让菜长得更好。
exampleTraditional: 農夫在田裡撒了很多肥料，讓菜長得更好。
exampleEnglish: The farmer spread a lot of fertilizer in the field to help the vegetables grow better.
hintSimplified: 农民放在土里，让植物长得更快更大的东西。
hintTraditional: 農民放在土裡，讓植物長得更快更大的東西。
hintEnglish: Something farmers put in the soil to help plants grow faster and bigger.

definition: to abolish; to abrogate; to repeal
exampleSimplified: 这个国家已经废除了死刑。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家已經廢除了死刑。
exampleEnglish: This country has already abolished the death penalty.
hintSimplified: 正式取消旧的法律或制度，以后不再使用。
hintTraditional: 正式取消舊的法律或制度，以後不再使用。
hintEnglish: Officially cancelling an old law or system so it is no longer used.

definition: to abandon (old ways); to discard; to invalidate
exampleSimplified: 那座废弃的工厂已经很多年没有人使用了。
exampleTraditional: 那座廢棄的工廠已經很多年沒有人使用了。
exampleEnglish: That abandoned factory hasn't been used by anyone for many years.
hintSimplified: 东西不再有用，被丢在一边没人管。
hintTraditional: 東西不再有用，被丟在一邊沒人管。
hintEnglish: Something no longer useful, left aside with no one taking care of it.

exampleSimplified: 地震以后，整个村子变成了一片废墟。
exampleTraditional: 地震以後，整個村子變成了一片廢墟。
exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, the whole village turned into ruins.
hintSimplified: 房子或城市被破坏后，剩下的破碎景象。
hintTraditional: 房子或城市被破壞後，剩下的破碎景象。
hintEnglish: The broken scene left after buildings or a city have been destroyed.

definition: abolition; annulled; to put an end to; to repeal (a law)
exampleSimplified: 这条旧法律已经在去年正式废止。
exampleTraditional: 這條舊法律已經在去年正式廢止。
exampleEnglish: This old law was formally repealed last year.
hintSimplified: 法律或规定不再有效，被正式停止。
hintTraditional: 法律或規定不再有效，被正式停止。
hintEnglish: A law or regulation is no longer valid and is formally stopped.

gloss: to expend a great deal of effort
definition: to expend a great deal of effort
exampleSimplified: 这个箱子太重了，搬起来很费力。
exampleTraditional: 這個箱子太重了，搬起來很費力。
exampleEnglish: This box is too heavy, so it takes a lot of effort to carry.
hintSimplified: 做一件事需要花很多力气，让人觉得很累。
hintTraditional: 做一件事需要花很多力氣，讓人覺得很累。
hintEnglish: Doing something takes a lot of strength and makes people feel very tired.

definition: (of a liquid) to boil; (of sentiments etc) to boil over; to be impassioned; to flare up
exampleSimplified: 水在一百度的时候会沸腾。
exampleTraditional: 水在一百度的時候會沸騰。
exampleEnglish: Water boils at one hundred degrees.
hintSimplified: 水加热到很高温度时，冒出很多泡泡的样子。
hintTraditional: 水加熱到很高溫度時，冒出很多泡泡的樣子。
hintEnglish: What water does when heated to a high temperature and many bubbles rise up.

exampleSimplified: 他得了肺炎,需要住院治疗。
exampleTraditional: 他得了肺炎,需要住院治療。
exampleEnglish: He has pneumonia and needs to be hospitalized.
hintSimplified: 这是一种让人咳嗽、发烧、呼吸困难的病,发生在胸部器官。
hintTraditional: 這是一種讓人咳嗽、發燒、呼吸困難的病,發生在胸部器官。
hintEnglish: An illness causing cough, fever and difficulty breathing, affecting an organ in the chest.

exampleSimplified: 这里的噪音超过八十分贝,太吵了。
exampleTraditional: 這裡的噪音超過八十分貝,太吵了。
exampleEnglish: The noise here exceeds eighty decibels; it's too loud.
hintSimplified: 这是测量声音大小的单位。
hintTraditional: 這是測量聲音大小的單位。
hintEnglish: A unit used to measure how loud a sound is.

definition: to distinguish; to differentiate; to resolve
exampleSimplified: 我分辨不出这两种茶有什么不同。
exampleTraditional: 我分辨不出這兩種茶有什麼不同。
exampleEnglish: I can't tell what the difference is between these two teas.
hintSimplified: 看出两样东西不一样,把它们区别开来。
hintTraditional: 看出兩樣東西不一樣,把它們區別開來。
hintEnglish: To see that two things are not the same and tell them apart.

definition: appropriate behavior; proper speech or action; propriety; within the norms
exampleSimplified: 他说话很有分寸,从不让人难堪。
exampleTraditional: 他說話很有分寸,從不讓人難堪。
exampleEnglish: He speaks with good judgment and never embarrasses anyone.
hintSimplified: 说话做事恰到好处,知道什么可以做、什么不可以做。
hintTraditional: 說話做事恰到好處,知道什麼可以做、什麼不可以做。
hintEnglish: Knowing the right limit in speech and behavior, what is or isn't appropriate.

gloss: to share (a burden, a cost, a responsibility)
definition: to share (a burden, a cost, a responsibility)
exampleSimplified: 室友们一起分担房租和生活费。
exampleTraditional: 室友們一起分擔房租和生活費。
exampleEnglish: The roommates share the rent and living expenses together.
hintSimplified: 大家一起承受费用或责任,不让一个人负责全部。
hintTraditional: 大家一起承受費用或責任,不讓一個人負責全部。
hintEnglish: Everyone takes on part of a cost or responsibility so one person doesn't bear it all.

definition: distribution; to assign (sb) to a job; to distribute
exampleSimplified: 老师把考卷分发给每个学生。
exampleTraditional: 老師把考卷分發給每個學生。
exampleEnglish: The teacher distributed the exam papers to every student.
hintSimplified: 把东西分开,交给不同的人或地方。
hintTraditional: 把東西分開,交給不同的人或地方。
hintEnglish: To hand out things to different people or places.

definition: to break up; to cut up
exampleSimplified: 这条河把城市分割成两个部分。
exampleTraditional: 這條河把城市分割成兩個部分。
exampleEnglish: This river divides the city into two parts.
hintSimplified: 把一个完整的东西切开,变成几块。
hintTraditional: 把一個完整的東西切開,變成幾塊。
hintEnglish: To cut a whole thing apart into several pieces.

exampleSimplified: 社会发展使贫富差距越来越分化。
exampleTraditional: 社會發展使貧富差距越來越分化。
exampleEnglish: Social development has made the gap between rich and poor increasingly polarized.
hintSimplified: 原本相近的事物,慢慢变得不一样,走向不同方向。
hintTraditional: 原本相近的事物,慢慢變得不一樣,走向不同方向。
hintEnglish: Things once similar gradually become different and go separate ways.

definition: classification; grade; rank; to classify; to grade; to rank
exampleSimplified: 电影要根据内容分级,保护小孩子。
exampleTraditional: 電影要根據內容分級,保護小孩子。
exampleEnglish: Movies must be rated by content to protect children.
hintSimplified: 按照程度或等级把东西分成不同类别。
hintTraditional: 按照程度或等級把東西分成不同類別。
hintEnglish: To sort things into different categories according to degree or level.

gloss: division of a large family into smaller groups
definition: division of a large family into smaller groups; to separate and live apart
exampleSimplified: 兄弟结婚后,就分家各自生活了。
exampleTraditional: 兄弟結婚後,就分家各自生活了。
exampleEnglish: After the brothers married, they split the household and lived separately.
hintSimplified: 一个大家庭的成员不再住在一起,财产也分开了。
hintTraditional: 一個大家庭的成員不再住在一起,財產也分開了。
hintEnglish: Members of a large family stop living together and divide the property.

definition: to break down; to decompose; to resolve
exampleSimplified: 水可以被电分解成氢和氧。
exampleTraditional: 水可以被電分解成氫和氧。
exampleEnglish: Water can be broken down into hydrogen and oxygen by electricity.
hintSimplified: 把一个整体拆成比较小的部分或成分。
hintTraditional: 把一個整體拆成比較小的部分或成分。
hintEnglish: To break a whole into smaller parts or components.

exampleSimplified: 战争让许多家庭被迫分离。
exampleTraditional: 戰爭讓許多家庭被迫分離。
exampleEnglish: The war forced many families to be separated.
hintSimplified: 原来在一起的人或东西离开了,不再连在一起。
hintTraditional: 原來在一起的人或東西離開了,不再連在一起。
hintEnglish: People or things that were together are no longer connected.

definition: fission; schism; to break up; to divide; to split up
exampleSimplified: 细胞不断分裂,身体才会长大。
exampleTraditional: 細胞不斷分裂,身體才會長大。
exampleEnglish: Cells keep dividing, and that is how the body grows.
hintSimplified: 一个东西裂开,变成两个或更多个。
hintTraditional: 一個東西裂開,變成兩個或更多個。
hintEnglish: One thing splits and becomes two or more.

exampleSimplified: 紧张时,身体会分泌更多汗水。
exampleTraditional: 緊張時,身體會分泌更多汗水。
exampleEnglish: When nervous, the body secretes more sweat.
hintSimplified: 身体里的腺体产生并排出液体,如激素或口水。
hintTraditional: 身體裡的腺體產生並排出液體,如激素或口水。
hintEnglish: Glands in the body produce and release fluids such as hormones or saliva.

definition: (chemistry) molecule; (math.) numerator of a fraction; Taiwan variant of 份子[fen4 zi5]; member of a class or group; people of a certain type; variant of 分子[fen4 zi3]
exampleSimplified: 水是由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成的分子。
exampleTraditional: 水是由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成的分子。
exampleEnglish: Water is a molecule made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
hintSimplified: 化学里由原子组成的很小的单位。
hintTraditional: 化學裡由原子組成的很小的單位。
hintEnglish: In chemistry, a very tiny unit made up of atoms.

exampleSimplified: 清明节时,我们去祖先的坟墓扫墓。
exampleTraditional: 清明節時,我們去祖先的墳墓掃墓。
exampleEnglish: During Tomb Sweeping Day, we visit our ancestors' graves.
hintSimplified: 人去世后被埋葬的地方。
hintTraditional: 人去世後被埋葬的地方。
hintEnglish: The place where a person is buried after death.

definition: emulsion; plaster; to paint; to whitewash
exampleSimplified: 我们请工人把客厅的墙壁粉刷一遍。
exampleTraditional: 我們請工人把客廳的牆壁粉刷一遍。
exampleEnglish: We asked workers to repaint the living room walls.
hintSimplified: 用刷子把油漆或白色涂料涂在墙上,让房子变新。
hintTraditional: 用刷子把油漆或白色塗料塗在牆上,讓房子變新。
hintEnglish: Using a brush to apply paint or white coating on walls to make a house look new.

gloss: (fig.) weight (importance, prestige, authority etc); (of written material) density
definition: (fig.) weight (importance, prestige, authority etc); (of written material) density; (food) portion size; (vector) component; quantity; weight; measure
exampleSimplified: 他在公司里很有分量,大家都听他的。
exampleTraditional: 他在公司裡很有分量,大家都聽他的。
exampleEnglish: He carries a lot of weight in the company; everyone listens to him.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人说的话或一件事有多重要、有多大影响力。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人說的話或一件事有多重要、有多大影響力。
hintEnglish: Describes how important or influential a person's words or a matter is.

definition: closed (i.e. isolated from outside input); to close down (an illegal venue); to close; to seal off
exampleSimplified: 这个村子很封闭,外人很少来。
exampleTraditional: 這個村子很封閉,外人很少來。
exampleEnglish: This village is very isolated; outsiders rarely come.
hintSimplified: 跟外面很少往来,不接受新的东西。
hintTraditional: 跟外面很少往來,不接受新的東西。
hintEnglish: Having little contact with the outside and not open to new things.

definition: to blockade; to lock down; to seal off
exampleSimplified: 警方封锁了道路,车子不能通过。
exampleTraditional: 警方封鎖了道路,車子不能透過。
exampleEnglish: The police sealed off the road, so cars couldn't pass.
hintSimplified: 用力量把路或地区围起来,不让人进出。
hintTraditional: 用力量把路或地區圍起來,不讓人進出。
hintEnglish: To block off a road or area so no one can enter or leave.

exampleSimplified: 门上贴着一张封条,谁也不能进去。
exampleTraditional: 門上貼著一張封條,誰也不能進去。
exampleEnglish: A seal strip is pasted on the door, so no one can go in.
hintSimplified: 贴在门或箱子上的纸条,表示不能随便打开。
hintTraditional: 貼在門或箱子上的紙條,表示不能隨便開啟。
hintEnglish: A paper strip stuck on a door or box showing it must not be opened.

gloss: fig. crisis (e.g. revolution, uprising, financial crisis etc)
definition: fig. crisis (e.g. revolution, uprising, financial crisis etc); storm; violent commotion
exampleSimplified: 海上的风暴让所有船只都回港了。
exampleTraditional: 海上的風暴讓所有船隻都回港了。
exampleEnglish: The storm at sea made all the ships return to port.
hintSimplified: 又大又猛的风雨天气,也可以比喻大的危机。
hintTraditional: 又大又猛的風雨天氣,也可以比喻大的危機。
hintEnglish: Fierce wind and rain; also used figuratively for a major crisis.

definition: craze or fad; tempest; wave (of popular sentiment etc)
exampleSimplified: 这个游戏在学生中引起一阵风潮。
exampleTraditional: 這個遊戲在學生中引起一陣風潮。
exampleEnglish: This game set off a craze among students.
hintSimplified: 短时间内很多人一起喜欢或模仿的流行现象。
hintTraditional: 短時間內很多人一起喜歡或模仿的流行現象。
hintEnglish: A trend that many people suddenly like or imitate for a while.

definition: grand (dialect); impressive (dialect); landscape; scene; sight; to be well-off; to be well-regarded; view
exampleSimplified: 台湾东部的风光非常美丽。
exampleTraditional: 台灣東部的風光非常美麗。
exampleEnglish: The scenery of eastern Taiwan is very beautiful.
hintSimplified: 一个地方的山水景色。
hintTraditional: 一個地方的山水景色。
hintEnglish: The natural views of mountains and water in a place.

definition: decency; public morals; to weather (rocks); wind erosion
exampleSimplified: 在庙里穿太暴露的衣服,有伤风化。
exampleTraditional: 在廟裡穿太暴露的衣服,有傷風化。
exampleEnglish: Wearing overly revealing clothes in a temple offends public decency.
hintSimplified: 社会认为好的道德和风俗习惯。
hintTraditional: 社會認為好的道德和風俗習慣。
hintEnglish: The good morals and customs that society regards as proper.

exampleSimplified: 今天风力很强,海边不适合骑车。
exampleTraditional: 今天風力很強,海邊不適合騎車。
exampleEnglish: The wind is very strong today, so the seaside isn't good for cycling.
hintSimplified: 气象报告里用来说空气流动有多强的力量。
hintTraditional: 氣象報告裡用來說空氣流動有多強的力量。
hintEnglish: In weather reports, it describes how strong the moving air is.

definition: current custom; current way of doing things
exampleSimplified: 年轻人之间流行一种新的生活风尚。
exampleTraditional: 年輕人之間流行一種新的生活風尚。
exampleEnglish: A new lifestyle trend is popular among young people.
hintSimplified: 某个时期社会上大家喜欢、模仿的风气或习惯。
hintTraditional: 某個時期社會上大家喜歡、模仿的風氣或習慣。
hintEnglish: The habits or tastes that people in society like and imitate during a certain period.

exampleSimplified: 他买房子以前,先请师傅看看风水。
exampleTraditional: 他買房子以前,先請師傅看看風水。
exampleEnglish: Before buying the house, he asked a master to check its feng shui.
hintSimplified: 传统上认为房子或坟墓的位置和方向会影响运气的学问。
hintTraditional: 傳統上認為房子或墳墓的位置和方向會影響運氣的學問。
hintEnglish: A traditional belief that the position and direction of a building affect one's luck.

definition: to be popular; to become fashionable; to catch on
exampleSimplified: 这种手机壳在年轻人中非常风行。
exampleTraditional: 這種手機殼在年輕人中非常風行。
exampleEnglish: This kind of phone case is very popular among young people.
hintSimplified: 某样东西很快被很多人接受和喜爱,到处都看得到。
hintTraditional: 某樣東西很快被很多人接受和喜愛,到處都看得到。
hintEnglish: Something quickly accepted and loved by many people, seen everywhere.

exampleSimplified: 锋面通过以后,台湾北部会下大雨。
exampleTraditional: 鋒面透過以後,台灣北部會下大雨。
exampleEnglish: After the front passes, northern Taiwan will have heavy rain.
hintSimplified: 冷空气和暖空气相遇的交界,常带来天气变化。
hintTraditional: 冷空氣和暖空氣相遇的交界,常帶來天氣變化。
hintEnglish: The boundary where cold and warm air meet, often bringing weather changes.

exampleSimplified: 妈妈为过年准备了一桌丰盛的晚餐。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽為過年準備了一桌豐盛的晚餐。
exampleEnglish: Mom prepared a lavish dinner for the New Year.
hintSimplified: 形容饭菜种类多、份量足,很豪华。
hintTraditional: 形容飯菜種類多、份量足,很豪華。
hintEnglish: Describes a meal with many dishes and generous portions.

exampleSimplified: 今年雨水够,农民们都获得了大丰收。
exampleTraditional: 今年雨水夠,農民們都獲得了大豐收。
exampleEnglish: There was enough rain this year, so the farmers all had a great harvest.
hintSimplified: 农作物长得好,农民收到很多粮食或水果。
hintTraditional: 農作物長得好,農民收到很多糧食或水果。
hintEnglish: Crops grow well and farmers gather plenty of grain or fruit.

definition: to consecrate; to dedicate; to devote; to offer respectfully
exampleSimplified: 她把一生都奉献给了教育工作。
exampleTraditional: 她把一生都奉獻給了教育工作。
exampleEnglish: She devoted her whole life to education.
hintSimplified: 不求回报,把时间、力量或心血给别人或某个事业。
hintTraditional: 不求回報,把時間、力量或心血給別人或某個事業。
hintEnglish: To give your time, energy or heart to others or a cause without expecting return.

definition: Taiwan pr. [feng4yang4]; to look after (elderly parents)
exampleSimplified: 孩子长大后,有责任奉养年老的父母。
exampleTraditional: 孩子長大後,有責任奉養年老的父母。
exampleEnglish: After growing up, children have a duty to support their elderly parents.
hintSimplified: 子女在经济和生活上照顾年老的长辈。
hintTraditional: 子女在經濟和生活上照顧年老的長輩。
hintEnglish: Children looking after elderly elders financially and in daily life.

exampleSimplified: 老和尚每天早上都在庙里念佛经。
exampleTraditional: 老和尚每天早上都在廟裡念佛經。
exampleEnglish: The old monk chants Buddhist scriptures in the temple every morning.
hintSimplified: 记载佛教教导的书,和尚常常诵读。
hintTraditional: 記載佛教教導的書,和尚常常誦讀。
hintEnglish: Books recording Buddhist teachings, often recited by monks.

definition: Buddhist image; CL:尊[zun1], 張|张[zhang1]; statue of Buddha or Bodhisattva
exampleSimplified: 庙里放着一尊很大的金色佛像。
exampleTraditional: 廟裡放著一尊很大的金色佛像。
exampleEnglish: A very large golden Buddha statue stands in the temple.
hintSimplified: 庙里供人拜的雕刻或塑造的人形,代表一位觉悟者。
hintTraditional: 廟裡供人拜的雕刻或塑造的人形,代表一位覺悟者。
hintEnglish: A carved or molded figure worshipped in temples, representing an enlightened one.

exampleSimplified: 委员会否决了这个预算计划。
exampleTraditional: 委員會否決了這個預算計劃。
exampleEnglish: The committee rejected this budget proposal.
hintSimplified: 开会投票时,不同意并使提案不能通过。
hintTraditional: 開會投票時,不同意並使提案不能透過。
hintEnglish: In a meeting vote, to refuse a proposal so that it does not pass.

exampleSimplified: 他对这个问题的看法太肤浅了。
exampleTraditional: 他對這個問題的看法太膚淺了。
exampleEnglish: His view of this problem is too superficial.
hintSimplified: 形容知识或想法不深入,只看到表面。
hintTraditional: 形容知識或想法不深入,只看到表面。
hintEnglish: Describes knowledge or ideas that aren't deep and only see the surface.

definition: barely enough to get by; perfunctory; to botch; to do sth half-heartedly or just for show; to elaborate (on a theme); to expound (the classics); to skimp
exampleSimplified: 你不要随便敷衍我,我要听真话。
exampleTraditional: 你不要隨便敷衍我,我要聽真話。
exampleEnglish: Don't just brush me off; I want to hear the truth.
hintSimplified: 做事或回答时不认真,随便应付过去。
hintTraditional: 做事或回答時不認真,隨便應付過去。
hintEnglish: Doing a task or answering carelessly, just to get by.

gloss: a captive (usu. a prisoner of war)
definition: a captive (usu. a prisoner of war); to take prisoner
exampleSimplified: 战争结束后,俘虏都被送回了家。
exampleTraditional: 戰爭結束後,俘虜都被送回了家。
exampleEnglish: After the war ended, the captives were all sent home.
hintSimplified: 战争中被对方抓住的人。
hintTraditional: 戰爭中被對方抓住的人。
hintEnglish: A person caught by the other side in a war.

gloss: (economics) (of a currency or rate etc) to float
definition: (economics) (of a currency or rate etc) to float; (fig.) to fluctuate; to rise and fall; to be changeable; to drift about; to move unsteadily
exampleSimplified: 最近汇率经常上下浮动。
exampleTraditional: 最近匯率經常上下浮動。
exampleEnglish: Exchange rates have been fluctuating up and down recently.
hintSimplified: 价格或数字不固定,会随情况上下变化。
hintTraditional: 價格或數字不固定,會隨情況上下變化。
hintEnglish: Prices or numbers are not fixed and rise and fall with conditions.

definition: to comply; to defer; to obey (an order)
exampleSimplified: 士兵必须服从长官的命令。
exampleTraditional: 士兵必須服從長官的命令。
exampleEnglish: Soldiers must obey their officers' orders.
hintSimplified: 听从上级或规定,照着去做,不反对。
hintTraditional: 聽從上級或規定,照著去做,不反對。
hintEnglish: To listen to a superior or rule and do as told without objecting.

exampleSimplified: 这家店专卖年轻人喜欢的服饰。
exampleTraditional: 這家店專賣年輕人喜歡的服飾。
exampleEnglish: This shop specializes in apparel that young people like.
hintSimplified: 衣服、帽子、鞋子和配件的总称。
hintTraditional: 衣服、帽子、鞋子和配件的總稱。
hintEnglish: A general term for clothes, hats, shoes and accessories.

exampleSimplified: 他因为犯罪,正在监狱里服刑。
exampleTraditional: 他因為犯罪,正在監獄裡服刑。
exampleEnglish: Because of his crime, he is serving his sentence in prison.
hintSimplified: 犯人被法院判决后,在监狱里度过规定的时间。
hintTraditional: 犯人被法院判決後,在監獄裡度過規定的時間。
hintEnglish: After a court ruling, a convict spends the set time in prison.

exampleSimplified: 今年房价上涨的幅度很大。
exampleTraditional: 今年房價上漲的幅度很大。
exampleEnglish: The extent of this year's rise in housing prices is large.
hintSimplified: 表示数量变化有多大的范围或程度。
hintTraditional: 表示數量變化有多大的範圍或程度。
hintEnglish: Indicates how big the range or degree of a change in quantity is.

exampleSimplified: 能有这么孝顺的孩子,是你的福气。
exampleTraditional: 能有這麼孝順的孩子,是你的福氣。
exampleEnglish: Having such a filial child is your good fortune.
hintSimplified: 指一个人拥有的好运和幸福。
hintTraditional: 指一個人擁有的好運和幸福。
hintEnglish: The good luck and happiness a person enjoys.

exampleSimplified: 手机的辐射对身体有影响吗?
exampleTraditional: 手機的輻射對身體有影響嗎?
exampleEnglish: Does the radiation from cell phones affect the body?
hintSimplified: 能量从中心向四周发出,太阳和核电厂都会有。
hintTraditional: 能量從中心向四周發出,太陽和核電廠都會有。
hintEnglish: Energy sent outward in all directions, as from the sun or a nuclear plant.

exampleSimplified: 爸爸用斧头把木头劈成小块。
exampleTraditional: 爸爸用斧頭把木頭劈成小塊。
exampleEnglish: Dad used an axe to chop the wood into small pieces.
hintSimplified: 一种有木柄和铁刃的工具,用来砍树或劈柴。
hintTraditional: 一種有木柄和鐵刃的工具,用來砍樹或劈柴。
hintEnglish: A tool with a wooden handle and iron blade used to chop trees or firewood.

definition: to bring up; to foster; to raise
exampleSimplified: 奶奶一个人把三个孙子抚养长大。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶一個人把三個孫子撫養長大。
exampleEnglish: Grandma raised three grandchildren all by herself.
hintSimplified: 父母或长辈照顾小孩,让他慢慢长大。
hintTraditional: 父母或長輩照顧小孩,讓他慢慢長大。
hintEnglish: Parents or elders caring for a child until he or she grows up.

definition: to foster; to nurture; to raise; to tend
exampleSimplified: 父母辛苦工作,就是为了抚育子女成才。
exampleTraditional: 父母辛苦工作,就是為了撫育子女成才。
exampleEnglish: Parents work hard in order to nurture their children to success.
hintSimplified: 用心照顾并教育小孩或幼小的生命,帮助成长。
hintTraditional: 用心照顧並教育小孩或幼小的生命,幫助成長。
hintEnglish: To carefully care for and educate a child or young life, helping it grow.

exampleSimplified: 冰箱里的水果放太久,已经腐烂了。
exampleTraditional: 冰箱裡的水果放太久,已經腐爛了。
exampleEnglish: The fruit in the fridge has been left too long and has rotted.
hintSimplified: 食物放太久会变成这样,发臭变坏。
hintTraditional: 食物放太久會變成這樣,發臭變壞。
hintEnglish: Food left too long becomes like this: it smells bad and spoils.

definition: corrosion; corruption; to corrode (degrade chemically); to rot
exampleSimplified: 海水会腐蚀铁做的船。
exampleTraditional: 海水會腐蝕鐵做的船。
