exampleEnglish: Seawater corrodes ships made of iron.
hintSimplified: 金属被酸或海水慢慢破坏,表面变坏。
hintTraditional: 金屬被酸或海水慢慢破壞,表面變壞。
hintEnglish: Metal is slowly destroyed by acid or seawater, and its surface deteriorates.

exampleSimplified: 那座腐朽的木桥已经不能走了。
exampleTraditional: 那座腐朽的木橋已經不能走了。
exampleEnglish: That decayed wooden bridge can no longer be walked on.
hintSimplified: 木头放久了变坏,或形容思想制度陈旧没落。
hintTraditional: 木頭放久了變壞,或形容思想制度陳舊沒落。
hintEnglish: Wood that has gone bad with age; also describes outdated, declining ideas or systems.

definition: payment; to pay a sum of money
exampleSimplified: 请您到柜台付款,谢谢。
exampleTraditional: 請您到櫃檯付款,謝謝。
exampleEnglish: Please pay at the counter, thank you.
hintSimplified: 买东西以后,要把钱交给店家。
hintTraditional: 買東西以後,要把錢交給店家。
hintEnglish: After buying something, you must hand the money over to the seller.

exampleSimplified: 这件事对公司的名声有负面影响。
exampleTraditional: 這件事對公司的名聲有負面影響。
exampleEnglish: This matter has a negative impact on the company's reputation.
hintSimplified: 和正面相反,指不好的、坏的一方面。
hintTraditional: 和正面相反,指不好的、壞的一方面。
hintEnglish: The opposite of the positive side; the bad aspect of something.

exampleSimplified: 他出生在一个富贵的家庭。
exampleTraditional: 他出生在一個富貴的家庭。
exampleEnglish: He was born into a wealthy and high-status family.
hintSimplified: 形容很有钱又有地位的生活。
hintTraditional: 形容很有錢又有地位的生活。
hintEnglish: Describes a life with both lots of money and high social standing.

definition: rich; wealthy; affluent; to be rich in; to be replete with
exampleSimplified: 这个国家的资源非常富有,人民生活很安定。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家的資源非常富有,人民生活很安定。
exampleEnglish: This country is very rich in resources, and its people live stable lives.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人或地方钱财很多,或者拥有很多某种好的东西。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人或地方錢財很多,或者擁有很多某種好的東西。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or place that has a lot of money, or an abundance of some good thing.

exampleSimplified: 那位妇人带着孩子在市场买菜。
exampleTraditional: 那位婦人帶著孩子在市場買菜。
exampleEnglish: That woman was buying vegetables at the market with her child.
hintSimplified: 指已经结婚的成年女性,比较书面。
hintTraditional: 指已經結婚的成年女性,比較書面。
hintEnglish: A grown woman, usually married; a somewhat literary term.

exampleSimplified: 我在信里附上了一张照片。
exampleTraditional: 我在信裡附上了一張照片。
exampleEnglish: I enclosed a photo in the letter.
hintSimplified: 写信或寄文件时,把另一份东西放在一起寄出。
hintTraditional: 寫信或寄檔案時,把另一份東西放在一起寄出。
hintEnglish: When sending a letter or document, putting another item along with it.

definition: anabiosis; to recover (health, economic); to resuscitate; variant of 復甦|复苏[fu4 su1]
exampleSimplified: 春天来了,大地开始复苏。
exampleTraditional: 春天來了,大地開始復甦。
exampleEnglish: Spring has come and the earth begins to revive.
hintSimplified: 冬天过后,万物重新有生命力;经济也可以这样变好。
hintTraditional: 冬天過後,萬物重新有生命力;經濟也可以這樣變好。
hintEnglish: After winter, everything regains life; an economy can also do this after a slump.

definition: recovery; to recover from illness; to restore (sth) to (its) former condition
exampleSimplified: 他的腿伤要三个月才能完全复原。
exampleTraditional: 他的腿傷要三個月才能完全復原。
exampleEnglish: His leg injury will take three months to fully heal.
hintSimplified: 生病或受伤后,慢慢回到原来的好状态。
hintTraditional: 生病或受傷後,慢慢回到原來的好狀態。
hintEnglish: After illness or injury, gradually returning to the original good condition.

definition: to assign; to bestow; to entrust (a task); to give
exampleSimplified: 这份工作赋予她很大的责任。
exampleTraditional: 這份工作賦予她很大的責任。
exampleEnglish: This job gives her great responsibility.
hintSimplified: 把重要的任务、权力或意义交给某人或某事。
hintTraditional: 把重要的任務、權力或意義交給某人或某事。
hintEnglish: To hand over an important task, power, or meaning to someone or something.

exampleSimplified: 该死,我又忘了带钥匙!
exampleTraditional: 該死,我又忘了帶鑰匙!
exampleEnglish: Damn, I forgot my keys again!
hintSimplified: 事情不顺利、很生气时,忍不住说的话。
hintTraditional: 事情不順利、很生氣時,忍不住說的話。
hintEnglish: What you blurt out when things go wrong and you are annoyed.

definition: to adapt; to rearrange; to revise
exampleSimplified: 这部电影是根据小说改编的。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影是根據小說改編的。
exampleEnglish: This movie was adapted from a novel.
hintSimplified: 把小说变成电影或电视剧,内容做一些调整。
hintTraditional: 把小說變成電影或電視劇,內容做一些調整。
hintEnglish: Turning a novel into a film or TV show, with some changes to the content.

definition: change of appearance; to revise one's point of view
exampleSimplified: 新公园盖好以后,这一带完全改观了。
exampleTraditional: 新公園蓋好以後,這一帶完全改觀了。
exampleEnglish: After the new park was built, this area changed completely in appearance.
hintSimplified: 样子或印象和以前很不一样。
hintTraditional: 樣子或印象和以前很不一樣。
hintEnglish: The look or impression is very different from before.

definition: to improve (sth); to refine; to reform (a system)
exampleSimplified: 农民想办法改良土壤,让稻米长得更好。
exampleTraditional: 農民想辦法改良土壤,讓稻米長得更好。
exampleEnglish: Farmers find ways to improve the soil so the rice grows better.
hintSimplified: 把原来不够好的品种或方法变得更好。
hintTraditional: 把原來不夠好的品種或方法變得更好。
hintEnglish: Making a variety or method that was not good enough better.

exampleSimplified: 学生会每年都会改选一次。
exampleTraditional: 學生會每年都會改選一次。
exampleEnglish: The student council holds a new election every year.
hintSimplified: 任期结束后,重新投票选出新的负责人。
hintTraditional: 任期結束後,重新投票選出新的負責人。
hintEnglish: After a term ends, people vote again to choose new leaders.

definition: briefly; in broad outline; to summarize; to generalize
exampleSimplified: 请你用一句话概括这篇文章的内容。
exampleTraditional: 請你用一句話概括這篇文章的內容。
exampleEnglish: Please summarize the content of this article in one sentence.
hintSimplified: 把很多内容简单地整理成重点。
hintTraditional: 把很多內容簡單地整理成重點。
hintEnglish: Condensing a lot of content into its main points.

exampleSimplified: 老师先介绍了这个城市的概况。
exampleTraditional: 老師先介紹了這個城市的概況。
exampleEnglish: The teacher first introduced the general situation of this city.
hintSimplified: 对一个地方或事情整体情形的简单说明。
hintTraditional: 對一個地方或事情整體情形的簡單說明。
hintEnglish: A simple description of the overall state of a place or matter.

definition: to affix a seal; to sign off on sth; to stamp (a document)
exampleSimplified: 这份合同需要经理盖章才有效。
exampleTraditional: 這份合同需要經理蓋章才有效。
exampleEnglish: This contract is only valid once the manager stamps it.
hintSimplified: 在文件上用印章压出记号,表示同意。
hintTraditional: 在檔案上用印章壓出記號,表示同意。
hintEnglish: Pressing a seal onto a document to show approval.

exampleSimplified: 在大家面前叫错名字,真是太尴尬了。
exampleTraditional: 在大家面前叫錯名字,真是太尷尬了。
exampleEnglish: Calling someone by the wrong name in front of everyone is so awkward.
hintSimplified: 在别人面前出错时,觉得不好意思又不知怎么办。
hintTraditional: 在別人面前出錯時,覺得不好意思又不知怎麼辦。
hintEnglish: The feeling when you make a mistake in front of others and don't know what to do.

definition: interference (physics); perturbation; to disturb; to interfere
exampleSimplified: 隔壁的噪音干扰了我学习。
exampleTraditional: 隔壁的噪音干擾了我學習。
exampleEnglish: The noise next door disturbed my studying.
hintSimplified: 别人或外面的事让你不能专心做事。
hintTraditional: 別人或外面的事讓你不能專心做事。
hintEnglish: Something from outside keeps you from concentrating on what you're doing.

exampleSimplified: 父母不应该过度干涉孩子的选择。
exampleTraditional: 父母不應該過度干涉孩子的選擇。
exampleEnglish: Parents should not excessively interfere with their children's choices.
hintSimplified: 管别人的事,让别人不能自己决定。
hintTraditional: 管別人的事,讓別人不能自己決定。
hintEnglish: Getting involved in others' affairs so they can't decide for themselves.

definition: (fig.) dull; dry; boring; (of skin, mouth etc) dry; (of timber etc) to dry out; to season; to cure; (of weather, climate, soil etc) dry; arid
exampleSimplified: 冬天的空气很干燥,要多喝水。
exampleTraditional: 冬天的空氣很乾燥,要多喝水。
exampleEnglish: The air in winter is very dry, so drink more water.
hintSimplified: 没有水分,摸起来或感觉起来不湿。
hintTraditional: 沒有水分,摸起來或感覺起來不溼。
hintEnglish: Without moisture; not damp to the touch or feel.

definition: emotional stirring; moved; one's thoughts and feelings; touched
exampleSimplified: 旅行回来以后,他有很多感触。
exampleTraditional: 旅行回來以後,他有很多感觸。
exampleEnglish: After coming back from the trip, he had many deep reflections.
hintSimplified: 看到或经历某些事后,心里产生的想法和感动。
hintTraditional: 看到或經歷某些事後,心裡產生的想法和感動。
hintEnglish: The thoughts and emotions stirred in your heart after seeing or experiencing something.

definition: emotional; perception; perceptual; sensibility; sensitive; sentimental
exampleSimplified: 她是一个感性的人,看电影时很容易哭。
exampleTraditional: 她是一個感性的人,看電影時很容易哭。
exampleEnglish: She is an emotional person and cries easily when watching movies.
hintSimplified: 形容人容易被情感影响,而不是只靠道理做决定。
hintTraditional: 形容人容易被情感影響,而不是隻靠道理做決定。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is easily influenced by feelings rather than deciding only by logic.

definition: to hasten; to hurry; to make haste
exampleSimplified: 听到电话响,他赶忙跑去接。
exampleTraditional: 聽到電話響,他趕忙跑去接。
exampleEnglish: Hearing the phone ring, he hurried to answer it.
hintSimplified: 一件事很急,所以动作马上变得很快。
hintTraditional: 一件事很急,所以動作馬上變得很快。
hintEnglish: Something is urgent, so one immediately acts quickly.

definition: guiding principle; program (i.e. plan of action)
exampleSimplified: 这个组织的纲领写得很清楚。
exampleTraditional: 這個組織的綱領寫得很清楚。
exampleEnglish: This organization's guiding platform is written very clearly.
hintSimplified: 一个团体或计划最基本的原则和目标。
hintTraditional: 一個團體或計劃最基本的原則和目標。
hintEnglish: The most basic principles and goals of a group or plan.

exampleSimplified: 面对困难,她表现得非常刚强。
exampleTraditional: 面對困難,她表現得非常剛強。
exampleEnglish: Facing difficulties, she acted very strong and unyielding.
hintSimplified: 形容人意志很坚定,不容易被打倒或屈服。
hintTraditional: 形容人意志很堅定,不容易被打倒或屈服。
hintEnglish: Describes a person with firm will who is not easily defeated or giving in.

exampleSimplified: 这座桥是用钢铁造的,非常坚固。
exampleTraditional: 這座橋是用鋼鐵造的,非常堅固。
exampleEnglish: This bridge is made of steel and is very sturdy.
hintSimplified: 一种又硬又结实的金属材料,常用来盖大楼和造桥。
hintTraditional: 一種又硬又結實的金屬材料,常用來蓋大樓和造橋。
hintEnglish: A hard, strong metal material often used to build skyscrapers and bridges.

exampleSimplified: 他在这个岗位上工作了十年。
exampleTraditional: 他在這個崗位上工作了十年。
exampleEnglish: He has worked in this position for ten years.
hintSimplified: 公司或机关里,某个人负责的工作位置。
hintTraditional: 公司或機關裡,某個人負責的工作位置。
hintEnglish: The place or role in a company or office that someone is responsible for.

exampleSimplified: 关于这个问题,您有什么高见?
exampleTraditional: 關於這個問題,您有什麼高見?
exampleEnglish: Regarding this issue, what is your esteemed opinion?
hintSimplified: 客气地称呼别人的好意见时用的敬语。
hintTraditional: 客氣地稱呼別人的好意見時用的敬語。
hintEnglish: A polite, honorific way of referring to someone else's good opinion.

definition: (meteorology) high atmospheric pressure; (physics) high pressure; high voltage; high-handed; oppressive; systolic blood pressure
exampleSimplified: 天气预报说,明天有高压带来好天气。
exampleTraditional: 天氣預報說,明天有高壓帶來好天氣。
exampleEnglish: The forecast says a high-pressure system will bring good weather tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 气象图上的一种气压状态,通常表示天气晴朗;也可指很大的压力。
hintTraditional: 氣象圖上的一種氣壓狀態,通常表示天氣晴朗;也可指很大的壓力。
hintEnglish: An atmospheric condition on weather maps that usually means clear skies; also refers to great pressure.

gloss: to bid farewell to; to say goodbye to
definition: to bid farewell to; to say goodbye to; to leave; to part from
exampleSimplified: 毕业那天,我们向老师告别。
exampleTraditional: 畢業那天,我們向老師告別。
exampleEnglish: On graduation day, we said goodbye to our teacher.
hintSimplified: 离开前,对人或地方说再见。
hintTraditional: 離開前,對人或地方說再見。
hintEnglish: Saying farewell to a person or place before leaving.

definition: to bring a lawsuit; to tell on sb; to complain (to a teacher, a superior etc)
exampleSimplified: 弟弟被打了,就跑去向妈妈告状。
exampleTraditional: 弟弟被打了,就跑去向媽媽告狀。
exampleEnglish: Little brother got hit and ran to tell Mom on him.
hintSimplified: 向老师或大人说别人做错的事,希望他们处理。
hintTraditional: 向老師或大人說別人做錯的事,希望他們處理。
hintEnglish: Telling a teacher or adult about someone's misdeed, hoping they will deal with it.

exampleSimplified: 他的胳膊受伤了,不能提重东西。
exampleTraditional: 他的胳膊受傷了,不能提重東西。
exampleEnglish: His arm is injured, so he can't carry heavy things.
hintSimplified: 身体上连接肩膀和手的部分。
hintTraditional: 身體上連線肩膀和手的部分。
hintEnglish: The part of the body connecting the shoulder and the hand.

definition: to eulogize; to extol; to sing the praises of
exampleSimplified: 这首诗歌颂了母亲的爱。
exampleTraditional: 這首詩歌頌了母親的愛。
exampleEnglish: This poem praises a mother's love.
hintSimplified: 用文章或歌曲大力称赞伟大的人或事。
hintTraditional: 用文章或歌曲大力稱讚偉大的人或事。
hintEnglish: To greatly praise great people or things through writing or song.

definition: knot; lump; preoccupation; problem; swelling or lump on skin; pimple
exampleSimplified: 他的额头上起了一个红疙瘩。
exampleTraditional: 他的額頭上起了一個紅疙瘩。
exampleEnglish: A red bump appeared on his forehead.
hintSimplified: 皮肤上凸起的小块,或者绳子上打的结。
hintTraditional: 皮膚上凸起的小塊,或者繩子上打的結。
hintEnglish: A small raised lump on the skin, or a knot tied in a string.

definition: dove; pigeon; various birds of the family Columbidae
exampleSimplified: 广场上有很多鸽子,孩子们在喂它们。
exampleTraditional: 廣場上有很多鴿子,孩子們在餵它們。
exampleEnglish: There are many pigeons in the square, and children are feeding them.
hintSimplified: 一种常在广场上见到的鸟,象征和平。
hintTraditional: 一種常在廣場上見到的鳥,象徵和平。
hintEnglish: A bird often seen in town squares, a symbol of peace.

exampleSimplified: 多沟通可以消除两代人之间的隔阂。
exampleTraditional: 多溝通可以消除兩代人之間的隔閡。
exampleEnglish: More communication can remove the gap between two generations.
hintSimplified: 人与人之间因为不了解而产生的距离感。
hintTraditional: 人與人之間因為不了解而產生的距離感。
hintEnglish: The sense of distance between people caused by a lack of understanding.

definition: on alternate days; the next day
exampleSimplified: 这种药要隔天吃一次。
exampleTraditional: 這種藥要隔天吃一次。
exampleEnglish: This medicine should be taken every other day.
hintSimplified: 中间空一天,不是今天也不是明天。
hintTraditional: 中間空一天,不是今天也不是明天。
hintEnglish: With one day in between; not every day.

exampleSimplified: 这间公寓的格局很方便,房间都很大。
exampleTraditional: 這間公寓的格局很方便,房間都很大。
exampleEnglish: This apartment's layout is very convenient, and the rooms are big.
hintSimplified: 房子里各个房间的安排和配置。
hintTraditional: 房子裡各個房間的安排和配置。
hintEnglish: The arrangement of the rooms in a house.

exampleSimplified: 请按照这个格式写报告。
exampleTraditional: 請按照這個格式寫報告。
exampleEnglish: Please write the report according to this format.
hintSimplified: 文件、表格或资料规定的写法或排列样子。
hintTraditional: 檔案、表格或資料規定的寫法或排列樣子。
hintEnglish: The prescribed way a document, form, or file is written or arranged.

gloss: especially; particularly; even more than usual
definition: especially; particularly; even more than usual; extra; additional
exampleSimplified: 下雨天,这家咖啡店格外安静。
exampleTraditional: 下雨天,這家咖啡店格外安靜。
exampleEnglish: On rainy days, this café is especially quiet.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示程度比平常更高。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示程度比平常更高。
hintEnglish: An adverb showing a degree higher than usual.

exampleSimplified: 公司需要技术革新,才能跟上时代。
exampleTraditional: 公司需要技術革新,才能跟上時代。
exampleEnglish: The company needs technological innovation to keep up with the times.
hintSimplified: 改掉旧的方法,换成新的做法或技术。
hintTraditional: 改掉舊的方法,換成新的做法或技術。
hintEnglish: Changing old methods and replacing them with new ways or technology.

gloss: all walks of life; all social circles
definition: all walks of life; all social circles
exampleSimplified: 各界人士都来参加这次活动。
exampleTraditional: 各界人士都來參加這次活動。
exampleEnglish: People from all walks of life came to this event.
hintSimplified: 社会上不同行业和领域的人。
hintTraditional: 社會上不同行業和領域的人。
hintEnglish: People from the different trades and fields of society.

exampleSimplified: 请先数一数盒子里东西的个数。
exampleTraditional: 請先數一數盒子裡東西的個數。
exampleEnglish: Please first count the number of items in the box.
hintSimplified: 一件一件算出来的东西的总量。
hintTraditional: 一件一件算出來的東西的總量。
hintEnglish: The total amount of things counted one by one.

definition: an individual; self-employed individual; small business operator (abbr. for 個體戶|个体户[ge4 ti3 hu4])
exampleSimplified: 每个个体都有自己的特点。
exampleTraditional: 每個個體都有自己的特點。
exampleEnglish: Every individual has their own characteristics.
hintSimplified: 相对于团体来说,单独的一个人或一个生物。
hintTraditional: 相對於團體來說,單獨的一個人或一個生物。
hintEnglish: In contrast to a group, a single person or living being.

gloss: (literary) to give; to accord; to render
definition: (literary) to give; to accord; to render
exampleSimplified: 老师给予我们很多鼓励和帮助。
exampleTraditional: 老師給予我們很多鼓勵和幫助。
exampleEnglish: The teacher gave us a lot of encouragement and help.
hintSimplified: 书面语,常和帮助、支持、鼓励等词搭配,表示交给别人。
hintTraditional: 書面語,常和幫助、支援、鼓勵等詞搭配,表示交給別人。
hintEnglish: A formal word, often paired with help, support or encouragement, meaning to bestow on others.

exampleSimplified: 经理会继续跟进这个案子的进度。
exampleTraditional: 經理會繼續跟進這個案子的進度。
exampleEnglish: The manager will keep following up on the progress of this case.
hintSimplified: 工作中,持续注意并处理事情后续的发展。
hintTraditional: 工作中,持續注意並處理事情後續的發展。
hintEnglish: At work, to keep paying attention to and handling how a matter develops afterward.

definition: (in) front; (in) sb's presence; (of children, parents etc) at one's side; living with one; just before (a date); the front (of)
exampleSimplified: 孩子站在妈妈跟前,不敢说话。
exampleTraditional: 孩子站在媽媽跟前,不敢說話。
exampleEnglish: The child stood in front of his mother, not daring to speak.
hintSimplified: 表示在某人身体的前面,离他很近的地方。
hintTraditional: 表示在某人身體的前面,離他很近的地方。
hintEnglish: Means right in front of someone, very close to them.

exampleSimplified: 我们必须找出问题的根源,才能真正解决它。
exampleTraditional: 我們必須找出問題的根源,才能真正解決它。
exampleEnglish: We must find the root of the problem before we can truly solve it.
hintSimplified: 一件事情最开始的原因,就像树根或水的来处。
hintTraditional: 一件事情最開始的原因,就像樹根或水的來處。
hintEnglish: The original cause of something, like the root of a tree or the spring of a river.

exampleSimplified: 这个地区的耕地越来越少了。
exampleTraditional: 這個地區的耕地越來越少了。
exampleEnglish: The amount of arable land in this area is getting smaller and smaller.
hintSimplified: 农民用来种稻米和蔬菜的土地。
hintTraditional: 農民用來種稻米和蔬菜的土地。
hintEnglish: Land that farmers use to grow rice and vegetables.

definition: to alter; to change; to replace
exampleSimplified: 开会前,他临时更动了计划。
exampleTraditional: 開會前,他臨時更動了計劃。
exampleEnglish: Before the meeting, he changed the plan at the last minute.
hintSimplified: 把原来决定好的内容、顺序或人事做一些改变。
hintTraditional: 把原來決定好的內容、順序或人事做一些改變。
hintEnglish: To make changes to something already decided, such as content, order or personnel.

exampleSimplified: 工地附近每天都很吵。
exampleTraditional: 工地附近每天都很吵。
exampleEnglish: It's noisy near the construction site every day.
hintSimplified: 工人在这里盖房子或大楼,常有吊车和安全帽。
hintTraditional: 工人在這裡蓋房子或大樓,常有吊車和安全帽。
hintEnglish: Workers build houses or buildings here, with cranes and hard hats around.

gloss: (of a delinquent) to be reformed through work and study
definition: (of a delinquent) to be reformed through work and study; (of a student) to work part-time (while continuing one's studies)
exampleSimplified: 他白天打工,晚上上课,是工读生。
exampleTraditional: 他白天打工,晚上上課,是工讀生。
exampleEnglish: He works during the day and attends class at night; he's a work-study student.
hintSimplified: 学生一边工作赚钱,一边继续读书的方式。
hintTraditional: 學生一邊工作賺錢,一邊繼續讀書的方式。
hintEnglish: A way for students to earn money by working while continuing to study.

definition: (Ministry of) Public Security; public safety; public security; see 公安縣|公安县[Gong1 an1 Xian4]
exampleSimplified: 公安人员很快赶到了现场。
exampleTraditional: 公安人員很快趕到了現場。
exampleEnglish: Public security officers quickly arrived at the scene.
hintSimplified: 负责维持社会秩序和治安的政府部门。
hintTraditional: 負責維持社會秩序和治安的政府部門。
hintEnglish: A government department in charge of maintaining public order and safety.

exampleSimplified: 他是公费出国留学的。
exampleTraditional: 他是公費出國留學的。
exampleEnglish: He went abroad to study at government expense.
hintSimplified: 学费或旅费不用自己付,由国家或单位出钱。
hintTraditional: 學費或旅費不用自己付,由國家或單位出錢。
hintEnglish: Costs are not paid by yourself but by the state or an organization.

exampleSimplified: 他加入了律师公会,可以得到很多帮助。
exampleTraditional: 他加入了律師公會,可以得到很多幫助。
exampleEnglish: He joined the bar association and can get a lot of support.
hintSimplified: 同一行业的人组成的团体,保护大家的权益。
hintTraditional: 同一行業的人組成的團體,保護大家的權益。
hintEnglish: A group formed by people in the same trade to protect their common interests.

exampleSimplified: 每个公民都有投票的权利。
exampleTraditional: 每個公民都有投票的權利。
exampleEnglish: Every citizen has the right to vote.
hintSimplified: 拥有一个国家国籍的人,有权利也有义务。
hintTraditional: 擁有一個國家國籍的人,有權利也有義務。
hintEnglish: A person who holds a country's nationality, with rights and duties.

exampleSimplified: 他是公认的最好的钢琴老师。
exampleTraditional: 他是公認的最好的鋼琴老師。
exampleEnglish: He is universally acknowledged as the best piano teacher.
hintSimplified: 大家都同意、没有人反对的看法。
hintTraditional: 大家都同意、沒有人反對的看法。
hintEnglish: A view that everyone agrees with and nobody opposes.

exampleSimplified: 他下班后不想再谈公事。
exampleTraditional: 他下班後不想再談公事。
exampleEnglish: After work he doesn't want to talk about business anymore.
hintSimplified: 跟工作或机关有关的事,不是私人的事。
hintTraditional: 跟工作或機關有關的事,不是私人的事。
hintEnglish: Matters related to work or an office, not personal matters.

exampleSimplified: 这份公文需要经理签名才能送出去。
exampleTraditional: 這份公文需要經理簽名才能送出去。
exampleEnglish: This official document needs the manager's signature before it can be sent out.
hintSimplified: 政府机关或公司之间正式往来的文件。
hintTraditional: 政府機關或公司之間正式往來的檔案。
hintEnglish: A formal document exchanged between government offices or companies.

exampleSimplified: 他因为公务出差到台中。
exampleTraditional: 他因為公務出差到台中。
exampleEnglish: He is on a business trip to Taichung for official duties.
hintSimplified: 政府或机关里应该处理的工作事务。
hintTraditional: 政府或機關裡應該處理的工作事務。
hintEnglish: Work duties that must be handled in a government or official setting.

gloss: public good; public welfare; public interest
definition: public good; public welfare; public interest
exampleSimplified: 周末他常常参加公益活动,帮助需要的人。
exampleTraditional: 週末他常常參加公益活動,幫助需要的人。
exampleEnglish: On weekends he often joins charity activities to help people in need.
hintSimplified: 不是为了赚钱,而是对大家社会有好处的事。
hintTraditional: 不是為了賺錢,而是對大家社會有好處的事。
hintEnglish: Not for making money but beneficial to society as a whole.

exampleSimplified: 政府发行公债来筹钱盖新铁路。
exampleTraditional: 政府發行公債來籌錢蓋新鐵路。
exampleEnglish: The government issues bonds to raise money for a new railway.
hintSimplified: 政府向人民借钱,以后要还的凭证。
hintTraditional: 政府向人民借錢,以後要還的憑證。
hintEnglish: A certificate showing the government borrowed money from people and will repay it.

exampleSimplified: 这次成功,你的功劳最大。
exampleTraditional: 這次成功,你的功勞最大。
exampleEnglish: You deserve the most credit for this success.
hintSimplified: 为一件事付出努力,做出的好成绩或贡献。
hintTraditional: 為一件事付出努力,做出的好成績或貢獻。
hintEnglish: The good result or contribution from putting effort into something.

exampleSimplified: 他做每件事都很功利,只看有没有好处。
exampleTraditional: 他做每件事都很功利,只看有沒有好處。
exampleEnglish: He is very utilitarian in everything, only caring whether there's a benefit.
hintSimplified: 形容人只在乎眼前的利益和成果。
hintTraditional: 形容人只在乎眼前的利益和成果。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who only cares about immediate benefits and results.

definition: to major (in a field); to study a specialty to obtain a higher degree
exampleSimplified: 她正在大学攻读经济学博士。
exampleTraditional: 她正在大學攻讀經濟學博士。
exampleEnglish: She is pursuing a doctorate in economics at university.
hintSimplified: 很认真、很深入地学习某个专业或学位。
hintTraditional: 很認真、很深入地學習某個專業或學位。
hintEnglish: To study a field or degree very seriously and in depth.

definition: an attack (terrorist or military); to accuse; to attack; to charge
exampleSimplified: 对方球队一直攻击我们的弱点。
exampleTraditional: 對方球隊一直攻擊我們的弱點。
exampleEnglish: The opposing team kept attacking our weak points.
hintSimplified: 主动用力量或言语去打击对方。
hintTraditional: 主動用力量或言語去打擊對方。
hintEnglish: To actively strike at the other side with force or words.

definition: supply (as in supply and demand); to furnish; to provide
exampleSimplified: 价格会受到市场供给和需求的影响。
exampleTraditional: 價格會受到市場供給和需求的影響。
exampleEnglish: Prices are affected by market supply and demand.
hintSimplified: 经济学里,和“需求”相对的一边,指提供出来的货物或服务。
hintTraditional: 經濟學裡,和“需求”相對的一邊,指提供出來的貨物或服務。
hintEnglish: In economics, the side opposite to demand, referring to goods or services being provided.

exampleSimplified: 这座古老的宫殿每年吸引很多游客。
exampleTraditional: 這座古老的宮殿每年吸引很多遊客。
exampleEnglish: This ancient palace attracts many tourists every year.
hintSimplified: 国王或皇帝住的大而华丽的建筑。
hintTraditional: 國王或皇帝住的大而華麗的建築。
hintEnglish: A large, splendid building where a king or emperor lived.

exampleSimplified: 他恭敬地向老师鞠躬。
exampleTraditional: 他恭敬地向老師鞠躬。
exampleEnglish: He bowed to the teacher respectfully.
hintSimplified: 形容对长辈或上司态度很有礼貌、很尊重。
hintTraditional: 形容對長輩或上司態度很有禮貌、很尊重。
hintEnglish: Describes a very polite and respectful attitude toward elders or superiors.

exampleSimplified: 你不用恭维我,我知道自己做得不够好。
exampleTraditional: 你不用恭維我,我知道自己做得不夠好。
exampleEnglish: You don't need to flatter me; I know I haven't done well enough.
hintSimplified: 为了讨好别人,说一些好听的话称赞他。
hintTraditional: 為了討好別人,說一些好聽的話稱讚他。
hintEnglish: To say nice things praising someone in order to please them.

definition: firm; solid; stable; to consolidate; to strengthen
exampleSimplified: 考试前要复习,才能巩固学过的知识。
exampleTraditional: 考試前要複習,才能鞏固學過的知識。
exampleEnglish: You should review before the exam to consolidate what you've learned.
hintSimplified: 让基础更稳、更牢,不容易动摇或忘记。
hintTraditional: 讓基礎更穩、更牢,不容易動搖或忘記。
hintEnglish: To make a foundation stronger and steadier so it won't waver or be forgotten.

definition: (adj.) communist; communism; to collectivize ownership of property
exampleSimplified: 这本书介绍了共产思想的历史。
exampleTraditional: 這本書介紹了共產思想的歷史。
exampleEnglish: This book introduces the history of communist thought.
hintSimplified: 一种主张财产归大家共有的思想，常用来形容相关的理论。
hintTraditional: 一種主張財產歸大家共有的思想，常用來形容相關的理論。
hintEnglish: An idea that property should be owned by everyone together; used to describe related theories.

exampleSimplified: 他的演讲引起了很多年轻人的共鸣。
exampleTraditional: 他的演講引起了很多年輕人的共鳴。
exampleEnglish: His speech struck a chord with many young people.
hintSimplified: 听到别人的想法后，你心里也有同样的感受。
hintTraditional: 聽到別人的想法後，你心裡也有同樣的感受。
hintEnglish: After hearing someone's ideas, you feel the same way inside.

definition: Taiwan pr. [gong4yang4]; to make offerings to (gods or ancestors); to provide for one's elders; to supply; to support one's parents
exampleSimplified: 他努力工作，供养年迈的父母。
exampleTraditional: 他努力工作，供養年邁的父母。
exampleEnglish: He works hard to support his elderly parents.
hintSimplified: 出钱照顾家人，让他们有饭吃、有地方住。
hintTraditional: 出錢照顧家人，讓他們有飯吃、有地方住。
hintEnglish: To pay for family members so they have food and a place to live.

definition: to collaborate with; to collude with; to gang up with
exampleSimplified: 那个官员和坏人勾结，做了不少坏事。
exampleTraditional: 那個官員和壞人勾結，做了不少壞事。
exampleEnglish: That official colluded with bad people and did many wrong things.
hintSimplified: 和别人暗中合作，一起做不好的事。
hintTraditional: 和別人暗中合作，一起做不好的事。
hintEnglish: To secretly team up with others to do something improper.

exampleSimplified: 他对新公司的未来有很多构想。
exampleTraditional: 他對新公司的未來有很多構想。
exampleEnglish: He has many ideas for the new company's future.
hintSimplified: 做事以前，在脑子里先想好的大概计划或想法。
hintTraditional: 做事以前，在腦子裡先想好的大概計劃或想法。
hintEnglish: A rough plan or idea you form in your head before doing something.

exampleSimplified: 一个人住在国外，他有时觉得很孤独。
exampleTraditional: 一個人住在國外，他有時覺得很孤獨。
exampleEnglish: Living alone abroad, he sometimes feels very lonely.
hintSimplified: 身边没有人陪，心里觉得很寂寞。
hintTraditional: 身邊沒有人陪，心裡覺得很寂寞。
hintEnglish: No one is around you, and you feel sad and alone.

exampleSimplified: 这个孤儿在爱心家庭里长大。
exampleTraditional: 這個孤兒在愛心家庭里長大。
exampleEnglish: This orphan grew up in a loving family.
hintSimplified: 父母都不在了的小孩。
hintTraditional: 父母都不在了的小孩。
hintEnglish: A child whose parents are no longer alive.

exampleSimplified: 他在班上被孤立，没有人愿意跟他玩。
exampleTraditional: 他在班上被孤立，沒有人願意跟他玩。
exampleEnglish: He was isolated in class and nobody wanted to play with him.
hintSimplified: 得不到别人的帮助或支持，像是被分开放在一边。
hintTraditional: 得不到別人的幫助或支援，像是被分開放在一邊。
hintEnglish: Getting no help or support from others, as if set apart on one side.

gloss: to fail to live up to (sb's expectations, trust or kindness); to let down
definition: to fail to live up to (sb's expectations, trust or kindness); to let down
exampleSimplified: 我不会辜负大家对我的期待。
exampleTraditional: 我不會辜負大家對我的期待。
exampleEnglish: I will not let down everyone's expectations of me.
hintSimplified: 别人信任你、帮助你，你却没有做到他们希望的事。
hintTraditional: 別人信任你、幫助你，你卻沒有做到他們希望的事。
hintEnglish: Others trusted and helped you, but you didn't do what they hoped.

definition: estimate; to appraise; to be valued at; to value; valuation
exampleSimplified: 店员先给这辆旧车估价，再决定要不要收。
exampleTraditional: 店員先給這輛舊車估價，再決定要不要收。
exampleEnglish: The clerk first estimated the value of this old car before deciding whether to take it.
hintSimplified: 在买卖以前，大概算一算东西值多少钱。
hintTraditional: 在買賣以前，大概算一算東西值多少錢。
hintEnglish: Roughly working out how much something is worth before buying or selling.

exampleSimplified: 他的脾气很古怪，大家都不太懂他。
exampleTraditional: 他的脾氣很古怪，大家都不太懂他。
exampleEnglish: He has a strange temper and nobody really understands him.
hintSimplified: 形容人或事和平常不一样，让人觉得很奇特。
hintTraditional: 形容人或事和平常不一樣，讓人覺得很奇特。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or thing that is unlike the usual and seems odd.

exampleSimplified: 图书馆里收藏了许多珍贵的古籍。
exampleTraditional: 圖書館裡收藏了許多珍貴的古籍。
exampleEnglish: The library holds many precious ancient texts.
hintSimplified: 很多年前写成、保存下来的书。
hintTraditional: 很多年前寫成、儲存下來的書。
hintEnglish: Books written many years ago and preserved until today.

exampleSimplified: 这家店专门卖各种古物。
exampleTraditional: 這家店專門賣各種古物。
exampleEnglish: This shop specializes in selling all kinds of antiques.
hintSimplified: 很久以前留下来的东西，常放在博物馆或老店里。
hintTraditional: 很久以前留下來的東西，常放在博物館或老店裡。
hintEnglish: Things left from long ago, often found in museums or old shops.

exampleSimplified: 今天股市大涨，很多人都很开心。
exampleTraditional: 今天股市大漲，很多人都很開心。
exampleEnglish: The stock market rose sharply today, and many people were happy.
hintSimplified: 人们买卖公司股票的地方，数字每天上上下下。
hintTraditional: 人們買賣公司股票的地方，數字每天上上下下。
hintEnglish: Where people buy and sell shares of companies; the numbers go up and down daily.

definition: to agitate for; to enthusiastically promote
exampleSimplified: 他到处鼓吹健康的生活方式。
exampleTraditional: 他到處鼓吹健康的生活方式。
exampleEnglish: He promotes a healthy lifestyle everywhere he goes.
hintSimplified: 大力宣传某种想法，希望更多人接受。
hintTraditional: 大力宣傳某種想法，希望更多人接受。
hintEnglish: To publicize an idea strongly, hoping more people will accept it.

gloss: to beat; to flap (wings, a fan etc)
definition: to beat; to flap (wings, a fan etc); to urge (an activity that may be beneficial, harmful or neutral); to encourage; to agitate; to instigate; to incite
exampleSimplified: 他鼓动同学们一起参加比赛。
exampleTraditional: 他鼓動同學們一起參加比賽。
exampleEnglish: He encouraged his classmates to join the competition together.
hintSimplified: 用话语让别人产生兴趣，去做某件事。
hintTraditional: 用話語讓別人產生興趣，去做某件事。
hintEnglish: Using words to make others interested in doing something.

exampleSimplified: 这家公司今年雇用了二十名新员工。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司今年雇用了二十名新員工。
exampleEnglish: This company hired twenty new employees this year.
hintSimplified: 老板给人工作，并付他薪水。
hintTraditional: 老闆給人工作，並付他薪水。
hintEnglish: A boss gives someone a job and pays them a salary.

exampleSimplified: 这个办法固然好，但是太贵了。
exampleTraditional: 這個辦法固然好，但是太貴了。
exampleEnglish: This method is indeed good, but it is too expensive.
hintSimplified: 先承认一件事是对的，后面常接着说不同的看法。
hintTraditional: 先承認一件事是對的，後面常接著說不同的看法。
hintEnglish: Used to first admit something is true, usually followed by a contrasting view.

exampleSimplified: 冰是水变成的固体。
exampleTraditional: 冰是水變成的固體。
exampleEnglish: Ice is the solid form of water.
hintSimplified: 不像水或空气那样会流动，有一定形状的物质。
hintTraditional: 不像水或空氣那樣會流動，有一定形狀的物質。
hintEnglish: Matter with a definite shape, unlike water or air that flow.

exampleSimplified: 每种文化都有自己固有的特色。
exampleTraditional: 每種文化都有自己固有的特色。
exampleEnglish: Every culture has its own inherent characteristics.
hintSimplified: 本来就有的，不是后来才加上的。
hintTraditional: 本來就有的，不是後來才加上的。
hintEnglish: Already there from the start, not added later.

definition: obstinate; stubborn; to cling to; to fixate on
exampleSimplified: 爷爷很固执，不肯听别人的意见。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺很固執，不肯聽別人的意見。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa is stubborn and refuses to listen to others' opinions.
hintSimplified: 形容人坚持自己的想法，别人怎么劝都不改。
hintTraditional: 形容人堅持自己的想法，別人怎麼勸都不改。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who sticks to their own view no matter how others persuade them.

definition: to display thoughtfulness towards; to give careful consideration to
exampleSimplified: 为了顾全大局，他决定先不说话。
exampleTraditional: 為了顧全大局，他決定先不說話。
exampleEnglish: To protect the overall situation, he decided not to speak for now.
hintSimplified: 为了不让整体受到损失，小心照顾各方面。
hintTraditional: 為了不讓整體受到損失，小心照顧各方面。
hintEnglish: Taking careful care of all sides so the whole is not harmed.

exampleSimplified: 下雨以后，墙上爬着一只小蜗牛。
exampleTraditional: 下雨以後，牆上爬著一隻小蝸牛。
exampleEnglish: After the rain, a little snail was crawling on the wall.
hintSimplified: 背着圆圆的壳，爬得很慢的小动物。
hintTraditional: 揹著圓圓的殼，爬得很慢的小動物。
hintEnglish: A small animal that carries a round shell and crawls very slowly.

exampleSimplified: 那位寡妇一个人把三个孩子养大。
exampleTraditional: 那位寡婦一個人把三個孩子養大。
exampleEnglish: That widow raised three children by herself.
hintSimplified: 丈夫去世以后，没有再结婚的女人。
hintTraditional: 丈夫去世以後，沒有再結婚的女人。
hintEnglish: A woman whose husband has died and who has not remarried.

exampleSimplified: 他为了这场官司请了一位律师。
exampleTraditional: 他為了這場官司請了一位律師。
exampleEnglish: He hired a lawyer for this lawsuit.
hintSimplified: 两方有争议，到法院请法官来判断的事。
hintTraditional: 兩方有爭議，到法院請法官來判斷的事。
hintEnglish: A dispute between two sides taken to court for a judge to decide.

exampleSimplified: 工人把老人的棺材抬上了车。
exampleTraditional: 工人把老人的棺材抬上了車。
exampleEnglish: The workers lifted the old man's coffin onto the car.
hintSimplified: 人去世后,遗体会被放进这种长方形的木箱里。
hintTraditional: 人去世後,遺體會被放進這種長方形的木箱裡。
hintEnglish: After a person dies, the body is placed in this rectangular wooden box.

definition: observation (scientific etc); to observe; to survey
exampleSimplified: 科学家每天观测天上的星星。
exampleTraditional: 科學家每天觀測天上的星星。
exampleEnglish: Scientists observe the stars in the sky every day.
hintSimplified: 用仪器仔细看并记录天气或星星等自然现象。
hintTraditional: 用儀器仔細看並記錄天氣或星星等自然現象。
hintEnglish: To carefully watch and record natural phenomena like weather or stars using instruments.

exampleSimplified: 看完展览以后,他说了自己的观感。
exampleTraditional: 看完展覽以後,他說了自己的觀感。
exampleEnglish: After seeing the exhibition, he shared his impressions.
hintSimplified: 看过或经历某件事以后,心里产生的印象和想法。
hintTraditional: 看過或經歷某件事以後,心裡產生的印象和想法。
hintEnglish: The impressions and thoughts you have after seeing or experiencing something.

exampleSimplified: 很多人在家里观看世界杯比赛。
exampleTraditional: 很多人在家裡觀看世界盃比賽。
exampleEnglish: Many people watch the World Cup matches at home.
hintSimplified: 认真地看比赛、表演或电影时会做的动作。
hintTraditional: 認真地看比賽、表演或電影時會做的動作。
hintEnglish: What you do when you attentively look at a match, a performance or a film.

definition: to observe and emulate; to study (esp. following sb's example)
exampleSimplified: 老师带学生去观摩别的学校的教学。
exampleTraditional: 老師帶學生去觀摩別的學校的教學。
exampleEnglish: The teacher took students to observe and learn from another school's teaching.
hintSimplified: 到现场看别人怎么做,目的是向对方学习。
hintTraditional: 到現場看別人怎麼做,目的是向對方學習。
hintEnglish: To go and watch how others do something in order to learn from them.

definition: to look around; to survey; to wait and see; to watch from the sidelines
exampleSimplified: 房价变化很大,很多人还在观望。
exampleTraditional: 房價變化很大,很多人還在觀望。
exampleEnglish: House prices are changing a lot, and many people are still waiting and watching.
hintSimplified: 不马上决定,先看看情况再说。
hintTraditional: 不馬上決定,先看看情況再說。
hintEnglish: Not deciding right away, but waiting to see how things develop first.

exampleSimplified: 进口汽车要付很高的关税。
exampleTraditional: 進口汽車要付很高的關稅。
exampleEnglish: Imported cars require paying a high tariff.
hintSimplified: 货物进入一个国家时,要向政府交的钱。
hintTraditional: 貨物進入一個國家時,要向政府交的錢。
hintEnglish: Money paid to the government when goods enter a country.

definition: to be deeply concerned; to be troubled (by)
exampleSimplified: 大家都很关切这次地震的消息。
exampleTraditional: 大家都很關切這次地震的訊息。
exampleEnglish: Everyone is deeply concerned about the news of this earthquake.
hintSimplified: 对重要的事或别人的情况非常在意、很担心。
hintTraditional: 對重要的事或別人的情況非常在意、很擔心。
hintEnglish: To care very much about an important matter or someone's situation.

definition: attentive to; care; concerned about; solicitude; to show care for
exampleSimplified: 社会应该多关怀孤单的老人。
exampleTraditional: 社會應該多關懷孤單的老人。
exampleEnglish: Society should show more care for lonely elderly people.
hintSimplified: 用温暖的心照顾和关心需要帮助的人。
hintTraditional: 用溫暖的心照顧和關心需要幫助的人。
hintEnglish: To look after and show warm concern for people who need help.

exampleSimplified: 在最后关头,他还是决定留下来。
exampleTraditional: 在最後關頭,他還是決定留下來。
exampleEnglish: At the last critical moment, he still decided to stay.
hintSimplified: 指事情发展中最重要、最紧急的时刻。
hintTraditional: 指事情發展中最重要、最緊急的時刻。
hintEnglish: The most important and urgent moment in the course of events.

definition: to keep an eye on; to look after; to remind; to take care; to tell
exampleSimplified: 我刚来公司,请大家多多关照。
exampleTraditional: 我剛來公司,請大家多多關照。
exampleEnglish: I just joined the company, so please take good care of me.
hintSimplified: 请别人多帮忙、多照顾时常说的客气话里的动词。
hintTraditional: 請別人多幫忙、多照顧時常說的客氣話裡的動詞。
hintEnglish: The verb in a polite phrase used to ask others for help and support.

definition: to discipline; to guarantee; to teach
exampleSimplified: 父母要好好管教自己的孩子。
exampleTraditional: 父母要好好管教自己的孩子。
exampleEnglish: Parents should properly discipline their children.
hintSimplified: 大人对孩子的行为严格要求,让他们守规矩。
hintTraditional: 大人對孩子的行為嚴格要求,讓他們守規矩。
hintEnglish: Adults strictly guiding children's behavior so they follow rules.

gloss: general term for pipes, cables etc
definition: general term for pipes, cables etc; pipeline
exampleSimplified: 施工时不小心弄坏了地下的管线。
exampleTraditional: 施工時不小心弄壞了地下的管線。
exampleEnglish: During construction, the underground pipelines were accidentally damaged.
hintSimplified: 埋在地下,用来输送水、瓦斯或电的各种设施。
hintTraditional: 埋在地下,用來輸送水、瓦斯或電的各種設施。
hintEnglish: Facilities buried underground that carry water, gas or electricity.

definition: CL:根[gen1]; Guanzi or Guan Zhong 管仲 (-645 BC), famous politician of Qi 齊國|齐国 of Spring and Autumn period; Guanzi, classical book containing writings of Guan Zhong and his school; drinking straw; pipe; tube
exampleSimplified: 这根管子里的水流得很慢。
exampleTraditional: 這根管子裡的水流得很慢。
exampleEnglish: The water in this pipe flows very slowly.
hintSimplified: 中间是空的,细长的东西,水或空气可以从里面通过。
hintTraditional: 中間是空的,細長的東西,水或空氣可以從裡面透過。
hintEnglish: A long, thin, hollow object through which water or air can pass.

definition: to carry out; to implement; to put into practice
exampleSimplified: 公司一定会贯彻这个新政策。
exampleTraditional: 公司一定會貫徹這個新政策。
exampleEnglish: The company will definitely carry out this new policy thoroughly.
hintSimplified: 把决定或想法完整地、彻底地做到。
hintTraditional: 把決定或想法完整地、徹底地做到。
hintEnglish: To put a decision or idea fully and thoroughly into practice.

exampleSimplified: 农民用河水灌溉稻田。
exampleTraditional: 農民用河水灌溉稻田。
exampleEnglish: Farmers use river water to irrigate the rice fields.
hintSimplified: 把水引到田地里,让农作物有水喝。
hintTraditional: 把水引到田地裡,讓農作物有水喝。
hintEnglish: Bringing water into fields so crops have enough to drink.

gloss: to channel water to another place
definition: to channel water to another place; to imbue with; to impart; to inculcate; to instill into; to teach
exampleSimplified: 老师不应该只是向学生灌输知识。
exampleTraditional: 老師不應該只是向學生灌輸知識。
exampleEnglish: Teachers should not just instill knowledge into students.
hintSimplified: 不断地把想法或知识放进别人脑子里,不管对方愿不愿意。
hintTraditional: 不斷地把想法或知識放進別人腦子裡,不管對方願不願意。
hintEnglish: Constantly putting ideas or knowledge into someone's mind, whether or not they want it.

exampleSimplified: 谢谢您光顾小店,欢迎下次再来。
exampleTraditional: 謝謝您光顧小店,歡迎下次再來。
exampleEnglish: Thank you for patronizing our little shop; please come again.
hintSimplified: 店家对来买东西的客人表示感谢时用的礼貌说法。
hintTraditional: 店家對來買東西的客人表示感謝時用的禮貌說法。
hintEnglish: A polite expression shopkeepers use when thanking customers who come to buy.

exampleSimplified: 这块石头摸起来很光滑。
exampleTraditional: 這塊石頭摸起來很光滑。
exampleEnglish: This stone feels very smooth to the touch.
hintSimplified: 东西表面平平的,没有粗糙的地方,摸起来很舒服。
hintTraditional: 東西表面平平的,沒有粗糙的地方,摸起來很舒服。
hintEnglish: A surface that is flat with no rough spots and feels pleasant to touch.

exampleSimplified: 他留下了光辉的成就,大家都很敬佩。
exampleTraditional: 他留下了光輝的成就,大家都很敬佩。
exampleEnglish: He left behind glorious achievements that everyone admires.
hintSimplified: 形容成就或形象伟大、明亮、让人敬佩。
hintTraditional: 形容成就或形象偉大、明亮、讓人敬佩。
hintEnglish: Describes achievements or image as great, shining and admirable.

definition: brilliant rays; radiance; rays of light
exampleSimplified: 太阳的光芒照在海面上。
exampleTraditional: 太陽的光芒照在海面上。
exampleEnglish: The sun's rays shine on the sea surface.
hintSimplified: 从太阳或灯发出来、向四周散开的亮线。
hintTraditional: 從太陽或燈發出來、向四周散開的亮線。
hintEnglish: Bright lines of light radiating outward from the sun or a lamp.

definition: norm; regulation; rule; specification; standard; to fix rules; to regulate; to specify; within the rules
exampleSimplified: 这家工厂的做法不符合安全规范。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠的做法不符合安全規範。
exampleEnglish: This factory's practices do not meet safety standards.
hintSimplified: 大家应该遵守的标准或规定。
hintTraditional: 大家應該遵守的標準或規定。
hintEnglish: A standard or rule that everyone should follow.

exampleSimplified: 这两个箱子的规格不一样。
exampleTraditional: 這兩個箱子的規格不一樣。
exampleEnglish: These two boxes have different specifications.
hintSimplified: 产品的大小、型号和质量等要求。
hintTraditional: 產品的大小、型號和質量等要求。
hintEnglish: The requirements of a product such as its size, model and quality.

exampleSimplified: 请在下星期一以前归还这本书。
exampleTraditional: 請在下星期一以前歸還這本書。
exampleEnglish: Please return this book before next Monday.
hintSimplified: 把借来的东西送回给原来的主人。
hintTraditional: 把借來的東西送回給原來的主人。
hintEnglish: To give a borrowed item back to its original owner.

definition: induction (method of deduction in logic); to conclude from facts; to sum up; to summarize
exampleSimplified: 请你把大家的意见归纳成三点。
exampleTraditional: 請你把大家的意見歸納成三點。
exampleEnglish: Please summarize everyone's opinions into three points.
hintSimplified: 把许多零散的内容整理起来,找出共同的重点。
hintTraditional: 把許多零散的內容整理起來,找出共同的重點。
hintEnglish: To organize many scattered pieces of content and find the common main points.

definition: (audio engineering) track; (fig.) a person's established path in life; (quantum mechanics) orbital; desired trajectory (of a business or other endeavor); orbit (of a satellite); track (for trains etc)
exampleSimplified: 火车沿着轨道慢慢地往前开。
exampleTraditional: 火車沿著軌道慢慢地往前開。
exampleEnglish: The train moves slowly forward along the track.
hintSimplified: 火车或地铁行驶时,车轮压在上面的两条长长的铁线。
hintTraditional: 火車或地鐵行駛時,車輪壓在上面的兩條長長的鐵線。
hintEnglish: The two long lines of metal that a train's wheels run on.

exampleSimplified: 万圣节的时候,孩子们喜欢打扮成鬼怪。
exampleTraditional: 萬聖節的時候,孩子們喜歡打扮成鬼怪。
exampleEnglish: At Halloween, children like to dress up as ghosts and monsters.
hintSimplified: 故事里出现的可怕、不属于人间的奇怪生物。
hintTraditional: 故事裡出現的可怕、不屬於人間的奇怪生物。
hintEnglish: Scary, strange creatures from stories that don't belong to the human world.

exampleSimplified: 饭店为贵宾准备了一间很大的房间。
exampleTraditional: 飯店為貴賓準備了一間很大的房間。
exampleEnglish: The restaurant prepared a very large room for the VIP guests.
hintSimplified: 受到特别欢迎和礼遇的重要客人。
hintTraditional: 受到特別歡迎和禮遇的重要客人。
hintEnglish: An important guest who receives special treatment and respect.

exampleSimplified: 他手里拿着一根长长的棍子。
exampleTraditional: 他手裡拿著一根長長的棍子。
exampleEnglish: He is holding a long stick in his hand.
hintSimplified: 又细又长、用木头或金属做成的东西,可以拿在手里。
hintTraditional: 又細又長、用木頭或金屬做成的東西,可以拿在手裡。
hintEnglish: A thin, long object made of wood or metal that you can hold in your hand.

exampleSimplified: 这辆车是国产的,价格比进口车便宜。
exampleTraditional: 這輛車是國產的,價格比進口車便宜。
exampleEnglish: This car is domestically made, and cheaper than imported cars.
hintSimplified: 东西是在本国做出来的,不是从外国买来的。
hintTraditional: 東西是在本國做出來的,不是從外國買來的。
hintEnglish: Made in one's own country, not bought from abroad.

exampleSimplified: 每个国家都需要花钱加强国防。
exampleTraditional: 每個國家都需要花錢加強國防。
exampleEnglish: Every country needs to spend money to strengthen its national defense.
hintSimplified: 一个国家用军队保护自己安全的工作。
hintTraditional: 一個國家用軍隊保護自己安全的工作。
hintEnglish: A country's work of protecting its own security with its armed forces.

exampleSimplified: 我们开车到了两个国家的国境。
exampleTraditional: 我們開車到了兩個國家的國境。
exampleEnglish: We drove to the border between the two countries.
hintSimplified: 一个国家和另一个国家相接的边线地区。
hintTraditional: 一個國家和另一個國家相接的邊線地區。
hintEnglish: The border area where one country meets another.

exampleSimplified: 古时候的国君住在很大的宫殿里。
exampleTraditional: 古時候的國君住在很大的宮殿裡。
exampleEnglish: In ancient times, the ruler lived in a huge palace.
hintSimplified: 古代一个国家最高的统治者,例如国王。
hintTraditional: 古代一個國家最高的統治者,例如國王。
hintEnglish: The highest ruler of a country in ancient times, such as a king.

definition: citizens; nationals; people of a nation
exampleSimplified: 国民都有接受教育的权利。
exampleTraditional: 國民都有接受教育的權利。
exampleEnglish: All citizens have the right to receive an education.
hintSimplified: 拥有一个国家国籍的人。
hintTraditional: 擁有一個國家國籍的人。
hintEnglish: People who hold the nationality of a country.

exampleSimplified: 这家银行是国营的,很多人都信任它。
exampleTraditional: 這家銀行是國營的,很多人都信任它。
exampleEnglish: This bank is state-run, and many people trust it.
hintSimplified: 由政府而不是私人来经营的。
hintTraditional: 由政府而不是私人來經營的。
hintEnglish: Run by the government rather than by private individuals.

exampleSimplified: 遇到问题时,他总是很果断地做出决定。
exampleTraditional: 遇到問題時,他總是很果斷地做出決定。
exampleEnglish: When facing problems, he always makes decisions decisively.
hintSimplified: 形容做决定时不犹豫、很快就下决心的样子。
hintTraditional: 形容做決定時不猶豫、很快就下決心的樣子。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who makes up their mind quickly without hesitating.

definition: (fig.) fruits (of success etc); fruit (produced by a plant); gains; results
exampleSimplified: 这是大家努力工作得来的果实。
exampleTraditional: 這是大家努力工作得來的果實。
exampleEnglish: This is the fruit of everyone's hard work.
hintSimplified: 努力之后得到的好成绩或好结果,也指树上长出来的东西。
hintTraditional: 努力之後得到的好成績或好結果,也指樹上長出來的東西。
hintEnglish: The good result obtained after hard effort; also what grows on a tree.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷的院子里种了很多果树。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺的院子裡種了很多果樹。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa planted many fruit trees in his yard.
hintSimplified: 苹果、橘子等水果就是从这种植物上长出来的。
hintTraditional: 蘋果、橘子等水果就是從這種植物上長出來的。
hintEnglish: The kind of plant that apples and oranges grow on.

definition: as expected; if indeed...; if it's really...; really; sure enough
exampleSimplified: 天气预报说会下雨,今天果真下雨了。
exampleTraditional: 天氣預報說會下雨,今天果真下雨了。
exampleEnglish: The forecast said it would rain, and sure enough it rained today.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示事情的结果和以前想的、说的一样。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示事情的結果和以前想的、說的一樣。
hintEnglish: An adverb showing that the result is just as was expected or said.

definition: to cross a barrier; to get through (an ordeal); to pass (a test); to reach (a standard)
exampleSimplified: 他终于通过考试,顺利过关了。
exampleTraditional: 他終於透過考試,順利過關了。
exampleEnglish: He finally passed the exam and got through smoothly.
hintSimplified: 通过检查、考试或困难,可以继续往下走。
hintTraditional: 透過檢查、考試或困難,可以繼續往下走。
hintEnglish: To get through a check, test, or difficulty and be able to move on.

exampleSimplified: 这种药吃过量对身体不好。
exampleTraditional: 這種藥吃過量對身體不好。
exampleEnglish: Taking too much of this medicine is bad for your body.
hintSimplified: 数量超过合适的范围,太多了。
hintTraditional: 數量超過合適的範圍,太多了。
hintEnglish: The amount goes beyond the proper limit; too much.

exampleSimplified: 这份文件请经理先过目,再寄出去。
exampleTraditional: 這份檔案請經理先過目,再寄出去。
exampleEnglish: Please have the manager look over this document before sending it out.
hintSimplified: 在决定之前,先把资料看一遍检查。
hintTraditional: 在決定之前,先把資料看一遍檢查。
hintEnglish: To look through material first for checking before a decision is made.

gloss: (basketball, soccer etc) to get past an opponent
definition: (basketball, soccer etc) to get past an opponent; to surpass others; outstanding
exampleSimplified: 这位球员的过人技术非常厉害。
exampleTraditional: 這位球員的過人技術非常厲害。
exampleEnglish: This player's skill at dribbling past opponents is very impressive.
hintSimplified: 踢足球或打篮球时,带球绕过对方球员。
hintTraditional: 踢足球或打籃球時,帶球繞過對方球員。
hintEnglish: In soccer or basketball, getting the ball past a defending player.

exampleSimplified: 这次事故是司机的过失造成的。
exampleTraditional: 這次事故是司機的過失造成的。
exampleEnglish: This accident was caused by the driver's negligence.
hintSimplified: 因为不小心而犯的错,不是故意的。
hintTraditional: 因為不小心而犯的錯,不是故意的。
hintEnglish: A mistake made through carelessness, not on purpose.

definition: fulfilling; gratifying; immensely enjoyable; satisfying; to get a kick out of sth; to satisfy a craving
exampleSimplified: 今天打了一场球,真是太过瘾了!
exampleTraditional: 今天打了一場球,真是太過癮了!
exampleEnglish: I played a ball game today, and it was so satisfying!
hintSimplified: 做喜欢的事做得很尽兴,觉得非常满足。
hintTraditional: 做喜歡的事做得很盡興,覺得非常滿足。
hintEnglish: The feeling of great satisfaction from fully enjoying something you like.

exampleSimplified: 你的行李过重,要多付一些钱。
exampleTraditional: 你的行李過重,要多付一些錢。
exampleEnglish: Your luggage is overweight, so you have to pay extra.
hintSimplified: 在机场,行李比规定的重量还重。
hintTraditional: 在機場,行李比規定的重量還重。
hintEnglish: At the airport, when baggage is heavier than the allowed weight.

exampleSimplified: 玉山的海拔将近四千米。
exampleTraditional: 玉山的海拔將近四千米。
exampleEnglish: Yushan's elevation is nearly four thousand meters.
hintSimplified: 表示一个地方比海平面高多少的数字。
hintTraditional: 表示一個地方比海平面高多少的數字。
hintEnglish: The number showing how high a place is above sea level.

gloss: the surface of the sea; ocean surface
definition: the surface of the sea; ocean surface
exampleSimplified: 太阳升起来,海面变成了金黄色。
exampleTraditional: 太陽昇起來,海面變成了金黃色。
exampleEnglish: As the sun rose, the sea surface turned golden.
hintSimplified: 大海最上面、能看到的那一层水面。
hintTraditional: 大海最上面、能看到的那一層水面。
hintEnglish: The visible top layer of the sea.

exampleSimplified: 地震以后,海啸冲到了岸边的村子。
exampleTraditional: 地震以後,海嘯衝到了岸邊的村子。
exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, a tsunami rushed into the village on the shore.
hintSimplified: 地震后海里出现的巨大可怕的浪,会淹没海边。
hintTraditional: 地震後海里出現的巨大可怕的浪,會淹沒海邊。
hintEnglish: A huge, terrifying wave after an earthquake that floods the coast.

exampleSimplified: 这些货物是用海运送到台湾的。
exampleTraditional: 這些貨物是用海運送到台灣的。
exampleEnglish: These goods were sent to Taiwan by sea freight.
hintSimplified: 用大船在海上运送货物的方式。
hintTraditional: 用大船在海上運送貨物的方式。
hintEnglish: A way of carrying goods on big ships across the water.

exampleSimplified: 农夫用天然的方法来对付害虫。
exampleTraditional: 農夫用天然的方法來對付害蟲。
exampleEnglish: The farmer uses natural methods to deal with harmful insects.
hintSimplified: 它们会吃掉农作物,让农夫很头痛的小动物。
hintTraditional: 它們會吃掉農作物,讓農夫很頭痛的小動物。
hintEnglish: Small creatures that eat crops and give farmers headaches.

gloss: (Tw) unincorporated firm (typically a smaller business such as a sole proprietorship or partnership)
definition: (Tw) unincorporated firm (typically a smaller business such as a sole proprietorship or partnership); (computing) (text file) line number; (data table or spreadsheet) row number
exampleSimplified: 他在市场里开了一家小行号,卖五金材料。
exampleTraditional: 他在市場裡開了一家小行號,賣五金材料。
exampleEnglish: He opened a small business firm in the market selling hardware.
hintSimplified: 在台湾,指没有正式登记成公司的小型商店或生意。
hintTraditional: 在台灣,指沒有正式登記成公司的小型商店或生意。
hintEnglish: In Taiwan, a small business that is not formally incorporated as a company.

definition: (fig.) ranks (as in "join the ranks of ..."); array; formation
exampleSimplified: 他决定加入志工的行列,帮助需要的人。
exampleTraditional: 他決定加入志工的行列,幫助需要的人。
exampleEnglish: He decided to join the ranks of volunteers to help people in need.
hintSimplified: 人们排成的一排排队伍;也比喻某个团体的成员。
hintTraditional: 人們排成的一排排隊伍;也比喻某個團體的成員。
hintEnglish: Rows of people lined up; also figuratively the members of a group.

definition: to fly; to navigate; to sail
exampleSimplified: 这艘船在太平洋上平稳地航行。
exampleTraditional: 這艘船在太平洋上平穩地航行。
exampleEnglish: This ship sails steadily across the Pacific Ocean.
hintSimplified: 船在水上或飞机在空中沿着路线前进。
hintTraditional: 船在水上或飛機在空中沿著路線前進。
hintEnglish: A ship or plane travels along a route over water or through the air.

definition: hardly; not at all; not in the least
exampleSimplified: 他毫不犹豫地跳下水去救人。
exampleTraditional: 他毫不猶豫地跳下水去救人。
exampleEnglish: He jumped into the water to save someone without the slightest hesitation.
hintSimplified: 放在动词或形容词前,表示一点儿也没有,语气很强。
hintTraditional: 放在動詞或形容詞前,表示一點兒也沒有,語氣很強。
hintEnglish: Placed before a verb or adjective to mean not at all, with strong emphasis.

gloss: to be just like; can be compared to
definition: to be just like; can be compared to
exampleSimplified: 学习外语好比爬山,要一步一步来。
exampleTraditional: 學習外語好比爬山,要一步一步來。
exampleEnglish: Learning a foreign language is like climbing a mountain; you go step by step.
hintSimplified: 用来打比方,说一件事就像另一件事。
hintTraditional: 用來打比方,說一件事就像另一件事。
hintEnglish: Used to make an analogy, saying one thing is like another.

exampleSimplified: 他是公司里有名的电脑好手。
exampleTraditional: 他是公司裡有名的電腦好手。
exampleEnglish: He is a well-known computer expert in the company.
hintSimplified: 在某方面技术很强、很厉害的人。
hintTraditional: 在某方面技術很強、很厲害的人。
hintEnglish: A person who is very skilled and capable in some field.

definition: feeling better; to be more at ease
exampleSimplified: 吃了药以后,他觉得好受多了。
exampleTraditional: 吃了藥以後,他覺得好受多了。
exampleEnglish: After taking the medicine, he felt much better.
hintSimplified: 生病或难过时,身体或心里不那么痛苦的感觉。
hintTraditional: 生病或難過時,身體或心裡不那麼痛苦的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling of being less miserable in body or mind when sick or sad.

definition: (Tw) brokerage firm; mark; prison cell; sign; signal; sort; type; work chant
exampleSimplified: 爸爸每天都去号子看股票的行情。
exampleTraditional: 爸爸每天都去號子看股票的行情。
exampleEnglish: Dad goes to the brokerage office every day to check stock prices.
hintSimplified: 在台湾,人们买卖股票时常去的地方。
hintTraditional: 在台灣,人們買賣股票時常去的地方。
hintEnglish: In Taiwan, a place where people go to buy and sell stocks.

definition: to annex; to merge; variant of 合併|合并[he2 bing4]
exampleSimplified: 这两家公司决定合并,成为一家大企业。
exampleTraditional: 這兩家公司決定合併,成為一家大企業。
exampleEnglish: The two companies decided to merge into one big enterprise.
hintSimplified: 把两个或更多的组织变成一个。
hintTraditional: 把兩個或更多的組織變成一個。
hintEnglish: To turn two or more organizations into one.

exampleSimplified: 请你先看清楚合同,再签名。
exampleTraditional: 請你先看清楚合同,再簽名。
exampleEnglish: Please read the contract carefully before signing.
hintSimplified: 双方同意某些条件后,写下来并签名的文件。
hintTraditional: 雙方同意某些條件後,寫下來並簽名的檔案。
hintEnglish: A written document signed after two sides agree to certain terms.

definition: by mutual agreement; congenial; suitable; to suit one's taste
exampleSimplified: 这件衣服的样式很合意,我就买了。
exampleTraditional: 這件衣服的樣式很合意,我就買了。
exampleEnglish: This piece of clothing is just to my liking, so I bought it.
hintSimplified: 东西或人正好符合你的想法,让你觉得满意。
hintTraditional: 東西或人正好符合你的想法,讓你覺得滿意。
hintEnglish: When something or someone matches your wishes and satisfies you.

exampleSimplified: 这个问题的关键究竟何在?
exampleTraditional: 這個問題的關鍵究竟何在?
exampleEnglish: Where exactly does the key to this problem lie?
hintSimplified: 书面语,用来问某件事的重点或原因在哪里。
hintTraditional: 書面語,用來問某件事的重點或原因在哪裡。
hintEnglish: Written style, used to ask where the key point or reason of something lies.

definition: conciliation; settlement; to become reconciled; to reconcile; to settle (a dispute out of court)
exampleSimplified: 经过谈判,双方终于和解了。
exampleTraditional: 經過談判,雙方終於和解了。
exampleEnglish: After negotiations, the two sides finally reached a settlement.
hintSimplified: 吵架或打官司的人不再争了,重新变得友好。
hintTraditional: 吵架或打官司的人不再爭了,重新變得友好。
hintEnglish: People who were quarreling or in a lawsuit stop fighting and become friendly again.

exampleSimplified: 他们一家人相处得非常和睦。
exampleTraditional: 他們一家人相處得非常和睦。
exampleEnglish: Their family gets along very harmoniously.
hintSimplified: 形容人与人之间关系亲近,不吵架。
hintTraditional: 形容人與人之間關係親近,不吵架。
hintEnglish: Describes people whose relationships are close and free of quarrels.

exampleSimplified: 一个和谐的社会需要大家互相尊重。
exampleTraditional: 一個和諧的社會需要大家互相尊重。
exampleEnglish: A harmonious society needs everyone to respect each other.
hintSimplified: 形容各部分配合得很好,没有冲突。
hintTraditional: 形容各部分配合得很好,沒有衝突。
hintEnglish: Describes parts that fit together well with no conflict.

definition: determination; on a deemed basis (taxation); to appraise and decide; to audit and determine; to check and ratify; to deem
exampleSimplified: 这笔预算已经由主管核定了。
exampleTraditional: 這筆預算已經由主管核定了。
exampleEnglish: This budget has already been reviewed and approved by the supervisor.
hintSimplified: 经过检查之后,正式决定数字或标准。
hintTraditional: 經過檢查之後,正式決定數字或標準。
hintEnglish: After checking, to officially decide on a figure or standard.

definition: to audit; to check; to examine; to verify
exampleSimplified: 请把名单和身份证再核对一次。
exampleTraditional: 請把名單和身份證再核對一次。
exampleEnglish: Please check the list against the ID cards once more.
hintSimplified: 把两份资料放在一起比较,看有没有错。
hintTraditional: 把兩份資料放在一起比較,看有沒有錯。
hintEnglish: Compare two sets of information to see if there are any errors.

exampleSimplified: 会计正在核算这个月的成本。
exampleTraditional: 會計正在核算這個月的成本。
exampleEnglish: The accountant is calculating this month's costs.
hintSimplified: 仔细计算钱或成本等数字。
hintTraditional: 仔細計算錢或成本等數字。
hintEnglish: To carefully calculate figures such as money or costs.

definition: to authorize; to investigate then ratify
exampleSimplified: 政府已经核准了这个建设计划。
exampleTraditional: 政府已經核准了這個建設計劃。
exampleEnglish: The government has already approved this construction plan.
hintSimplified: 上级检查后同意某件事,可以进行。
hintTraditional: 上級檢查後同意某件事,可以進行。
hintEnglish: A higher authority checks and agrees that something may go ahead.

exampleSimplified: 这位科学家研究核子物理已经三十年了。
exampleTraditional: 這位科學家研究核子物理已經三十年了。
exampleEnglish: This scientist has studied nuclear physics for thirty years.
hintSimplified: 与原子中心的部分有关,常和能量、反应堆连在一起。
hintTraditional: 與原子中心的部分有關,常和能量、反應堆連在一起。
hintEnglish: Related to the center of an atom, often linked with energy and reactors.

definition: callous; heartless; firm resolve (as in 下狠心[xia4 hen3 xin1]); to resolve (to do sth)
exampleSimplified: 他狠心地把小狗丢在路边。
exampleTraditional: 他狠心地把小狗丟在路邊。
exampleEnglish: He cruelly abandoned the puppy by the roadside.
hintSimplified: 形容人不顾别人的感受,心肠很硬;有时也指下定决心。
hintTraditional: 形容人不顧別人的感受,心腸很硬;有時也指下定決心。
hintEnglish: Describes someone hard-hearted who ignores others' feelings; sometimes steeling oneself.

definition: to consider; to examine; to weigh
exampleSimplified: 我们不能只用成绩来衡量一个学生。
exampleTraditional: 我們不能只用成績來衡量一個學生。
exampleEnglish: We cannot judge a student only by grades.
hintSimplified: 用某种标准去判断一个人或事物的价值或好坏。
hintTraditional: 用某種標準去判斷一個人或事物的價值或好壞。
hintEnglish: To use some standard to judge the value or quality of a person or thing.

definition: commotion; controversy; to cause a sensation; to create a stir in (a place)
exampleSimplified: 这部电影上映后,轰动了全台湾。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影上映後,轟動了全台灣。
exampleEnglish: After its release, this movie caused a sensation across all of Taiwan.
hintSimplified: 一件大事让很多人都很吃惊、都在谈论。
hintTraditional: 一件大事讓很多人都很吃驚、都在談論。
hintEnglish: A big event that surprises many people and gets everyone talking.

exampleSimplified: 今年公司发给员工很多红利。
exampleTraditional: 今年公司發給員工很多紅利。
exampleEnglish: This year the company gave employees a large bonus.
hintSimplified: 公司赚钱后,分给股东或员工的钱。
hintTraditional: 公司賺錢後,分給股東或員工的錢。
hintEnglish: Money a company shares with shareholders or employees after making a profit.

gloss: to braise in soy sauce until reddish-brown
definition: to braise in soy sauce until reddish-brown
exampleSimplified: 妈妈做的红烧肉又香又好吃。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽做的紅燒肉又香又好吃。
exampleEnglish: The braised pork my mom makes is fragrant and delicious.
hintSimplified: 一种用酱油慢慢炖煮，让菜变成深褐色的烹饪方法。
hintTraditional: 一種用醬油慢慢燉煮，讓菜變成深褐色的烹飪方法。
hintEnglish: A cooking method of slowly stewing food in soy sauce until it turns deep brown.

exampleSimplified: 大雨过后，洪水淹没了许多房子。
exampleTraditional: 大雨過後，洪水淹沒了許多房子。
exampleEnglish: After the heavy rain, the flood swamped many houses.
hintSimplified: 大雨或河水涨得太高，水冲到陆地上造成的灾害。
hintTraditional: 大雨或河水漲得太高，水衝到陸地上造成的災害。
hintEnglish: A disaster in which rain or rivers rise too high and water covers the land.

definition: grand; imposing; magnificent; see 宏偉區|宏伟区[Hong2 wei3 Qu1]
exampleSimplified: 这座宏伟的建筑吸引了很多游客。
exampleTraditional: 這座宏偉的建築吸引了很多遊客。
exampleEnglish: This magnificent building attracts many tourists.
hintSimplified: 形容建筑或计划规模很大、很有气势。
hintTraditional: 形容建築或計劃規模很大、很有氣勢。
hintEnglish: Describes a building or plan that is huge and impressive.

exampleSimplified: 前辈应该多照顾后辈。
exampleTraditional: 前輩應該多照顧後輩。
exampleEnglish: Seniors should take good care of those who come after them.
hintSimplified: 指比自己年轻、资历较浅的人，和前辈相对。
hintTraditional: 指比自己年輕、資歷較淺的人，和前輩相對。
hintEnglish: People younger or less experienced than oneself; the opposite of seniors.

definition: an appeal; to appeal (to); to call on (sb to do sth)
exampleSimplified: 政府呼吁大家少用塑料袋，保护环境。
exampleTraditional: 政府呼籲大家少用塑膠袋，保護環境。
exampleEnglish: The government appeals to everyone to use fewer plastic bags and protect the environment.
hintSimplified: 公开请求大家一起做某件事。
hintTraditional: 公開請求大家一起做某件事。
hintEnglish: To publicly ask people to join in doing something.

definition: absent-mindedly; any old how; at random; at will; careless; casually; reckless
exampleSimplified: 他胡乱吃了几口，就匆匆出门了。
exampleTraditional: 他胡亂吃了幾口，就匆匆出門了。
exampleEnglish: He ate a few bites carelessly and hurried out.
hintSimplified: 做事没有认真想，也没有照规矩，随便乱来。
hintTraditional: 做事沒有認真想，也沒有照規矩，隨便亂來。
hintEnglish: Doing something carelessly, without thought or order.

exampleSimplified: 他对这个消息充满狐疑，不敢相信。
exampleTraditional: 他對這個訊息充滿狐疑，不敢相信。
exampleEnglish: He was full of suspicion about the news and couldn't believe it.
hintSimplified: 心里觉得有问题，不太相信，一直猜想。
hintTraditional: 心裡覺得有問題，不太相信，一直猜想。
hintEnglish: Feeling that something is off and not trusting it, constantly wondering.

gloss: (in Hong Kong and Macau) bank account
definition: (in Hong Kong and Macau) bank account; population (counted as number of households for census or taxation); registered residence; residence permit
exampleSimplified: 他把户口迁到了台北。
exampleTraditional: 他把戶口遷到了台北。
exampleEnglish: He moved his household registration to Taipei.
hintSimplified: 政府登记一家人住在哪里的正式记录。
hintTraditional: 政府登記一家人住在哪裡的正式記錄。
hintEnglish: The official government record of where a household lives.

exampleSimplified: 我们的能力正好可以互补。
exampleTraditional: 我們的能力正好可以互補。
exampleEnglish: Our abilities complement each other just right.
hintSimplified: 两方各有长处，可以补足对方的不足。
hintTraditional: 兩方各有長處，可以補足對方的不足。
hintEnglish: Two sides each have strengths that make up for the other's weaknesses.

exampleSimplified: 两国签订了互惠的贸易协定。
exampleTraditional: 兩國簽訂了互惠的貿易協定。
exampleEnglish: The two countries signed a mutually beneficial trade agreement.
hintSimplified: 双方都能得到好处的合作方式。
hintTraditional: 雙方都能得到好處的合作方式。
hintEnglish: A way of cooperating in which both sides gain something.

exampleSimplified: 春风一吹，粉红色的花瓣落了一地。
exampleTraditional: 春風一吹，粉紅色的花瓣落了一地。
exampleEnglish: When the spring wind blew, pink petals covered the ground.
hintSimplified: 组成一朵花的一片片彩色部分。
hintTraditional: 組成一朵花的一片片彩色部分。
hintEnglish: The colorful individual pieces that make up a flower.

exampleSimplified: 公园里开满了美丽的花朵。
exampleTraditional: 公園裡開滿了美麗的花朵。
exampleEnglish: The park is full of beautiful blossoms.
hintSimplified: 植物上开出来、很漂亮的部分，常用一朵两朵来数。
hintTraditional: 植物上開出來、很漂亮的部分，常用一朵兩朵來數。
hintEnglish: The pretty part that blooms on a plant, counted with a measure word for blossoms.

exampleSimplified: 这个花市有各种各样的花卉。
exampleTraditional: 這個花市有各種各樣的花卉。
exampleEnglish: This flower market has all kinds of flowers and plants.
hintSimplified: 可以观赏的花和植物的总称。
hintTraditional: 可以觀賞的花和植物的總稱。
hintEnglish: A general term for ornamental flowers and plants.

exampleSimplified: 这个杯子上有很漂亮的花纹。
exampleTraditional: 這個杯子上有很漂亮的花紋。
exampleEnglish: This cup has a very beautiful pattern on it.
hintSimplified: 布、盘子或墙上用来装饰的线条和图案。
hintTraditional: 布、盤子或牆上用來裝飾的線條和圖案。
hintEnglish: The decorative lines and designs on cloth, plates or walls.

gloss: fancy-style (as in 花樣滑冰|花样滑冰[hua1 yang4 hua2 bing1] figure skating)
definition: fancy-style (as in 花樣滑冰|花样滑冰[hua1 yang4 hua2 bing1] figure skating); pattern; ruse; trick; way of doing sth
exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅的菜单上有很多新花样。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳的選單上有很多新花樣。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant's menu has many new varieties.
hintSimplified: 指做事或东西的各种不同样式和变化。
hintTraditional: 指做事或東西的各種不同樣式和變化。
hintEnglish: The different styles and variations of how something is done or made.

definition: ethnic Chinese; non-Chinese citizen of Chinese ancestry
exampleSimplified: 他是在美国出生的华裔青年。
exampleTraditional: 他是在美國出生的華裔青年。
exampleEnglish: He is a young person of Chinese descent born in the United States.
hintSimplified: 住在外国，但祖先是中国人的人。
hintTraditional: 住在外國，但祖先是中國人的人。
hintEnglish: A person living abroad whose ancestors were Chinese.

gloss: chemical engineering (abbr. for 化學工程|化学工程[hua4 xue2 gong1 cheng2])
definition: chemical engineering (abbr. for 化學工程|化学工程[hua4 xue2 gong1 cheng2]); chemical industry (abbr. for 化學工業|化学工业[hua4 xue2 gong1 ye4])
exampleSimplified: 哥哥大学念的是化工，现在在工厂上班。
exampleTraditional: 哥哥大學唸的是化工，現在在工廠上班。
exampleEnglish: My older brother studied chemical engineering in college and now works in a factory.
hintSimplified: 用化学方法制造塑料、药品等产品的工业或专业。
hintTraditional: 用化學方法制造塑膠、藥品等產品的工業或專業。
hintEnglish: An industry or field that makes plastics, medicine and the like by chemical methods.

exampleSimplified: 博物馆里展示着恐龙的化石。
exampleTraditional: 博物館裡展示著恐龍的化石。
exampleEnglish: The museum displays dinosaur fossils.
hintSimplified: 保存在石头里的几百万年前动植物的遗迹。
hintTraditional: 儲存在石頭裡的幾百萬年前動植物的遺蹟。
hintEnglish: Remains of ancient animals or plants preserved in rock for millions of years.

definition: CL:臺|台[tai2],部[bu4]; modern drama; stage play
exampleSimplified: 我们周末去剧院看了一场话剧。
exampleTraditional: 我們週末去劇院看了一場話劇。
exampleEnglish: We went to the theater on the weekend to see a stage play.
hintSimplified: 演员在舞台上用说话和动作演出的戏，没有唱歌为主。
hintTraditional: 演員在舞台上用說話和動作演出的戲，沒有唱歌為主。
hintEnglish: A theater performance where actors mainly speak and act on stage, rather than sing.

exampleSimplified: 周末我想去看他的画展。
exampleTraditional: 週末我想去看他的畫展。
exampleEnglish: This weekend I want to go see his art exhibition.
hintSimplified: 把画家的作品放在一个地方给大家参观的活动。
hintTraditional: 把畫家的作品放在一個地方給大家參觀的活動。
hintEnglish: An event where an artist's paintings are displayed for visitors to see.

definition: to see off; to send off
exampleSimplified: 同学们开了一个晚会欢送毕业的学长。
exampleTraditional: 同學們開了一個晚會歡送畢業的學長。
exampleEnglish: The students held a party to send off the graduating seniors.
hintSimplified: 用聚会等方式热情地送别要离开的人。
hintTraditional: 用聚會等方式熱情地送別要離開的人。
hintEnglish: To warmly bid farewell to someone who is leaving, often with a gathering.

exampleSimplified: 沙漠里的湖水只是一种幻象。
exampleTraditional: 沙漠裡的湖水只是一種幻象。
exampleEnglish: The lake in the desert was just an illusion.
hintSimplified: 看起来像真的，其实不存在的景象。
hintTraditional: 看起來像真的，其實不存在的景象。
hintEnglish: A scene that looks real but actually does not exist.

definition: to exchange (sth) for (sth else); to obtain (sth) in exchange
exampleSimplified: 他用自己的努力换取了成功。
exampleTraditional: 他用自己的努力換取了成功。
exampleEnglish: He exchanged his hard work for success.
hintSimplified: 付出一些东西，从而得到另一样想要的东西。
hintTraditional: 付出一些東西，從而得到另一樣想要的東西。
hintEnglish: To give up something in order to obtain something else you want.

exampleSimplified: 医生正在照顾那位患者。
exampleTraditional: 醫生正在照顧那位患者。
exampleEnglish: The doctor is taking care of that patient.
hintSimplified: 生病、接受医生治疗的人，比较正式的说法。
hintTraditional: 生病、接受醫生治療的人，比較正式的說法。
hintEnglish: A person who is ill and receiving treatment from a doctor; a formal term.

definition: absurd; beyond belief; dissipated; intemperate; preposterous
exampleSimplified: 这个想法太荒唐了，没有人会相信。
exampleTraditional: 這個想法太荒唐了，沒有人會相信。
exampleEnglish: This idea is too absurd; nobody would believe it.
hintSimplified: 形容事情或言行很不合理，让人觉得可笑。
hintTraditional: 形容事情或言行很不合理，讓人覺得可笑。
hintEnglish: Describes things or behavior so unreasonable that they seem laughable.

exampleSimplified: 他慌张地跑进教室,忘了带书包。
exampleTraditional: 他慌張地跑進教室,忘了帶書包。
exampleEnglish: He ran into the classroom in a flustered state and forgot his school bag.
hintSimplified: 形容人遇到突然的事情,心里着急,动作乱七八糟、不够镇定。
hintTraditional: 形容人遇到突然的事情,心裡著急,動作亂七八糟、不夠鎮定。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who, faced with something sudden, is anxious and acts in a disorderly, unsteady way.

exampleSimplified: 听到地震的消息,大家都感到十分惶恐。
exampleTraditional: 聽到地震的訊息,大家都感到十分惶恐。
exampleEnglish: Hearing the news of the earthquake, everyone felt extremely fearful and uneasy.
hintSimplified: 形容人因为害怕和不安,心里非常紧张。
hintTraditional: 形容人因為害怕和不安,心裡非常緊張。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is very tense inside because of fear and unease.

exampleSimplified: 他昨晚没睡好,今天整天精神恍惚。
exampleTraditional: 他昨晚沒睡好,今天整天精神恍惚。
exampleEnglish: He didn't sleep well last night and has been in a daze all day.
hintSimplified: 人没有精神,注意力不集中,好像在做梦一样。
hintTraditional: 人沒有精神,注意力不集中,好像在做夢一樣。
hintEnglish: A person lacks energy and can't concentrate, as if in a dream.

exampleSimplified: 书架上积了一层厚厚的灰尘。
exampleTraditional: 書架上積了一層厚厚的灰塵。
exampleEnglish: A thick layer of dust has built up on the bookshelf.
hintSimplified: 房间很久没打扫,桌子和书上会有的细小脏东西。
hintTraditional: 房間很久沒打掃,桌子和書上會有的細小髒東西。
hintEnglish: The fine dirty particles that cover tables and books when a room hasn't been cleaned for a long time.

exampleSimplified: 这位运动员有着辉煌的成绩。
