exampleTraditional: 這件事對我們極為重要。
exampleEnglish: This matter is extremely important to us.
hintSimplified: 程度副词，表示程度非常高，比“很”更强。
hintTraditional: 程度副詞，表示程度非常高，比“很”更強。
hintEnglish: A degree adverb meaning a very high level, stronger than "very".

definition: to assemble; to build up; to concentrate; to marshal; to mass
exampleSimplified: 士兵们在广场上集结，准备出发。
exampleTraditional: 士兵們在廣場上集結，準備出發。
exampleEnglish: The soldiers assembled in the square, ready to set off.
hintSimplified: 很多人或军队聚在同一个地方，准备行动。
hintTraditional: 很多人或軍隊聚在同一個地方，準備行動。
hintEnglish: Many people or troops gather in one place, getting ready to act.

gloss: centralized power (history), e.g. under an Emperor or party
definition: centralized power (history), e.g. under an Emperor or party
exampleSimplified: 古代皇帝为了集权，削弱了地方的力量。
exampleTraditional: 古代皇帝為了集權，削弱了地方的力量。
exampleEnglish: To centralize power, ancient emperors weakened the strength of local regions.
hintSimplified: 把国家的权力都集中在中央或一个人手里。
hintTraditional: 把國家的權力都集中在中央或一個人手裡。
hintEnglish: Gathering all of a country's power in the central government or one person.

definition: a group; a team; as a group; collective (decision); en masse; joint (effort)
exampleSimplified: 我们要有集体荣誉感。
exampleTraditional: 我們要有集體榮譽感。
exampleEnglish: We should have a sense of collective honor.
hintSimplified: 和“个人”相对，指许多人组成的整体。
hintTraditional: 和“個人”相對，指許多人組成的整體。
hintEnglish: The opposite of "individual"; a whole made up of many people.

exampleSimplified: 他在一家大型集团公司工作。
exampleTraditional: 他在一家大型集團公司工作。
exampleEnglish: He works at a large corporate group.
hintSimplified: 由很多公司或组织结合而成的大型机构。
hintTraditional: 由很多公司或組織結合而成的大型機構。
hintEnglish: A large organization formed by combining many companies or bodies.

definition: first aid; to give emergency treatment
exampleSimplified: 医生到达以前，他先给病人做了急救。
exampleTraditional: 醫生到達以前，他先給病人做了急救。
exampleEnglish: Before the doctor arrived, he gave the patient first aid.
hintSimplified: 有人突然受伤或生病时，在医院以外先做的紧急处理。
hintTraditional: 有人突然受傷或生病時，在醫院以外先做的緊急處理。
hintEnglish: Urgent treatment given outside the hospital when someone is suddenly hurt or ill.

exampleSimplified: 他的脾气很急躁，做事总是等不及。
exampleTraditional: 他的脾氣很急躁，做事總是等不及。
exampleEnglish: He has a hot temper and is always impatient when doing things.
hintSimplified: 形容人心里着急，没有耐心，容易冲动。
hintTraditional: 形容人心裡著急，沒有耐心，容易衝動。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is anxious, lacks patience and acts on impulse.

gloss: one's ancestral home (registered place of family origin, typically inherited patrilineally and recorded in official documents)
definition: one's ancestral home (registered place of family origin, typically inherited patrilineally and recorded in official documents)
exampleSimplified: 请在表格上填写你的姓名和籍贯。
exampleTraditional: 請在表格上填寫你的姓名和籍貫。
exampleEnglish: Please fill in your name and ancestral home on the form.
hintSimplified: 表格上常有的一项，指祖先或家族原来居住的地方。
hintTraditional: 表格上常有的一項，指祖先或家族原來居住的地方。
hintEnglish: An item often on forms, referring to the place where one's ancestors or family originally came from.

exampleSimplified: 那架飞机被导弹击落了。
exampleTraditional: 那架飛機被導彈擊落了。
exampleEnglish: That plane was shot down by a missile.
hintSimplified: 用武器打中天上的飞机，让它掉下来。
hintTraditional: 用武器打中天上的飛機，讓它掉下來。
hintEnglish: Hitting an aircraft in the sky with a weapon so that it falls down.

definition: to carry on (a tradition etc); to inherit; to succeed to (the throne etc)
exampleSimplified: 他继承了父亲留下的房子。
exampleTraditional: 他繼承了父親留下的房子。
exampleEnglish: He inherited the house his father left behind.
hintSimplified: 接受前人留下的财产、传统或事业。
hintTraditional: 接受前人留下的財產、傳統或事業。
hintEnglish: To receive the property, traditions or work left by earlier people.

exampleSimplified: 夏天的季风给这个地区带来了大量雨水。
exampleTraditional: 夏天的季風給這個地區帶來了大量雨水。
exampleEnglish: The summer monsoon brings a lot of rain to this region.
hintSimplified: 随季节改变方向的风，常带来一个雨季。
hintTraditional: 隨季節改變方向的風，常帶來一個雨季。
hintEnglish: A wind that changes direction with the seasons and often brings a rainy season.

exampleSimplified: 医生说这种药的剂量不能太大。
exampleTraditional: 醫生說這種藥的劑量不能太大。
exampleEnglish: The doctor said the dosage of this medicine must not be too large.
hintSimplified: 吃药时，每次应该使用的分量。
hintTraditional: 吃藥時，每次應該使用的分量。
hintEnglish: The amount of medicine that should be taken each time.

exampleSimplified: 学校要求学生遵守纪律。
exampleTraditional: 學校要求學生遵守紀律。
exampleEnglish: The school requires students to follow discipline.
hintSimplified: 团体里要求大家必须遵守的规矩。
hintTraditional: 團體裡要求大家必須遵守的規矩。
hintEnglish: The rules that everyone in a group must obey.

exampleSimplified: 学好一项技能可以帮你找到工作。
exampleTraditional: 學好一項技能可以幫你找到工作。
exampleEnglish: Mastering a skill can help you find a job.
hintSimplified: 经过学习或练习得到的、能做某件事的本领。
hintTraditional: 經過學習或練習得到的、能做某件事的本領。
hintEnglish: An ability to do something, gained through learning or practice.

exampleSimplified: 这位老师傅的技艺非常高超。
exampleTraditional: 這位老師傅的技藝非常高超。
exampleEnglish: This old master's craftsmanship is extremely superb.
hintSimplified: 手工艺人或表演者精巧的手艺和本领。
hintTraditional: 手工藝人或表演者精巧的手藝和本領。
hintEnglish: The refined handiwork and skill of a craftsman or performer.

gloss: to offer sacrifices to the gods or ancestors
definition: to offer sacrifices to the gods or ancestors
exampleSimplified: 清明节时，人们会祭祀祖先。
exampleTraditional: 清明節時，人們會祭祀祖先。
exampleEnglish: During the Qingming Festival, people hold rites to honor their ancestors.
hintSimplified: 用食物和香等，向神明或祖先表示敬意的仪式。
hintTraditional: 用食物和香等，向神明或祖先表示敬意的儀式。
hintEnglish: A ceremony using food, incense and so on to show respect to gods or ancestors.

definition: (coll.) guy; chap; domestic animal; household dish, implement or furniture; variant of 家伙[jia1 huo5]; weapon
exampleSimplified: 那个家伙今天又迟到了。
exampleTraditional: 那個傢伙今天又遲到了。
exampleEnglish: That guy was late again today.
hintSimplified: 口语中称呼某个人，有时带一点不客气或亲昵的语气。
hintTraditional: 口語中稱呼某個人，有時帶一點不客氣或親暱的語氣。
hintEnglish: A casual way to refer to a person, sometimes slightly rude or affectionate.

exampleSimplified: 医院通知了病人的家属。
exampleTraditional: 醫院通知了病人的家屬。
exampleEnglish: The hospital notified the patient's family members.
hintSimplified: 和某个人有亲属关系的人，尤其是同住的亲人。
hintTraditional: 和某個人有親屬關係的人，尤其是同住的親人。
hintEnglish: People related to a certain person, especially the relatives who live with them.

exampleSimplified: 中秋佳节，全家人一起赏月。
exampleTraditional: 中秋佳節，全家人一起賞月。
exampleEnglish: On the Mid-Autumn festive day, the whole family admires the moon together.
hintSimplified: 指快乐、值得庆祝的节日，常用于书面语。
hintTraditional: 指快樂、值得慶祝的節日，常用於書面語。
hintEnglish: A happy, celebration-worthy holiday, often used in written language.

exampleSimplified: 这首古诗写的是一位美丽的佳人。
exampleTraditional: 這首古詩寫的是一位美麗的佳人。
exampleEnglish: This ancient poem describes a beautiful lady.
hintSimplified: 古诗文里常用来称呼容貌出众的年轻女子。
hintTraditional: 古詩文裡常用來稱呼容貌出眾的年輕女子。
hintEnglish: Used in classical writing to refer to a young woman of outstanding looks.

definition: to intensify; to speed up; to step up
exampleSimplified: 工人们加紧赶工，希望按时完成。
exampleTraditional: 工人們加緊趕工，希望按時完成。
exampleEnglish: The workers stepped up their efforts, hoping to finish on time.
hintSimplified: 因为时间不多，让工作或行动更紧张、更用力。
hintTraditional: 因為時間不多，讓工作或行動更緊張、更用力。
hintEnglish: Making work or action more urgent and intense because time is short.

gloss: to accelerate; to speed up; to hasten
definition: to accelerate; to speed up; to hasten
exampleSimplified: 我们必须加快脚步，否则会赶不上火车。
exampleTraditional: 我們必須加快腳步，否則會趕不上火車。
exampleEnglish: We must speed up our pace, or we will miss the train.
hintSimplified: 让速度变得更快。
hintTraditional: 讓速度變得更快。
hintEnglish: To make the speed become higher.

exampleSimplified: 老板说年底会给表现好的员工加薪。
exampleTraditional: 老闆說年底會給表現好的員工加薪。
exampleEnglish: The boss said that good employees will get a raise at the end of the year.
hintSimplified: 公司给员工的工资变多。
hintTraditional: 公司給員工的工資變多。
hintEnglish: A company gives its employees more pay.

gloss: (of an illness etc) to become more serious
definition: (of an illness etc) to become more serious; to aggravate (a bad situation); to emphasize; to increase (a burden, punishment etc); to make heavier
exampleSimplified: 天气变冷后，他的病情加重了。
exampleTraditional: 天氣變冷後，他的病情加重了。
exampleEnglish: After the weather turned cold, his illness got worse.
hintSimplified: 让病情、负担或问题变得更严重。
hintTraditional: 讓病情、負擔或問題變得更嚴重。
hintEnglish: To make an illness, burden or problem more serious.

exampleSimplified: 她终于挣脱了传统观念的枷锁。
exampleTraditional: 她終於掙脫了傳統觀念的枷鎖。
exampleEnglish: She finally broke free from the shackles of traditional thinking.
hintSimplified: 原本指套在人身上的刑具，现在常比喻束缚人的东西。
hintTraditional: 原本指套在人身上的刑具，現在常比喻束縛人的東西。
hintEnglish: Originally a restraint put on a prisoner, now often a metaphor for something that holds people back.

definition: a mix; to be tangled up with; to mingle; to mix together (disparate substances)
exampleSimplified: 他的话里夹杂着一些方言。
exampleTraditional: 他的話裡夾雜著一些方言。
exampleEnglish: His speech was mixed with some dialect words.
hintSimplified: 指不同的东西混在一起，不是单纯的一种。
hintTraditional: 指不同的東西混在一起，不是單純的一種。
hintEnglish: Describes different things being mixed together rather than being pure.

exampleSimplified: 假若明天下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
exampleTraditional: 假若明天下雨，我們就不去爬山了。
exampleEnglish: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.
hintSimplified: 连词，用来提出一个条件或假设，后面接结果。
hintTraditional: 連詞，用來提出一個條件或假設，後面接結果。
hintEnglish: A conjunction that introduces a hypothetical condition, followed by a result.

exampleSimplified: 假使你是我，你会怎么做？
exampleTraditional: 假使你是我，你會怎麼做？
exampleEnglish: If you were me, what would you do?
hintSimplified: 连词，用来设想一种不一定会发生的情况。
hintTraditional: 連詞，用來設想一種不一定會發生的情況。
hintEnglish: A conjunction used to imagine a situation that may not actually happen.

exampleSimplified: 这只是一种假象，事实并不是这样。
exampleTraditional: 這只是一種假象，事實並不是這樣。
exampleEnglish: This is only an illusion; the truth is not like this.
hintSimplified: 表面看起来是这样，但其实不是真的情况。
hintTraditional: 表面看起來是這樣，但其實不是真的情況。
hintEnglish: A surface appearance that looks real but is not the true situation.

definition: airs; arrogance; frame; framework; shelf; stand
exampleSimplified: 他把书都放在书架子上。
exampleTraditional: 他把書都放在書架子上。
exampleEnglish: He put all his books on the bookshelf.
hintSimplified: 用来放东西的框架；也可以指人摆出的高傲态度。
hintTraditional: 用來放東西的框架；也可以指人擺出的高傲態度。
hintEnglish: A frame used for holding things; it can also mean a haughty attitude someone puts on.

definition: structure; framework; architecture; to construct; to build
exampleSimplified: 这个软件的架构非常清楚。
exampleTraditional: 這個軟體的架構非常清楚。
exampleEnglish: The architecture of this software is very clear.
hintSimplified: 指系统或建筑整体的组成方式和基本框架。
hintTraditional: 指系統或建築整體的組成方式和基本框架。
hintEnglish: The overall way a system or building is organized, its basic framework.

gloss: to supervise; to oversee; to inspect
definition: to supervise; to oversee; to inspect
exampleSimplified: 政府应该监督食品的安全。
exampleTraditional: 政府應該監督食品的安全。
exampleEnglish: The government should oversee food safety.
hintSimplified: 在旁边注意看着，确保别人做事符合规定。
hintTraditional: 在旁邊注意看著，確保別人做事符合規定。
hintEnglish: To watch closely to make sure others act according to the rules.

definition: highest peak; most advanced and sophisticated; sharp pointed end; the best; the cusp; the tip; tip-top
exampleSimplified: 这家公司研发尖端科技。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司研發尖端科技。
exampleEnglish: This company develops cutting-edge technology.
hintSimplified: 形容科技或技术发展得最先进、最前面。
hintTraditional: 形容科技或技術發展得最先進、最前面。
hintEnglish: Describes technology that is the most advanced and at the very front.

exampleSimplified: 这座桥建得非常坚固。
exampleTraditional: 這座橋建得非常堅固。
exampleEnglish: This bridge is built very solidly.
hintSimplified: 形容建筑或东西结实，不容易坏。
hintTraditional: 形容建築或東西結實，不容易壞。
hintEnglish: Describes a building or object that is sturdy and not easily damaged.

exampleSimplified: 她以坚忍的毅力度过了难关。
exampleTraditional: 她以堅忍的毅力度過了難關。
exampleEnglish: She got through the hard times with great perseverance.
hintSimplified: 形容人遇到困难时能忍耐，不轻易放弃。
hintTraditional: 形容人遇到困難時能忍耐，不輕易放棄。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who endures hardship and does not give up easily.

definition: to believe firmly; without any doubt
exampleSimplified: 我坚信只要努力，就一定会成功。
exampleTraditional: 我堅信只要努力，就一定會成功。
exampleEnglish: I firmly believe that as long as you work hard, you will succeed.
hintSimplified: 非常确定地相信某件事，一点也不怀疑。
hintTraditional: 非常確定地相信某件事，一點也不懷疑。
hintEnglish: To trust that something is true with no doubt at all.

exampleSimplified: 这块石头又重又坚硬。
exampleTraditional: 這塊石頭又重又堅硬。
exampleEnglish: This rock is both heavy and hard.
hintSimplified: 形容东西很硬，不容易弄破或弄弯。
hintTraditional: 形容東西很硬，不容易弄破或弄彎。
hintEnglish: Describes something very hard that is not easily broken or bent.

definition: concurrent job; moonlighting; to hold concurrent posts
exampleSimplified: 他白天上班，晚上还做兼职。
exampleTraditional: 他白天上班，晚上還做兼職。
exampleEnglish: He works during the day and also has a part-time job at night.
hintSimplified: 在主要的工作以外，另外做的一份工作。
hintTraditional: 在主要的工作以外，另外做的一份工作。
hintEnglish: An extra job done in addition to one's main work.

gloss: (of a task, mission or responsibility) extremely difficult; challenging; demanding
definition: (of a task, mission or responsibility) extremely difficult; challenging; demanding; variant of 艱鉅|艰巨[jian1 ju4]
exampleSimplified: 这是一项艰巨的任务。
exampleTraditional: 這是一項艱鉅的任務。
exampleEnglish: This is an extremely demanding task.
hintSimplified: 形容任务或责任非常困难，需要很大的努力。
hintTraditional: 形容任務或責任非常困難，需要很大的努力。
hintEnglish: Describes a task or responsibility that is very hard and requires great effort.

exampleSimplified: 山区的生活条件很艰苦。
exampleTraditional: 山區的生活條件很艱苦。
exampleEnglish: Living conditions in the mountain area are very harsh.
hintSimplified: 形容生活或环境很差，过得很辛苦。
hintTraditional: 形容生活或環境很差，過得很辛苦。
hintEnglish: Describes life or surroundings that are poor and tough to endure.

exampleSimplified: 那段日子过得十分艰难。
exampleTraditional: 那段日子過得十分艱難。
exampleEnglish: Those days were very hard to get through.
hintSimplified: 形容处境困难，做起来很不容易。
hintTraditional: 形容處境困難，做起來很不容易。
hintEnglish: Describes a situation that is difficult and not easy to handle.

exampleSimplified: 这种方法既简便又省时间。
exampleTraditional: 這種方法既簡便又省時間。
exampleEnglish: This method is both simple and time-saving.
hintSimplified: 形容方法容易，用起来不麻烦。
hintTraditional: 形容方法容易，用起來不麻煩。
hintEnglish: Describes a method that is easy and not troublesome to use.

definition: abbreviation; short form; to be abbreviated to
exampleSimplified: 台北大学的简称是北大。
exampleTraditional: 台北大學的簡稱是北大。
exampleEnglish: The short form of the university's name is Beida.
hintSimplified: 把比较长的名字缩短以后的叫法。
hintTraditional: 把比較長的名字縮短以後的叫法。
hintEnglish: The name used after a long name has been shortened.

exampleSimplified: 我们应该把手续简化一点。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該把手續簡化一點。
exampleEnglish: We should make the procedures a bit simpler.
hintSimplified: 把复杂的东西变得比较容易、不那么麻烦。
hintTraditional: 把複雜的東西變得比較容易、不那麼麻煩。
hintEnglish: To make something complicated easier and less troublesome.

gloss: simplified form of Chinese characters, as opposed to traditional form 繁體|繁体[fan2 ti3]
definition: simplified form of Chinese characters, as opposed to traditional form 繁體|繁体[fan2 ti3]
exampleSimplified: 这本书有简体和繁体两种版本。
exampleTraditional: 這本書有簡體和繁體兩種版本。
exampleEnglish: This book comes in both simplified and traditional character versions.
hintSimplified: 笔画比较少的汉字写法，中国大陆常用。
hintTraditional: 筆畫比較少的漢字寫法，中國大陸常用。
hintEnglish: The form of Chinese characters with fewer strokes, commonly used in mainland China.

definition: review; self-criticism; to examine or inspect
exampleSimplified: 会议结束后，我们一起检讨这次的错误。
exampleTraditional: 會議結束後，我們一起檢討這次的錯誤。
exampleEnglish: After the meeting, we reviewed this mistake together.
hintSimplified: 回头看自己做过的事，找出问题和不足。
hintTraditional: 回頭看自己做過的事，找出問題和不足。
hintEnglish: To look back at what was done and find the problems and shortcomings.

exampleSimplified: 他对这个问题有独特的见解。
exampleTraditional: 他對這個問題有獨特的見解。
exampleEnglish: He has a unique view on this issue.
hintSimplified: 对事情的看法或想法，常常很有深度。
hintTraditional: 對事情的看法或想法，常常很有深度。
hintEnglish: One's way of seeing or thinking about something, often with some depth.

definition: experience; insight; knowledge; to experience for oneself; to gain first-hand knowledge of sth
exampleSimplified: 出国旅行可以增长见识。
exampleTraditional: 出國旅行可以增長見識。
exampleEnglish: Traveling abroad can broaden your horizons.
hintSimplified: 因为看过、经历过很多事而得到的知识和眼界。
hintTraditional: 因為看過、經歷過很多事而得到的知識和眼界。
hintEnglish: The knowledge and perspective gained from having seen and experienced many things.

definition: evidence; to be witness to; witness
exampleSimplified: 这座老桥见证了城市的变化。
exampleTraditional: 這座老橋見證了城市的變化。
exampleEnglish: This old bridge bore witness to the city's changes.
hintSimplified: 亲眼看到重要的事情发生，并能证明它是真的。
hintTraditional: 親眼看到重要的事情發生，並能證明它是真的。
hintEnglish: To see an important event happen with one's own eyes and be able to confirm it.

exampleSimplified: 他们打算在海边建造一座新的桥。
exampleTraditional: 他們打算在海邊建造一座新的橋。
exampleEnglish: They plan to build a new bridge by the sea.
hintSimplified: 工人用材料把房子、桥或大楼做起来。
hintTraditional: 工人用材料把房子、橋或大樓做起來。
hintEnglish: Workers use materials to put up a house, bridge or tall building.

definition: physical exercise; to exercise; to keep fit; to work out
exampleSimplified: 我每个星期去健身房健身三次。
exampleTraditional: 我每個星期去健身房健身三次。
exampleEnglish: I go to the gym to work out three times a week.
hintSimplified: 为了让身体更强壮，在运动中心做的活动。
hintTraditional: 為了讓身體更強壯，在運動中心做的活動。
hintEnglish: An activity done at a sports center to make your body stronger.

exampleSimplified: 他长得又高又健壮，一点也不怕冷。
exampleTraditional: 他長得又高又健壯，一點也不怕冷。
exampleEnglish: He is tall and sturdy and not afraid of the cold at all.
hintSimplified: 形容人的身体强壮，很有力气，也不容易生病。
hintTraditional: 形容人的身體強壯，很有力氣，也不容易生病。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose body is strong, full of strength and rarely sick.

definition: fig. to embarrass; general; high-ranking military officer; to challenge; to check or checkmate; to put sb on the spot
exampleSimplified: 这位将军带领士兵打了很多场胜仗。
exampleTraditional: 這位將軍帶領士兵打了很多場勝仗。
exampleEnglish: This general led his soldiers to win many battles.
hintSimplified: 他是军队里地位很高的人,负责指挥士兵打仗。
hintTraditional: 他是軍隊裡地位很高的人,負責指揮士兵打仗。
hintEnglish: He is a high-ranking person in the army who commands soldiers in battle.

exampleSimplified: 老板为了奖励大家，请全公司去旅行。
exampleTraditional: 老闆為了獎勵大家，請全公司去旅行。
exampleEnglish: To reward everyone, the boss took the whole company on a trip.
hintSimplified: 表现好的人得到好处，让他以后更努力。
hintTraditional: 表現好的人得到好處，讓他以後更努力。
hintEnglish: Giving a good performer something so they will try even harder.

exampleSimplified: 国王奖赏了那位勇敢的士兵。
exampleTraditional: 國王獎賞了那位勇敢計程車兵。
exampleEnglish: The king rewarded the brave soldier.
hintSimplified: 上位的人把钱或东西送给有功劳的人。
hintTraditional: 上位的人把錢或東西送給有功勞的人。
hintEnglish: A person in authority gives money or gifts to someone who did great service.

exampleSimplified: 她把得奖的奖状挂在墙上。
exampleTraditional: 她把得獎的獎狀掛在牆上。
exampleEnglish: She hung the award certificate she won on the wall.
hintSimplified: 学校比赛得第一名时，会发给你的一张纸。
hintTraditional: 學校比賽得第一名時，會發給你的一張紙。
hintEnglish: A sheet of paper given to you at school when you win first place.

definition: to argue; to be reasonable; to reason with sb; to talk sense
exampleSimplified: 他很不讲理，不管怎么说都不听。
exampleTraditional: 他很不講理，不管怎麼說都不聽。
exampleEnglish: He is unreasonable and won't listen no matter what you say.
hintSimplified: 形容人说话做事不按道理，只坚持自己的想法。
hintTraditional: 形容人說話做事不按道理，只堅持自己的想法。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who doesn't follow logic and only insists on their own idea.

exampleSimplified: 学校暑假办了一个教师讲习。
exampleTraditional: 學校暑假辦了一個教師講習。
exampleEnglish: The school held a teacher training workshop during summer vacation.
hintSimplified: 一种短期的学习活动，由专家教大家某种知识或技能。
hintTraditional: 一種短期的學習活動，由專家教大家某種知識或技能。
hintEnglish: A short-term learning activity where an expert teaches a certain skill.

exampleSimplified: 老师上课前发给我们一份讲义。
exampleTraditional: 老師上課前發給我們一份講義。
exampleEnglish: The teacher gave us a handout before class.
hintSimplified: 老师印出来给学生上课时用的资料。
hintTraditional: 老師印出來給學生上課時用的資料。
hintEnglish: Printed material the teacher gives students to use during class.

definition: chair (academic position); course of lectures; lecture series
exampleSimplified: 今天晚上大学有一场关于环保的讲座。
exampleTraditional: 今天晚上大學有一場關於環保的講座。
exampleEnglish: Tonight the university has a lecture on environmental protection.
hintSimplified: 请专家来对很多听众介绍某个主题的活动。
hintTraditional: 請專家來對很多聽眾介紹某個主題的活動。
hintEnglish: An event where an expert presents a topic to an audience.

exampleSimplified: 城市里的马路和高架桥交错在一起。
exampleTraditional: 城市裡的馬路和高架橋交錯在一起。
exampleEnglish: The roads and overpasses in the city crisscross each other.
hintSimplified: 形容线条或道路一条压着一条，彼此穿过。
hintTraditional: 形容線條或道路一條壓著一條，彼此穿過。
hintEnglish: Describes lines or roads that pass over and through one another.

exampleSimplified: 工厂下个月十号会准时交货。
exampleTraditional: 工廠下個月十號會準時交貨。
exampleEnglish: The factory will deliver the goods on time on the tenth of next month.
hintSimplified: 卖家把买家订的东西送到并交给对方。
hintTraditional: 賣家把買家訂的東西送到並交給對方。
hintEnglish: A seller hands over to the buyer the items that were ordered.

definition: (math.) (set theory) intersection; (of diverse emotions) to occur simultaneously; to intermingle; common ground; points of commonality; overlap; connection; interaction; dealings
exampleSimplified: 我们两个人的生活几乎没有什么交集。
exampleTraditional: 我們兩個人的生活幾乎沒有什麼交集。
exampleEnglish: Our two lives have almost no overlap.
hintSimplified: 两个人或两件事共同有的部分；数学里指两组东西都有的部分。
hintTraditional: 兩個人或兩件事共同有的部分；數學裡指兩組東西都有的部分。
hintEnglish: The part two people or things share; in math, what two groups have in common.

exampleSimplified: 我们俩的交情很深，认识二十年了。
exampleTraditional: 我們倆的交情很深，認識二十年了。
exampleEnglish: We two have a deep friendship; we've known each other for twenty years.
hintSimplified: 人和人之间因为长久来往而有的感情。
hintTraditional: 人和人之間因為長久來往而有的感情。
hintEnglish: The feeling between people built up from a long period of contact.

exampleSimplified: 我们已经跟对方公司交涉了好几次。
exampleTraditional: 我們已經跟對方公司交涉了好幾次。
exampleEnglish: We have already negotiated with the other company several times.
hintSimplified: 为了解决问题，正式去和对方商量。
hintTraditional: 為了解決問題，正式去和對方商量。
hintEnglish: Formally talking with the other side in order to settle a problem.

definition: chat; discussion; to discuss; to converse
exampleSimplified: 他们坐在咖啡店里，愉快地交谈了一个下午。
exampleTraditional: 他們坐在咖啡店裡，愉快地交談了一個下午。
exampleEnglish: They sat in the café and chatted happily all afternoon.
hintSimplified: 两个人面对面互相说话。
hintTraditional: 兩個人面對面互相說話。
hintEnglish: Two people speaking to each other face to face.

exampleSimplified: 孩子还没回家，妈妈焦急地等着。
exampleTraditional: 孩子還沒回家，媽媽焦急地等著。
exampleEnglish: The child hasn't come home yet, and the mother waits anxiously.
hintSimplified: 心里很着急不安，因为担心事情不顺利。
hintTraditional: 心裡很著急不安，因為擔心事情不順利。
hintEnglish: Feeling restless and worried inside because things may not go well.

exampleSimplified: 导演正在修改这部电影的脚本。
exampleTraditional: 導演正在修改這部電影的腳本。
exampleEnglish: The director is revising the script of this movie.
hintSimplified: 拍电影或演戏时，写着台词和情节的文字。
hintTraditional: 拍電影或演戲時，寫著臺詞和情節的文字。
hintEnglish: The text with lines and plot used when making a film or play.

gloss: (fig.) to run around with (sb); to get involved with; to mix (with other people)
definition: (fig.) to run around with (sb); to get involved with; to mix (with other people); (fig.) to spoil; to mess up things; to mix; to blend
exampleSimplified: 你别跟那些坏朋友搅和在一起。
exampleTraditional: 你別跟那些壞朋友攪和在一起。
exampleEnglish: Don't get mixed up with those bad friends.
hintSimplified: 和不好的人或事牵扯在一起；也指把东西弄混。
hintTraditional: 和不好的人或事牽扯在一起；也指把東西弄混。
hintEnglish: To get tangled up with bad people or matters; also to stir things together.

definition: (automotive) sedan; (old) enclosed carriage for carrying passengers
exampleSimplified: 他开着一辆黑色的轿车来接我们。
exampleTraditional: 他開著一輛黑色的轎車來接我們。
exampleEnglish: He came to pick us up in a black sedan.
hintSimplified: 一种有四个门、可以坐几个人的小汽车。
hintTraditional: 一種有四個門、可以坐幾個人的小汽車。
hintEnglish: A small car with four doors that seats several people.

exampleSimplified: 他唱完歌，观众都大声叫好。
exampleTraditional: 他唱完歌，觀眾都大聲叫好。
exampleEnglish: When he finished singing, the audience cheered loudly.
hintSimplified: 看完精彩的表演，大声喊出来表示赞美。
hintTraditional: 看完精彩的表演，大聲喊出來表示讚美。
hintEnglish: After a great performance, shouting out loud to show praise.

exampleSimplified: 教官要求学生们早上六点起床。
exampleTraditional: 教官要求學生們早上六點起床。
exampleEnglish: The instructor required the students to get up at six in the morning.
hintSimplified: 在学校或军队里负责训练学生或士兵的人。
hintTraditional: 在學校或軍隊裡負責訓練學生或士兵的人。
hintEnglish: A person in a school or army who trains students or soldiers.

definition: to civilize; to enlighten; to indoctrinate; to train (an animal)
exampleSimplified: 古代的君王希望用礼乐教化百姓。
exampleTraditional: 古代的君王希望用禮樂教化百姓。
exampleEnglish: Ancient rulers hoped to educate and civilize the people through rites and music.
hintSimplified: 用教育和好的影响，让人变得有礼貌、有道德。
hintTraditional: 用教育和好的影響，讓人變得有禮貌、有道德。
hintEnglish: Using education and good influence to make people polite and moral.

gloss: (literary) to instruct; to admonish; to counsel
definition: (literary) to instruct; to admonish; to counsel; teachings; instruction; guidance
exampleSimplified: 我永远不会忘记老师的教诲。
exampleTraditional: 我永遠不會忘記老師的教誨。
exampleEnglish: I will never forget my teacher's teachings.
hintSimplified: 长辈或老师认真地告诉你做人做事的道理。
hintTraditional: 長輩或老師認真地告訴你做人做事的道理。
hintEnglish: Elders or teachers earnestly telling you how to behave and live.

exampleSimplified: 这位教徒每个星期天都去教堂做礼拜。
exampleTraditional: 這位教徒每個星期天都去教堂做禮拜。
exampleEnglish: This believer goes to church to worship every Sunday.
hintSimplified: 信奉某种宗教、常去教堂或寺庙的人。
hintTraditional: 信奉某種宗教、常去教堂或寺廟的人。
hintEnglish: A person who follows a religion and often goes to a church or temple.

exampleSimplified: 他是一位经验丰富的中文教员。
exampleTraditional: 他是一位經驗豐富的中文教員。
exampleEnglish: He is an experienced Chinese teacher.
hintSimplified: 在学校或培训机构负责上课的人员。
hintTraditional: 在學校或培訓機構負責上課的人員。
hintEnglish: A person employed at a school or training center to teach classes.

definition: battle; contest; to compete with sb; to haggle; to pit oneself against sb; to quibble
exampleSimplified: 两支球队今晚要进行一场激烈的较量。
exampleTraditional: 兩支球隊今晚要進行一場激烈的較量。
exampleEnglish: The two teams will have a fierce contest tonight.
hintSimplified: 双方用力量或本领比一比，看谁更强。
hintTraditional: 雙方用力量或本領比一比，看誰更強。
hintEnglish: Two sides test their strength or skill against each other to see who is stronger.

exampleSimplified: 不同阶层的人生活方式也不一样。
exampleTraditional: 不同階層的人生活方式也不一樣。
exampleEnglish: People of different social strata have different lifestyles.
hintSimplified: 社会上按收入、地位等分出来的不同群体。
hintTraditional: 社會上按收入、地位等分出來的不同群體。
hintEnglish: Different groups in society divided by income, status and so on.

exampleSimplified: 历史上，社会分成不同的阶级。
exampleTraditional: 歷史上，社會分成不同的階級。
exampleEnglish: Historically, society was divided into different classes.
hintSimplified: 社会中地位、财富相近的人所组成的大类，常有高低之分。
hintTraditional: 社會中地位、財富相近的人所組成的大類，常有高低之分。
hintEnglish: A large category of people in society with similar status or wealth, often ranked high or low.

exampleSimplified: 我们这里的街坊都很热心。
exampleTraditional: 我們這裡的街坊都很熱心。
exampleEnglish: The neighbors around here are all very warm-hearted.
hintSimplified: 住在你家附近、同一条街或同一个社区的人。
hintTraditional: 住在你家附近、同一條街或同一個社群的人。
hintEnglish: People who live near your home, on the same street or in the same community.

definition: to assume control; to take over
exampleSimplified: 新经理上星期正式接管了这家公司。
exampleTraditional: 新經理上星期正式接管了這家公司。
exampleEnglish: The new manager officially took over this company last week.
hintSimplified: 从别人手里拿过来，开始负责管理某件事或某个地方。
hintTraditional: 從別人手裡拿過來，開始負責管理某件事或某個地方。
hintEnglish: To take something from someone else and start being in charge of it.

definition: in a row; in succession; on end
exampleSimplified: 这个月他接连生了两次病。
exampleTraditional: 這個月他接連生了兩次病。
exampleEnglish: This month he fell ill twice in a row.
hintSimplified: 一次又一次，中间几乎没有停顿，常用来修饰动作。
hintTraditional: 一次又一次，中間幾乎沒有停頓，常用來修飾動作。
hintEnglish: One time after another with hardly any break; used before verbs.

definition: to accept (sb or sth); to admit or welcome (into a group)
exampleSimplified: 公司愿意接纳不同意见。
exampleTraditional: 公司願意接納不同意見。
exampleEnglish: The company is willing to accept different opinions.
hintSimplified: 愿意收下、让别人或别的想法成为其中一部分。
hintTraditional: 願意收下、讓別人或別的想法成為其中一部分。
hintEnglish: To be willing to take in people or ideas and let them become part of a group.

definition: to arrange; to discuss a matter with sb; to get in touch with
exampleSimplified: 你可以先和负责人接洽一下细节。
exampleTraditional: 你可以先和負責人接洽一下細節。
exampleEnglish: You can first get in touch with the person in charge to discuss the details.
hintSimplified: 为了谈事情或安排工作，先和对方联系、商量。
hintTraditional: 為了談事情或安排工作，先和對方聯絡、商量。
hintEnglish: To contact and talk with someone first in order to discuss or arrange business.

exampleSimplified: 新美术馆明天将举行揭幕仪式。
exampleTraditional: 新美術館明天將舉行揭幕儀式。
exampleEnglish: The new art museum will hold its unveiling ceremony tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 新建筑或活动正式开始时，拉开布幕的仪式。
hintTraditional: 新建築或活動正式開始時，拉開布幕的儀式。
hintEnglish: The ceremony of pulling back a curtain when a new building or event officially begins.

definition: to announce publicly; to disclose; to make known; to publish
exampleSimplified: 比赛结果明天才会揭晓。
exampleTraditional: 比賽結果明天才會揭曉。
exampleEnglish: The results of the competition will only be announced tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 把原本不公开的结果或答案告诉大家。
hintTraditional: 把原本不公開的結果或答案告訴大家。
hintEnglish: To tell everyone a result or answer that was previously kept secret.

exampleSimplified: 她穿着一件洁白的婚纱。
exampleTraditional: 她穿著一件潔白的婚紗。
exampleEnglish: She wore a pure white wedding dress.
hintSimplified: 形容颜色白而且很干净，像雪一样。
hintTraditional: 形容顏色白而且很乾淨，像雪一樣。
hintEnglish: Describes a color that is white and very clean, like snow.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷一辈子都很节俭，从不乱花钱。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺一輩子都很節儉，從不亂花錢。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa has been thrifty all his life and never wastes money.
hintSimplified: 形容人不浪费钱和东西，花得很少。
hintTraditional: 形容人不浪費錢和東西，花得很少。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who doesn't waste money or things and spends little.

exampleSimplified: 他竭力想说服大家接受这个计划。
exampleTraditional: 他竭力想說服大家接受這個計劃。
exampleEnglish: He tried his utmost to persuade everyone to accept the plan.
hintSimplified: 用尽全部的力量去做某件事。
hintTraditional: 用盡全部的力量去做某件事。
hintEnglish: To use all of one's strength to do something.

definition: buff (physique); durable; rugged; strong; sturdy; to bear fruit
exampleSimplified: 他常常运动，身体很结实。
exampleTraditional: 他常常運動，身體很結實。
exampleEnglish: He exercises often, so his body is very sturdy.
hintSimplified: 形容身体强壮，或东西坚固耐用。
hintTraditional: 形容身體強壯，或東西堅固耐用。
hintEnglish: Describes a body that is strong, or an object that is solid and durable.

definition: (of a company) to cease operations; to complete a course; to finish school, esp. a short course
exampleSimplified: 他在语言中心完成了课程，顺利结业。
exampleTraditional: 他在語言中心完成了課程，順利結業。
exampleEnglish: He finished the course at the language center and completed it successfully.
hintSimplified: 学生读完一个短期课程或训练班后，正式结束学习。
hintTraditional: 學生讀完一個短期課程或訓練班後，正式結束學習。
hintEnglish: When a student finishes a short course or training program and officially ends the study.

definition: to become attached (to sb, sth); to form ties
exampleSimplified: 他因为一次旅行，与中国文化结缘。
exampleTraditional: 他因為一次旅行，與中國文化結緣。
exampleEnglish: Because of one trip, he formed a bond with Chinese culture.
hintSimplified: 和某人或某事因为机会而产生了联系或感情。
hintTraditional: 和某人或某事因為機會而產生了聯絡或感情。
hintEnglish: To form a connection or affection with a person or thing by chance.

definition: CL:次[ci4]; liberation; refers to the Communists' victory over the Nationalists in 1949; to emancipate; to liberate
exampleSimplified: 这场改革让妇女得到了解放。
exampleTraditional: 這場改革讓婦女得到了解放。
exampleEnglish: This reform liberated women.
hintSimplified: 让人或事物不再受到束缚，得到自由。
hintTraditional: 讓人或事物不再受到束縛，得到自由。
hintEnglish: To free people or things from restraints and give them freedom.

exampleSimplified: 天气很热，一杯冰水就能解渴。
exampleTraditional: 天氣很熱，一杯冰水就能解渴。
exampleEnglish: The weather is hot; a glass of iced water can quench your thirst.
hintSimplified: 口很干的时候喝水，让想喝水的感觉消失。
hintTraditional: 口很乾的時候喝水，讓想喝水的感覺消失。
hintEnglish: When your mouth is dry, drinking so that the feeling of needing a drink goes away.

definition: anatomy; to analyze; to dissect (an animal)
exampleSimplified: 医学院的学生要学习解剖人体。
exampleTraditional: 醫學院的學生要學習解剖人體。
exampleEnglish: Medical students have to learn to dissect the human body.
hintSimplified: 为了研究身体或动物的内部结构而切开它。
hintTraditional: 為了研究身體或動物的內部結構而切開它。
hintEnglish: To cut open a body or animal in order to study its internal structure.

gloss: to explain (verbally); to give a running commentary
definition: to explain (verbally); to give a running commentary
exampleSimplified: 博物馆的导览员正在为大家解说展品。
exampleTraditional: 博物館的導覽員正在為大家解說展品。
exampleEnglish: The museum guide is explaining the exhibits to everyone.
hintSimplified: 一边看一边用话语说明内容，比如球赛或展览。
hintTraditional: 一邊看一邊用話語說明內容，比如球賽或展覽。
hintEnglish: To explain content out loud as people watch, such as at a match or an exhibition.

definition: to break up into components; to collapse; to crumble; to disintegrate
exampleSimplified: 这家大公司最后解体成了几家小公司。
exampleTraditional: 這家大公司最後解體成了幾家小公司。
exampleEnglish: This large company eventually broke up into several small companies.

exampleTraditional: 醫生從我的手臂靜脈抽了一點血。
exampleEnglish: The doctor drew a little blood from the vein in my arm.
hintSimplified: 把血液送回心脏的血管,手背上常常看得到。
hintTraditional: 把血液送回心臟的血管,手背上常常看得到。
hintEnglish: The blood vessel that carries blood back to the heart, often visible on the back of the hand.

definition: (electronics) quiescent; (physics) static; passive; quiet; sedate; static; steady-state
exampleSimplified: 这张静态图片不会动,但是很清楚。
exampleTraditional: 這張靜態圖片不會動,但是很清楚。
exampleEnglish: This static picture doesn't move, but it is very clear.
hintSimplified: 形容东西不动、没有变化的状态,和“动”相反。
hintTraditional: 形容東西不動、沒有變化的狀態,和“動”相反。
hintEnglish: Describes something that does not move or change; the opposite of dynamic.

definition: contest; competition; match; race; to compete; to race
exampleSimplified: 他参加了学校举办的数学竞赛。
exampleTraditional: 他參加了學校舉辦的數學競賽。
exampleEnglish: He took part in the math contest held by the school.
hintSimplified: 很多人一起比谁的成绩或能力更好的活动。
hintTraditional: 很多人一起比誰的成績或能力更好的活動。
hintEnglish: An event where many people compete to see whose results or abilities are better.

definition: to run for office; to take part in an election
exampleSimplified: 他决定参加明年的市长竞选。
exampleTraditional: 他決定參加明年的市長競選。
exampleEnglish: He decided to run in next year's mayoral election.
hintSimplified: 为了得到大家的票,争取当上某个职位的行动。
hintTraditional: 為了得到大家的票,爭取當上某個職位的行動。
hintEnglish: Efforts to win people's votes in order to get a certain public position.

exampleSimplified: 邻居之间因为停车位发生了纠纷。
exampleTraditional: 鄰居之間因為停車位發生了糾紛。
exampleEnglish: A dispute arose between neighbors over a parking space.
hintSimplified: 两方因为利益或意见不同而发生的争吵或麻烦。
hintTraditional: 兩方因為利益或意見不同而發生的爭吵或麻煩。
hintEnglish: Quarrels or trouble between two sides caused by differing interests or opinions.

definition: (Tw) hostess club; hotel; pub (public house); restaurant; wine shop
exampleSimplified: 我们在海边订了一家酒店,住三个晚上。
exampleTraditional: 我們在海邊訂了一家酒店,住三個晚上。
exampleEnglish: We booked a hotel by the sea and will stay three nights.
hintSimplified: 出门旅行时,可以付钱住宿的大楼。
hintTraditional: 出門旅行時,可以付錢住宿的大樓。
hintEnglish: A large building where you pay to stay overnight when traveling.

exampleSimplified: 下班后,他常去街角的酒馆喝一杯。
exampleTraditional: 下班後,他常去街角的酒館喝一杯。
exampleEnglish: After work, he often goes to the pub on the corner for a drink.
hintSimplified: 人们晚上聊天、喝啤酒或其他饮料的小店。
hintTraditional: 人們晚上聊天、喝啤酒或其他飲料的小店。
hintEnglish: A small place where people chat and drink beer or other beverages in the evening.

exampleSimplified: 护士用酒精帮我的伤口消毒。
exampleTraditional: 護士用酒精幫我的傷口消毒。
exampleEnglish: The nurse disinfected my wound with alcohol.
hintSimplified: 一种无色的液体,可以消毒,也是酒里让人醉的成分。
hintTraditional: 一種無色的液體,可以消毒,也是酒裡讓人醉的成分。
hintEnglish: A colorless liquid used to disinfect, and also the ingredient in drinks that makes people drunk.

definition: to be in order; to be ready
exampleSimplified: 所有的设备都已经就绪,可以开始了。
exampleTraditional: 所有的裝置都已經就緒,可以開始了。
exampleEnglish: All the equipment is ready, so we can start.
hintSimplified: 事情都准备好了,随时可以开始行动。
hintTraditional: 事情都準備好了,隨時可以開始行動。
hintEnglish: Everything has been prepared and action can begin at any time.

definition: emergency relief; to help the needy with cash or goods
exampleSimplified: 政府拿出一笔钱来救济受灾的家庭。
exampleTraditional: 政府拿出一筆錢來救濟受災的家庭。
exampleEnglish: The government provided money to give relief to families hit by the disaster.
hintSimplified: 帮助穷人或灾民,给他们钱或食物。
hintTraditional: 幫助窮人或災民,給他們錢或食物。
hintEnglish: Helping poor people or disaster victims by giving them money or food.

definition: to assist; to help; to save; to support
exampleSimplified: 救援人员很快就赶到了现场。
exampleTraditional: 救援人員很快就趕到了現場。
exampleEnglish: The rescue workers quickly arrived at the scene.
hintSimplified: 发生灾难时,有人赶去帮助被困的人。
hintTraditional: 發生災難時,有人趕去幫助被困的人。
hintEnglish: When a disaster happens, people rush to help those who are trapped.

exampleSimplified: 明天北部地区局部有雨。
exampleTraditional: 明天北部地區局部有雨。
exampleEnglish: Tomorrow there will be rain in parts of the northern region.
hintSimplified: 指整体中的一小块,不是全部。
hintTraditional: 指整體中的一小塊,不是全部。
hintEnglish: Refers to one small portion of a whole, not all of it.

exampleSimplified: 这场比赛的局面对我们很不利。
exampleTraditional: 這場比賽的局面對我們很不利。
exampleEnglish: The situation in this match is very unfavorable for us.
hintSimplified: 形容事情或比赛在某个时候发展成的状况。
hintTraditional: 形容事情或比賽在某個時候發展成的狀況。
hintEnglish: Describes the state that events or a game have developed into at a given moment.

exampleSimplified: 考试没通过,他觉得非常沮丧。
exampleTraditional: 考試沒透過,他覺得非常沮喪。
exampleEnglish: He failed the exam and felt very dejected.
hintSimplified: 失败以后心情很低落,没有信心。
hintTraditional: 失敗以後心情很低落,沒有信心。
hintEnglish: The low mood and lack of confidence you feel after failing.

exampleSimplified: 他的举止非常有礼貌。
exampleTraditional: 他的舉止非常有禮貌。
exampleEnglish: His manner is very polite.
hintSimplified: 一个人的动作和行为表现出来的样子。
hintTraditional: 一個人的動作和行為表現出來的樣子。
hintEnglish: The way a person's movements and behavior appear to others.

exampleSimplified: 他每天去健身房练习举重。
exampleTraditional: 他每天去健身房練習舉重。
exampleEnglish: He goes to the gym every day to practice weightlifting.
hintSimplified: 一种运动,用力把很重的铁杠铃举过头。
hintTraditional: 一種運動,用力把很重的鐵槓鈴舉過頭。
hintEnglish: A sport where you lift a heavy metal barbell over your head.

exampleSimplified: 故事里的巨人住在高高的山上。
exampleTraditional: 故事裡的巨人住在高高的山上。
exampleEnglish: The giant in the story lives on a high mountain.
hintSimplified: 童话里身体非常高大的人。
hintTraditional: 童話裡身體非常高大的人。
hintEnglish: In fairy tales, a person with an extremely huge body.

definition: according to reports; it is reported (that)
exampleSimplified: 据悉,新的捷运线明年开始通车。
exampleTraditional: 據悉,新的捷運線明年開始通車。
exampleEnglish: It is reported that the new MRT line will open next year.
hintSimplified: 新闻里常用,表示消息是听别人说的。
hintTraditional: 新聞裡常用,表示訊息是聽別人說的。
hintEnglish: Often used in news, showing the information comes from what others have reported.

gloss: to have all of the elements mentioned (features, qualities, items etc)
definition: to have all of the elements mentioned (features, qualities, items etc)
exampleSimplified: 这家小店虽然不大,但是商品应有尽有,样样俱全。
exampleTraditional: 這家小店雖然不大,但是商品應有盡有,樣樣俱全。
exampleEnglish: Although this shop is small, it has everything; all kinds of goods are available.
hintSimplified: 需要的东西或条件一样都不缺。
hintTraditional: 需要的東西或條件一樣都不缺。
hintEnglish: Every needed item or condition is present, with nothing missing.

exampleSimplified: 他决定捐献自己的骨髓去救人。
exampleTraditional: 他決定捐獻自己的骨髓去救人。
exampleEnglish: He decided to donate his bone marrow to save someone.
hintSimplified: 把血、器官或财物无偿给需要的人或机构。
hintTraditional: 把血、器官或財物無償給需要的人或機構。
hintEnglish: To give blood, organs or goods freely to people or institutions in need.

definition: benefaction; to contribute (as a gift); to donate
exampleSimplified: 这位企业家向学校捐赠了一批图书。
exampleTraditional: 這位企業家向學校捐贈了一批圖書。
exampleEnglish: The entrepreneur donated a batch of books to the school.
hintSimplified: 把钱或物品免费送给学校、机构等。
hintTraditional: 把錢或物品免費送給學校、機構等。
hintEnglish: To give money or goods for free to schools or organizations.

exampleSimplified: 明天晚上就是篮球比赛的决赛。
exampleTraditional: 明天晚上就是籃球比賽的決賽。
exampleEnglish: Tomorrow night is the basketball final.
hintSimplified: 比赛的最后一场,决定谁是冠军。
hintTraditional: 比賽的最後一場,決定誰是冠軍。
hintEnglish: The last match of a tournament, deciding who is champion.

definition: a resolution; to pass a resolution
exampleSimplified: 大会通过了一项重要的决议。
exampleTraditional: 大會透過了一項重要的決議。
exampleEnglish: The assembly passed an important resolution.
hintSimplified: 会议经过讨论后正式作出的决定。
hintTraditional: 會議經過討論後正式作出的決定。
hintEnglish: A decision formally made by a meeting after discussion.

exampleSimplified: 面对两份工作,他必须做出抉择。
exampleTraditional: 面對兩份工作,他必須做出抉擇。
exampleEnglish: Faced with two jobs, he must make a choice.
hintSimplified: 在重要的几个选项中,必须选出一个。
hintTraditional: 在重要的幾個選項中,必須選出一個。
hintEnglish: Having to pick one among several important options.

definition: extinct; to be eradicated; to break off relations; to vanish
exampleSimplified: 这种鸟在这里已经绝迹了。
exampleTraditional: 這種鳥在這裡已經絕跡了。
exampleEnglish: This kind of bird has disappeared from here entirely.
hintSimplified: 某种动物或东西完全消失,再也看不到了。
hintTraditional: 某種動物或東西完全消失,再也看不到了。
hintEnglish: A certain animal or thing has vanished completely and can no longer be seen.

exampleSimplified: 饮食要均衡,才能保持健康。
exampleTraditional: 飲食要均衡,才能保持健康。
exampleEnglish: Your diet must be balanced to stay healthy.
hintSimplified: 各部分的比例差不多,没有偏多或偏少。
hintTraditional: 各部分的比例差不多,沒有偏多或偏少。
hintEnglish: The proportions of all parts are about equal, with none too much or too little.

definition: even; homogeneous; well-distributed; well-proportioned (figure, body etc)
exampleSimplified: 请把酱料均匀地涂在面包上。
exampleTraditional: 請把醬料均勻地塗在麵包上。
exampleEnglish: Please spread the sauce evenly on the bread.
hintSimplified: 分布得很平均,每个地方都差不多。
hintTraditional: 分佈得很平均,每個地方都差不多。
hintEnglish: Spread so that every spot is about the same.

exampleSimplified: 这个国家每年花很多钱在军备上。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家每年花很多錢在軍備上。
exampleEnglish: This country spends a lot of money on armaments every year.
hintSimplified: 国家为了战争准备的武器和装备。
hintTraditional: 國家為了戰爭準備的武器和裝備。
hintEnglish: The weapons and equipment a country prepares for war.

exampleSimplified: 历史上,军阀之间常常互相争夺地盘。
exampleTraditional: 歷史上,軍閥之間常常互相爭奪地盤。
exampleEnglish: In history, warlords often fought one another for territory.
hintSimplified: 过去掌握军队、占据一方地区的人。
hintTraditional: 過去掌握軍隊、佔據一方地區的人。
hintEnglish: In the past, a man who controlled an army and held a region.

exampleSimplified: 他的父亲是一位退休的军官。
exampleTraditional: 他的父親是一位退休的軍官。
exampleEnglish: His father is a retired military officer.
hintSimplified: 在军队里带领士兵的人。
hintTraditional: 在軍隊裡帶領士兵的人。
hintEnglish: A person who leads soldiers in the army.

exampleSimplified: 海上有一艘大军舰正在巡逻。
exampleTraditional: 海上有一艘大軍艦正在巡邏。
exampleEnglish: A large warship is patrolling at sea.
hintSimplified: 海军用的大船,上面有武器。
hintTraditional: 海軍用的大船,上面有武器。
hintEnglish: A large navy vessel equipped with weapons.

definition: to open; to set up; to start (a business etc)
exampleSimplified: 他打算明年开办一家咖啡店。
exampleTraditional: 他打算明年開辦一家咖啡店。
exampleEnglish: He plans to open a coffee shop next year.
hintSimplified: 创立一家店、学校或公司,让它开始运作。
hintTraditional: 創立一家店、學校或公司,讓它開始運作。
hintEnglish: To set up a shop, school or company and get it running.

gloss: to talk sb round; to straighten sth out; to enlighten
definition: to talk sb round; to straighten sth out; to enlighten
exampleSimplified: 老师耐心地开导心情不好的学生。
exampleTraditional: 老師耐心地開導心情不好的學生。
exampleEnglish: The teacher patiently talked to the student who was in a bad mood and helped him see things clearly.
hintSimplified: 用好话劝说心里想不通的人,帮他想明白。
hintTraditional: 用好話勸說心裡想不通的人,幫他想明白。
hintEnglish: Using kind words to persuade someone who is stuck, helping them understand.

definition: to serve a meal; to start eating
exampleSimplified: 妈妈说:“开饭了,大家快来吃!”
exampleTraditional: 媽媽說:“開飯了,大家快來吃!”
exampleEnglish: Mom said, "Dinner is served, everyone come and eat!"
hintSimplified: 饭做好了,家人可以坐下来吃的时候,大家会喊这个词。
hintTraditional: 飯做好了,家人可以坐下來吃的時候,大家會喊這個詞。
hintEnglish: When the food is ready and the family can sit down to eat, people call this out.

definition: to open one's mouth; to start to talk
exampleSimplified: 他很害羞,不敢在会议上开口说话。
exampleTraditional: 他很害羞,不敢在會議上開口說話。
exampleEnglish: He is shy and doesn't dare to speak up in meetings.
hintSimplified: 张开嘴巴,开始说话,或向别人提出请求。
hintTraditional: 張開嘴巴,開始說話,或向別人提出請求。
hintEnglish: To start speaking, or to ask someone for something.

exampleSimplified: 站在山顶上,眼前的景色非常开阔。
exampleTraditional: 站在山頂上,眼前的景色非常開闊。
exampleEnglish: Standing on the mountaintop, the view before you is very wide and open.
hintSimplified: 形容地方宽广、没有东西挡住,也可以形容心胸或眼界很大。
hintTraditional: 形容地方寬廣、沒有東西擋住,也可以形容心胸或眼界很大。
hintEnglish: Describes a place that is wide and unobstructed, or a broad mind or outlook.

definition: (electricity) open circuit; to construct a road; to make one's way through; to open up a path
exampleSimplified: 这辆车在前面开路,后面的车跟着走。
exampleTraditional: 這輛車在前面開路,後面的車跟著走。
exampleEnglish: This car leads the way in front, and the cars behind follow.
hintSimplified: 走在最前面,为后面的人或车辆带路或清出一条路。
hintTraditional: 走在最前面,為後面的人或車輛帶路或清出一條路。
hintEnglish: To go at the front to clear or lead a path for those behind.

exampleSimplified: 奥运会明天晚上正式开幕。
exampleTraditional: 奧運會明天晚上正式開幕。
exampleEnglish: The Olympic Games will officially open tomorrow evening.
hintSimplified: 大型活动或展览的第一天,舞台的布幕拉开,典礼开始。
hintTraditional: 大型活動或展覽的第一天,舞台的布幕拉開,典禮開始。
hintEnglish: The start of a big event or show, when the curtain goes up and the ceremony begins.

exampleSimplified: 今天股市开盘后不久就大涨了。
exampleTraditional: 今天股市開盤後不久就大漲了。
exampleEnglish: Today the stock market rose sharply soon after opening.
hintSimplified: 股票市场每天早上开始交易的时刻。
hintTraditional: 股票市場每天早上開始交易的時刻。
hintEnglish: The moment each morning when the stock market starts trading.

gloss: to open up; to create; to establish
definition: to open up; to create; to establish
exampleSimplified: 公司想开辟新的市场,吸引更多客人。
exampleTraditional: 公司想開闢新的市場,吸引更多客人。
exampleEnglish: The company wants to open up new markets to attract more customers.
hintSimplified: 原来没有的路、领域或机会,经过努力把它建立起来。
hintTraditional: 原來沒有的路、領域或機會,經過努力把它建立起來。
hintEnglish: To create a road, field or opportunity that did not exist before, through effort.

exclusionReason: Answer is in the hint
definition: (computing) to enable (a feature); (of a system or device) to start operating automatically; to self-initiate; to open (sth that has been sealed); to start; to begin; to initiate (an era, process, journey etc)

hintTraditional: 讓機器、軟體或功能開始運作,比“開啟”更正式。
hintEnglish: To get a machine, software or feature started; more formal than a plain "open".

exampleSimplified: 这篇文章的开头写得很吸引人。
exampleTraditional: 這篇文章的開頭寫得很吸引人。
exampleEnglish: The beginning of this article is written in a very engaging way.
hintSimplified: 一篇文章、一个故事或一件事最前面的部分。
hintTraditional: 一篇文章、一個故事或一件事最前面的部分。
hintEnglish: The very first part of an article, story or event.

definition: (old) to dismiss (an employee); expenses; to pay (expenses)
exampleSimplified: 在大城市生活,每个月的开销很大。
exampleTraditional: 在大城市生活,每個月的開銷很大。
exampleEnglish: Living in a big city, monthly expenses are high.
hintSimplified: 每个月花在房租、吃饭和交通上的钱。
hintTraditional: 每個月花在房租、吃飯和交通上的錢。
hintEnglish: The money spent each month on rent, food and transport.

definition: open (for business); to open a business; to open a practice
exampleSimplified: 这家咖啡店下个星期就要开业了。
exampleTraditional: 這家咖啡店下個星期就要開業了。
exampleEnglish: This coffee shop is going to open for business next week.
hintSimplified: 新的商店或公司第一次开始做生意。
hintTraditional: 新的商店或公司第一次開始做生意。
hintEnglish: When a new shop or company starts doing business for the first time.

definition: (of an exhibition etc) to open; to develop; to launch; to unfold
exampleSimplified: 学校打算开展环保活动,鼓励大家做资源回收。
exampleTraditional: 學校打算開展環保活動,鼓勵大家做資源回收。
exampleEnglish: The school plans to launch environmental activities to encourage recycling.
hintSimplified: 让活动或工作开始进行,并逐步推广下去。
hintTraditional: 讓活動或工作開始進行,並逐步推廣下去。
hintEnglish: To get an activity or project started and carried out step by step.

gloss: first transaction of a business day
definition: first transaction of a business day; to open a business
exampleSimplified: 新超市下周一开张,有很多优惠。
exampleTraditional: 新超市下週一開張,有很多優惠。
exampleEnglish: The new supermarket opens next Monday with many special offers.
hintSimplified: 商店第一次开门营业,或一天中的第一笔生意。
hintTraditional: 商店第一次開門營業,或一天中的第一筆生意。
hintEnglish: When a store opens its doors for the first time, or makes its first sale of the day.

exampleSimplified: 图书馆里有很多学术刊物可以借阅。
exampleTraditional: 圖書館裡有很多學術刊物可以借閱。
exampleEnglish: The library has many academic periodicals available to borrow.
hintSimplified: 定期出版的杂志或期刊,常放在图书馆里。
hintTraditional: 定期出版的雜誌或期刊,常放在圖書館裡。
hintEnglish: Magazines or journals published regularly, often found in a library.

definition: to carry a story; to publish (in a newspaper or magazine)
exampleSimplified: 报纸上刊登了一则征人启事。
exampleTraditional: 報紙上刊登了一則徵人啟事。
exampleEnglish: The newspaper published a job recruitment notice.
hintSimplified: 报纸或杂志把文章、广告印出来让大家看到。
hintTraditional: 報紙或雜誌把文章、廣告印出來讓大家看到。
hintEnglish: When a newspaper or magazine prints an article or advertisement for readers.

exampleSimplified: 警卫整晚都在仓库门口看守。

hintEnglish: A worker who digs coal or metal underground.

exampleSimplified: 夏天的森林里有各种各样的昆虫。
exampleTraditional: 夏天的森林裡有各種各樣的昆蟲。
exampleEnglish: In the summer forest there are all kinds of insects.
hintSimplified: 蚂蚁、蝴蝶、蜜蜂这一类六条腿的小动物。
hintTraditional: 螞蟻、蝴蝶、蜜蜂這一類六條腿的小動物。
hintEnglish: Small six-legged creatures like ants, butterflies and bees.

exampleSimplified: 公司现在陷入了严重的困境。
exampleTraditional: 公司現在陷入了嚴重的困境。
exampleEnglish: The company has now fallen into a serious predicament.
hintSimplified: 遇到很大的麻烦,很难找到出路的处境。
hintTraditional: 遇到很大的麻煩,很難找到出路的處境。
hintEnglish: A situation of great trouble from which it is hard to find a way out.

definition: to cause complications; to disturb; to perplex
exampleSimplified: 失眠的问题已经困扰他很多年了。
exampleTraditional: 失眠的問題已經困擾他很多年了。
exampleEnglish: The problem of insomnia has troubled him for many years.
hintSimplified: 让人心里不安、不舒服,长时间摆脱不了。
hintTraditional: 讓人心裡不安、不舒服,長時間擺脫不了。
hintEnglish: To make someone uneasy and bothered for a long time, hard to shake off.

gloss: to extend (a building, an airport runway etc)
definition: to extend (a building, an airport runway etc)
exampleSimplified: 学校打算明年扩建图书馆。
exampleTraditional: 學校打算明年擴建圖書館。
exampleEnglish: The school plans to expand the library next year.
hintSimplified: 把已有的房子或道路建得更大。
hintTraditional: 把已有的房子或道路建得更大。
hintEnglish: To make an existing building or road bigger by building more.

gloss: to spread; to proliferate; to diffuse
definition: to spread; to proliferate; to diffuse
exampleSimplified: 病毒很快就在城市里扩散开来。
exampleTraditional: 病毒很快就在城市裡擴散開來。
exampleEnglish: The virus quickly spread throughout the city.
hintSimplified: 向四周散开,范围越来越大,例如烟、消息或疾病。
hintTraditional: 向四周散開,範圍越來越大,例如煙、訊息或疾病。
hintEnglish: To spread outward in all directions, with the range growing, like smoke, news or disease.

definition: dilation; expansion; to broaden; to expand (e.g. one's power or influence)
exampleSimplified: 这家公司最近扩张得很快。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司最近擴張得很快。
exampleEnglish: This company has expanded very quickly recently.
hintSimplified: 让规模、势力或范围变得更大。
hintTraditional: 讓規模、勢力或範圍變得更大。
hintEnglish: To make scale, influence or range bigger.

definition: to ask voters for support; to campaign for votes
exampleSimplified: 选举前,候选人到处拉票。
exampleTraditional: 選舉前,候選人到處拉票。
exampleEnglish: Before the election, the candidates canvass for votes everywhere.
hintSimplified: 选举时,候选人请人们把票投给自己。
hintTraditional: 選舉時,候選人請人們把票投給自己。
hintEnglish: During an election, a candidate asks people to cast their vote for him or her.

exampleSimplified: 腊月是农历一年里最后一个月。
exampleTraditional: 臘月是農曆一年裡最後一個月。
exampleEnglish: The twelfth lunar month is the last month of the lunar year.
hintSimplified: 农历的最后一个月,快要过年了。
hintTraditional: 農曆的最後一個月,快要過年了。
hintEnglish: The last month of the lunar calendar, when the New Year is near.

definition: guest; see 來賓市|来宾市[Lai2 bin1 Shi4]; visitor
exampleSimplified: 婚礼上,主人热情地招待每一位来宾。
exampleTraditional: 婚禮上,主人熱情地招待每一位來賓。
exampleEnglish: At the wedding, the host warmly welcomed every guest.
hintSimplified: 被邀请来参加典礼或会议的客人。
hintTraditional: 被邀請來參加典禮或會議的客人。
hintEnglish: People invited to attend a ceremony or meeting.

gloss: to be competent or equal to
definition: to be competent or equal to; to come out as; to emerge (from a comparison)
exampleSimplified: 坐捷运比开车来得快。
exampleTraditional: 坐捷運比開車來得快。
exampleEnglish: Taking the MRT is faster than driving.
hintSimplified: 用在比较句里,表示某种方式比另一种更合适或更好。
hintTraditional: 用在比較句裡,表示某種方式比另一種更合適或更好。
hintEnglish: Used in comparisons to show that one way is more suitable or better than another.

exampleSimplified: 家里来客了,妈妈赶快去泡茶。
exampleTraditional: 家裡來客了,媽媽趕快去泡茶。
exampleEnglish: A guest has come to the house, so Mom hurried to make tea.
hintSimplified: 到家里或店里来拜访的人。
hintTraditional: 到家裡或店裡來拜訪的人。
hintEnglish: A person who comes to visit a home or a shop.

exampleSimplified: 他很懒惰,什么事都不想做。
exampleTraditional: 他很懶惰,什麼事都不想做。
exampleEnglish: He is very lazy and doesn't want to do anything.
hintSimplified: 形容人不爱工作或学习,总想休息。
hintTraditional: 形容人不愛工作或學習,總想休息。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who dislikes working or studying and always wants to rest.

exampleSimplified: 他周末总是懒散地躺在沙发上看电视。
exampleTraditional: 他週末總是懶散地躺在沙發上看電視。
exampleEnglish: On weekends he always lounges lazily on the sofa watching TV.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人做事没有精神、不认真、没有规矩的样子。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人做事沒有精神、不認真、沒有規矩的樣子。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is listless, undisciplined and not serious about doing things.

exampleSimplified: 老师请同学们大声朗读这篇课文。
exampleTraditional: 老師請同學們大聲朗讀這篇課文。
exampleEnglish: The teacher asked the students to read this text aloud.
hintSimplified: 在课堂上，把文章用声音清楚地念出来。
hintTraditional: 在課堂上，把文章用聲音清楚地念出來。
hintEnglish: In class, to say a text out loud clearly with your voice.

definition: to declaim; to read aloud with expression; to recite
exampleSimplified: 她在晚会上深情地朗诵了一首诗。
exampleTraditional: 她在晚會上深情地朗誦了一首詩。
exampleEnglish: At the evening party she recited a poem with deep feeling.
hintSimplified: 带着感情、有节奏地念诗或散文给大家听。
hintTraditional: 帶著感情、有節奏地念詩或散文給大家聽。
hintEnglish: To perform a poem or prose to an audience with feeling and rhythm.

gloss: abbr. for 勞動改造|劳动改造[lao2 dong4 gai3 zao4]
definition: abbr. for 勞動改造|劳动改造[lao2 dong4 gai3 zao4]; laogai (prison camp); reform through labor
exampleSimplified: 他犯了错，被送去劳改了几年。
exampleTraditional: 他犯了錯，被送去勞改了幾年。
exampleEnglish: He committed a crime and was sent to reform through labor for a few years.
hintSimplified: 罪犯在监狱里一边工作一边接受改造的制度。
hintTraditional: 罪犯在監獄裡一邊工作一邊接受改造的制度。
hintEnglish: A system in which offenders work while being reformed in prison.

definition: exhausted; tired; to toil; worn out
exampleSimplified: 忙了一整天，我觉得非常劳累。
exampleTraditional: 忙了一整天，我覺得非常勞累。
exampleEnglish: After being busy all day, I feel very exhausted.
hintSimplified: 工作太久或太辛苦以后，身体很想休息的感觉。
hintTraditional: 工作太久或太辛苦以後，身體很想休息的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling that your body needs rest after working too long or too hard.

definition: father; husband; old fellow; old man
exampleSimplified: 公园里有一个老头在下棋。
exampleTraditional: 公園裡有一個老頭在下棋。
exampleEnglish: There is an old man playing chess in the park.
hintSimplified: 口语中指年纪很大的男人，有时带一点随便的语气。
hintTraditional: 口語中指年紀很大的男人，有時帶一點隨便的語氣。
hintEnglish: Colloquial term for an elderly man, sometimes in a casual tone.

gloss: fellow townsman; fellow villager; sb from the same hometown
definition: fellow townsman; fellow villager; sb from the same hometown
exampleSimplified: 在国外遇到老乡，我觉得特别亲切。
exampleTraditional: 在國外遇到老鄉，我覺得特別親切。
exampleEnglish: Meeting someone from my hometown abroad feels especially warm.
hintSimplified: 和你来自同一个地方的人。
hintTraditional: 和你來自同一個地方的人。
hintEnglish: A person who comes from the same place as you.

gloss: "I, your father" (in anger, or out of contempt)
definition: "I, your father" (in anger, or out of contempt); I (used arrogantly or jocularly); Laozi or Lao-tze (c. 500 BC), Chinese philosopher, the founder of Taoism; daddy; father; the sacred book of Daoism, 道德經|道德经[Dao4 de2 jing1] by Laozi
exampleSimplified: 他生气地说：“老子不干了！”
exampleTraditional: 他生氣地說：“老子不幹了！”
exampleEnglish: He said angrily, "I'm done with this!"
hintSimplified: 生气或看不起别人时，男人用来称呼自己的粗鲁说法；也是一位古代哲学家的称呼。
hintTraditional: 生氣或看不起別人時，男人用來稱呼自己的粗魯說法；也是一位古代哲學家的稱呼。
hintEnglish: A rude way a man refers to himself when angry or contemptuous; also the title of an ancient philosopher.

exampleSimplified: 飞机和船都用雷达来找方向。
exampleTraditional: 飛機和船都用雷達來找方向。
exampleEnglish: Planes and ships both use radar to find their way.
hintSimplified: 用无线电波来发现远处飞机或船的机器。
hintTraditional: 用無線電波來發現遠處飛機或船的機器。
hintEnglish: A device that uses radio waves to detect distant planes or ships.

exampleSimplified: 这两篇文章的内容太雷同了。
exampleTraditional: 這兩篇文章的內容太雷同了。
exampleEnglish: The contents of these two articles are far too similar.
hintSimplified: 形容不同的东西内容或样子几乎一样，缺少变化。
hintTraditional: 形容不同的東西內容或樣子幾乎一樣，缺少變化。
hintEnglish: Describes different things that are almost the same, lacking variety.

exampleSimplified: 多年的工作让他累积了很多经验。
exampleTraditional: 多年的工作讓他累積了很多經驗。
exampleEnglish: Years of work have let him accumulate a lot of experience.
hintSimplified: 一点一点地增加，越来越多。
hintTraditional: 一點一點地增加，越來越多。
hintEnglish: To increase little by little until there is more and more.

exampleSimplified: 肉要放在冰箱里冷冻，才不会坏。
exampleTraditional: 肉要放在冰箱裡冷凍，才不會壞。
exampleEnglish: Meat must be frozen in the fridge so it doesn't go bad.
hintSimplified: 把食物放在很低的温度下，让它变硬，可以保存很久。
hintTraditional: 把食物放在很低的溫度下，讓它變硬，可以儲存很久。
hintEnglish: To keep food at very low temperature so it hardens and lasts long.

exampleSimplified: 听到那个消息，他吓出了一身冷汗。
exampleTraditional: 聽到那個訊息，他嚇出了一身冷汗。
exampleEnglish: Hearing the news, he broke out in a cold sweat.
hintSimplified: 人害怕或紧张时，身上流出的汗。
hintTraditional: 人害怕或緊張時，身上流出的汗。
hintEnglish: The sweat that comes out of your body when you are scared or nervous.

exampleSimplified: 下雨天，夜市里显得很冷清。
exampleTraditional: 下雨天，夜市裡顯得很冷清。
exampleEnglish: On rainy days, the night market looks very deserted.
hintSimplified: 形容地方人很少，不热闹，让人觉得有点孤单。
hintTraditional: 形容地方人很少，不熱鬧，讓人覺得有點孤單。
hintEnglish: Describes a place with few people, not lively, a bit lonely.

exampleSimplified: 坏人用照片勒索他一大笔钱。
exampleTraditional: 壞人用照片勒索他一大筆錢。
exampleEnglish: The bad guys used photos to extort a large sum of money from him.
hintSimplified: 用威胁的方法，强迫别人给钱或东西，是犯法的事。
hintTraditional: 用威脅的方法，強迫別人給錢或東西，是犯法的事。
hintEnglish: Using threats to force someone to give money or things; it is a crime.

exampleSimplified: 我们在黎明前就出发去看日出。
exampleTraditional: 我們在黎明前就出發去看日出。
exampleEnglish: We set out before dawn to watch the sunrise.
hintSimplified: 天快要亮、太阳还没出来的时候。
hintTraditional: 天快要亮、太陽還沒出來的時候。
hintEnglish: The time when the sky is getting light but the sun hasn't risen yet.

definition: to be killed; to die in an accident or disaster
exampleSimplified: 这次空难中有很多乘客不幸罹难。
exampleTraditional: 這次空難中有很多乘客不幸罹難。
exampleEnglish: Many passengers unfortunately perished in this plane crash.
hintSimplified: 在意外或灾难中不幸死去，新闻里常用的正式说法。
hintTraditional: 在意外或災難中不幸死去，新聞裡常用的正式說法。
hintEnglish: A formal term used in news for dying unfortunately in an accident or disaster.

exampleSimplified: 这辆车已经跑了五万公里的里程。
exampleTraditional: 這輛車已經跑了五萬公里的里程。
exampleEnglish: This car has already covered a mileage of fifty thousand kilometers.
hintSimplified: 车子走过的路有多远，也可以比喻事情发展的重要阶段。
hintTraditional: 車子走過的路有多遠，也可以比喻事情發展的重要階段。
hintEnglish: How far a vehicle has traveled; also figuratively an important stage of development.

gloss: to manage wealth; to manage finances; money management
definition: to manage wealth; to manage finances; money management
exampleSimplified: 年轻人也应该学习怎么理财。
exampleTraditional: 年輕人也應該學習怎麼理財。
exampleEnglish: Young people should also learn how to manage their money.
hintSimplified: 安排和管理自己的钱，让它慢慢增加。
hintTraditional: 安排和管理自己的錢，讓它慢慢增加。
hintEnglish: To plan and manage your own money so that it grows slowly.

exampleSimplified: 做重要决定时，我们要理性一点。
exampleTraditional: 做重要決定時，我們要理性一點。
exampleEnglish: When making important decisions, we should be more rational.
hintSimplified: 用头脑思考，而不是只凭感情做判断。
hintTraditional: 用頭腦思考，而不是隻憑感情做判斷。
hintEnglish: Judging with your head rather than only with emotions.

gloss: Neo-Confucian Rationalistic School (from Song to mid-Qing times, c. 1000-1750, typified by the teachings of Cheng Hao 程顥|程颢[Cheng2 Hao4], Cheng Yi 程頤|程颐[Cheng2 Yi2] and Zhu Xi 朱熹[Zhu1 xi1])
definition: Neo-Confucian Rationalistic School (from Song to mid-Qing times, c. 1000-1750, typified by the teachings of Cheng Hao 程顥|程颢[Cheng2 Hao4], Cheng Yi 程頤|程颐[Cheng2 Yi2] and Zhu Xi 朱熹[Zhu1 xi1]); School of Principle; science
exampleSimplified: 宋朝的理学对后来的思想影响很大。
exampleTraditional: 宋朝的理學對後來的思想影響很大。
exampleEnglish: Neo-Confucianism of the Song dynasty greatly influenced later thought.
hintSimplified: 宋朝时发展起来的一种儒家哲学思想。
hintTraditional: 宋朝時發展起來的一種儒家哲學思想。
hintEnglish: A Confucian school of philosophy that developed in the Song dynasty.

exampleSimplified: 生气的时候，要保持理智，不要乱说话。
exampleTraditional: 生氣的時候，要保持理智，不要亂說話。
exampleEnglish: When angry, stay level-headed and don't speak rashly.
hintSimplified: 遇到问题时，能冷静思考、不被情绪控制的能力。
hintTraditional: 遇到問題時，能冷靜思考、不被情緒控制的能力。
hintEnglish: The ability to think calmly and not be controlled by emotions when facing problems.

definition: ceremonial robe; formal attire (dinner suit, evening gown etc)
exampleSimplified: 新娘穿着一件白色的礼服走进教堂。
exampleTraditional: 新娘穿著一件白色的禮服走進教堂。
exampleEnglish: The bride walked into the church in a white formal gown.
hintSimplified: 婚礼或典礼等正式场合穿的漂亮衣服。
hintTraditional: 婚禮或典禮等正式場合穿的漂亮衣服。
hintEnglish: Fine clothes worn at formal occasions such as weddings or ceremonies.

exampleSimplified: 去日本做客要注意一些基本的礼节。
exampleTraditional: 去日本做客要注意一些基本的禮節。
exampleEnglish: When visiting Japan as a guest, you should pay attention to some basic etiquette.
hintSimplified: 人与人见面或相处时，应该遵守的有礼貌的规矩。
hintTraditional: 人與人見面或相處時，應該遵守的有禮貌的規矩。
hintEnglish: Polite rules people should follow when meeting or interacting.

definition: striving to do one's best; to make every effort to
exampleSimplified: 我们力求在期限以前完成这个计划。
exampleTraditional: 我們力求在期限以前完成這個計劃。
exampleEnglish: We strive to finish this project before the deadline.
hintSimplified: 非常努力地想要做到，尽量达到好的结果。
hintTraditional: 非常努力地想要做到，儘量達到好的結果。
hintEnglish: To work very hard to achieve something, aiming for a good result.

definition: to act energetically; to practice diligently
exampleSimplified: 他一直力行环保,每天都骑自行车上班。
exampleTraditional: 他一直力行環保,每天都騎腳踏車上班。
exampleEnglish: He has always put environmentalism into practice by cycling to work every day.
hintSimplified: 意思是努力地去实践自己相信的想法或原则。
hintTraditional: 意思是努力地去實踐自己相信的想法或原則。
hintEnglish: It means to make a great effort to put one's beliefs or principles into practice.

exampleSimplified: 他大学读的是物理系,最喜欢上力学课。
exampleTraditional: 他大學讀的是物理系,最喜歡上力學課。
exampleEnglish: He studied physics at university, and his favorite class was mechanics.
hintSimplified: 物理学的一个分支,研究物体的运动和受力。
hintTraditional: 物理學的一個分支,研究物體的運動和受力。
hintEnglish: A branch of physics that studies how objects move and the forces acting on them.

exampleSimplified: 这个国家是在一百多年前立国的。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家是在一百多年前立國的。
exampleEnglish: This country was founded more than a hundred years ago.
hintSimplified: 一群人建立一个新的国家，有自己的政府和名字，就叫做这个。
hintTraditional: 一群人建立一個新的國家，有自己的政府和名字，就叫做這個。
hintEnglish: When a group of people set up a new nation with its own government and name, this is what it's called.

exampleSimplified: 这张立体卡片打开以后,里面的房子会站起来。
exampleTraditional: 這張立體卡片開啟以後,裡面的房子會站起來。
exampleEnglish: When you open this three-dimensional card, the house inside stands up.
hintSimplified: 形容东西有长、宽、高,不是平平的一张图。
hintTraditional: 形容東西有長、寬、高,不是平平的一張圖。
hintEnglish: Describes something with length, width and height, not flat like a picture.

exampleSimplified: 银行最近调低了存款的利率。
exampleTraditional: 銀行最近調低了存款的利率。
exampleEnglish: The bank recently lowered the interest rate on deposits.
hintSimplified: 把钱存在银行或向银行借钱时,用来算利息的比例。
hintTraditional: 把錢存在銀行或向銀行借錢時,用來算利息的比例。
hintEnglish: The percentage used to calculate what you earn or pay when saving or borrowing money at a bank.

definition: advantages and disadvantages; merits and drawbacks; pros and cons
exampleSimplified: 做决定以前,你要先想清楚这件事的利弊。
exampleTraditional: 做決定以前,你要先想清楚這件事的利弊。
exampleEnglish: Before making a decision, you should think carefully about the pros and cons of this matter.
hintSimplified: 一件事好的一面和不好的一面。
hintTraditional: 一件事好的一面和不好的一面。
hintEnglish: The good side and the bad side of something.

exampleSimplified: 历届毕业生都会回学校参加校庆。
exampleTraditional: 歷屆畢業生都會回學校參加校慶。
exampleEnglish: Graduates of all past years come back to the school for its anniversary.
hintSimplified: 指过去每一次举办的会议、比赛或每一任的人。
hintTraditional: 指過去每一次舉辦的會議、比賽或每一任的人。
hintEnglish: Refers to every past session, competition or term that has taken place.

definition: (of) all-time; always; throughout (a period of time)
exampleSimplified: 这家老店历来都是用传统方法做面包。
exampleTraditional: 這家老店歷來都是用傳統方法做麵包。
exampleEnglish: This old shop has always made bread using traditional methods.
hintSimplified: 表示从过去到现在一直都是这样。
hintTraditional: 表示從過去到現在一直都是這樣。
hintEnglish: Indicates that it has been this way from the past up until now.

definition: bygone years; calendar year; over the years
exampleSimplified: 这个城市历年的平均气温都在上升。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市歷年的平均氣溫都在上升。
exampleEnglish: This city's average temperature has been rising over the years.
hintSimplified: 指过去的很多年,常用来看每一年的数字或变化。
hintTraditional: 指過去的很多年,常用來看每一年的數字或變化。
hintEnglish: Refers to many past years, often used when looking at figures or changes year by year.

exampleSimplified: 几个国家组成联盟,一起对抗气候变化。
exampleTraditional: 幾個國家組成聯盟,一起對抗氣候變化。
exampleEnglish: Several countries formed an alliance to fight climate change together.
hintSimplified: 几个国家或团体为了共同目标而结合在一起的组织。
hintTraditional: 幾個國家或團體為了共同目標而結合在一起的組織。
hintEnglish: An organization in which several countries or groups join together for a common goal.

definition: connection; contact; relation; to get in touch with; to integrate; to link; to touch; variant of 聯繫|联系[lian2 xi4]
exampleSimplified: 到了机场以后,请马上和我联系。
exampleTraditional: 到了機場以後,請馬上和我聯繫。
exampleEnglish: After you arrive at the airport, please contact me right away.
hintSimplified: 用电话或讯息跟别人取得沟通,或指事物之间的关系。
hintTraditional: 用電話或訊息跟別人取得溝通,或指事物之間的關係。
hintEnglish: To get in touch with someone by phone or message, or the relationship between things.

exampleSimplified: 这条小路把两个村子连系起来。
exampleTraditional: 這條小路把兩個村子連繫起來。
exampleEnglish: This small road connects the two villages.
hintSimplified: 让两个东西或两个地方接在一起,产生关系。
hintTraditional: 讓兩個東西或兩個地方接在一起,產生關係。
hintEnglish: To make two things or places join together and form a link.

definition: Lenovo; mental association; to associate (cognitively); to make an associative connection; word prediction and auto-complete functions of input method editing programs
exampleSimplified: 看到海,我就联想到小时候的暑假。
exampleTraditional: 看到海,我就聯想到小時候的暑假。
exampleEnglish: Seeing the sea, I am reminded of summer vacations from my childhood.
hintSimplified: 看到或听到一件事,心里自然想到另一件相关的事。
hintTraditional: 看到或聽到一件事,心裡自然想到另一件相關的事。
hintEnglish: When seeing or hearing one thing, you naturally think of another related thing.

definition: joint (liability etc); to be related; to entail; to involve
exampleSimplified: 一个小错误,可能会连带影响整个计划。
exampleTraditional: 一個小錯誤,可能會連帶影響整個計劃。
exampleEnglish: One small mistake may also affect the entire plan.
hintSimplified: 表示一件事发生时,另一件相关的事也跟着受到影响。
hintTraditional: 表示一件事發生時,另一件相關的事也跟著受到影響。
hintEnglish: Means that when one thing happens, a related thing is affected along with it.

definition: (Tw) link (on a website); hyperlink; variant of 聯結|联结[lian2 jie2]
exampleSimplified: 请点击这个连结,就可以看到完整的新闻。
exampleTraditional: 請點選這個連結,就可以看到完整的新聞。
exampleEnglish: Please click this link and you can see the full news report.
hintSimplified: 网页上点一下就能跳到另一个页面的文字或图案。
hintTraditional: 網頁上點一下就能跳到另一個頁面的文字或圖案。
hintEnglish: Text or an image on a web page that you click to jump to another page.

gloss: to combine; to join; to link
definition: to combine; to join; to link
exampleSimplified: 这座桥把小岛和大陆联结在一起。
exampleTraditional: 這座橋把小島和大陸聯結在一起。
exampleEnglish: This bridge links the small island with the mainland.
hintSimplified: 把分开的东西接合起来,使它们成为一体。
hintTraditional: 把分開的東西接合起來,使它們成為一體。
hintEnglish: To join separate things so that they become one whole.

definition: to continue in (a political) office; to serve for another term of office
exampleSimplified: 市长在选举中获胜,成功连任。
exampleTraditional: 市長在選舉中獲勝,成功連任。
exampleEnglish: The mayor won the election and was successfully re-elected to another term.
hintSimplified: 做完一任官职以后,又继续做下一任。
hintTraditional: 做完一任官職以後,又繼續做下一任。
hintEnglish: After finishing one term in office, continuing on to the next term.

gloss: (Tw) to connect (to a network, device etc); to go online; connection
definition: (Tw) to connect (to a network, device etc); to go online; connection; (congressional) caucus; electrical lead; connecting line
exampleSimplified: 网络不太稳定,视频会议一直没办法连线。
exampleTraditional: 網路不太穩定,視訊會議一直沒辦法連線。
exampleEnglish: The network is unstable, so the video meeting couldn't connect.
hintSimplified: 让电脑或手机接上网络,或和别人在线上接通。
hintTraditional: 讓電腦或手機接上網路,或和別人線上上接通。
hintEnglish: To get a computer or phone onto the network, or to link up with someone online.

exampleSimplified: 这家店卖的都是廉价的日用品。
exampleTraditional: 這家店賣的都是廉價的日用品。
exampleEnglish: This shop sells only cheap everyday goods.
hintSimplified: 形容东西的价格很低,不太贵。
hintTraditional: 形容東西的價格很低,不太貴。
hintEnglish: Describes something whose price is very low and not expensive.

exampleSimplified: 大家都说这位官员为人廉洁,从不收礼。
exampleTraditional: 大家都說這位官員為人廉潔,從不收禮。
exampleEnglish: Everyone says this official is honest and incorruptible and never accepts gifts.
hintSimplified: 形容人做事公正,不贪钱,也不接受不正当的好处。
hintTraditional: 形容人做事公正,不貪錢,也不接受不正當的好處。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who acts fairly, is not greedy, and refuses improper benefits.

exampleSimplified: 阳光照在她年轻的脸庞上,看起来很开心。
exampleTraditional: 陽光照在她年輕的臉龐上,看起來很開心。
exampleEnglish: The sunlight shone on her young face, and she looked very happy.
hintSimplified: 人脸的样子或轮廓,常用在文章里。
hintTraditional: 人臉的樣子或輪廓,常用在文章裡。
hintEnglish: The shape or outline of a person's face, often used in written prose.

definition: Facebook; types of facial makeup in operas
exampleSimplified: 京剧演员脸上画着红色和黑色的脸谱。
exampleTraditional: 京劇演員臉上畫著紅色和黑色的臉譜。
exampleEnglish: The Peking opera actor has a red and black painted face design.
hintSimplified: 戏曲演员脸上画的图案,颜色代表不同的性格。
hintTraditional: 戲曲演員臉上畫的圖案,顏色代表不同的性格。
hintEnglish: The patterns painted on opera performers' faces, whose colors represent different personalities.

definition: a golden opportunity; a good chance
exampleSimplified: 这次比赛是你展现实力的良机,不要错过。
exampleTraditional: 這次比賽是你展現實力的良機,不要錯過。
exampleEnglish: This competition is a golden opportunity to show your ability, so don't miss it.
hintSimplified: 非常好、很适合做某件事的机会。
hintTraditional: 非常好、很適合做某件事的機會。
hintEnglish: A very good chance that is well suited for doing something.

definition: both ends of sth; electric or magnetic poles; the north and south poles; the two poles
exampleSimplified: 地球的两极常年被冰雪覆盖。
exampleTraditional: 地球的兩極常年被冰雪覆蓋。
exampleEnglish: The two poles of the Earth are covered with ice and snow all year round.
hintSimplified: 指地球最北和最南的两端,或相反的两个极端。
hintTraditional: 指地球最北和最南的兩端,或相反的兩個極端。
hintEnglish: Refers to the northernmost and southernmost ends of the Earth, or two opposite extremes.

exampleSimplified: 站在山顶,可以看到辽阔的草原。
exampleTraditional: 站在山頂,可以看到遼闊的草原。
exampleEnglish: Standing on the mountaintop, you can see the vast grassland.
hintSimplified: 形容土地或天空又大又宽,一眼看不到边。
hintTraditional: 形容土地或天空又大又寬,一眼看不到邊。
hintEnglish: Describes land or sky that is so large and wide that you can't see its edges.

exampleSimplified: 这趟列车明天早上八点从台北出发。
exampleTraditional: 這趟列車明天早上八點從台北出發。
exampleEnglish: This train departs from Taipei at eight tomorrow morning.
hintSimplified: 在铁轨上跑的一长串车厢。
hintTraditional: 在鐵軌上跑的一長串車廂。
hintEnglish: A long string of carriages running on rails.

exampleSimplified: 这位作家曾经游历过欧洲的许多列国。
exampleTraditional: 這位作家曾經遊歷過歐洲的許多列國。
exampleEnglish: This writer once traveled through many countries of Europe.
hintSimplified: 指历史上或地图上许多不同的国家。
hintTraditional: 指歷史上或地圖上許多不同的國家。
hintEnglish: Refers to many different countries, in history or on the map.

exampleSimplified: 这个景点已经被列入世界遗产名单。
exampleTraditional: 這個景點已經被列入世界遺產名單。
exampleEnglish: This scenic spot has been included on the World Heritage list.
hintSimplified: 把一个名字或项目放进一份名单或计划里。
hintTraditional: 把一個名字或專案放進一份名單或計劃裡。
hintEnglish: To put a name or item into a list or plan.

exampleSimplified: 那个猎人带着狗走进了森林。
exampleTraditional: 那個獵人帶著狗走進了森林。
exampleEnglish: The hunter walked into the forest with his dog.
hintSimplified: 他在山林里追捕野生动物。
hintTraditional: 他在山林裡追捕野生動物。
hintEnglish: He pursues wild animals in the mountains and forests.

exampleSimplified: 我们在纪念碑前向烈士献花。
exampleTraditional: 我們在紀念碑前向烈士獻花。
exampleEnglish: We laid flowers for the martyrs in front of the monument.
hintSimplified: 为了崇高的理想牺牲生命而受人敬仰的人。
hintTraditional: 為了崇高的理想犧牲生命而受人敬仰的人。
hintEnglish: A person who gave his life for a noble cause and is revered.

exampleSimplified: 这位医生有二十年的临床经验。
exampleTraditional: 這位醫生有二十年的臨床經驗。
exampleEnglish: This doctor has twenty years of clinical experience.
hintSimplified: 医学上指直接在病人身边观察和治疗。
hintTraditional: 醫學上指直接在病人身邊觀察和治療。
hintEnglish: In medicine, observing and treating directly at the patient's side.

exampleSimplified: 我们和邻里的关系一直很好。
exampleTraditional: 我們和鄰里的關係一直很好。
exampleEnglish: We have always had a good relationship with our neighbors.
hintSimplified: 住在你家附近的人们。
hintTraditional: 住在你家附近的人們。
hintEnglish: The people who live close to your home.

exampleSimplified: 他在散步的时候突然有了写歌的灵感。
exampleTraditional: 他在散步的時候突然有了寫歌的靈感。
exampleEnglish: While taking a walk, he suddenly got inspiration to write a song.
hintSimplified: 艺术家突然想到好点子的那种感觉。
hintTraditional: 藝術家突然想到好點子的那種感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling when an artist suddenly gets a great idea.

definition: (of a prediction) accurate; correct; effective; efficacious
exampleSimplified: 听说这座庙很灵验，很多人来求平安。
exampleTraditional: 聽說這座廟很靈驗，很多人來求平安。
exampleEnglish: They say this temple is very efficacious, and many people come to pray for safety.
hintSimplified: 形容祈求或预言真的实现了。
hintTraditional: 形容祈求或預言真的實現了。
hintEnglish: Describes a prayer or prediction that really comes true.

definition: captain (of sports squad); leader of a group; to lead a group
exampleSimplified: 领队带着大家走进体育馆。
exampleTraditional: 領隊帶著大家走進體育館。
exampleEnglish: The team leader led everyone into the gymnasium.
hintSimplified: 带着一群人出赛或旅行的负责人。
hintTraditional: 帶著一群人出賽或旅行的負責人。
hintEnglish: The person in charge who leads a group to competitions or trips.

definition: to comprehend; to grasp; to understand
exampleSimplified: 我慢慢领会了老师话里的意思。
exampleTraditional: 我慢慢領會了老師話裡的意思。
exampleEnglish: I gradually grasped the meaning behind the teacher's words.
hintSimplified: 听完或看完之后，真正明白其中的含意。
hintTraditional: 聽完或看完之後，真正明白其中的含意。
hintEnglish: After hearing or seeing something, truly understanding its meaning.

exampleSimplified: 经过多年的修行，他终于领悟了人生的道理。
exampleTraditional: 經過多年的修行，他終於領悟了人生的道理。
exampleEnglish: After years of practice, he finally realized the truth of life.
hintSimplified: 经过思考后，突然明白深刻的道理。
hintTraditional: 經過思考後，突然明白深刻的道理。
hintEnglish: After reflection, suddenly understanding a profound truth.

definition: course; sequence of processes; stream; work flow in manufacturing
exampleSimplified: 新员工要先熟悉公司的工作流程。
exampleTraditional: 新員工要先熟悉公司的工作流程。
exampleEnglish: New employees must first become familiar with the company's workflow.
hintSimplified: 做一件事所经过的一步一步的顺序。
hintTraditional: 做一件事所經過的一步一步的順序。
hintEnglish: The step-by-step order through which a task is done.

gloss: to spread; to circulate; to hand down
definition: to spread; to circulate; to hand down
exampleSimplified: 这个故事在民间流传了几百年。
exampleTraditional: 這個故事在民間流傳了幾百年。
exampleEnglish: This story has circulated among the people for hundreds of years.
hintSimplified: 故事或消息从一个人传到另一个人，传很久很远。
hintTraditional: 故事或訊息從一個人傳到另一個人，傳很久很遠。
hintEnglish: A story or news passing from person to person, far and for a long time.

definition: to be stranded; to wander about destitute
exampleSimplified: 战争让他流落到一个陌生的城市。
exampleTraditional: 戰爭讓他流落到一個陌生的城市。
exampleEnglish: The war left him stranded in an unfamiliar city.
hintSimplified: 没有家，漂泊到别的地方，生活很困难。
hintTraditional: 沒有家，漂泊到別的地方，生活很困難。
hintEnglish: Without a home, drifting to another place and living in hardship.

exampleSimplified: 警察抓到了几个在街上闹事的流氓。
exampleTraditional: 警察抓到了幾個在街上鬧事的流氓。
exampleEnglish: The police caught several hoodlums causing trouble on the street.
hintSimplified: 在街头欺负人、不守规矩的坏人。
hintTraditional: 在街頭欺負人、不守規矩的壞人。
hintEnglish: Bad people who bully others on the street and break the rules.

gloss: (fig.) (of talented staff, followers of a religious faith, investment funds etc) to go elsewhere
definition: (fig.) (of talented staff, followers of a religious faith, investment funds etc) to go elsewhere; (of soil etc) to wash away; to be eroded; to fail to be retained
exampleSimplified: 这家公司的优秀人才不断流失。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司的優秀人才不斷流失。
exampleEnglish: This company's talented people keep leaving.
hintSimplified: 人才、资金或客人慢慢离开，越来越少。
hintTraditional: 人才、資金或客人慢慢離開，越來越少。
hintEnglish: Talent, money or customers gradually leaving, becoming fewer and fewer.

exampleSimplified: 这家小店每个月的流水大约有十万元。
exampleTraditional: 這家小店每個月的流水大約有十萬元。
exampleEnglish: This small shop's monthly turnover is about 100,000 dollars.
hintSimplified: 店家一段时间内收入和支出的总金额。
hintTraditional: 店家一段時間內收入和支出的總金額。
hintEnglish: The total amount of money passing through a shop over a period.

definition: circulation; distribution; to circulate; to distribute
exampleSimplified: 商品要靠良好的流通才能送到消费者手中。
exampleTraditional: 商品要靠良好的流通才能送到消費者手中。
exampleEnglish: Goods need good circulation to reach consumers.
hintSimplified: 货物、货币或空气顺畅地来回移动。
hintTraditional: 貨物、貨幣或空氣順暢地來回移動。
hintEnglish: Goods, money or air moving smoothly back and forth.

gloss: meteor hammer (abbr. for 流星錘|流星锤[liu2 xing1 chui2])
definition: meteor hammer (abbr. for 流星錘|流星锤[liu2 xing1 chui2]); meteor; shooting star
exampleSimplified: 昨晚我们在山上看到了一颗流星。
exampleTraditional: 昨晚我們在山上看到了一顆流星。
exampleEnglish: Last night we saw a shooting star on the mountain.
hintSimplified: 夜空中一闪而过的亮光，人们常对它许愿。
hintTraditional: 夜空中一閃而過的亮光，人們常對它許願。
hintEnglish: A flash of light across the night sky, which people often make wishes upon.

exampleSimplified: 长江流域住着很多人口。
exampleTraditional: 長江流域住著很多人口。
exampleEnglish: A large population lives in the Yangtze River basin.
hintSimplified: 一条大河和它的支流所经过的整片土地。
hintTraditional: 一條大河和它的支流所經過的整片土地。
hintEnglish: The whole land area covered by a big river and its tributaries.

exampleSimplified: 河边种了一排柳树，风一吹就轻轻摇动。
exampleTraditional: 河邊種了一排柳樹，風一吹就輕輕搖動。
exampleEnglish: A row of willow trees is planted by the river and sways gently in the wind.
hintSimplified: 枝条又细又长、常种在水边的树。
hintTraditional: 枝條又細又長、常種在水邊的樹。
hintEnglish: A tree with long, thin drooping branches, often planted by water.

definition: cage; basket; container; large box; trunk; chest
exampleSimplified: 小鸟被关在笼子里，一直想飞出去。
exampleTraditional: 小鳥被關在籠子裡，一直想飛出去。
exampleEnglish: The little bird was kept in a cage and always wanted to fly out.
hintSimplified: 用来关鸟或小动物的东西，有很多栏杆。
hintTraditional: 用來關鳥或小動物的東西，有很多欄杆。
hintEnglish: Something with many bars used to keep birds or small animals.

exampleSimplified: 整座城市被浓浓的雾笼罩着。
exampleTraditional: 整座城市被濃濃的霧籠罩著。
exampleEnglish: The whole city was enveloped in thick fog.
hintSimplified: 像一层东西从上面盖住整个地方。
hintTraditional: 像一層東西從上面蓋住整個地方。
hintEnglish: Like a layer covering a whole place from above.

exampleSimplified: 一家公司不应该垄断整个市场。
exampleTraditional: 一家公司不應該壟斷整個市場。
exampleEnglish: One company should not monopolize the whole market.
hintSimplified: 一个人或公司独自控制某个行业，别人无法参与。
hintTraditional: 一個人或公司獨自控制某個行業，別人無法參與。
hintEnglish: One person or company controlling an industry alone, leaving others out.

definition: CL:棟|栋[dong4],幢[zhuang4],座[zuo4]; a building of two or more stories
exampleSimplified: 他们住在一栋十层的楼房里。
exampleTraditional: 他們住在一棟十層的樓房裡。
exampleEnglish: They live in a ten-story building.
