hintSimplified: 有很多层，人们住在里面的高大建筑。
hintTraditional: 有很多層，人們住在裡面的高大建築。
hintEnglish: A tall building with many floors where people live.

exampleSimplified: 冬天，他们围着炉子取暖。
exampleTraditional: 冬天，他們圍著爐子取暖。
exampleEnglish: In winter, they gather around the stove to keep warm.
hintSimplified: 可以生火，用来取暖或者做饭的设备。
hintTraditional: 可以生火，用來取暖或者做飯的裝置。
hintEnglish: A device where you light a fire, used for heating or cooking.

gloss: dry land (as opposed to the sea)
definition: dry land (as opposed to the sea)
exampleSimplified: 地球上的陆地比海洋小很多。
exampleTraditional: 地球上的陸地比海洋小很多。
exampleEnglish: The land on Earth is much smaller than the oceans.
hintSimplified: 地球表面不是海洋的部分。
hintTraditional: 地球表面不是海洋的部分。
hintEnglish: The part of Earth's surface that is not ocean.

gloss: to pass by; to pass through
definition: to pass by; to pass through
exampleSimplified: 我昨天路过你家，可是你不在。
exampleTraditional: 我昨天路過你家，可是你不在。
exampleEnglish: I passed by your house yesterday, but you weren't there.
hintSimplified: 在去别的地方的路上，经过某个地方，没有停留很久。
hintTraditional: 在去別的地方的路上，經過某個地方，沒有停留很久。
hintEnglish: To go by a place on the way elsewhere without stopping long.

definition: al fresco; in the open; outdoors
exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅有一个露天的座位区。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳有一個露天的座位區。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant has an outdoor seating area.
hintSimplified: 没有屋顶，在室外的。
hintTraditional: 沒有屋頂，在室外的。
hintEnglish: Having no roof; outside, not indoors.

exampleSimplified: 老师把这堂课录影下来了。
exampleTraditional: 老師把這堂課錄影下來了。
exampleEnglish: The teacher recorded this class on video.
hintSimplified: 用摄影机把动态的画面和声音保存下来。
hintTraditional: 用攝影機把動態的畫面和聲音儲存下來。
hintEnglish: To save moving pictures and sound using a camera.

exampleSimplified: 远处山的轮廓在雾中慢慢出现。
exampleTraditional: 遠處山的輪廓在霧中慢慢出現。
exampleEnglish: The outline of the distant mountain slowly appeared in the fog.
hintSimplified: 物体外面一圈的线条或形状，看不清里面的细节。
hintTraditional: 物體外面一圈的線條或形狀，看不清裡面的細節。
hintEnglish: The line or shape around the edge of an object, without inner details.

exampleSimplified: 医生必须遵守职业伦理。
exampleTraditional: 醫生必須遵守職業倫理。
exampleEnglish: Doctors must abide by professional ethics.
hintSimplified: 人与人相处时，应该遵守的道德规范。
hintTraditional: 人與人相處時，應該遵守的道德規範。
hintEnglish: The moral principles people should follow in their dealings with one another.

definition: to be occupied; to degenerate; to fall into enemy hands; to submerge
exampleSimplified: 这座城市在战争中沦陷了。
exampleTraditional: 這座城市在戰爭中淪陷了。
exampleEnglish: This city fell to enemy occupation during the war.
hintSimplified: 国土或城市被外来的军队占领。
hintTraditional: 國土或城市被外來的軍隊佔領。
hintEnglish: When a land or city is taken over by a foreign army.

definition: argument; line of reasoning; point (of discussion); thesis
exampleSimplified: 这篇文章的论点很清楚，也很有说服力。
exampleTraditional: 這篇文章的論點很清楚，也很有說服力。
exampleEnglish: The argument of this article is clear and persuasive.
hintSimplified: 写文章或辩论时，作者想证明的主要看法。
hintTraditional: 寫文章或辯論時，作者想證明的主要看法。
hintEnglish: The main view that a writer or debater tries to prove.

gloss: variant of 囉唆|啰唆[luo1 suo5]
definition: variant of 囉唆|啰唆[luo1 suo5]
exampleSimplified: 他说话太啰嗦了，半天讲不到重点。
exampleTraditional: 他說話太囉嗦了，半天講不到重點。
exampleEnglish: He is too long-winded and takes forever to get to the point.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人话很多，同样的事情说了又说。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人話很多，同樣的事情說了又說。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who talks too much, repeating the same things.

definition: also pr. [luo1suo1]; long-winded; wordy; to talk endlessly; to go on and on; troublesome; pesky
exampleSimplified: 妈妈有时候很啰唆，一直提醒我带伞。
exampleTraditional: 媽媽有時候很囉唆，一直提醒我帶傘。
exampleEnglish: Mom can be nagging sometimes, reminding me over and over to bring an umbrella.
hintSimplified: 形容话多又重复，让人觉得有点烦。
hintTraditional: 形容話多又重複，讓人覺得有點煩。
hintEnglish: Describes talk that is wordy and repetitive, a bit annoying.

exampleSimplified: 你的想法很有逻辑，我听得懂。
exampleTraditional: 你的想法很有邏輯，我聽得懂。
exampleEnglish: Your thinking is very logical, and I can follow it.
hintSimplified: 思考和推理时，前后要合理、有条理的规则。
hintTraditional: 思考和推理時，前後要合理、有條理的規則。
hintEnglish: The rules of reasoning that make thoughts consistent and orderly.

definition: ending up as; in total; leading to; resulting in
exampleSimplified: 他赌博输光了钱，落得一无所有。
exampleTraditional: 他賭博輸光了錢，落得一無所有。
exampleEnglish: He gambled away his money and ended up with nothing.
hintSimplified: 表示经过一些事情之后，得到了不好的结果。
hintTraditional: 表示經過一些事情之後，得到了不好的結果。
hintEnglish: Indicates that after some events one arrives at an unfortunate result.

definition: also pr. [luo4 tuo4]; down and out; in dire straits; unconventional; unrestrained
exampleSimplified: 他生意失败后，一个人落魄地流浪街头。
exampleTraditional: 他生意失敗後，一個人落魄地流浪街頭。
exampleEnglish: After his business failed, he wandered the streets down and out.
hintSimplified: 形容人失去工作或钱财，生活很不顺利、很可怜。
hintTraditional: 形容人失去工作或錢財，生活很不順利、很可憐。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who has lost job or money and is in a sorry state.

gloss: to fail to be chosen (or elected)
definition: to fail to be chosen (or elected); to lose an election
exampleSimplified: 他这次参加选举，不幸落选了。
exampleTraditional: 他這次參加選舉，不幸落選了。
exampleEnglish: He ran in this election but unfortunately lost.
hintSimplified: 参加选举或比赛，却没有被选上。
hintTraditional: 參加選舉或比賽，卻沒有被選上。
hintEnglish: To take part in an election or selection but not be chosen.

exampleSimplified: 骆驼可以在沙漠里走很远的路。
exampleTraditional: 駱駝可以在沙漠裡走很遠的路。
exampleEnglish: Camels can travel a long way in the desert.
hintSimplified: 背上有驼峰，能在沙漠里很久不喝水的动物。
hintTraditional: 背上有駝峰，能在沙漠裡很久不喝水的動物。
hintEnglish: An animal with humps on its back that can go long without water in the desert.

exampleSimplified: 这次出国的旅费我已经存好了。
exampleTraditional: 這次出國的旅費我已經存好了。
exampleEnglish: I have already saved the travel expenses for this trip abroad.
hintSimplified: 出远门时，交通、住宿等需要花的钱。
hintTraditional: 出遠門時，交通、住宿等需要花的錢。
hintEnglish: The money needed for transport, lodging, etc. when going on a trip.

exampleSimplified: 漫长的旅途让大家都累了。
exampleTraditional: 漫長的旅途讓大家都累了。
exampleEnglish: The long journey made everyone tired.
hintSimplified: 出门旅行时，从出发到目的地的这一段路。
hintTraditional: 出門旅行時，從出發到目的地的這一段路。
hintEnglish: The stretch from departure to destination when traveling.

definition: background (academic and work); curriculum vitae; résumé
exampleSimplified: 申请工作时，要先准备好你的履历。
exampleTraditional: 申請工作時，要先準備好你的履歷。
exampleEnglish: When applying for a job, first prepare your résumé.
hintSimplified: 写下一个人学过什么、做过什么工作的资料。
hintTraditional: 寫下一個人學過什麼、做過什麼工作的資料。
hintEnglish: A record of what a person has studied and which jobs they have held.

definition: to carry out (a task); to fulfill (one's obligations); to implement (an agreement); to perform
exampleSimplified: 双方都必须履行合约上的规定。
exampleTraditional: 雙方都必須履行合約上的規定。
exampleEnglish: Both sides must carry out the terms of the contract.
hintSimplified: 按照承诺、合约或义务去实际做到。
hintTraditional: 按照承諾、合約或義務去實際做到。
hintEnglish: To actually do what a promise, contract or duty requires.

definition: anesthesia; to anesthetize; (fig.) to corrupt (sb's mind); to enervate; to numb the mind (to escape from harsh reality)
exampleSimplified: 手术前，医生会先给病人麻醉。
exampleTraditional: 手術前，醫生會先給病人麻醉。
exampleEnglish: Before surgery, the doctor first anesthetizes the patient.
hintSimplified: 动手术前用药让人暂时没有感觉。
hintTraditional: 動手術前用藥讓人暫時沒有感覺。
hintEnglish: Using medicine before an operation so a person temporarily feels nothing.

definition: ambush; to ambush; to lie in wait for; to lie low
exampleSimplified: 警察在路边埋伏，等着小偷出现。
exampleTraditional: 警察在路邊埋伏，等著小偷出現。
exampleEnglish: The police lay in ambush by the road, waiting for the thief to appear.
hintSimplified: 偷偷藏起来，等对方出现时突然行动。
hintTraditional: 偷偷藏起來，等對方出現時突然行動。
hintEnglish: To hide secretly and act suddenly when the other party appears.

exampleSimplified: 房子已经有买主了，价钱也谈好了。
exampleTraditional: 房子已經有買主了，價錢也談好了。
exampleEnglish: The house already has a buyer, and the price has been agreed.
hintSimplified: 要花钱把东西买下来的人。
hintTraditional: 要花錢把東西買下來的人。
hintEnglish: The person who is going to pay to acquire something.

definition: to forge ahead; to step in; to stride forward
exampleSimplified: 我们要向新的目标迈进。
exampleTraditional: 我們要向新的目標邁進。
exampleEnglish: We must stride forward toward a new goal.
hintSimplified: 大步向前走，也比喻朝目标不断前进。
hintTraditional: 大步向前走，也比喻朝目標不斷前進。
hintEnglish: To step boldly forward, also figuratively to keep advancing toward a goal.

exampleSimplified: 秋天到了,田里的麦子都变黄了。
exampleTraditional: 秋天到了,田裡的麥子都變黃了。
exampleEnglish: Autumn has come, and the wheat in the fields has turned yellow.
hintSimplified: 这种农作物成熟时是金黄色的,可以磨成粉做面包和面条。
hintTraditional: 這種農作物成熟時是金黃色的,可以磨成粉做麵包和麵條。
hintEnglish: This crop turns golden when ripe and can be ground into flour for bread and noodles.

exampleSimplified: 他态度蛮横,一点道理也不讲。
exampleTraditional: 他態度蠻橫,一點道理也不講。
exampleEnglish: He has a overbearing attitude and won't listen to any reason.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人很凶,不讲道理,还强迫别人接受他的想法。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人很兇,不講道理,還強迫別人接受他的想法。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is harsh, unreasonable, and forces others to accept their way.

definition: (of farm animals) heavy with young; (to collide) full on; to have one's heart filled with
exampleSimplified: 他满怀希望地走进了考场。
exampleTraditional: 他滿懷希望地走進了考場。
exampleEnglish: He walked into the exam room full of hope.
hintSimplified: 心里装满了某种感情或想法,常和希望、感激一起用。
hintTraditional: 心裡裝滿了某種感情或想法,常和希望、感激一起用。
hintEnglish: Having one's heart filled with a certain feeling or thought, often used with hope or gratitude.

exampleSimplified: 等待检查结果的夜晚显得特别漫长。
exampleTraditional: 等待檢查結果的夜晚顯得特別漫長。
exampleEnglish: The night of waiting for the test results felt especially long.
hintSimplified: 形容时间或道路好像没有尽头,过得很慢。
hintTraditional: 形容時間或道路好像沒有盡頭,過得很慢。
hintEnglish: Describes time or a road that seems to have no end and passes slowly.

exampleSimplified: 森林大火很快就向山下蔓延了。
exampleTraditional: 森林大火很快就向山下蔓延了。
exampleEnglish: The forest fire quickly spread down the mountain.
hintSimplified: 像火、疾病或藤类植物一样,一点一点向四周扩大。
hintTraditional: 像火、疾病或藤類植物一樣,一點一點向四周擴大。
hintEnglish: To gradually expand in all directions, like fire, disease, or climbing vines.

definition: to conform slavishly; to follow blindly; unthinking obedience
exampleSimplified: 做决定时不要盲从别人的意见。
exampleTraditional: 做決定時不要盲從別人的意見。
exampleEnglish: Don't blindly follow others' opinions when making decisions.
hintSimplified: 自己不思考,别人怎么做就怎么做。
hintTraditional: 自己不思考,別人怎麼做就怎麼做。
hintEnglish: Not thinking for oneself and just doing whatever others do.

exampleSimplified: 这条街的红绿灯会发出声音,帮助盲人过马路。
exampleTraditional: 這條街的紅綠燈會發出聲音,幫助盲人過馬路。
exampleEnglish: The traffic lights on this street make sounds to help blind people cross.
hintSimplified: 眼睛看不见东西的人,出门常常需要手杖或导盲犬。
hintTraditional: 眼睛看不見東西的人,出門常常需要手杖或導盲犬。
hintEnglish: A person who cannot see, who often needs a cane or guide dog when going out.

exampleSimplified: 他茫然地看着四周,不知道该往哪里走。
exampleTraditional: 他茫然地看著四周,不知道該往哪裡走。
exampleEnglish: He looked around blankly, not knowing which way to go.
hintSimplified: 形容什么都不明白、不知道怎么办的样子。
hintTraditional: 形容什麼都不明白、不知道怎麼辦的樣子。
hintEnglish: Describes a state of understanding nothing and not knowing what to do.

exampleSimplified: 天气变冷了,我多盖了一条毛毯。
exampleTraditional: 天氣變冷了,我多蓋了一條毛毯。
exampleEnglish: The weather got cold, so I added an extra blanket.
hintSimplified: 用羊毛或其他材料做成,晚上盖在身上保暖。
hintTraditional: 用羊毛或其他材料做成,晚上蓋在身上保暖。
hintEnglish: Made of wool or other material and put over you at night to keep warm.

exampleSimplified: 山上的树林非常茂密,阳光很难照进来。
exampleTraditional: 山上的樹林非常茂密,陽光很難照進來。
exampleEnglish: The trees on the mountain are so dense that sunlight can hardly get in.
hintSimplified: 形容树木或草长得又多又厚。
hintTraditional: 形容樹木或草長得又多又厚。
hintEnglish: Describes trees or grass growing thick and plentiful.

definition: adventure; foray; to take chances; to take risks
exampleSimplified: 他喜欢冒险,常常一个人去爬高山。
exampleTraditional: 他喜歡冒險,常常一個人去爬高山。
exampleEnglish: He likes taking risks and often climbs high mountains alone.
hintSimplified: 明知可能有危险,还是去做一件刺激的事。
hintTraditional: 明知可能有危險,還是去做一件刺激的事。
hintEnglish: Doing something exciting even though you know it may be dangerous.

exampleSimplified: 她的眉毛又黑又长,很好看。
exampleTraditional: 她的眉毛又黑又長,很好看。
exampleEnglish: Her eyebrows are dark and long, and look very nice.
hintSimplified: 长在眼睛上方的一排细细的毛。
hintTraditional: 長在眼睛上方的一排細細的毛。
hintEnglish: The row of fine hairs growing above the eyes.

exampleSimplified: 他皱着眉头,好像遇到了麻烦。
exampleTraditional: 他皺著眉頭,好像遇到了麻煩。
exampleEnglish: He knitted his brow, as if he had run into trouble.
hintSimplified: 脸上两道眉毛附近的地方,烦恼时会皱起来。
hintTraditional: 臉上兩道眉毛附近的地方,煩惱時會皺起來。
hintEnglish: The area around the eyebrows on the face, which wrinkles when one is worried.

exampleSimplified: 每每想起小时候,我就觉得很温暖。
exampleTraditional: 每每想起小時候,我就覺得很溫暖。
exampleEnglish: Whenever I think of my childhood, I feel warm.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示每一次都这样,有时候是常常的意思,多用于书面语。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示每一次都這樣,有時候是常常的意思,多用於書面語。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning every time it happens, somewhat formal.

exampleSimplified: 他们一家人过着美满的生活。
exampleTraditional: 他們一家人過著美滿的生活。
exampleEnglish: Their family lives a happy and perfect life.
hintSimplified: 形容家庭、婚姻或生活幸福,没有遗憾。
hintTraditional: 形容家庭、婚姻或生活幸福,沒有遺憾。
hintEnglish: Describes a family, marriage, or life that is happy and without regrets.

definition: (old) brothel; door; faction; family; family status; portal; sect; strategic gateway; web portal
exampleSimplified: 这个网站是很多人上网的门户。
exampleTraditional: 這個網站是很多人上網的門戶。
exampleEnglish: This website is a portal where many people go online.
hintSimplified: 原来指房子的出入口,现在也指进入某个领域或网络的入口。
hintTraditional: 原來指房子的出入口,現在也指進入某個領域或網路的入口。
hintEnglish: Originally the entrance of a house; now also an entry point to a field or the internet.

exampleSimplified: 海边的风很猛烈,伞都被吹坏了。
exampleTraditional: 海邊的風很猛烈,傘都被吹壞了。
exampleEnglish: The wind by the sea was fierce and even broke the umbrella.
hintSimplified: 形容力量很大、速度很快,让人感觉很强烈。
hintTraditional: 形容力量很大、速度很快,讓人感覺很強烈。
hintEnglish: Describes force that is great and fast, feeling very intense.

definition: to dream about (sth or sb); to see in a dream
exampleSimplified: 我昨晚梦见了很久没见的朋友。
exampleTraditional: 我昨晚夢見了很久沒見的朋友。
exampleEnglish: Last night I dreamed of a friend I haven't seen in a long time.
hintSimplified: 睡觉的时候,在脑子里看到某个人或某件事。
hintTraditional: 睡覺的時候,在腦子裡看到某個人或某件事。
hintEnglish: While sleeping, seeing a certain person or thing in your mind.

exampleSimplified: 老师出了一个谜语,让大家一起猜。
exampleTraditional: 老師出了一個謎語,讓大家一起猜。
exampleEnglish: The teacher posed a riddle for everyone to guess together.
hintSimplified: 一种用问题或描述让人猜答案的文字游戏。
hintTraditional: 一種用問題或描述讓人猜答案的文字遊戲。
hintEnglish: A word game that uses a question or description for people to guess the answer.

exampleSimplified: 孩子们在游乐园里玩迷宫,找了很久才出来。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們在遊樂園裡玩迷宮,找了很久才出來。
exampleEnglish: The children played in a maze at the amusement park and took a long time to find the way out.
hintSimplified: 路线弯弯曲曲、很容易走错的地方,要找到出口很难。
hintTraditional: 路線彎彎曲曲、很容易走錯的地方,要找到出口很難。
hintEnglish: A place with twisting paths where it's easy to go wrong and hard to find the exit.

definition: to baffle; to confuse; to puzzle
exampleSimplified: 这些广告的说法让消费者感到迷惑。
exampleTraditional: 這些廣告的說法讓消費者感到迷惑。
exampleEnglish: The claims in these ads leave consumers confused.
hintSimplified: 因为情况复杂,让人弄不清楚,不知道该相信什么。
hintTraditional: 因為情況複雜,讓人弄不清楚,不知道該相信什麼。
hintEnglish: When a complicated situation leaves someone unsure what to believe.

definition: to be enchanted by; to be infatuated with; to be passionate about
exampleSimplified: 他从小就迷恋篮球,每天都要打。
exampleTraditional: 他從小就迷戀籃球,每天都要打。
exampleEnglish: He has been infatuated with basketball since childhood and plays every day.
hintSimplified: 对某个人或某件事非常着迷,舍不得放下。
hintTraditional: 對某個人或某件事非常著迷,捨不得放下。
hintEnglish: Being so fascinated by someone or something that you can't let go.

definition: to complement; to make up for a deficiency
exampleSimplified: 他努力工作,想弥补自己犯的错误。
exampleTraditional: 他努力工作,想彌補自己犯的錯誤。
exampleEnglish: He works hard, wanting to make up for the mistake he made.
hintSimplified: 把缺少的或做错的部分补上,让结果变得完整。
hintTraditional: 把缺少的或做錯的部分補上,讓結果變得完整。
hintEnglish: To fill in what was lacking or wrong so the result is complete.

exampleSimplified: 早上上班时间,车站里的人群非常密集。
exampleTraditional: 早上上班時間,車站裡的人群非常密集。
exampleEnglish: During the morning rush hour, the crowd at the station is very dense.
hintSimplified: 很多人或东西紧紧地聚在同一个地方。
hintTraditional: 很多人或東西緊緊地聚在同一個地方。
hintEnglish: Many people or things gathered tightly in the same place.

gloss: an obvious reason, truth or fact
definition: an obvious reason, truth or fact; reasonable; sensible; to understand the reason or reasoning
exampleSimplified: 他是个明理的人,跟他好好说就能沟通。
exampleTraditional: 他是個明理的人,跟他好好說就能溝通。
exampleEnglish: He is a reasonable person; if you talk to him properly you can communicate.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人懂得道理,能分辨对错,不会乱发脾气。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人懂得道理,能分辨對錯,不會亂發脾氣。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who understands what's right and wrong and doesn't lose their temper.

exampleSimplified: 明日的会议改到下午三点举行。
exampleTraditional: 明日的會議改到下午三點舉行。
exampleEnglish: Tomorrow's meeting has been moved to three in the afternoon.
hintSimplified: 今天的下一天,常用在比较正式的文字里。
hintTraditional: 今天的下一天,常用在比較正式的文字裡。
hintEnglish: The day after today, often used in more formal writing.

exampleSimplified: 他做了一个明智的决定,没有借钱投资。
exampleTraditional: 他做了一個明智的決定,沒有借錢投資。
exampleEnglish: He made a wise decision and did not borrow money to invest.
hintSimplified: 形容一个选择很聪明、很有判断力。
hintTraditional: 形容一個選擇很聰明、很有判斷力。
hintEnglish: Describes a choice that shows good sense and sound judgment.

definition: number of places; place (in an institution, a group etc); quota
exampleSimplified: 这个课程的名额只有二十个,要早点报名。
exampleTraditional: 這個課程的名額只有二十個,要早點報名。
exampleEnglish: This course has only twenty places, so sign up early.
hintSimplified: 比赛、学校或活动能接受的人数限制。
hintTraditional: 比賽、學校或活動能接受的人數限制。
hintEnglish: The limit on how many people a contest, school or event can accept.

exampleSimplified: 这位老师傅的名号在行业里无人不知。
exampleTraditional: 這位老師傅的名號在行業裡無人不知。
exampleEnglish: This old master's name is known by everyone in the trade.
hintSimplified: 一个人或店因为有名声而被大家叫的称号。
hintTraditional: 一個人或店因為有名聲而被大家叫的稱號。
hintEnglish: A title or name by which a person or shop is known because of its reputation.

exampleSimplified: 这家小吃店在台南很有名气。
exampleTraditional: 這家小吃店在臺南很有名氣。
exampleEnglish: This snack shop is quite famous in Tainan.
hintSimplified: 一个人或地方被很多人知道、认识的程度。
hintTraditional: 一個人或地方被很多人知道、認識的程度。
hintEnglish: The degree to which a person or place is known by many people.

definition: CL:處|处[chu4]; a place famous for its scenery or historical relics; scenic spot
exampleSimplified: 阿里山是台湾有名的名胜。
exampleTraditional: 阿里山是台灣有名的名勝。
exampleEnglish: Alishan is a famous scenic spot in Taiwan.
hintSimplified: 风景很美或有历史,游客常去参观的地方。
hintTraditional: 風景很美或有歷史,遊客常去參觀的地方。
hintEnglish: A place with beautiful scenery or history that tourists like to visit.

exampleSimplified: 他为了保护自己的名声,从不说谎。
exampleTraditional: 他為了保護自己的名聲,從不說謊。
exampleEnglish: To protect his reputation, he never lies.
hintSimplified: 别人对你的品行或表现的整体评价。
hintTraditional: 別人對你的品行或表現的整體評價。
hintEnglish: The overall opinion others have of your character or conduct.

definition: accomplishment; item (in a program of entertainments); sth more than meets the eye; sth significant but not immediately apparent; trick (act of mischief); worthwhile result
exampleSimplified: 他忙了三年,终于搞出了一点名堂。
exampleTraditional: 他忙了三年,終於搞出了一點名堂。
exampleEnglish: After three years of hard work, he finally achieved something.
hintSimplified: 努力以后得到的成绩;也可指花样、道理。
hintTraditional: 努力以後得到的成績;也可指花樣、道理。
hintEnglish: Results gained after effort; it can also mean a trick or a reason behind something.

exampleSimplified: 这间房子在他母亲的名下。
exampleTraditional: 這間房子在他母親的名下。
exampleEnglish: This house is registered under his mother's name.
hintSimplified: 财产登记时,写着谁是所有人。
hintTraditional: 財產登記時,寫著誰是所有人。
hintEnglish: Used when property is registered as belonging to a certain owner.

exampleSimplified: 每天早上冥想十分钟,可以让心情平静。
exampleTraditional: 每天早上冥想十分鐘,可以讓心情平靜。
exampleEnglish: Meditating for ten minutes every morning can calm your mind.
hintSimplified: 安静地坐着,闭上眼睛,放松并专注内心。
hintTraditional: 安靜地坐著,閉上眼睛,放鬆並專注內心。
hintEnglish: Sitting quietly with eyes closed, relaxing and focusing inward.

definition: named after; naming; to christen; to designate; to dub; to give a name to
exampleSimplified: 这座桥是为了纪念他而命名的。
exampleTraditional: 這座橋是為了紀念他而命名的。
exampleEnglish: This bridge was named in his memory.
hintSimplified: 给人、地方或新东西取一个正式的名字。
hintTraditional: 給人、地方或新東西取一個正式的名字。
hintEnglish: To give a formal name to a person, place or new thing.

exampleSimplified: 他投出的飞镖正好命中红心。
exampleTraditional: 他投出的飛鏢正好命中紅心。
exampleEnglish: The dart he threw hit the bullseye exactly.
hintSimplified: 射箭、投篮或开枪时,正好打到目标。
hintTraditional: 射箭、投籃或開槍時,正好打到目標。
hintEnglish: When an arrow, shot or throw lands right on the target.

gloss: (esp. of a mountain range) to be continuous; to stretch long and unbroken
definition: (esp. of a mountain range) to be continuous; to stretch long and unbroken
exampleSimplified: 山脉绵延数百公里,景色非常壮观。
exampleTraditional: 山脈綿延數百公里,景色非常壯觀。
exampleEnglish: The mountain range stretches continuously for hundreds of kilometers, with magnificent scenery.
hintSimplified: 形容山或路一直向远方延伸,没有中断。
hintTraditional: 形容山或路一直向遠方延伸,沒有中斷。
hintEnglish: Describes mountains or roads extending far into the distance without a break.

definition: duty free (shop); not liable to taxation (of monastery, imperial family etc); tax free
exampleSimplified: 机场的免税店常常有很多游客。
exampleTraditional: 機場的免稅店常常有很多遊客。
exampleEnglish: The duty-free shops at the airport are often full of travelers.
hintSimplified: 买东西时不用付某种政府收的钱,机场常见。
hintTraditional: 買東西時不用付某種政府收的錢,機場常見。
hintEnglish: Buying things without paying a certain government charge, common at airports.

exampleSimplified: 打疫苗可以让身体产生免疫力。
exampleTraditional: 打疫苗可以讓身體產生免疫力。
exampleEnglish: Getting vaccinated lets the body develop immunity.
hintSimplified: 身体能抵抗病菌,不容易生病的能力。
hintTraditional: 身體能抵抗病菌,不容易生病的能力。
hintEnglish: The body's ability to resist germs and not easily fall ill.

exampleSimplified: 我觉得这个人的面孔很熟悉。
exampleTraditional: 我覺得這個人的面孔很熟悉。
exampleEnglish: I feel this person's face looks very familiar.
hintSimplified: 人头部前面,有眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴的部分。
hintTraditional: 人頭部前面,有眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴的部分。
hintEnglish: The front of the head, with eyes, nose and mouth.

gloss: to describe; to depict; to portray
definition: to describe; to depict; to portray
exampleSimplified: 这位作家把乡下的生活描绘得非常生动。
exampleTraditional: 這位作家把鄉下的生活描繪得非常生動。
exampleEnglish: This writer portrays country life very vividly.
hintSimplified: 用文字或图画生动地把景象表现出来。
hintTraditional: 用文字或圖畫生動地把景象表現出來。
hintEnglish: To vividly present a scene using words or pictures.

exampleSimplified: 请你描述一下昨天发生的事情。
exampleTraditional: 請你描述一下昨天發生的事情。
exampleEnglish: Please describe what happened yesterday.
hintSimplified: 用话把事情或东西的样子说清楚。
hintTraditional: 用話把事情或東西的樣子說清楚。
hintEnglish: To explain in words how something or someone looks or happened.

exampleSimplified: 这个博物馆展出了许多台湾的民俗文物。
exampleTraditional: 這個博物館展出了許多台灣的民俗文物。
exampleEnglish: This museum exhibits many Taiwanese folk-custom artifacts.
hintSimplified: 一个地方的人民长期流传下来的生活习惯和节日活动。
hintTraditional: 一個地方的人民長期流傳下來的生活習慣和節日活動。
hintEnglish: Long-standing everyday habits and festival activities passed down among a region's people.

gloss: privately run (i.e. by a company, not the state)
definition: privately run (i.e. by a company, not the state)
exampleSimplified: 这家民营医院的服务很周到。
exampleTraditional: 這家民營醫院的服務很周到。
exampleEnglish: This privately run hospital offers very attentive service.
hintSimplified: 由私人或公司经营,不是政府开的。
hintTraditional: 由私人或公司經營,不是政府開的。
hintEnglish: Run by individuals or a company, not opened by the government.

exampleSimplified: 她对花粉很敏感,春天常常打喷嚏。
exampleTraditional: 她對花粉很敏感,春天常常打噴嚏。
exampleEnglish: She is very sensitive to pollen and often sneezes in spring.
hintSimplified: 对很小的变化或刺激,很快就有反应。
hintTraditional: 對很小的變化或刺激,很快就有反應。
hintEnglish: Reacting quickly to even small changes or stimuli.

exampleSimplified: 这只猫的动作非常敏捷。
exampleTraditional: 這隻貓的動作非常敏捷。
exampleEnglish: This cat moves very nimbly.
hintSimplified: 形容动作或思路又快又灵活。
hintTraditional: 形容動作或思路又快又靈活。
hintEnglish: Describes movements or thinking that are quick and agile.

exampleSimplified: 他是大家公认的模范员工。
exampleTraditional: 他是大家公認的模範員工。
exampleEnglish: He is a model employee recognized by everyone.
hintSimplified: 表现很好,值得别人学习的人。
hintTraditional: 表現很好,值得別人學習的人。
hintEnglish: A person who performs so well that others should learn from them.

exampleSimplified: 工厂用这个模具来制造塑胶杯。
exampleTraditional: 工廠用這個模具來製造塑膠杯。
exampleEnglish: The factory uses this mold to make plastic cups.
hintSimplified: 工厂里用来把材料压成固定形状的工具。
hintTraditional: 工廠裡用來把材料壓成固定形狀的工具。
hintEnglish: A factory tool used to shape material into a fixed form.

exampleSimplified: 疫情之后,很多公司改变了工作模式。
exampleTraditional: 疫情之後,很多公司改變了工作模式。
exampleEnglish: After the pandemic, many companies changed their way of working.
hintSimplified: 做事情时固定的方式或标准的样子。
hintTraditional: 做事情時固定的方式或標準的樣子。
hintEnglish: A fixed way of doing things or a standard form.

exampleSimplified: 他在生日派对上表演了一个有趣的魔术。
exampleTraditional: 他在生日派對上表演了一個有趣的魔術。
exampleEnglish: He performed a fun magic trick at the birthday party.
hintSimplified: 表演者让硬币突然消失，观众都觉得很神奇。
hintTraditional: 表演者讓硬幣突然消失，觀眾都覺得很神奇。
hintEnglish: The performer makes a coin suddenly vanish, and the audience finds it amazing.

definition: end (of a period); final phase; last part
exampleSimplified: 这个王朝到了末期，国家变得越来越弱。
exampleTraditional: 這個王朝到了末期，國家變得越來越弱。
exampleEnglish: By the final period of this dynasty, the country grew weaker and weaker.
hintSimplified: 指一个时代或阶段快要结束的那段时间。
hintTraditional: 指一個時代或階段快要結束的那段時間。
hintEnglish: The stretch of time when an era or stage is about to finish.

exampleSimplified: 这个家族在几十年前就已经没落了。
exampleTraditional: 這個家族在幾十年前就已經沒落了。
exampleEnglish: This family fell into decline several decades ago.
hintSimplified: 一个家族或行业从以前很兴盛变得越来越差。
hintTraditional: 一個家族或行業從以前很興盛變得越來越差。
hintEnglish: A family or industry goes from prosperous to steadily worse.

exampleSimplified: 海关把违禁品全部没收了。
exampleTraditional: 海關把違禁品全部沒收了。
exampleEnglish: Customs confiscated all the prohibited items.
hintSimplified: 官员把不合法的东西强制拿走，不还给你。
hintTraditional: 官員把不合法的東西強制拿走，不還給你。
hintEnglish: An official forcibly takes illegal things away and does not give them back.

exampleSimplified: 她默默地为大家做了很多事。
exampleTraditional: 她默默地為大家做了很多事。
exampleEnglish: She quietly did a lot for everyone.
hintSimplified: 形容不说话、不张扬地做事。
hintTraditional: 形容不說話、不張揚地做事。
hintEnglish: Describes doing things without speaking or drawing attention.

definition: (of people) in sync; well coordinated; rapport; tacit understanding; unwritten agreement
exampleSimplified: 他们合作了很多年，非常有默契。
exampleTraditional: 他們合作了很多年，非常有默契。
exampleEnglish: They have worked together for many years and understand each other very well.
hintSimplified: 两个人不用多说，就知道对方想做什么。
hintTraditional: 兩個人不用多說，就知道對方想做什麼。
hintEnglish: Two people know what the other wants to do without saying much.

definition: to ignore; to neglect; to treat with contempt
exampleSimplified: 我们不能漠视环境污染的问题。
exampleTraditional: 我們不能漠視環境汙染的問題。
exampleEnglish: We cannot turn a blind eye to the problem of environmental pollution.
hintSimplified: 对重要的事冷淡，一点也不关心。
hintTraditional: 對重要的事冷淡，一點也不關心。
hintEnglish: To be cold toward something important and not care at all.

definition: to earn a living; to seek one's livelihood; to work to support oneself
exampleSimplified: 他来到大城市，靠打工谋生。
exampleTraditional: 他來到大城市，靠打工謀生。
exampleEnglish: He came to the big city and made a living by doing odd jobs.
hintSimplified: 想办法工作赚钱，让自己能够生活下去。
hintTraditional: 想辦法工作賺錢，讓自己能夠生活下去。
hintEnglish: To find ways to work and earn money so you can survive.

exampleSimplified: 某些人觉得早上喝咖啡比较有精神。
exampleTraditional: 某些人覺得早上喝咖啡比較有精神。
exampleEnglish: Some people feel more alert drinking coffee in the morning.
hintSimplified: 用来指一部分不特别说明的人或事。
hintTraditional: 用來指一部分不特別說明的人或事。
hintEnglish: Used to refer to a certain unspecified portion of people or things.

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂专门生产建筑用的木材。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠專門生產建築用的木材。
exampleEnglish: This factory specializes in producing wood for construction.
hintSimplified: 从树上取得、可以用来盖房子或做家具的材料。
hintTraditional: 從樹上取得、可以用來蓋房子或做傢俱的材料。
hintEnglish: A material from trees used for building houses or making furniture.

exampleSimplified: 这幅木刻作品是一位老艺术家做的。
exampleTraditional: 這幅木刻作品是一位老藝術家做的。
exampleEnglish: This woodcut was made by an old artist.
hintSimplified: 在木板上刻出图案，再印在纸上的艺术。
hintTraditional: 在木板上刻出圖案，再印在紙上的藝術。
hintEnglish: An art of carving a design into a board and then printing it on paper.

exampleSimplified: 他买了一些木料来做书架。
exampleTraditional: 他買了一些木料來做書架。
exampleEnglish: He bought some lumber to make a bookshelf.
hintSimplified: 木工做东西之前准备的木头原料。
hintTraditional: 木工做東西之前準備的木頭原料。
hintEnglish: The raw wood a carpenter prepares before making something.

exampleSimplified: 孩子们很喜欢看木偶表演。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們很喜歡看木偶表演。
exampleEnglish: The children love watching puppet shows.
hintSimplified: 用线或手操作、在舞台上表演的小人偶。
hintTraditional: 用線或手操作、在舞台上表演的小人偶。
hintEnglish: A small figure operated by strings or a hand and performed on stage.

gloss: (fig.) to be bathed in; to be immersed in
definition: (fig.) to be bathed in; to be immersed in; to bathe; to take a bath
exampleSimplified: 孩子们沐浴在温暖的阳光和爱里。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們沐浴在溫暖的陽光和愛裡。
exampleEnglish: The children are bathed in warm sunshine and love.
hintSimplified: 比喻完全处在阳光、爱或幸福之中，像洗澡一样。
hintTraditional: 比喻完全處在陽光、愛或幸福之中，像洗澡一樣。
hintEnglish: Figuratively, to be completely in sunshine, love or happiness, as if washing.

definition: to see at first hand; to see with one's own eyes; to witness
exampleSimplified: 许多路人亲眼目睹了这起意外。
exampleTraditional: 許多路人親眼目睹了這起意外。
exampleEnglish: Many passersby saw the accident with their own eyes.
hintSimplified: 亲自在现场看到某件事发生。
hintTraditional: 親自在現場看到某件事發生。
hintEnglish: To personally be on the scene and see something happen.

definition: (lit. and fig.) sight; vision; expression in one's eyes; look; gaze; (fig.) attention
exampleSimplified: 她用温柔的目光看着自己的孩子。
exampleTraditional: 她用溫柔的目光看著自己的孩子。
exampleEnglish: She looked at her child with a gentle gaze.
hintSimplified: 眼睛看人或看事物时所表现出来的神情。
hintTraditional: 眼睛看人或看事物時所表現出來的神情。
hintEnglish: The expression the eyes show when looking at a person or thing.

gloss: to see with one's own eyes
definition: to see with one's own eyes; to witness
exampleSimplified: 一位目击者向警察说明了当时的情况。
exampleTraditional: 一位目擊者向警察說明了當時的情況。
exampleEnglish: An eyewitness explained to the police what happened at the time.
hintSimplified: 亲眼看见事情发生，常用在事故或案件中。
hintTraditional: 親眼看見事情發生，常用在事故或案件中。
hintEnglish: To see something happen with one's own eyes, often in accidents or cases.

exampleSimplified: 牧场上有很多牛和羊在吃草。
exampleTraditional: 牧場上有很多牛和羊在吃草。
exampleEnglish: There are many cows and sheep eating grass on the ranch.
hintSimplified: 一大片草地，农民在那里养牛羊。
hintTraditional: 一大片草地，農民在那裡養牛羊。
hintEnglish: A large grassy area where farmers raise cattle and sheep.

exampleSimplified: 学校正在募集资金帮助贫困学生。
exampleTraditional: 學校正在募集資金幫助貧困學生。
exampleEnglish: The school is raising funds to help students in need.
hintSimplified: 向很多人请求捐钱或物资，集合起来做好事。
hintTraditional: 向很多人請求捐錢或物資，集合起來做好事。
hintEnglish: To ask many people for money or supplies and gather them for a good cause.

exampleSimplified: 他今天没来上班，大家都觉得很纳闷。
exampleTraditional: 他今天沒來上班，大家都覺得很納悶。
exampleEnglish: He didn't come to work today, and everyone feels puzzled.
hintSimplified: 遇到想不通的事，心里觉得奇怪又疑惑。
hintTraditional: 遇到想不通的事，心裡覺得奇怪又疑惑。
hintEnglish: Feeling odd and doubtful when facing something you can't figure out.

definition: to bring into; to channel into; to incorporate; to integrate into
exampleSimplified: 这项计划已经被纳入明年的预算。
exampleTraditional: 這項計劃已經被納入明年的預算。
exampleEnglish: This plan has been included in next year's budget.
hintSimplified: 把某件事放进一个范围或计划里面。
hintTraditional: 把某件事放進一個範圍或計劃裡面。
hintEnglish: To put something inside a certain scope or plan.

exampleSimplified: 每个公民都有依法纳税的责任。
exampleTraditional: 每個公民都有依法納稅的責任。
exampleEnglish: Every citizen has the duty to pay taxes according to the law.
hintSimplified: 每年要把一部分收入交给政府。
hintTraditional: 每年要把一部分收入交給政府。
hintEnglish: Each year you hand part of your income to the government.

gloss: equivalent to either 是[shi4] or 就是[jiu4 shi4]
definition: equivalent to either 是[shi4] or 就是[jiu4 shi4]
exampleSimplified: 这座古城乃是这个地区最重要的文化中心。
exampleTraditional: 這座古城乃是這個地區最重要的文化中心。
exampleEnglish: This ancient city is the most important cultural center of the region.
hintSimplified: 书面语里用来下判断，作用像“是”，但比较文雅。
hintTraditional: 書面語裡用來下判斷，作用像“是”，但比較文雅。
hintEnglish: In formal writing, used to make a statement of identity, like a more elegant "to be".

exampleSimplified: 跑马拉松需要很好的耐力。
exampleTraditional: 跑馬拉松需要很好的耐力。
exampleEnglish: Running a marathon requires great endurance.
hintSimplified: 长时间做运动或工作也不容易累的能力。
hintTraditional: 長時間做運動或工作也不容易累的能力。
hintEnglish: The ability to keep exercising or working for a long time without tiring.

gloss: (of a marriage) the bridegroom's side; the husband's side
definition: (of a marriage) the bridegroom's side; the husband's side
exampleSimplified: 婚礼上，男方的亲戚都来了。
exampleTraditional: 婚禮上，男方的親戚都來了。
exampleEnglish: At the wedding, the groom's relatives all came.
hintSimplified: 结婚时，指新郎那一边的人或家庭。
hintTraditional: 結婚時，指新郎那一邊的人或家庭。
hintEnglish: At a wedding, the side of the family or people belonging to the groom.

exampleSimplified: 这道题的难度太高了,我不会做。
exampleTraditional: 這道題的難度太高了,我不會做。
exampleEnglish: The difficulty of this question is too high; I can't do it.
hintSimplified: 形容一件事容易还是困难的程度。
hintTraditional: 形容一件事容易還是困難的程度。
hintEnglish: Describes how easy or hard something is.

exampleSimplified: 大家一起努力,终于度过了这个难关。
exampleTraditional: 大家一起努力,終於度過了這個難關。
exampleEnglish: We all worked together and finally got through this critical hardship.
hintSimplified: 生活或工作中很困难、很危险的阶段,必须设法度过。
hintTraditional: 生活或工作中很困難、很危險的階段,必須設法度過。
hintEnglish: A very hard or dangerous stage in life or work that you must find a way to get through.

definition: difficult to escape from; hard to avoid; will inevitably
exampleSimplified: 第一次上台演讲,难免会紧张。
exampleTraditional: 第一次上臺演講,難免會緊張。
exampleEnglish: Giving a speech on stage for the first time, it's hard to avoid feeling nervous.
hintSimplified: 表示某种情况很难避免,常常会发生。
hintTraditional: 表示某種情況很難避免,常常會發生。
hintEnglish: Indicates that a situation is hard to avoid and will often happen.

exampleSimplified: 交通问题是这个城市的一大难题。
exampleTraditional: 交通問題是這個城市的一大難題。
exampleEnglish: Traffic is a major difficult problem for this city.
hintSimplified: 很不容易解决的问题。
hintTraditional: 很不容易解決的問題。
hintEnglish: A problem that is not easy to solve.

exampleSimplified: 战争让很多人变成了难民。
exampleTraditional: 戰爭讓很多人變成了難民。
exampleEnglish: The war turned many people into refugees.
hintSimplified: 因为战争或灾害,被迫离开家乡逃到别处的人。
hintTraditional: 因為戰爭或災害,被迫離開家鄉逃到別處的人。
hintEnglish: People forced to flee their homeland because of war or disaster.

definition: to bring together; to embrace; to include
exampleSimplified: 这部电影囊括了所有重要的大奖。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影囊括了所有重要的大獎。
exampleEnglish: This film swept up all the major awards.
hintSimplified: 把全部的东西都包含或得到,一个也不漏。
hintTraditional: 把全部的東西都包含或得到,一個也不漏。
hintEnglish: To include or win everything, leaving nothing out.

exampleSimplified: 小时候的回忆常常浮现在我的脑海里。
exampleTraditional: 小時候的回憶常常浮現在我的腦海裡。
exampleEnglish: Childhood memories often surface in my mind.
hintSimplified: 想法、回忆出现的地方,在头脑里面。
hintTraditional: 想法、回憶出現的地方,在頭腦裡面。
hintEnglish: The place inside the head where thoughts and memories appear.

exampleSimplified: 做研究工作需要消耗很多脑力。
exampleTraditional: 做研究工作需要消耗很多腦力。
exampleEnglish: Doing research work consumes a lot of mental effort.
hintSimplified: 思考、记忆和解决问题时用到的能力。
hintTraditional: 思考、記憶和解決問題時用到的能力。
hintEnglish: The ability used when thinking, remembering and solving problems.

exampleSimplified: 新的内阁成员昨天正式宣誓就职。
exampleTraditional: 新的內閣成員昨天正式宣誓就職。
exampleEnglish: The new cabinet members were officially sworn in yesterday.
hintSimplified: 由各部门首长组成、帮助国家领导人处理政务的团体。
hintTraditional: 由各部門首長組成、幫助國家領導人處理政務的團體。
hintEnglish: A group of department heads who help the national leader run the government.

definition: (semantics) connotation; implication; inner qualities (of a person); meaningful content
exampleSimplified: 这首诗很有内涵,值得慢慢读。
exampleTraditional: 這首詩很有內涵,值得慢慢讀。
exampleEnglish: This poem has real depth and is worth reading slowly.
hintSimplified: 指一个人或作品表面之下深刻的意义和修养。
hintTraditional: 指一個人或作品表面之下深刻的意義和修養。
hintEnglish: The deep meaning or cultivation beneath the surface of a person or work.

definition: domestic market; to sell in the domestic market
exampleSimplified: 这家工厂的产品主要是内销,很少出口。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠的產品主要是內銷,很少出口。
exampleEnglish: This factory's products are mainly sold domestically and rarely exported.
hintSimplified: 商品在本国的市场上卖,不卖到外国。
hintTraditional: 商品在本國的市場上賣,不賣到外國。
hintEnglish: Goods sold in the home country's market, not abroad.

exampleSimplified: 一个人的内在美比外表更重要。
exampleTraditional: 一個人的內在美比外表更重要。
exampleEnglish: A person's inner beauty is more important than appearance.
hintSimplified: 存在于事物或人本身里面的,不是外表的。
hintTraditional: 存在於事物或人本身裡面的,不是外表的。
hintEnglish: Existing inside a thing or person itself, not on the outside.

exampleSimplified: 这个国家的内战持续了好几年。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家的內戰持續了好幾年。
exampleEnglish: This country's civil war lasted for several years.
hintSimplified: 同一个国家里不同的团体互相打仗。
hintTraditional: 同一個國家裡不同的團體互相打仗。
hintEnglish: Fighting between different groups within the same country.

exampleSimplified: 一个国家的内政应该由自己的人民决定。
exampleTraditional: 一個國家的內政應該由自己的人民決定。
exampleEnglish: A country's internal affairs should be decided by its own people.
hintSimplified: 一个国家自己国内的行政和管理事务。
hintTraditional: 一個國家自己國內的行政和管理事務。
hintEnglish: The administration and management matters inside one's own country.

exampleSimplified: 吃完早餐后,我觉得身体充满了能量。
exampleTraditional: 吃完早餐後,我覺得身體充滿了能量。
exampleEnglish: After eating breakfast, I felt my body full of energy.
hintSimplified: 物理学中使物体运动或做工的力量,也指人的活力。
hintTraditional: 物理學中使物體運動或做工的力量,也指人的活力。
hintEnglish: In physics, what lets things move or do work; also a person's vitality.

definition: to draft; to draw up; to formulate
exampleSimplified: 经理正在拟定明年的工作计划。
exampleTraditional: 經理正在擬定明年的工作計劃。
exampleEnglish: The manager is drafting next year's work plan.
hintSimplified: 先把计划或文件大概写出来,还没有最后决定。
hintTraditional: 先把計劃或檔案大概寫出來,還沒有最後決定。
hintEnglish: To write out a plan or document roughly before it is finalized.

exampleSimplified: 我突然有了一个出国留学的念头。
exampleTraditional: 我突然有了一個出國留學的念頭。
exampleEnglish: I suddenly had the idea of studying abroad.
hintSimplified: 脑子里突然出现的想法或打算。
hintTraditional: 腦子裡突然出現的想法或打算。
hintEnglish: A thought or intention that suddenly appears in your head.

exampleSimplified: 过年时,她带着孩子回娘家吃团圆饭。
exampleTraditional: 過年時,她帶著孩子回娘家吃團圓飯。
exampleEnglish: At New Year, she took her children back to her parents' home for the reunion dinner.
hintSimplified: 已婚女人父母居住的家。
hintTraditional: 已婚女人父母居住的家。
hintEnglish: The home of a married woman's own parents.

definition: fig. with rapt attention; to congeal; to freeze; to solidify
exampleSimplified: 油放在冷的地方很快就凝固了。
exampleTraditional: 油放在冷的地方很快就凝固了。
exampleEnglish: Oil solidifies quickly when left in a cold place.
hintSimplified: 液体变冷后变成硬硬的固体。
hintTraditional: 液體變冷後變成硬硬的固體。
hintEnglish: When a liquid cools and turns into a hard solid.

definition: clot (of blood); to coagulate; to condense; to solidify
exampleSimplified: 冷空气让水气在玻璃上凝结成小水珠。
exampleTraditional: 冷空氣讓水氣在玻璃上凝結成小水珠。
exampleEnglish: The cold air made water vapor condense into small droplets on the glass.
hintSimplified: 气体变成液体,或松散的东西聚成一块。
hintTraditional: 氣體變成液體,或鬆散的東西聚成一塊。
hintEnglish: When gas turns into liquid, or loose matter gathers into a mass.

definition: aggregation; coacervation (i.e. form tiny droplets); coherent; to coagulate; to condense
exampleSimplified: 这次活动凝聚了全班同学的力量。
exampleTraditional: 這次活動凝聚了全班同學的力量。
exampleEnglish: This event brought together the strength of the whole class.
hintSimplified: 把分散的人或力量集合在一起。
hintTraditional: 把分散的人或力量集合在一起。
hintEnglish: To gather scattered people or forces together.

definition: to fix one's eyes on; to gaze at
exampleSimplified: 他静静地凝视着远方的海面。
exampleTraditional: 他靜靜地凝視著遠方的海面。
exampleEnglish: He quietly gazed at the sea surface in the distance.
hintSimplified: 眼睛一动不动、很专心地看着。
hintTraditional: 眼睛一動不動、很專心地看著。
hintEnglish: To look very attentively with eyes fixed and unmoving.

definition: (mechanics) torsion; to reverse; to turn around (an undesirable situation)
exampleSimplified: 新政策希望能扭转经济下滑的局面。
exampleTraditional: 新政策希望能扭轉經濟下滑的局面。
exampleEnglish: The new policy hopes to reverse the economic downturn.
hintSimplified: 把不好的情况改变成好的方向。
hintTraditional: 把不好的情況改變成好的方向。
hintEnglish: To change a bad situation around to a better direction.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷把农具整齐地放在仓库里。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺把農具整齊地放在倉庫裡。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa neatly put the farm tools in the storehouse.
hintSimplified: 种田的人用的锄头、镰刀等工具。
hintTraditional: 種田的人用的鋤頭、鐮刀等工具。
hintEnglish: Tools like hoes and sickles used by people who work the land.

exampleSimplified: 这片农田里种着一大片稻米。
exampleTraditional: 這片農田裡種著一大片稻米。
exampleEnglish: A large patch of rice is planted in this farmland.
hintSimplified: 农民用来种稻米、蔬菜的土地。
hintTraditional: 農民用來種稻米、蔬菜的土地。
hintEnglish: Land that farmers use to grow rice and vegetables.

exampleSimplified: 古代有很多奴隶没有自由。
exampleTraditional: 古代有很多奴隸沒有自由。
exampleEnglish: In ancient times, many slaves had no freedom.
hintSimplified: 在过去，他们被别人拥有，必须无偿工作，没有自由。
hintTraditional: 在過去，他們被別人擁有，必須無償工作，沒有自由。
hintEnglish: In the past, they were owned by others, had to work without pay, and had no freedom.

exampleSimplified: 听了他的话，她满肚子怒气。
exampleTraditional: 聽了他的話，她滿肚子怒氣。
exampleEnglish: After hearing his words, she was full of anger.
hintSimplified: 一个人非常生气时，心里充满的那种情绪。
hintTraditional: 一個人非常生氣時，心裡充滿的那種情緒。
hintEnglish: The feeling that fills a person's heart when they are very upset.

exampleSimplified: 他太懦弱了，不敢说出自己的想法。
exampleTraditional: 他太懦弱了，不敢說出自己的想法。
exampleEnglish: He is too timid and doesn't dare say what he thinks.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人胆子小，遇到困难就退缩，不敢面对。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人膽子小，遇到困難就退縮，不敢面對。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is timid and shrinks back from difficulty, not daring to face it.

exampleSimplified: 他一直记得对妈妈的诺言。
exampleTraditional: 他一直記得對媽媽的諾言。
exampleEnglish: He always remembered the promise he made to his mother.
hintSimplified: 你答应别人一定会做到的话。
hintTraditional: 你答應別人一定會做到的話。
hintEnglish: The words by which you assure someone you will certainly do something.

definition: of the bride's party; the bride's side (of a wedding)
exampleSimplified: 婚礼那天，女方的家人都来了。
exampleTraditional: 婚禮那天，女方的家人都來了。
exampleEnglish: On the wedding day, the bride's family all came.
hintSimplified: 结婚时，和新娘有关的那一边。
hintTraditional: 結婚時，和新娘有關的那一邊。
hintEnglish: At a wedding, the side that is related to the bride.

definition: maltreatment; mistreatment; to abuse; to maltreat; to mistreat
exampleSimplified: 我们不应该虐待小动物。
exampleTraditional: 我們不應該虐待小動物。
exampleEnglish: We should not mistreat small animals.
hintSimplified: 用残忍的方式对待人或动物，让他们受苦。
hintTraditional: 用殘忍的方式對待人或動物，讓他們受苦。
hintEnglish: Treating people or animals cruelly so that they suffer.

gloss: to take (a picture); to shoot (a film)
definition: to take (a picture); to shoot (a film)
exampleSimplified: 这部电影是在台湾拍摄的。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影是在台灣拍攝的。
exampleEnglish: This movie was filmed in Taiwan.
hintSimplified: 用相机或摄影机把画面记录下来。
hintTraditional: 用相機或攝影機把畫面記錄下來。
hintEnglish: Recording images with a camera or film camera.

exampleSimplified: 他跟不上音乐的拍子。
exampleTraditional: 他跟不上音樂的拍子。
exampleEnglish: He can't keep up with the beat of the music.
hintSimplified: 音乐里规律出现的强弱节奏，跳舞时要跟着它。
hintTraditional: 音樂裡規律出現的強弱節奏，跳舞時要跟著它。
hintEnglish: The regular rhythm in music that you follow when dancing.

definition: to eliminate; to exclude; to remove; to rule out
exampleSimplified: 警方已经排除了他杀的可能。
exampleTraditional: 警方已經排除了他殺的可能。
exampleEnglish: The police have ruled out the possibility of homicide.
hintSimplified: 把不可能或不需要的东西去掉，不再考虑。
hintTraditional: 把不可能或不需要的東西去掉，不再考慮。
hintEnglish: Taking away what is impossible or unneeded so it is no longer considered.

definition: to crowd out; to push aside; to supplant
exampleSimplified: 新来的同事常常被大家排挤。
exampleTraditional: 新來的同事常常被大家排擠。
exampleEnglish: The new colleague is often shunned by everyone.
hintSimplified: 大家用不友善的方式让某个人没有位置、不被接受。
hintTraditional: 大家用不友善的方式讓某個人沒有位置、不被接受。
hintEnglish: Everyone unkindly makes a person feel unwelcome and left out.

exampleSimplified: 这所大学的排名每年都在上升。
exampleTraditional: 這所大學的排名每年都在上升。
exampleEnglish: This university's ranking rises every year.
hintSimplified: 比赛或比较之后，按好坏排出来的名次。
hintTraditional: 比賽或比較之後，按好壞排出來的名次。
hintEnglish: The position given after a competition or comparison, in order of quality.

gloss: to send (on a mission); to dispatch
definition: to send (on a mission); to dispatch
exampleSimplified: 公司派遣他去国外工作。
exampleTraditional: 公司派遣他去國外工作。
exampleEnglish: The company sent him to work abroad.
hintSimplified: 上级安排人到别的地方去完成任务。
hintTraditional: 上級安排人到別的地方去完成任務。
hintEnglish: A superior arranges for someone to go elsewhere to carry out a task.

exampleSimplified: 他穿着西装，很有派头。
exampleTraditional: 他穿著西裝，很有派頭。
exampleEnglish: He wears a suit and has an impressive air about him.
hintSimplified: 一个人表现出来的气势和讲究，让人觉得很有身份。
hintTraditional: 一個人表現出來的氣勢和講究，讓人覺得很有身份。
hintEnglish: The stylish bearing a person shows that makes them seem important.

exampleSimplified: 别在意旁人怎么看你。
exampleTraditional: 別在意旁人怎麼看你。
exampleEnglish: Don't care how other people see you.
hintSimplified: 不是你自己，也不是你的家人，而是在旁边的别人。
hintTraditional: 不是你自己，也不是你的家人，而是在旁邊的別人。
hintEnglish: Not you or your family, but other people who are around.

definition: to audit (a class); to be present at a meeting as an observer; to sit in on (proceedings)
exampleSimplified: 我想去旁听王教授的课。
exampleTraditional: 我想去旁聽王教授的課。
exampleEnglish: I want to sit in on Professor Wang's class.
hintSimplified: 没有正式选课，只是坐在教室里听课。
hintTraditional: 沒有正式選課，只是坐在教室裡聽課。
hintEnglish: Sitting in a classroom to listen without being formally enrolled.

definition: to abandon; to discard; to dump (sb); to renounce
exampleSimplified: 他不会抛弃自己的朋友。
exampleTraditional: 他不會拋棄自己的朋友。
exampleEnglish: He will not abandon his friends.
hintSimplified: 不再照顾或不再要，把人或东西丢下不管。
hintTraditional: 不再照顧或不再要，把人或東西丟下不管。
hintEnglish: To leave a person or thing behind and no longer care for it.

exampleSimplified: 学生们在操场的跑道上练习跑步。
exampleTraditional: 學生們在操場的跑道上練習跑步。
exampleEnglish: The students practice running on the track of the sports field.
hintSimplified: 操场上画着线、让人比赛跑步的路。
hintTraditional: 操場上畫著線、讓人比賽跑步的路。
hintEnglish: The marked lanes on a sports field where people run in races.

exampleSimplified: 房价的泡沫终于破了。
exampleTraditional: 房價的泡沫終於破了。
exampleEnglish: The bubble in housing prices finally burst.
hintSimplified: 洗澡或洗碗时会出现的小白球；也比喻价格虚高、不真实的现象。
hintTraditional: 洗澡或洗碗時會出現的小白球；也比喻價格虛高、不真實的現象。
hintEnglish: Small white balls seen while washing; also a metaphor for unreal, inflated prices.

exampleSimplified: 谢谢你一直陪伴我度过难关。
exampleTraditional: 謝謝你一直陪伴我度過難關。
exampleEnglish: Thank you for always being by my side through hard times.
hintSimplified: 和某人在一起，给他温暖和支持。
hintTraditional: 和某人在一起，給他溫暖和支援。
hintEnglish: Being together with someone, giving them warmth and support.

definition: to cultivate; to groom; to train; training
exampleSimplified: 新员工要参加一星期的培训。
exampleTraditional: 新員工要參加一星期的培訓。
exampleEnglish: New employees must attend a week of training.
hintSimplified: 公司或机构安排的课程，让人学会工作需要的技能。
hintTraditional: 公司或機構安排的課程，讓人學會工作需要的技能。
hintEnglish: Courses arranged by a company so people learn the skills needed for work.

exampleSimplified: 农民努力培育新的稻米品种。
exampleTraditional: 農民努力培育新的稻米品種。
exampleEnglish: Farmers work hard to cultivate new varieties of rice.
hintSimplified: 用心照顾植物、动物或人才，让他们慢慢长大。
hintTraditional: 用心照顧植物、動物或人才，讓他們慢慢長大。
hintEnglish: Carefully tending plants, animals or talent so they slowly grow.

exampleSimplified: 战争期间，政府对粮食实行配给。
exampleTraditional: 戰爭期間，政府對糧食實行配給。
exampleEnglish: During the war, the government rationed food.
hintSimplified: 东西不够时，政府按人数规定每人能分到的量。
hintTraditional: 東西不夠時，政府按人數規定每人能分到的量。
hintEnglish: When goods are scarce, the government sets the amount each person receives.

exampleSimplified: 这部动画片的中文配音很好听。
exampleTraditional: 這部動畫片的中文配音很好聽。
exampleEnglish: The Chinese dubbing of this cartoon sounds great.
hintSimplified: 在电影或动画里，用另一种声音或语言为角色说话。
hintTraditional: 在電影或動畫裡，用另一種聲音或語言為角色說話。
hintEnglish: Speaking for characters in a film or cartoon with another voice or language.

definition: lacquer; to spray paint or lacquer
exampleSimplified: 师傅正在给车门喷漆。
exampleTraditional: 師傅正在給車門噴漆。
exampleEnglish: The mechanic is spray-painting the car door.
hintSimplified: 用喷枪把颜色均匀地涂在车或家具表面。
hintTraditional: 用噴槍把顏色均勻地塗在車或傢俱表面。
hintEnglish: Using a spray gun to evenly apply color to a car or furniture surface.

exampleSimplified: 台北位于一个盆地里。
exampleTraditional: 台北位於一個盆地裡。
exampleEnglish: Taipei is located in a basin.
hintSimplified: 四周有山、中间地势低而平的地形。
hintTraditional: 四周有山、中間地勢低而平的地形。
hintEnglish: A landform with mountains around and low, flat land in the middle.

exampleSimplified: 这个城市的经济发展得很蓬勃。
exampleTraditional: 這個城市的經濟發展得很蓬勃。
exampleEnglish: This city's economy is developing very vigorously.
hintSimplified: 形容事业或产业充满活力、快速成长的样子。
hintTraditional: 形容事業或產業充滿活力、快速成長的樣子。
hintEnglish: Describes a business or industry full of energy and growing fast.

gloss: to patronize a restaurant or store
definition: to patronize a restaurant or store; to show one's support for a performer or theatrical troupe etc by attending their show; to attend an event to cheer on the participants; to sing the praises of
exampleSimplified: 朋友的小店开张了,我们都去捧场。
exampleTraditional: 朋友的小店開張了,我們都去捧場。
exampleEnglish: My friend's little shop opened, and we all went to show our support.
hintSimplified: 朋友开店或表演时,你特地去光顾、支持他。
hintTraditional: 朋友開店或表演時,你特地去光顧、支援他。
hintEnglish: When a friend opens a shop or performs, you make a point of going to support them.

exampleSimplified: 这家店的水果批发价格很便宜。
exampleTraditional: 這家店的水果批發價格很便宜。
exampleEnglish: This shop's wholesale fruit prices are very cheap.
hintSimplified: 一次大量买卖货物,价格通常比零售便宜。
hintTraditional: 一次大量買賣貨物,價格通常比零售便宜。
hintEnglish: Buying or selling goods in large quantities, usually cheaper than retail.

exampleSimplified: 经理已经批准了我的休假申请。
exampleTraditional: 經理已經批准了我的休假申請。
exampleEnglish: The manager has already approved my leave request.
hintSimplified: 上级同意你的申请或计划。
hintTraditional: 上級同意你的申請或計劃。
hintEnglish: A superior agrees to your application or plan.

exampleSimplified: 连续加班一个星期,他看起来非常疲惫。
exampleTraditional: 連續加班一個星期,他看起來非常疲憊。
exampleEnglish: After working overtime for a week straight, he looks utterly exhausted.
hintSimplified: 身体和精神都非常累,没有力气。
hintTraditional: 身體和精神都非常累,沒有力氣。
hintEnglish: Both body and mind are very tired, with no energy left.

gloss: for example; for instance; such as
definition: for example; for instance; such as
exampleSimplified: 我喜欢运动,譬如游泳、跑步和打篮球。
exampleTraditional: 我喜歡運動,譬如游泳、跑步和打籃球。
exampleEnglish: I like sports, for example swimming, running and playing basketball.
hintSimplified: 用在句中,后面接着举出例子来说明。
hintTraditional: 用在句中,後面接著舉出例子來說明。
hintEnglish: Used in a sentence to introduce an example that illustrates a point.

exampleSimplified: 调查结果和实际情况有一些偏差。
exampleTraditional: 調查結果和實際情況有一些偏差。
exampleEnglish: The survey results deviate somewhat from the actual situation.
hintSimplified: 结果和标准或事实之间有不准确、不一致的地方。
hintTraditional: 結果和標準或事實之間有不準確、不一致的地方。
hintEnglish: A discrepancy between a result and the standard or the facts.

definition: a moment; short period of time
exampleSimplified: 请等我片刻,我马上回来。
exampleTraditional: 請等我片刻,我馬上回來。
exampleEnglish: Please wait a moment for me, I'll be right back.
hintSimplified: 非常短的一段时间。
hintTraditional: 非常短的一段時間。
hintEnglish: A very short stretch of time.

exampleSimplified: 他从小生活贫苦,所以特别努力读书。
exampleTraditional: 他從小生活貧苦,所以特別努力讀書。
exampleEnglish: He grew up in poverty, so he studied especially hard.
hintSimplified: 形容生活没有钱,过得很辛苦。
hintTraditional: 形容生活沒有錢,過得很辛苦。
hintEnglish: Describes a life without money and full of hardship.

exampleSimplified: 这个组织经常帮助城市里的贫民。
exampleTraditional: 這個組織經常幫助城市裡的貧民。
exampleEnglish: This organization often helps the poor people in the city.
hintSimplified: 指生活没有钱、需要别人帮助的一群人。
hintTraditional: 指生活沒有錢、需要別人幫助的一群人。
hintEnglish: People who have little money and need others' help.

gloss: one's taste (i.e. in music, literature, fashion, food and drink etc); good taste
definition: one's taste (i.e. in music, literature, fashion, food and drink etc); good taste; to appreciate; to sample; to taste
exampleSimplified: 她的穿衣品味很特别,大家都很欣赏。
exampleTraditional: 她的穿衣品味很特別,大家都很欣賞。
exampleEnglish: Her taste in clothes is very distinctive, and everyone admires it.
hintSimplified: 一个人对美、音乐或食物的欣赏眼光和喜好。
hintTraditional: 一個人對美、音樂或食物的欣賞眼光和喜好。
hintEnglish: A person's eye and preferences for beauty, music or food.

exampleSimplified: 这个农场种了很多不同品种的苹果。
exampleTraditional: 這個農場種了很多不同品種的蘋果。
exampleEnglish: This farm grows many different varieties of apples.
hintSimplified: 同一类东西里,不同的种类。
hintTraditional: 同一類東西里,不同的種類。
hintEnglish: The different kinds within the same category of things.

exampleSimplified: 他只是一个平凡的上班族,过着简单的生活。
exampleTraditional: 他只是一個平凡的上班族,過著簡單的生活。
exampleEnglish: He is just an ordinary office worker living a simple life.
hintSimplified: 形容普通、没有什么特别的地方。
hintTraditional: 形容普通、沒有什麼特別的地方。
hintEnglish: Describes something ordinary with nothing special about it.

exampleSimplified: 老师在黑板上画了一个平面图形。
exampleTraditional: 老師在黑板上畫了一個平面圖形。
exampleEnglish: The teacher drew a plane figure on the blackboard.
hintSimplified: 数学里只有长和宽、没有厚度的面。
hintTraditional: 數學裡只有長和寬、沒有厚度的面。
hintEnglish: In math, a surface with length and width but no thickness.

exampleSimplified: 飞机飞得很平稳,乘客们都睡着了。
exampleTraditional: 飛機飛得很平穩,乘客們都睡著了。
exampleEnglish: The plane flew very smoothly, and the passengers all fell asleep.
hintSimplified: 形容没有大的晃动或变化,很稳定。
hintTraditional: 形容沒有大的晃動或變化,很穩定。
hintEnglish: Describes something steady, without big shaking or change.

gloss: on an equal footing; on the same level
definition: on an equal footing; on the same level; parallel (in a spatial or geometric sense, or figuratively); simultaneous; concurrent
exampleSimplified: 这两条马路平行,永远不会相交。
exampleTraditional: 這兩條馬路平行,永遠不會相交。
exampleEnglish: These two roads are parallel and will never meet.
hintSimplified: 两条线并排向前,距离不变,永远不会碰到。
hintTraditional: 兩條線並排向前,距離不變,永遠不會碰到。
hintEnglish: Two lines run side by side at a constant distance and never touch.

definition: assessment; evaluation; to assess; to evaluate
exampleSimplified: 公司请专家来评估这个计划的风险。
exampleTraditional: 公司請專家來評估這個計劃的風險。
exampleEnglish: The company invited experts to assess the risks of this plan.
hintSimplified: 对价值、能力或风险做出初步的判断和估计。
hintTraditional: 對價值、能力或風險做出初步的判斷和估計。
hintEnglish: To make a judgment and estimate of value, ability or risk.

exampleSimplified: 大家对这部电影的评价都很高。
exampleTraditional: 大家對這部電影的評價都很高。
exampleEnglish: Everyone gives this movie a very high rating.
hintSimplified: 说出你认为一个人或一件事好不好。
hintTraditional: 說出你認為一個人或一件事好不好。
hintEnglish: Saying whether you think a person or thing is good or not.

definition: CL:篇[pian1]; comment; commentary; to comment on; to discuss
exampleSimplified: 报纸上有一篇关于这件事的评论。
exampleTraditional: 報紙上有一篇關於這件事的評論。
exampleEnglish: There is a commentary about this matter in the newspaper.
hintSimplified: 对事情或作品发表的看法文章,常出现在报纸或网络上。
hintTraditional: 對事情或作品發表的看法文章,常出現在報紙或網路上。
hintEnglish: An article giving opinions about an event or work, often in newspapers or online.

gloss: husband's family (traditionally where the wife moves into)
definition: husband's family (traditionally where the wife moves into)
exampleSimplified: 过年的时候,她先回婆家吃团圆饭。
exampleTraditional: 過年的時候,她先回婆家吃團圓飯。
exampleEnglish: At New Year, she first goes to her husband's family home for the reunion dinner.
hintSimplified: 已婚女人称丈夫的父母和家人所住的家。
hintTraditional: 已婚女人稱丈夫的父母和家人所住的家。
hintEnglish: What a married woman calls the home of her husband's parents and family.

exampleSimplified: 警察花了三天时间才破案。
exampleTraditional: 警察花了三天時間才破案。
exampleEnglish: The police took three days to solve the case.
hintSimplified: 警察找出犯人,让案件有了结果。
hintTraditional: 警察找出犯人,讓案件有了結果。
hintEnglish: The police find the culprit and bring a case to a resolution.

definition: bankruptcy; to become impoverished; to go bankrupt
exampleSimplified: 因为经营不好,这家公司去年破产了。
exampleTraditional: 因為經營不好,這家公司去年破產了。
exampleEnglish: Because of poor management, this company went bankrupt last year.
hintSimplified: 公司或个人没有钱还债,事业只好结束。
hintTraditional: 公司或個人沒有錢還債,事業只好結束。
hintEnglish: A company or person cannot pay debts and the business has to end.

definition: to do away with; to eliminate; to get rid of
exampleSimplified: 我们应该破除旧的观念,接受新想法。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該破除舊的觀念,接受新想法。
exampleEnglish: We should do away with old ideas and accept new ones.
hintSimplified: 把旧的习惯、迷信或观念去掉。
hintTraditional: 把舊的習慣、迷信或觀念去掉。
hintEnglish: To get rid of old habits, superstitions or ideas.

definition: to break open and capture; to uncover (a criminal plot)
exampleSimplified: 警方破获了一起大型诈骗案。
exampleTraditional: 警方破獲了一起大型詐騙案。
exampleEnglish: The police cracked a major fraud case.
hintSimplified: 警察侦查成功,抓到犯人或找到证据。
hintTraditional: 警察偵查成功,抓到犯人或找到證據。
hintEnglish: The police investigate successfully and catch the culprits or find evidence.

exampleSimplified: 老师今天破例让我们提早下课。
exampleTraditional: 老師今天破例讓我們提早下課。
exampleEnglish: Today the teacher made an exception and let us out of class early.
hintSimplified: 不照平常的规定做,这一次特别允许。
hintTraditional: 不照平常的規定做,這一次特別允許。
hintEnglish: Not following the usual rule, specially allowing it just this once.

definition: to shatter; to smash to pieces
exampleSimplified: 杯子掉在地上,摔得破碎了。
exampleTraditional: 杯子掉在地上,摔得破碎了。
exampleEnglish: The cup fell on the floor and shattered.
hintSimplified: 玻璃掉在地上以后,变成很多小块。
hintTraditional: 玻璃掉在地上以後,變成很多小塊。
hintEnglish: After glass falls on the floor, it turns into many small pieces.

exampleSimplified: 他在那个国家受到了很多迫害。
exampleTraditional: 他在那個國家受到了很多迫害。
exampleEnglish: He suffered a lot of persecution in that country.
hintSimplified: 用不公平、残酷的方式长期伤害某些人。
hintTraditional: 用不公平、殘酷的方式長期傷害某些人。
hintEnglish: To harm certain people over a long time in an unfair, cruel way.

exampleSimplified: 这位经理做事很有魄力,不怕困难。
exampleTraditional: 這位經理做事很有魄力,不怕困難。
exampleEnglish: This manager is very bold and decisive and isn't afraid of difficulties.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人做决定时勇敢、果断、有胆量的特质。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人做決定時勇敢、果斷、有膽量的特質。
hintEnglish: A quality of someone who decides things with courage and decisiveness.

definition: not frivolous; plain and simple; simple living; unadorned
exampleSimplified: 她的穿着很朴素,可是很大方。
exampleTraditional: 她的穿著很樸素,可是很大方。
exampleEnglish: She dresses simply, but with elegance.
hintSimplified: 形容东西或生活简单,不华丽,也不太花钱。
hintTraditional: 形容東西或生活簡單,不華麗,也不太花錢。
hintEnglish: Describes things or a lifestyle that is plain, not fancy, and not costly.

definition: (advertising) exposure; (fig.) to expose (a scandal); Taiwan pr. [pu4 guang1]; to expose (photography)
exampleSimplified: 这张照片曝光过度,看起来太白了。
exampleTraditional: 這張照片曝光過度,看起來太白了。
exampleEnglish: This photo is overexposed and looks too white.
hintSimplified: 照相时光线进入相机太多或太少;也指让事情被大家知道。
hintTraditional: 照相時光線進入相機太多或太少;也指讓事情被大家知道。
hintEnglish: In photography, light entering the camera; also, making something known to the public.

definition: also pr. [pu4 lu4]; to expose; to lay bare; to reveal
exampleSimplified: 他的秘密终于暴露了。
exampleTraditional: 他的秘密終於暴露了。
exampleEnglish: His secret was finally exposed.
hintSimplified: 本来藏起来的东西被别人看见或发现。
hintTraditional: 本來藏起來的東西被別人看見或發現。
hintEnglish: Something that was hidden becomes visible or discovered by others.

exampleSimplified: 冬天的夜晚,街上空无一人,显得很凄凉。
exampleTraditional: 冬天的夜晚,街上空無一人,顯得很淒涼。
exampleEnglish: On a winter night the street is empty and looks desolate.
hintSimplified: 形容地方冷清或心情孤单、难过的样子。
hintTraditional: 形容地方冷清或心情孤單、難過的樣子。
hintEnglish: Describes a lonely, cheerless place or a sad, solitary mood.

exampleSimplified: 不可以欺侮比你弱小的同学。
exampleTraditional: 不可以欺侮比你弱小的同學。
exampleEnglish: You must not bully classmates who are weaker than you.
hintSimplified: 仗着自己比较强,对别人不好,让人难过。
hintTraditional: 仗著自己比較強,對別人不好,讓人難過。
hintEnglish: Relying on being stronger to treat others badly and make them miserable.

exampleSimplified: 大峡谷的景色真是自然界的奇观。
exampleTraditional: 大峽谷的景色真是自然界的奇觀。
exampleEnglish: The scenery of the Grand Canyon is truly a wonder of nature.
hintSimplified: 非常特别、少见又让人惊讶的美丽景象。
hintTraditional: 非常特別、少見又讓人驚訝的美麗景象。
hintEnglish: A very special, rare and astonishing sight.

definition: miracle; wonder; marvel; variant of 奇蹟|奇迹[qi2 ji4]
exampleSimplified: 他从大病中恢复,医生说这是一个奇迹。
exampleTraditional: 他從大病中恢復,醫生說這是一個奇蹟。
exampleEnglish: He recovered from a serious illness; the doctor said it was a miracle.
hintSimplified: 一件本来不可能发生,却真的发生的好事。
hintTraditional: 一件本來不可能發生,卻真的發生的好事。
hintEnglish: A good thing that seemed impossible but really happened.

exampleSimplified: 这个故事的情节非常奇妙,让人想一直看下去。
exampleTraditional: 這個故事的情節非常奇妙,讓人想一直看下去。
exampleEnglish: The plot of this story is wonderfully intriguing and makes you want to keep reading.
hintSimplified: 形容事情很特别、有趣,让人觉得不可思议。
hintTraditional: 形容事情很特別、有趣,讓人覺得不可思議。
hintEnglish: Describes something special and interesting that feels almost unbelievable.

exampleSimplified: 森林里有许多奇异的花草。
exampleTraditional: 森林裡有許多奇異的花草。
exampleEnglish: There are many strange and exotic plants in the forest.
hintSimplified: 形容和平常很不一样,让人觉得奇怪的样子。
hintTraditional: 形容和平常很不一樣,讓人覺得奇怪的樣子。
hintEnglish: Describes something very different from usual, which seems odd.

gloss: abbr. for 期貨合約|期货合约[qi1 huo4 he2 yue1], futures contract (finance)
definition: abbr. for 期貨合約|期货合约[qi1 huo4 he2 yue1], futures contract (finance)
exampleSimplified: 他在银行工作,专门做期货交易。
exampleTraditional: 他在銀行工作,專門做期貨交易。
exampleEnglish: He works at a bank and specializes in futures trading.
hintSimplified: 一种金融商品,先约定价格,以后才交货或结算。
hintTraditional: 一種金融商品,先約定價格,以後才交貨或結算。
hintEnglish: A financial product where the price is agreed now and delivery or settlement happens later.

exampleSimplified: 操场上升起了一面鲜红的旗帜。
exampleTraditional: 操場上升起了一面鮮紅的旗幟。
exampleEnglish: A bright red flag was raised on the playground.
hintSimplified: 挂在杆子上、代表国家或团体的布;也比喻目标或榜样。
hintTraditional: 掛在杆子上、代表國家或團體的布;也比喻目標或榜樣。
hintEnglish: Cloth on a pole representing a country or group; also figuratively a goal or model.

exampleSimplified: 路边有一个乞丐在向路人要钱。
exampleTraditional: 路邊有一個乞丐在向路人要錢。
exampleEnglish: A beggar by the road is asking passersby for money.
hintSimplified: 没有钱也没有家,在路上向别人要钱或食物的人。
hintTraditional: 沒有錢也沒有家,在路上向別人要錢或食物的人。
hintEnglish: A person with no money or home who asks others on the street for money or food.

definition: enlightenment; motivation; revelation; to enlighten; to explain (a text etc); to stimulate (a mental attitude)
exampleSimplified: 老师的一句话给了我很大的启发。
exampleTraditional: 老師的一句話給了我很大的啟發。
exampleEnglish: The teacher's single remark gave me great inspiration.
hintSimplified: 听到或看到某些事,让你突然想到新的方法或道理。
hintTraditional: 聽到或看到某些事,讓你突然想到新的方法或道理。
hintEnglish: Hearing or seeing something that suddenly gives you a new idea or insight.

definition: enlightenment; illumination; lesson; moral (of a story etc); revelation; to enlighten; to reveal
exampleSimplified: 这次失败给我们带来了很重要的启示。
exampleTraditional: 這次失敗給我們帶來了很重要的啟示。
exampleEnglish: This failure gave us an important lesson.
hintSimplified: 从一件事情中得到的重要道理,让人明白该怎么做。
hintTraditional: 從一件事情中得到的重要道理,讓人明白該怎麼做。
hintEnglish: An important lesson drawn from an event that shows you what to do.

definition: a notice; announcement (written, on billboard, letter, newspaper or website); to post information
exampleSimplified: 他在报纸上登了一则寻狗启事。
exampleTraditional: 他在報紙上登了一則尋狗啟事。
exampleEnglish: He placed a notice in the newspaper looking for his lost dog.
hintSimplified: 贴在墙上或登在报上,公开说明一件事或找人找东西的短文。
hintTraditional: 貼在牆上或登在報上,公開說明一件事或找人找東西的短文。
hintEnglish: A short text posted on a wall or in a newspaper to announce something or look for someone or something.

definition: the start (of some activity); to set in motion; to set out
exampleSimplified: 这家公司起步很晚,但是发展得很快。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司起步很晚,但是發展得很快。
exampleEnglish: This company got started late, but it has grown quickly.
hintSimplified: 一件事业或计划刚开始的阶段。
hintTraditional: 一件事業或計劃剛開始的階段。
hintEnglish: The initial stage when a business or plan has just begun.

definition: to move up and down; to undulate; ups and downs
exampleSimplified: 远处的山峦起伏,景色很美。
exampleTraditional: 遠處的山巒起伏,景色很美。
exampleEnglish: The hills in the distance rise and fall, and the scenery is beautiful.
hintSimplified: 一高一低,不断变化,像海浪或山一样。
hintTraditional: 一高一低,不斷變化,像海浪或山一樣。
hintEnglish: Going high and low repeatedly, like waves or mountains.

gloss: at the minimum; at the very least
definition: at the minimum; at the very least
exampleSimplified: 你起码要先把作业写完才能出去玩。
exampleTraditional: 你起碼要先把作業寫完才能出去玩。
exampleEnglish: You must at least finish your homework before you can go out and play.
hintSimplified: 表示最低的要求或数量,「至少」的意思。
hintTraditional: 表示最低的要求或數量,「至少」的意思。
hintEnglish: Indicates the lowest requirement or amount, meaning 'at the least'.

definition: origin; to come from; to originate
exampleSimplified: 这个节日的起源可以追溯到两千年前。
exampleTraditional: 這個節日的起源可以追溯到兩千年前。
exampleEnglish: The origin of this festival can be traced back two thousand years.
hintSimplified: 一件事物最早开始出现的地方或原因。
hintTraditional: 一件事物最早開始出現的地方或原因。
hintEnglish: The place or cause where something first began.

exampleSimplified: 这位英雄面对困难时表现出大无畏的气概。
exampleTraditional: 這位英雄面對困難時表現出大無畏的氣概。
exampleEnglish: The hero showed a fearless spirit when facing difficulties.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人面对困难时表现出的勇敢、大方的精神。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人面對困難時表現出的勇敢、大方的精神。
hintEnglish: Describes the brave and magnanimous spirit a person shows when facing hardship.

definition: air duct; gas pipe; respiratory tract; trachea; windpipe
exampleSimplified: 食物不小心进了气管,他咳个不停。
exampleTraditional: 食物不小心進了氣管,他咳個不停。
exampleEnglish: Food accidentally went into his windpipe and he couldn't stop coughing.
hintSimplified: 身体里让空气从喉咙进入肺的管子。
hintTraditional: 身體裡讓空氣從喉嚨進入肺的管子。
hintEnglish: The tube in the body that lets air go from the throat into the lungs.

definition: dignified air; imposing manner; impressive; magnificent; stylish
exampleSimplified: 这家饭店的大门非常气派。
exampleTraditional: 這家飯店的大門非常氣派。
exampleEnglish: The entrance of this hotel is very grand.
hintSimplified: 形容建筑或场面很大、很豪华,让人觉得有面子。
hintTraditional: 形容建築或場面很大、很豪華,讓人覺得有面子。
hintEnglish: Describes a building or occasion that is large and luxurious, and impressive.

definition: energetic looks; grandeur; imposing manner; loftiness; vigor
exampleSimplified: 这座山看起来非常有气势。
exampleTraditional: 這座山看起來非常有氣勢。
exampleEnglish: This mountain looks very imposing.
hintSimplified: 形容人或建筑给人强大、雄伟、让人敬畏的感觉。
hintTraditional: 形容人或建築給人強大、雄偉、讓人敬畏的感覺。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or building that gives a powerful, majestic, awe-inspiring impression.

exampleSimplified: 这种气体闻起来很臭,请不要吸入。
exampleTraditional: 這種氣體聞起來很臭,請不要吸入。
exampleEnglish: This gas smells awful; please don't breathe it in.
hintSimplified: 物质的一种状态,不是固体也不是液体,看不见却会流动。
hintTraditional: 物質的一種狀態,不是固體也不是液體,看不見卻會流動。
hintEnglish: A state of matter that is neither solid nor liquid, often invisible and able to flow.

exampleSimplified: 山上的气压比平地低很多。
exampleTraditional: 山上的氣壓比平地低很多。
exampleEnglish: The air pressure on the mountain is much lower than on flat land.
hintSimplified: 天气预报常提到,指空气对地面产生的压力。
hintTraditional: 天氣預報常提到,指空氣對地面產生的壓力。
hintEnglish: Often mentioned in weather forecasts; the force the air exerts on the ground.

exampleSimplified: 这次失败成了他改变人生的契机。
exampleTraditional: 這次失敗成了他改變人生的契機。
exampleEnglish: This failure became the turning point that changed his life.
hintSimplified: 让事情出现转变或新发展的关键机会。
hintTraditional: 讓事情出現轉變或新發展的關鍵機會。
hintEnglish: A key opportunity that makes things change or develop in a new direction.

gloss: (sports) to forfeit (a game); to voluntarily withdraw from a match
definition: (sports) to forfeit (a game); to voluntarily withdraw from a match; to abstain (from voting); to waive a right
exampleSimplified: 因为受伤,他决定在比赛中弃权。
exampleTraditional: 因為受傷,他決定在比賽中棄權。
exampleEnglish: Because of his injury, he decided to withdraw from the match.
hintSimplified: 投票或比赛时,自己决定不参加或不行使决定的权利。
hintTraditional: 投票或比賽時,自己決定不參加或不行使決定的權利。
hintEnglish: In a vote or contest, choosing not to take part or not to use one's right.

exampleSimplified: 你这样说话不太恰当。
exampleTraditional: 你這樣說話不太恰當。
exampleEnglish: It's not quite appropriate for you to speak like that.
hintSimplified: 形容说法或做法很合适,不过分也不不足。
hintTraditional: 形容說法或做法很合適,不過分也不不足。
hintEnglish: Describes words or actions that fit well, neither too much nor too little.

gloss: (of number, time, size etc) just right
definition: (of number, time, size etc) just right; as it turns out; by lucky coincidence
exampleSimplified: 我到车站时,恰好赶上最后一班车。
exampleTraditional: 我到車站時,恰好趕上最後一班車。
exampleEnglish: When I reached the station, I just caught the last bus.
hintSimplified: 表示时间、数量或情况刚刚合适,有点巧合。
hintTraditional: 表示時間、數量或情況剛剛合適,有點巧合。
hintEnglish: Indicates that timing, amount or situation fits exactly, a bit by coincidence.

exampleSimplified: 他们在晚会上跳了一支恰恰。
exampleTraditional: 他們在晚會上跳了一支恰恰。
exampleEnglish: They danced a cha-cha at the party.
hintSimplified: 一种节奏明快、来自拉丁美洲的交际舞。
hintTraditional: 一種節奏明快、來自拉丁美洲的交際舞。
hintEnglish: A lively social dance with a catchy rhythm from Latin America.

exampleSimplified: 两家公司的代表正在洽商合作的细节。
exampleTraditional: 兩家公司的代表正在洽商合作的細節。
exampleEnglish: Representatives of the two companies are negotiating the details of cooperation.
hintSimplified: 商人之间为了生意或合作而互相讨论条件。
hintTraditional: 商人之間為了生意或合作而互相討論條件。
hintEnglish: When business people discuss terms for a deal or partnership.

exampleSimplified: 经理下午要和客户洽谈新的合约。
exampleTraditional: 經理下午要和客戶洽談新的合約。
exampleEnglish: The manager will discuss a new contract with the client this afternoon.
hintSimplified: 双方为了合作或买卖而正式地交谈、商量。
hintTraditional: 雙方為了合作或買賣而正式地交談、商量。
hintEnglish: Two parties formally talk things over for cooperation or a deal.

definition: implicated; to implicate; to link together
exampleSimplified: 他无辜被牵连进这起案件。
exampleTraditional: 他無辜被牽連進這起案件。
exampleEnglish: He was innocently dragged into this case.
hintSimplified: 自己没有直接做错,却因为别人的事而受到影响或麻烦。
hintTraditional: 自己沒有直接做錯,卻因為別人的事而受到影響或麻煩。
hintEnglish: Getting affected or in trouble because of someone else's matter, though not directly at fault.

exampleSimplified: 两国领导人今天签署了合作协议。
exampleTraditional: 兩國領導人今天簽署了合作協議。
exampleEnglish: The leaders of the two countries signed a cooperation agreement today.
hintSimplified: 在重要的文件或条约上正式写下自己的名字。
hintTraditional: 在重要的檔案或條約上正式寫下自己的名字。
hintEnglish: To formally write one's name on an important document or treaty.

exampleSimplified: 他取得了很大的成就,但仍然很谦逊。
exampleTraditional: 他取得了很大的成就,但仍然很謙遜。
exampleEnglish: He has achieved a lot, but remains very humble.
hintSimplified: 形容人不骄傲,不自大,愿意向别人学习。
hintTraditional: 形容人不驕傲,不自大,願意向別人學習。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is not proud or arrogant and is willing to learn from others.

exampleSimplified: 我们应该尊敬前辈,向他们学习经验。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該尊敬前輩,向他們學習經驗。
exampleEnglish: We should respect our seniors and learn from their experience.
hintSimplified: 在工作或学问上比你早入行、经验更丰富的人。
hintTraditional: 在工作或學問上比你早入行、經驗更豐富的人。
hintEnglish: Someone who entered a field before you and has more experience.

exampleSimplified: 年轻人要努力,才能有光明的前程。
exampleTraditional: 年輕人要努力,才能有光明的前程。
exampleEnglish: Young people must work hard to have a bright future.
hintSimplified: 指一个人将来在事业或人生上的发展。
hintTraditional: 指一個人將來在事業或人生上的發展。
hintEnglish: A person's future development in career or life.

definition: all around; around; from beginning to end; front and rear
exampleSimplified: 他在公司工作了前后十年。
exampleTraditional: 他在公司工作了前後十年。
exampleEnglish: He worked at the company for ten years in all.
hintSimplified: 表示从开始到结束的整段时间,或大约在某个时间的前面和后面。
hintTraditional: 表示從開始到結束的整段時間,或大約在某個時間的前面和後面。
hintEnglish: Refers to the whole span from start to end, or roughly around a certain time.

exampleSimplified: 这个行业的前景非常好。
exampleTraditional: 這個行業的前景非常好。
exampleEnglish: The prospects of this industry are very good.
hintSimplified: 指事业、行业将来可能的发展情况。
hintTraditional: 指事業、行業將來可能的發展情況。
hintEnglish: The likely future development of a career or industry.

exampleSimplified: 他有前科,所以很难找到工作。
exampleTraditional: 他有前科,所以很難找到工作。
exampleEnglish: He has a criminal record, so it's hard for him to find a job.
hintSimplified: 一个人以前犯过法并被判过刑的记录。
hintTraditional: 一個人以前犯過法並被判過刑的記錄。
hintEnglish: The record of someone who broke the law and was sentenced before.

exampleSimplified: 在这个前提下,我们可以继续讨论。
exampleTraditional: 在這個前提下,我們可以繼續討論。
exampleEnglish: Under this premise, we can continue the discussion.
hintSimplified: 想让事情成立或进行,必须先具备的条件。
hintTraditional: 想讓事情成立或進行,必須先具備的條件。
hintEnglish: A condition that must be met first for something to hold or proceed.

definition: buried and concealed; hidden beneath the surface
exampleSimplified: 平静的表面下潜藏着巨大的危机。
exampleTraditional: 平靜的表面下潛藏著巨大的危機。
exampleEnglish: A huge crisis lies hidden beneath the calm surface.
hintSimplified: 东西或问题躲在里面,不容易被发现。
hintTraditional: 東西或問題躲在裡面,不容易被發現。
hintEnglish: Something or a problem hiding inside that is not easily noticed.

exampleSimplified: 这个孩子很有潜力,将来一定会成功。
exampleTraditional: 這個孩子很有潛力,將來一定會成功。
exampleEnglish: This child has great potential and will surely succeed.
hintSimplified: 还没有完全表现出来、但将来可以发展的能力。
hintTraditional: 還沒有完全表現出來、但將來可以發展的能力。
hintEnglish: An ability not yet fully shown but that can develop in the future.

exampleSimplified: 她虔诚地在佛像前祈祷。
exampleTraditional: 她虔誠地在佛像前祈禱。
exampleEnglish: She prayed devoutly before the Buddha statue.
hintSimplified: 形容对宗教或信仰非常认真、真心恭敬。
hintTraditional: 形容對宗教或信仰非常認真、真心恭敬。
hintEnglish: Describes being very sincere and reverent toward religion or belief.

exampleSimplified: 他的见解太浅薄,没有说服力。
exampleTraditional: 他的見解太淺薄,沒有說服力。
exampleEnglish: His views are too shallow and not persuasive.
hintSimplified: 形容知识或想法不够深入,缺少深度。
hintTraditional: 形容知識或想法不夠深入,缺少深度。
hintEnglish: Describes knowledge or ideas that lack depth.

gloss: (of written or spoken material) easy to understand; accessible
definition: (of written or spoken material) easy to understand; accessible
exampleSimplified: 老师用浅显的例子解释这个道理。
exampleTraditional: 老師用淺顯的例子解釋這個道理。
exampleEnglish: The teacher explained this principle with simple, easy-to-grasp examples.
hintSimplified: 形容文章或说明不难,一看就懂。
hintTraditional: 形容文章或說明不難,一看就懂。
hintEnglish: Describes writing or explanation that is not difficult and is understood at a glance.

definition: a melody; a tune; accent (distinctive way of pronouncing a language); elegance; refinement; tone (manner of expression)
exampleSimplified: 他说话的腔调带着浓浓的南方味道。
exampleTraditional: 他說話的腔調帶著濃濃的南方味道。
exampleEnglish: His way of speaking has a strong southern flavor.
hintSimplified: 指说话时声音高低、语气所形成的特别风格或口音。
hintTraditional: 指說話時聲音高低、語氣所形成的特別風格或口音。
hintEnglish: The distinctive style or accent formed by the pitch and tone of someone's speech.

exampleSimplified: 小猫躲在墙角,不敢出来。
exampleTraditional: 小貓躲在牆角,不敢出來。
exampleEnglish: The kitten is hiding in the corner and doesn't dare come out.
hintSimplified: 两面墙相接的地方,常有人被罚站在那里。
hintTraditional: 兩面牆相接的地方,常有人被罰站在那裡。
hintEnglish: The place where two walls meet, where people are often made to stand as punishment.

exampleSimplified: 今天的风很强劲,骑车很费力。
exampleTraditional: 今天的風很強勁,騎車很費力。
exampleEnglish: The wind is very strong today, so cycling takes a lot of effort.
hintSimplified: 形容力量很大、很有冲劲,例如风、引擎或经济增长。
hintTraditional: 形容力量很大、很有衝勁,例如風、引擎或經濟增長。
hintEnglish: Describes great force and drive, like wind, an engine or economic growth.

gloss: to insist on; to demand; to impose
definition: to insist on; to demand; to impose
exampleSimplified: 感情的事不能强求,顺其自然吧。
exampleTraditional: 感情的事不能強求,順其自然吧。
exampleEnglish: You can't force matters of the heart; just let things take their course.
hintSimplified: 明明条件不够或别人不愿意,还硬要得到某个结果。
hintTraditional: 明明條件不夠或別人不願意,還硬要得到某個結果。
hintEnglish: To insist on getting a result even though conditions aren't right or others are unwilling.

exampleSimplified: 小国常常在强权的压力下生存。
exampleTraditional: 小國常常在強權的壓力下生存。
exampleEnglish: Small countries often survive under the pressure of dominant powers.
hintSimplified: 靠力量和势力而不是道理来支配别人的那种权力。
hintTraditional: 靠力量和勢力而不是道理來支配別人的那種權力。
hintEnglish: Power that dominates others through strength and influence rather than reason.

exampleSimplified: 他每天运动,身体变得很强壮。
exampleTraditional: 他每天運動,身體變得很強壯。
exampleEnglish: He exercises every day, and his body has become very strong.
hintSimplified: 形容人身体结实、有力气,不容易生病。
hintTraditional: 形容人身體結實、有力氣,不容易生病。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose body is sturdy and powerful, rarely getting sick.

exclusionReason: Traditional form is not listed among dictionary recognized forms

exampleSimplified: 语言是沟通不同文化的桥梁。
exampleTraditional: 語言是溝通不同文化的橋梁。
exampleEnglish: Language is a bridge connecting different cultures.
hintSimplified: 架在河上让人通过的建筑,也比喻连接两方的东西。
hintTraditional: 架在河上讓人透過的建築,也比喻連線兩方的東西。
hintEnglish: A structure over a river for crossing, also figuratively something that connects two sides.

exampleSimplified: 我们在国外遇到,真是太巧合了!
exampleTraditional: 我們在國外遇到,真是太巧合了!
exampleEnglish: Meeting abroad like this is such a coincidence!
hintSimplified: 两件事没有计划却刚好同时发生,让人觉得很神奇。
hintTraditional: 兩件事沒有計劃卻剛好同時發生,讓人覺得很神奇。
hintEnglish: Two things happen together by chance without any plan, which feels amazing.

exampleSimplified: 这座山有一面是又高又陡的峭壁。
exampleTraditional: 這座山有一面是又高又陡的峭壁。
exampleEnglish: One side of this mountain is a tall, steep cliff.
hintSimplified: 山上几乎垂直、又高又陡的岩石面,很危险。
hintTraditional: 山上幾乎垂直、又高又陡的岩石面,很危險。
hintEnglish: A nearly vertical, tall rock face on a mountain; very dangerous.

definition: to cut class; to skip school
exampleSimplified: 他常常翘课去打球,被老师发现了。
exampleTraditional: 他常常翹課去打球,被老師發現了。
exampleEnglish: He often skipped class to play ball and was found out by the teacher.
hintSimplified: 学生没有请假,故意不去上课。
hintTraditional: 學生沒有請假,故意不去上課。
hintEnglish: A student deliberately doesn't attend class without asking for leave.

gloss: to compare notes; to learn from one another
definition: to compare notes; to learn from one another
exampleSimplified: 我们常常一起切磋球技,进步很快。
exampleTraditional: 我們常常一起切磋球技,進步很快。
exampleEnglish: We often exchange pointers on our ball skills together and improve quickly.
hintSimplified: 大家互相交流、比较,从对方身上学习技艺或知识。
hintTraditional: 大家互相交流、比較,從對方身上學習技藝或知識。
hintEnglish: People exchange and compare with each other to learn skills or knowledge from one another.

exampleSimplified: 政府应该切实解决老百姓的问题。
exampleTraditional: 政府應該切實解決老百姓的問題。
exampleEnglish: The government should earnestly solve the people's problems.
hintSimplified: 形容做事认真、实在,真正去做而不是只说。
hintTraditional: 形容做事認真、實在,真正去做而不是隻說。
hintEnglish: Describes doing things seriously and genuinely, actually acting rather than just talking.

exampleSimplified: 警察终于抓到了那个窃贼。
exampleTraditional: 警察終於抓到了那個竊賊。
exampleEnglish: The police finally caught that thief.
hintSimplified: 偷别人东西的人,常在夜里进入房子。
hintTraditional: 偷別人東西的人,常在夜裡進入房子。
hintEnglish: A person who steals others' belongings, often entering houses at night.

definition: (coll.) to get intimate with sb; affectionate; intimate; warmhearted; to show affection for
exampleSimplified: 那对情侣在公园里亲热地聊天。
exampleTraditional: 那對情侶在公園裡親熱地聊天。
exampleEnglish: The couple chatted affectionately in the park.
hintSimplified: 形容人和人之间很亲近、很温暖的样子。
hintTraditional: 形容人和人之間很親近、很溫暖的樣子。
hintEnglish: Describes people being very close and warm toward each other.

exampleSimplified: 只有亲身经历过,才能真正了解。
exampleTraditional: 只有親身經歷過,才能真正了解。
exampleEnglish: Only by experiencing it personally can you truly understand.
hintSimplified: 自己直接去做或经历,不是听别人说的。
hintTraditional: 自己直接去做或經歷,不是聽別人說的。
hintEnglish: Doing or experiencing something directly yourself, not hearing it from others.

definition: biological (parents); birth (parents); one's own (child) (i.e. one's child by birth)
exampleSimplified: 他不知道自己的亲生父母是谁。
exampleTraditional: 他不知道自己的親生父母是誰。
exampleEnglish: He doesn't know who his birth parents are.
hintSimplified: 指有血缘关系、亲自生下孩子的父母,不是领养的。
hintTraditional: 指有血緣關係、親自生下孩子的父母,不是領養的。
hintEnglish: Refers to parents who are related by blood and gave birth to the child, not adoptive ones.

definition: to assault; to encroach on; to infringe on; to violate
exampleSimplified: 这家公司被指控侵犯了别人的专利权。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司被指控侵犯了別人的專利權。
