exampleEnglish: The company was accused of infringing on others' patent rights.
hintSimplified: 不经允许就破坏别人的权利、领土或隐私。
hintTraditional: 不經允許就破壞別人的權利、領土或隱私。
hintEnglish: To damage someone's rights, territory or privacy without permission.

exampleSimplified: 历史上,这个国家曾经遭到外国侵略。
exampleTraditional: 歷史上,這個國家曾經遭到外國侵略。
exampleEnglish: Historically, this country was invaded by foreign powers.
hintSimplified: 一个国家用军队进入另一个国家,想占领它。
hintTraditional: 一個國家用軍隊進入另一個國家,想佔領它。
hintEnglish: One country sends its army into another, wanting to take it over.

exampleSimplified: 海水慢慢侵蚀了岸边的岩石。
exampleTraditional: 海水慢慢侵蝕了岸邊的岩石。
exampleEnglish: Seawater slowly eroded the rocks along the shore.
hintSimplified: 水、风或酸一点一点地破坏、腐坏某种东西。
hintTraditional: 水、風或酸一點一點地破壞、腐壞某種東西。
hintEnglish: Water, wind or acid gradually damages or wears something away.

exampleSimplified: 台风侵袭台湾,许多学校停课。
exampleTraditional: 颱風侵襲台灣,許多學校停課。
exampleEnglish: A typhoon struck Taiwan and many schools were closed.
hintSimplified: 台风、寒流等突然来到,带来破坏或影响。
hintTraditional: 颱風、寒流等突然來到,帶來破壞或影響。
hintEnglish: Typhoons or cold fronts suddenly arrive, bringing damage or disruption.

definition: to admire; to look up to; to respect sb greatly
exampleSimplified: 我很钦佩你面对困难的勇气。
exampleTraditional: 我很欽佩你面對困難的勇氣。
exampleEnglish: I really admire your courage in facing difficulties.
hintSimplified: 对别人的品德或能力感到尊敬和佩服。
hintTraditional: 對別人的品德或能力感到尊敬和佩服。
hintEnglish: To feel respect and admiration for someone's character or ability.

exampleSimplified: 她很勤奋,每天都读书到深夜。
exampleTraditional: 她很勤奮,每天都讀書到深夜。
exampleEnglish: She is very diligent and studies late into the night every day.
hintSimplified: 形容人工作或学习很努力,不偷懒。
hintTraditional: 形容人工作或學習很努力,不偷懶。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who works or studies hard and doesn't slack off.

exampleSimplified: 那段青春的回忆,我永远不会忘记。
exampleTraditional: 那段青春的回憶,我永遠不會忘記。
exampleEnglish: I will never forget the memories of that time of youth.
hintSimplified: 人生中年轻、充满活力的那段美好时光。
hintTraditional: 人生中年輕、充滿活力的那段美好時光。
hintEnglish: The beautiful, energetic period of life when one is young.

exampleSimplified: 雨后的山林显得格外青翠。
exampleTraditional: 雨後的山林顯得格外青翠。
exampleEnglish: The mountain forest looks especially lush and green after the rain.
hintSimplified: 形容植物颜色鲜绿、很有生机。
hintTraditional: 形容植物顏色鮮綠、很有生機。
hintEnglish: Describes plants that are a vivid green and full of life.

exampleSimplified: 夏天晚上,池塘边有青蛙在叫。
exampleTraditional: 夏天晚上,池塘邊有青蛙在叫。
exampleEnglish: On summer nights, frogs croak by the pond.
hintSimplified: 绿色的小动物,会跳,也会游泳,常在池塘边叫。
hintTraditional: 綠色的小動物,會跳,也會游泳,常在池塘邊叫。
hintEnglish: A small green animal that hops and swims, often croaking by ponds.

exampleSimplified: 山里的溪水清澈见底。
exampleTraditional: 山裡的溪水清澈見底。
exampleEnglish: The mountain stream is so clear you can see the bottom.
hintSimplified: 形容水非常干净、透明,没有杂质。
hintTraditional: 形容水非常乾淨、透明,沒有雜質。
hintEnglish: Describes water that is very clean and transparent, without impurities.

exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅的厨房很清洁,大家都很放心。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳的廚房很清潔,大家都很放心。
exampleEnglish: The kitchen of this restaurant is very clean, so everyone feels reassured.
hintSimplified: 形容环境或东西没有脏东西,干干净净。
hintTraditional: 形容環境或東西沒有髒東西,乾乾淨淨。
hintEnglish: Describes a place or thing with no dirt, spotless and tidy.

exampleSimplified: 我想找一个清静的地方好好看书。
exampleTraditional: 我想找一個清靜的地方好好看書。
exampleEnglish: I want to find a peaceful and quiet place to read properly.
hintSimplified: 形容环境没有吵闹的声音,让人觉得安心。
hintTraditional: 形容環境沒有吵鬧的聲音,讓人覺得安心。
hintEnglish: Describes a place without noise, where one feels at ease.

exampleSimplified: 他是一位清廉的官员,从来不收红包。
exampleTraditional: 他是一位清廉的官員,從來不收紅包。
exampleEnglish: He is an honest official who never accepts bribes.
hintSimplified: 形容公务人员不贪钱,品德很好。
hintTraditional: 形容公務人員不貪錢,品德很好。
hintEnglish: Describes a public servant who is not greedy for money and has good character.

definition: (of a location) quiet and secluded; beautiful and secluded
exampleSimplified: 山里的小路十分清幽,很适合散步。
exampleTraditional: 山裡的小路十分清幽,很適合散步。
exampleEnglish: The small path in the mountains is very quiet and secluded, perfect for a walk.
hintSimplified: 形容风景优美、安静又偏僻的地方。
hintTraditional: 形容風景優美、安靜又偏僻的地方。
hintEnglish: Describes a scenic place that is calm, quiet and out of the way.

definition: a sweep (against crime); to mop up; to tidy up
exampleSimplified: 周末我们全家一起清扫房子。
exampleTraditional: 週末我們全家一起清掃房子。
exampleEnglish: On the weekend our whole family cleans the house together.
hintSimplified: 用扫把把地上的垃圾和灰尘弄干净。
hintTraditional: 用掃把把地上的垃圾和灰塵弄乾淨。
hintEnglish: Using a broom to get rubbish and dust off the floor.

definition: a philanderer; disrespectful; frivolous; light (weight); to scorn
exampleSimplified: 他说话很轻薄,让人觉得不舒服。
exampleTraditional: 他說話很輕薄,讓人覺得不舒服。
exampleEnglish: He speaks in a frivolous, disrespectful way that makes people uncomfortable.
hintSimplified: 形容人的言行不庄重,不尊重别人。
hintTraditional: 形容人的言行不莊重,不尊重別人。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose words and behavior are not serious or respectful toward others.

definition: disdain; contempt; scornful; disdainful; contemptuous; pejorative
exampleSimplified: 他用轻蔑的眼神看着对手。
exampleTraditional: 他用輕蔑的眼神看著對手。
exampleEnglish: He looked at his opponent with a contemptuous gaze.
hintSimplified: 觉得别人很差,看不起他的态度。
hintTraditional: 覺得別人很差,看不起他的態度。
hintEnglish: An attitude of thinking someone is inferior and looking down on them.

exampleSimplified: 不要轻易放弃自己的梦想。
exampleTraditional: 不要輕易放棄自己的夢想。
exampleEnglish: Don't give up your dreams lightly.
hintSimplified: 表示不经过认真考虑,很随便就做某事。
hintTraditional: 表示不經過認真考慮,很隨便就做某事。
hintEnglish: Means doing something casually, without careful thought.

exampleSimplified: 警察收到了一份重要的情报。
exampleTraditional: 警察收到了一份重要的情報。
exampleEnglish: The police received an important piece of intelligence.
hintSimplified: 关于对手或敌人的秘密消息,常和间谍有关。
hintTraditional: 關於對手或敵人的秘密訊息,常和間諜有關。
hintEnglish: Secret news about an opponent or enemy, often linked to spies.

definition: disposition of mind; feelings; moral character; sentiments
exampleSimplified: 多听音乐可以陶冶情操。
exampleTraditional: 多聽音樂可以陶冶情操。
exampleEnglish: Listening to more music can cultivate one's sentiment and character.
hintSimplified: 指人心中高尚的感情和品味,可以通过艺术培养。
hintTraditional: 指人心中高尚的感情和品味,可以透過藝術培養。
hintEnglish: Refers to refined feelings and taste in a person's heart, which art can nurture.

exampleSimplified: 电影里的男人偷偷养了一个情妇。
exampleTraditional: 電影裡的男人偷偷養了一個情婦。
exampleEnglish: In the movie, the man secretly kept a mistress.
hintSimplified: 已婚男人在妻子以外秘密交往的女人。
hintTraditional: 已婚男人在妻子以外秘密交往的女人。
hintEnglish: A woman a married man secretly sees besides his wife.

exampleSimplified: 这部小说的情节非常精彩。
exampleTraditional: 這部小說的情節非常精彩。
exampleEnglish: The plot of this novel is very exciting.
hintSimplified: 故事里一件接一件发生的事。
hintTraditional: 故事裡一件接一件發生的事。
hintEnglish: The events in a story that happen one after another.

exampleSimplified: 想起当时的情景,他还是很感动。
exampleTraditional: 想起當時的情景,他還是很感動。
exampleEnglish: Thinking of the scene back then, he still feels moved.
hintSimplified: 某个时候发生的事和看到的样子。
hintTraditional: 某個時候發生的事和看到的樣子。
hintEnglish: What happened and what could be seen at a certain moment.

exampleSimplified: 公园里有很多手牵手的情侣。
exampleTraditional: 公園裡有很多手牽手的情侶。
exampleEnglish: There are many couples holding hands in the park.
hintSimplified: 互相喜欢、正在谈恋爱的两个人。
hintTraditional: 互相喜歡、正在談戀愛的兩個人。
hintEnglish: Two people who like each other and are in a romantic relationship.

definition: appeal; delight; fun; inclinations and interests; interest
exampleSimplified: 这间咖啡店布置得很有情趣。
exampleTraditional: 這間咖啡店佈置得很有情趣。
exampleEnglish: This café is decorated with great charm.
hintSimplified: 让人觉得生活有味道、有品味的气氛。
hintTraditional: 讓人覺得生活有味道、有品味的氣氛。
hintEnglish: An atmosphere that makes life feel tasteful and delightful.

exampleSimplified: 幸好没有人受伤,大家都很庆幸。
exampleTraditional: 幸好沒有人受傷,大家都很慶幸。
exampleEnglish: Luckily nobody was hurt, and everyone felt fortunate.
hintSimplified: 事情没有变坏,心里觉得运气很好。
hintTraditional: 事情沒有變壞,心裡覺得運氣很好。
hintEnglish: Feeling lucky inside because things did not turn out badly.

exampleSimplified: 台湾中部有很多丘陵地形。
exampleTraditional: 台灣中部有很多丘陵地形。
exampleEnglish: There is a lot of hilly terrain in central Taiwan.
hintSimplified: 比山矮、起伏不大的高地。
hintTraditional: 比山矮、起伏不大的高地。
hintEnglish: Raised land lower than mountains, with gentle slopes.

gloss: to pursue one's studies; to attend school
definition: to pursue one's studies; to attend school; to seek knowledge
exampleSimplified: 他十八岁就离开家乡去外地求学。
exampleTraditional: 他十八歲就離開家鄉去外地求學。
exampleEnglish: He left his hometown to study elsewhere at eighteen.
hintSimplified: 为了读书学习,到学校去念书。
hintTraditional: 為了讀書學習,到學校去唸書。
hintEnglish: Going to school in order to study and learn.

definition: to appeal (for help); to request help
exampleSimplified: 遇到困难时,可以向朋友求助。
exampleTraditional: 遇到困難時,可以向朋友求助。
exampleEnglish: When you meet difficulties, you can ask friends for help.
hintSimplified: 遇到麻烦,请别人来帮忙。
hintTraditional: 遇到麻煩,請別人來幫忙。
hintEnglish: Asking someone to lend a hand when in trouble.

definition: (as a transitive verb) to defeat; to prevail over; to succumb; to surrender; to yield
exampleSimplified: 他不愿意向困难屈服。
exampleTraditional: 他不願意向困難屈服。
exampleEnglish: He is unwilling to yield to difficulties.
hintSimplified: 在压力下放弃抵抗,只好接受。
hintTraditional: 在壓力下放棄抵抗,只好接受。
hintEnglish: To stop resisting under pressure and have to accept.

exampleSimplified: 今年手机市场的趋势是越来越轻薄。
exampleTraditional: 今年手機市場的趨勢是越來越輕薄。
exampleEnglish: This year's trend in the phone market is toward ever lighter and thinner models.
hintSimplified: 事情发展的大方向,看得出未来会怎样。
hintTraditional: 事情發展的大方向,看得出未來會怎樣。
hintEnglish: The general direction in which things develop, hinting at the future.

exampleSimplified: 我们可以通过不同的渠道了解这个消息。
exampleTraditional: 我們可以透過不同的渠道了解這個訊息。
exampleEnglish: We can learn about this news through different channels.
hintSimplified: 获得消息或商品的方法和途径。
hintTraditional: 獲得訊息或商品的方法和途徑。
hintEnglish: The ways and routes through which information or goods are obtained.

exampleSimplified: 记者到乡下取材,写了一篇报道。
exampleTraditional: 記者到鄉下取材,寫了一篇報道。
exampleEnglish: The reporter went to the countryside to gather material and wrote a report.
hintSimplified: 作家或记者为了写作去找资料和题材。
hintTraditional: 作家或記者為了寫作去找資料和題材。
hintEnglish: What writers or reporters do when looking for material and subjects to write about.

gloss: to suppress; to crack down on; to prohibit
definition: to suppress; to crack down on; to prohibit
exampleSimplified: 政府决定取缔路边的非法摊贩。
exampleTraditional: 政府決定取締路邊的非法攤販。
exampleEnglish: The government decided to crack down on illegal street vendors.
hintSimplified: 官方禁止不合法的事,不许继续存在。
hintTraditional: 官方禁止不合法的事,不許繼續存在。
hintEnglish: When authorities ban something illegal and do not let it continue.

exampleSimplified: 工作人员到河边取样检查水质。
exampleTraditional: 工作人員到河邊取樣檢查水質。
exampleEnglish: Staff went to the river to take samples and check the water quality.
hintSimplified: 从一大堆东西中拿出一小部分来检验。
hintTraditional: 從一大堆東西中拿出一小部分來檢驗。
hintEnglish: Taking a small part from a large amount in order to test it.

exampleSimplified: 他总是说好听的话来取悦老板。
exampleTraditional: 他總是說好聽的話來取悅老闆。
exampleEnglish: He always says nice things to please his boss.
hintSimplified: 为了让别人高兴或喜欢自己,而努力讨好对方。
hintTraditional: 為了讓別人高興或喜歡自己,而努力討好對方。
hintEnglish: Trying hard to make someone happy or to win their favor.

definition: fun; interest; delight; taste; liking; preference
exampleSimplified: 这本书写得很有趣味,大家都爱看。
exampleTraditional: 這本書寫得很有趣味,大家都愛看。
exampleEnglish: This book is written in a very interesting way, and everyone loves reading it.
hintSimplified: 让人觉得有意思、愉快的特点。
hintTraditional: 讓人覺得有意思、愉快的特點。
hintEnglish: The quality that makes something enjoyable and interesting.

exampleSimplified: 他的朋友圈子很小,只有几个好友。
exampleTraditional: 他的朋友圈子很小,只有幾個好友。
exampleEnglish: His circle of friends is small, with only a few close friends.
hintSimplified: 一群有共同兴趣或身份的人所组成的范围。
hintTraditional: 一群有共同興趣或身份的人所組成的範圍。
hintEnglish: The group of people who share interests or a background and spend time together.

definition: all-out (effort); full strength; fully (support); with all one's strength
exampleSimplified: 我们会全力支持你完成这个计划。
exampleTraditional: 我們會全力支援你完成這個計劃。
exampleEnglish: We will support you with all our strength in completing this plan.
hintSimplified: 用上所有的力量,一点也不保留地去做事。
hintTraditional: 用上所有的力量,一點也不保留地去做事。
hintEnglish: Using every bit of strength without holding anything back.

exampleSimplified: 公司决定全盘改变原来的做法。
exampleTraditional: 公司決定全盤改變原來的做法。
exampleEnglish: The company decided to completely change its original approach.
hintSimplified: 形容处理事情时包括全部、整体,不是只做一部分。
hintTraditional: 形容處理事情時包括全部、整體,不是隻做一部分。
hintEnglish: Describes dealing with something as a whole, not just a part.

exampleSimplified: 公民有选举的权力。
exampleTraditional: 公民有選舉的權力。
exampleEnglish: Citizens have the power to vote.
hintSimplified: 依法可以管理、决定或指挥别人的力量。
hintTraditional: 依法可以管理、決定或指揮別人的力量。
hintEnglish: The legal ability to govern, decide, or give orders to others.

exampleSimplified: 他是这个领域里公认的权威。
exampleTraditional: 他是這個領域裡公認的權威。
exampleEnglish: He is a recognized authority in this field.
hintSimplified: 在某个专业里最有地位、最让人相信的人或意见。
hintTraditional: 在某個專業裡最有地位、最讓人相信的人或意見。
hintEnglish: The person or opinion most trusted and respected in a specialized field.

exampleSimplified: 消费者的权益应该受到保护。
exampleTraditional: 消費者的權益應該受到保護。
exampleEnglish: Consumers' rights and interests should be protected.
hintSimplified: 法律上应该得到、也要被保护的好处和权利。
hintTraditional: 法律上應該得到、也要被保護的好處和權利。
hintEnglish: The rights and benefits a person should legally receive and have protected.

exampleSimplified: 母亲的爱是他努力的泉源。
exampleTraditional: 母親的愛是他努力的泉源。
exampleEnglish: His mother's love is the wellspring of his effort.
hintSimplified: 本来指水流出来的地方,也比喻力量或想法的来处。
hintTraditional: 本來指水流出來的地方,也比喻力量或想法的來處。
hintEnglish: Literally where water comes out; figuratively where energy or ideas come from.

definition: to advise; to attempt to convince
exampleSimplified: 老师耐心地劝导那个迷路的学生。
exampleTraditional: 老師耐心地勸導那個迷路的學生。
exampleEnglish: The teacher patiently counseled the lost student.
hintSimplified: 用好话慢慢说服别人,让他走上正确的路。
hintTraditional: 用好話慢慢說服別人,讓他走上正確的路。
hintEnglish: Gently persuading someone with kind words to take the right path.

definition: CL:席[xi2]; advice; exhortation; to advise; to exhort; to urge
exampleSimplified: 他不听朋友的劝告,结果后悔了。
exampleTraditional: 他不聽朋友的勸告,結果後悔了。
exampleEnglish: He didn't heed his friend's advice and ended up regretting it.
hintSimplified: 别人真诚地提醒你不要做某件事的话。
hintTraditional: 別人真誠地提醒你不要做某件事的話。
hintEnglish: Sincere words from others urging you not to do something.

exampleSimplified: 这个产品有一个很大的缺陷。
exampleTraditional: 這個產品有一個很大的缺陷。
exampleEnglish: This product has a major flaw.
hintSimplified: 东西或人身上不够完美、不好的地方。
hintTraditional: 東西或人身上不夠完美、不好的地方。
hintEnglish: A place where something or someone is imperfect or lacking.

exampleSimplified: 我们必须确保食品安全。
exampleTraditional: 我們必須確保食品安全。
exampleEnglish: We must ensure food safety.
hintSimplified: 采取办法,让事情一定能做到或不会出问题。
hintTraditional: 採取辦法,讓事情一定能做到或不會出問題。
hintEnglish: Taking measures so that something is certain to happen or nothing goes wrong.

exampleSimplified: 警察还不知道事故的确切时间。
exampleTraditional: 警察還不知道事故的確切時間。
exampleEnglish: The police still don't know the exact time of the accident.
hintSimplified: 形容说法或资料很准确,没有模糊的地方。
hintTraditional: 形容說法或資料很準確,沒有模糊的地方。
hintEnglish: Describes information that is precise, with nothing vague.

exampleSimplified: 澎湖是台湾有名的群岛。
exampleTraditional: 澎湖是台灣有名的群島。
exampleEnglish: Penghu is a famous archipelago of Taiwan.
hintSimplified: 海里聚在一起的许多小岛。
hintTraditional: 海里聚在一起的許多小島。
hintEnglish: Many small islands clustered together in the sea.

gloss: to live together (in a large group or flock)
definition: to live together (in a large group or flock)
exampleSimplified: 企鹅喜欢群居,常常成千上万只在一起。
exampleTraditional: 企鵝喜歡群居,常常成千上萬只在一起。
exampleEnglish: Penguins like to live in groups, often thousands together.
hintSimplified: 很多动物或人不单独生活,而是住在一起。
hintTraditional: 很多動物或人不單獨生活,而是住在一起。
hintEnglish: Many animals or people live together rather than alone.

exampleSimplified: 这种染料可以把布染成蓝色。
exampleTraditional: 這種染料可以把布染成藍色。
exampleEnglish: This dye can color cloth blue.
hintSimplified: 用来给布、头发等换颜色的材料。
hintTraditional: 用來給布、頭髮等換顏色的材料。
hintEnglish: A material used to change the color of cloth, hair, and so on.

exampleSimplified: 最近学中文的热潮越来越大。
exampleTraditional: 最近學中文的熱潮越來越大。
exampleEnglish: Recently the craze for learning Chinese has been growing.
hintSimplified: 很多人同时对某件事特别有兴趣的社会现象。
hintTraditional: 很多人同時對某件事特別有興趣的社會現象。
hintEnglish: A social phenomenon in which many people become keen on the same thing at once.

exampleSimplified: 热带水果又甜又好吃。
exampleTraditional: 熱帶水果又甜又好吃。
exampleEnglish: Tropical fruit is sweet and delicious.
hintSimplified: 靠近赤道、一年到头都很热的地区。
hintTraditional: 靠近赤道、一年到頭都很熱的地區。
hintEnglish: The region near the equator that is hot all year round.

exampleSimplified: 这位医生对病人充满仁爱之心。
exampleTraditional: 這位醫生對病人充滿仁愛之心。
exampleEnglish: This doctor is full of benevolence toward patients.
hintSimplified: 对别人善良、关心、愿意帮助的心。
hintTraditional: 對別人善良、關心、願意幫助的心。
hintEnglish: A kind heart that cares about others and is willing to help.

gloss: classifier for number of people participating
definition: classifier for number of people participating; person-times; visits
exampleSimplified: 展览期间共有十万人次参观。
exampleTraditional: 展覽期間共有十萬人次參觀。
exampleEnglish: During the exhibition, there were 100,000 visits in total.
hintSimplified: 统计参加或来访的人数时,每个人来一次算一次的单位。
hintTraditional: 統計參加或來訪的人數時,每個人來一次算一次的單位。
hintEnglish: A unit for counting attendance, where each person's each visit counts once.

definition: human sympathy; humane; humanitarianism; sexual intercourse; the "human way", one of the stages in the cycle of reincarnation (Buddhism)
exampleSimplified: 我们应该用人道的方式对待动物。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該用人道的方式對待動物。
exampleEnglish: We should treat animals in a humane way.
hintSimplified: 尊重生命、同情别人的态度或做法。
hintTraditional: 尊重生命、同情別人的態度或做法。
hintEnglish: An attitude or approach that respects life and shows compassion.

exampleSimplified: 这次火灾是一场可以避免的人祸。
exampleTraditional: 這次火災是一場可以避免的人禍。
exampleEnglish: This fire was an avoidable man-made disaster.
hintSimplified: 不是天气或地震造成,而是人的错误带来的灾难。
hintTraditional: 不是天氣或地震造成,而是人的錯誤帶來的災難。
hintEnglish: A disaster caused not by nature but by human error.

exampleSimplified: 他的人际关系很好,到哪里都有朋友。
exampleTraditional: 他的人際關係很好,到哪裡都有朋友。
exampleEnglish: He has good interpersonal relationships and has friends everywhere.
hintSimplified: 指人和人之间交往、相处的情形。
hintTraditional: 指人和人之間交往、相處的情形。
hintEnglish: Refers to how people interact and get along with one another.

definition: favor; a good turn; human emotions; social relationship; friendship
exampleSimplified: 他帮了我一个大忙,我欠他一份人情。
exampleTraditional: 他幫了我一個大忙,我欠他一份人情。
exampleEnglish: He did me a big favor, so I owe him one.
hintSimplified: 别人帮过你,你觉得应该回报的情分。
hintTraditional: 別人幫過你,你覺得應該回報的情分。
hintEnglish: The sense of obligation to repay someone who has helped you.

exampleSimplified: 广场上聚集了很多人群,非常热闹。
exampleTraditional: 廣場上聚集了很多人群,非常熱鬧。
exampleEnglish: A large crowd gathered in the square, and it was very lively.
hintSimplified: 很多人聚在一起,像一大片。
hintTraditional: 很多人聚在一起,像一大片。
hintEnglish: Many people gathered together, like a big mass.

exampleSimplified: 会议邀请了许多专业人士参加。
exampleTraditional: 會議邀請了許多專業人士參加。
exampleEnglish: The meeting invited many professionals to attend.
hintSimplified: 指在某个领域或社会上有一定身份的人,常说「专业……」。
hintTraditional: 指在某個領域或社會上有一定身份的人,常說「專業……」。
hintEnglish: Refers to people with a certain standing in a field or in society, as in 'professional ...'.

exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅最近人手不够,大家都很忙。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳最近人手不夠,大家都很忙。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant is short-staffed lately, so everyone is very busy.
hintSimplified: 工作场所里能干活的员工数量;太少就会忙不过来。
hintTraditional: 工作場所裡能幹活的員工數量;太少就會忙不過來。
hintEnglish: The number of workers available at a workplace; too few and everyone is overwhelmed.

exampleSimplified: 公司还没有决定新经理的人选。
exampleTraditional: 公司還沒有決定新經理的人選。
exampleEnglish: The company hasn't decided on who will be the new manager.
hintSimplified: 被考虑来担任某个职位的那个人。
hintTraditional: 被考慮來擔任某個職位的那個人。
hintEnglish: The person being considered to fill a certain position.

exampleSimplified: 这个湖是人造的,不是天然的。
exampleTraditional: 這個湖是人造的,不是天然的。
exampleEnglish: This lake is man-made, not natural.
hintSimplified: 不是自然形成,而是由人做出来的。
hintTraditional: 不是自然形成,而是由人做出來的。
hintEnglish: Not formed naturally, but made by people.

exampleSimplified: 他忍痛卖掉了心爱的老车。
exampleTraditional: 他忍痛賣掉了心愛的老車。
exampleEnglish: He sold his beloved old car with great reluctance.
hintSimplified: 心里很舍不得,但还是做了决定。
hintTraditional: 心裡很捨不得,但還是做了決定。
hintEnglish: Very unwilling in one's heart, but making the decision anyway.

definition: CL:屆|届[jie4]; tenure (entire period in office); term of office
exampleSimplified: 市长的任期是四年。
exampleTraditional: 市長的任期是四年。
exampleEnglish: The mayor's term of office is four years.
hintSimplified: 官员或负责人担任某个职务的时间长度。
hintTraditional: 官員或負責人擔任某個職務的時間長度。
hintEnglish: The length of time an official or leader holds a position.

definition: any; arbitrary; at random; at will
exampleSimplified: 你可以任意选择自己喜欢的颜色。
exampleTraditional: 你可以任意選擇自己喜歡的顏色。
exampleEnglish: You may freely choose any color you like.
hintSimplified: 不受限制,想怎样就怎样。
hintTraditional: 不受限制,想怎樣就怎樣。
hintEnglish: Without restriction; however one likes.

definition: to acknowledge one's mistake; to admit an error
exampleSimplified: 他知道自己错了,马上向老师认错。
exampleTraditional: 他知道自己錯了,馬上向老師認錯。
exampleEnglish: He knew he was wrong and immediately admitted his fault to the teacher.
hintSimplified: 做错事以后,承认自己有问题。
hintTraditional: 做錯事以後,承認自己有問題。
hintEnglish: After doing something wrong, admitting that you are at fault.

definition: determination (of an amount); of the firm opinion; to believe firmly; to determine (a fact); to identify with; to maintain (that sth is true); to set one's mind on
exampleSimplified: 警方认定这是一次意外。
exampleTraditional: 警方認定這是一次意外。
exampleEnglish: The police determined that this was an accident.
hintSimplified: 经过判断后,肯定地认为事情就是这样。
hintTraditional: 經過判斷後,肯定地認為事情就是這樣。
hintEnglish: After judging, firmly concluding that something is the case.

exampleSimplified: 这次旅行的日程已经排好了。
exampleTraditional: 這次旅行的日程已經排好了。
exampleEnglish: The schedule for this trip has already been arranged.
hintSimplified: 按日期安排好的活动计划。
hintTraditional: 按日期安排好的活動計劃。
hintEnglish: A plan of activities arranged by date.

definition: day by day; increasingly; more and more; more and more with each passing day
exampleSimplified: 网络对生活的影响日益增加。
exampleTraditional: 網路對生活的影響日益增加。
exampleEnglish: The internet's influence on life is growing day by day.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示情况随着时间一天比一天更明显。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示情況隨著時間一天比一天更明顯。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning a situation becomes more pronounced as time passes.

exampleSimplified: 这个水瓶的容量是一升。
exampleTraditional: 這個水瓶的容量是一升。
exampleEnglish: This water bottle has a capacity of one liter.
hintSimplified: 一个瓶子或硬盘最多能装多少东西。
hintTraditional: 一個瓶子或硬碟最多能裝多少東西。
hintEnglish: How much a bottle or hard drive can hold at most.

definition: to accommodate; to contain; to hold; to tolerate (different opinions)
exampleSimplified: 这个体育馆可以容纳一万名观众。
exampleTraditional: 這個體育館可以容納一萬名觀眾。
exampleEnglish: This stadium can hold ten thousand spectators.
hintSimplified: 空间大小足够让人或东西进来。
hintTraditional: 空間大小足夠讓人或東西進來。
hintEnglish: A space big enough to let people or things in.

exampleSimplified: 请把剩菜放进这个容器里。
exampleTraditional: 請把剩菜放進這個容器裡。
exampleEnglish: Please put the leftovers into this container.
hintSimplified: 用来装东西的盒子、瓶子或罐子的统称。
hintTraditional: 用來裝東西的盒子、瓶子或罐子的統稱。
hintEnglish: General term for boxes, bottles or jars used to hold things.

exampleSimplified: 学校不容许学生在教室里抽烟。
exampleTraditional: 學校不容許學生在教室裡抽菸。
exampleEnglish: The school does not allow students to smoke in the classroom.
hintSimplified: 同意让别人做某件事,多用在否定句。
hintTraditional: 同意讓別人做某件事,多用在否定句。
hintEnglish: To agree to let someone do something, often used in negatives.

definition: to dissolve (of sugar etc); to melt
exampleSimplified: 糖放进热水里很快就溶化了。
exampleTraditional: 糖放進熱水裡很快就溶化了。
exampleEnglish: Sugar dissolves quickly when put in hot water.
hintSimplified: 固体放进水里或受热后,慢慢消失变成液体。
hintTraditional: 固體放進水裡或受熱後,慢慢消失變成液體。
hintEnglish: A solid, in water or heat, gradually disappears into liquid.

definition: a mixture; an amalgam; fusion; to be in harmony with (nature); to fit in; to harmonize with; welding together
exampleSimplified: 这道菜融合了中西方的口味。
exampleTraditional: 這道菜融合了中西方的口味。
exampleEnglish: This dish blends Chinese and Western flavors.
hintSimplified: 把不同的东西合在一起,变成一体。
hintTraditional: 把不同的東西合在一起,變成一體。
hintEnglish: To bring different things together into one.

definition: friendly relations; harmonious; on good terms with one another
exampleSimplified: 同事们相处得很融洽。
exampleTraditional: 同事們相處得很融洽。
exampleEnglish: The colleagues get along very harmoniously.
hintSimplified: 形容人与人之间关系和谐、没有矛盾。
hintTraditional: 形容人與人之間關係和諧、沒有矛盾。
hintEnglish: Describes relations between people that are harmonious, without conflict.

exampleSimplified: 拿到冠军是球队的最高荣誉。
exampleTraditional: 拿到冠軍是球隊的最高榮譽。
exampleEnglish: Winning the championship is the team's highest honor.
hintSimplified: 因为出色的表现而得到的光荣名声。
hintTraditional: 因為出色的表現而得到的光榮名聲。
hintEnglish: Glorious recognition received for outstanding achievement.

exampleSimplified: 这张沙发又大又柔软,坐起来很舒服。
exampleTraditional: 這張沙發又大又柔軟,坐起來很舒服。
exampleEnglish: This sofa is big and soft, and very comfortable to sit on.
hintSimplified: 形容摸起来不硬,像棉花或枕头一样。
hintTraditional: 形容摸起來不硬,像棉花或枕頭一樣。
hintEnglish: Describes something not hard to the touch, like cotton or a pillow.

definition: corny; fulsome (of praise); maudlin; sappy; sickening
exampleSimplified: 他说的情话太肉麻了,我听了起鸡皮疙瘩。
exampleTraditional: 他說的情話太肉麻了,我聽了起雞皮疙瘩。
exampleEnglish: His sweet talk was so cheesy that it gave me goosebumps.
hintSimplified: 话或动作太亲热、太做作,让旁人觉得不自在。
hintTraditional: 話或動作太親熱、太做作,讓旁人覺得不自在。
hintEnglish: Words or actions so affectionate or affected that onlookers feel uncomfortable.

exampleSimplified: 运动不但锻炼肉体,也能放松心情。
exampleTraditional: 運動不但鍛鍊肉體,也能放鬆心情。
exampleEnglish: Exercise not only trains the body but also relaxes the mind.
hintSimplified: 与精神、心灵相对,指人身体的部分。
hintTraditional: 與精神、心靈相對,指人身體的部分。
hintEnglish: As opposed to spirit or soul, the physical part of a person.

gloss: Confucian school, founded by Confucius 孔子[Kong3 zi3] (551-479 BC) and Mencius 孟子[Meng4 zi3] (c. 372-c. 289 BC)
definition: Confucian school, founded by Confucius 孔子[Kong3 zi3] (551-479 BC) and Mencius 孟子[Meng4 zi3] (c. 372-c. 289 BC)
exampleSimplified: 儒家思想对东亚文化影响很大。
exampleTraditional: 儒家思想對東亞文化影響很大。
exampleEnglish: Confucian thought has had a great influence on East Asian culture.
hintSimplified: 以孔子为代表的古代思想学派,重视礼与仁。
hintTraditional: 以孔子為代表的古代思想學派,重視禮與仁。
hintEnglish: An ancient school of thought led by Confucius, stressing ritual and benevolence.

exampleSimplified: 今年这个国家出现了入超,进口比出口多。
exampleTraditional: 今年這個國家出現了入超,進口比出口多。
exampleEnglish: This year the country had a trade deficit, with imports exceeding exports.
hintSimplified: 一个国家买进的货物比卖出的货物多的经济情况。
hintTraditional: 一個國家買進的貨物比賣出的貨物多的經濟情況。
hintEnglish: An economic situation where a country buys in more goods than it sells abroad.

definition: to engage with secular society; to involve oneself in human affairs; to join the WTO (abbr. for 加入世界貿易組織|加入世界贸易组织[jia1 ru4 Shi4 jie4 Mao4 yi4 Zu3 zhi1])
exampleSimplified: 他年轻时想出家,后来决定入世,帮助更多的人。
exampleTraditional: 他年輕時想出家,後來決定入世,幫助更多的人。
exampleEnglish: When he was young he wanted to become a monk, but later he decided to engage with the world and help more people.
hintSimplified: 与离开尘世相反,指积极投入社会、参与世俗生活。
hintTraditional: 與離開塵世相反,指積極投入社會、參與世俗生活。
hintEnglish: The opposite of withdrawing from the world; it means actively joining society and everyday life.

exampleSimplified: 遇到困难的时候,不要表现得太软弱。
exampleTraditional: 遇到困難的時候,不要表現得太軟弱。
exampleEnglish: When you meet difficulties, don't act too weak.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人没有力量或意志,容易被打倒或屈服。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人沒有力量或意志,容易被打倒或屈服。
hintEnglish: Describes a person lacking strength or will, easily beaten or giving in.

exampleSimplified: 这个软体可以免费下载,但是要先注册。
exampleTraditional: 這個軟體可以免費下載,但是要先註冊。
exampleEnglish: This software can be downloaded for free, but you have to register first.
hintSimplified: 电脑或手机里的程序,看不见也摸不到,和机器本身相对。
hintTraditional: 電腦或手機裡的程式,看不見也摸不到,和機器本身相對。
hintEnglish: The programs in a computer or phone, which you can't touch, as opposed to the machine itself.

definition: a certain number or amount; how many?; how much?
exampleSimplified: 会议上提出了若干问题,需要大家讨论。
exampleTraditional: 會議上提出了若干問題,需要大家討論。
exampleEnglish: Several questions were raised at the meeting and need to be discussed by everyone.
hintSimplified: 表示不确定的数量,不多也不少,常放在名词前面。
hintTraditional: 表示不確定的數量,不多也不少,常放在名詞前面。
hintEnglish: Indicates an unspecified number, neither many nor few, often placed before a noun.

exampleSimplified: 小孩子撒谎是不对的,要说实话。
exampleTraditional: 小孩子撒謊是不對的,要說實話。
exampleEnglish: It's wrong for children to tell lies; they should tell the truth.
hintSimplified: 明明知道不是真的,却故意这样告诉别人。
hintTraditional: 明明知道不是真的,卻故意這樣告訴別人。
hintEnglish: Knowing something isn't true but deliberately telling it to others anyway.

definition: (broadly) prose (as opposed to verse); (more narrowly) free-form literary prose, such as essays, sketches and reflections
exampleSimplified: 我很喜欢读他写的散文,文字很优美。
exampleTraditional: 我很喜歡讀他寫的散文,文字很優美。
exampleEnglish: I really like reading the essays he writes; the writing is beautiful.
hintSimplified: 一种不押韵、形式自由的文学作品,和诗不一样。
hintTraditional: 一種不押韻、形式自由的文學作品,和詩不一樣。
hintEnglish: A literary form that is free in structure and doesn't rhyme, unlike poetry.

exampleSimplified: 有人在网路上散布不实的消息。
exampleTraditional: 有人在網路上散布不實的訊息。
exampleEnglish: Someone is spreading false information on the Internet.
hintSimplified: 把消息、谣言或东西传到很多地方去。
hintTraditional: 把訊息、謠言或東西傳到很多地方去。
hintEnglish: To send news, rumors or things out to many places.

exampleSimplified: 他家里最近有丧事,所以请了几天假。
exampleTraditional: 他家裡最近有喪事,所以請了幾天假。
exampleEnglish: There was a funeral in his family recently, so he took a few days off.
hintSimplified: 家里有人去世后,要办的各种仪式和事情。
hintTraditional: 家裡有人去世後,要辦的各種儀式和事情。
hintEnglish: The ceremonies and matters to handle after someone in the family has passed away.

exampleSimplified: 我感冒了,嗓子很痛,不太想说话。
exampleTraditional: 我感冒了,嗓子很痛,不太想說話。
exampleEnglish: I have a cold and my throat hurts, so I don't feel like talking.
hintSimplified: 身体里发出声音的部位,感冒时常常会痛。
hintTraditional: 身體裡發出聲音的部位,感冒時常常會痛。
hintEnglish: The part of the body that produces voice, which often hurts when you have a cold.

definition: to die; to lose one's life
exampleSimplified: 这场意外让十几个人不幸丧生。
exampleTraditional: 這場意外讓十幾個人不幸喪生。
exampleEnglish: This accident unfortunately killed over a dozen people.
hintSimplified: 在意外或灾难中失去生命,是比较正式的说法。
hintTraditional: 在意外或災難中失去生命,是比較正式的說法。
hintEnglish: To lose one's life in an accident or disaster; a rather formal expression.

definition: CL:陣|阵[zhen4]; disturbance; uproar; to become restless
exampleSimplified: 听到这个消息,人群中出现了一阵骚动。
exampleTraditional: 聽到這個訊息,人群中出現了一陣騷動。
exampleEnglish: Hearing this news, a commotion broke out in the crowd.
hintSimplified: 很多人因为突然的事情而不安、吵闹起来。
hintTraditional: 很多人因為突然的事情而不安、吵鬧起來。
hintEnglish: When many people become uneasy and noisy because of something sudden.

exampleSimplified: 我嫂子做的菜特别好吃。
exampleTraditional: 我嫂子做的菜特別好吃。
exampleEnglish: The dishes my sister-in-law cooks are especially delicious.
hintSimplified: 哥哥的太太,你会这样称呼她。
hintTraditional: 哥哥的太太,你會這樣稱呼她。
hintEnglish: Your older brother's wife; this is how you address her.

exampleSimplified: 这颗珍珠的色泽非常漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 這顆珍珠的色澤非常漂亮。
exampleEnglish: The color and luster of this pearl is very beautiful.
hintSimplified: 指物体表面的颜色和光亮的样子。
hintTraditional: 指物體表面的顏色和光亮的樣子。
hintEnglish: Refers to the color and shine on the surface of an object.

definition: a brake; to brake (when driving); to check (bad habits); to stop; to switch off
exampleSimplified: 这辆车的刹车坏了,太危险了。
exampleTraditional: 這輛車的剎車壞了,太危險了。
exampleEnglish: This car's brake is broken; it's too dangerous.
hintSimplified: 汽车或脚踏车上让车子慢下来或停住的装置。
hintTraditional: 汽車或腳踏車上讓車子慢下來或停住的裝置。
hintEnglish: The device on a car or bicycle that makes it slow down or stop.

exampleSimplified: 前面突然有人过马路,司机赶紧煞车。
exampleTraditional: 前面突然有人過馬路,司機趕緊煞車。
exampleEnglish: Someone suddenly crossed the road ahead, so the driver braked quickly.
hintSimplified: 开车时为了不撞到东西,让车子马上停下来的动作。
hintTraditional: 開車時為了不撞到東西,讓車子馬上停下來的動作。
hintEnglish: The action of making a vehicle stop right away while driving so as not to hit something.

exampleSimplified: 他喊了一整晚,声音都变得沙哑了。
exampleTraditional: 他喊了一整晚,聲音都變得沙啞了。
exampleEnglish: He shouted all night and his voice became hoarse.
hintSimplified: 形容嗓子不舒服时,声音粗粗的、不清楚。
hintTraditional: 形容嗓子不舒服時,聲音粗粗的、不清楚。
hintEnglish: Describes a voice that is rough and unclear when the throat is unwell.

exampleSimplified: 你别当傻瓜了,他是在骗你的钱。
exampleTraditional: 你別當傻瓜了,他是在騙你的錢。
exampleEnglish: Stop being a fool; he's trying to cheat you out of your money.
hintSimplified: 形容不聪明、容易被骗的人,有时也是开玩笑的叫法。
hintTraditional: 形容不聰明、容易被騙的人,有時也是開玩笑的叫法。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is not smart and easily fooled; sometimes used jokingly.

exampleSimplified: 我们终于爬到了这座山峰的最高处。
exampleTraditional: 我們終於爬到了這座山峰的最高處。
exampleEnglish: We finally climbed to the highest point of this mountain peak.
hintSimplified: 山最高、最尖的那个部分。
hintTraditional: 山最高、最尖的那個部分。
hintEnglish: The highest, pointed part of a mountain.

exampleSimplified: 春天的时候,山谷里开满了野花。
exampleTraditional: 春天的時候,山谷裡開滿了野花。
exampleEnglish: In spring, the valley is full of wildflowers.
hintSimplified: 两座山之间低低的、狭长的地方。
hintTraditional: 兩座山之間低低的、狹長的地方。
hintEnglish: The low, narrow area between two mountains.

exampleSimplified: 台湾的中央山脉很长,有很多高山。
exampleTraditional: 台灣的中央山脈很長,有很多高山。
exampleEnglish: Taiwan's Central Mountain Range is very long and has many high mountains.
hintSimplified: 许多山连在一起,像一条长长的线。
hintTraditional: 許多山連在一起,像一條長長的線。
hintEnglish: Many mountains linked together like a long line.

exampleSimplified: 天空中划过一道闪电,接着传来雷声。
exampleTraditional: 天空中劃過一道閃電,接著傳來雷聲。
exampleEnglish: A flash of lightning streaked across the sky, followed by the sound of thunder.
hintSimplified: 下大雨时天空中突然出现的明亮光线,后面常有雷声。
hintTraditional: 下大雨時天空中突然出現的明亮光線,後面常有雷聲。
hintEnglish: The bright light that suddenly appears in the sky in a rainstorm, often followed by thunder.

definition: to be evasive; to equivocate; to glisten; to glitter; to twinkle; to flicker
exampleSimplified: 夜空中的星星一闪一闪地闪烁着。
exampleTraditional: 夜空中的星星一閃一閃地閃爍著。
exampleEnglish: The stars in the night sky twinkle on and off.
hintSimplified: 形容光一亮一暗、不稳定的样子,像远处的星星。
hintTraditional: 形容光一亮一暗、不穩定的樣子,像遠處的星星。
hintEnglish: Describes light that goes bright and dim unsteadily, like distant stars.

definition: to glint; to glitter; to radiate; to sparkle
exampleSimplified: 阳光下,湖面闪耀着金色的光芒。
exampleTraditional: 陽光下,湖面閃耀著金色的光芒。
exampleEnglish: Under the sunlight, the lake surface glitters with golden light.
hintSimplified: 形容光线强烈而明亮,让人觉得很耀眼。
hintTraditional: 形容光線強烈而明亮,讓人覺得很耀眼。
hintEnglish: Describes light that is strong and bright, dazzling to the eyes.

gloss: to be good at; to be expert in
definition: to be good at; to be expert in
exampleSimplified: 她很擅长画画,也喜欢教小朋友。
exampleTraditional: 她很擅長畫畫,也喜歡教小朋友。
exampleEnglish: She is very good at drawing and also likes teaching children.
hintSimplified: 对某件事特别熟练,做得比一般人好。
hintTraditional: 對某件事特別熟練,做得比一般人好。
hintEnglish: Being especially skilled at something, doing it better than most people.

exampleSimplified: 医生帮他清洗伤口,然后包上纱布。
exampleTraditional: 醫生幫他清洗傷口,然後包上紗布。
exampleEnglish: The doctor cleaned his wound and then wrapped it in gauze.
hintSimplified: 身体被刀或其他东西弄破的地方,需要消毒和包起来。
hintTraditional: 身體被刀或其他東西弄破的地方,需要消毒和包起來。
hintEnglish: The place on the body broken by a knife or something else, needing disinfecting and bandaging.

exampleSimplified: 这次地震造成了很多人员伤亡。
exampleTraditional: 這次地震造成了很多人員傷亡。
exampleEnglish: This earthquake caused many casualties.
hintSimplified: 意外或灾难发生后，受伤和死去的人。
hintTraditional: 意外或災難發生後，受傷和死去的人。
hintEnglish: The people who were hurt or killed after an accident or disaster.

gloss: to bring up various ideas for discussion
definition: to bring up various ideas for discussion; to discuss
exampleSimplified: 这个问题还有商榷的余地，我们再想想。
exampleTraditional: 這個問題還有商榷的餘地，我們再想想。
exampleEnglish: There is still room for discussion on this issue; let's think again.
hintSimplified: 对别人的意见或做法，礼貌地提出想法一起讨论。
hintTraditional: 對別人的意見或做法，禮貌地提出想法一起討論。
hintEnglish: Politely putting forward ideas to discuss about someone's opinion or approach.

exampleSimplified: 公司的主管正在商讨明年的计划。
exampleTraditional: 公司的主管正在商討明年的計劃。
exampleEnglish: The company's managers are discussing next year's plan.
hintSimplified: 几个人一起认真讨论，想找出办法。
hintTraditional: 幾個人一起認真討論，想找出辦法。
hintEnglish: Several people seriously talk together to find a solution.

exampleSimplified: 他因为压力太大，一时想不开而上吊了。
exampleTraditional: 他因為壓力太大，一時想不開而上吊了。
exampleEnglish: Under too much pressure, he couldn't cope and hanged himself.
hintSimplified: 用绳子套住脖子结束生命的一种悲伤行为。
hintTraditional: 用繩子套住脖子結束生命的一種悲傷行為。
hintEnglish: A sad act of ending one's life with a rope around the neck.

exampleSimplified: 这是上好的茶叶，只有贵客来才泡。
exampleTraditional: 這是上好的茶葉，只有貴客來才泡。
exampleEnglish: This is top-quality tea, brewed only when honored guests come.
hintSimplified: 形容东西的品质非常高，是最好的那一等。
hintTraditional: 形容東西的品質非常高，是最好的那一等。
hintEnglish: Describes something of very high quality, the best grade.

definition: fig. ambitious to improve oneself; to do better; to make progress; to move forwards
exampleSimplified: 他是个很上进的年轻人，每天都努力学习。
exampleTraditional: 他是個很上進的年輕人，每天都努力學習。
exampleEnglish: He is a very motivated young man who studies hard every day.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人有目标，一直想让自己变得更好。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人有目標，一直想讓自己變得更好。
hintEnglish: Describes a person with goals who always wants to become better.

definition: (Tw) topless; the skies above a certain place; (aviation) airspace
exampleSimplified: 一架飞机从我们的上空飞过。
exampleTraditional: 一架飛機從我們的上空飛過。
exampleEnglish: A plane flew over the sky above us.
hintSimplified: 指某个地方上面很高的天空范围。
hintTraditional: 指某個地方上面很高的天空範圍。
hintEnglish: The high area of sky above a certain place.

definition: to be on one's way; to start on a journey
exampleSimplified: 天一亮，他们就收拾行李上路了。
exampleTraditional: 天一亮，他們就收拾行李上路了。
exampleEnglish: As soon as it got light, they packed up and set off.
hintSimplified: 准备好以后，开始出发去远的地方。
hintTraditional: 準備好以後，開始出發去遠的地方。
hintEnglish: After getting ready, starting out toward a faraway place.

definition: (of a shop) to close; to drop in; to go and live with one's wife's family, in effect becoming a member of her family; to lock a door; to visit
exampleSimplified: 医生答应下午上门替老人检查身体。
exampleTraditional: 醫生答應下午上門替老人檢查身體。
exampleEnglish: The doctor agreed to visit the elderly man's home this afternoon for a checkup.
hintSimplified: 亲自到别人家里去拜访或提供服务。
hintTraditional: 親自到別人家裡去拜訪或提供服務。
hintEnglish: Going in person to someone's home to visit or provide a service.

exampleSimplified: 我的上司今天要我加班。
exampleTraditional: 我的上司今天要我加班。
exampleEnglish: My superior asked me to work overtime today.
hintSimplified: 在公司里职位比你高、管你的人。
hintTraditional: 在公司裡職位比你高、管你的人。
hintEnglish: The person at work who ranks above you and manages you.

exampleSimplified: 我打算在十月上旬去日本旅行。
exampleTraditional: 我打算在十月上旬去日本旅行。
exampleEnglish: I plan to travel to Japan in the first ten days of October.
hintSimplified: 一个月里从一号到十号的这段时间。
hintTraditional: 一個月裡從一號到十號的這段時間。
hintEnglish: The period of a month from the 1st to the 10th.

definition: a screening; a staging; to screen (a movie); to stage (a play)
exampleSimplified: 这部新电影下个月就要在各大戏院上演。
exampleTraditional: 這部新電影下個月就要在各大戲院上演。
exampleEnglish: This new movie will be shown in major cinemas next month.
hintSimplified: 戏剧或电影在剧场、戏院给观众看。
hintTraditional: 戲劇或電影在劇場、戲院給觀眾看。
hintEnglish: A play or film being presented to audiences in a theater.

definition: to become addicted; to get into a habit
exampleSimplified: 他玩手机游戏玩到上瘾，每天都停不下来。
exampleTraditional: 他玩手機遊戲玩到上癮，每天都停不下來。
exampleEnglish: He's addicted to mobile games and can't stop every day.
hintSimplified: 对某件事或某种东西太依赖，很难戒掉。
hintTraditional: 對某件事或某種東西太依賴，很難戒掉。
hintEnglish: Becoming so dependent on something that it is hard to quit.

exampleSimplified: 最近蔬菜的价格一直上涨。
exampleTraditional: 最近蔬菜的價格一直上漲。
exampleEnglish: Vegetable prices have been rising lately.
hintSimplified: 物价或水位变得比以前更高。
hintTraditional: 物價或水位變得比以前更高。
hintEnglish: Prices or water levels becoming higher than before.

exampleSimplified: 新年的时候，奶奶会去庙里烧香拜拜。
exampleTraditional: 新年的時候，奶奶會去廟裡燒香拜拜。
exampleEnglish: At New Year, grandma goes to the temple to burn incense and pray.
hintSimplified: 在庙里拜神时，点燃一种有香味的细棍子。
hintTraditional: 在廟裡拜神時，點燃一種有香味的細棍子。
hintEnglish: At a temple, lighting thin scented sticks while worshipping.

exampleSimplified: 他过着奢侈的生活，常常买名牌包。
exampleTraditional: 他過著奢侈的生活，常常買名牌包。
exampleEnglish: He lives a luxurious life and often buys designer bags.
hintSimplified: 花钱太多，追求不必要的享受。
hintTraditional: 花錢太多，追求不必要的享受。
hintEnglish: Spending too much money, pursuing unnecessary comforts.

definition: an extravagant hope; to have excessive expectations
exampleSimplified: 对穷学生来说，买房子只是一种奢望。
exampleTraditional: 對窮學生來說，買房子只是一種奢望。
exampleEnglish: For a poor student, buying a house is just an unrealistic hope.
hintSimplified: 很难实现、几乎不可能得到的愿望。
hintTraditional: 很難實現、幾乎不可能得到的願望。
hintEnglish: A wish that is very hard to realize, almost impossible to get.

exampleSimplified: 这个公园的设施很新，也很干净。
exampleTraditional: 這個公園的設施很新，也很乾淨。
exampleEnglish: The facilities in this park are new and clean.
hintSimplified: 为了方便大家使用而建好的各种设备。
hintTraditional: 為了方便大家使用而建好的各種裝置。
hintEnglish: The various equipment built for everyone's convenience.

definition: tentative plan; to assume; to envisage; to have consideration for; to imagine
exampleSimplified: 你可以先设想一下最坏的情况。
exampleTraditional: 你可以先設想一下最壞的情況。
exampleEnglish: You can first imagine the worst-case scenario.
hintSimplified: 在事情发生前，先在脑中想象可能的情形。
hintTraditional: 在事情發生前，先在腦中想象可能的情形。
hintEnglish: Picturing in your mind how things might turn out before they happen.

exampleSimplified: 他每个周末都去靶场练习射击。
exampleTraditional: 他每個週末都去靶場練習射擊。
exampleEnglish: He goes to the range every weekend to practice shooting.
hintSimplified: 用枪或弓对准目标，把子弹或箭发出去。
hintTraditional: 用槍或弓對準目標，把子彈或箭發出去。
hintEnglish: Aiming a gun or bow at a target and sending out bullets or arrows.

exampleSimplified: 这位射手在比赛中连续命中了十个靶。
exampleTraditional: 這位射手在比賽中連續命中了十個靶。
exampleEnglish: This marksman hit ten targets in a row in the competition.
hintSimplified: 擅长用枪或弓射击的人，或球队中负责进球的人。
hintTraditional: 擅長用槍或弓射擊的人，或球隊中負責進球的人。
hintEnglish: A person skilled at shooting with a gun or bow, or a team's goal scorer.

gloss: to involve; to relate to; to concern; to touch upon
definition: to involve; to relate to; to concern; to touch upon
exampleSimplified: 这个问题涉及很多不同的部门。
exampleTraditional: 這個問題涉及很多不同的部門。
exampleEnglish: This problem involves many different departments.
hintSimplified: 某件事和别的事情有关系，牵连到它。
hintTraditional: 某件事和別的事情有關係，牽連到它。
hintEnglish: One matter is connected to or reaches into other matters.

gloss: to be a suspect (in a crime)
definition: to be a suspect (in a crime); to be suspected of
exampleSimplified: 他涉嫌诈骗，警察正在调查。
exampleTraditional: 他涉嫌詐騙，警察正在調查。
exampleEnglish: He is suspected of fraud, and the police are investigating.
hintSimplified: 有证据让人怀疑某人做了违法的事，但还没有定罪。
hintTraditional: 有證據讓人懷疑某人做了違法的事，但還沒有定罪。
hintEnglish: There is evidence to suspect someone of an illegal act, but no verdict yet.

exampleSimplified: 今天报纸的社论讨论了环保问题。
exampleTraditional: 今天報紙的社論討論了環保問題。
exampleEnglish: Today's newspaper editorial discussed environmental issues.
hintSimplified: 报纸上代表报社发表意见的文章。
hintTraditional: 報紙上代表報社發表意見的文章。
hintEnglish: An article in a newspaper expressing the paper's own opinion.

definition: intake; to absorb (nutrients etc); to assimilate; to take a photograph of (a scene)
exampleSimplified: 每天要摄取足够的蛋白质和维生素。
exampleTraditional: 每天要攝取足夠的蛋白質和維生素。
exampleEnglish: You need to take in enough protein and vitamins every day.
hintSimplified: 从食物中吸收身体需要的营养。
hintTraditional: 從食物中吸收身體需要的營養。
hintEnglish: Absorbing the nutrients the body needs from food.

exampleSimplified: 今天的气温是三十度,也就是摄氏三十度。
exampleTraditional: 今天的氣溫是三十度,也就是攝氏三十度。
exampleEnglish: Today's temperature is thirty degrees, that is, thirty degrees Celsius.
hintSimplified: 台湾天气预报用的温度单位,水在一百度会沸腾。
hintTraditional: 台灣天氣預報用的溫度單位,水在一百度會沸騰。
hintEnglish: The temperature scale used in Taiwan's weather forecasts, in which water boils at one hundred degrees.

exampleSimplified: 这本书的内容太深奥了,我看不懂。
exampleTraditional: 這本書的內容太深奧了,我看不懂。
exampleEnglish: The content of this book is too abstruse; I can't understand it.
hintSimplified: 形容道理或学问很难懂,需要花很多时间研究。
hintTraditional: 形容道理或學問很難懂,需要花很多時間研究。
hintEnglish: Describes a theory or field of knowledge that is hard to understand and takes much study.

definition: (of a person) reserved; (of a voice, sound etc) deep; deep; low-pitched; profound; undemonstrative
exampleSimplified: 他是个深沉的人,很少说出自己的想法。
exampleTraditional: 他是個深沉的人,很少說出自己的想法。
exampleEnglish: He is a reserved person who rarely says what he thinks.
hintSimplified: 形容人不轻易表现情绪,心思很重,让人看不透。
hintTraditional: 形容人不輕易表現情緒,心思很重,讓人看不透。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who doesn't easily show emotions and is hard to read.

definition: (of a speech etc) profundity; advanced stage of development; depth
exampleSimplified: 这篇报道很有深度,让我学到很多。
exampleTraditional: 這篇報道很有深度,讓我學到很多。
exampleEnglish: This report has real depth; I learned a lot from it.
hintSimplified: 指文章或想法不肤浅,也指水从上到下的距离。
hintTraditional: 指文章或想法不膚淺,也指水從上到下的距離。
hintEnglish: Refers to how non-superficial an article or idea is; also the distance from the surface down in water.

exampleSimplified: 他们之间有着深厚的友情。
exampleTraditional: 他們之間有著深厚的友情。
exampleEnglish: There is a deep friendship between them.
hintSimplified: 形容感情或基础很扎实、很浓,不容易改变。
hintTraditional: 形容感情或基礎很紮實、很濃,不容易改變。
hintEnglish: Describes feelings or foundations that are solid and strong, not easily changed.

exampleSimplified: 这次旅行让我深切感受到家人的重要。
exampleTraditional: 這次旅行讓我深切感受到家人的重要。
exampleEnglish: This trip made me deeply feel how important family is.
hintSimplified: 形容感受或体会非常真实、强烈,从心里来的。
hintTraditional: 形容感受或體會非常真實、強烈,從心裡來的。
hintEnglish: Describes a feeling or realization that is very real and intense, from the heart.

exampleSimplified: 他打算毕业后去国外深造。
exampleTraditional: 他打算畢業後去國外深造。
exampleEnglish: He plans to go abroad for further study after graduating.
hintSimplified: 大学毕业以后,继续念更高的学位或学更专业的东西。
hintTraditional: 大學畢業以後,繼續念更高的學位或學更專業的東西。
hintEnglish: After finishing university, continuing to study for a higher degree or more specialized knowledge.

definition: a woman's physique; figure; posture on stage
exampleSimplified: 这位舞者的身段非常优美。
exampleTraditional: 這位舞者的身段非常優美。
exampleEnglish: This dancer's figure and poise are very graceful.
hintSimplified: 指人的体态或姿态,也指舞台上演员的动作。
hintTraditional: 指人的體態或姿態,也指舞台上演員的動作。
hintEnglish: Refers to a person's figure or bearing, also a performer's movements on stage.

exampleSimplified: 父母的身教比言教更重要。
exampleTraditional: 父母的身教比言教更重要。
exampleEnglish: Parents' teaching by example matters more than teaching by words.
hintSimplified: 不只用嘴巴说,而是用自己的行为给别人做榜样。
hintTraditional: 不只用嘴巴說,而是用自己的行為給別人做榜樣。
hintEnglish: Not just using words, but setting an example through one's own behavior.

exampleSimplified: 身为老师,我要以身作则。
exampleTraditional: 身為老師,我要以身作則。
exampleEnglish: As a teacher, I must lead by example.
hintSimplified: 放在句首,说明某人的身份或角色,后面常接应该做的事。
hintTraditional: 放在句首,說明某人的身份或角色,後面常接應該做的事。
hintEnglish: Placed at the start of a sentence to state someone's role or status, often followed by what they should do.

exampleSimplified: 天气冷了,你要注意身子,别感冒了。
exampleTraditional: 天氣冷了,你要注意身子,別感冒了。
exampleEnglish: It's getting cold; take care of yourself and don't catch a cold.
hintSimplified: 口语中指人的躯体,也常指健康状况。
hintTraditional: 口語中指人的軀體,也常指健康狀況。
hintEnglish: In spoken language, refers to a person's body, often also to their health.

definition: to promote; to uphold (e.g. justice or virtue)
exampleSimplified: 我们应该伸张正义,帮助弱者。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該伸張正義,幫助弱者。
exampleEnglish: We should uphold justice and help the weak.
hintSimplified: 让正义、权利等理念得到发扬和实现。
hintTraditional: 讓正義、權利等理念得到發揚和實現。
hintEnglish: To make ideals like justice or rights be upheld and realized.

exampleSimplified: 她脸上的神情看起来很紧张。
exampleTraditional: 她臉上的神情看起來很緊張。
exampleEnglish: The look on her face seemed very nervous.
hintSimplified: 从脸上和眼神看得出来的心情或态度。
hintTraditional: 從臉上和眼神看得出來的心情或態度。
hintEnglish: The mood or attitude that can be seen from someone's face and eyes.

exampleSimplified: 这份申请要经过主管审核才能通过。
exampleTraditional: 這份申請要經過主管審核才能透過。
exampleEnglish: This application must be reviewed by the supervisor before it can be approved.
hintSimplified: 检查资料是否正确,再决定能不能通过。
hintTraditional: 檢查資料是否正確,再決定能不能透過。
hintEnglish: Checking whether documents are correct before deciding whether to approve them.

exampleSimplified: 法院明天将对这个案子进行审判。
exampleTraditional: 法院明天將對這個案子進行審判。
exampleEnglish: The court will hold a trial for this case tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 法官在法院里听双方说法,再决定对错。
hintTraditional: 法官在法院裡聽雙方說法,再決定對錯。
hintEnglish: A judge in court hears both sides and then decides who is right or wrong.

exampleSimplified: 做这么大的决定,我们必须审慎考虑。
exampleTraditional: 做這麼大的決定,我們必須審慎考慮。
exampleEnglish: For such a big decision, we must consider carefully.
hintSimplified: 做事前仔细想清楚,不随便,怕出错。
hintTraditional: 做事前仔細想清楚,不隨便,怕出錯。
hintEnglish: Thinking things over carefully before acting, not being casual, for fear of mistakes.

gloss: (of a committee etc) to deliberate; to consider; to discuss
definition: (of a committee etc) to deliberate; to consider; to discuss
exampleSimplified: 委员会正在审议新的预算案。
exampleTraditional: 委員會正在審議新的預算案。
exampleEnglish: The committee is deliberating on the new budget proposal.
hintSimplified: 会议中大家仔细讨论一个提案,再决定是否通过。
hintTraditional: 會議中大家仔細討論一個提案,再決定是否透過。
hintEnglish: In a meeting, people discuss a proposal carefully before deciding whether to pass it.

exampleSimplified: 雨水慢慢渗入土壤里。
exampleTraditional: 雨水慢慢滲入土壤裡。
exampleEnglish: Rainwater slowly seeps into the soil.
hintSimplified: 液体一点一点进到物体里面,也可比喻思想影响别处。
hintTraditional: 液體一點一點進到物體裡面,也可比喻思想影響別處。
hintEnglish: Liquid gets into something bit by bit; figuratively, ideas spreading into other areas.

gloss: to make a fire; to light a fire
definition: to make a fire; to light a fire
exampleSimplified: 我们在营地里生火煮晚饭。
exampleTraditional: 我們在營地裡生火煮晚飯。
exampleEnglish: We lit a fire at the campsite to cook dinner.
hintSimplified: 露营时,先用木柴让火烧起来,才能烤东西。
hintTraditional: 露營時,先用木柴讓火燒起來,才能烤東西。
hintEnglish: When camping, you get a fire going with wood before you can cook.

exampleSimplified: 青春期会出现很多生理上的变化。
exampleTraditional: 青春期會出現很多生理上的變化。
exampleEnglish: Many physiological changes appear during puberty.
hintSimplified: 跟身体器官怎么运作有关的,不是心理方面的。
hintTraditional: 跟身體器官怎麼運作有關的,不是心理方面的。
hintEnglish: Relating to how the body's organs function, as opposed to the mind.

definition: in one's entire life; life (a person's whole life)
exampleSimplified: 这位老人生平最爱的就是读书。
exampleTraditional: 這位老人生平最愛的就是讀書。
exampleEnglish: What this old man loved most in his whole life was reading.
hintSimplified: 指一个人从出生到现在或去世前的整个一辈子。
hintTraditional: 指一個人從出生到現在或去世前的整個一輩子。
hintEnglish: Refers to a person's entire life, from birth up to now or until death.

definition: (of a deceased) during one's life; while living
exampleSimplified: 他生前很喜欢帮助别人。
exampleTraditional: 他生前很喜歡幫助別人。
exampleEnglish: While he was alive, he liked helping others very much.
hintSimplified: 说已经去世的人,在还活着的那段时间。
hintTraditional: 說已經去世的人,在還活著的那段時間。
hintEnglish: Said of a person who has died, referring to the time when they were still alive.

definition: living person; stranger; to be born (in a certain time or place); to give birth
exampleSimplified: 这只狗很怕生人,看到客人就躲起来。
exampleTraditional: 這隻狗很怕生人,看到客人就躲起來。
exampleEnglish: This dog is afraid of strangers and hides when it sees guests.
hintSimplified: 指自己不认识、没见过的人。
hintTraditional: 指自己不認識、沒見過的人。
hintEnglish: Refers to someone you don't know and have never met.

exampleSimplified: 医生每天都面对生死的考验。
exampleTraditional: 醫生每天都面對生死的考驗。
exampleEnglish: Doctors face the test of life and death every day.
hintSimplified: 活下来或是离开人世,这两种情况合在一起说。
hintTraditional: 活下來或是離開人世,這兩種情況合在一起說。
hintEnglish: Surviving or leaving this world: these two outcomes spoken of together.

gloss: (fig.) ecosystem (a complex network, e.g. in tech, business or media, as in 數字生態|数字生态[shu4 zi4 sheng1 tai4] "digital ecosystem")
definition: (fig.) ecosystem (a complex network, e.g. in tech, business or media, as in 數字生態|数字生态[shu4 zi4 sheng1 tai4] "digital ecosystem"); ecological state (the condition or health of a natural environment); ecology (the study of interactions between organisms and their environment)
exampleSimplified: 保护生态环境是我们共同的责任。
exampleTraditional: 保護生態環境是我們共同的責任。
exampleEnglish: Protecting the ecological environment is our shared responsibility.
hintSimplified: 指生物和它们周围环境之间互相影响的关系。
hintTraditional: 指生物和它們周圍環境之間互相影響的關係。
hintEnglish: Refers to the interrelationship between living things and their surroundings.

definition: (attributive) biological; bio-; organism; living creature; life form
exampleSimplified: 这位老师研究海洋生物已经二十年了。
exampleTraditional: 這位老師研究海洋生物已經二十年了。
exampleEnglish: This teacher has been studying marine life for twenty years.
hintSimplified: 动物、植物和细菌等有生命的东西，都可以这样统称。
hintTraditional: 動物、植物和細菌等有生命的東西，都可以這樣統稱。
hintEnglish: A collective term for animals, plants, bacteria and other living things.

gloss: (of a law, contract, agreement, ban etc) to come into force; to go into effect; to become operative
definition: (of a law, contract, agreement, ban etc) to come into force; to go into effect; to become operative
exampleSimplified: 新的规定从下个月一号起生效。
exampleTraditional: 新的規定從下個月一號起生效。
exampleEnglish: The new regulation takes effect on the first of next month.
hintSimplified: 法律或合同从某个时间开始正式有作用。
hintTraditional: 法律或合同從某個時間開始正式有作用。
hintEnglish: When a law or contract officially begins to have force from a certain time.

gloss: rigid; stiff; lacking naturalness or smoothness; awkward; forced
definition: rigid; stiff; lacking naturalness or smoothness; awkward; forced
exampleSimplified: 他的翻译太生硬了,读起来很不自然。
exampleTraditional: 他的翻譯太生硬了,讀起來很不自然。
exampleEnglish: His translation is too stiff and reads very unnaturally.
hintSimplified: 形容说话、动作或文字不自然、不流畅。
hintTraditional: 形容說話、動作或文字不自然、不流暢。
hintEnglish: Describes speech, movement or writing that is unnatural and not smooth.

definition: fertility; to give birth to; to bear
exampleSimplified: 很多年轻夫妻现在不太愿意生育孩子。
exampleTraditional: 很多年輕夫妻現在不太願意生育孩子。
exampleEnglish: Many young couples today are not very willing to have children.
hintSimplified: 女人怀孕后生下小孩,并把孩子养大。
hintTraditional: 女人懷孕後生下小孩,並把孩子養大。
hintEnglish: A woman bearing children and bringing them into the world.

exampleSimplified: 这种动物的生殖能力很强。
exampleTraditional: 這種動物的生殖能力很強。
exampleEnglish: This animal has a strong reproductive ability.
hintSimplified: 生物产生下一代的过程,常出现在生物课里。
hintTraditional: 生物產生下一代的過程,常出現在生物課裡。
hintEnglish: The process by which living things produce the next generation, often seen in biology class.

gloss: to advance to a higher-level position; to be promoted to a higher position in a new department
definition: to advance to a higher-level position; to be promoted to a higher position in a new department
exampleSimplified: 他工作很努力,去年终于升迁为经理。
exampleTraditional: 他工作很努力,去年終於升遷為經理。
exampleEnglish: He worked hard and was finally promoted to manager last year.
hintSimplified: 在公司里职位变高了。
hintTraditional: 在公司裡職位變高了。
hintEnglish: Getting a higher position at a company.

definition: to appreciate; to rise in value
exampleSimplified: 这几年房子升值了很多,他赚了不少钱。
exampleTraditional: 這幾年房子升值了很多,他賺了不少錢。
exampleEnglish: Houses have risen a lot in value in recent years, and he made quite a bit of money.
hintSimplified: 东西或货币的价格比以前更高。
hintTraditional: 東西或貨幣的價格比以前更高。
hintEnglish: Something's or a currency's value becomes higher than before.

definition: to assert; to claim; to proclaim; to state
exampleSimplified: 他声称自己昨天晚上一直在家。
exampleTraditional: 他聲稱自己昨天晚上一直在家。
exampleEnglish: He claimed that he was at home all last night.
hintSimplified: 公开地说自己做了什么,但别人不一定相信。
hintTraditional: 公開地說自己做了什麼,但別人不一定相信。
hintEnglish: To say publicly that something is so, though others may not believe it.

definition: CL:項|项[xiang4],份[fen4]; declaration; statement; to declare; to state
exampleSimplified: 公司发表了一份声明,解释这件事的原因。
exampleTraditional: 公司發表了一份聲明,解釋這件事的原因。
exampleEnglish: The company issued a statement explaining the reason for this matter.
hintSimplified: 政府或公司公开发表的正式文字,说明立场。
hintTraditional: 政府或公司公開發表的正式文字,說明立場。
hintEnglish: An official text publicly released by a government or company to state its position.

definition: fame and power; impetus; influence; momentum; prestige
exampleSimplified: 游行的人很多,声势非常浩大。
exampleTraditional: 遊行的人很多,聲勢非常浩大。
exampleEnglish: There were many marchers, and the momentum was tremendous.
hintSimplified: 指一件事给人的力量和气势,让人觉得很大。
hintTraditional: 指一件事給人的力量和氣勢,讓人覺得很大。
hintEnglish: The force and impressive scale that an event gives people.

definition: (archaic) to handle administrative work; perceptive; understanding; to simplify matters; to save trouble
exampleSimplified: 用洗碗机洗碗比较省事。
exampleTraditional: 用洗碗機洗碗比較省事。
exampleEnglish: Washing dishes with a dishwasher is more convenient and saves effort.
hintSimplified: 做事的方法简单,不用花很多力气或麻烦。
hintTraditional: 做事的方法簡單,不用花很多力氣或麻煩。
hintEnglish: A way of doing things that is simple and doesn't take much effort or trouble.

exampleSimplified: 谢谢你们的盛情款待,我们玩得很开心。
exampleTraditional: 謝謝你們的盛情款待,我們玩得很開心。
exampleEnglish: Thank you for your generous hospitality; we had a great time.
hintSimplified: 主人对客人非常热情、很有诚意的心意。
hintTraditional: 主人對客人非常熱情、很有誠意的心意。
hintEnglish: A host's very warm and sincere kindness toward guests.

gloss: to be in vogue; to be popular; to be prevalent
definition: to be in vogue; to be popular; to be prevalent
exampleSimplified: 这种运动在年轻人之间很盛行。
exampleTraditional: 這種運動在年輕人之間很盛行。
exampleEnglish: This kind of sport is very popular among young people.
hintSimplified: 某种东西或风气在一段时间里很多人喜欢、很流行。
hintTraditional: 某種東西或風氣在一段時間裡很多人喜歡、很流行。
hintEnglish: When a trend or custom is widespread and liked by many people for a time.

definition: (of a receptacle etc) to contain; one's Sunday best; rich attire; splendid clothes
exampleSimplified: 婚礼上,客人们都盛装出席。
exampleTraditional: 婚禮上,客人們都盛裝出席。
exampleEnglish: At the wedding, the guests all attended dressed in their finest.
hintSimplified: 为了重要场合,穿上最漂亮、最正式的衣服。
hintTraditional: 為了重要場合,穿上最漂亮、最正式的衣服。
hintEnglish: Wearing one's most beautiful and formal clothes for an important occasion.

exampleSimplified: 阿里山是台湾有名的旅游胜地。
exampleTraditional: 阿里山是台灣有名的旅遊勝地。
exampleEnglish: Alishan is a famous tourist attraction in Taiwan.
hintSimplified: 风景很美、很多人去玩的有名地方。
hintTraditional: 風景很美、很多人去玩的有名地方。
hintEnglish: A famous place with beautiful scenery that many people visit.

definition: Buddhist lama; a sage; virtuous ruler; wine; wise and holy man
exampleSimplified: 孔子被后人尊为圣贤。
exampleTraditional: 孔子被後人尊為聖賢。
exampleEnglish: Confucius is revered by later generations as a sage.
hintSimplified: 品德和智慧都极高、受人尊敬的古代人物。
hintTraditional: 品德和智慧都極高、受人尊敬的古代人物。
hintEnglish: An ancient figure of the highest virtue and wisdom, deeply respected.

definition: a failing (of a system); not working properly; out of order (of machine)
exampleSimplified: 手机触控屏幕突然失灵了,怎么按都没反应。
exampleTraditional: 手機觸控螢幕突然失靈了,怎麼按都沒反應。
exampleEnglish: The phone's touchscreen suddenly stopped working; nothing responds however I press.
hintSimplified: 机器或设备本来能用,却忽然不能正常工作。
hintTraditional: 機器或裝置本來能用,卻忽然不能正常工作。
hintEnglish: A machine or device that used to work suddenly stops functioning properly.

definition: disappointment; frustrated; loss; to drop (sth); to feel a sense of loss; to lose (sth)
exampleSimplified: 考试没考好,他心里觉得很失落。
exampleTraditional: 考試沒考好,他心裡覺得很失落。
exampleEnglish: He didn't do well on the exam and felt very down.
hintSimplified: 希望没有实现时,心里空空的、不开心的感觉。
hintTraditional: 希望沒有實現時,心裡空空的、不開心的感覺。
hintEnglish: The empty, unhappy feeling when hopes aren't fulfilled.

definition: blindness; to become blind; to lose one's eyesight
exampleSimplified: 那场意外让他的一只眼睛失明了。
exampleTraditional: 那場意外讓他的一隻眼睛失明了。
exampleEnglish: That accident left one of his eyes blind.
hintSimplified: 眼睛再也看不见东西。
hintTraditional: 眼睛再也看不見東西。
hintEnglish: The eyes can no longer see anything.

gloss: (of a plane, ship etc) to have an accident (plane crash, shipwreck, vehicle collision etc)
definition: (of a plane, ship etc) to have an accident (plane crash, shipwreck, vehicle collision etc); to mess things up
exampleSimplified: 那架飞机在山区失事,幸好没有人受伤。
exampleTraditional: 那架飛機在山區失事,幸好沒有人受傷。
exampleEnglish: The plane crashed in the mountains, luckily with no one injured.
hintSimplified: 飞机或船等交通工具发生严重的意外。
hintTraditional: 飛機或船等交通工具發生嚴重的意外。
hintEnglish: A serious accident happening to a plane, ship or similar vehicle.

definition: a slip; accidentally; by mistake; miscalculation; to be defeated; to lose control; unwise move
exampleSimplified: 他一失手,杯子就掉到地上摔破了。
exampleTraditional: 他一失手,杯子就掉到地上摔破了。
exampleEnglish: His hand slipped, and the cup fell to the floor and broke.
hintSimplified: 手没有拿稳或没有控制好,东西掉了或出了错。
hintTraditional: 手沒有拿穩或沒有控制好,東西掉了或出了錯。
hintEnglish: The hand loses its grip or control, so something drops or goes wrong.

definition: to be missing; to disappear; unaccounted for
exampleSimplified: 警察正在寻找失踪三天的小女孩。
exampleTraditional: 警察正在尋找失蹤三天的小女孩。
exampleEnglish: The police are searching for the little girl who has been missing for three days.
hintSimplified: 一个人突然不见了,没有人知道他在哪里。
hintTraditional: 一個人突然不見了,沒有人知道他在哪裡。
hintEnglish: A person suddenly vanishes and nobody knows where they are.

definition: normal (school, e.g. Beijing Normal University); pedagogical; teacher-training
exampleSimplified: 她大学读的是师范学院,以后想当老师。
exampleTraditional: 她大學讀的是師範學院,以後想當老師。
exampleEnglish: She attended a teachers college and wants to become a teacher later.
hintSimplified: 专门培养未来老师的学校或专业。
hintTraditional: 專門培養未來老師的學校或專業。
hintEnglish: A school or program specially for training future teachers.

exampleSimplified: 农夫春天时会给田里的蔬菜施肥。
exampleTraditional: 農夫春天時會給田裡的蔬菜施肥。
exampleEnglish: In spring the farmer fertilizes the vegetables in the field.
hintSimplified: 农人为了让植物长得好,在土里加养分。
hintTraditional: 農人為了讓植物長得好,在土裡加養分。
hintEnglish: Farmers add nutrients to the soil so plants grow well.

definition: to put in place; to put into practice; to take effect
exampleSimplified: 这项新办法将从明年一月开始施行。
exampleTraditional: 這項新辦法將從明年一月開始施行。
exampleEnglish: This new measure will be implemented starting next January.
hintSimplified: 法规或办法正式开始实际执行。
hintTraditional: 法規或辦法正式開始實際執行。
hintEnglish: A rule or measure officially begins to be carried out in practice.

exampleSimplified: 警察在河边发现了一具尸体。
exampleTraditional: 警察在河邊發現了一具屍體。
exampleEnglish: The police found a dead body by the river.
hintSimplified: 人死了以后留下来的身体。
hintTraditional: 人死了以後留下來的身體。
hintEnglish: The body left behind after a person has died.

definition: gypsum CaSO4·2(H2O); plaster; plaster cast (for a broken bone)
exampleSimplified: 他的腿骨折了,医生给他打上了石膏。
exampleTraditional: 他的腿骨折了,醫生給他打上了石膏。
exampleEnglish: His leg was broken, so the doctor put it in a plaster cast.
hintSimplified: 白色的粉末加水会变硬,骨折时用来固定手脚。
hintTraditional: 白色的粉末加水會變硬,骨折時用來固定手腳。
hintEnglish: A white powder that hardens with water, used to immobilize a broken limb.

definition: a pure shade (of some color); ample; complete; hundred percent
exampleSimplified: 她唱歌的时候,自信十足。
exampleTraditional: 她唱歌的時候,自信十足。
exampleEnglish: When she sings, she is full of confidence.
hintSimplified: 形容某种气质或程度非常充分、一点也不缺。
hintTraditional: 形容某種氣質或程度非常充分、一點也不缺。
hintEnglish: Describes a quality or degree that is completely full, lacking nothing.

exampleSimplified: 我很怀念小时候那段快乐的时光。
exampleTraditional: 我很懷念小時候那段快樂的時光。
exampleEnglish: I really miss that happy time of my childhood.
hintSimplified: 指一去不回、慢慢流逝的日子或岁月。
hintTraditional: 指一去不回、慢慢流逝的日子或歲月。
hintEnglish: Days or years that slowly pass and never return.

exampleSimplified: 到了秋天这个时节,山上的叶子都红了。
exampleTraditional: 到了秋天這個時節,山上的葉子都紅了。
exampleEnglish: At this time of autumn, the leaves on the mountains all turn red.
hintSimplified: 一年中某个有特色的时期,常和季节或节日有关。
hintTraditional: 一年中某個有特色的時期,常和季節或節日有關。
hintEnglish: A characteristic period of the year, often linked to a season or festival.

exampleSimplified: 她今天穿得很时髦,大家都看着她。
exampleTraditional: 她今天穿得很時髦,大家都看著她。
exampleEnglish: She is dressed very fashionably today, and everyone is looking at her.
hintSimplified: 形容衣服或打扮符合最新的流行。
hintTraditional: 形容衣服或打扮符合最新的流行。
hintEnglish: Describes clothes or style that follow the latest trend.

definition: (law) prescription; limitation; (metallurgy) aging; period of viability or validity; timeliness
exampleSimplified: 这张优惠券的时效只有三天。
exampleTraditional: 這張優惠券的時效只有三天。
exampleEnglish: This coupon is only valid for three days.
hintSimplified: 指某件事或文件在多长时间内有效。
hintTraditional: 指某件事或檔案在多長時間內有效。
hintEnglish: How long something or a document remains effective.

exampleSimplified: 记者到现场实地采访了当地居民。
exampleTraditional: 記者到現場實地採訪了當地居民。
exampleEnglish: The reporter went to the scene and interviewed local residents on site.
hintSimplified: 亲自到真正的地点去做,而不是只在办公室里想。
hintTraditional: 親自到真正的地點去做,而不是隻在辦公室裡想。
hintEnglish: Going personally to the actual place, rather than just thinking in an office.

definition: practice; to carry out (a project); to live up to (a promise); to put into practice
exampleSimplified: 学了理论以后,还要多实践才行。
exampleTraditional: 學了理論以後,還要多實踐才行。
exampleEnglish: After learning the theory, you also need to practice more.
hintSimplified: 把学到的想法或知识真正拿来做。
hintTraditional: 把學到的想法或知識真正拿來做。
hintEnglish: Actually putting learned ideas or knowledge to use.

definition: live (e.g. broadcast or recording); scene; the real situation; what is actually happening
exampleSimplified: 今晚有棒球比赛的实况转播。
exampleTraditional: 今晚有棒球比賽的實況轉播。
exampleEnglish: Tonight there is a live broadcast of the baseball game.
hintSimplified: 电视上同时播出的真实现场情形。
hintTraditional: 電視上同時播出的真實現場情形。
hintEnglish: The real situation at the scene shown on TV as it happens.

definition: (computing) instance; actual example; demonstration; illustration; living example
exampleSimplified: 老师举了一个实例来说明这个问题。
exampleTraditional: 老師舉了一個實例來說明這個問題。
exampleEnglish: The teacher gave a real example to explain this problem.
hintSimplified: 真实发生过、用来说明道理的具体事情。
hintTraditional: 真實發生過、用來說明道理的具體事情。
hintEnglish: A concrete event that really happened, used to explain a point.

definition: field work; internship; to intern; to practice
exampleSimplified: 暑假我要去一家公司实习。
exampleTraditional: 暑假我要去一家公司實習。
exampleEnglish: This summer vacation I'm going to do an internship at a company.
hintSimplified: 学生在毕业前到公司里边做边学。
hintTraditional: 學生在畢業前到公司裡邊做邊學。
hintEnglish: What students do before graduating, working and learning at a company.

exampleSimplified: 这个理论需要更多实证研究来支持。
exampleTraditional: 這個理論需要更多實證研究來支援。
exampleEnglish: This theory needs more empirical research to support it.
hintSimplified: 用真实的资料和实验来证明,不是只靠想象。
hintTraditional: 用真實的資料和實驗來證明,不是隻靠想象。
hintEnglish: Proving with real data and experiments, not just imagination.

exampleSimplified: 这两种做法的实质是一样的。
exampleTraditional: 這兩種做法的實質是一樣的。
exampleEnglish: The essence of these two approaches is the same.
hintSimplified: 一件事情表面下最核心、最根本的内容。
hintTraditional: 一件事情表面下最核心、最根本的內容。
hintEnglish: The core, most fundamental content beneath the surface of something.

exampleSimplified: 研究历史需要收集很多史料。
exampleTraditional: 研究歷史需要收集很多史料。
exampleEnglish: Studying history requires collecting a lot of historical materials.
hintSimplified: 历史学家用来研究过去的文件、记录等资料。
hintTraditional: 歷史學家用來研究過去的檔案、記錄等資料。
hintEnglish: Documents and records historians use to study the past.

gloss: (coll.) to handle (a draught animal, tool, machine etc)
definition: (coll.) to handle (a draught animal, tool, machine etc); Taiwan pr. [shi3 huan4]; to order sb around
exampleSimplified: 他总是把弟弟当佣人使唤。
exampleTraditional: 他總是把弟弟當傭人使喚。
exampleEnglish: He always orders his younger brother around like a servant.
hintSimplified: 叫别人帮自己做事,像指挥下属一样。
hintTraditional: 叫別人幫自己做事,像指揮下屬一樣。
hintEnglish: Telling someone to do things for you, as if directing a subordinate.

exampleSimplified: 各国使节出席了今天的开幕典礼。
exampleTraditional: 各國使節出席了今天的開幕典禮。
exampleEnglish: Envoys from various countries attended today's opening ceremony.
hintSimplified: 国家派到外国去代表自己的外交人员。
hintTraditional: 國家派到外國去代表自己的外交人員。
hintEnglish: Diplomatic personnel a country sends abroad to represent it.

exampleSimplified: 这个箱子很重,你要使劲儿推才行。
exampleTraditional: 這個箱子很重,你要使勁兒推才行。
exampleEnglish: This box is heavy; you have to push with all your strength.
hintSimplified: 搬重东西或拔河时,把全身的力气都用上。
hintTraditional: 搬重東西或拔河時,把全身的力氣都用上。
hintEnglish: Using all your body's strength when moving something heavy or in a tug-of-war.

definition: a calling; long-term task to which one devotes oneself; mission
exampleSimplified: 保护环境是我们每个人的使命。
exampleTraditional: 保護環境是我們每個人的使命。
exampleEnglish: Protecting the environment is the mission of each of us.
hintSimplified: 一个人或团体觉得自己必须完成的重要责任。
hintTraditional: 一個人或團體覺得自己必須完成的重要責任。
hintEnglish: An important responsibility that a person or group feels they must fulfill.

exampleSimplified: 那些士兵每天早上都要练习跑步。
exampleTraditional: 那些士兵每天早上都要練習跑步。
exampleEnglish: Those soldiers have to practice running every morning.
hintSimplified: 在军队里,职位不高的普通军人。
hintTraditional: 在軍隊裡,職位不高的普通軍人。
hintEnglish: Ordinary people of low rank serving in the army.

definition: court lady; palace maid; traditional painting of beautiful women
exampleSimplified: 这幅古画画的是几位仕女在花园里赏花。
exampleTraditional: 這幅古畫畫的是幾位仕女在花園裡賞花。
exampleEnglish: This ancient painting shows several court ladies admiring flowers in a garden.
hintSimplified: 古代画里常见的,穿着漂亮衣服的宫廷或贵族女子。
hintTraditional: 古代畫裡常見的,穿著漂亮衣服的宮廷或貴族女子。
hintEnglish: Women in beautiful clothes from palaces or noble families, often seen in ancient paintings.

definition: a model example; demonstration; to demonstrate; to show how to do sth
exampleSimplified: 老师先示范一遍,然后请同学们跟着做。
exampleTraditional: 老師先示範一遍,然後請同學們跟著做。
exampleEnglish: The teacher first demonstrates once, then asks the students to follow.
hintSimplified: 先自己做给别人看,让别人知道怎么做。
hintTraditional: 先自己做給別人看,讓別人知道怎麼做。
hintEnglish: Doing something first yourself so others can see how it's done.

gloss: the marketplace (i.e. the world of business and commerce)
definition: the marketplace (i.e. the world of business and commerce)
exampleSimplified: 这种手机在市面上已经买不到了。
exampleTraditional: 這種手機在市面上已經買不到了。
exampleEnglish: This kind of phone can no longer be bought on the market.
hintSimplified: 指商品在商店里流通、买卖的情况。
hintTraditional: 指商品在商店裡流通、買賣的情況。
hintEnglish: It refers to the circulation and sale of goods in stores and trade.

exampleSimplified: 政府努力改善市容,让街道更干净。
exampleTraditional: 政府努力改善市容,讓街道更乾淨。
exampleEnglish: The government works to improve the city's appearance and keep the streets cleaner.
hintSimplified: 一座城市的街道、建筑等给人的整体外观印象。
hintTraditional: 一座城市的街道、建築等給人的整體外觀印象。
hintEnglish: The overall look of a city's streets and buildings.

definition: age; era; for many generations; generation
exampleSimplified: 这个传统在我们家已经传了好几个世代。
exampleTraditional: 這個傳統在我們家已經傳了好幾個世代。
exampleEnglish: This tradition has been passed down in our family for several generations.
hintSimplified: 祖父、父亲、孩子,一代接着一代,说的就是这个。
hintTraditional: 祖父、父親、孩子,一代接著一代,說的就是這個。
hintEnglish: Grandfather, father, child, one after another—this describes that.

exampleSimplified: 世间的一切都在不断变化。
exampleTraditional: 世間的一切都在不斷變化。
exampleEnglish: Everything in the world is constantly changing.
hintSimplified: 人们生活的这个社会和天地之间。
hintTraditional: 人們生活的這個社會和天地之間。
hintEnglish: The society and realm in which people live.

definition: affairs of life; things of the world
exampleSimplified: 爷爷经历过很多,看透了世事。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺經歷過很多,看透了世事。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa has been through a lot and has seen through the affairs of the world.
hintSimplified: 人生中发生的各种事情和变化。
hintTraditional: 人生中發生的各種事情和變化。
hintEnglish: The various events and changes that happen in human life.

definition: CL:份[fen4],張|张[zhang1]; examination paper; test paper
exampleSimplified: 老师把试卷发给了每个同学。
exampleTraditional: 老師把試卷發給了每個同學。
exampleEnglish: The teacher handed out the exam paper to every student.
hintSimplified: 考试时发下来,上面印着题目,要写答案。
hintTraditional: 考試時發下來,上面印著題目,要寫答案。
hintEnglish: Handed out during an exam, printed with questions you must answer.

exampleSimplified: 他试图说服父母让他出国留学。
exampleTraditional: 他試圖說服父母讓他出國留學。
exampleEnglish: He tried to persuade his parents to let him study abroad.
hintSimplified: 想要做某件事,并且正在努力尝试,但不一定成功。
hintTraditional: 想要做某件事,並且正在努力嘗試,但不一定成功。
hintEnglish: Wanting to do something and making an effort, though not necessarily succeeding.

exampleSimplified: 这位著名作家昨天在医院逝世了。
exampleTraditional: 這位著名作家昨天在醫院逝世了。
exampleEnglish: This famous writer passed away in the hospital yesterday.
hintSimplified: 对重要或受尊敬的人离开人间的正式说法。
hintTraditional: 對重要或受尊敬的人離開人間的正式說法。
hintEnglish: A formal way to say an important or respected person has left this life.

definition: to be bound to; undoubtedly will
exampleSimplified: 不改善服务,公司势必失去客人。
exampleTraditional: 不改善服務,公司勢必失去客人。
exampleEnglish: If it doesn't improve its service, the company will inevitably lose customers.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示根据情况,结果一定会这样。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示根據情況,結果一定會這樣。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning that, given the situation, the outcome will surely be so.

exampleSimplified: 昨天路口发生了一起交通事故。
exampleTraditional: 昨天路口發生了一起交通事故。
exampleEnglish: A traffic accident happened at the intersection yesterday.
hintSimplified: 意外发生的不好的事,常常造成伤害或损失。
hintTraditional: 意外發生的不好的事,常常造成傷害或損失。
hintEnglish: An unexpected bad occurrence that often causes injury or loss.

exampleSimplified: 这场突然的事变让大家都很震惊。
exampleTraditional: 這場突然的事變讓大家都很震驚。
exampleEnglish: This sudden incident shocked everyone.
hintSimplified: 突然发生、影响很大的重大事件。
hintTraditional: 突然發生、影響很大的重大事件。
hintEnglish: A sudden major event with great impact.

exampleSimplified: 事态越来越严重,大家都很担心。
exampleTraditional: 事態越來越嚴重,大家都很擔心。
exampleEnglish: The situation is getting more serious, and everyone is worried.
hintSimplified: 某件事发展到现在的情况和趋势。
hintTraditional: 某件事發展到現在的情況和趨勢。
hintEnglish: The current condition and trend of how a matter is developing.

definition: (political, economic etc) affairs; transaction (as in a computer database); work
exampleSimplified: 他每天都要处理很多行政事务。
exampleTraditional: 他每天都要處理很多行政事務。
exampleEnglish: He has to handle a lot of administrative matters every day.
hintSimplified: 工作中需要处理的各种杂事。
hintTraditional: 工作中需要處理的各種雜事。
hintEnglish: The various routine matters to be handled at work.

exampleSimplified: 关于旅行的相关事宜,我们明天再讨论。
exampleTraditional: 關於旅行的相關事宜,我們明天再討論。
exampleEnglish: We'll discuss the matters related to the trip tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 常用在正式场合,指要安排或处理的有关事情。
hintTraditional: 常用在正式場合,指要安排或處理的有關事情。
hintEnglish: Used in formal settings for matters that need to be arranged or handled.

gloss: to release (a prisoner); to set free
definition: to release (a prisoner); to set free; to release (energy, gas, resources); to express (emotions, goodwill, intentions)
exampleSimplified: 警方昨天把那名被关的人释放了。
exampleTraditional: 警方昨天把那名被關的人釋放了。
exampleEnglish: The police released the detained person yesterday.
hintSimplified: 让被关起来的人重新得到自由。
hintTraditional: 讓被關起來的人重新得到自由。
hintEnglish: Letting a person who was locked up become free again.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷的嗜好是喝茶和下棋。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺的嗜好是喝茶和下棋。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa's hobbies are drinking tea and playing chess.
hintSimplified: 一个人特别喜欢、常常去做的事情或习惯。
hintTraditional: 一個人特別喜歡、常常去做的事情或習慣。
hintEnglish: Something a person especially loves and often does, almost a habit.

definition: to consider to be; to deem; to see as; to view as
exampleSimplified: 很多人把这座山视为神圣的地方。
exampleTraditional: 很多人把這座山視為神聖的地方。
exampleEnglish: Many people regard this mountain as a sacred place.
hintSimplified: 表示把某人或某事看成是某种样子。
hintTraditional: 表示把某人或某事看成是某種樣子。
hintEnglish: Expresses seeing someone or something as being a certain way.

exampleSimplified: 这里的气候很适宜种茶。
exampleTraditional: 這裡的氣候很適宜種茶。
exampleEnglish: The climate here is very suitable for growing tea.
hintSimplified: 形容条件刚好合适,对某事很好。
hintTraditional: 形容條件剛好合適,對某事很好。
hintEnglish: Describes conditions that are just right and good for something.

exampleSimplified: 这家饭馆的价格适中,味道也不错。
exampleTraditional: 這家飯館的價格適中,味道也不錯。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant's prices are moderate and the food is good too.
hintSimplified: 不太多也不太少,不太大也不太小,刚刚好。
hintTraditional: 不太多也不太少,不太大也不太小,剛剛好。
hintEnglish: Neither too much nor too little, neither too big nor too small—just right.

definition: a collection; to collect (works of art, dolls, antiques etc); to put away for safekeeping; (Internet) to bookmark
exampleSimplified: 他喜欢收藏各种老邮票。
exampleTraditional: 他喜歡收藏各種老郵票。
exampleEnglish: He likes collecting all kinds of old stamps.
hintSimplified: 把喜欢或有价值的东西收集起来好好保存。
hintTraditional: 把喜歡或有價值的東西收集起來好好儲存。
hintEnglish: Gathering and keeping things you like or that are valuable.

definition: to bribe; to buy off; to purchase; to buy
exampleSimplified: 有人想用钱收买这位证人。
exampleTraditional: 有人想用錢收買這位證人。
exampleEnglish: Someone tried to buy off this witness with money.
hintSimplified: 用钱或好处让别人帮自己做不正当的事。
hintTraditional: 用錢或好處讓別人幫自己做不正當的事。
hintEnglish: Using money or benefits to get someone to do improper things for you.

definition: (physiology) systole; to contract; to pull back; to shrink
exampleSimplified: 天气太冷,金属会收缩。
exampleTraditional: 天氣太冷,金屬會收縮。
exampleEnglish: When the weather is too cold, metal contracts.
hintSimplified: 物体变小、变紧,或者范围缩小。
hintTraditional: 物體變小、變緊,或者範圍縮小。
hintEnglish: An object becoming smaller and tighter, or its scope narrowing.

exampleSimplified: 爸爸每天早上都收听新闻广播。
exampleTraditional: 爸爸每天早上都收聽新聞廣播。
exampleEnglish: Dad listens to the news broadcast every morning.
hintSimplified: 打开收音机,听电台节目。
hintTraditional: 開啟收音機,聽電臺節目。
hintEnglish: Turning on a radio to hear a station's programs.

exampleSimplified: 这项投资的收益比我们想的高。
exampleTraditional: 這項投資的收益比我們想的高。
exampleEnglish: The return on this investment is higher than we thought.
hintSimplified: 投资或做生意后赚到的钱。
hintTraditional: 投資或做生意後賺到的錢。
hintEnglish: Money earned after investing or doing business.

exampleSimplified: 请先看一下产品使用手册。
exampleTraditional: 請先看一下產品使用手冊。
exampleEnglish: Please take a look at the product user manual first.
hintSimplified: 一本小书,教你怎么使用机器或了解规定。
hintTraditional: 一本小書,教你怎麼使用機器或了解規定。
hintEnglish: A small book that teaches you how to use a machine or understand rules.

exampleSimplified: 警察从口袋里拿出一把手枪。
exampleTraditional: 警察從口袋裡拿出一把手槍。
exampleEnglish: The police officer took a handgun out of his pocket.
hintSimplified: 警察或军人带在身上的小型武器,可以单手使用。
hintTraditional: 警察或軍人帶在身上的小型武器,可以單手使用。
hintEnglish: A small weapon carried by police or soldiers, usable with one hand.

exampleSimplified: 他做了一个手势,叫我们安静。
exampleTraditional: 他做了一個手勢,叫我們安靜。
exampleEnglish: He made a gesture telling us to be quiet.
hintSimplified: 不说话,只用手做出动作来表达意思。
hintTraditional: 不說話,只用手做出動作來表達意思。
hintEnglish: Expressing a meaning with hand movements instead of speaking.

exampleSimplified: 这只狗每天晚上都守护着我们的家。
exampleTraditional: 這隻狗每天晚上都守護著我們的家。
exampleEnglish: This dog protects our home every night.
hintSimplified: 留在某人或某处旁边,不让它受到伤害。
hintTraditional: 留在某人或某處旁邊,不讓它受到傷害。
hintEnglish: To stay beside a person or place so that no harm comes to it.

gloss: capital city of an autonomous region
definition: capital city of an autonomous region
exampleSimplified: 这个自治区的首府是一座很大的城市。
exampleTraditional: 這個自治區的首府是一座很大的城市。
exampleEnglish: The capital of this autonomous region is a very large city.
hintSimplified: 一个自治区政府所在的最重要城市。
hintTraditional: 一個自治區政府所在的最重要城市。
hintEnglish: The most important city where an autonomous region's government is located.

exampleSimplified: 这个部落的首领非常受人尊敬。
exampleTraditional: 這個部落的首領非常受人尊敬。
exampleEnglish: The leader of this tribe is greatly respected.
hintSimplified: 带领一群人或一个团体的最高的人。
hintTraditional: 帶領一群人或一個團體的最高的人。
hintEnglish: The top person who leads a group or community.

exampleSimplified: 她是这家乐团的首席小提琴手。
exampleTraditional: 她是這家樂團的首席小提琴手。
exampleEnglish: She is the principal violinist of this orchestra.
hintSimplified: 在团体或职位中排第一、地位最高的。
hintTraditional: 在團體或職位中排第一、地位最高的。
hintEnglish: Ranked first or highest in a group or position.

exampleSimplified: 妈妈的首饰盒里有很多漂亮的项链。
