exampleTraditional: 媽媽的首飾盒裡有很多漂亮的項鍊。
exampleEnglish: Mom's box of jewelry has many beautiful necklaces.
hintSimplified: 项链、耳环、戒指等戴在身上的装饰品。
hintTraditional: 項鍊、耳環、戒指等戴在身上的裝飾品。
hintEnglish: Necklaces, earrings, rings and other ornaments worn on the body.

exampleSimplified: 首长来视察时,大家都站起来欢迎。
exampleTraditional: 首長來視察時,大家都站起來歡迎。
exampleEnglish: When the senior official came to inspect, everyone stood up to welcome him.
hintSimplified: 对地位很高的领导或高级官员的称呼。
hintTraditional: 對地位很高的領導或高階官員的稱呼。
hintEnglish: A term for a high-ranking leader or senior official.

definition: damaged; injured; killed; robbed; to suffer damage, injury etc
exampleSimplified: 这次地震中受害的人很多。
exampleTraditional: 這次地震中受害的人很多。
exampleEnglish: Many people were hurt in this earthquake.
hintSimplified: 遇到灾难或坏事,身体或财物受到损失。
hintTraditional: 遇到災難或壞事,身體或財物受到損失。
hintEnglish: To suffer harm or loss in a disaster or bad event.

exampleSimplified: 新员工要先受训两个星期才能上班。
exampleTraditional: 新員工要先受訓兩個星期才能上班。
exampleEnglish: New employees must be trained for two weeks before they start work.
hintSimplified: 为了学会工作的方法,接受专门的练习和教导。
hintTraditional: 為了學會工作的方法,接受專門的練習和教導。
hintEnglish: To undergo special practice and instruction to learn how to do a job.

exampleSimplified: 王老师每天在大学里授课。
exampleTraditional: 王老師每天在大學裡授課。
exampleEnglish: Teacher Wang gives lectures at the university every day.
hintSimplified: 老师在教室里把知识教给学生。
hintTraditional: 老師在教室裡把知識教給學生。
hintEnglish: A teacher passes on knowledge to students in a classroom.

exampleSimplified: 以前山上的居民靠狩猎生活。
exampleTraditional: 以前山上的居民靠狩獵生活。
exampleEnglish: In the past, mountain residents lived by hunting.
hintSimplified: 在山林里追捕野生动物。
hintTraditional: 在山林裡追捕野生動物。
hintEnglish: Chasing and catching wild animals in the mountains and forests.

gloss: Canopus (brightest star in the constellation Carina 船底座[Chuan2 di3 zuo4]); Longevity Star
definition: Canopus (brightest star in the constellation Carina 船底座[Chuan2 di3 zuo4]); Longevity Star; God of Longevity; elderly person whose birthday is being celebrated
exampleSimplified: 今天是爷爷的生日,他是全家的寿星。
exampleTraditional: 今天是爺爺的生日,他是全家的壽星。
exampleEnglish: Today is Grandpa's birthday, and he is the guest of honor of the whole family.
hintSimplified: 过生日的老人,是大家庆祝的主角。
hintTraditional: 過生日的老人,是大家慶祝的主角。
hintEnglish: The elderly person celebrating a birthday, who is the center of the celebration.

definition: persuasion; to clear the way; to dredge; to enlighten; to open up a path for; to remove obstructions
exampleSimplified: 老师耐心地疏导学生的不安情绪。
exampleTraditional: 老師耐心地疏導學生的不安情緒。
exampleEnglish: The teacher patiently eased the students' anxious feelings.
hintSimplified: 用说话和引导让堵住的情绪或交通慢慢通畅。
hintTraditional: 用說話和引導讓堵住的情緒或交通慢慢通暢。
hintEnglish: Using guidance to gradually clear blocked emotions or traffic.

definition: Taiwan pr. [shu1san4]; idle; leisurely; laid-back; scattered; sparse; to scatter; to disperse; to evacuate
exampleSimplified: 警报响了,大家赶快疏散到安全的地方。
exampleTraditional: 警報響了,大家趕快疏散到安全的地方。
exampleEnglish: The alarm rang, and everyone quickly evacuated to a safe place.
hintSimplified: 人群很多时,让大家分开离开危险的地方。
hintTraditional: 人群很多時,讓大家分開離開危險的地方。
hintEnglish: Making a crowd spread out and leave a dangerous place.

gloss: book (chiefly used to refer to a plurality of books or books in general)
definition: book (chiefly used to refer to a plurality of books or books in general)
exampleSimplified: 光看书本还不够,你也要多实际练习。
exampleTraditional: 光看書本還不夠,你也要多實際練習。
exampleEnglish: Just reading textbooks isn't enough; you also need to practice a lot.
hintSimplified: 学生学习时用的印刷读物,常和实际经验相对。
hintTraditional: 學生學習時用的印刷讀物,常和實際經驗相對。
hintEnglish: Printed material students study from, often contrasted with real experience.

exampleSimplified: 请你把意见用书面方式交给我。
exampleTraditional: 請你把意見用書面方式交給我。
exampleEnglish: Please give me your opinion in written form.
hintSimplified: 用文字写下来的,不是口头说的。
hintTraditional: 用文字寫下來的,不是口頭說的。
hintEnglish: Put down in text rather than spoken aloud.

exampleSimplified: 小朋友正在学习书写自己的名字。
exampleTraditional: 小朋友正在學習書寫自己的名字。
exampleEnglish: The little child is learning to write his own name.
hintSimplified: 用笔把字写出来的动作。
hintTraditional: 用筆把字寫出來的動作。
hintEnglish: The act of forming characters with a pen.

exampleSimplified: 放假去海边玩,心情特别舒畅。
exampleTraditional: 放假去海邊玩,心情特別舒暢。
exampleEnglish: Going to the seaside on vacation made me feel especially carefree and refreshed.
hintSimplified: 心里没有烦恼,觉得轻松又愉快。
hintTraditional: 心裡沒有煩惱,覺得輕鬆又愉快。
hintEnglish: Feeling light and happy with no worries on one's mind.

definition: to extend; to roll out; to smooth out; to unfold
exampleSimplified: 早上起床后,她伸伸懒腰,让身体舒展一下。
exampleTraditional: 早上起床後,她伸伸懶腰,讓身體舒展一下。
exampleEnglish: After getting up, she stretched to loosen her body.
hintSimplified: 把弯着或卷着的东西慢慢打开、放松。
hintTraditional: 把彎著或卷著的東西慢慢開啟、放鬆。
hintEnglish: To slowly open up or relax something bent or curled.

definition: to give aid and support; to transfuse blood
exampleSimplified: 病人流血太多,医生马上帮他输血。
exampleTraditional: 病人流血太多,醫生馬上幫他輸血。
exampleEnglish: The patient lost too much blood, so the doctor gave him a transfusion right away.
hintSimplified: 医院把别人捐的红色液体送进病人身体里。
hintTraditional: 醫院把別人捐的紅色液體送進病人身體裡。
hintEnglish: A hospital puts donated red fluid into a patient's body.

gloss: to bind; to tie up; to fetter; to shackle
definition: to bind; to tie up; to fetter; to shackle
exampleSimplified: 他不想被传统的观念束缚。
exampleTraditional: 他不想被傳統的觀念束縛。
exampleEnglish: He doesn't want to be restricted by traditional ideas.
hintSimplified: 让人或事物不能自由行动,受到限制。
hintTraditional: 讓人或事物不能自由行動,受到限制。
hintEnglish: To keep a person or thing from moving freely; to restrict.

exampleSimplified: 春天我们在山上种了一百棵树苗。
exampleTraditional: 春天我們在山上種了一百棵樹苗。
exampleEnglish: In spring we planted a hundred saplings on the mountain.
hintSimplified: 刚种下去、还很小的树。
hintTraditional: 剛種下去、還很小的樹。
hintEnglish: A very young tree that has just been planted.

exampleSimplified: 公司需要分析这些数据,才能做决定。
exampleTraditional: 公司需要分析這些數據,才能做決定。
exampleEnglish: The company needs to analyze this data before making a decision.
hintSimplified: 电脑或统计里用来分析的数字和资料。
hintTraditional: 電腦或統計裡用來分析的數字和資料。
hintEnglish: Numbers and information used for analysis in computing or statistics.

exampleSimplified: 这件事对他来说是双重打击。
exampleTraditional: 這件事對他來說是雙重打擊。
exampleEnglish: This matter was a double blow to him.
hintSimplified: 有两层、两个方面的。
hintTraditional: 有兩層、兩個方面的。
hintEnglish: Having two layers or two aspects.

exampleSimplified: 他们在网球比赛中打双打,配合得很好。
exampleTraditional: 他們在網球比賽中打雙打,配合得很好。
exampleEnglish: They played doubles in the tennis match and worked well together.
hintSimplified: 网球或羽毛球比赛中,每一边有两个人一起上场的比赛方式。
hintTraditional: 網球或羽毛球比賽中,每一邊有兩個人一起上場的比賽方式。
hintEnglish: A match format in tennis or badminton where each side has two players.

exampleSimplified: 他很爽快,一听就答应帮我了。
exampleTraditional: 他很爽快,一聽就答應幫我了。
exampleEnglish: He's very straightforward; he agreed to help me as soon as he heard.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人说话做事直接、不拖拖拉拉。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人說話做事直接、不拖拖拉拉。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who speaks and acts directly, without hesitation.

definition: lane (in a swimming pool); water route; watercourse (river, canal, drain etc)
exampleSimplified: 游泳比赛时,每个选手都在自己的水道里游。
exampleTraditional: 游泳比賽時,每個選手都在自己的水道裡遊。
exampleEnglish: In the swimming race, each swimmer swims in their own lane.
hintSimplified: 游泳池里用绳子隔开、让每个人各游各的那一条区域。
hintTraditional: 游泳池裡用繩子隔開、讓每個人各遊各的那一條區域。
hintEnglish: The strip of a swimming pool separated by ropes where each swimmer swims.

exampleSimplified: 台湾南部有很多农民种水稻。
exampleTraditional: 台灣南部有很多農民種水稻。
exampleEnglish: Many farmers in southern Taiwan grow paddy rice.
hintSimplified: 一种需要种在有水的田里的植物,果实就是我们常吃的米饭的原料。
hintTraditional: 一種需要種在有水的田裡的植物,果實就是我們常吃的米飯的原料。
hintEnglish: A plant grown in flooded fields whose grain becomes the staple food.

exampleSimplified: 她戴着一条水晶项链,看起来很漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 她戴著一條水晶項鍊,看起來很漂亮。
exampleEnglish: She wore a crystal necklace and looked beautiful.
hintSimplified: 一种透明又闪亮的矿石,常用来做首饰或装饰品。
hintTraditional: 一種透明又閃亮的礦石,常用來做首飾或裝飾品。
hintEnglish: A transparent, sparkling mineral often made into jewelry or decorations.

exampleSimplified: 这座水库提供了城市大部分的用水。
exampleTraditional: 這座水庫提供了城市大部分的用水。
exampleEnglish: This reservoir supplies most of the city's water.
hintSimplified: 人们在山谷里筑坝,用来储存大量水的地方。
hintTraditional: 人們在山谷裡築壩,用來儲存大量水的地方。
hintEnglish: A place where a dam holds back a large amount of water for storage.

exampleSimplified: 这个国家利用水力发电,很环保。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家利用水力發電,很環保。
exampleEnglish: This country uses water power to generate electricity, which is eco-friendly.
hintSimplified: 流动的水所产生的力量,可以用来推动机器或发电。
hintTraditional: 流動的水所產生的力量,可以用來推動機器或發電。
hintEnglish: The force produced by flowing water, used to drive machines or make electricity.

exampleSimplified: 工人正在用水泥铺新的马路。
exampleTraditional: 工人正在用水泥鋪新的馬路。
exampleEnglish: Workers are paving a new road with cement.
hintSimplified: 盖房子时用的灰色粉末,加水搅拌后会变硬。
hintTraditional: 蓋房子時用的灰色粉末,加水攪拌後會變硬。
hintEnglish: A gray powder used in building that hardens when mixed with water.

definition: headwaters of a river; water source; water supply
exampleSimplified: 山上的水源必须保持干净。
exampleTraditional: 山上的水源必須保持乾淨。
exampleEnglish: The water source in the mountains must be kept clean.
hintSimplified: 河流或城市用水最初来的地方。
hintTraditional: 河流或城市用水最初來的地方。
hintEnglish: The place where a river or a city's water supply originally comes from.

definition: obedient; to comply; to defer; to submit
exampleSimplified: 这个孩子很顺从,爸妈说什么他都听。
exampleTraditional: 這個孩子很順從,爸媽說什麼他都聽。
exampleEnglish: This child is very obedient and listens to whatever his parents say.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人听别人的话,不反对也不反抗。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人聽別人的話,不反對也不反抗。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who listens to others and neither objects nor resists.

gloss: to comply with; to conform to; to adapt to; to go along with; in tune with
definition: to comply with; to conform to; to adapt to; to go along with; in tune with
exampleSimplified: 公司必须顺应市场的变化。
exampleTraditional: 公司必須順應市場的變化。
exampleEnglish: Companies must adapt to changes in the market.
hintSimplified: 配合环境或趋势的改变,而不是对着干。
hintTraditional: 配合環境或趨勢的改變,而不是對著幹。
hintEnglish: To go along with changes in the environment or trends rather than resist them.

gloss: in an instant; in a flash
definition: in an instant; in a flash
exampleSimplified: 在那一瞬间,我什么都说不出来。
exampleTraditional: 在那一瞬間,我什麼都說不出來。
exampleEnglish: In that instant, I couldn't say anything.
hintSimplified: 指非常非常短的一段时间,眨一下眼就过去了。
hintTraditional: 指非常非常短的一段時間,眨一下眼就過去了。
hintEnglish: An extremely short moment, over in the blink of an eye.

definition: to lie; to tell an untruth
exampleSimplified: 小孩说谎是不对的,要诚实。
exampleTraditional: 小孩說謊是不對的,要誠實。
exampleEnglish: It's wrong for children to lie; they should be honest.
hintSimplified: 故意讲不真实的话来骗人。
hintTraditional: 故意講不真實的話來騙人。
hintEnglish: To deliberately say untrue things in order to deceive people.

definition: to banter; to chat and laugh; to crack jokes
exampleSimplified: 朋友们坐在一起说说笑笑,气氛很轻松。
exampleTraditional: 朋友們坐在一起說說笑笑,氣氛很輕鬆。
exampleEnglish: Friends sat together chatting and joking in a relaxed atmosphere.
hintSimplified: 大家一边聊天一边开玩笑,很开心。
hintTraditional: 大家一邊聊天一邊開玩笑,很開心。
hintEnglish: People chatting and joking around happily together.

definition: Zeitgeist; tide of thought; way of thinking characteristic of a historical period
exampleSimplified: 这本书介绍了二十世纪的西方思潮。
exampleTraditional: 這本書介紹了二十世紀的西方思潮。
exampleEnglish: This book introduces the intellectual trends of the twentieth century West.
hintSimplified: 某个时代里很多人共同拥有、广泛流行的想法和观念。
hintTraditional: 某個時代裡很多人共同擁有、廣泛流行的想法和觀念。
hintEnglish: The widespread ideas and beliefs shared by many people in a given era.

definition: to long for; to miss; to think of
exampleSimplified: 出国以后,他常常思念家乡的亲人。
exampleTraditional: 出國以後,他常常思念家鄉的親人。
exampleEnglish: Since going abroad, he often misses his family back home.
hintSimplified: 对离得很远的人或地方一直想着,心里很难过。
hintTraditional: 對離得很遠的人或地方一直想著,心裡很難過。
hintEnglish: To keep thinking, with sadness, of a faraway person or place.

exampleSimplified: 学数学可以训练我们的逻辑思维。
exampleTraditional: 學數學可以訓練我們的邏輯思維。
exampleEnglish: Studying math can train our logical thinking.
hintSimplified: 人在脑子里分析、想问题的方式和过程。
hintTraditional: 人在腦子裡分析、想問題的方式和過程。
hintEnglish: The way and process by which a person analyzes and thinks in the mind.

definition: a bit; the slightest amount or degree
exampleSimplified: 他对这件事丝毫不在乎。
exampleTraditional: 他對這件事絲毫不在乎。
exampleEnglish: He doesn't care about this matter in the slightest.
hintSimplified: 常用在否定句里,表示连一点点都没有。
hintTraditional: 常用在否定句裡,表示連一點點都沒有。
hintEnglish: Often used in negative sentences to mean not even the tiniest bit.

exampleSimplified: 司令向士兵们下达了命令。
exampleTraditional: 司令向士兵們下達了命令。
exampleEnglish: The commander gave orders to the soldiers.
hintSimplified: 军队里负责指挥一支部队的高级长官。
hintTraditional: 軍隊裡負責指揮一支部隊的高階長官。
hintEnglish: A high-ranking officer in charge of leading a military force.

definition: cultured; educate; gentle; intellectual; polite; refined
exampleSimplified: 他说话很斯文,看起来像个读书人。
exampleTraditional: 他說話很斯文,看起來像個讀書人。
exampleEnglish: He speaks gently and refined, like a scholar.
hintSimplified: 形容人举止有礼貌、说话温和,很有教养。
hintTraditional: 形容人舉止有禮貌、說話溫和,很有教養。
hintEnglish: Describes someone polite and gentle in manner, well-bred and educated.

exampleSimplified: 他做这件事不是为大家,而是出于私心。
exampleTraditional: 他做這件事不是為大家,而是出於私心。
exampleEnglish: He did this not for everyone, but out of selfish motives.
hintSimplified: 只为自己好处着想的念头。
hintTraditional: 只為自己好處著想的念頭。
hintEnglish: A thought focused only on one's own benefit.

definition: Taiwan pr. [si4 de5]; rather like; seems as if
exampleSimplified: 他高兴得像孩子似的跳了起来。
exampleTraditional: 他高興得像孩子似的跳了起來。
exampleEnglish: He was so happy that he jumped up like a child.
hintSimplified: 放在句尾的助词,表示好像或差不多像前面所说的样子。
hintTraditional: 放在句尾的助詞,表示好像或差不多像前面所說的樣子。
hintEnglish: A particle at the end of a phrase meaning something is like or as if what was just described.

gloss: (used to form an adverbial phrase X + 似地[shi4 de5]) like (X); as if (X)
definition: (used to form an adverbial phrase X + 似地[shi4 de5]) like (X); as if (X); Taiwan pr. [si4de5]
exampleSimplified: 她开心得像小鸟似地唱着歌跑了过去。
exampleTraditional: 她開心得像小鳥似地唱著歌跑了過去。
exampleEnglish: She ran over singing, happy as a little bird.
hintSimplified: 接在名词或短语后面,组成副词短语,表示好像那样地做某事。
hintTraditional: 接在名詞或短語後面,組成副詞短語,表示好像那樣地做某事。
hintEnglish: Attached after a noun or phrase to form an adverbial phrase meaning in the manner of something.

exampleSimplified: 山上种了很多松树,空气很清新。
exampleTraditional: 山上種了很多松樹,空氣很清新。
exampleEnglish: Many pine trees are planted on the mountain, and the air is fresh.
hintSimplified: 一种叶子像细针、冬天也不会变黄的常绿树。
hintTraditional: 一種葉子像細針、冬天也不會變黃的常綠樹。
hintEnglish: An evergreen tree with needle-like leaves that stays green in winter.

gloss: to instigate; to incite; to urge; to encourage
definition: to instigate; to incite; to urge; to encourage
exampleSimplified: 是他怂恿我去试试的,我才报名的。
exampleTraditional: 是他慫恿我去試試的,我才報名的。
exampleEnglish: He egged me on to give it a try, so I signed up.
hintSimplified: 在旁边鼓动别人去做某件事,常常不是什么好事。
hintTraditional: 在旁邊鼓動別人去做某件事,常常不是什麼好事。
hintEnglish: To urge someone from the sidelines to do something, often something unwise.

exampleSimplified: 他到处搜集旧邮票。
exampleTraditional: 他到處搜集舊郵票。
exampleEnglish: He collects old stamps everywhere.
hintSimplified: 把很多资料或东西从各处找来放在一起。
hintTraditional: 把很多資料或東西從各處找來放在一起。
hintEnglish: To find many materials or items from various places and put them together.

definition: common term; commonly referred to as
exampleSimplified: 这种水果的俗称是“金龙果”。
exampleTraditional: 這種水果的俗稱是“金龍果”。
exampleEnglish: The common name of this fruit is "golden dragon fruit."
hintSimplified: 人们平常口中用的名字，不是正式或学术的名字。
hintTraditional: 人們平常口中用的名字，不是正式或學術的名字。
hintEnglish: The name people use in everyday speech, not the formal or scientific one.

exampleSimplified: “入乡随俗”是一句有名的俗语。
exampleTraditional: “入鄉隨俗”是一句有名的俗語。
exampleEnglish: "When in Rome, do as the Romans do" is a well-known folk saying.
hintSimplified: 民间流传的简短话，常包含生活经验。
hintTraditional: 民間流傳的簡短話，常包含生活經驗。
hintEnglish: A short saying passed down among the people, often containing life experience.

exampleSimplified: 他一见到朋友就开始诉苦。
exampleTraditional: 他一見到朋友就開始訴苦。
exampleEnglish: As soon as he saw his friend, he started complaining about his troubles.
hintSimplified: 向别人说出自己的困难和不开心。
hintTraditional: 向別人說出自己的困難和不開心。
hintEnglish: To tell others about your difficulties and unhappiness.

exampleSimplified: 这位老师的专业素质很高。
exampleTraditional: 這位老師的專業素質很高。
exampleEnglish: This teacher's professional caliber is very high.
hintSimplified: 一个人原本具有的品德、能力和修养。
hintTraditional: 一個人原本具有的品德、能力和修養。
hintEnglish: A person's inherent character, ability and cultivation.

exampleSimplified: 她在庙口请人算命。
exampleTraditional: 她在廟口請人算命。
exampleEnglish: She asked someone to tell her fortune at the temple entrance.
hintSimplified: 有人根据生辰八字或手相，说你未来会怎样。
hintTraditional: 有人根據生辰八字或手相，說你未來會怎樣。
hintEnglish: Someone uses your birth date or palm to say what your future will be.

exampleSimplified: 小学生要先学好算术。
exampleTraditional: 小學生要先學好算術。
exampleEnglish: Elementary students must first learn arithmetic well.
hintSimplified: 小学里教加减乘除的基础课程。
hintTraditional: 小學裡教加減乘除的基礎課程。
hintEnglish: The basic elementary school subject teaching adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing.

exampleSimplified: 虽说天气很冷，大家还是去爬山了。
exampleTraditional: 雖說天氣很冷，大家還是去爬山了。
exampleEnglish: Although it was cold, everyone still went hiking.
hintSimplified: 连接词，先承认一件事，后面常接“但是”或“还是”表示转折。
hintTraditional: 連線詞，先承認一件事，後面常接“但是”或“還是”表示轉折。
hintEnglish: A conjunction that first admits one fact, followed by a contrast like "but" or "still."

exampleSimplified: 你先走，我随后就到。
exampleTraditional: 你先走，我隨後就到。
exampleEnglish: You go first, I'll arrive shortly after.
hintSimplified: 表示在某件事之后不久接着发生。
hintTraditional: 表示在某件事之後不久接著發生。
hintEnglish: Indicates something happens soon after another thing.

exampleSimplified: 他说完话，随即离开了教室。
exampleTraditional: 他說完話，隨即離開了教室。
exampleEnglish: After finishing speaking, he immediately left the classroom.
hintSimplified: 副词，表示前一件事刚完，马上做下一件事。
hintTraditional: 副詞，表示前一件事剛完，馬上做下一件事。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning the next thing happens right after the previous one finishes.

definition: to (carry) on one's person; to (take) with one
exampleSimplified: 出国时要随身带着护照。
exampleTraditional: 出國時要隨身帶著護照。
exampleEnglish: When going abroad, you must carry your passport with you.
hintSimplified: 放在自己身上或身边，不离开自己。
hintTraditional: 放在自己身上或身邊，不離開自己。
hintEnglish: Kept on or next to yourself, never leaving you.

exampleSimplified: 总统随同代表团一起访问。
exampleTraditional: 總統隨同代表團一起訪問。
exampleEnglish: The president visited together with the delegation.
hintSimplified: 跟着别人一起去，常用在正式场合。
hintTraditional: 跟著別人一起去，常用在正式場合。
hintEnglish: To go along with others, often in formal settings.

exampleSimplified: 火车穿过一条很长的隧道。
exampleTraditional: 火車穿過一條很長的隧道。
exampleEnglish: The train passed through a very long tunnel.
hintSimplified: 在山或地下挖出来让车通过的通道。
hintTraditional: 在山或地下挖出來讓車透過的通道。
hintEnglish: A passage dug through a mountain or underground for vehicles.

exampleSimplified: 漫长的岁月让小镇改变了很多。
exampleTraditional: 漫長的歲月讓小鎮改變了很多。
exampleEnglish: The long years have changed the small town a lot.
hintSimplified: 指很长一段时间慢慢过去，常带有文学感。
hintTraditional: 指很長一段時間慢慢過去，常帶有文學感。
hintEnglish: Refers to a long stretch of time slowly passing, with a literary feel.

exampleSimplified: 抽烟会损害你的健康。
exampleTraditional: 抽菸會損害你的健康。
exampleEnglish: Smoking will harm your health.
hintSimplified: 让好的东西受到不好的影响，变得更差。
hintTraditional: 讓好的東西受到不好的影響，變得更差。
hintEnglish: To cause something good to be negatively affected and become worse.

exampleSimplified: 手机掉在地上，屏幕损坏了。
exampleTraditional: 手機掉在地上，螢幕損壞了。
exampleEnglish: The phone fell on the ground and the screen was damaged.
hintSimplified: 东西被弄坏，不能正常使用。
hintTraditional: 東西被弄壞，不能正常使用。
hintEnglish: A thing is broken and can't be used normally.

definition: disability; impairment; loss; to damage; to harm; to injure

exampleEnglish: Her constitution is weak and she catches colds easily.
hintSimplified: 一个人身体天生或长期形成的健康状态。
hintTraditional: 一個人身體天生或長期形成的健康狀態。
hintEnglish: A person's inborn or long-term physical condition.

definition: to replace; to substitute for; to supersede
exampleSimplified: 电子书不可能完全替代纸本书。
exampleTraditional: 電子書不可能完全替代紙本書。
exampleEnglish: E-books cannot completely replace printed books.
hintSimplified: 用一个东西或人去取代原来的另一个。
hintTraditional: 用一個東西或人去取代原來的另一個。
hintEnglish: Using one thing or person in the place of another.

exampleSimplified: 猫是老鼠的天敌。
exampleTraditional: 貓是老鼠的天敵。
exampleEnglish: Cats are the natural enemy of mice.
hintSimplified: 在自然界中专门捕食某种动物的另一种动物。
hintTraditional: 在自然界中專門捕食某種動物的另一種動物。
hintEnglish: An animal in nature that habitually hunts another kind of animal.

exampleSimplified: 好奇是孩子的天性。
exampleTraditional: 好奇是孩子的天性。
exampleEnglish: Curiosity is a child's nature.
hintSimplified: 一个人生下来就有的性格或倾向。
hintTraditional: 一個人生下來就有的性格或傾向。
hintEnglish: A character or tendency a person is born with.

exampleSimplified: 地震和台风都是天灾。
exampleTraditional: 地震和颱風都是天災。
exampleEnglish: Earthquakes and typhoons are both natural disasters.
hintSimplified: 地震、洪水等自然带来的灾难,不是人造成的。
hintTraditional: 地震、洪水等自然帶來的災難,不是人造成的。
hintEnglish: Disasters like earthquakes and floods caused by nature, not people.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷每天都到田地里工作。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺每天都到田地裡工作。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa goes to work in the fields every day.
hintSimplified: 农夫种稻米或蔬菜的土地。
hintTraditional: 農夫種稻米或蔬菜的土地。
hintEnglish: Land where farmers grow rice or vegetables.

exampleSimplified: 他是学校田径队的选手。
exampleTraditional: 他是學校田徑隊的選手。
exampleEnglish: He is a member of the school track and field team.
hintSimplified: 包括跑步、跳高、跳远和投掷的一类运动。
hintTraditional: 包括跑步、跳高、跳遠和投擲的一類運動。
hintEnglish: A group of sports including running, jumping and throwing.

exampleSimplified: 她有一个甜美的笑容。
exampleTraditional: 她有一個甜美的笑容。
exampleEnglish: She has a sweet smile.
hintSimplified: 形容声音、笑容或样子让人觉得可爱又舒服。
hintTraditional: 形容聲音、笑容或樣子讓人覺得可愛又舒服。
hintEnglish: Describes a voice, smile or look that feels lovely and pleasant.

exampleSimplified: 他对食物很挑剔,不好吃的都不吃。
exampleTraditional: 他對食物很挑剔,不好吃的都不吃。
exampleEnglish: He is very picky about food and won't eat anything that doesn't taste good.
hintSimplified: 形容人要求很高,总是找出小缺点。
hintTraditional: 形容人要求很高,總是找出小缺點。
hintEnglish: Describes someone with high demands who always finds small faults.

definition: blended; harmonious; mediation; seasoning; to compromise; to mediate; to reconcile; to mix; to blend; to placate; to season
exampleSimplified: 他努力调和两个朋友之间的矛盾。
exampleTraditional: 他努力調和兩個朋友之間的矛盾。
exampleEnglish: He tried hard to smooth over the conflict between the two friends.
hintSimplified: 让互相冲突的双方或不同的东西变得和谐。
hintTraditional: 讓互相沖突的雙方或不同的東西變得和諧。
hintEnglish: To make conflicting parties or different things harmonious.

definition: to adjust; to harmonize; to reconcile (accountancy etc); to regulate
exampleSimplified: 你可以自己调节冷气的温度。
exampleTraditional: 你可以自己調節冷氣的溫度。
exampleEnglish: You can adjust the air conditioner's temperature yourself.
hintSimplified: 把速度、温度或情绪调整到合适的程度。
hintTraditional: 把速度、溫度或情緒調整到合適的程度。
hintEnglish: To tune speed, temperature or mood to a suitable level.

exampleSimplified: 这个小男孩很调皮,常常把家里弄得乱七八糟。
exampleTraditional: 這個小男孩很調皮,常常把家裡弄得亂七八糟。
exampleEnglish: This little boy is very naughty and often turns the house into a mess.
hintSimplified: 形容孩子不听话、爱玩爱闹、喜欢恶作剧。
hintTraditional: 形容孩子不聽話、愛玩愛鬧、喜歡惡作劇。
hintEnglish: Describes a child who is disobedient, playful and fond of pranks.

gloss: regulations; rules; code of conduct; ordinances; statutes
definition: regulations; rules; code of conduct; ordinances; statutes
exampleSimplified: 市政府通过了一项新的环保条例。
exampleTraditional: 市政府透過了一項新的環保條例。
exampleEnglish: The city government passed a new environmental protection regulation.
hintSimplified: 政府或机构订出来,要大家遵守的一项项规定。
hintTraditional: 政府或機構訂出來,要大家遵守的一項項規定。
hintEnglish: The individual rules set by a government or organization that everyone must follow.

definition: (music) to transcribe by ear; (of a pupil) to write down (in a dictation exercise); dictation
exampleSimplified: 老师念词语,我们一边听一边写在本子上,这是今天的听写。
exampleTraditional: 老師念詞語,我們一邊聽一邊寫在本子上,這是今天的聽寫。
exampleEnglish: The teacher reads words aloud and we write them in our notebooks; this is today's dictation.
hintSimplified: 语文课常有的练习:老师念,学生听了以后把字写下来。
hintTraditional: 語文課常有的練習:老師念,學生聽了以後把字寫下來。
hintEnglish: A common language-class exercise: the teacher reads aloud and students write down what they hear.

definition: pause (in speech); to break off; to halt
exampleSimplified: 他说话时偶尔会有一点停顿,好像在想接下来要说什么。
exampleTraditional: 他說話時偶爾會有一點停頓,好像在想接下來要說什麼。
exampleEnglish: He pauses a little now and then when speaking, as if thinking about what to say next.
hintSimplified: 说话或做事时,中间短暂地停下来,没有继续。
hintTraditional: 說話或做事時,中間短暫地停下來,沒有繼續。
hintEnglish: A brief stop in the middle of speaking or doing something, before continuing.

gloss: to remain (at a stage, level etc)
definition: to remain (at a stage, level etc); to stay for a time; to stop; to remain
exampleSimplified: 我们在台北只停留了两天就回国了。
exampleTraditional: 我們在台北只停留了兩天就回國了。
exampleEnglish: We only stayed in Taipei for two days before returning home.
hintSimplified: 在某个地方暂时待着,不马上离开。
hintTraditional: 在某個地方暫時待著,不馬上離開。
hintEnglish: To stay somewhere for a while without leaving right away.

definition: at a standstill; bogged down; stagnation
exampleSimplified: 经济长期停滞,让许多年轻人找不到好工作。
exampleTraditional: 經濟長期停滯,讓許多年輕人找不到好工作。
exampleEnglish: With the economy stagnant for a long time, many young people can't find good jobs.
hintSimplified: 事情没有进步,也没有发展,好像被卡住了一样。
hintTraditional: 事情沒有進步,也沒有發展,好像被卡住了一樣。
hintEnglish: Things make no progress or development, as if stuck.

definition: (scientific) journal; bulletin; circular; to announce; to inform; to notify
exampleSimplified: 学校发出通报,提醒同学注意流感。
exampleTraditional: 學校發出通報,提醒同學注意流感。
exampleEnglish: The school issued a notice reminding students to watch out for the flu.
hintSimplified: 机关或学校用正式的方式,把消息告诉大家。
hintTraditional: 機關或學校用正式的方式,把訊息告訴大家。
hintEnglish: When an organization or school formally informs everyone of some news.

definition: (Tw) to commute; (of a locality) to have a transportation service; to open to traffic (e.g. new bridge, rail line etc)
exampleSimplified: 新的捷运线下个月就要通车了。
exampleTraditional: 新的捷運線下個月就要通車了。
exampleEnglish: The new MRT line will open to traffic next month.
hintSimplified: 新的铁路或道路完成后,开始让车子可以行驶。
hintTraditional: 新的鐵路或道路完成後,開始讓車子可以行駛。
hintEnglish: When a newly built railway or road starts to allow vehicles to run.

definition: generic term; to be generally referred to (as)
exampleSimplified: “珍奶”是珍珠奶茶的通称。
exampleTraditional: “珍奶”是珍珠奶茶的通稱。
exampleEnglish: "Zhennai" is the common name for bubble milk tea.
hintSimplified: 大家平常都这样叫,不一定是正式的名字。
hintTraditional: 大家平常都這樣叫,不一定是正式的名字。
hintEnglish: What people commonly call something, though not necessarily its formal name.

definition: to list as wanted; to order the arrest of sb as criminal
exampleSimplified: 警察正在通缉那名逃走的犯人。
exampleTraditional: 警察正在通緝那名逃走的犯人。
exampleEnglish: The police are issuing a wanted notice for the escaped criminal.
hintSimplified: 警方公开命令各地一起抓捕逃跑的犯人。
hintTraditional: 警方公開命令各地一起抓捕逃跑的犯人。
hintEnglish: The police publicly order a search everywhere to catch a fugitive.

definition: to be in general use; to go through; to pass through
exampleSimplified: 这种付款方式在全国都很通行。
exampleTraditional: 這種付款方式在全國都很通行。
exampleEnglish: This payment method is widely accepted across the country.
hintSimplified: 某种做法或规定被大家普遍接受、到处都可以用。
hintTraditional: 某種做法或規定被大家普遍接受、到處都可以用。
hintEnglish: A practice or rule that is widely accepted and usable everywhere.

definition: (of two or more things) interchangeable; to be used by everyone (language, textbook etc); to use anywhere, anytime (card, ticket etc)
exampleSimplified: 这种充电线和很多手机都通用。
exampleTraditional: 這種充電線和很多手機都通用。
exampleEnglish: This charging cable works with many phones.
hintSimplified: 同一样东西可以在不同的地方或不同的设备上使用。
hintTraditional: 同一樣東西可以在不同的地方或不同的裝置上使用。
hintEnglish: The same thing can be used in different places or with different devices.

exampleSimplified: 旅行时有一个好同伴,路上就不会无聊。
exampleTraditional: 旅行時有一個好同伴,路上就不會無聊。
exampleEnglish: With a good companion when traveling, the road is never boring.
hintSimplified: 和你一起做事或一起去某地的人。
hintTraditional: 和你一起做事或一起去某地的人。
hintEnglish: A person who does something or goes somewhere together with you.

exampleSimplified: 移民的孩子很快就被当地文化同化了。
exampleTraditional: 移民的孩子很快就被當地文化同化了。
exampleEnglish: The immigrants' children were soon assimilated into the local culture.
hintSimplified: 一个群体慢慢变得和另一个群体的文化、习惯一样。
hintTraditional: 一個群體慢慢變得和另一個群體的文化、習慣一樣。
hintEnglish: When a group gradually becomes the same as another in culture and habits.

gloss: person from the same hometown or home region
definition: person from the same hometown or home region
exampleSimplified: 在国外遇到同乡,我们特别高兴。
exampleTraditional: 在國外遇到同鄉,我們特別高興。
exampleEnglish: We were especially happy to meet someone from our hometown abroad.
hintSimplified: 和你来自同一个家乡或地区的人。
hintTraditional: 和你來自同一個家鄉或地區的人。
hintEnglish: A person who comes from the same home region as you.

definition: concentric; see 同心縣|同心县[Tong2 xin1 Xian4]; to be of one mind; united
exampleSimplified: 只要大家同心,就没有克服不了的困难。
exampleTraditional: 只要大家同心,就沒有克服不了的困難。
exampleEnglish: As long as everyone is of one mind, no difficulty is insurmountable.
hintSimplified: 许多人想法一致、心意相通,一起努力。
hintTraditional: 許多人想法一致、心意相通,一起努力。
hintEnglish: Many people share the same thoughts and intentions and work together.

gloss: person in the same trade or business
definition: person in the same trade or business; same trade or business
exampleSimplified: 这家店和同业一起举办了促销活动。
exampleTraditional: 這家店和同業一起舉辦了促銷活動。
exampleEnglish: This shop held a promotion together with others in the same trade.
hintSimplified: 做同一种生意或属于同一行的人或公司。
hintTraditional: 做同一種生意或屬於同一行的人或公司。
hintEnglish: People or companies engaged in the same kind of business.

exampleSimplified: 他把所有的旧衣服统统捐给了慈善机构。
exampleTraditional: 他把所有的舊衣服統統捐給了慈善機構。
exampleEnglish: He donated all his old clothes, every single one, to charity.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示没有例外,全部都是。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示沒有例外,全部都是。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning without exception, all of them.

exampleSimplified: 战争期间,政府对粮食的价格实行统制。
exampleTraditional: 戰爭期間,政府對糧食的價格實行統制。
exampleEnglish: During the war, the government imposed controls on food prices.
hintSimplified: 政府或上级集中管理,不让人自由决定。
hintTraditional: 政府或上級集中管理,不讓人自由決定。
hintEnglish: Centralized management by the government or authorities, leaving no free choice.

definition: to abhor; to detest; to loathe
exampleSimplified: 大家都痛恨那些欺骗老人的诈骗集团。
exampleTraditional: 大家都痛恨那些欺騙老人的詐騙集團。
exampleEnglish: Everyone deeply hates the scam rings that cheat the elderly.
hintSimplified: 对某人或某事感到非常强烈的不满和讨厌。
hintTraditional: 對某人或某事感到非常強烈的不滿和討厭。
hintEnglish: To feel very strong resentment and dislike toward someone or something.

definition: illegal immigration; to run a blockade; to steal across the international border; to stowaway (on a ship)
exampleSimplified: 有些人冒着生命危险坐小船偷渡到别的国家。
exampleTraditional: 有些人冒著生命危險坐小船偷渡到別的國家。
exampleEnglish: Some people risk their lives crossing by small boat illegally into other countries.
hintSimplified: 没有合法手续,偷偷地过境进入另一个国家。
hintTraditional: 沒有合法手續,偷偷地過境進入另一個國家。
hintEnglish: To secretly cross a border into another country without legal papers.

gloss: to be lazy when effort is expected; to slack off
definition: to be lazy when effort is expected; to slack off
exampleSimplified: 老板不在的时候,他就偷懒玩手机。
exampleTraditional: 老闆不在的時候,他就偷懶玩手機。
exampleEnglish: When the boss is away, he slacks off and plays on his phone.
hintSimplified: 应该认真做事的时候,却想办法少做一点。
hintTraditional: 應該認真做事的時候,卻想辦法少做一點。
hintEnglish: When you should work hard, you find ways to do less.

definition: to insure; to take out insurance
exampleSimplified: 出国旅行前,我先为自己投保了旅游险。
exampleTraditional: 出國旅行前,我先為自己投保了旅遊險。
exampleEnglish: Before traveling abroad, I took out travel insurance for myself.
hintSimplified: 向保险公司申请并付费,买一份保障。
hintTraditional: 向保險公司申請並付費,買一份保障。
hintEnglish: To apply to an insurance company and pay for coverage.

definition: congenial; agreeable; to speculate; to profiteer
exampleSimplified: 他靠炒股票投机,结果赔了不少钱。
exampleTraditional: 他靠炒股票投機,結果賠了不少錢。
exampleEnglish: He speculated by trading stocks and ended up losing a lot of money.
hintSimplified: 为了赚快钱,冒险抓住机会买卖;也指两人谈得来。
hintTraditional: 為了賺快錢,冒險抓住機會買賣;也指兩人談得來。
hintEnglish: Seizing chances to trade for quick profit at a risk; also describes two people who get along well.

exampleSimplified: 这个杯子是透明的,可以看见里面的水。
exampleTraditional: 這個杯子是透明的,可以看見裡面的水。
exampleEnglish: This cup is transparent, so you can see the water inside.
hintSimplified: 像干净的玻璃一样,光可以穿过,能看到另一边。
hintTraditional: 像乾淨的玻璃一樣,光可以穿過,能看到另一邊。
hintEnglish: Like clean glass, light passes through and you can see the other side.

exampleSimplified: 他跟着师傅学做面包，已经当了三年徒弟。
exampleTraditional: 他跟著師傅學做麵包，已經當了三年徒弟。
exampleEnglish: He has been learning to bake bread from his master and has been an apprentice for three years.
hintSimplified: 跟着师傅学手艺的人。
hintTraditional: 跟著師傅學手藝的人。
hintEnglish: A person who learns a craft by following a master.

definition: assault; concentrated effort to finish a job quickly; fig. rushed job; sudden and violent attack
exampleSimplified: 老师今天突击检查大家的作业。
exampleTraditional: 老師今天突擊檢查大家的作業。
exampleEnglish: Today the teacher made a surprise check of everyone's homework.
hintSimplified: 没有事先通知，突然进行检查或行动。
hintTraditional: 沒有事先通知，突然進行檢查或行動。
hintEnglish: To act or inspect suddenly without prior notice.

exampleSimplified: 他在会议上突然说出这句话，让大家觉得很突兀。
exampleTraditional: 他在會議上突然說出這句話，讓大家覺得很突兀。
exampleEnglish: He suddenly said this in the meeting, and everyone found it abrupt and out of place.
hintSimplified: 形容事情或东西出现得很不自然，和周围不太协调。
hintTraditional: 形容事情或東西出現得很不自然，和周圍不太協調。
hintEnglish: Describes something that appears unnatural and out of harmony with its surroundings.

exampleSimplified: 这份报告里有很多图表，看起来很清楚。
exampleTraditional: 這份報告裡有很多圖表，看起來很清楚。
exampleEnglish: This report has many charts, so it looks very clear.
hintSimplified: 用线条、方块或圆形把数字整理成图的东西。
hintTraditional: 用線條、方塊或圓形把數字整理成圖的東西。
hintEnglish: Something that organizes numbers into lines, bars or circles.

exampleSimplified: 这个原住民部落的图腾是一只老鹰。
exampleTraditional: 這個原住民部落的圖騰是一隻老鷹。
exampleEnglish: The totem of this indigenous tribe is an eagle.
hintSimplified: 古代部落当作象征或守护的动物或图案。
hintTraditional: 古代部落當作象徵或守護的動物或圖案。
hintEnglish: An animal or symbol that an ancient tribe treated as its emblem or protector.

exampleSimplified: 这里的土壤很肥沃，适合种水果。
exampleTraditional: 這裡的土壤很肥沃，適合種水果。
exampleEnglish: The soil here is very fertile and suitable for growing fruit.
hintSimplified: 植物生长需要的地面上的泥土。
hintTraditional: 植物生長需要的地面上的泥土。
hintEnglish: The earth on the ground that plants need in order to grow.

definition: to have a reunion; to reunite
exampleSimplified: 春节的时候，全家人都会回老家团聚。
exampleTraditional: 春節的時候，全家人都會回老家團聚。
exampleEnglish: During Chinese New Year, the whole family goes back to the hometown to be together.
hintSimplified: 分开的家人或朋友重新聚在一起。
hintTraditional: 分開的家人或朋友重新聚在一起。
hintEnglish: When separated family or friends come together again.

exampleSimplified: 这个合唱团的团员每个星期六都要练习。
exampleTraditional: 這個合唱團的團員每個星期六都要練習。
exampleEnglish: The members of this choir have to practice every Saturday.
hintSimplified: 属于某个团体或组织的人。
hintTraditional: 屬於某個團體或組織的人。
hintEnglish: A person who belongs to a certain group or organization.

definition: speculation; to conjecture; to speculate; to surmise
exampleSimplified: 这只是我的推测，还没有证据。
exampleTraditional: 這只是我的推測，還沒有證據。
exampleEnglish: This is only my guess; I don't have any evidence yet.
hintSimplified: 根据已知的信息，想象还不确定的事情。
hintTraditional: 根據已知的資訊，想象還不確定的事情。
hintEnglish: Imagining something uncertain based on known information.

definition: to accord importance to; to esteem; to revere; to think highly of
exampleSimplified: 大家都很推崇这位老师的教学方法。
exampleTraditional: 大家都很推崇這位老師的教學方法。
exampleEnglish: Everyone holds this teacher's teaching method in high esteem.
hintSimplified: 对某人或某事给予很高的评价和尊敬。
hintTraditional: 對某人或某事給予很高的評價和尊敬。
hintEnglish: To give someone or something very high praise and respect.

definition: to launch; to publish; to push out; to recommend; to release
exampleSimplified: 这家公司下个月会推出一款新手机。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司下個月會推出一款新手機。
exampleEnglish: This company will release a new phone next month.
hintSimplified: 公司把新产品或新活动第一次拿给大众。
hintTraditional: 公司把新產品或新活動第一次拿給大眾。
hintEnglish: When a company presents a new product or activity to the public for the first time.

exampleSimplified: 大家一起推选他当班长。
exampleTraditional: 大家一起推選他當班長。
exampleEnglish: Everyone together chose him to be class president.
hintSimplified: 大家通过讨论或投票，选出适合的人。
hintTraditional: 大家透過討論或投票，選出適合的人。
hintEnglish: A group picks a suitable person through discussion or voting.

exampleSimplified: 人老了以后，身体的功能会慢慢退化。
exampleTraditional: 人老了以後，身體的功能會慢慢退化。
exampleEnglish: When people get old, their body functions gradually deteriorate.
hintSimplified: 能力或功能慢慢变差，不如以前。
hintTraditional: 能力或功能慢慢變差，不如以前。
hintEnglish: Abilities or functions gradually become worse than before.

definition: to be a burden on; to encumber; to implicate
exampleSimplified: 他不想拖累家人，所以决定自己去工作。
exampleTraditional: 他不想拖累家人，所以決定自己去工作。
exampleEnglish: He didn't want to be a burden on his family, so he decided to go to work himself.
hintSimplified: 因为自己的问题，给别人带来麻烦和负担。
hintTraditional: 因為自己的問題，給別人帶來麻煩和負擔。
hintEnglish: To bring trouble and burden to others because of one's own problems.

definition: to delay; to procrastinate; to put off
exampleSimplified: 你不要再拖延了，赶快把报告写完。
exampleTraditional: 你不要再拖延了，趕快把報告寫完。
exampleEnglish: Stop putting it off and hurry up and finish writing the report.
hintSimplified: 该做的事不马上做，一直往后放。
hintTraditional: 該做的事不馬上做，一直往後放。
hintEnglish: Not doing what should be done right away and keep putting it off.

definition: to disengage; to escape (from obligations); to free oneself; to get away
exampleSimplified: 我现在太忙了，实在没办法脱身。
exampleTraditional: 我現在太忙了，實在沒辦法脫身。
exampleEnglish: I'm too busy right now and really can't get away.
hintSimplified: 从很忙或麻烦的事情中离开。
hintTraditional: 從很忙或麻煩的事情中離開。
hintEnglish: To leave a busy or troublesome situation.

gloss: (not of regular commerce) to sell or dispose of (goods etc)
definition: (not of regular commerce) to sell or dispose of (goods etc); to get rid of; to unload
exampleSimplified: 他急着搬家，所以把旧车尽快脱手了。
exampleTraditional: 他急著搬家，所以把舊車儘快脫手了。
exampleEnglish: He was in a hurry to move, so he sold his old car off quickly.
hintSimplified: 把手上的东西卖掉，不再拥有。
hintTraditional: 把手上的東西賣掉，不再擁有。
hintEnglish: To sell something you hold so you no longer own it.

exampleSimplified: 因为他个子很高，同学都叫他的外号“长颈鹿”。
exampleTraditional: 因為他個子很高，同學都叫他的外號“長頸鹿”。
exampleEnglish: Because he is very tall, his classmates call him by the nickname "giraffe".
hintSimplified: 朋友根据特点给人取的、不是本名的称呼。
hintTraditional: 朋友根據特點給人取的、不是本名的稱呼。
hintEnglish: A name friends give someone based on a trait, not their real name.

exampleSimplified: 这座桥可以承受很大的外力。
exampleTraditional: 這座橋可以承受很大的外力。
exampleEnglish: This bridge can withstand a lot of external force.
hintSimplified: 从物体外面来的推或拉的力量。
hintTraditional: 從物體外面來的推或拉的力量。
hintEnglish: A pushing or pulling force coming from outside an object.

exampleSimplified: 他在一家外贸公司上班，常常跟国外客户联络。
exampleTraditional: 他在一家外貿公司上班，常常跟國外客戶聯絡。
exampleEnglish: He works at a foreign trade company and often contacts overseas clients.
hintSimplified: 一个国家和别的国家买卖商品的活动。
hintTraditional: 一個國家和別的國家買賣商品的活動。
hintEnglish: The activity of a country buying and selling goods with other countries.

definition: (basketball) outside the three-point line; (military) line of troops encircling an enemy position; (telephony) outside line
exampleSimplified: 他的外线投篮很准，常常帮球队得分。
exampleTraditional: 他的外線投籃很準，常常幫球隊得分。
exampleEnglish: His outside shooting is very accurate and often helps the team score.
hintSimplified: 篮球场上离篮筐比较远的区域。
hintTraditional: 籃球場上離籃筐比較遠的區域。
hintEnglish: The area on a basketball court that is far from the hoop.

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂生产的茶叶大部分都外销到日本。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠生產的茶葉大部分都外銷到日本。
exampleEnglish: Most of the tea produced by this factory is exported to Japan.
hintSimplified: 把本地生产的东西卖到别的国家。
hintTraditional: 把本地生產的東西賣到別的國家。
hintEnglish: To sell locally made goods to other countries.

exampleSimplified: 外遇问题让他们的婚姻出现了裂痕。
exampleTraditional: 外遇問題讓他們的婚姻出現了裂痕。
exampleEnglish: The problem of an affair put a crack in their marriage.
hintSimplified: 结了婚的人和配偶以外的人有感情关系。
hintTraditional: 結了婚的人和配偶以外的人有感情關係。
hintEnglish: A married person having a romantic relationship with someone other than their spouse.

exampleSimplified: 成功不只靠外在条件，也要靠自己的努力。
exampleTraditional: 成功不只靠外在條件，也要靠自己的努力。
exampleEnglish: Success doesn't depend only on external conditions but also on your own effort.
hintSimplified: 在表面或外部的，不是内部的。
hintTraditional: 在表面或外部的，不是內部的。
hintEnglish: On the surface or outside, not inside.

exampleSimplified: 政府欢迎外资来这里设厂。
exampleTraditional: 政府歡迎外資來這裡設廠。
exampleEnglish: The government welcomes foreign capital to set up factories here.
hintSimplified: 从别的国家来的企业或个人投入的钱。
hintTraditional: 從別的國家來的企業或個人投入的錢。
hintEnglish: Money invested by companies or individuals from other countries.

definition: crooked; curved; to bend; to curve around; to warp; to wind
exampleSimplified: 这条山路弯曲得很厉害,开车要小心。
exampleTraditional: 這條山路彎曲得很厲害,開車要小心。
exampleEnglish: This mountain road is very winding, so drive carefully.
hintSimplified: 形容路、河或线条不是直的,而是一路拐来拐去。
hintTraditional: 形容路、河或線條不是直的,而是一路拐來拐去。
hintEnglish: Describes a road, river or line that is not straight but twists and turns.

definition: complete; faultless; perfect; to leave nothing to be desired
exampleSimplified: 这家医院的设备非常完备,什么检查都能做。
exampleTraditional: 這家醫院的裝置非常完備,什麼檢查都能做。
exampleEnglish: This hospital's equipment is very complete; it can do any kind of exam.
hintSimplified: 形容设施、制度或准备样样都有,没有缺少什么。
hintTraditional: 形容設施、制度或準備樣樣都有,沒有缺少什麼。
hintEnglish: Describes facilities, systems or preparations in which nothing is missing.

definition: to dally with; to engage in; to play with; to resort to; to toy with
exampleSimplified: 他一直在玩弄别人的感情,真让人生气。
exampleTraditional: 他一直在玩弄別人的感情,真讓人生氣。
exampleEnglish: He keeps toying with other people's feelings, which is really infuriating.
hintSimplified: 不认真、不尊重地对待人或事物,只是拿来消遣或操纵。
hintTraditional: 不認真、不尊重地對待人或事物,只是拿來消遣或操縱。
hintEnglish: To treat a person or thing without seriousness or respect, just for amusement or manipulation.

exampleSimplified: 她以顽强的意志战胜了疾病。
exampleTraditional: 她以頑強的意志戰勝了疾病。
exampleEnglish: She overcame the illness with her tenacious will.
hintSimplified: 形容人面对困难时很坚强,不轻易放弃。
hintTraditional: 形容人面對困難時很堅強,不輕易放棄。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is strong in the face of difficulty and does not give up easily.

definition: to remedy; to rescue; to save
exampleSimplified: 医生努力挽救了这个病人的生命。
exampleTraditional: 醫生努力挽救了這個病人的生命。
exampleEnglish: The doctor worked hard to save this patient's life.
hintSimplified: 在情况很糟或快要失败时,想办法让它不要变得更坏。
hintTraditional: 在情況很糟或快要失敗時,想辦法讓它不要變得更壞。
hintEnglish: When things are going badly or about to fail, to find a way to keep them from getting worse.

definition: extremely; one ten thousandth part; very much
exampleSimplified: 听到这个好消息,我万分高兴。
exampleTraditional: 聽到這個好訊息,我萬分高興。
exampleEnglish: Hearing this good news, I was extremely happy.
hintSimplified: 放在形容词前面,表示程度非常非常高。
hintTraditional: 放在形容詞前面,表示程度非常非常高。
hintEnglish: Placed before an adjective to show the degree is extremely high.

exampleSimplified: 俗话说,家和万事兴。
exampleTraditional: 俗話說,家和萬事興。
exampleEnglish: As the saying goes, when the family is harmonious, everything prospers.
hintSimplified: 指世界上所有的事情,常出现在祝福的话里。
hintTraditional: 指世界上所有的事情,常出現在祝福的話裡。
hintEnglish: Refers to all matters in the world, often found in well-wishing phrases.

definition: His Majesty; Long live (the king, the revolution etc)!; Your Majesty
exampleSimplified: 大家一起喊:“祖国万岁!”
exampleTraditional: 大家一起喊:“祖國萬歲!”
exampleEnglish: Everyone shouted together: "Long live the motherland!"
hintSimplified: 人们欢呼时喊的话,祝愿某人或某事永远存在。
hintTraditional: 人們歡呼時喊的話,祝願某人或某事永遠存在。
hintEnglish: What people shout when cheering, wishing someone or something to last forever.

gloss: absolutely; certainly (usually followed by a negative expression)
definition: absolutely; certainly (usually followed by a negative expression); hundred million; (fig.) enormous quantity
exampleSimplified: 这件事你万万不可告诉别人。
exampleTraditional: 這件事你萬萬不可告訴別人。
exampleEnglish: You must absolutely not tell anyone about this.
hintSimplified: 副词,多放在否定词前面,强调绝对不可以或不可能。
hintTraditional: 副詞,多放在否定詞前面,強調絕對不可以或不可能。
hintEnglish: An adverb, usually before a negative word, stressing something is absolutely not allowed or possible.

exampleSimplified: 春天来了,万物都开始生长。
exampleTraditional: 春天來了,萬物都開始生長。
exampleEnglish: Spring has come, and all living things begin to grow.
hintSimplified: 指世界上所有的东西,特别是自然界的一切生物。
hintTraditional: 指世界上所有的東西,特別是自然界的一切生物。
hintEnglish: Refers to everything in the world, especially all living things in nature.

definition: to feel sorry for sb; to feel that it is a great pity; to regret
exampleSimplified: 大家都为他错过这次机会而感到惋惜。
exampleTraditional: 大家都為他錯過這次機會而感到惋惜。
exampleEnglish: Everyone felt sorry that he missed this opportunity.
hintSimplified: 看到好的人或事没有好结果时,心里觉得可惜、难过。
hintTraditional: 看到好的人或事沒有好結果時,心裡覺得可惜、難過。
hintEnglish: The sad feeling when a good person or thing does not turn out well.

gloss: (of a nation) to be destroyed; to be subjugated
definition: (of a nation) to be destroyed; to be subjugated; a fallen nation
exampleSimplified: 历史上有很多王朝因为内乱而亡国。
exampleTraditional: 歷史上有很多王朝因為內亂而亡國。
exampleEnglish: In history, many dynasties fell because of internal turmoil.
hintSimplified: 一个国家被消灭,不再存在。
hintTraditional: 一個國家被消滅,不再存在。
hintEnglish: When a country is wiped out and no longer exists.

definition: contacts; dealings; to go back and forth
exampleSimplified: 这两家公司之间有很多业务往来。
exampleTraditional: 這兩家公司之間有很多業務往來。
exampleEnglish: There is a lot of business interaction between these two companies.
hintSimplified: 人或团体之间互相联系、走动、交流。
hintTraditional: 人或團體之間互相聯絡、走動、交流。
hintEnglish: Mutual contact, visits and exchanges between people or groups.

definition: busy season; peak period; see also 淡季[dan4 ji4]
exampleSimplified: 暑假是旅游业的旺季,机票特别贵。
exampleTraditional: 暑假是旅遊業的旺季,機票特別貴。
exampleEnglish: Summer vacation is the peak season for tourism, and plane tickets are especially expensive.
hintSimplified: 一年中生意最好、客人最多的时期。
hintTraditional: 一年中生意最好、客人最多的時期。
hintEnglish: The time of year when business is best and customers are most numerous.

exampleSimplified: 年轻人精力旺盛,很少觉得累。
exampleTraditional: 年輕人精力旺盛,很少覺得累。
exampleEnglish: Young people are full of energy and rarely feel tired.
hintSimplified: 形容生命力、精神或需求非常强,很有活力。
hintTraditional: 形容生命力、精神或需求非常強,很有活力。
hintEnglish: Describes vitality, spirit or demand that is very strong and full of life.

definition: awe-inspiring bearing; authority; power; imposing; impressive; majestic
exampleSimplified: 穿上制服的警察看起来很威风。
exampleTraditional: 穿上制服的警察看起來很威風。
exampleEnglish: The police officer looks very imposing in uniform.
hintSimplified: 形容人的样子很有气势,让人敬畏。
hintTraditional: 形容人的樣子很有氣勢,讓人敬畏。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose appearance is commanding and inspires respect.

exampleSimplified: 这种新武器的威力非常大。
exampleTraditional: 這種新武器的威力非常大。
exampleEnglish: The power of this new weapon is enormous.
hintSimplified: 指某种东西所拥有的很大的力量或作用。
hintTraditional: 指某種東西所擁有的很大的力量或作用。
hintEnglish: The great force or effect that something possesses.

gloss: to atrophy (of muscle, social custom etc)
definition: to atrophy (of muscle, social custom etc); to dry up (of a plant); to wither
exampleSimplified: 长期不运动,肌肉会慢慢萎缩。
exampleTraditional: 長期不運動,肌肉會慢慢萎縮。
exampleEnglish: If you don't exercise for a long time, your muscles will gradually atrophy.
hintSimplified: 身体的一部分或经济、市场变小、变弱,不如以前。
hintTraditional: 身體的一部分或經濟、市場變小、變弱,不如以前。
hintEnglish: When a body part, or an economy or market, shrinks and becomes weaker than before.

definition: behavior; conduct; personal character; for others' interest; for sb; to conduct oneself
exampleSimplified: 他为人正直,大家都很信任他。
exampleTraditional: 他為人正直,大家都很信任他。
exampleEnglish: He is upright in character, and everyone trusts him.
hintSimplified: 说一个人的品格和处世的方式。
hintTraditional: 說一個人的品格和處世的方式。
hintEnglish: Speaks of a person's character and way of dealing with others.

exampleSimplified: 他以捕鱼为生,住在海边。
exampleTraditional: 他以捕魚為生,住在海邊。
exampleEnglish: He makes his living by fishing and lives by the sea.
hintSimplified: 靠做某种工作来赚钱,维持日子。
hintTraditional: 靠做某種工作來賺錢,維持日子。
hintEnglish: To rely on a certain job to earn money and keep life going.

exampleSimplified: 以校长为首的代表团今天抵达台北。
exampleTraditional: 以校長為首的代表團今天抵達台北。
exampleEnglish: The delegation headed by the principal arrived in Taipei today.
hintSimplified: 一群人中,由某个人领头、担任最重要的位置。
hintTraditional: 一群人中,由某個人領頭、擔任最重要的位置。
hintEnglish: In a group, with a certain person in the lead holding the most important position.

gloss: (used in combination with words like 到[dao4] or 至[zhi4] in constructs of the form 到...為止|到...为止)
definition: (used in combination with words like 到[dao4] or 至[zhi4] in constructs of the form 到...為止|到...为止); until
exampleSimplified: 到目前为止,我们已经卖出了五百本书。
exampleTraditional: 到目前為止,我們已經賣出了五百本書。
exampleEnglish: Up to now, we have already sold five hundred books.
hintSimplified: 常和“到”一起用,表示事情持续到某个时间或程度就结束。
hintTraditional: 常和“到”一起用,表示事情持續到某個時間或程度就結束。
hintEnglish: Often used with "to", showing that something continues up to a certain time or point and then ends.

definition: to be contrary to; to go against; to violate
exampleSimplified: 这样做违背了我们的原则。
exampleTraditional: 這樣做違背了我們的原則。
exampleEnglish: Doing it this way goes against our principles.
hintSimplified: 做的事和原则、愿望或规定相反。
hintTraditional: 做的事和原則、願望或規定相反。
hintEnglish: What you do is the opposite of a principle, wish or rule.

definition: to break a promise; to default (on a loan or contract); to violate an agreement
exampleSimplified: 如果公司违约,就要赔钱给客户。
exampleTraditional: 如果公司違約,就要賠錢給客戶。
exampleEnglish: If the company breaches the contract, it must pay compensation to the customer.
hintSimplified: 没有按照合同或约定去做。
hintTraditional: 沒有按照合同或約定去做。
hintEnglish: Not doing what a contract or agreement says.

definition: harmful effect; damage; to harm; to jeopardize; to endanger
exampleSimplified: 吸烟对健康的危害很大。
exampleTraditional: 吸菸對健康的危害很大。
exampleEnglish: Smoking does great harm to health.
hintSimplified: 对人或事物造成的坏影响和伤害。
hintTraditional: 對人或事物造成的壞影響和傷害。
hintEnglish: The bad influence and damage caused to people or things.

exampleSimplified: 冬天很冷,出门要戴一条围巾。
exampleTraditional: 冬天很冷,出門要戴一條圍巾。
exampleEnglish: It's cold in winter, so you should wear a scarf when going out.
hintSimplified: 天气冷的时候,绕在脖子上保暖的长布。
hintTraditional: 天氣冷的時候,繞在脖子上保暖的長布。
hintEnglish: A long piece of cloth wrapped around the neck to keep warm in cold weather.

exampleSimplified: 学校的围墙很高,外面的人进不来。
exampleTraditional: 學校的圍牆很高,外面的人進不來。
exampleEnglish: The school's surrounding wall is high, so outsiders can't get in.
hintSimplified: 建在房子或学校四周,把里面和外面隔开的墙。
hintTraditional: 建在房子或學校四周,把裡面和外面隔開的牆。
hintEnglish: A wall built around a house or school that separates inside from outside.

definition: to center on (an issue); to revolve around
exampleSimplified: 我们的讨论围绕着环保问题进行。
exampleTraditional: 我們的討論圍繞著環保問題進行。
exampleEnglish: Our discussion revolves around environmental protection issues.
hintSimplified: 在某个中心的四周转动,或者以某个话题为重点。
hintTraditional: 在某個中心的四周轉動,或者以某個話題為重點。
hintEnglish: To move around a center, or to take a topic as the focus.

exampleSimplified: 病人的呼吸非常微弱。
exampleTraditional: 病人的呼吸非常微弱。
exampleEnglish: The patient's breathing is very faint.
hintSimplified: 形容声音、光线或力量很小,几乎感觉不到。
hintTraditional: 形容聲音、光線或力量很小,幾乎感覺不到。
hintEnglish: Describes a sound, light or strength that is so small it is hardly noticeable.

exampleSimplified: 这种微小的虫子,用眼睛几乎看不见。
exampleTraditional: 這種微小的蟲子,用眼睛幾乎看不見。
exampleEnglish: This tiny insect is almost invisible to the naked eye.
hintSimplified: 形容东西体积非常小,小到不容易注意到。
hintTraditional: 形容東西體積非常小,小到不容易注意到。
hintEnglish: Describes something so small in size that it is hard to notice.

exampleSimplified: 最近天气太热,我一点儿胃口也没有。
exampleTraditional: 最近天氣太熱,我一點兒胃口也沒有。
exampleEnglish: The weather has been so hot lately that I have no appetite at all.
hintSimplified: 想吃东西的感觉。生病或太热时,这种感觉常常会变差。
hintTraditional: 想吃東西的感覺。生病或太熱時,這種感覺常常會變差。
hintEnglish: The desire to eat. It often gets worse when you are ill or when it's too hot.

exampleSimplified: 贵的东西未必就是好的东西。
exampleTraditional: 貴的東西未必就是好的東西。
exampleEnglish: Expensive things are not necessarily good things.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示某件事不一定是真的,也有可能不是这样。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示某件事不一定是真的,也有可能不是這樣。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning something is not necessarily true; it may not be so.

exampleSimplified: 你这样说,未免太不客气了。
exampleTraditional: 你這樣說,未免太不客氣了。
exampleEnglish: Saying it like that is a bit too impolite.
hintSimplified: 副词,用来表示觉得某件事做得有点过分或不太合适。
hintTraditional: 副詞,用來表示覺得某件事做得有點過分或不太合適。
hintEnglish: An adverb used to express that something seems a bit excessive or inappropriate.

exampleSimplified: 这个国家位于温带,四季分明。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家位於溫帶,四季分明。
exampleEnglish: This country is located in the temperate zone and has four distinct seasons.
hintSimplified: 地球上不太热也不太冷的地区,四季变化明显。
hintTraditional: 地球上不太熱也不太冷的地區,四季變化明顯。
hintEnglish: A region of the earth that is neither too hot nor too cold, with clear seasonal changes.

exampleSimplified: 考试以前,我要把学过的课文再温习一遍。
exampleTraditional: 考試以前,我要把學過的課文再溫習一遍。
exampleEnglish: Before the exam, I need to go over the texts I've studied once more.
hintSimplified: 把学过的东西再看一次,免得忘记。
hintTraditional: 把學過的東西再看一次,免得忘記。
hintEnglish: To look again at what you've learned so that you won't forget it.

definition: docile; harmless; meek; moderate and obedient; tame
exampleSimplified: 这只小狗性格温驯,小孩子都喜欢它。
exampleTraditional: 這隻小狗性格溫馴,小孩子都喜歡它。
exampleEnglish: This puppy has a gentle, docile nature, and all the children like it.
hintSimplified: 形容动物很听话,不会攻击人。
hintTraditional: 形容動物很聽話,不會攻擊人。
hintEnglish: Describes an animal that is obedient and does not attack people.

exampleSimplified: 历史上的瘟疫夺走了很多人的生命。
exampleTraditional: 歷史上的瘟疫奪走了很多人的生命。
exampleEnglish: Plagues in history took the lives of many people.
hintSimplified: 一种传播很快、让很多人生病的可怕传染病。
hintTraditional: 一種傳播很快、讓很多人生病的可怕傳染病。
hintEnglish: A terrible contagious disease that spreads quickly and makes many people sick.

exampleSimplified: 古埃及是人类最早的文明之一。
exampleTraditional: 古埃及是人類最早的文明之一。
exampleEnglish: Ancient Egypt is one of the earliest civilizations of humankind.
hintSimplified: 人类社会发展出来的文化和生活方式,例如古代的某个大国。
hintTraditional: 人類社會發展出來的文化和生活方式,例如古代的某個大國。
hintEnglish: The culture and way of life developed by human society, such as that of a great ancient state.

exampleSimplified: 这位年轻作家在文坛上很受欢迎。
exampleTraditional: 這位年輕作家在文壇上很受歡迎。
exampleEnglish: This young writer is very popular in the literary world.
hintSimplified: 作家、诗人等写作的人所组成的圈子。
hintTraditional: 作家、詩人等寫作的人所組成的圈子。
hintEnglish: The circle formed by writers, poets and other people who write.

exampleSimplified: 写论文时,要先查很多文献。
exampleTraditional: 寫論文時,要先查很多文獻。
exampleEnglish: When writing a thesis, you first have to look up a lot of literature.
hintSimplified: 做研究时参考的书籍、论文和资料。
hintTraditional: 做研究時參考的書籍、論文和資料。
hintEnglish: The books, papers and materials consulted when doing research.

exampleSimplified: 台北一零一大楼闻名世界。
exampleTraditional: 台北一零一大樓聞名世界。
exampleEnglish: Taipei 101 is world-famous.
hintSimplified: 形容人或地方名气很大,很多人都听说过。
hintTraditional: 形容人或地方名氣很大,很多人都聽說過。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or place with a great reputation that many people have heard of.

exampleSimplified: 他做事一向很稳健,不会冒太大的风险。
exampleTraditional: 他做事一向很穩健,不會冒太大的風險。
exampleEnglish: He always acts steadily and doesn't take too big risks.
hintSimplified: 形容人做事稳当、小心,不急躁。
hintTraditional: 形容人做事穩當、小心,不急躁。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who acts in a steady, careful way without being hasty.

exampleSimplified: 熬夜太多会让生活作息紊乱。
exampleTraditional: 熬夜太多會讓生活作息紊亂。
exampleEnglish: Staying up late too often will disrupt your daily routine.
hintSimplified: 形容事情失去正常的次序,变得乱七八糟。
hintTraditional: 形容事情失去正常的次序,變得亂七八糟。
hintEnglish: Describes things that have lost their normal order and become disordered.

definition: to be published; to come out
exampleSimplified: 这部新手机下个月就要问世了。
exampleTraditional: 這部新手機下個月就要問世了。
exampleEnglish: This new phone will come out next month.
hintSimplified: 新的作品或产品第一次出现在大家面前。
hintTraditional: 新的作品或產品第一次出現在大家面前。
hintEnglish: When a new work or product appears before the public for the first time.

exampleSimplified: 乌龟爬得很慢,但是可以活很久。
exampleTraditional: 烏龜爬得很慢,但是可以活很久。
exampleEnglish: Turtles crawl very slowly, but they can live a long time.
hintSimplified: 背上有硬壳的动物,走得很慢,寿命很长。
hintTraditional: 背上有硬殼的動物,走得很慢,壽命很長。
hintEnglish: An animal with a hard shell on its back that walks slowly and lives very long.

exampleSimplified: 树上有一只黑色的乌鸦在叫。
exampleTraditional: 樹上有一隻黑色的烏鴉在叫。
exampleEnglish: A black crow is cawing in the tree.
hintSimplified: 一种全身黑色的鸟,叫声沙哑。
hintTraditional: 一種全身黑色的鳥,叫聲沙啞。
hintEnglish: A bird with all-black feathers and a hoarse call.

exampleSimplified: 看到孩子平安回来,妈妈高兴无比。
exampleTraditional: 看到孩子平安回來,媽媽高興無比。
exampleEnglish: Seeing her child return safely, the mother was incomparably happy.
hintSimplified: 放在形容词后面,表示程度非常高,没有什么能比得上。
hintTraditional: 放在形容詞後面,表示程度非常高,沒有什麼能比得上。
hintEnglish: Placed after an adjective to show an extremely high degree that nothing can match.

exampleSimplified: 老师的话给了我无形的压力。
exampleTraditional: 老師的話給了我無形的壓力。
exampleEnglish: The teacher's words put invisible pressure on me.
hintSimplified: 形容东西看不见、摸不到,却真的有影响。
hintTraditional: 形容東西看不見、摸不到,卻真的有影響。
hintEnglish: Describes something that can't be seen or touched but really has an effect.

exampleSimplified: 他的努力无疑是这次成功的关键。
exampleTraditional: 他的努力無疑是這次成功的關鍵。
exampleEnglish: His effort was undoubtedly the key to this success.
hintSimplified: 表示事情非常确定,没有任何怀疑的地方。
hintTraditional: 表示事情非常確定,沒有任何懷疑的地方。
hintEnglish: Expresses that something is completely certain, with nothing to doubt.

definition: metal hardware (nuts and bolts); the five metals: gold, silver, copper, iron, tin 金銀銅鐵錫|金银铜铁锡[jin1 yin2 tong2 tie3 xi1]
exampleSimplified: 爸爸去五金行买了螺丝和锤子。
exampleTraditional: 爸爸去五金行買了螺絲和錘子。
exampleEnglish: Dad went to the hardware store to buy screws and a hammer.
hintSimplified: 螺丝、钉子、工具等金属小东西的总称。
hintTraditional: 螺絲、釘子、工具等金屬小東西的總稱。
hintEnglish: A general term for small metal items such as screws, nails and tools.

exampleSimplified: 解决问题不应该只靠武力。
exampleTraditional: 解決問題不應該只靠武力。
exampleEnglish: Problems should not be solved by force alone.
hintSimplified: 用军队或拳头等强硬的力量来压制别人。
hintTraditional: 用軍隊或拳頭等強硬的力量來壓制別人。
hintEnglish: Using the strength of armies or fists to force others into submission.

exampleSimplified: 这位武士每天都认真练习剑术。
exampleTraditional: 這位武士每天都認真練習劍術。
exampleEnglish: This samurai practices swordsmanship seriously every day.
hintSimplified: 古代日本腰间带刀的战士。
hintTraditional: 古代日本腰間帶刀的戰士。
hintEnglish: A sword-carrying warrior of ancient Japan.

definition: armed (forces); arms; equipment; military; to arm
exampleSimplified: 那些士兵全副武装,准备出发。
exampleTraditional: 那些士兵全副武裝,準備出發。
exampleEnglish: Those soldiers are fully armed and ready to set out.
hintSimplified: 给人配备枪炮等武器,或指带着武器的状态。
hintTraditional: 給人配備槍炮等武器,或指帶著武器的狀態。
hintEnglish: To equip people with guns and weapons, or the state of carrying them.

exampleSimplified: 你不可以用难听的话侮辱别人。
exampleTraditional: 你不可以用難聽的話侮辱別人。
exampleEnglish: You must not insult others with nasty words.
hintSimplified: 说难听的话或做坏事,让别人觉得丢脸、没有尊严。
hintTraditional: 說難聽的話或做壞事,讓別人覺得丟臉、沒有尊嚴。
hintEnglish: Saying or doing something that makes others feel shamed and stripped of dignity.

exampleSimplified: 这个岛的物产非常丰富。
exampleTraditional: 這個島的物產非常豐富。
exampleEnglish: This island is rich in natural products.
hintSimplified: 一个地方出产的农作物、矿产等东西。
hintTraditional: 一個地方出產的農作物、礦產等東西。
hintEnglish: The crops, minerals and other things a region produces.

exampleSimplified: 请带好您的随身物品。
exampleTraditional: 請帶好您的隨身物品。
exampleEnglish: Please take your personal belongings with you.
hintSimplified: 人们使用或携带的各种东西的总称。
hintTraditional: 人們使用或攜帶的各種東西的總稱。
hintEnglish: A general term for the various things people use or carry.

exampleSimplified: 桌上有一个奇怪的圆形物体。
exampleTraditional: 桌上有一個奇怪的圓形物體。
exampleEnglish: There is a strange round object on the table.
hintSimplified: 有形状、占空间的东西,科学课常用这个词。
hintTraditional: 有形狀、佔空間的東西,科學課常用這個詞。
hintEnglish: Something with shape that takes up space; a word often used in science class.

exampleSimplified: 灾区急需食物和药品等物资。
exampleTraditional: 災區急需食物和藥品等物資。
exampleEnglish: The disaster area urgently needs supplies such as food and medicine.
hintSimplified: 生活或救灾时需要的食物、衣服、药品等东西。
hintTraditional: 生活或救災時需要的食物、衣服、藥品等東西。
hintEnglish: Food, clothes, medicine and the like needed for living or disaster relief.

exampleSimplified: 这个测量结果有一点误差。
exampleTraditional: 這個測量結果有一點誤差。
exampleEnglish: This measurement result has a slight error.
hintSimplified: 测量或计算的结果和真实数值之间的差距。
hintTraditional: 測量或計算的結果和真實數值之間的差距。
hintEnglish: The gap between a measured or calculated result and the true value.

exampleSimplified: 我们之间有一些误解,谈谈就好了。
exampleTraditional: 我們之間有一些誤解,談談就好了。
exampleEnglish: There is some misunderstanding between us; talking it over will fix it.
hintSimplified: 因为想错了对方的意思,所以产生不对的看法。
hintTraditional: 因為想錯了對方的意思,所以產生不對的看法。
hintEnglish: A wrong view that arises from misreading what someone meant.

definition: pragmatic; to deal with concrete matters
exampleSimplified: 他做事很务实,不喜欢空谈。
exampleTraditional: 他做事很務實,不喜歡空談。
exampleEnglish: He is very pragmatic and dislikes empty talk.
hintSimplified: 形容人重视实际效果,不说空话、不做表面功夫。
hintTraditional: 形容人重視實際效果,不說空話、不做表面功夫。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who values real results and avoids empty words or show.

exampleSimplified: 他穿着一套黑色的西服去面试。
exampleTraditional: 他穿著一套黑色的西服去面試。
exampleEnglish: He wore a black suit to the interview.
hintSimplified: 男士在正式场合常穿的上衣和长裤,通常配领带。
hintTraditional: 男士在正式場合常穿的上衣和長褲,通常配領帶。
hintEnglish: Jacket and trousers men wear on formal occasions, usually with a tie.

definition: countries of the Indian Ocean (traditional); the West (Europe and North America)
exampleSimplified: 这幅画是西洋风格的。
exampleTraditional: 這幅畫是西洋風格的。
exampleEnglish: This painting is in a Western style.
hintSimplified: 过去用来泛指欧美国家的说法。
hintTraditional: 過去用來泛指歐美國家的說法。
hintEnglish: An older way of referring generally to Europe and America.

definition: Western medicine; a doctor trained in Western medicine
exampleSimplified: 他生病时先去看西医,再看中医。
exampleTraditional: 他生病時先去看西醫,再看中醫。
exampleEnglish: When he is ill, he sees a Western doctor first, then a Chinese medicine doctor.
hintSimplified: 用手术和化学药物等现代方法治病的医生或医学。
hintTraditional: 用手術和化學藥物等現代方法治病的醫生或醫學。
hintEnglish: A doctor or medical system that treats illness with surgery and modern drugs.

exampleSimplified: 山里有一条清澈的溪流。
exampleTraditional: 山裡有一條清澈的溪流。
exampleEnglish: There is a clear stream in the mountains.
hintSimplified: 山中流下来的细小而清澈的水。
hintTraditional: 山中流下來的細小而清澈的水。
hintEnglish: Small, clear water flowing down from the mountains.

gloss: a seat (in a theater, stadium etc)
definition: a seat (in a theater, stadium etc); parliamentary or congressional seat
exampleSimplified: 这场演唱会的席位很快就卖完了。
exampleTraditional: 這場演唱會的席位很快就賣完了。
exampleEnglish: The seats for this concert sold out quickly.
hintSimplified: 在剧场、会场里留给某个人坐的位置。
hintTraditional: 在劇場、會場裡留給某個人坐的位置。
hintEnglish: A place reserved for someone to sit in a theater or meeting hall.

definition: attack (esp. surprise attack); raid; to attack
exampleSimplified: 敌人在半夜突然袭击了村子。
exampleTraditional: 敵人在半夜突然襲擊了村子。
exampleEnglish: The enemy suddenly attacked the village in the middle of the night.
hintSimplified: 趁别人没有准备,突然发动攻击。
hintTraditional: 趁別人沒有準備,突然發動攻擊。
hintEnglish: To strike suddenly while others are unprepared.

exampleSimplified: 昔日的小渔村现在已经变成大城市。
exampleTraditional: 昔日的小漁村現在已經變成大城市。
exampleEnglish: The small fishing village of the past has now become a big city.
hintSimplified: 指很久以前的日子,常和现在对比。
hintTraditional: 指很久以前的日子,常和現在對比。
hintEnglish: Refers to days long past, often contrasted with the present.

exampleSimplified: 老师给我们出了很多习题。
exampleTraditional: 老師給我們出了很多習題。
exampleEnglish: The teacher gave us a lot of exercises.
hintSimplified: 课本后面让学生练习的问题。
hintTraditional: 課本後面讓學生練習的問題。
hintEnglish: Questions at the end of a textbook for students to practice.

exampleSimplified: 这次比赛是对新选手的一次洗礼。
exampleTraditional: 這次比賽是對新選手的一次洗禮。
exampleEnglish: This competition was a baptism for the new players.
hintSimplified: 原指宗教仪式,也比喻经历重大考验后得到改变。
hintTraditional: 原指宗教儀式,也比喻經歷重大考驗後得到改變。
hintEnglish: Originally a religious rite; also figuratively a major test that changes a person.

exampleSimplified: 过年时,家家户户都充满喜气。
exampleTraditional: 過年時,家家戶戶都充滿喜氣。
exampleEnglish: At New Year, every household is full of festive cheer.
hintSimplified: 过节或有喜事时,到处洋溢的快乐气氛。
hintTraditional: 過節或有喜事時,到處洋溢的快樂氣氛。
hintEnglish: The joyful atmosphere everywhere during holidays or happy events.

exampleSimplified: 收到录取通知书,她心里充满喜悦。
exampleTraditional: 收到錄取通知書,她心裡充滿喜悅。
exampleEnglish: On receiving the admission letter, her heart was filled with joy.
hintSimplified: 心里非常高兴、愉快的感觉。
hintTraditional: 心裡非常高興、愉快的感覺。
hintEnglish: A feeling of great happiness and pleasure inside.

exampleSimplified: 奶奶很爱听戏曲。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶很愛聽戲曲。
exampleEnglish: Grandma loves listening to traditional opera.
hintSimplified: 中国传统的舞台艺术,有唱、有演,还有锣鼓。
hintTraditional: 中國傳統的舞台藝術,有唱、有演,還有鑼鼓。
hintEnglish: A traditional Chinese stage art with singing, acting and gongs and drums.

exampleSimplified: 这块玉很漂亮,但有一点小瑕疵。
exampleTraditional: 這塊玉很漂亮,但有一點小瑕疵。
exampleEnglish: This jade is beautiful, but it has a small flaw.
hintSimplified: 东西上不完美的小缺点或小痕迹。
hintTraditional: 東西上不完美的小缺點或小痕跡。
hintEnglish: A small imperfection or mark on an otherwise good object.

exampleSimplified: 我们开车经过一个很深的峡谷。
exampleTraditional: 我們開車經過一個很深的峽谷。
exampleEnglish: We drove through a very deep canyon.
hintSimplified: 两边是高高的山壁,中间又深又窄的地形。
hintTraditional: 兩邊是高高的山壁,中間又深又窄的地形。
hintEnglish: A deep, narrow landform with high walls on both sides.

exampleSimplified: 这间房间很狭小,放不下大桌子。
exampleTraditional: 這間房間很狹小,放不下大桌子。
exampleEnglish: This room is very cramped and can't fit a big table.
hintSimplified: 形容空间很小,让人觉得不够用。
hintTraditional: 形容空間很小,讓人覺得不夠用。
hintEnglish: Describes a space that is so small it feels insufficient.

exampleSimplified: 这条巷子非常狭窄,汽车开不进去。
exampleTraditional: 這條巷子非常狹窄,汽車開不進去。
exampleEnglish: This alley is very narrow; cars can't get in.
hintSimplified: 形容路或空间的宽度很小,人和车不容易通过。
hintTraditional: 形容路或空間的寬度很小,人和車不容易透過。
hintEnglish: Describes a road or space with little width, hard for people or cars to pass.

exampleSimplified: 他想了很久,还是不知道该怎么下笔。
exampleTraditional: 他想了很久,還是不知道該怎麼下筆。
exampleEnglish: He thought for a long time but still didn't know how to start writing.
hintSimplified: 写文章或画画时,开始把笔放到纸上的动作。
hintTraditional: 寫文章或畫畫時,開始把筆放到紙上的動作。
hintEnglish: The act of starting to write or draw by setting the pen on paper.

exampleSimplified: 最近股票价格大幅下跌,很多人很担心。
exampleTraditional: 最近股票價格大幅下跌,很多人很擔心。
exampleEnglish: Stock prices have fallen sharply recently, and many people are worried.
hintSimplified: 价格或数字突然变低,和上涨相反。
hintTraditional: 價格或數字突然變低,和上漲相反。
hintEnglish: When prices or numbers suddenly become lower; the opposite of rising.

definition: (fig.) to decline; to slide down (a slope etc)
exampleSimplified: 今年公司的业绩明显下滑。
exampleTraditional: 今年公司的業績明顯下滑。
exampleEnglish: The company's performance has clearly declined this year.
hintSimplified: 成绩、数量或水平慢慢变差、变低。
hintTraditional: 成績、數量或水平慢慢變差、變低。
hintEnglish: When results, quantity or level gradually get worse or lower.

exampleSimplified: 请回答下列问题,并写在答案纸上。
exampleTraditional: 請回答下列問題,並寫在答案紙上。
exampleEnglish: Please answer the following questions and write them on the answer sheet.
hintSimplified: 用来指后面要列出来的项目。
hintTraditional: 用來指後面要列出來的專案。
hintEnglish: Used to refer to the items that are listed right after.

definition: downstream; fig. to fall into bad ways; offal; to go into the water; to go to pot; to launch (a ship); to lead astray; to put into water; tripe; viscera
exampleSimplified: 夏天很多人喜欢到海边下水玩。
exampleTraditional: 夏天很多人喜歡到海邊下水玩。
exampleEnglish: In summer many people like to go into the water at the beach.
hintSimplified: 为了游泳或玩水,走进河里或海里。
hintTraditional: 為了游泳或玩水,走進河裡或海里。
hintEnglish: Going into a river or the sea in order to swim or play.

exampleSimplified: 我们下旬要交报告,时间不多了。
exampleTraditional: 我們下旬要交報告,時間不多了。
exampleEnglish: We have to hand in the report in the last ten days of the month; there's not much time.
hintSimplified: 一个月里二十一号以后的那段时间。
hintTraditional: 一個月裡二十一號以後的那段時間。
hintEnglish: The stretch of a month after the twentieth.

exampleSimplified: 故事里说,吃了这颗仙丹就能长生不老。
exampleTraditional: 故事裡說,吃了這顆仙丹就能長生不老。
exampleEnglish: The story says that eating this elixir makes one immortal.
hintSimplified: 神话里神仙做的药,吃了可以不会死。
hintTraditional: 神話裡神仙做的藥,吃了可以不會死。
hintEnglish: In myths, a medicine made by immortals that supposedly lets you live forever.

gloss: early or late; first and last; priority
definition: early or late; first and last; priority; in succession; one after another
exampleSimplified: 他们先后来到台湾工作。
exampleTraditional: 他們先後來到台灣工作。
exampleEnglish: They came to Taiwan to work one after another.
hintSimplified: 表示几件事或几个人一个接一个发生,时间有早有晚。
hintTraditional: 表示幾件事或幾個人一個接一個發生,時間有早有晚。
hintEnglish: Indicates several events or people happening one after another, some earlier and some later.

exampleSimplified: 他是这个领域的先驱,后人都很尊敬他。
exampleTraditional: 他是這個領域的先驅,後人都很尊敬他。
exampleEnglish: He was a pioneer in this field, and later generations respect him greatly.
hintSimplified: 指最早开始做一件新事的人,为后人开路。
hintTraditional: 指最早開始做一件新事的人,為後人開路。
hintEnglish: A person who first began something new and paved the way for others.

gloss: embryonic period (contrasted with 後天|后天[hou4 tian1])
definition: embryonic period (contrasted with 後天|后天[hou4 tian1]); inborn; innate; natural
exampleSimplified: 这个孩子先天听力不好,需要特别照顾。
exampleTraditional: 這個孩子先天聽力不好,需要特別照顧。
exampleEnglish: This child has had poor hearing since birth and needs special care.
hintSimplified: 指出生时就有的,不是长大以后才形成的。
hintTraditional: 指出生時就有的,不是長大以後才形成的。
hintEnglish: Refers to what exists from birth, not developed later in life.

definition: (of colors) bright; fresh and clear; clear-cut; distinct
exampleSimplified: 这幅画的颜色对比很鲜明。
exampleTraditional: 這幅畫的顏色對比很鮮明。
exampleEnglish: The color contrast in this painting is very vivid.
hintSimplified: 形容颜色或特点很清楚、很突出,一看就懂。
hintTraditional: 形容顏色或特點很清楚、很突出,一看就懂。
hintEnglish: Describes colors or features that are clear and striking at a glance.

exclusionReason: Traditional form is not listed among dictionary recognized forms

definition: bright-colored; gaily-colored; variant of 鮮豔|鲜艳[xian1 yan4]
exampleSimplified: 她穿了一件颜色鲜艳的红裙子。
exampleTraditional: 她穿了一件顏色鮮豔的紅裙子。
exampleEnglish: She wore a brightly colored red dress.
hintSimplified: 形容花或衣服的颜色明亮漂亮,很吸引人。
hintTraditional: 形容花或衣服的顏色明亮漂亮,很吸引人。
hintEnglish: Describes flowers or clothes whose colors are bright and eye-catching.

exampleSimplified: 这种衣服的纤维很柔软,穿起来很舒服。
exampleTraditional: 這種衣服的纖維很柔軟,穿起來很舒服。
exampleEnglish: The fibers of this clothing are very soft and comfortable to wear.
hintSimplified: 组成布料、植物或肌肉的细细的丝状东西。
hintTraditional: 組成布料、植物或肌肉的細細的絲狀東西。
hintEnglish: The thin thread-like material that makes up cloth, plants or muscle.

exampleSimplified: 警察怀疑他,因为他有重大嫌疑。
exampleTraditional: 警察懷疑他,因為他有重大嫌疑。
exampleEnglish: The police suspect him because he is a prime suspect.
hintSimplified: 别人怀疑某人可能做了坏事,但还没有证明。
hintTraditional: 別人懷疑某人可能做了壞事,但還沒有證明。
hintEnglish: When others think someone may have done something wrong, not yet proven.

exampleSimplified: 太阳出来后,山上的美景慢慢显现出来。
exampleTraditional: 太陽出來後,山上的美景慢慢顯現出來。
exampleEnglish: After the sun came out, the beautiful mountain scenery gradually appeared.
hintSimplified: 原来看不见的东西,慢慢出现在眼前。
hintTraditional: 原來看不見的東西,慢慢出現在眼前。
hintEnglish: Something previously unseen gradually comes into view.

exampleSimplified: 人的忍耐是有限度的,请不要再吵了。
exampleTraditional: 人的忍耐是有限度的,請不要再吵了。
exampleEnglish: People's patience has a limit; please stop making noise.
hintSimplified: 事情能达到的最大范围或程度,不能再超过。
hintTraditional: 事情能達到的最大範圍或程度,不能再超過。
hintEnglish: The maximum extent something can reach, beyond which it can't go.

exampleSimplified: 宪法保障每个人的基本权利。
exampleTraditional: 憲法保障每個人的基本權利。
exampleEnglish: The constitution protects everyone's basic rights.
hintSimplified: 一个国家最重要、最基本的法律。
hintTraditional: 一個國家最重要、最基本的法律。
hintEnglish: The most important and fundamental law of a country.

definition: (electricity) line; circuit; wire; (traffic) road; track; route
exampleSimplified: 这条公交车的线路经过火车站和夜市。
exampleTraditional: 這條公交車的線路經過火車站和夜市。
exampleEnglish: This bus route passes by the train station and the night market.
hintSimplified: 公交车或电力、网络所走的固定路径。
hintTraditional: 公交車或電力、網路所走的固定路徑。
hintEnglish: The fixed path followed by a bus, or by electricity or a network.

definition: to get caught up in; to land in (a predicament); to sink into
exampleSimplified: 公司陷入了严重的困难。
exampleTraditional: 公司陷入了嚴重的困難。
exampleEnglish: The company has fallen into serious difficulties.
hintSimplified: 掉进不好的情况里,很难走出来。
hintTraditional: 掉進不好的情況裡,很難走出來。
hintEnglish: To fall into a bad situation that is hard to get out of.

gloss: (coll.) (of a woman) to give one's virginity to
definition: (coll.) (of a woman) to give one's virginity to; to commit one's energy to; to devote oneself to; to sacrifice one's life for
exampleSimplified: 他为科学研究献身,一辈子都没有结婚。
exampleTraditional: 他為科學研究獻身,一輩子都沒有結婚。
exampleEnglish: He devoted his life to scientific research and never married.
hintSimplified: 把自己的一生或生命全部给某个理想或事业。
hintTraditional: 把自己的一生或生命全部給某個理想或事業。
hintEnglish: To give one's whole life to an ideal or cause.

exampleSimplified: 现今的社会,人人都离不开手机。
exampleTraditional: 現今的社會,人人都離不開手機。
exampleEnglish: In today's society, everyone can't live without a phone.
hintSimplified: 指现在这个时代,常用在书面语里。
hintTraditional: 指現在這個時代,常用在書面語裡。
hintEnglish: Refers to the present era, often used in written language.

definition: current; in force; to be in effect
exampleSimplified: 按照现行的规定,这件事不能这样办。
exampleTraditional: 按照現行的規定,這件事不能這樣辦。
exampleEnglish: Under the current regulations, this can't be handled this way.
hintSimplified: 形容规定或制度现在正在使用、还有效。
hintTraditional: 形容規定或制度現在正在使用、還有效。
hintEnglish: Describes rules or systems that are in use and valid right now.

exampleSimplified: 我们要先了解现状,再想办法改善。
exampleTraditional: 我們要先了解現狀,再想辦法改善。
exampleEnglish: We must first understand the current situation, then think of ways to improve it.
hintSimplified: 事情目前的样子或情况。
hintTraditional: 事情目前的樣子或情況。
hintEnglish: The way things are at the moment.

definition: according to legend; to hand down; to pass on; tradition has it that ...
exampleSimplified: 相传这座古庙已经有一千年的历史了。
exampleTraditional: 相傳這座古廟已經有一千年的歷史了。
exampleEnglish: According to legend, this old temple has a history of a thousand years.
hintSimplified: 用来说一件事是人们一代一代讲下来的，不一定有证据。
hintTraditional: 用來說一件事是人們一代一代講下來的，不一定有證據。
hintEnglish: Used to say something has been passed down by people through generations, not necessarily with proof.

exampleSimplified: 我和哥哥的年纪相仿，所以常常一起玩。
exampleTraditional: 我和哥哥的年紀相仿，所以常常一起玩。
exampleEnglish: My brother and I are about the same age, so we often play together.
hintSimplified: 形容两个人或两样东西差不多，没有太大的不同。
hintTraditional: 形容兩個人或兩樣東西差不多，沒有太大的不同。
hintEnglish: Describes two people or things that are almost the same, without big differences.

exampleSimplified: 他说的话和事实不相符。
exampleTraditional: 他說的話和事實不相符。
exampleEnglish: What he said does not match the facts.
hintSimplified: 两件事的内容一致，没有矛盾。
hintTraditional: 兩件事的內容一致，沒有矛盾。
hintEnglish: The content of two things is consistent, with no contradiction.

exampleSimplified: 这几家商店相继关门了。
exampleTraditional: 這幾家商店相繼關門了。
exampleEnglish: These shops closed down one after another.
hintSimplified: 形容几件事一个接着一个很快发生。
hintTraditional: 形容幾件事一個接著一個很快發生。
hintEnglish: Describes several things happening one right after another in quick succession.

gloss: to match; to fit; to pair well
definition: to match; to fit; to pair well
exampleSimplified: 这条围巾和你的外套很相配。
exampleTraditional: 這條圍巾和你的外套很相配。
exampleEnglish: This scarf goes very well with your coat.
hintSimplified: 两样东西或两个人放在一起看起来很合适。
hintTraditional: 兩樣東西或兩個人放在一起看起來很合適。
hintEnglish: Two things or people look suitable and harmonious together.

definition: local (to an area); native soil; one's hometown; one's native land
exampleSimplified: 这位作家喜欢写充满乡土气息的故事。
exampleTraditional: 這位作家喜歡寫充滿鄉土氣息的故事。
exampleEnglish: This writer likes to write stories full of local, countryside flavor.
hintSimplified: 指家乡那块地方特有的风俗、文化或气息。
hintTraditional: 指家鄉那塊地方特有的風俗、文化或氣息。
hintEnglish: Refers to the customs, culture or atmosphere peculiar to one's home region.

definition: CL:塊|块[kuai4]; perfumed soap; toilet soap
exampleSimplified: 洗手的时候，我喜欢用有花香的香皂。
exampleTraditional: 洗手的時候，我喜歡用有花香的香皂。
exampleEnglish: When washing my hands, I like to use flower-scented soap.
hintSimplified: 一块一块的，有香味，洗手洗澡时会用。
hintTraditional: 一塊一塊的，有香味，洗手洗澡時會用。
hintEnglish: A solid bar with a pleasant smell, used when washing hands or bathing.

gloss: to accept the situation and move on
definition: to accept the situation and move on; to avoid dwelling on unpleasant things; to get over (a shock, bereavement etc)
exampleSimplified: 事情已经发生了，你要想开一点。
exampleTraditional: 事情已經發生了，你要想開一點。
exampleEnglish: It has already happened, so try to let it go.
hintSimplified: 遇到不顺利的事，不再难过，放宽心。
hintTraditional: 遇到不順利的事，不再難過，放寬心。
hintEnglish: After something goes badly, to stop being upset and relax your mind.

exampleSimplified: 她的声音很响亮，教室后面也听得见。
exampleTraditional: 她的聲音很響亮，教室後面也聽得見。
exampleEnglish: Her voice is loud and clear; it can be heard even at the back of the classroom.
hintSimplified: 形容声音大而且清楚，远处也听得到。
hintTraditional: 形容聲音大而且清楚，遠處也聽得到。
hintEnglish: Describes a sound that is big and clear, audible even from far away.

exampleSimplified: 我们请了一位向导带我们爬山。
exampleTraditional: 我們請了一位嚮導帶我們爬山。
exampleEnglish: We hired a guide to take us hiking in the mountains.
hintSimplified: 在陌生的地方带路、介绍风景的人。
hintTraditional: 在陌生的地方帶路、介紹風景的人。
hintEnglish: A person who leads the way and introduces the scenery in an unfamiliar place.

definition: to look forward to; to yearn for
exampleSimplified: 他从小就向往在大海边生活。
exampleTraditional: 他從小就嚮往在大海邊生活。
exampleEnglish: Since childhood he has yearned to live by the sea.
hintSimplified: 心里很喜欢某种生活或地方，希望有一天能得到。
hintTraditional: 心裡很喜歡某種生活或地方，希望有一天能得到。
hintEnglish: To love a kind of life or place in your heart and hope to have it someday.

definition: symbol; emblem; to symbolize; to signify; to represent
exampleSimplified: 鸽子是和平的象征。
exampleTraditional: 鴿子是和平的象徵。
exampleEnglish: The dove is a symbol of peace.
hintSimplified: 用一个具体的东西来代表某种意思或精神。
hintTraditional: 用一個具體的東西來代表某種意思或精神。
hintEnglish: A concrete thing used to represent a certain meaning or spirit.

exampleSimplified: 用餐前，服务生会先把桌子消毒。
exampleTraditional: 用餐前，服務生會先把桌子消毒。
exampleEnglish: Before the meal, the waiter first disinfects the table.
hintSimplified: 用药水或高温杀死细菌，让东西变干净。
hintTraditional: 用藥水或高溫殺死細菌，讓東西變乾淨。
hintEnglish: Use chemicals or high heat to kill germs and make things clean.

exampleSimplified: 消防人员很快就赶到了现场。
exampleTraditional: 消防人員很快就趕到了現場。
exampleEnglish: Firefighting personnel arrived at the scene very quickly.
hintSimplified: 和预防火灾、灭火有关的工作。
hintTraditional: 和預防火災、滅火有關的工作。
hintEnglish: Related to preventing and putting out fires.

definition: (old) news; mail; message; to consume; to use up; to deplete; to expend
exampleSimplified: 跑步会消耗很多体力。
exampleTraditional: 跑步會消耗很多體力。
exampleEnglish: Running uses up a lot of physical energy.
hintSimplified: 东西或力气因为使用而一点一点变少。
hintTraditional: 東西或力氣因為使用而一點一點變少。
hintEnglish: Things or energy gradually decrease because they are being used.

definition: amusement; pastime; recreation; to make sport of; to while the time away
exampleSimplified: 周末他喜欢钓鱼来消遣。
exampleTraditional: 週末他喜歡釣魚來消遣。
exampleEnglish: On weekends he likes to fish as a pastime.
hintSimplified: 做轻松有趣的事，来打发空闲的时间。
hintTraditional: 做輕鬆有趣的事，來打發空閒的時間。
hintEnglish: Doing relaxing, fun things to pass free time.

definition: confident and at ease; free and easy
exampleSimplified: 他走路的样子很潇洒。
exampleTraditional: 他走路的樣子很瀟灑。
exampleEnglish: He has a very dashing, carefree way of walking.
hintSimplified: 形容人的举止自然大方，不拘束，很有风度。
hintTraditional: 形容人的舉止自然大方，不拘束，很有風度。
