hintEnglish: Describes a person whose manner is natural, unrestrained and stylish.

exampleSimplified: 退休后，他过着逍遥自在的生活。
exampleTraditional: 退休後，他過著逍遙自在的生活。
exampleEnglish: After retiring, he lives a carefree and unrestrained life.
hintSimplified: 形容人没有烦恼，也没有人管，过得很自由。
hintTraditional: 形容人沒有煩惱，也沒有人管，過得很自由。
hintEnglish: Describes someone with no worries and no one controlling them, living freely.

definition: to follow the example of; to imitate
exampleSimplified: 我们应该效法他认真工作的精神。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該效法他認真工作的精神。
exampleEnglish: We should follow his example of working conscientiously.
hintSimplified: 把别人好的做法或精神当作榜样来学习。
hintTraditional: 把別人好的做法或精神當作榜樣來學習。
hintEnglish: To take someone's good methods or spirit as a model and learn from it.

definition: to serve (in some capacity); to work for
exampleSimplified: 如果有需要，我很乐意为您效劳。
exampleTraditional: 如果有需要，我很樂意為您效勞。
exampleEnglish: If you need anything, I would be glad to be of service to you.
hintSimplified: 客气地说愿意为别人做事、提供帮助。
hintTraditional: 客氣地說願意為別人做事、提供幫助。
hintEnglish: A polite way to say you are willing to do things and help for someone.

definition: effectiveness; positive effect; to serve (in some capacity)
exampleSimplified: 这种药的效力可以维持八个小时。
exampleTraditional: 這種藥的效力可以維持八個小時。
exampleEnglish: The effect of this medicine can last eight hours.
hintSimplified: 指药物、法律等能发生作用的力量。
hintTraditional: 指藥物、法律等能發生作用的力量。
hintEnglish: The power of medicine, laws, etc. to take effect.

gloss: to vow loyalty and devotion to
definition: to vow loyalty and devotion to
exampleSimplified: 古代的将军发誓要效忠国家。
exampleTraditional: 古代的將軍發誓要效忠國家。
exampleEnglish: Generals in ancient times swore to be loyal to the country.
hintSimplified: 对国家或领导人表示完全忠诚，愿意奉献一切。
hintTraditional: 對國家或領導人表示完全忠誠，願意奉獻一切。
hintEnglish: To show complete loyalty to a country or leader, willing to give everything.

exampleSimplified: 他是个孝子，每天都照顾生病的母亲。
exampleTraditional: 他是個孝子，每天都照顧生病的母親。
exampleEnglish: He is a devoted son who takes care of his sick mother every day.
hintSimplified: 对父母非常尊敬、照顾得很好的儿子。
hintTraditional: 對父母非常尊敬、照顧得很好的兒子。
hintEnglish: A son who deeply respects his parents and takes very good care of them.

definition: to assist; to cooperate in doing sth; to help sb do sth
exampleSimplified: 这次活动由市政府主办，我们公司协办。
exampleTraditional: 這次活動由市政府主辦，我們公司協辦。
exampleEnglish: This event is hosted by the city government and co-organized by our company.
hintSimplified: 不是主要负责的人，而是在旁边帮忙一起办事。
hintTraditional: 不是主要負責的人，而是在旁邊幫忙一起辦事。
hintEnglish: Not the main organizer, but helping alongside to get something done.

definition: accord; agreement; to reach an agreement
exampleSimplified: 两国终于签订了贸易协定。
exampleTraditional: 兩國終於簽訂了貿易協定。
exampleEnglish: The two countries finally signed a trade agreement.
hintSimplified: 双方经过讨论后，写下来共同遵守的约定。
hintTraditional: 雙方經過討論後，寫下來共同遵守的約定。
hintEnglish: A written arrangement both sides agree to follow after discussion.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4],家[jia1]; a society; an association
exampleSimplified: 他加入了一个摄影协会,每个月都参加活动。
exampleTraditional: 他加入了一個攝影協會,每個月都參加活動。
exampleEnglish: He joined a photography association and takes part in its activities every month.
hintSimplified: 有共同兴趣或职业的人组成的团体。
hintTraditional: 有共同興趣或職業的人組成的團體。
hintEnglish: A group formed by people who share an interest or profession.

definition: agreement; to consult with; to talk things over
exampleSimplified: 双方经过协商,终于决定了开会的时间。
exampleTraditional: 雙方經過協商,終於決定了開會的時間。
exampleEnglish: After discussion, both sides finally decided on the meeting time.
hintSimplified: 有问题时,大家坐下来互相讨论,想找出大家都能接受的办法。
hintTraditional: 有問題時,大家坐下來互相討論,想找出大家都能接受的辦法。
hintEnglish: When there is a problem, people sit down and discuss to find a solution everyone accepts.

definition: concerted; harmonious; to coordinate; to fit together; to harmonize; to match (colors etc)
exampleSimplified: 经理负责协调各部门之间的工作。
exampleTraditional: 經理負責協調各部門之間的工作。
exampleEnglish: The manager is responsible for coordinating work between departments.
hintSimplified: 让不同的人或事配合得好,不互相冲突。
hintTraditional: 讓不同的人或事配合得好,不互相沖突。
hintEnglish: To make different people or things work well together without conflict.

exampleSimplified: 两家公司签了一份合作协议。
exampleTraditional: 兩家公司簽了一份合作協議。
exampleEnglish: The two companies signed a cooperation agreement.
hintSimplified: 双方经过谈判后写下来、要遵守的约定。
hintTraditional: 雙方經過談判後寫下來、要遵守的約定。
hintEnglish: A written deal that two sides must follow after negotiating.

exampleSimplified: 这些钱都是父母用血汗换来的。
exampleTraditional: 這些錢都是父母用血汗換來的。
exampleEnglish: This money was earned with my parents' sweat and toil.
hintSimplified: 形容非常辛苦的劳动和付出。
hintTraditional: 形容非常辛苦的勞動和付出。
hintEnglish: Describes extremely hard labor and effort.

exampleSimplified: 地板上有一些血迹,他赶快拿布擦干净。
exampleTraditional: 地板上有一些血跡,他趕快拿布擦乾淨。
exampleEnglish: There were some bloodstains on the floor, so he quickly wiped them clean with a cloth.
hintSimplified: 受伤后,红色液体留在衣服或地上的痕迹。
hintTraditional: 受傷後,紅色液體留在衣服或地上的痕跡。
hintEnglish: The mark left on clothes or the floor by red liquid after an injury.

exampleSimplified: 医生说他年纪大了,要常常量血压。
exampleTraditional: 醫生說他年紀大了,要常常量血壓。
exampleEnglish: The doctor said that since he is older, he should measure his blood pressure often.
hintSimplified: 医生用仪器量,高了或低了都对身体不好。
hintTraditional: 醫生用儀器量,高了或低了都對身體不好。
hintEnglish: Doctors measure it with a device; too high or too low is bad for health.

definition: realism; realistic; realistic portrayal; true to life
exampleSimplified: 这位画家的风格很写实,画得像照片一样。
exampleTraditional: 這位畫家的風格很寫實,畫得像照片一樣。
exampleEnglish: This painter's style is very realistic; his paintings look like photographs.
hintSimplified: 艺术作品照着真实的样子来表现,不夸张也不抽象。
hintTraditional: 藝術作品照著真實的樣子來表現,不誇張也不抽象。
hintEnglish: An art style that depicts things as they truly are, neither exaggerated nor abstract.

definition: (disparaging) pathetic; (of a tire) to be flat; to be discouraged; to despair; to leak (gas); to vent one's anger
exampleSimplified: 考试没考好,你不要泄气,下次再努力。
exampleTraditional: 考試沒考好,你不要洩氣,下次再努力。
exampleEnglish: Don't lose heart because you did badly on the exam; try harder next time.
hintSimplified: 失败以后,觉得没有信心,不想再努力了。
hintTraditional: 失敗以後,覺得沒有信心,不想再努力了。
hintEnglish: After failing, feeling without confidence and not wanting to try anymore.

exampleSimplified: 这是她最心爱的玩偶,从小就一直带在身边。
exampleTraditional: 這是她最心愛的玩偶,從小就一直帶在身邊。
exampleEnglish: This is her most beloved doll, which she has kept by her side since childhood.
hintSimplified: 形容人或东西在心里非常珍贵、特别喜欢。
hintTraditional: 形容人或東西在心裡非常珍貴、特別喜歡。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or thing that is very precious and dearly loved.

definition: to be kindhearted; to be softhearted; to be tenderhearted
exampleSimplified: 她很心软,看到流浪狗就忍不住想帮忙。
exampleTraditional: 她很心軟,看到流浪狗就忍不住想幫忙。
exampleEnglish: She is soft-hearted and can't help wanting to help when she sees a stray dog.
hintSimplified: 形容人容易同情别人,很难狠下心拒绝。
hintTraditional: 形容人容易同情別人,很難狠下心拒絕。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who easily feels sympathy and finds it hard to refuse.

definition: CL:宗[zong1],樁|桩[zhuang1]; a load on one's mind; worry
exampleSimplified: 他最近好像有心事,吃饭时都不说话。
exampleTraditional: 他最近好像有心事,吃飯時都不說話。
exampleEnglish: He seems to have something on his mind lately; he doesn't speak during meals.
hintSimplified: 藏在心里、让人烦恼却没有说出来的事。
hintTraditional: 藏在心裡、讓人煩惱卻沒有說出來的事。
hintEnglish: Something troubling kept inside the heart and not spoken about.

exampleSimplified: 他整天没有心思工作,一直想着旅行的事。
exampleTraditional: 他整天沒有心思工作,一直想著旅行的事。
exampleEnglish: He has no mind for work all day and keeps thinking about the trip.
hintSimplified: 指想法或精神集中的地方,也可以说是想做某事的兴致。
hintTraditional: 指想法或精神集中的地方,也可以說是想做某事的興致。
hintEnglish: Refers to where one's thoughts or attention are, or the desire to do something.

exampleSimplified: 看到妈妈一个人辛苦工作,我觉得很心酸。
exampleTraditional: 看到媽媽一個人辛苦工作,我覺得很心酸。
exampleEnglish: Seeing my mother work hard all alone, I felt a pang of sadness.
hintSimplified: 看到别人受苦或自己难过时,心里又痛又悲伤的感觉。
hintTraditional: 看到別人受苦或自己難過時,心裡又痛又悲傷的感覺。
hintEnglish: The painful, sad feeling inside when seeing someone suffer or when one is hurt.

definition: attitude (of the heart); mentality; state of one's psyche; way of thinking
exampleSimplified: 面对失败,保持好的心态比什么都重要。
exampleTraditional: 面對失敗,保持好的心態比什麼都重要。
exampleEnglish: When facing failure, keeping a good mindset is more important than anything.
hintSimplified: 一个人面对事情时,心里的想法和看法。
hintTraditional: 一個人面對事情時,心裡的想法和看法。
hintEnglish: A person's inner outlook and way of seeing things when facing situations.

definition: to be distressed; to feel sorry for sb; to grudge; to love dearly; to regret
exampleSimplified: 看到孩子生病,妈妈非常心疼。
exampleTraditional: 看到孩子生病,媽媽非常心疼。
exampleEnglish: Seeing her child sick, the mother felt great heartache.
hintSimplified: 对亲近的人感到不舍和难过;花了很多钱时也会有这种感觉。
hintTraditional: 對親近的人感到不捨和難過;花了很多錢時也會有這種感覺。
hintEnglish: Feeling tender pain for someone dear; also felt when spending a lot of money.

exampleSimplified: 他心胸很宽广,从不跟别人计较小事。
exampleTraditional: 他心胸很寬廣,從不跟別人計較小事。
exampleEnglish: He is very broad-minded and never quarrels with others over small matters.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人能容纳别人的程度,大度或小气。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人能容納別人的程度,大度或小氣。
hintEnglish: Describes how much a person can tolerate others, generous or petty.

exampleSimplified: 老师们辛勤地教导每一个学生。
exampleTraditional: 老師們辛勤地教導每一個學生。
exampleEnglish: The teachers diligently teach every student.
hintSimplified: 形容人工作认真又不怕累,付出很多力气。
hintTraditional: 形容人工作認真又不怕累,付出很多力氣。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who works earnestly, not afraid of tiredness, and gives a lot of effort.

exampleSimplified: 她讲起创业时的辛酸,眼泪忍不住流了下来。
exampleTraditional: 她講起創業時的辛酸,眼淚忍不住流了下來。
exampleEnglish: As she spoke of the hardships of starting her business, she couldn't hold back her tears.
hintSimplified: 生活中遇到的痛苦和艰难,让人难过。
hintTraditional: 生活中遇到的痛苦和艱難,讓人難過。
hintEnglish: The pain and difficulties met in life that make one sad.

exampleSimplified: 她的打扮很新潮,走在街上很引人注意。
exampleTraditional: 她的打扮很新潮,走在街上很引人注意。
exampleEnglish: Her outfit is very trendy and draws attention on the street.
hintSimplified: 形容衣服或想法符合最新的流行,很时髦。
hintTraditional: 形容衣服或想法符合最新的流行,很時髦。
hintEnglish: Describes clothes or ideas that follow the latest trends.

exampleSimplified: 我是新手,请大家多多指教。
exampleTraditional: 我是新手,請大家多多指教。
exampleEnglish: I'm a beginner, so please give me plenty of guidance.
hintSimplified: 刚开始学习或做某件事、还没有经验的人。
hintTraditional: 剛開始學習或做某件事、還沒有經驗的人。
hintEnglish: A person who has just started something and has no experience yet.

definition: fig. new and original; lit. new bud
exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅的设计很新颖,客人都觉得有意思。
exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳的設計很新穎,客人都覺得有意思。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant's design is very novel, and customers find it interesting.
hintSimplified: 形容想法或样子和以前的不一样,有创意。
hintTraditional: 形容想法或樣子和以前的不一樣,有創意。
hintEnglish: Describes ideas or looks that differ from before and are creative.

definition: to have confidence in; to have faith in; to rely on; to trust
exampleSimplified: 孩子们都很信赖这位老师。
exampleTraditional: 孩子們都很信賴這位老師。
exampleEnglish: The children all trust and rely on this teacher.
hintSimplified: 觉得某人很可靠,放心地依靠他。
hintTraditional: 覺得某人很可靠,放心地依靠他。
hintEnglish: Feeling someone is dependable and relying on them with peace of mind.

exampleSimplified: 有了坚定的信念,他才没有放弃梦想。
exampleTraditional: 有了堅定的信念,他才沒有放棄夢想。
exampleEnglish: With firm conviction, he did not give up his dream.
hintSimplified: 心里坚决相信的想法,让人不轻易改变。
hintTraditional: 心裡堅決相信的想法,讓人不輕易改變。
hintEnglish: An idea one firmly believes in that keeps one from changing easily.

exampleSimplified: 每到节日,许多信徒都会去庙里拜拜。
exampleTraditional: 每到節日,許多信徒都會去廟裡拜拜。
exampleEnglish: On every festival, many believers go to the temple to worship.
hintSimplified: 相信并跟随某种宗教的人。
hintTraditional: 相信並跟隨某種宗教的人。
hintEnglish: A person who believes in and follows a certain religion.

exampleSimplified: 请把这个信息转告给大家。
exampleTraditional: 請把這個信息轉告給大家。
exampleEnglish: Please pass this information on to everyone.
hintSimplified: 人们通过手机或网络传递的内容、消息或资料。
hintTraditional: 人們透過手機或網路傳遞的內容、訊息或資料。
hintEnglish: Content, news or data that people pass along through phones or the internet.

exampleSimplified: 夜晚的天空里挂满了闪亮的星辰。
exampleTraditional: 夜晚的天空裡掛滿了閃亮的星辰。
exampleEnglish: The night sky is full of shining stars.
hintSimplified: 晚上抬头可以看到的许多发光天体，常用在文学里。
hintTraditional: 晚上抬頭可以看到的許多發光天體，常用在文學裡。
hintEnglish: The many glowing bodies you see when looking up at night, often used in literary writing.

exampleSimplified: 你知道自己是什么星座吗？
exampleTraditional: 你知道自己是什麼星座嗎？
exampleEnglish: Do you know what your zodiac sign is?
hintSimplified: 根据出生的日期分成十二种，人们常用它来谈性格和运势。
hintTraditional: 根據出生的日期分成十二種，人們常用它來談性格和運勢。
hintEnglish: Twelve types based on your birth date, often used to talk about personality and fortune.

exampleSimplified: 政府打算在这里兴建一座新的图书馆。
exampleTraditional: 政府打算在這裡興建一座新的圖書館。
exampleEnglish: The government plans to build a new library here.
hintSimplified: 指规模较大的建筑或设施开始盖起来。
hintTraditional: 指規模較大的建築或設施開始蓋起來。
hintEnglish: Said when a fairly large building or facility starts to be constructed.

definition: flourishing; prosperous; see 興隆縣|兴隆县[Xing1 long2 Xian4]; thriving
exampleSimplified: 这家老店的生意一直很兴隆。
exampleTraditional: 這家老店的生意一直很興隆。
exampleEnglish: This old shop's business has always been thriving.
hintSimplified: 形容生意或事业非常好，客人很多、赚很多钱。
hintTraditional: 形容生意或事業非常好，客人很多、賺很多錢。
hintEnglish: Describes business or an enterprise that is doing very well, with many customers.

definition: to be aroused; to burgeon; to come into vogue; to rise; to spring up
exampleSimplified: 近年来，网络购物在各地兴起。
exampleTraditional: 近年來，網路購物在各地興起。
exampleEnglish: In recent years, online shopping has risen up everywhere.
hintSimplified: 指新的风气、潮流或事物开始出现并渐渐流行。
hintTraditional: 指新的風氣、潮流或事物開始出現並漸漸流行。
hintEnglish: Said when a new trend or phenomenon begins to appear and spread.

definition: to be merciful; to do good works
exampleSimplified: 他一生都在行善，帮助穷苦的人。
exampleTraditional: 他一生都在行善，幫助窮苦的人。
exampleEnglish: All his life he did good deeds, helping the poor.
hintSimplified: 做好事、帮助别人，常和慈善或宗教有关。
hintTraditional: 做好事、幫助別人，常和慈善或宗教有關。
hintEnglish: Doing good deeds and helping others, often linked to charity or religion.

exampleSimplified: 每个公民都应该行使自己的投票权。
exampleTraditional: 每個公民都應該行使自己的投票權。
exampleEnglish: Every citizen should exercise their right to vote.
hintSimplified: 正式地运用权利或权力，让它发生作用。
hintTraditional: 正式地運用權利或權力，讓它發生作用。
hintEnglish: To formally put a right or power into use.

exampleSimplified: 地球是太阳系里的一颗行星。
exampleTraditional: 地球是太陽系裡的一顆行星。
exampleEnglish: Earth is a planet in the solar system.
hintSimplified: 绕着太阳转的大天体，例如地球、火星和木星。
hintTraditional: 繞著太陽轉的大天體，例如地球、火星和木星。
hintEnglish: A large body that orbits the sun, such as Earth, Mars and Jupiter.

exampleSimplified: 他在市政府的行政部门工作。
exampleTraditional: 他在市政府的行政部門工作。
exampleEnglish: He works in the administrative department of the city government.
hintSimplified: 和政府或机关管理事务有关的，常放在名词前面。
hintTraditional: 和政府或機關管理事務有關的，常放在名詞前面。
hintEnglish: Related to the management of affairs in governments or offices; placed before nouns.

exampleSimplified: 这起案件已经交给刑事警察处理。
exampleTraditional: 這起案件已經交給刑事警察處理。
exampleEnglish: This case has been handed over to the criminal police.
hintSimplified: 和犯罪、法律处罚有关的，不是一般的民间纠纷。
hintTraditional: 和犯罪、法律處罰有關的，不是一般的民間糾紛。
hintEnglish: Related to crime and legal punishment, as opposed to ordinary civil disputes.

exampleSimplified: 目前的经济形势对年轻人不太有利。
exampleTraditional: 目前的經濟形勢對年輕人不太有利。
exampleEnglish: The current economic situation is not very favorable to young people.
hintSimplified: 指事情发展的状况和趋势，常用来分析局面。
hintTraditional: 指事情發展的狀況和趨勢，常用來分析局面。
hintEnglish: The state and trend of how things are developing, used to analyze a situation.

exampleSimplified: 水有固体、液体和气体三种形态。
exampleTraditional: 水有固體、液體和氣體三種形態。
exampleEnglish: Water has three forms: solid, liquid and gas.
hintSimplified: 事物表现出来的样子或存在的状态。
hintTraditional: 事物表現出來的樣子或存在的狀態。
hintEnglish: The outward appearance or state in which something exists.

exampleSimplified: 舞者每天练习，保持良好的形体。
exampleTraditional: 舞者每天練習，保持良好的形體。
exampleEnglish: The dancer practices every day to maintain a good physique.
hintSimplified: 指人身体的外形和姿态，常和健美、舞蹈有关。
hintTraditional: 指人身體的外形和姿態，常和健美、舞蹈有關。
hintEnglish: The shape and posture of a person's body, often related to fitness or dance.

exampleSimplified: 这种家庭型态在现代社会越来越常见。
exampleTraditional: 這種家庭型態在現代社會越來越常見。
exampleEnglish: This type of family structure is more and more common in modern society.
hintSimplified: 事物的类型或样式，台湾常用来谈社会或生活方式。
hintTraditional: 事物的型別或樣式，台灣常用來談社會或生活方式。
hintEnglish: The type or pattern of something, commonly used in Taiwan to discuss society or lifestyles.

exampleSimplified: 这台电脑的性能非常好，运行很快。
exampleTraditional: 這臺電腦的性能非常好，執行很快。
exampleEnglish: This computer has excellent performance and runs very fast.
hintSimplified: 机器或产品能做到什么程度、效果好不好。
hintTraditional: 機器或產品能做到什麼程度、效果好不好。
hintEnglish: How well a machine or product works and what it is capable of.

exampleSimplified: 她性情温和，很少跟人吵架。
exampleTraditional: 她性情溫和，很少跟人吵架。
exampleEnglish: She has a gentle temperament and rarely argues with people.
hintSimplified: 一个人天生的脾气和个性。
hintTraditional: 一個人天生的脾氣和個性。
hintEnglish: A person's innate temper and character.

exampleSimplified: 他今天兴致很高，唱了好几首歌。
exampleTraditional: 他今天興致很高，唱了好幾首歌。
exampleEnglish: He was in high spirits today and sang several songs.
hintSimplified: 对做某件事感到愉快、想去做的心情。
hintTraditional: 對做某件事感到愉快、想去做的心情。
hintEnglish: The cheerful mood of wanting to do something.

exampleSimplified: 跑完步以后，我觉得胸口有点闷。
exampleTraditional: 跑完步以後，我覺得胸口有點悶。
exampleEnglish: After running, I felt a bit of tightness in my chest.
hintSimplified: 身体前面、脖子下面、心脏附近的位置。
hintTraditional: 身體前面、脖子下面、心臟附近的位置。
hintEnglish: The front part of the body below the neck, near the heart.

exampleSimplified: 师傅正在修补我那双破了的鞋子。
exampleTraditional: 師傅正在修補我那雙破了的鞋子。
exampleEnglish: The craftsman is mending my torn shoes.
hintSimplified: 把破了或坏了的地方弄好。
hintTraditional: 把破了或壞了的地方弄好。
hintEnglish: To fix a place that is torn or damaged.

exampleSimplified: 这本教科书明年会重新修订。
exampleTraditional: 這本教科書明年會重新修訂。
exampleEnglish: This textbook will be revised next year.
hintSimplified: 把书、法规或计划里的内容检查并改正、更新。
hintTraditional: 把書、法規或計劃裡的內容檢查並改正、更新。
hintEnglish: To check and update the content of a book, regulation or plan.

exampleSimplified: 他们打算在河上修建一座新桥。
exampleTraditional: 他們打算在河上修建一座新橋。
exampleEnglish: They plan to build a new bridge over the river.
hintSimplified: 建造道路、桥梁或房屋等工程。
hintTraditional: 建造道路、橋樑或房屋等工程。
hintEnglish: To construct works such as roads, bridges or houses.

gloss: nun or sister (of the Roman Catholic or Greek Orthodox churches)
definition: nun or sister (of the Roman Catholic or Greek Orthodox churches)
exampleSimplified: 那位修女每天都在教堂里帮助病人。
exampleTraditional: 那位修女每天都在教堂裡幫助病人。
exampleEnglish: That nun helps the sick in the church every day.
hintSimplified: 在天主教会里过着宗教生活的女性。
hintTraditional: 在天主教會里過著宗教生活的女性。
hintEnglish: A woman who lives a religious life in the Catholic church.

exampleSimplified: 老师说话很有礼貌，真是有修养。
exampleTraditional: 老師說話很有禮貌，真是有修養。
exampleEnglish: The teacher speaks very politely and is truly cultivated.
hintSimplified: 一个人通过学习和磨练得到的品德与气质。
hintTraditional: 一個人透過學習和磨練得到的品德與氣質。
hintEnglish: The character and refinement a person gains through study and self-discipline.

exampleSimplified: 工人们正在山上修筑一条新公路。
exampleTraditional: 工人們正在山上修築一條新公路。
exampleEnglish: Workers are building a new highway on the mountain.
hintSimplified: 建造铁路、公路、堤防等较大的工程。
hintTraditional: 建造鐵路、公路、堤防等較大的工程。
hintEnglish: To build large works such as railways, roads or embankments.

definition: (computing) to emulate; (computing) virtual; fictitious; theoretical; hypothetical; to imagine; to make up
exampleSimplified: 这个游戏让玩家进入一个虚拟的世界。
exampleTraditional: 這個遊戲讓玩家進入一個虛擬的世界。
exampleEnglish: This game lets players enter a virtual world.
hintSimplified: 不是真实存在的，而是用电脑做出来的。
hintTraditional: 不是真實存在的，而是用電腦做出來的。
hintEnglish: Not really existing, but created by a computer.

exampleSimplified: 他很虚心，总是认真听别人的意见。
exampleTraditional: 他很虛心，總是認真聽別人的意見。
exampleEnglish: He is very humble and always listens carefully to others' opinions.
hintSimplified: 形容一个人不骄傲，愿意向别人学习。
hintTraditional: 形容一個人不驕傲，願意向別人學習。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who is not proud and is willing to learn from others.

definition: for a long time; for ages
exampleSimplified: 我们许久没有见面了，你过得好吗？
exampleTraditional: 我們許久沒有見面了，你過得好嗎？
exampleEnglish: We haven't seen each other for a long time. How have you been?
hintSimplified: 表示过了很长的一段时间。
hintTraditional: 表示過了很長的一段時間。
hintEnglish: Indicates that a very long period of time has passed.

exampleSimplified: 没有老师的许可，学生不能离开教室。
exampleTraditional: 沒有老師的許可，學生不能離開教室。
exampleEnglish: Without the teacher's permission, students cannot leave the classroom.
hintSimplified: 别人同意你做某件事，或是官方给你的同意。
hintTraditional: 別人同意你做某件事，或是官方給你的同意。
hintEnglish: Someone agrees to let you do something, or an official approval you are given.

definition: heavy drinking; to drink to excess; to get drunk
exampleSimplified: 酗酒对身体很不好，也会影响家人。
exampleTraditional: 酗酒對身體很不好，也會影響家人。
exampleEnglish: Excessive drinking is very bad for the body and also affects one's family.
hintSimplified: 喝太多酒，而且无法控制自己。
hintTraditional: 喝太多酒，而且無法控制自己。
hintEnglish: Drinking far too much alcohol and being unable to control oneself.

exampleSimplified: 这场音乐会的序幕非常精彩。
exampleTraditional: 這場音樂會的序幕非常精彩。
exampleEnglish: The opening of this concert was wonderful.
hintSimplified: 戏剧或大事件正式开始前的第一部分。
hintTraditional: 戲劇或大事件正式開始前的第一部分。
hintEnglish: The first part before a play or a big event officially begins.

definition: account; narration; narrative; telling; to recount; to relate (a story or information); to tell or talk about
exampleSimplified: 他把昨天发生的事详细地叙述了一遍。
exampleTraditional: 他把昨天發生的事詳細地敘述了一遍。
exampleEnglish: He recounted in detail what happened yesterday.
hintSimplified: 把事情的经过一步一步说出来或写出来。
hintTraditional: 把事情的經過一步一步說出來或寫出來。
hintEnglish: To tell or write out how something happened, step by step.

exampleSimplified: 这家公司宣称他们的新产品最环保。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司宣稱他們的新產品最環保。
exampleEnglish: This company claims its new product is the most eco-friendly.
hintSimplified: 公开地说自己的看法或事情是这样，但不一定有证明。
hintTraditional: 公開地說自己的看法或事情是這樣，但不一定有證明。
hintEnglish: To say publicly that something is so, though not necessarily proven.

exampleSimplified: 老师宣告考试现在开始。
exampleTraditional: 老師宣告考試現在開始。
exampleEnglish: The teacher announced that the exam begins now.
hintSimplified: 正式地对大家说出一件重要的事。
hintTraditional: 正式地對大家說出一件重要的事。
hintEnglish: To formally tell everyone about something important.

exampleSimplified: 政府宣示今年要加强环境保护。
exampleTraditional: 政府宣示今年要加強環境保護。
exampleEnglish: The government declared that it would strengthen environmental protection this year.
hintSimplified: 公开表明自己的立场或决心。
hintTraditional: 公開表明自己的立場或決心。
hintEnglish: To publicly make clear one's position or determination.

definition: to make a vow; to swear an oath (of office)
exampleSimplified: 新总统在大家面前宣誓就职。
exampleTraditional: 新總統在大家面前宣誓就職。
exampleEnglish: The new president took the oath of office in front of everyone.
hintSimplified: 举起手，在众人面前郑重地说出自己的承诺。
hintTraditional: 舉起手，在眾人面前鄭重地說出自己的承諾。
hintEnglish: Raising a hand and solemnly stating a promise in front of people.

exampleSimplified: 这份宣言表达了大家对和平的希望。
exampleTraditional: 這份宣言表達了大家對和平的希望。
exampleEnglish: This declaration expresses everyone's hope for peace.
hintSimplified: 团体公开发表的重要文字，说明立场或目标。
hintTraditional: 團體公開發表的重要文字，說明立場或目標。
hintEnglish: An important text publicly issued by a group, stating its position or goals.

gloss: to publicize; to advertise; to spread far and wide
definition: to publicize; to advertise; to spread far and wide
exampleSimplified: 他们努力宣扬环保的重要性。
exampleTraditional: 他們努力宣揚環保的重要性。
exampleEnglish: They work hard to promote the importance of environmental protection.
hintSimplified: 用各种方法让很多人知道某个想法或好处。
hintTraditional: 用各種方法讓很多人知道某個想法或好處。
hintEnglish: Using various methods to let many people know about an idea or benefit.

exampleSimplified: 这首歌的旋律很好听，我一听就记住了。
exampleTraditional: 這首歌的旋律很好聽，我一聽就記住了。
exampleEnglish: The melody of this song is lovely; I remembered it as soon as I heard it.
hintSimplified: 一首歌里高低起伏、让人哼唱的声音。
hintTraditional: 一首歌裡高低起伏、讓人哼唱的聲音。
hintEnglish: The rising and falling sounds in a song that people hum.

definition: to revolve; to rotate; to spin; to whirl
exampleSimplified: 地球一边旋转，一边绕着太阳走。
exampleTraditional: 地球一邊旋轉，一邊繞著太陽走。
exampleEnglish: The Earth rotates while it travels around the sun.
hintSimplified: 像轮子或陀螺一样，绕着中心一圈一圈地动。
hintTraditional: 像輪子或陀螺一樣，繞著中心一圈一圈地動。
hintEnglish: Moving around a center in circles, like a wheel or a top.

exampleSimplified: 两个队伍的实力悬殊，比赛很快就结束了。
exampleTraditional: 兩個隊伍的實力懸殊，比賽很快就結束了。
exampleEnglish: The two teams were vastly unequal in strength, so the match ended quickly.
hintSimplified: 两边的差别非常大，根本不能相比。
hintTraditional: 兩邊的差別非常大，根本不能相比。
hintEnglish: The difference between two sides is so large that they can't be compared.

exampleSimplified: 我们站在悬崖边，看着下面的大海。
exampleTraditional: 我們站在懸崖邊，看著下面的大海。
exampleEnglish: We stood at the edge of the cliff, looking at the sea below.
hintSimplified: 山边又高又陡的地方，往下看会很危险。
hintTraditional: 山邊又高又陡的地方，往下看會很危險。
hintEnglish: A high, steep place at the edge of a mountain; looking down is dangerous.

exampleSimplified: 学校通过比赛选拔最优秀的学生去参加比赛。
exampleTraditional: 學校透過比賽選拔最優秀的學生去參加比賽。
exampleEnglish: The school selects its best students through a contest to take part in the competition.
hintSimplified: 从很多人当中挑出最好的人才。
hintTraditional: 從很多人當中挑出最好的人才。
hintEnglish: Picking out the best talents from among many people.

definition: to buy; to select and purchase
exampleSimplified: 周末我想去商场选购一些新家具。
exampleTraditional: 週末我想去商場選購一些新傢俱。
exampleEnglish: This weekend I want to go to the mall and pick out some new furniture.
hintSimplified: 在很多商品中比较、挑选，然后买下来。
hintTraditional: 在很多商品中比較、挑選，然後買下來。
hintEnglish: Comparing and choosing among many goods, then buying them.

exampleSimplified: 选民们排队到学校去投票。
exampleTraditional: 選民們排隊到學校去投票。
exampleEnglish: The voters lined up to cast their ballots at the school.
hintSimplified: 有资格在选举中投票的人。
hintTraditional: 有資格在選舉中投票的人。
hintEnglish: People who are eligible to vote in an election.

exampleSimplified: 他把选票放进了投票箱里。
exampleTraditional: 他把選票放進了投票箱裡。
exampleEnglish: He put his ballot into the ballot box.
hintSimplified: 选举时，写上或圈出你选择的那张纸。
hintTraditional: 選舉時，寫上或圈出你選擇的那張紙。
hintEnglish: The paper on which you mark your choice during an election.

gloss: (at a school) to take as an elective
definition: (at a school) to take as an elective; an elective; elective (subject)
exampleSimplified: 这学期我选修了一门摄影课。
exampleTraditional: 這學期我選修了一門攝影課。
exampleEnglish: This semester I took a photography class as an elective.
hintSimplified: 大学里不是必须上，而是自己挑选来学的课。
hintTraditional: 大學裡不是必須上，而是自己挑選來學的課。
hintEnglish: Courses at university that are not required but chosen by yourself.

exampleSimplified: 我还差两个学分才能毕业。
exampleTraditional: 我還差兩個學分才能畢業。
exampleEnglish: I still need two more credits to graduate.
hintSimplified: 大学里上完一门课后得到的计算单位，够了才能毕业。
hintTraditional: 大學裡上完一門課後得到的計算單位，夠了才能畢業。
hintEnglish: The unit earned after finishing a university course; you need enough to graduate.

definition: academic discipline; branch of learning; course; subject
exampleSimplified: 数学是我最喜欢的学科。
exampleTraditional: 數學是我最喜歡的學科。
exampleEnglish: Math is my favorite subject.
hintSimplified: 学校里按内容分开的知识领域，比如数学、历史。
hintTraditional: 學校裡按內容分開的知識領域，比如數學、歷史。
hintEnglish: A field of knowledge divided by content at school, such as math or history.

exampleSimplified: 新的学年从九月开始。
exampleTraditional: 新的學年從九月開始。
exampleEnglish: The new school year begins in September.
hintSimplified: 学校从开学到放暑假之间的一整年。
hintTraditional: 學校從開學到放暑假之間的一整年。
hintEnglish: The full year at school from the start of classes to the summer break.

exampleSimplified: 这位老教授学识渊博，大家都很尊敬他。
exampleTraditional: 這位老教授學識淵博，大家都很尊敬他。
exampleEnglish: This old professor is very learned, and everyone respects him.
hintSimplified: 一个人读了很多书、知识很丰富，就是有这个。
hintTraditional: 一個人讀了很多書、知識很豐富，就是有這個。
hintEnglish: What a person has when they have read a lot and have rich knowledge.

exampleSimplified: 这位科学家提出的学说改变了人们的想法。
exampleTraditional: 這位科學家提出的學說改變了人們的想法。
exampleEnglish: The theory proposed by this scientist changed people's thinking.
hintSimplified: 学者提出的一套系统的看法或理论。
hintTraditional: 學者提出的一套系統的看法或理論。
hintEnglish: A systematic set of views or theory put forward by a scholar.

exampleSimplified: 他十六岁就去师傅的店里当学徒。
exampleTraditional: 他十六歲就去師傅的店裡當學徒。
exampleEnglish: At sixteen he went to work as an apprentice in his master's shop.
hintSimplified: 跟着师傅一边工作一边学技术的年轻人。
hintTraditional: 跟著師傅一邊工作一邊學技術的年輕人。
hintEnglish: A young person who learns a trade by working alongside a master.

gloss: member of an institution of learning
definition: member of an institution of learning; officer cadet; student
exampleSimplified: 这家舞蹈教室有很多新来的学员。
exampleTraditional: 這家舞蹈教室有很多新來的學員。
exampleEnglish: This dance studio has many new students.
hintSimplified: 参加某个训练班或课程的人。
hintTraditional: 參加某個訓練班或課程的人。
hintEnglish: A person who takes part in a training class or course.

exampleSimplified: 各个国家的学制不太一样。
exampleTraditional: 各個國家的學制不太一樣。
exampleEnglish: The school system differs from country to country.
hintSimplified: 规定小学、中学、大学各念几年的整套制度。
hintTraditional: 規定小學、中學、大學各念幾年的整套制度。
hintEnglish: The whole system that sets how many years each level of school lasts.

exampleSimplified: 下大雪以后，孩子们在院子里堆了一个雪人。
exampleTraditional: 下大雪以後，孩子們在院子裡堆了一個雪人。
exampleEnglish: After the heavy snow, the children built a snowman in the yard.
hintSimplified: 冬天小孩用白色的雪堆成的，常有胡萝卜鼻子。
hintTraditional: 冬天小孩用白色的雪堆成的，常有胡蘿蔔鼻子。
hintEnglish: Made by children from white snow in winter, often with a carrot nose.

definition: to cripple; to impair; to weaken
exampleSimplified: 这次受伤削弱了球队的实力。
exampleTraditional: 這次受傷削弱了球隊的實力。
exampleEnglish: This injury weakened the team's strength.
hintSimplified: 让力量或影响变得比以前小。
hintTraditional: 讓力量或影響變得比以前小。
hintEnglish: To make strength or influence smaller than before.

exampleSimplified: 警察每天晚上都在社区里巡逻。
exampleTraditional: 警察每天晚上都在社群裡巡邏。
exampleEnglish: The police patrol the neighborhood every night.
hintSimplified: 警察或警卫在一个地区来回走动，注意有没有问题。
hintTraditional: 警察或警衛在一個地區來回走動，注意有沒有問題。
hintEnglish: Police or guards walking back and forth in an area to watch for trouble.

gloss: to inspect (a site); (of a dignitary) to visit; to go on an inspection tour
definition: to inspect (a site); (of a dignitary) to visit; to go on an inspection tour; to survey (a scene); to scan with one's eyes
exampleSimplified: 校长每个星期都会到各班巡视。
exampleTraditional: 校長每個星期都會到各班巡視。
exampleEnglish: The principal makes rounds of every class each week.
hintSimplified: 负责的人到各个地方走一走、看一看，检查情况。
hintTraditional: 負責的人到各個地方走一走、看一看，檢查情況。
hintEnglish: A person in charge goes around different places to check how things are.

exampleSimplified: 他向服务员询问附近有没有药局。
exampleTraditional: 他向服務員詢問附近有沒有藥局。
exampleEnglish: He asked the waiter whether there was a pharmacy nearby.
hintSimplified: 想知道某件事，所以向别人提出问题。
hintTraditional: 想知道某件事，所以向別人提出問題。
hintEnglish: Wanting to know something, so you put a question to someone.

exampleSimplified: 历史课上老师讲到了鸦片战争。
exampleTraditional: 歷史課上老師講到了鴉片戰爭。
exampleEnglish: In history class the teacher talked about the Opium War.
hintSimplified: 一种由罂粟制成的毒品，历史上曾造成很大的问题。
hintTraditional: 一種由罌粟製成的毒品，歷史上曾造成很大的問題。
hintEnglish: A drug made from poppies that caused great problems in history.

exampleSimplified: 文件太大了，请先压缩再寄出去。
exampleTraditional: 檔案太大了，請先壓縮再寄出去。
exampleEnglish: The file is too big; please compress it before sending.
hintSimplified: 把档案或东西变小，占的空间更少。
hintTraditional: 把檔案或東西變小，佔的空間更少。
hintEnglish: Making a file or object smaller so it takes up less space.

definition: to inhibit; to stifle; to suppress
exampleSimplified: 他努力压制心里的怒气，没有大声说话。
exampleTraditional: 他努力壓制心裡的怒氣，沒有大聲說話。
exampleEnglish: He tried hard to suppress his anger and did not raise his voice.
hintSimplified: 用力量不让某种情绪或声音表现出来。
hintTraditional: 用力量不讓某種情緒或聲音表現出來。
hintEnglish: Using force to keep a feeling or voice from showing.

exampleSimplified: 我的牙齿很痛，明天要去看牙科。
exampleTraditional: 我的牙齒很痛，明天要去看牙科。
exampleEnglish: My tooth hurts a lot; I'm going to the dentist tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 医院里专门治疗牙齿问题的部门。
hintTraditional: 醫院裡專門治療牙齒問題的部門。
hintEnglish: The hospital department that treats problems with teeth.

definition: runner-up; second place (in a sports contest)
exampleSimplified: 他在这次比赛中拿到了亚军。
exampleTraditional: 他在這次比賽中拿到了亞軍。
exampleEnglish: He won second place in this competition.
hintSimplified: 比赛中得到第二名的人或队伍。
hintTraditional: 比賽中得到第二名的人或隊伍。
hintEnglish: The person or team that finishes in second place in a contest.

definition: arguments; expression of opinion; remarks; views
exampleSimplified: 每个人都有自由发表言论的权利。
exampleTraditional: 每個人都有自由發表言論的權利。
exampleEnglish: Everyone has the right to freely express their opinions.
hintSimplified: 人们公开说出来或写出来的意见和看法。
hintTraditional: 人們公開說出來或寫出來的意見和看法。
hintEnglish: Opinions and views that people say or write publicly.

exampleSimplified: 山上有很多大大小小的岩石。
exampleTraditional: 山上有很多大大小小的岩石。
exampleEnglish: There are many rocks big and small on the mountain.
hintSimplified: 山里常见的又硬又重的自然物质。
hintTraditional: 山裡常見的又硬又重的自然物質。
hintEnglish: Hard, heavy natural material commonly found in mountains.

definition: (computing) to lag; to delay; to keep putting sth off; to postpone; to procrastinate
exampleSimplified: 因为下大雨，飞机的起飞时间延迟了。
exampleTraditional: 因為下大雨，飛機的起飛時間延遲了。
exampleEnglish: Because of the heavy rain, the plane's departure was delayed.
hintSimplified: 原定的时间往后推，比计划晚发生。
hintTraditional: 原定的時間往後推，比計劃晚發生。
hintEnglish: The planned time is pushed back so it happens later than planned.

gloss: to extend; to stretch; to expand; to spread
definition: to extend; to stretch; to expand; to spread
exampleSimplified: 这条路一直延伸到海边。
exampleTraditional: 這條路一直延伸到海邊。
exampleEnglish: This road extends all the way to the seaside.
hintSimplified: 路、铁路或线条向远处一直伸长。
hintTraditional: 路、鐵路或線條向遠處一直伸長。
hintEnglish: A road, railway or line stretching on into the distance.

gloss: to postpone (with unfortunate consequences); to take too long (to do sth); to miss (a deadline or window of opportunity)
definition: to postpone (with unfortunate consequences); to take too long (to do sth); to miss (a deadline or window of opportunity)
exampleSimplified: 大雾延误了很多班飞机。
exampleTraditional: 大霧延誤了很多班飛機。
exampleEnglish: The thick fog delayed many flights.
hintSimplified: 因为耽搁，错过了该做事的时间，造成麻烦。
hintTraditional: 因為耽擱，錯過了該做事的時間，造成麻煩。
hintEnglish: Because of a hold-up, the right time is missed and trouble results.

definition: to continue; to go on; to last
exampleSimplified: 这个传统已经延续了几百年。
exampleTraditional: 這個傳統已經延續了幾百年。
exampleEnglish: This tradition has continued for several hundred years.
hintSimplified: 某件事或某种状态没有中断，一直保持下去。
hintTraditional: 某件事或某種狀態沒有中斷，一直保持下去。
hintEnglish: Something goes on without interruption and keeps being maintained.

exampleSimplified: 台湾东部的沿海风景非常漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 台灣東部的沿海風景非常漂亮。
exampleEnglish: The coastal scenery in eastern Taiwan is very beautiful.
hintSimplified: 靠近大海边的地区。
hintTraditional: 靠近大海邊的地區。
hintEnglish: Describes areas close to the edge of the sea.

gloss: along the sides of the road
definition: along the sides of the road; by the wayside
exampleSimplified: 我们沿途拍了很多漂亮的照片。
exampleTraditional: 我們沿途拍了很多漂亮的照片。
exampleEnglish: We took many beautiful photos along the way.
hintSimplified: 从出发到目的地的路上经过的地方。
hintTraditional: 從出發到目的地的路上經過的地方。
hintEnglish: The places passed on the way from departure to destination.

definition: to carry on as before; to follow (an old custom etc)
exampleSimplified: 这个村子至今仍沿袭着古老的习俗。
exampleTraditional: 這個村子至今仍沿襲著古老的習俗。
exampleEnglish: This village still follows its ancient customs to this day.
hintSimplified: 照着以前的做法或习惯继续做，不改变。
hintTraditional: 照著以前的做法或習慣繼續做，不改變。
hintEnglish: To keep doing things the way they were done before, without change.

definition: according to usage; to apply as before; to continue to use (old methods)
exampleSimplified: 公司仍然沿用旧的办法处理这些问题。
exampleTraditional: 公司仍然沿用舊的辦法處理這些問題。
exampleEnglish: The company still uses the old method to handle these problems.
hintSimplified: 继续使用以前的方法、名称或规定。
hintTraditional: 繼續使用以前的方法、名稱或規定。
hintEnglish: To keep using a previous method, name or rule.

exampleSimplified: 这个房间里严禁吸烟,请大家注意。
exampleTraditional: 這個房間裡嚴禁吸菸,請大家注意。
exampleEnglish: Smoking is strictly prohibited in this room; please pay attention.
hintSimplified: 告示牌上常写的词,表示绝对不可以做某件事。
hintTraditional: 告示牌上常寫的詞,表示絕對不可以做某件事。
hintEnglish: A word often on signs, meaning something absolutely must not be done.

exampleSimplified: 老师对迟到的学生很严厉。
exampleTraditional: 老師對遲到的學生很嚴厲。
exampleEnglish: The teacher is very strict with students who are late.
hintSimplified: 形容人的态度很凶、要求很高,不容易原谅别人。
hintTraditional: 形容人的態度很兇、要求很高,不容易原諒別人。
hintEnglish: Describes a person whose attitude is harsh and demanding, not easily forgiving.

gloss: tight; strict; closely controlled; rigorous and thorough
definition: tight; strict; closely controlled; rigorous and thorough
exampleSimplified: 警方对这个地区进行了严密的检查。
exampleTraditional: 警方對這個地區進行了嚴密的檢查。
exampleEnglish: The police carried out a tight inspection of this area.
hintSimplified: 形容计划或管理很周到,没有空隙,不容易出错。

hintEnglish: Describes a plan or control that is thorough, with no gaps, hard to get wrong.

exampleSimplified: 语言会随着时间慢慢演变。
exampleTraditional: 語言會隨著時間慢慢演變。
exampleEnglish: Language slowly evolves over time.
hintSimplified: 事物经过很长时间,一步一步地变成另一种样子。

hintEnglish: Things gradually turn into a different form step by step over a long time.

exampleSimplified: 校长在毕业典礼上发表了一场精彩的演说。

hintSimplified: 站在很多人面前,正式地说出自己的想法。

hintEnglish: Formally telling your ideas while standing in front of many people.

gloss: (military, firefighting etc) (verb and noun) drill; exercise; maneuver
definition: (military, firefighting etc) (verb and noun) drill; exercise; maneuver
exampleSimplified: 学校每年都会举行火灾演习。
exampleTraditional: 學校每年都會舉行火災演習。
exampleEnglish: The school holds a fire drill every year.
hintSimplified: 为了应付紧急情况,事先假装真的发生而进行的练习。
hintTraditional: 為了應付緊急情況,事先假裝真的發生而進行的練習。
hintEnglish: Practice done beforehand, pretending an emergency is real.

gloss: (lit. and fig.) field of vision; scope; horizon
definition: (lit. and fig.) field of vision; scope; horizon
exampleSimplified: 出国旅行让我大开眼界。
exampleTraditional: 出國旅行讓我大開眼界。
exampleEnglish: Traveling abroad really broadened my horizons.
hintSimplified: 指一个人见过、知道的事物范围有多大。
hintTraditional: 指一個人見過、知道的事物範圍有多大。
hintEnglish: Refers to how wide the range is of things a person has seen and knows.

definition: in a moment; soon; to look on as sth happens
exampleSimplified: 眼看就要下雨了,我们快回家吧。
exampleTraditional: 眼看就要下雨了,我們快回家吧。
exampleEnglish: It's about to rain; let's hurry home.
hintSimplified: 表示某件事马上就要发生,时间很短。
hintTraditional: 表示某件事馬上就要發生,時間很短。
hintEnglish: Indicates something is about to happen very soon.

definition: derivation; derivative; to derive; to give rise to

hintTraditional: 從原來的東西里發展、產生出新的東西。
hintEnglish: New things develop and come out of an original thing.

exampleSimplified: 奶奶喜欢在冬天炖一碗燕窝。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶喜歡在冬天燉一碗燕窩。
exampleEnglish: Grandma likes to stew a bowl of bird's nest in winter.
hintSimplified: 一种昂贵的补品,原料是某种小鸟做的巢。
hintTraditional: 一種昂貴的補品,原料是某種小鳥做的巢。
hintEnglish: An expensive tonic food made from the nest of a certain small bird.

exampleSimplified: 春天到了,燕子飞回来了。
exampleTraditional: 春天到了,燕子飛回來了。
exampleEnglish: Spring has come and the swallows have flown back.
hintSimplified: 一种会在屋檐下做窝的小鸟,春天常看到它。
hintTraditional: 一種會在屋簷下做窩的小鳥,春天常看到它。
hintEnglish: A small bird that builds nests under eaves and is often seen in spring.

definition: to ask earnestly; to implore; to plead
exampleSimplified: 孩子央求妈妈带他去动物园。
exampleTraditional: 孩子央求媽媽帶他去動物園。
exampleEnglish: The child begged his mother to take him to the zoo.
hintSimplified: 非常诚恳、一再地请求别人帮忙或答应。
hintTraditional: 非常誠懇、一再地請求別人幫忙或答應。
hintEnglish: To ask someone repeatedly and sincerely for help or agreement.

exampleSimplified: 我从小就很仰慕这位科学家。
exampleTraditional: 我從小就很仰慕這位科學家。
exampleEnglish: I have admired this scientist since I was little.
hintSimplified: 对一个很有成就的人心里非常尊敬和喜爱。
hintTraditional: 對一個很有成就的人心裡非常尊敬和喜愛。
hintEnglish: Feeling great respect and fondness for a highly accomplished person.

exampleSimplified: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。
exampleTraditional: 植物從土壤中吸收養分。
exampleEnglish: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
hintSimplified: 食物或土壤里能让生物长大、保持健康的成分。
hintTraditional: 食物或土壤裡能讓生物長大、保持健康的成分。
hintEnglish: The components in food or soil that help living things grow and stay healthy.

exclusionReason: Simplified form is not recognized by the dictionary

gloss: to enjoy a life in retirement
definition: to enjoy a life in retirement; to provide for the elderly (family members)
exampleSimplified: 他退休后搬到乡下养老。
exampleTraditional: 他退休後搬到鄉下養老。
exampleEnglish: After retiring, he moved to the countryside to spend his old age.
hintSimplified: 年纪大了以后,过着安静、不工作的生活。
hintTraditional: 年紀大了以後,過著安靜、不工作的生活。
hintEnglish: Living a quiet life without work after getting old.

definition: to bring up; to nurture; to rear
exampleSimplified: 父母辛苦地养育了我们三个孩子。
exampleTraditional: 父母辛苦地養育了我們三個孩子。
exampleEnglish: My parents worked hard to raise the three of us children.

hintTraditional: 父母照顧小孩,讓他們慢慢長大成人。
hintEnglish: Parents taking care of children so they grow up to be adults.

gloss: to rock; to shake; to sway
definition: to rock; to shake; to sway
exampleSimplified: 船在海上不停地摇晃,我有点想吐。

exampleEnglish: The boat kept swaying on the sea and I felt a bit sick.
hintSimplified: 东西或身体左右不稳地来回动。
hintTraditional: 東西或身體左右不穩地來回動。
hintEnglish: Things or the body moving unsteadily back and forth.

exampleSimplified: 网络上的谣言传得很快,不要随便相信。
exampleTraditional: 網路上的謠言傳得很快,不要隨便相信。
exampleEnglish: Rumors spread fast online; don't just believe them.
hintSimplified: 没有根据、却被很多人传来传去的消息。
hintTraditional: 沒有根據、卻被很多人傳來傳去的訊息。
hintEnglish: Groundless news passed around among many people.

exampleSimplified: 那个小岛离这里非常遥远。
exampleTraditional: 那個小島離這裡非常遙遠。
exampleEnglish: That small island is very far from here.
hintSimplified: 形容距离或时间离现在很长很长。
hintTraditional: 形容距離或時間離現在很長很長。
hintEnglish: Describes a distance or time that is very, very long.

exampleSimplified: 请把这篇文章的要点写下来。
exampleTraditional: 請把這篇文章的要點寫下來。
exampleEnglish: Please write down the key points of this article.
hintSimplified: 一段话或一篇文章里最重要的内容。
hintTraditional: 一段話或一篇文章裡最重要的內容。
hintEnglish: The most important content in a talk or an article.

exampleSimplified: 警方终于抓到了这名要犯。
exampleTraditional: 警方終於抓到了這名要犯。
exampleEnglish: The police finally caught this major criminal.
hintSimplified: 犯了重大罪行、警方特别重视要抓的人。
hintTraditional: 犯了重大罪行、警方特別重視要抓的人。
hintEnglish: A person who committed a serious crime and whom the police especially want to catch.

exampleSimplified: 这家商店也卖一些常用的药品。
exampleTraditional: 這家商店也賣一些常用的藥品。
exampleEnglish: This store also sells some commonly used medicines.
hintSimplified: 医生开给病人、用来治病的东西的总称。
hintTraditional: 醫生開給病人、用來治病的東西的總稱。
hintEnglish: General term for things used to treat illness, as prescribed by doctors.

gloss: (in more recent usage) performance (of a business, employee etc); results
definition: (in more recent usage) performance (of a business, employee etc); results; achievement; accomplishment
exampleSimplified: 今年公司的业绩比去年好很多。
exampleTraditional: 今年公司的業績比去年好很多。
exampleEnglish: The company's results this year are much better than last year.
hintSimplified: 公司或员工工作后得到的成绩,常用数字来衡量。
hintTraditional: 公司或員工工作後得到的成績,常用數字來衡量。
hintEnglish: The results a company or employee achieves from work, often measured in numbers.

definition: as before; still; to remain the same
exampleSimplified: 多年没见,她依旧那么年轻漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 多年沒見,她依舊那麼年輕漂亮。
exampleEnglish: We haven't met in years, yet she's still as young and pretty as ever.
hintSimplified: 表示经过一段时间后,情况和以前一样没有变。
hintTraditional: 表示經過一段時間後,情況和以前一樣沒有變。
hintEnglish: Indicates that after some time, the situation is unchanged from before.

gloss: to depend on; to be dependent on
definition: to depend on; to be dependent on
exampleSimplified: 你不能一直依赖父母,要学会独立。
exampleTraditional: 你不能一直依賴父母,要學會獨立。
exampleEnglish: You can't depend on your parents forever; you must learn to be independent.
hintSimplified: 需要靠别人或某样东西才能生活或做事。
hintTraditional: 需要靠別人或某樣東西才能生活或做事。
hintEnglish: Needing to rely on others or something in order to live or get things done.

exampleSimplified: 请依照说明书的步骤来安装这台机器。
exampleTraditional: 請依照說明書的步驟來安裝這臺機器。
exampleEnglish: Please install this machine following the steps in the manual.
hintSimplified: 按照规定、说明或标准去做事时会用的词。
hintTraditional: 按照規定、說明或標準去做事時會用的詞。
hintEnglish: Used when you do something following rules, instructions or a standard.

exampleSimplified: 台湾的医疗服务很方便，看病也不太贵。

exampleEnglish: Taiwan's medical services are convenient, and seeing a doctor isn't too expensive.
hintSimplified: 医院和医生为病人检查、治病的服务。
hintTraditional: 醫院和醫生為病人檢查、治病的服務。
hintEnglish: The care that hospitals and doctors provide to examine and cure patients.

exampleSimplified: 这位老医生的医术非常高明，大家都很信任他。
exampleTraditional: 這位老醫生的醫術非常高明，大家都很信任他。
exampleEnglish: This old doctor's medical skill is excellent, and everyone trusts him.
hintSimplified: 医生治病的本领和技术。
hintTraditional: 醫生治病的本領和技術。
hintEnglish: A doctor's skill and ability in treating illness.

definition: medical; medical care and medicines; medicine (drug); pharmaceutical
exampleSimplified: 他在一家医药公司上班，负责研发新产品。
exampleTraditional: 他在一家醫藥公司上班，負責研發新產品。
exampleEnglish: He works at a pharmaceutical company, in charge of developing new products.
hintSimplified: 跟药品和治病有关的领域，常和公司、产业放在一起。
hintTraditional: 跟藥品和治病有關的領域，常和公司、產業放在一起。
hintEnglish: The field related to drugs and curing illness, often paired with company or industry.

exampleSimplified: 周末我们一道去山上走走，好不好？
exampleTraditional: 週末我們一道去山上走走，好不好？
exampleEnglish: This weekend, shall we go hiking in the mountains together?
hintSimplified: 表示和别人在一起做同一件事，比较书面。
hintTraditional: 表示和別人在一起做同一件事，比較書面。
hintEnglish: Means doing the same thing with others; somewhat formal.

definition: at one time; for a time; once; one time
exampleSimplified: 这家老店一度非常热闹，现在却很冷清。
exampleTraditional: 這家老店一度非常熱鬧，現在卻很冷清。
exampleEnglish: This old shop was once very lively, but now it is quiet.
hintSimplified: 说明过去曾经有一段时间出现某种情况，后来变了。
hintTraditional: 說明過去曾經有一段時間出現某種情況，後來變了。
hintEnglish: Says that at some time in the past a situation existed, but later it changed.

exampleSimplified: 过期的东西我们一概不卖。
exampleTraditional: 過期的東西我們一概不賣。
exampleEnglish: We don't sell any expired items, without exception.
hintSimplified: 副词，表示不分情况，全部都一样处理。
hintTraditional: 副詞，表示不分情況，全部都一樣處理。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning everything is treated the same way, with no exceptions.

definition: all along; consistent; constant; from start to finish; persistent

exampleTraditional: 他一貫守時，從來沒有遲到過。
exampleEnglish: He has always been punctual and has never been late.
hintSimplified: 形容态度或做法从以前到现在都没有改变。
hintTraditional: 形容態度或做法從以前到現在都沒有改變。
hintEnglish: Describes an attitude or way of doing things that has never changed from past to present.

definition: same; identical; uniformly; all; without exception
exampleSimplified: 进入图书馆的人一律要先登记。
exampleTraditional: 進入圖書館的人一律要先登記。
exampleEnglish: Everyone entering the library must register first, without exception.
hintSimplified: 副词，表示规定对所有人或事都相同，没有例外。
hintTraditional: 副詞，表示規定對所有人或事都相同，沒有例外。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning a rule applies the same to all people or things, no exceptions.

exampleSimplified: 你不能一味地责怪孩子，也要听听他的想法。
exampleTraditional: 你不能一味地責怪孩子，也要聽聽他的想法。
exampleEnglish: You can't just keep blaming the child; you should also listen to his ideas.
hintSimplified: 表示只顾着做同一件事，不考虑其他情况，常带批评的意思。
hintTraditional: 表示只顧著做同一件事，不考慮其他情況，常帶批評的意思。
hintEnglish: Means focusing only on one thing without considering other aspects, often with criticism.

exampleSimplified: 面试的时候，注意仪表会给人好印象。
exampleTraditional: 面試的時候，注意儀表會給人好印象。
exampleEnglish: At an interview, paying attention to your appearance gives a good impression.
hintSimplified: 一个人的外表、穿着和举止给人的整体样子。
hintTraditional: 一個人的外表、穿著和舉止給人的整體樣子。
hintEnglish: The overall look of a person's exterior, clothing and manner.

definition: CL:筆|笔[bi3]; bequest; heritage; inheritance; legacy

exampleTraditional: 他從祖父那裡繼承了一大筆遺產。
exampleEnglish: He inherited a large inheritance from his grandfather.
hintSimplified: 人去世后留给家人的钱或房子等财产。
hintTraditional: 人去世後留給家人的錢或房子等財產。
hintEnglish: Money, houses or other property left to family after a person dies.

definition: heredity; to inherit (a trait); to pass on (to one's offspring)

exampleTraditional: 他的捲髮是從媽媽那裡遺傳來的。
exampleEnglish: His curly hair was inherited from his mother.
hintSimplified: 父母的特征通过基因传给孩子。
hintTraditional: 父母的特徵透過基因傳給孩子。
hintEnglish: Parents' traits are passed to their children through genes.

definition: regret; to be sorry that; to regret
exampleSimplified: 很遗憾，你要的那本书已经卖完了。
exampleTraditional: 很遺憾，你要的那本書已經賣完了。
exampleEnglish: Unfortunately, the book you wanted has already sold out.
hintSimplified: 事情不如人意时，心里觉得可惜、不太满意的感觉。
hintTraditional: 事情不如人意時，心裡覺得可惜、不太滿意的感覺。
hintEnglish: The feeling of pity when things don't turn out as hoped.

definition: to hand down; to leave behind
exampleSimplified: 战争遗留下来的问题到现在还没有解决。
exampleTraditional: 戰爭遺留下來的問題到現在還沒有解決。
exampleEnglish: The problems left behind by the war have still not been solved.
hintSimplified: 过去的事情结束后，还剩下来的影响或东西。
hintTraditional: 過去的事情結束後，還剩下來的影響或東西。
hintEnglish: What remains or continues as an effect after past events have ended.

exampleSimplified: 他不应该遗弃那只可怜的小狗。
exampleTraditional: 他不應該遺棄那隻可憐的小狗。
exampleEnglish: He shouldn't have abandoned that poor little dog.
hintSimplified: 把应该照顾的人或动物丢下不管。
hintTraditional: 把應該照顧的人或動物丟下不管。
hintEnglish: To leave behind and neglect a person or animal you should care for.

exampleSimplified: 家人在医院见到了老人的遗体，难过地哭了。
exampleTraditional: 家人在醫院見到了老人的遺體，難過地哭了。
exampleEnglish: The family saw the old man's remains at the hospital and cried sadly.
hintSimplified: 人去世后留下的身体，说法比较尊敬。
hintTraditional: 人去世後留下的身體，說法比較尊敬。
hintEnglish: The body left after a person has died, a respectful term.

gloss: to forget; to cease to think about (sb or sth) anymore
definition: to forget; to cease to think about (sb or sth) anymore
exampleSimplified: 这件小事早就被大家遗忘了。
exampleTraditional: 這件小事早就被大家遺忘了。
exampleEnglish: This small matter was long ago forgotten by everyone.
hintSimplified: 时间久了，事情在记忆里慢慢消失。
hintTraditional: 時間久了，事情在記憶裡慢慢消失。
hintEnglish: Over time, something slowly fades from memory.

gloss: the mission in life of a deceased person, left to others to carry on
definition: the mission in life of a deceased person, left to others to carry on
exampleSimplified: 他完成了父亲未完成的遗志，开了这所学校。
exampleTraditional: 他完成了父親未完成的遺志，開了這所學校。
exampleEnglish: He fulfilled his father's unfinished will and opened this school.
hintSimplified: 人去世前没有完成、希望后人继续的心愿。
hintTraditional: 人去世前沒有完成、希望後人繼續的心願。
hintEnglish: The unfulfilled wish of someone who died, hoped to be carried on by others.

exampleSimplified: 这个古代遗址每年吸引很多游客来参观。
exampleTraditional: 這個古代遺址每年吸引很多遊客來參觀。
exampleEnglish: This ancient site attracts many visitors every year.
hintSimplified: 古代建筑或城市留下来的地方，考古学家常去研究。
hintTraditional: 古代建築或城市留下來的地方，考古學家常去研究。
hintEnglish: A place where ancient buildings or towns left remains, often studied by archaeologists.

exampleSimplified: 听完说明后，他对这个计划还有一些疑虑。
exampleTraditional: 聽完說明後，他對這個計劃還有一些疑慮。
exampleEnglish: After hearing the explanation, he still had some doubts about the plan.
hintSimplified: 心里不太放心、怀疑又担心的想法。
hintTraditional: 心裡不太放心、懷疑又擔心的想法。
hintEnglish: Thoughts of being unsure, suspicious and worried.

exampleSimplified: 医生为病人做了肾脏移植手术。
exampleTraditional: 醫生為病人做了腎臟移植手術。
exampleEnglish: The doctor performed a kidney transplant operation on the patient.
hintSimplified: 把器官或植物从一个地方换到另一个地方。
hintTraditional: 把器官或植物從一個地方換到另一個地方。
hintEnglish: Moving an organ or plant from one place to another.

gloss: also written 以至於|以至于[yi3 zhi4 yu2]
definition: also written 以至於|以至于[yi3 zhi4 yu2]; down to; to such an extent as to ...; up to
exampleSimplified: 他工作太认真，以至忘了吃午饭。
exampleTraditional: 他工作太認真，以至忘了吃午飯。
exampleEnglish: He worked so seriously that he forgot to eat lunch.
hintSimplified: 连接词，用在前面的情况很强，引出后面的结果或程度。
hintTraditional: 連線詞，用在前面的情況很強，引出後面的結果或程度。
hintEnglish: A conjunction used after a strong situation to introduce a resulting consequence or degree.
