exampleTraditional: 他沒有注意路況，以致發生了車禍。
exampleEnglish: He didn't pay attention to the road, with the result that an accident happened.
hintSimplified: 连接词，引出前面原因造成的不好结果。
hintTraditional: 連線詞，引出前面原因造成的不好結果。
hintEnglish: A conjunction introducing a bad result caused by the preceding reason.

exampleSimplified: 这家饭店有一流的服务和美味的菜。
exampleTraditional: 這家飯店有一流的服務和美味的菜。
exampleEnglish: This restaurant has first-class service and delicious food.
hintSimplified: 形容品质或水平在同类里是最好的那一等。
hintTraditional: 形容品質或水平在同類裡是最好的那一等。
hintEnglish: Describes quality or level that is in the top tier of its kind.

exampleSimplified: 他的生活一如往常，每天早上都去公园跑步。
exampleTraditional: 他的生活一如往常，每天早上都去公園跑步。
exampleEnglish: His life is just as usual; he goes jogging in the park every morning.
hintSimplified: 书面语，表示和以前或某种情况完全相同，常和“往常”“既往”搭配。
hintTraditional: 書面語，表示和以前或某種情況完全相同，常和“往常”“既往”搭配。
hintEnglish: Formal written word meaning exactly the same as before or as something else, often paired with words like 'usual'.

exampleSimplified: 她一心想考上好大学，所以每天都认真读书。
exampleTraditional: 她一心想考上好大學，所以每天都認真讀書。
exampleEnglish: She is set on getting into a good university, so she studies hard every day.
hintSimplified: 形容只专注在一件事上，没有别的念头。
hintTraditional: 形容只專注在一件事上，沒有別的念頭。
hintEnglish: Describes focusing on one thing only, with no other thoughts.

exampleSimplified: 水和牛奶都是液体，可以倒进杯子里。
exampleTraditional: 水和牛奶都是液體，可以倒進杯子裡。
exampleEnglish: Water and milk are both liquids and can be poured into a cup.
hintSimplified: 不是固体，也不是气体，可以流动，会随着容器改变形状。
hintTraditional: 不是固體，也不是氣體，可以流動，會隨著容器改變形狀。
hintEnglish: Neither solid nor gas; it flows and takes the shape of its container.

definition: to inhibit; to keep down; to suppress
exampleSimplified: 医生说这种药可以抑制病情继续恶化。
exampleTraditional: 醫生說這種藥可以抑制病情繼續惡化。
exampleEnglish: The doctor said this medicine can keep the illness from getting worse.
hintSimplified: 用力量或方法让某种情绪、反应或发展不要太强烈。
hintTraditional: 用力量或方法讓某種情緒、反應或發展不要太強烈。
hintEnglish: To use force or a method to keep an emotion, reaction or development from growing too strong.

exampleSimplified: 我不明白他这样说的真正意图是什么。
exampleTraditional: 我不明白他這樣說的真正意圖是什麼。
exampleEnglish: I don't understand what his real intention in saying that is.
hintSimplified: 一个人做某件事背后想要达到的目的或打算。
hintTraditional: 一個人做某件事背後想要達到的目的或打算。
hintEnglish: The purpose or plan behind what a person does.

definition: (Tw) to get a sense of; flavor; implication; meaning; overtone; to imply; to mean
exampleSimplified: 听完他的话，我隐约感觉到一丝意味深长的暗示。
exampleTraditional: 聽完他的話，我隱約感覺到一絲意味深長的暗示。
exampleEnglish: After hearing his words, I faintly sensed a meaningful hint.
hintSimplified: 话语或事情里面隐含的味道或含义，让人慢慢体会。
hintTraditional: 話語或事情裡面隱含的味道或含義，讓人慢慢體會。
hintEnglish: The implied flavor or meaning in words or events that one slowly senses.

exampleSimplified: 学好一种外语需要很大的毅力。
exampleTraditional: 學好一種外語需要很大的毅力。
exampleEnglish: Learning a foreign language well takes great perseverance.
hintSimplified: 遇到困难也不放弃、坚持到底的精神力量。
hintTraditional: 遇到困難也不放棄、堅持到底的精神力量。
hintEnglish: The mental strength to keep going and not give up despite difficulties.

exampleSimplified: 他们在晚上抵达台北，翌日就出发去花莲。
exampleTraditional: 他們在晚上抵達台北，翌日就出發去花蓮。
exampleEnglish: They arrived in Taipei in the evening and left for Hualien the next day.
hintSimplified: 书面语，指某一天过后的那一天。
hintTraditional: 書面語，指某一天過後的那一天。
hintEnglish: Formal word for the day after a particular day.

exampleSimplified: 今天的天气异常闷热，大家都不想出门。
exampleTraditional: 今天的天氣異常悶熱，大家都不想出門。
exampleEnglish: The weather today is unusually hot and stuffy, and nobody wants to go out.
hintSimplified: 放在形容词前面，表示程度很高，比平常特别得多；也指不正常。
hintTraditional: 放在形容詞前面，表示程度很高，比平常特別得多；也指不正常。
hintEnglish: Placed before an adjective to show a degree far beyond the usual; also means not normal.

definition: a place far from home; foreign land
exampleSimplified: 他在异乡工作多年，常常想念家人。
exampleTraditional: 他在異鄉工作多年，常常想念家人。
exampleEnglish: He has worked in a faraway land for many years and often misses his family.
hintSimplified: 不是自己出生或长大的地方，离家很远的地方。
hintTraditional: 不是自己出生或長大的地方，離家很遠的地方。
hintEnglish: A place that is not where you were born or raised, far from home.

definition: to agree upon; to reach an agreement
exampleSimplified: 两国代表经过讨论，议定了新的合作办法。
exampleTraditional: 兩國代表經過討論，議定了新的合作辦法。
exampleEnglish: After discussion, the two countries' representatives agreed on a new way of cooperating.
hintSimplified: 大家经过商量之后，共同决定某件事。
hintTraditional: 大家經過商量之後，共同決定某件事。
hintEnglish: To jointly decide on something after discussing it.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; discussion; to comment; to discuss; to talk about
exampleSimplified: 这件事引起了网友们的热烈议论。
exampleTraditional: 這件事引起了網友們的熱烈議論。
exampleEnglish: This matter sparked heated discussion among netizens.
hintSimplified: 人们对某人或某事发表看法，互相谈论。
hintTraditional: 人們對某人或某事發表看法，互相談論。
hintEnglish: People voicing opinions and talking about someone or something.

definition: CL:項|项[xiang4]; issue (under discussion); subject; topic; topic of discussion
exampleSimplified: 今天会议的第一个议题是明年的预算。
exampleTraditional: 今天會議的第一個議題是明年的預算。
exampleEnglish: The first agenda item of today's meeting is next year's budget.
hintSimplified: 会议中需要讨论的题目或问题。
hintTraditional: 會議中需要討論的題目或問題。
hintEnglish: A topic or question to be discussed at a meeting.

exampleSimplified: 这位议员常常到地方听取民众的意见。
exampleTraditional: 這位議員常常到地方聽取民眾的意見。
exampleEnglish: This councilor often goes out to the community to hear people's opinions.
hintSimplified: 由人民选出来，在议会里讨论并决定事情的人。
hintTraditional: 由人民選出來，在議會里討論並決定事情的人。
hintEnglish: A person elected by the public to discuss and decide matters in an assembly.

exampleSimplified: 佛教认为人生的一切都有因果关系。
exampleTraditional: 佛教認為人生的一切都有因果關係。
exampleEnglish: Buddhism holds that everything in life has a cause-and-effect relationship.
hintSimplified: 事情的原因和结果之间的关系。
hintTraditional: 事情的原因和結果之間的關係。
hintEnglish: The relationship between the reason for something and its result.

definition: a conspiracy; a plot; to conspire; to plot
exampleSimplified: 警方发现了一个想骗走老人存款的阴谋。
exampleTraditional: 警方發現了一個想騙走老人存款的陰謀。
exampleEnglish: The police uncovered a plot to swindle elderly people out of their savings.
hintSimplified: 暗中计划要做坏事或害人的计谋。
hintTraditional: 暗中計劃要做壞事或害人的計謀。
hintEnglish: A secret scheme to do something bad or harm others.

exampleSimplified: 那次意外在他心里留下了很深的阴影。
exampleTraditional: 那次意外在他心裡留下了很深的陰影。
exampleEnglish: That accident left a deep shadow in his heart.
hintSimplified: 光被挡住后出现的暗暗的形状；也比喻心里不愉快的感受。
hintTraditional: 光被擋住後出現的暗暗的形狀；也比喻心裡不愉快的感受。
hintEnglish: The dark shape that appears when light is blocked; also figuratively an unpleasant lingering feeling.

exampleSimplified: 这部电影在大银幕上看起来特别震撼。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影在大銀幕上看起來特別震撼。
exampleEnglish: This film looks especially impressive on the big screen.
hintSimplified: 电影院里用来播放影片的大白布。
hintTraditional: 電影院裡用來播放影片的大白布。
hintEnglish: The large white surface in a cinema on which films are shown.

exampleSimplified: 她买了一辆银色的小汽车。
exampleTraditional: 她買了一輛銀色的小汽車。
exampleEnglish: She bought a silver-colored small car.
hintSimplified: 像金属一样闪亮的灰白色，常用来形容车子或首饰。
hintTraditional: 像金屬一樣閃亮的灰白色，常用來形容車子或首飾。
hintEnglish: A shiny grayish-white color like metal, often used to describe cars or jewelry.

exampleSimplified: 故事里的商人带着一袋银子去买马。
exampleTraditional: 故事裡的商人帶著一袋銀子去買馬。
exampleEnglish: In the story, the merchant took a bag of silver to buy a horse.
hintSimplified: 古时候人们用来买东西的白色金属钱。
hintTraditional: 古時候人們用來買東西的白色金屬錢。
hintEnglish: White metal money that people used to buy things in ancient times.

definition: introduction; primer; to boot; to conduct; to guide; to lead (around)
exampleSimplified: 老师耐心地引导学生自己找出答案。
exampleTraditional: 老師耐心地引導學生自己找出答案。
exampleEnglish: The teacher patiently guides students to find the answers themselves.
hintSimplified: 带领别人，指出方向或方法，让他们往正确的路走。
hintTraditional: 帶領別人，指出方向或方法，讓他們往正確的路走。
hintEnglish: To lead others by showing a direction or method so they go the right way.

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂从国外引进了新的生产技术。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠從國外引進了新的生產技術。
exampleEnglish: This factory brought in new production technology from abroad.
hintSimplified: 把外面的人才、技术或设备带到自己这里来使用。
hintTraditional: 把外面的人才、技術或裝置帶到自己這裡來使用。
hintEnglish: To bring in talent, technology or equipment from outside for one's own use.

exampleSimplified: 这辆车的引擎声音很大，应该送去检查。
exampleTraditional: 這輛車的引擎聲音很大，應該送去檢查。
exampleEnglish: This car's engine is very loud and should be taken in for a check.
hintSimplified: 汽车或飞机里提供动力、让它们动起来的机器。
hintTraditional: 汽車或飛機裡提供動力、讓它們動起來的機器。
hintEnglish: The machine inside a car or plane that provides power to make it move.

definition: covert; hidden; implicit; private; recessed (lighting); to conceal; to harbor (i.e. keep sth hidden); to hide; to hide oneself; to lie low; to mask; to nestle; to shelter
exampleSimplified: 他把真正的想法隐藏在心里，没有告诉任何人。
exampleTraditional: 他把真正的想法隱藏在心裡，沒有告訴任何人。
exampleEnglish: He hid his true thoughts deep inside and told no one.
hintSimplified: 把东西或感情藏起来，不让别人发现。
hintTraditional: 把東西或感情藏起來，不讓別人發現。
hintEnglish: To conceal things or feelings so others won't find them.

exampleSimplified: 传说有位隐士住在深山里，很少与人来往。
exampleTraditional: 傳說有位隱士住在深山裡，很少與人來往。
exampleEnglish: Legend says a hermit lives deep in the mountains and rarely mixes with people.
hintSimplified: 离开社会，独自住在安静的地方，不愿出名的人。
hintTraditional: 離開社會，獨自住在安靜的地方，不願出名的人。
hintEnglish: A person who leaves society to live alone in a quiet place, avoiding fame.

exampleSimplified: 远处隐约传来一阵音乐声。
exampleTraditional: 遠處隱約傳來一陣音樂聲。
exampleEnglish: A faint sound of music could be heard from far away.
hintSimplified: 形容声音或影子不太清楚，好像看得到又看不清。
hintTraditional: 形容聲音或影子不太清楚，好像看得到又看不清。
hintEnglish: Describes a sound or shape that is not clear, as if you can just barely perceive it.

definition: proof; evidence; to confirm; to corroborate; to verify
exampleSimplified: 实验的结果印证了他的想法是对的。
exampleTraditional: 實驗的結果印證了他的想法是對的。
exampleEnglish: The experiment's results confirmed that his idea was right.
hintSimplified: 用事实或结果来证明一个说法是真的。
hintTraditional: 用事實或結果來證明一個說法是真的。
hintEnglish: To use facts or results to show that a claim is true.

exampleSimplified: 夏天的时候，我最爱吃新鲜的樱桃。
exampleTraditional: 夏天的時候，我最愛吃新鮮的櫻桃。
exampleEnglish: In summer, I love eating fresh cherries most.
hintSimplified: 一种红色的小水果，圆圆的，有长长的梗，里面有一颗核。
hintTraditional: 一種紅色的小水果，圓圓的，有長長的梗，裡面有一顆核。
hintEnglish: A small round red fruit with a long stem and a pit inside.

exampleSimplified: 消防员英勇地冲进火场救人。
exampleTraditional: 消防員英勇地衝進火場救人。
exampleEnglish: The firefighters bravely rushed into the fire to rescue people.
hintSimplified: 形容人面对危险时很勇敢，值得佩服。
hintTraditional: 形容人面對危險時很勇敢，值得佩服。
hintEnglish: Describes someone who is admirably brave when facing danger.

gloss: (coll.) eagle; hawk; any similar bird of prey
definition: (coll.) eagle; hawk; any similar bird of prey
exampleSimplified: 一只老鹰在山谷上空慢慢地飞。
exampleTraditional: 一隻老鷹在山谷上空慢慢地飛。
exampleEnglish: An eagle was slowly flying above the valley.
hintSimplified: 一种在天空飞的大鸟，眼睛很锐利，会抓小动物吃。
hintTraditional: 一種在天空飛的大鳥，眼睛很銳利，會抓小動物吃。
hintEnglish: A large bird that soars in the sky, has sharp eyes, and catches small animals.

exampleSimplified: 我们傍晚才走到山上的营地。
exampleTraditional: 我們傍晚才走到山上的營地。
exampleEnglish: We only reached the camp on the mountain in the evening.
hintSimplified: 露营或军队暂时住宿和搭帐篷的地方。
hintTraditional: 露營或軍隊暫時住宿和搭帳篷的地方。
hintEnglish: A place where campers or soldiers temporarily stay and set up tents.

definition: to build (housing); to construct; to make
exampleSimplified: 店里用灯光和音乐营造出温馨的气氛。
exampleTraditional: 店裡用燈光和音樂營造出溫馨的氣氛。
exampleEnglish: The shop uses lighting and music to create a cozy atmosphere.
hintSimplified: 用心安排，让某种环境或气氛慢慢形成。
hintTraditional: 用心安排，讓某種環境或氣氛慢慢形成。
hintEnglish: To deliberately arrange things so that a certain environment or mood takes shape.

definition: to cater to; to pander to
exampleSimplified: 这家公司的广告只是为了迎合年轻人的口味。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司的廣告只是為了迎合年輕人的口味。
exampleEnglish: This company's ads just aim to cater to young people's tastes.
hintSimplified: 为了让别人喜欢或满意，而照对方的想法去做。
hintTraditional: 為了讓別人喜歡或滿意，而照對方的想法去做。
hintEnglish: To act according to others' wishes so that they will like or be satisfied with you.

definition: innuendo; to insinuate; to refer obliquely to
exampleSimplified: 这部电影影射了当时社会的一些问题。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影影射了當時社會的一些問題。
exampleEnglish: This film alludes to some problems of society at the time.
hintSimplified: 不直接说出来，而是用暗示的方式指向某人或某事。
hintTraditional: 不直接說出來，而是用暗示的方式指向某人或某事。
hintEnglish: To point at a person or matter indirectly through hints rather than saying it outright.

exampleSimplified: 这台电脑的硬体比较旧，所以速度很慢。
exampleTraditional: 這臺電腦的硬體比較舊，所以速度很慢。
exampleEnglish: This computer's hardware is rather old, so it is slow.
hintSimplified: 电脑里看得到、摸得到的零件，和程序相对。
hintTraditional: 電腦裡看得到、摸得到的零件，和程式相對。
hintEnglish: The physical parts of a computer you can see and touch, as opposed to programs.

gloss: to meet a contingency; to adapt oneself to changes
definition: to meet a contingency; to adapt oneself to changes
exampleSimplified: 遇到突发状况时，他的应变能力很强。
exampleTraditional: 遇到突發狀況時，他的應變能力很強。
exampleEnglish: When sudden situations arise, his ability to adapt is very strong.
hintSimplified: 面对突然的变化，马上想办法处理。
hintTraditional: 面對突然的變化，馬上想辦法處理。
hintEnglish: To quickly figure out how to handle sudden changes.

definition: dinner party; banquet; social engagement; to engage in social activities; to socialize
exampleSimplified: 他每天晚上都有应酬，很少回家吃饭。
exampleTraditional: 他每天晚上都有應酬，很少回家吃飯。
exampleEnglish: He has social engagements every evening and rarely eats at home.
hintSimplified: 因为工作或人际关系而参加的饭局或聚会。
hintTraditional: 因為工作或人際關係而參加的飯局或聚會。
hintEnglish: A meal or gathering one attends because of work or social relationships.

definition: (attributive) emergency; to meet a contingency; to respond to an emergency
exampleSimplified: 我在背包里准备了应急用的食物和水。
exampleTraditional: 我在揹包裡準備了應急用的食物和水。
exampleEnglish: I prepared emergency food and water in my backpack.
hintSimplified: 为了处理突然发生的紧急情况而准备的。
hintTraditional: 為了處理突然發生的緊急情況而準備的。
hintEnglish: Prepared for dealing with an urgent situation that arises suddenly.

definition: to be fulfilled; to come about as predicted; to come true
exampleSimplified: 他的预言后来真的应验了。
exampleTraditional: 他的預言後來真的應驗了。
exampleEnglish: His prediction really came true later.
hintSimplified: 以前说的话或预感，后来真的发生了。
hintTraditional: 以前說的話或預感，後來真的發生了。
hintEnglish: What was said or sensed earlier really did happen later.

definition: to apply (for a job); to reply to a job advertisement
exampleSimplified: 他去应征一家贸易公司的业务工作。
exampleTraditional: 他去應徵一家貿易公司的業務工作。
exampleEnglish: He went to apply for a sales job at a trading company.
hintSimplified: 看到公司在找人，就去报名并希望被录用。
hintTraditional: 看到公司在找人，就去報名並希望被錄用。
hintEnglish: To sign up for a position a company is recruiting for, hoping to be hired.

definition: eager; enthusiastically; to jump; to leap
exampleSimplified: 同学们踊跃地举手回答老师的问题。
exampleTraditional: 同學們踴躍地舉手回答老師的問題。
exampleEnglish: The students eagerly raised their hands to answer the teacher's question.
hintSimplified: 形容大家很积极，抢着参加或发言。
hintTraditional: 形容大家很積極，搶著參加或發言。
hintEnglish: Describes people being enthusiastic, eager to join in or speak up.

exampleSimplified: 这个应用程式已经有一百万用户了。
exampleTraditional: 這個應用程式已經有一百萬用戶了。
exampleEnglish: This app already has one million users.
hintSimplified: 使用某种产品或网络服务的人。
hintTraditional: 使用某種產品或網路服務的人。
hintEnglish: A person who uses a certain product or online service.

exampleSimplified: 这个小工具的用途很多，家里很实用。
exampleTraditional: 這個小工具的用途很多，家裡很實用。
exampleEnglish: This little tool has many uses and is very handy at home.
hintSimplified: 一样东西可以拿来做什么事。
hintTraditional: 一樣東西可以拿來做什麼事。
hintEnglish: What a thing can be used for.

exampleSimplified: 中国有着悠久的历史和文化。
exampleTraditional: 中國有著悠久的歷史和文化。
exampleEnglish: China has a long history and culture.
hintSimplified: 形容历史或传统已经存在了很长很长的时间。
hintTraditional: 形容歷史或傳統已經存在了很長很長的時間。
hintEnglish: Describes a history or tradition that has existed for a very long time.

definition: carefree; leisurely; relaxed; variant of 悠閒|悠闲
exampleSimplified: 周末他悠闲地坐在院子里喝茶。
exampleTraditional: 週末他悠閒地坐在院子裡喝茶。
exampleEnglish: On weekends he sits leisurely in the yard drinking tea.
hintSimplified: 形容心情轻松，没有压力，也不着急。
hintTraditional: 形容心情輕鬆，沒有壓力，也不著急。
hintEnglish: Describes a relaxed state of mind, with no pressure and no hurry.

gloss: preferential treatment; to give preferential treatment
definition: preferential treatment; to give preferential treatment
exampleSimplified: 博物馆对学生和老人都有优待。
exampleTraditional: 博物館對學生和老人都有優待。
exampleEnglish: The museum gives preferential treatment to students and seniors.
hintSimplified: 给某些人比一般人更好的条件，例如便宜的票价。
hintTraditional: 給某些人比一般人更好的條件，例如便宜的票價。
hintEnglish: Giving certain people better conditions than others, such as cheaper tickets.

exampleSimplified: 这家公司的最大优势是价格便宜。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司的最大優勢是價格便宜。
exampleEnglish: This company's biggest advantage is its low prices.
hintSimplified: 比别人更有利、更强的条件。
hintTraditional: 比別人更有利、更強的條件。
hintEnglish: A condition that is more favorable or stronger than others'.

gloss: to have priority; to take precedence
definition: to have priority; to take precedence
exampleSimplified: 老人和小孩可以优先上车。
exampleTraditional: 老人和小孩可以優先上車。
exampleEnglish: Seniors and children may board first.
hintSimplified: 比别人先得到机会或先被处理。
hintTraditional: 比別人先得到機會或先被處理。
hintEnglish: To get a chance or be dealt with before others.

exampleSimplified: 她以优异的成绩从大学毕业。
exampleTraditional: 她以優異的成績從大學畢業。
exampleEnglish: She graduated from university with outstanding grades.
hintSimplified: 形容成绩或表现特别好，比一般人好很多。
hintTraditional: 形容成績或表現特別好，比一般人好很多。
hintEnglish: Describes grades or performance that are far better than average.

exampleSimplified: 你知道端午节的由来吗？
exampleTraditional: 你知道端午節的由來嗎？
exampleEnglish: Do you know the origin of the Dragon Boat Festival?
hintSimplified: 一件事或一个习俗是怎么开始、从哪里来的。
hintTraditional: 一件事或一個習俗是怎麼開始、從哪裡來的。
hintEnglish: How a thing or custom began and where it came from.

definition: CL:次[ci4]; to go sightseeing; to tour; to visit
exampleSimplified: 我们周末去故宫游览了一整天。
exampleTraditional: 我們週末去故宮遊覽了一整天。
exampleEnglish: We spent a whole day at the weekend touring the Palace Museum.
hintSimplified: 到风景区或名胜古迹到处走走看看。
hintTraditional: 到風景區或名勝古蹟到處走走看看。
hintEnglish: To walk around a scenic spot or historic site and look at the sights.

exampleSimplified: 这个国家的沙漠里有很大的油田。
exampleTraditional: 這個國家的沙漠裡有很大的油田。
exampleEnglish: There are huge oil fields in this country's desert.
hintSimplified: 地下有很多石油、可以开采的地方。
hintTraditional: 地下有很多石油、可以開採的地方。
hintEnglish: An area underground rich in petroleum that can be extracted.

definition: CL:根[gen1]; slick and sly person; youtiao (deep-fried breadstick)
exampleSimplified: 早上我喜欢吃油条，配一杯热豆浆。
exampleTraditional: 早上我喜歡吃油條，配一杯熱豆漿。
exampleEnglish: In the morning I like eating fried dough sticks with a cup of hot soy milk.
hintSimplified: 一种长长的、用油炸的早餐食物，常和豆浆一起吃。
hintTraditional: 一種長長的、用油炸的早餐食物，常和豆漿一起吃。
hintEnglish: A long, deep-fried breakfast food often eaten with soy milk.

exampleSimplified: 同学之间应该互相友爱，互相帮助。
exampleTraditional: 同學之間應該互相友愛，互相幫助。
exampleEnglish: Classmates should be kind to one another and help each other.
hintSimplified: 朋友或同伴之间亲切、关心对方的感情。
hintTraditional: 朋友或同伴之間親切、關心對方的感情。
hintEnglish: The warm, caring feeling between friends or companions.

exampleSimplified: 这家店卖的蔬菜都是有机的，价钱比较贵。
exampleTraditional: 這家店賣的蔬菜都是有機的，價錢比較貴。
exampleEnglish: The vegetables this shop sells are all organic, so they cost more.
hintSimplified: 种菜时不用化学肥料和农药的。
hintTraditional: 種菜時不用化學肥料和農藥的。
hintEnglish: Describes produce grown without chemical fertilizer or pesticides.

exampleSimplified: 他说的话很有理，大家都同意。
exampleTraditional: 他說的話很有理，大家都同意。
exampleEnglish: What he said was very reasonable, and everyone agreed.
hintSimplified: 说的话合乎道理，让人觉得对。
hintTraditional: 說的話合乎道理，讓人覺得對。
hintEnglish: Describes words that make sense and seem right.

exampleSimplified: 经过治疗，他的病情有所好转。
exampleTraditional: 經過治療，他的病情有所好轉。
exampleEnglish: After treatment, his condition has improved somewhat.
hintSimplified: 放在动词前面，表示有一点变化，但程度不大。
hintTraditional: 放在動詞前面，表示有一點變化，但程度不大。
hintEnglish: Placed before a verb to show some change, though not a big one.

exampleSimplified: 他是一位很有为的年轻人，未来一定不错。
exampleTraditional: 他是一位很有為的年輕人，未來一定不錯。
exampleEnglish: He is a very promising young man and will surely have a bright future.
hintSimplified: 形容年轻人有能力、有前途，将来会做出成绩。
hintTraditional: 形容年輕人有能力、有前途，將來會做出成績。
hintEnglish: Describes a young person with ability and a future of achievement.

exampleSimplified: 我们的时间和预算都很有限。
exampleTraditional: 我們的時間和預算都很有限。
exampleEnglish: Our time and budget are both very limited.
hintSimplified: 数量或范围不多，有一个界线。
hintTraditional: 數量或範圍不多，有一個界線。
hintEnglish: Not much in amount or range; having a boundary.

exampleSimplified: 这家公司有很多有形资产，比如房子和机器。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司有很多有形資產，比如房子和機器。
exampleEnglish: This company has many tangible assets, such as buildings and machines.
hintSimplified: 看得见、摸得着的，和抽象的相反。
hintTraditional: 看得見、摸得著的，和抽象的相反。
hintEnglish: Can be seen and touched; the opposite of abstract.

exampleSimplified: 多运动对身体健康很有益。
exampleTraditional: 多運動對身體健康很有益。
exampleEnglish: Exercising more is very beneficial for your health.
hintSimplified: 对人或事情有好处。
hintTraditional: 對人或事情有好處。
hintEnglish: Bringing good results or advantages to someone or something.

exampleSimplified: 他不是有意迟到的，路上塞车了。
exampleTraditional: 他不是有意遲到的，路上塞車了。
exampleEnglish: He wasn't late on purpose; there was a traffic jam.
hintSimplified: 自己知道，而且是故意去做的。
hintTraditional: 自己知道，而且是故意去做的。
hintEnglish: Doing something knowingly and deliberately.

exampleSimplified: 我们能在国外遇见，真是有缘。
exampleTraditional: 我們能在國外遇見，真是有緣。
exampleEnglish: It's truly fate that we met abroad.
hintSimplified: 两个人好像命中注定会相遇或成为朋友。
hintTraditional: 兩個人好像命中註定會相遇或成為朋友。
hintEnglish: Two people seem destined to meet or become friends.

definition: to attract; to entice; to induce; to lure
exampleSimplified: 美食的诱惑让他很难减肥成功。
exampleTraditional: 美食的誘惑讓他很難減肥成功。
exampleEnglish: The temptation of delicious food makes it hard for him to lose weight.
hintSimplified: 让人很想要，很难拒绝的吸引力。
hintTraditional: 讓人很想要，很難拒絕的吸引力。
hintEnglish: An attraction that makes you want something and hard to refuse.

exampleSimplified: 你都三十岁了，不要这么幼稚。
exampleTraditional: 你都三十歲了，不要這麼幼稚。
exampleEnglish: You're already thirty; don't be so childish.
hintSimplified: 形容大人的想法或行为像小孩子，不成熟。
hintTraditional: 形容大人的想法或行為像小孩子，不成熟。
hintEnglish: Describes an adult whose thinking or behavior is like a child's, not mature.

exampleSimplified: 中文的语法比我想象的简单。
exampleTraditional: 中文的語法比我想象的簡單。
exampleEnglish: Chinese grammar is simpler than I imagined.
hintSimplified: 学外语时要学的句子结构和排列规则。
hintTraditional: 學外語時要學的句子結構和排列規則。
hintEnglish: The rules of sentence structure you study when learning a foreign language.

exampleSimplified: 这个决定真是太愚蠢了。
exampleTraditional: 這個決定真是太愚蠢了。
exampleEnglish: This decision is really too foolish.
hintSimplified: 形容人或做法不聪明，缺少头脑。
hintTraditional: 形容人或做法不聰明，缺少頭腦。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or action lacking intelligence or sense.

exampleSimplified: 这件事引起了社会舆论的关注。
exampleTraditional: 這件事引起了社會輿論的關注。
exampleEnglish: This matter drew the attention of public opinion.
hintSimplified: 社会上大多数人对某件事的看法和讨论。
hintTraditional: 社會上大多數人對某件事的看法和討論。
hintEnglish: What most people in society think and discuss about an issue.

exampleSimplified: 渔民每天清晨就开船出海捕鱼。
exampleTraditional: 漁民每天清晨就開船出海捕魚。
exampleEnglish: The fishermen set out to sea to catch fish every early morning.
hintSimplified: 靠在海上或河里捕鱼生活的人。
hintTraditional: 靠在海上或河裡捕魚生活的人。
hintEnglish: People who make a living catching fish at sea or in rivers.

definition: to apply; to give; to impose
exampleSimplified: 公司对这个问题会予以认真处理。
exampleTraditional: 公司對這個問題會予以認真處理。
exampleEnglish: The company will give this problem serious attention.
hintSimplified: 书面语，常放在动词前，表示给出或进行某种处理。
hintTraditional: 書面語，常放在動詞前，表示給出或進行某種處理。
hintEnglish: A formal word placed before a verb, meaning to give or carry out some treatment.

exampleSimplified: 今天与会的人员都提出了自己的意见。
exampleTraditional: 今天與會的人員都提出了自己的意見。
exampleEnglish: All the people attending today's meeting offered their own opinions.
hintSimplified: 出席并参加一场会议。
hintTraditional: 出席並參加一場會議。
hintEnglish: To be present at and take part in a conference.

exampleSimplified: 雨季来了，出门要记得带伞。
exampleTraditional: 雨季來了，出門要記得帶傘。
exampleEnglish: The rainy season has arrived, so remember to bring an umbrella when going out.
hintSimplified: 一年中经常下很多雨的那段时间。
hintTraditional: 一年中經常下很多雨的那段時間。
hintEnglish: The period of the year when it rains a lot.

definition: (PRC) Chinese (as a school subject); literature and language
exampleSimplified: 他的语文成绩很好，特别会写作文。
exampleTraditional: 他的語文成績很好，特別會寫作文。
exampleEnglish: His Chinese class grades are very good; he is especially good at writing essays.
hintSimplified: 学校里学习阅读、写作和课文的一门课。
hintTraditional: 學校裡學習閱讀、寫作和課文的一門課。
hintEnglish: A school subject where you study reading, writing and texts in your native language.

exampleSimplified: 宇宙非常大，有无数的星星。
exampleTraditional: 宇宙非常大，有無數的星星。
exampleEnglish: The universe is enormous and has countless stars.
hintSimplified: 包括地球、太阳和所有星星的无限空间。
hintTraditional: 包括地球、太陽和所有星星的無限空間。
hintEnglish: The boundless space containing Earth, the sun and all the stars.

exampleSimplified: 博物馆里展出了很多古代的玉器。
exampleTraditional: 博物館裡展出了很多古代的玉器。
exampleEnglish: The museum displays many ancient jade artifacts.
hintSimplified: 用一种绿色的美丽石头做成的物品或装饰品。
hintTraditional: 用一種綠色的美麗石頭做成的物品或裝飾品。
hintEnglish: Objects or ornaments made from a beautiful green stone.

exampleSimplified: 专家预测明年的经济会慢慢变好。
exampleTraditional: 專家預測明年的經濟會慢慢變好。
exampleEnglish: Experts predict that the economy will slowly improve next year.
hintSimplified: 在事情发生之前，根据资料猜测未来会怎么样。
hintTraditional: 在事情發生之前，根據資料猜測未來會怎麼樣。
hintEnglish: Before something happens, guessing what the future will be like based on data.

definition: precautionary; prophylactic; to guard against; to prevent; to protect; to take precautions against
exampleSimplified: 每年打流感疫苗可以预防生病。
exampleTraditional: 每年打流感疫苗可以預防生病。
exampleEnglish: Getting a flu shot every year can help prevent illness.
hintSimplified: 事情还没发生，先做准备，避免坏事出现。
hintTraditional: 事情還沒發生，先做準備，避免壞事出現。
hintEnglish: Before something happens, preparing in advance so the bad thing doesn't occur.

definition: advance notice; to forecast; to predict
exampleSimplified: 这部电影的预告片看起来很有意思。
exampleTraditional: 這部電影的預告片看起來很有意思。
exampleEnglish: The trailer for this movie looks very interesting.
hintSimplified: 在正式播出或举行以前，先告诉大家内容。
hintTraditional: 在正式播出或舉行以前，先告訴大家內容。
hintEnglish: Telling people the content beforehand, before the official broadcast or event.

definition: prediction; projection; to estimate; to forecast
exampleSimplified: 公司预估今年的收入会增加百分之十。
exampleTraditional: 公司預估今年的收入會增加百分之十。
exampleEnglish: The company estimates that this year's revenue will increase by ten percent.
hintSimplified: 事先大概算一算数字或结果。
hintTraditional: 事先大概算一算數字或結果。
hintEnglish: Roughly calculating a number or result in advance.

definition: preliminary competition; to hold preliminary heats
exampleSimplified: 我们队通过了预赛，明天要打决赛。
exampleTraditional: 我們隊透過了預賽，明天要打決賽。
exampleEnglish: Our team passed the preliminaries and will play the finals tomorrow.
hintSimplified: 正式比赛以前，先选出好选手的比赛。
hintTraditional: 正式比賽以前，先選出好選手的比賽。
hintEnglish: A contest held before the main competition to select the best players.

definition: booking; reservation; to book; to make an appointment
exampleSimplified: 我已经打电话预约了星期六晚上的餐厅。
exampleTraditional: 我已經打電話預約了星期六晚上的餐廳。
exampleEnglish: I already phoned to reserve the restaurant for Saturday night.
hintSimplified: 去餐厅或医院以前，先和对方说好时间。
hintTraditional: 去餐廳或醫院以前，先和對方說好時間。
hintEnglish: Agreeing on a time with a restaurant or clinic before going.

exampleSimplified: 这个寓言告诉我们要诚实。
exampleTraditional: 這個寓言告訴我們要誠實。
exampleEnglish: This fable tells us to be honest.
hintSimplified: 一种短故事，常用动物说明做人的道理。
hintTraditional: 一種短故事，常用動物說明做人的道理。
hintEnglish: A short story, often with animals, that teaches a moral lesson.

exampleSimplified: 苏州的园林有水、有树，也有漂亮的房子。
exampleTraditional: 蘇州的園林有水、有樹，也有漂亮的房子。
exampleEnglish: The gardens of Suzhou have water, trees and beautiful buildings.
hintSimplified: 用花草、树木、水池和亭子设计出来的美丽地方。
hintTraditional: 用花草、樹木、水池和亭子設計出來的美麗地方。
hintEnglish: A beautiful place designed with plants, trees, ponds and pavilions.

exampleSimplified: 睡了一觉以后，他又恢复了元气。
exampleTraditional: 睡了一覺以後，他又恢復了元氣。
exampleEnglish: After a good sleep, he regained his vitality.
hintSimplified: 人身体里充满的精神和力量。
hintTraditional: 人身體裡充滿的精神和力量。
hintEnglish: The spirit and energy a person is full of.

exampleSimplified: 两国元首今天在台北见面。
exampleTraditional: 兩國元首今天在台北見面。
exampleEnglish: The heads of the two countries met in Taipei today.
hintSimplified: 一个国家最高的领导人。
hintTraditional: 一個國家最高的領導人。
hintEnglish: The highest leader of a country.

definition: (chemistry) element; (math.) element (member of a set); element (key component of sth)
exampleSimplified: 水是由氢和氧两种元素组成的。
exampleTraditional: 水是由氫和氧兩種元素組成的。
exampleEnglish: Water is made up of two elements, hydrogen and oxygen.
hintSimplified: 化学里构成物质的基本种类，如氢、氧、碳。
hintTraditional: 化學裡構成物質的基本種類，如氫、氧、碳。
hintEnglish: In chemistry, a basic kind of substance that makes up matter, like hydrogen or carbon.

definition: original shape; true appearance (under the disguise); true character
exampleSimplified: 听到这句话，他的坏脾气马上现了原形。
exampleTraditional: 聽到這句話，他的壞脾氣馬上現了原形。
exampleEnglish: Hearing this, his true nature immediately showed.
hintSimplified: 东西或人本来真正的样子，常指假装被拆穿以后。
hintTraditional: 東西或人本來真正的樣子，常指假裝被拆穿以後。
hintEnglish: The true original appearance of something or someone, often after a disguise is exposed.

exampleSimplified: 一大片原野在阳光下一直延伸到远方。
exampleTraditional: 一大片原野在陽光下一直延伸到遠方。
exampleEnglish: A vast stretch of open country extends into the distance under the sun.
hintSimplified: 城市以外，宽广又没有什么房子的大地。
hintTraditional: 城市以外，寬廣又沒有什麼房子的大地。
hintEnglish: Wide land outside the city with hardly any buildings.

exampleSimplified: 搬家以后，房子必须恢复原状才能还给房东。
exampleTraditional: 搬家以後，房子必須恢復原狀才能還給房東。
exampleEnglish: After moving out, the house must be restored to its original condition before returning it to the landlord.
hintSimplified: 东西还没有被改变以前的样子。
hintTraditional: 東西還沒有被改變以前的樣子。
hintEnglish: How something looked before it was changed.

exampleSimplified: 水是由氢和氧的原子组成的。
exampleTraditional: 水是由氫和氧的原子組成的。
exampleEnglish: Water is made up of hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
hintSimplified: 物质中非常非常小的基本粒子，中心有核，周围有电子。
hintTraditional: 物質中非常非常小的基本粒子，中心有核，周圍有電子。
hintEnglish: A extremely tiny basic particle of matter, with a nucleus at the center and electrons around it.

definition: aid; assistance; to aid; to help; to support
exampleSimplified: 地震以后，很多国家给这个地区提供援助。
exampleTraditional: 地震以後，很多國家給這個地區提供援助。
exampleEnglish: After the earthquake, many countries provided aid to the region.
hintSimplified: 在别人有困难时，给钱、食物或人力来帮忙。
hintTraditional: 在別人有困難時，給錢、食物或人力來幫忙。
hintEnglish: Giving money, food or manpower to help others in difficulty.

definition: (photography) long shot; long-term prospects; scenery in the distance
exampleSimplified: 这家公司的远景很好，大家都愿意投资。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司的遠景很好，大家都願意投資。
exampleEnglish: This company has a bright future outlook, and everyone is willing to invest.
hintSimplified: 对未来发展的看法或希望。
hintTraditional: 對未來發展的看法或希望。
hintEnglish: A view or hope about future development.

definition: constraint; restriction; to constrain; to limit to; to restrict
exampleSimplified: 孩子需要规则的约束，才能学会自律。
exampleTraditional: 孩子需要規則的約束，才能學會自律。
exampleEnglish: Children need the restraint of rules in order to learn self-discipline.
hintSimplified: 用规定限制人的行为，不让他随便做事。
hintTraditional: 用規定限制人的行為，不讓他隨便做事。
hintEnglish: Limiting a person's behavior with rules so he can't do just anything.

exampleSimplified: 这支乐队今晚会在学校的广场表演。
exampleTraditional: 這支樂隊今晚會在學校的廣場表演。
exampleEnglish: This band will perform in the school square tonight.
hintSimplified: 一群人一起演奏乐器或唱歌的团体。
hintTraditional: 一群人一起演奏樂器或唱歌的團體。
hintEnglish: A group of people who play instruments or sing together.

gloss: (fig.) to function; to be in operation
definition: (fig.) to function; to be in operation; (of a computer) to run; (of a train service etc) to operate; to run; (of celestial bodies etc) to move along one's course
exampleSimplified: 这台电脑运行得很慢，需要换新的。
exampleTraditional: 這臺電腦運行得很慢，需要換新的。
exampleEnglish: This computer runs very slowly and needs to be replaced.
hintSimplified: 机器、系统或程序正在工作、转动。
hintTraditional: 機器、系統或程式正在工作、轉動。
hintEnglish: A machine, system or program that is working or running.

exampleSimplified: 公共汽车上有一个座位是留给孕妇的。
exampleTraditional: 公共汽車上有一個座位是留給孕婦的。
exampleEnglish: On the bus, one seat is reserved for pregnant women.
hintSimplified: 肚子里有小宝宝的女人。
hintTraditional: 肚子裡有小寶寶的女人。
hintEnglish: A woman who has a baby growing inside her.

hintSimplified: 比医院小，看一般小病的地方。
hintTraditional: 比醫院小，看一般小病的地方。
hintEnglish: A place smaller than a hospital where common minor illnesses are treated.

exampleSimplified: 遇到火灾时，他还是很镇定。
exampleTraditional: 遇到火災時，他還是很鎮定。
exampleEnglish: Even in a fire, he stayed calm.
hintSimplified: 遇到危险或意外时，心里不慌张、很稳。
hintTraditional: 遇到危險或意外時，心裡不慌張、很穩。
hintEnglish: Not panicking and staying steady when facing danger or accidents.

definition: repression; suppression; to put down; to quell; to suppress
exampleSimplified: 政府派警察去镇压这场混乱。
exampleTraditional: 政府派警察去鎮壓這場混亂。
exampleEnglish: The government sent police to suppress the chaos.
hintSimplified: 用强大的力量让反对或混乱的行动停下来。
hintTraditional: 用強大的力量讓反對或混亂的行動停下來。
hintEnglish: Using strong force to stop opposition or disorder.

exampleSimplified: 手机在桌上振动了一下。
exampleTraditional: 手機在桌上振動了一下。
exampleEnglish: The phone vibrated once on the table.
hintSimplified: 物体很快地来回轻轻抖动。
hintTraditional: 物體很快地來回輕輕抖動。
hintEnglish: When an object quickly shakes back and forth in small movements.

exampleSimplified: 这个消息让所有人都感到震惊。
exampleTraditional: 這個訊息讓所有人都感到震驚。
exampleEnglish: This news left everyone shocked.
hintSimplified: 听到意想不到的大事，心里非常吃惊。
hintTraditional: 聽到意想不到的大事，心裡非常吃驚。
hintEnglish: Being greatly startled on hearing unexpected big news.

definition: camp; faction; group of people; sides in a dispute
exampleSimplified: 这两个阵营的意见完全不同。
exampleTraditional: 這兩個陣營的意見完全不同。
exampleEnglish: The opinions of these two camps are completely different.
hintSimplified: 在比赛、竞争或争论中，站在同一边的一群人。
hintTraditional: 在比賽、競爭或爭論中，站在同一邊的一群人。
hintEnglish: A group of people on the same side in a contest, competition or dispute.

definition: (fig.) to vanish; to disappear; to evaporate
exampleSimplified: 夏天太阳很大,地上的水很快就蒸发了。
exampleTraditional: 夏天太陽很大,地上的水很快就蒸發了。
exampleEnglish: In summer the sun is strong, and the water on the ground evaporates quickly.
hintSimplified: 水受热后变成气体,慢慢消失在空气中。
hintTraditional: 水受熱後變成氣體,慢慢消失在空氣中。
hintEnglish: When heated, water turns into gas and slowly disappears into the air.

exampleSimplified: 锅盖打开的时候,热热的蒸气冒了出来。
exampleTraditional: 鍋蓋開啟的時候,熱熱的蒸氣冒了出來。
exampleEnglish: When the pot lid was opened, hot steam came out.
hintSimplified: 水烧开以后,从锅里冒出来的白色热气。
hintTraditional: 水燒開以後,從鍋裡冒出來的白色熱氣。
hintEnglish: The white hot vapor that rises from a pot after water boils.

exampleSimplified: 他们为了这件事争辩了很久,还是没有结果。
exampleTraditional: 他們為了這件事爭辯了很久,還是沒有結果。
exampleEnglish: They argued about this matter for a long time and still had no result.
hintSimplified: 两个人意见不同,各自说出理由来互相反驳。
hintTraditional: 兩個人意見不同,各自說出理由來互相反駁。
hintEnglish: Two people disagree and each gives reasons to counter the other.

definition: to contest; to fight over; to vie over
exampleSimplified: 两支球队都在争夺这次比赛的冠军。
exampleTraditional: 兩支球隊都在爭奪這次比賽的冠軍。
exampleEnglish: Both teams are fighting for the championship of this competition.
hintSimplified: 大家都想得到同一样东西,所以互相竞争。
hintTraditional: 大家都想得到同一樣東西,所以互相競爭。
hintEnglish: Everyone wants the same thing, so they compete against each other for it.

definition: determined not to fall short; to resolve on improvement; to work hard for sth
exampleSimplified: 这个孩子很争气,考上了最好的大学。
exampleTraditional: 這個孩子很爭氣,考上了最好的大學。
exampleEnglish: This child has made us proud and got into the best university.
hintSimplified: 努力做好事情,不让父母或家人失望。
hintTraditional: 努力做好事情,不讓父母或家人失望。
hintEnglish: Working hard to succeed so as not to let one's parents or family down.

exampleSimplified: 这个新政策在社会上引起了很大的争议。
exampleTraditional: 這個新政策在社會上引起了很大的爭議。
exampleEnglish: This new policy has caused a lot of controversy in society.
hintSimplified: 大家对一件事有很不同的看法,常常吵个不停。
hintTraditional: 大家對一件事有很不同的看法,常常吵個不停。
hintEnglish: People have very different views on something and keep debating it.

exampleSimplified: 政府决定对进口商品征收更高的税。
exampleTraditional: 政府決定對進口商品徵收更高的稅。
exampleEnglish: The government decided to levy higher taxes on imported goods.
hintSimplified: 政府依法向人民或公司收取税款或土地。
hintTraditional: 政府依法向人民或公司收取稅款或土地。
hintEnglish: The government legally collects taxes or land from people or companies.

exampleSimplified: 他在水里拼命挣扎,希望有人能来救他。
exampleTraditional: 他在水裡拼命掙扎,希望有人能來救他。
exampleEnglish: He struggled desperately in the water, hoping someone would come save him.
hintSimplified: 在困难或危险中,用尽力气想要脱身。
hintTraditional: 在困難或危險中,用盡力氣想要脫身。
hintEnglish: Using all one's strength to get free in a difficult or dangerous situation.

definition: to consolidate; to rectify; to reorganize; to tidy up
exampleSimplified: 市政府决定整顿夜市的卫生和秩序。
exampleTraditional: 市政府決定整頓夜市的衛生和秩序。
exampleEnglish: The city government decided to clean up the hygiene and order of the night market.
hintSimplified: 把混乱的地方或组织重新整理,让它变得更好。
hintTraditional: 把混亂的地方或組織重新整理,讓它變得更好。
hintEnglish: To reorganize a messy place or organization so that it improves.

exampleSimplified: 我为了这份报告整整忙了一个星期。
exampleTraditional: 我為了這份報告整整忙了一個星期。
exampleEnglish: I was busy with this report for a whole week.
hintSimplified: 强调时间或数量刚好够、一点不少,而且常常让人觉得很多。
hintTraditional: 強調時間或數量剛好夠、一點不少,而且常常讓人覺得很多。
hintEnglish: Stresses that a time or amount is complete, with nothing missing, often feeling like a lot.

definition: fair; honest; just (when needed); reasonable; sensible; timely
exampleSimplified: 他是用正当的方法赚到这些钱的。
exampleTraditional: 他是用正當的方法賺到這些錢的。
exampleEnglish: He earned this money by legitimate means.
hintSimplified: 形容事情合理合法,没有做错。
hintTraditional: 形容事情合理合法,沒有做錯。
hintEnglish: Describes something reasonable and lawful, not wrong.

definition: (of an heir) legitimate; Zhengtong Emperor, reign name of sixth Ming Emperor Zhu Qizhen 朱祁鎮|朱祁镇[Zhu1 Qi2 zhen4] (1427-1464), reigned 1435-1449, temple name Yingzong 英宗[Ying1 zong1]; orthodox; traditional; orthodoxy; tradition; principles of dynastic succession
exampleSimplified: 他认为只有这一家才是正统的传统做法。
exampleTraditional: 他認為只有這一家才是正統的傳統做法。
exampleEnglish: He believes only this family follows the orthodox traditional method.
hintSimplified: 指被大家承认的、从传统一代代传下来的正宗系统。
hintTraditional: 指被大家承認的、從傳統一代代傳下來的正宗系統。
hintEnglish: Refers to the recognized, authentic line passed down through tradition.

gloss: (in the titles of traditional commentaries) correct interpretation
definition: (in the titles of traditional commentaries) correct interpretation; just; righteous; justice; righteousness
exampleSimplified: 我们应该为正义而努力,不能怕困难。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該為正義而努力,不能怕困難。
exampleEnglish: We should strive for justice and not fear difficulties.
hintSimplified: 社会上公平、合理、符合道德的原则。
hintTraditional: 社會上公平、合理、符合道德的原則。
hintEnglish: The principle of being fair, reasonable and morally right in society.

exampleSimplified: 市长希望靠好的政绩赢得下一次选举。
exampleTraditional: 市長希望靠好的政績贏得下一次選舉。
exampleEnglish: The mayor hopes to win the next election with good political achievements.
hintSimplified: 官员在任期内做出的成果和成绩。
hintTraditional: 官員在任期內做出的成果和成績。
hintEnglish: The results and accomplishments an official achieves during their term.

exampleSimplified: 选举前,每位候选人都会发表自己的政见。
exampleTraditional: 選舉前,每位候選人都會發表自己的政見。
exampleEnglish: Before the election, every candidate presents their own political views.
hintSimplified: 候选人对国家大事的看法和主张。
hintTraditional: 候選人對國家大事的看法和主張。
hintEnglish: A candidate's opinions and proposals about national affairs.

exampleSimplified: 新的政权成立以后,国家的制度也改变了。
exampleTraditional: 新的政權成立以後,國家的制度也改變了。
exampleEnglish: After the new regime was established, the country's system also changed.
hintSimplified: 一个国家或政府管理国家的权力。
hintTraditional: 一個國家或政府管理國家的權力。
hintEnglish: The power by which a state or government governs a country.

definition: certificate; negotiable security (financial); stocks and bonds
exampleSimplified: 他在证券公司工作,每天都看股票的价格。
exampleTraditional: 他在證券公司工作,每天都看股票的價格。
exampleEnglish: He works at a securities firm and watches stock prices every day.
hintSimplified: 股票、债券这一类可以买卖的投资凭证。
hintTraditional: 股票、債券這一類可以買賣的投資憑證。
hintEnglish: Tradable investment certificates such as stocks and bonds.

exampleSimplified: 法官请证人说出当天晚上看到的事。
exampleTraditional: 法官請證人說出當天晚上看到的事。
exampleEnglish: The judge asked the witness to say what he saw that night.
hintSimplified: 在法院里说出自己亲眼看到的事情的人。
hintTraditional: 在法院裡說出自己親眼看到的事情的人。
hintEnglish: A person in court who tells what they saw with their own eyes.

exampleSimplified: 请在三天之内把报告交给我。
exampleTraditional: 請在三天之內把報告交給我。
exampleEnglish: Please hand the report to me within three days.
hintSimplified: 放在时间、数量或范围后面,表示不超过那个界线。
hintTraditional: 放在時間、數量或範圍後面,表示不超過那個界線。
hintEnglish: Placed after a time, quantity or area to show it does not go beyond that limit.

definition: brace; strut; to prop up; to support
exampleSimplified: 这几根柱子支撑着整个屋顶。
exampleTraditional: 這幾根柱子支撐著整個屋頂。
exampleEnglish: These pillars support the entire roof.
hintSimplified: 从下面顶住东西,让它不会倒下来。
hintTraditional: 從下面頂住東西,讓它不會倒下來。
hintEnglish: To hold something up from below so it does not fall.

exampleSimplified: 你可以用手机支付这次的餐费。
exampleTraditional: 你可以用手機支付這次的餐費。
exampleEnglish: You can pay for this meal with your phone.
hintSimplified: 买东西或接受服务后,把钱交给对方。
hintTraditional: 買東西或接受服務後,把錢交給對方。
hintEnglish: Handing money to the other side after buying something or receiving a service.

definition: to allocate; to control; to dominate
exampleSimplified: 你可以自己支配这个月的零用钱。
exampleTraditional: 你可以自己支配這個月的零用錢。
exampleEnglish: You can control how to spend this month's allowance yourself.
hintSimplified: 决定钱、时间或人力要怎么使用。
hintTraditional: 決定錢、時間或人力要怎麼使用。
hintEnglish: To decide how money, time or people will be used.

definition: to deal with; to provide for; to wait on
exampleSimplified: 客人太多了,老板一个人实在支应不过来。
exampleTraditional: 客人太多了,老闆一個人實在支應不過來。
exampleEnglish: There were too many customers, and the boss alone really couldn't cope.
hintSimplified: 面对很多事情或客人时,想办法应付过去。
hintTraditional: 面對很多事情或客人時,想辦法應付過去。
hintEnglish: Finding ways to handle many tasks or guests when facing them.

definition: content with one's situation; to know contentment (hence happiness)
exampleSimplified: 爷爷很知足,觉得现在的生活已经很幸福了。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺很知足,覺得現在的生活已經很幸福了。
exampleEnglish: Grandpa is very content and feels his current life is already very happy.
hintSimplified: 对自己现在拥有的东西觉得满意,不再要求更多。
hintTraditional: 對自己現在擁有的東西覺得滿意,不再要求更多。
hintEnglish: Feeling satisfied with what one has and not asking for more.

gloss: fat (in the body, in a plant, or in food)
definition: fat (in the body, in a plant, or in food)
exampleSimplified: 吃太多油炸食物,身体里的脂肪会越来越多。
exampleTraditional: 吃太多油炸食物,身體裡的脂肪會越來越多。
exampleEnglish: If you eat too much fried food, the fat in your body will keep increasing.
hintSimplified: 身体或食物里油油的成分,太多会让人变胖。
hintTraditional: 身體或食物裡油油的成分,太多會讓人變胖。
hintEnglish: The oily substance in the body or food that makes people gain weight when excessive.

exampleSimplified: 这个圆形桌子的直径大约是一米五。
exampleTraditional: 這個圓形桌子的直徑大約是一米五。
exampleEnglish: The diameter of this round table is about one and a half meters.
hintSimplified: 通过圆心，连接圆上两点的最长线段的长度。
hintTraditional: 透過圓心，連線圓上兩點的最長線段的長度。
hintEnglish: The length of the longest line through the center of a circle, connecting two points on it.

definition: on duty; to work a shift
exampleSimplified: 今天晚上轮到我值班，所以不能和你们吃饭。
exampleTraditional: 今天晚上輪到我值班，所以不能和你們吃飯。
exampleEnglish: Tonight it's my turn on duty, so I can't have dinner with you.
hintSimplified: 在规定的时间里留在工作岗位上，负责处理事情。
hintTraditional: 在規定的時間裡留在工作崗位上，負責處理事情。
hintEnglish: To stay at your post during a set time and be responsible for handling things.

exampleSimplified: 这幅画很老了，一定很值钱。
exampleTraditional: 這幅畫很老了，一定很值錢。
exampleEnglish: This painting is very old, so it must be worth a lot.
hintSimplified: 形容东西价格高，或者很有价值。
hintTraditional: 形容東西價格高，或者很有價值。
hintEnglish: Describes something with a high price or great worth.

exampleSimplified: 这个岛曾经被外国殖民了很多年。
exampleTraditional: 這個島曾經被外國殖民了很多年。
exampleEnglish: This island was once colonized by a foreign country for many years.
hintSimplified: 强国在别的地方建立统治，并让自己的人民移居过去。
hintTraditional: 強國在別的地方建立統治，並讓自己的人民移居過去。
hintEnglish: When a powerful country takes control of another land and sends its own people to settle there.

definition: (physics) mass; quality (i.e. degree of excellence); quality and quantity
exampleSimplified: 买东西的时候，我最重视质量，不只看价格。
exampleTraditional: 買東西的時候，我最重視質量，不只看價格。
exampleEnglish: When buying things, I care most about quality, not just price.
hintSimplified: 指产品或服务好不好的程度。
hintTraditional: 指產品或服務好不好的程度。
hintEnglish: How good or bad a product or service is.

gloss: to call into question; to challenge (the truth or validity of)
definition: to call into question; to challenge (the truth or validity of)
exampleSimplified: 很多人质疑这个新政策是不是真的有用。
exampleTraditional: 很多人質疑這個新政策是不是真的有用。
exampleEnglish: Many people question whether this new policy is really useful.
hintSimplified: 对某件事是否正确或可靠，提出怀疑和疑问。
hintTraditional: 對某件事是否正確或可靠，提出懷疑和疑問。
hintEnglish: To raise doubts about whether something is correct or reliable.

exampleSimplified: 他在公司的职务是销售部经理。
exampleTraditional: 他在公司的職務是銷售部經理。
exampleEnglish: His position in the company is sales department manager.
hintSimplified: 在公司或机关里担任的工作和地位。
hintTraditional: 在公司或機關裡擔任的工作和地位。
hintEnglish: The job and rank someone holds in a company or organization.

exampleSimplified: 照顾好病人是护士最重要的职责。
exampleTraditional: 照顧好病人是護士最重要的職責。
exampleEnglish: Taking good care of patients is a nurse's most important responsibility.
hintSimplified: 因为工作或身份而必须做的事。
hintTraditional: 因為工作或身份而必須做的事。
hintEnglish: What you must do because of your job or role.

exampleSimplified: 开车以前，你要先拿到驾驶执照。
exampleTraditional: 開車以前，你要先拿到駕駛執照。
exampleEnglish: Before driving, you must first get a driver's license.
hintSimplified: 政府发的证件，有了它才可以合法做某些事或开店。
hintTraditional: 政府發的證件，有了它才可以合法做某些事或開店。
hintEnglish: An official document from the government that lets you legally do something or run a business.

exampleSimplified: 这个政党已经执政超过八年了。
exampleTraditional: 這個政黨已經執政超過八年了。
exampleEnglish: This party has been in power for more than eight years.
hintSimplified: 政党或人掌握政权，管理国家。
hintTraditional: 政黨或人掌握政權，管理國家。
hintEnglish: When a party or person holds power and runs a country.

definition: (Buddhism) attachment; dedicated; devoted; persistent; to persist in; to cling to
exampleSimplified: 她对音乐很执着，每天都练习好几个小时。
exampleTraditional: 她對音樂很執著，每天都練習好幾個小時。
exampleEnglish: She is very devoted to music and practices for several hours every day.
hintSimplified: 形容人对某件事坚持到底，不轻易改变或放弃。
hintTraditional: 形容人對某件事堅持到底，不輕易改變或放棄。
hintEnglish: Describes a person who sticks to something firmly and does not easily change or give up.

gloss: to have no alternative but to; to be obliged to
definition: to have no alternative but to; to be obliged to
exampleSimplified: 因为下大雨，我们只得取消明天的活动。
exampleTraditional: 因為下大雨，我們只得取消明天的活動。
exampleEnglish: Because of heavy rain, we have no choice but to cancel tomorrow's event.
hintSimplified: 副词，表示没有别的办法，只好这样做。
hintTraditional: 副詞，表示沒有別的辦法，只好這樣做。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning there is no other way, so one has to do it this way.

definition: (computing) pointer; (production) target; quota; index; indicator; sign; signpost
exampleSimplified: 公司今年的销售指标比去年高很多。
exampleTraditional: 公司今年的銷售指標比去年高很多。
exampleEnglish: The company's sales target this year is much higher than last year's.
hintSimplified: 用来衡量或要求达到的数字目标。
hintTraditional: 用來衡量或要求達到的數字目標。
hintEnglish: A numerical figure used to measure or to set as a goal to reach.

definition: to censure; to give directions; to indicate; to pick at; to point out; to show how (to do sth)
exampleSimplified: 谢谢老师的指点，我知道该怎么改了。
exampleTraditional: 謝謝老師的指點，我知道該怎麼改了。
exampleEnglish: Thanks to the teacher's guidance, I know how to revise it now.
hintSimplified: 有经验的人告诉你方法，帮你找到方向。
hintTraditional: 有經驗的人告訴你方法，幫你找到方向。
hintEnglish: When an experienced person shows you the method and helps you find direction.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; conductor (of an orchestra); to command; to conduct; to direct
exampleSimplified: 乐团的指挥站在前面，双手慢慢抬起来。
exampleTraditional: 樂團的指揮站在前面，雙手慢慢抬起來。
exampleEnglish: The orchestra's conductor stood at the front and slowly raised both hands.
hintSimplified: 带领乐团演奏的人，或者发出命令让大家行动。
hintTraditional: 帶領樂團演奏的人，或者發出命令讓大家行動。
hintEnglish: The person who leads an orchestra's performance, or the act of giving orders so people act.

exampleSimplified: 他否认了所有对他的指控。
exampleTraditional: 他否認了所有對他的指控。
exampleEnglish: He denied all the charges against him.
hintSimplified: 公开说某人做了坏事或犯了法。
hintTraditional: 公開說某人做了壞事或犯了法。
hintEnglish: To publicly say that someone did something wrong or broke the law.

exampleSimplified: 今天股市的指数下跌了很多。
exampleTraditional: 今天股市的指數下跌了很多。
exampleEnglish: The stock market index dropped a lot today.
hintSimplified: 用来表示经济或其他情况变化程度的数字。
hintTraditional: 用來表示經濟或其他情況變化程度的數字。
hintEnglish: A number used to show how much the economy or another situation has changed.

definition: prospect; hope; to count on; to hope for
exampleSimplified: 你不要指望别人天天帮你做事。
exampleTraditional: 你不要指望別人天天幫你做事。
exampleEnglish: Don't count on others to help you with things every day.
hintSimplified: 把希望放在某人或某事上，相信它会实现。
hintTraditional: 把希望放在某人或某事上，相信它會實現。
hintEnglish: To place your hope on someone or something, trusting it will come true.

definition: fingerprint; the arches, loops and whorls on the fingers
exampleSimplified: 警察在桌子上找到了他的指纹。
exampleTraditional: 警察在桌子上找到了他的指紋。
exampleEnglish: The police found his fingerprints on the table.
hintSimplified: 手指末端的纹路，每个人都不一样。
hintTraditional: 手指末端的紋路，每個人都不一樣。
hintEnglish: The patterns on the tips of the fingers, different for every person.

definition: directions; guidance; guidelines; to guide; to point (the way); to show
exampleSimplified: 请按照路上的指引走，就能找到出口。
exampleTraditional: 請按照路上的指引走，就能找到出口。
exampleEnglish: Please follow the directions on the road and you will find the exit.
hintSimplified: 告诉你方向或方法，让你知道怎么走或怎么做。
hintTraditional: 告訴你方向或方法，讓你知道怎麼走或怎麼做。
hintEnglish: Telling you the way or method so you know where to go or what to do.

definition: criticism; to comment; to point out mistakes or weak points for correction
exampleSimplified: 这是我的第一篇文章，请大家多多指正。
exampleTraditional: 這是我的第一篇文章，請大家多多指正。
exampleEnglish: This is my first article; please give me your corrections and feedback.
hintSimplified: 客气地请别人看看，并告诉你哪里有错。
hintTraditional: 客氣地請別人看看，並告訴你哪裡有錯。
hintEnglish: A polite way to ask others to look it over and tell you where the mistakes are.

definition: so far; to this day; until now
exampleSimplified: 这件事发生在十年前，至今我还记得很清楚。
exampleTraditional: 這件事發生在十年前，至今我還記得很清楚。
exampleEnglish: This happened ten years ago, and I still remember it clearly to this day.
hintSimplified: 从过去某个时候一直到现在。
hintTraditional: 從過去某個時候一直到現在。
hintEnglish: From some point in the past all the way up to now.

exampleSimplified: 这个地区的治安很好，晚上也很安全。
exampleTraditional: 這個地區的治安很好，晚上也很安全。
exampleEnglish: Public security in this area is very good, and it's safe even at night.
hintSimplified: 指社会上有没有犯罪，人们生活是否安全稳定。
hintTraditional: 指社會上有沒有犯罪，人們生活是否安全穩定。
hintEnglish: Whether a society has little crime and people's lives are safe and stable.

gloss: to tackle a problem at its root; to effect a permanent solution (contrasted with 治標|治标[zhi4 biao1])
definition: to tackle a problem at its root; to effect a permanent solution (contrasted with 治標|治标[zhi4 biao1])
exampleSimplified: 想解决交通问题，必须从治本做起。
exampleTraditional: 想解決交通問題，必須從治本做起。
exampleEnglish: To solve the traffic problem, we must start by tackling the root cause.
hintSimplified: 解决问题时，找出根本原因并彻底处理。
hintTraditional: 解決問題時，找出根本原因並徹底處理。
hintEnglish: When solving a problem, finding the fundamental cause and dealing with it thoroughly.

gloss: to treat only the symptoms but not the root cause
definition: to treat only the symptoms but not the root cause
exampleSimplified: 吃药只能治标，想健康还是要多运动。
exampleTraditional: 吃藥只能治標，想健康還是要多運動。
exampleEnglish: Medicine only treats the symptoms; to be healthy you still need to exercise more.
hintSimplified: 只处理表面的问题，没有解决根本原因。
hintTraditional: 只處理表面的問題，沒有解決根本原因。
hintEnglish: Dealing only with surface problems without solving the underlying cause.

definition: governance; to administer; to control; to govern; to manage
exampleSimplified: 政府正在努力治理空气污染问题。
exampleTraditional: 政府正在努力治理空氣汙染問題。
exampleEnglish: The government is working hard to manage the air pollution problem.
hintSimplified: 政府或组织管理国家、城市或环境问题的方式。
hintTraditional: 政府或組織管理國家、城市或環境問題的方式。
hintEnglish: The way a government or organization manages a country, city or environmental problem.

definition: medical treatment; therapy; to treat (an illness)
exampleSimplified: 医生说他的病需要长期治疗。
exampleTraditional: 醫生說他的病需要長期治療。
exampleEnglish: The doctor said his illness needs long-term treatment.
hintSimplified: 生病的人在医院里接受药物或手术,希望恢复健康。
hintTraditional: 生病的人在醫院裡接受藥物或手術,希望恢復健康。
hintEnglish: What a sick person receives at the hospital with medicine or surgery, hoping to recover.

exampleSimplified: 他们志趣相投,所以成了好朋友。
exampleTraditional: 他們志趣相投,所以成了好朋友。
exampleEnglish: They share the same interests and aspirations, so they became good friends.
hintSimplified: 一个人心里喜欢和追求的方向,朋友之间如果相同就容易合得来。
hintTraditional: 一個人心裡喜歡和追求的方向,朋友之間如果相同就容易合得來。
hintEnglish: The direction a person likes and pursues in their heart; friends who share it get along easily.

exampleSimplified: 他从小就有当医生的志向。
exampleTraditional: 他從小就有當醫生的志向。
exampleEnglish: Since childhood he has had the ambition to become a doctor.
hintSimplified: 一个人想在将来做到的远大目标或理想。
hintTraditional: 一個人想在將來做到的遠大目標或理想。
hintEnglish: A person's great goal or ideal for what to achieve in the future.

gloss: variant of 致辭|致辞[zhi4 ci2]
definition: variant of 致辭|致辞[zhi4 ci2]
exampleSimplified: 校长在毕业典礼上致词。
exampleTraditional: 校長在畢業典禮上致詞。
exampleEnglish: The principal gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.
hintSimplified: 在婚礼或典礼等场合,站在台上正式讲几句话。
hintTraditional: 在婚禮或典禮等場合,站在臺上正式講幾句話。
hintEnglish: Standing on stage at a wedding or ceremony to formally say a few words.

exampleSimplified: 很多人希望通过努力工作来致富。
exampleTraditional: 很多人希望透過努力工作來致富。
exampleEnglish: Many people hope to become wealthy through hard work.
hintSimplified: 从没有钱变成很有钱的过程。
hintTraditional: 從沒有錢變成很有錢的過程。
hintEnglish: The process of going from having little money to having a lot.

gloss: to devote oneself to; to work toward (often followed by 於|于[yu2])
definition: to devote oneself to; to work toward (often followed by 於|于[yu2])
exampleSimplified: 他一生致力于教育工作。
exampleTraditional: 他一生致力於教育工作。
exampleEnglish: He devoted his whole life to education.
hintSimplified: 把自己的时间和精力都用在某件事上,常和“于”一起用。
hintTraditional: 把自己的時間和精力都用在某件事上,常和“於”一起用。
hintEnglish: To put all your time and energy into something; often used with the character 于.

definition: deadly; fatal; mortal; to sacrifice one's life
exampleSimplified: 这种病毒对老人来说可能是致命的。
exampleTraditional: 這種病毒對老人來說可能是致命的。
exampleEnglish: This virus can be deadly for the elderly.
hintSimplified: 形容非常危险,可能让人失去生命。
hintTraditional: 形容非常危險,可能讓人失去生命。
hintEnglish: Describes something so dangerous that it may cost a person's life.

definition: to devote attention to; to send one's greetings; to send one's best regards
exampleSimplified: 他向在场的客人点头致意。
exampleTraditional: 他向在場的客人點頭致意。
exampleEnglish: He nodded in greeting to the guests present.
hintSimplified: 用点头、挥手或简短的话向别人表示问候和敬意。
hintTraditional: 用點頭、揮手或簡短的話向別人表示問候和敬意。
hintEnglish: To show greeting and respect to others with a nod, a wave or a few words.

exampleSimplified: 阅读可以帮助孩子发展智力。
exampleTraditional: 閱讀可以幫助孩子發展智力。
exampleEnglish: Reading can help children develop their intelligence.
hintSimplified: 一个人思考、理解和学习的能力。
hintTraditional: 一個人思考、理解和學習的能力。
hintEnglish: A person's ability to think, understand and learn.

exampleSimplified: 这家公司因为违法而受到制裁。
exampleTraditional: 這家公司因為違法而受到制裁。
exampleEnglish: The company was sanctioned for breaking the law.
hintSimplified: 对做错事或违反规定的人、公司或国家给予的惩罚。
hintTraditional: 對做錯事或違反規定的人、公司或國家給予的懲罰。
hintEnglish: Punishment given to a person, company or country that broke rules.

exampleSimplified: 这家工厂主要生产塑料制品。
exampleTraditional: 這家工廠主要生產塑膠製品。
exampleEnglish: This factory mainly produces plastic products.
hintSimplified: 用某种材料在工厂里做出来的东西。
hintTraditional: 用某種材料在工廠裡做出來的東西。
hintEnglish: Things made from a certain material in a factory.

gloss: (of a person) to remain in (a place) (due to circumstances that prevent one leaving); to be stranded
definition: (of a person) to remain in (a place) (due to circumstances that prevent one leaving); to be stranded; (of sth that would typically dissipate, e.g. floodwater, pollutants) to remain; to linger
exampleSimplified: 大雪让许多旅客滞留在机场。
exampleTraditional: 大雪讓許多旅客滯留在機場。
exampleEnglish: The heavy snow left many travelers stranded at the airport.
hintSimplified: 因为天气或意外,想走却不能离开某个地方。
hintTraditional: 因為天氣或意外,想走卻不能離開某個地方。
hintEnglish: Wanting to leave a place but unable to because of weather or an accident.

definition: to break off; to cut short; to discontinue; to interrupt
exampleSimplified: 网络突然中断,会议没办法继续。
exampleTraditional: 網路突然中斷,會議沒辦法繼續。
exampleEnglish: The internet suddenly cut out, and the meeting couldn't continue.
hintSimplified: 正在进行的事情在中途停下来,不再继续。
hintTraditional: 正在進行的事情在中途停下來,不再繼續。
hintEnglish: Something in progress stops midway and does not continue.

gloss: Zhonghe or Chungho city in New Taipei City 新北市[Xin1 bei3 shi4], Taiwan
definition: Zhonghe or Chungho city in New Taipei City 新北市[Xin1 bei3 shi4], Taiwan; neutralization (chemistry); to counteract; to neutralize
exampleSimplified: 我朋友住在新北市的中和。
exampleTraditional: 我朋友住在新北市的中和。
exampleEnglish: My friend lives in Zhonghe in New Taipei City.
hintSimplified: 台湾北部一个在大城市旁边的区,人口很多,有捷运经过。
hintTraditional: 台灣北部一個在大城市旁邊的區,人口很多,有捷運經過。
hintEnglish: A densely populated district in northern Taiwan next to a big city, served by the metro.

exampleSimplified: 在这场争论中,他保持中立。
exampleTraditional: 在這場爭論中,他保持中立。
exampleEnglish: In this argument, he stayed neutral.
hintSimplified: 不支持任何一边,对双方都公平。
hintTraditional: 不支援任何一邊,對雙方都公平。
hintEnglish: Not supporting either side, being fair to both.

exampleSimplified: 我们打算在三月中旬去日本旅行。
exampleTraditional: 我們打算在三月中旬去日本旅行。
exampleEnglish: We plan to travel to Japan in mid-March.
hintSimplified: 一个月里大约十一号到二十号的那段时间。
hintTraditional: 一個月裡大約十一號到二十號的那段時間。
hintEnglish: The period of a month from about the 11th to the 20th.

exampleSimplified: 这座老房子建于十九世纪中叶。
exampleTraditional: 這座老房子建於十九世紀中葉。
exampleEnglish: This old house was built in the middle of the 19th century.
hintSimplified: 指一个世纪中间的那段时期。
hintTraditional: 指一個世紀中間的那段時期。
hintEnglish: The middle period of a century.

gloss: a doctor trained in Chinese medicine
definition: a doctor trained in Chinese medicine; traditional Chinese medical science
exampleSimplified: 奶奶感冒的时候喜欢看中医。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶感冒的時候喜歡看中醫。
exampleEnglish: When Grandma has a cold, she likes to see a traditional Chinese medicine doctor.
hintSimplified: 用把脉、草药和针灸帮人治病的医生。
hintTraditional: 用把脈、草藥和針灸幫人治病的醫生。
hintEnglish: A doctor who treats people with pulse-taking, herbs and acupuncture.

definition: (literary) (of person) mediocre; golden mean (Confucianism); ordinary; the Doctrine of the Mean, one of the Four Books 四書|四书[Si4 shu1]
exampleSimplified: 他的想法很中庸,从来不走极端。
exampleTraditional: 他的想法很中庸,從來不走極端。
exampleEnglish: His thinking is moderate; he never goes to extremes.
hintSimplified: 形容态度或做法不偏向任何一边,不极端,也有普通平庸的意思。
hintTraditional: 形容態度或做法不偏向任何一邊,不極端,也有普通平庸的意思。
hintEnglish: Describes an attitude that leans to neither side and is not extreme; also can mean ordinary.

exampleSimplified: 这只狗对主人非常忠实。
exampleTraditional: 這隻狗對主人非常忠實。
exampleEnglish: This dog is very faithful to its owner.
hintSimplified: 形容人或动物一直真心对待别人,不会背叛。
hintTraditional: 形容人或動物一直真心對待別人,不會背叛。
hintEnglish: Describes a person or animal that is always sincere toward others and never betrays them.

exampleSimplified: 我衷心感谢大家的帮助。
exampleTraditional: 我衷心感謝大家的幫助。
exampleEnglish: I sincerely thank everyone for their help.
hintSimplified: 表示感情从心里发出来,非常真诚。
hintTraditional: 表示感情從心裡發出來,非常真誠。
hintEnglish: Expresses feelings that come from deep in the heart, very sincere.

gloss: end (of a performance or sports match)
definition: end (of a performance or sports match); last round of testing in the imperial examinations
exampleSimplified: 终场哨声一响,球迷们都欢呼起来。
exampleTraditional: 終場哨聲一響,球迷們都歡呼起來。
exampleEnglish: When the final whistle blew, the fans all cheered.
hintSimplified: 比赛或表演最后结束的时候。
hintTraditional: 比賽或表演最後結束的時候。
hintEnglish: The moment when a match or performance finally ends.

definition: end; conclusion; to come to an end; to terminate (sth)
exampleSimplified: 这场战争终于走向了终结。
exampleTraditional: 這場戰爭終於走向了終結。
exampleEnglish: The war finally came to an end.
hintSimplified: 一件事情或一段时期完全结束。
hintTraditional: 一件事情或一段時期完全結束。
hintEnglish: A matter or period comes to a complete close.

gloss: in the end; after all; eventually
definition: in the end; after all; eventually
exampleSimplified: 孩子终究要长大,父母不能照顾他一辈子。
exampleTraditional: 孩子終究要長大,父母不能照顧他一輩子。
exampleEnglish: Children will grow up after all; parents can't take care of them forever.
hintSimplified: 副词,表示经过各种情况之后,结果还是这样,带有强调的语气。
hintTraditional: 副詞,表示經過各種情況之後,結果還是這樣,帶有強調的語氣。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning that despite everything, the result is still this; used for emphasis.

exampleSimplified: 他一辈子没结婚,终身都在照顾那些孤儿。
exampleTraditional: 他一輩子沒結婚,終身都在照顧那些孤兒。
exampleEnglish: He never married and devoted his whole life to caring for orphans.
hintSimplified: 从出生到去世的整段时间,常和大事或职业一起用。
hintTraditional: 從出生到去世的整段時間,常和大事或職業一起用。
hintEnglish: The whole span from birth to death, often used with big matters or careers.

exampleSimplified: 由于种种原因,这次旅行只好取消了。
exampleTraditional: 由於種種原因,這次旅行只好取消了。
exampleEnglish: For various reasons, we had to cancel this trip.
hintSimplified: 表示各式各样、很多不同的,常放在“原因”前面。
hintTraditional: 表示各式各樣、很多不同的,常放在“原因”前面。
hintEnglish: Means many different kinds; often placed before “reasons”.

gloss: to plant; to grow (a crop); to cultivate
definition: to plant; to grow (a crop); to cultivate
exampleSimplified: 这里的农民大多种植茶叶和水果。
exampleTraditional: 這裡的農民大多種植茶葉和水果。
exampleEnglish: Most farmers here grow tea and fruit.
hintSimplified: 农民把种子放进土里,让作物长大,这样的工作。
hintTraditional: 農民把種子放進土裡,讓作物長大,這樣的工作。
hintEnglish: What farmers do when they put seeds in soil and raise crops.

exampleSimplified: 爷爷去年中风以后,右手就不太灵活了。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺去年中風以後,右手就不太靈活了。
exampleEnglish: Since grandpa had a stroke last year, his right hand hasn't been very agile.
hintSimplified: 血管出问题,让人突然身体一边不能动的严重疾病。
hintTraditional: 血管出問題,讓人突然身體一邊不能動的嚴重疾病。
hintEnglish: A serious illness where blood vessels fail and one side of the body suddenly can't move.

gloss: to win a prize (in a lottery etc)
definition: to win a prize (in a lottery etc)
exampleSimplified: 他买的彩票中奖了,高兴得跳了起来。
exampleTraditional: 他買的彩票中獎了,高興得跳了起來。
exampleEnglish: His lottery ticket won a prize, and he jumped for joy.
hintSimplified: 买彩票或抽奖时,运气很好,得到奖品或奖金。
hintTraditional: 買彩票或抽獎時,運氣很好,得到獎品或獎金。
hintEnglish: When you're lucky in a lottery or raffle and get a prize or money.

exampleSimplified: 老师对我的作文提出了很中肯的意见。
exampleTraditional: 老師對我的作文提出了很中肯的意見。
exampleEnglish: The teacher gave very pertinent comments on my essay.
hintSimplified: 形容话或意见说到重点,很实在、很准确。
hintTraditional: 形容話或意見說到重點,很實在、很準確。
hintEnglish: Describes words or opinions that hit the key point, honest and accurate.

definition: sunstroke; heatstroke; to suffer heat exhaustion
exampleSimplified: 夏天在太阳下运动太久,很容易中暑。
exampleTraditional: 夏天在太陽下運動太久,很容易中暑。
exampleEnglish: In summer, exercising too long in the sun makes it easy to get heatstroke.
hintSimplified: 天气太热,人头晕、不舒服,甚至昏倒的病。
hintTraditional: 天氣太熱,人頭暈、不舒服,甚至昏倒的病。
hintEnglish: Illness from very hot weather, making you dizzy, unwell, or even faint.

gloss: to put in an important position
definition: to put in an important position
exampleSimplified: 老板很欣赏他,打算重用他做部门经理。
exampleTraditional: 老闆很欣賞他,打算重用他做部門經理。
exampleEnglish: The boss appreciates him and plans to give him an important role as department manager.
hintSimplified: 上司相信某人的能力,把重要的工作交给他。
hintTraditional: 上司相信某人的能力,把重要的工作交給他。
hintEnglish: A superior trusts someone's ability and gives them important responsibilities.

gloss: (fig.) major center (for commerce, culture or tourism etc)
definition: (fig.) major center (for commerce, culture or tourism etc); (military) strategic town
exampleSimplified: 这座城市自古就是西南地区的经济重镇。
exampleTraditional: 這座城市自古就是西南地區的經濟重鎮。
exampleEnglish: This city has been an economic hub of the southwest since ancient times.
hintSimplified: 在某个地区很重要的城市,可能是商业或文化的中心。
hintTraditional: 在某個地區很重要的城市,可能是商業或文化的中心。
hintEnglish: An important city in a region, perhaps a center of commerce or culture.

definition: (computing) (attributive) peripheral; merch (abbr. for 周邊商品|周边商品[zhou1 bian1 shang1 pin3]); periphery; rim; perimeter; surroundings
exampleSimplified: 这家商店周边有很多好吃的小吃店。
exampleTraditional: 這家商店周邊有很多好吃的小吃店。
exampleEnglish: There are many good snack shops around this store.
hintSimplified: 某个地方附近的一圈地区;电脑旁边的设备也可以这样说。
hintTraditional: 某個地方附近的一圈地區;電腦旁邊的裝置也可以這樣說。
hintEnglish: The area close around a place; also used for accessories attached to a computer.

exampleSimplified: 出发前,他做了一份非常周密的旅行计划。
exampleTraditional: 出發前,他做了一份非常周密的旅行計劃。
exampleEnglish: Before leaving, he made a very thorough travel plan.
hintSimplified: 形容计划或想法考虑得很仔细,没有漏洞。
hintTraditional: 形容計劃或想法考慮得很仔細,沒有漏洞。
hintEnglish: Describes a plan or thought that is carefully considered, with no gaps.

exampleSimplified: 这份说明书写得很周详,每个步骤都有图。
exampleTraditional: 這份說明書寫得很周詳,每個步驟都有圖。
