hintTraditional: 警察跟在逃跑的人後面，想把他抓住。
hintEnglish: The police follow a fleeing person, trying to catch him.

gloss: to try to find out; to trace; to track down
definition: to try to find out; to trace; to track down
exampleSimplified: 公司正在追查这笔钱的去向。
exampleTraditional: 公司正在追查這筆錢的去向。
exampleEnglish: The company is tracing where this money went.
hintSimplified: 顺着线索一步一步调查，想找出真相或来源。
hintTraditional: 順著線索一步一步調查，想找出真相或來源。
hintEnglish: To follow clues step by step to find the truth or the source.

exampleSimplified: 这次事故的责任一定要追究到底。
exampleTraditional: 這次事故的責任一定要追究到底。
exampleEnglish: Responsibility for this accident must be investigated to the end.
hintSimplified: 对出了问题的事，深入调查原因，要有人负责。
hintTraditional: 對出了問題的事，深入調查原因，要有人負責。
hintEnglish: To dig deeply into a problem's cause and hold someone responsible.

exampleSimplified: 诚实是做人最基本的准则。
exampleTraditional: 誠實是做人最基本的準則。
exampleEnglish: Honesty is the most basic principle of how to behave.
hintSimplified: 大家做事或判断时依照的标准和原则。
hintTraditional: 大家做事或判斷時依照的標準和原則。
hintEnglish: The standards and principles people follow when acting or judging.

definition: to allow; to grant; to permit
exampleSimplified: 老师不准许学生在考试时看手机。
exampleTraditional: 老師不准許學生在考試時看手機。
exampleEnglish: The teacher does not allow students to look at their phones during the exam.
hintSimplified: 同意别人去做某件事，说可以。
hintTraditional: 同意別人去做某件事，說可以。
hintEnglish: To agree that someone may do something; to say it is okay.

exampleSimplified: 这位科学家为社会做出了卓越的贡献。
exampleTraditional: 這位科學家為社會做出了卓越的貢獻。
exampleEnglish: This scientist made outstanding contributions to society.
hintSimplified: 形容成就或能力非常好，比一般人高得多。
hintTraditional: 形容成就或能力非常好，比一般人高得多。
hintEnglish: Describes achievements or ability far better than most people's.

gloss: to put one's hand to it
definition: to put one's hand to it; to set out; to start out on a task
exampleSimplified: 我们应该马上着手准备明天的会议。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該馬上著手準備明天的會議。
exampleEnglish: We should start preparing for tomorrow's meeting right away.
hintSimplified: 开始做一件事情，从某个地方先动手。
hintTraditional: 開始做一件事情，從某個地方先動手。
hintEnglish: To begin doing something, starting with a first step.

definition: having sth in mind; to concentrate; to have one's eyes on (a goal)
exampleSimplified: 做计划时，要着眼于长远的发展。
exampleTraditional: 做計劃時，要著眼於長遠的發展。
exampleEnglish: When making plans, you should focus on long-term development.
hintSimplified: 思考问题时，把注意力放在某一个角度或目标上。
hintTraditional: 思考問題時，把注意力放在某一個角度或目標上。
hintEnglish: When thinking, to fix your attention on a particular angle or goal.

gloss: to put emphasis on; to stress
definition: to put emphasis on; to stress
exampleSimplified: 这堂课着重讲解语法的用法。
exampleTraditional: 這堂課著重講解語法的用法。
exampleEnglish: This class focuses on explaining how grammar is used.
hintSimplified: 在许多内容中，特别重视其中一部分。
hintTraditional: 在許多內容中，特別重視其中一部分。
hintEnglish: Among many things, to give special importance to one part.

definition: to allow for; to consider; to measure (food and drink); to use one's discretion
exampleSimplified: 老师会酌量给学生加分。
exampleTraditional: 老師會酌量給學生加分。
exampleEnglish: The teacher will add points for students at his discretion.
hintSimplified: 根据实际情况来考虑，决定多一点还是少一点。
hintTraditional: 根據實際情況來考慮，決定多一點還是少一點。
hintEnglish: To consider the situation and decide on a bit more or a bit less.

exampleSimplified: 她是公司里一位资深的工程师。
exampleTraditional: 她是公司裡一位資深的工程師。
exampleEnglish: She is a veteran engineer at the company.
hintSimplified: 形容在某个行业工作很多年、经验很丰富的人。
hintTraditional: 形容在某個行業工作很多年、經驗很豐富的人。
hintEnglish: Describes someone with many years of rich experience in a field.

definition: subsidy; to provide financial aid; to subsidize
exampleSimplified: 基金会资助了很多贫穷的学生上大学。
exampleTraditional: 基金會資助了很多貧窮的學生上大學。
exampleEnglish: The foundation financially supported many poor students to attend university.
hintSimplified: 用钱帮助别人完成学业或事业。
hintTraditional: 用錢幫助別人完成學業或事業。
hintEnglish: To help others with money so they can finish studies or a project.

exampleSimplified: 你坐着的姿势不对，会让背很痛。
exampleTraditional: 你坐著的姿勢不對，會讓背很痛。
exampleEnglish: Your sitting posture is wrong and will make your back hurt.
hintSimplified: 身体站着、坐着或做动作时的样子。
hintTraditional: 身體站著、坐著或做動作時的樣子。
hintEnglish: The way the body is positioned when standing, sitting or moving.

exampleSimplified: 她以友善的姿态面对每一位客人。
exampleTraditional: 她以友善的姿態面對每一位客人。
exampleEnglish: She faces every guest with a friendly manner.
hintSimplified: 人的样子或对待别人、事情时表现出来的态度。
hintTraditional: 人的樣子或對待別人、事情時表現出來的態度。
hintEnglish: A person's bearing or the manner shown toward others or a matter.

exampleSimplified: 一个人在国外生活，那种滋味不好受。
exampleTraditional: 一個人在國外生活，那種滋味不好受。
exampleEnglish: Living abroad alone is not an easy feeling to bear.
hintSimplified: 吃东西时的味道，也指经历某事时心里的感受。
hintTraditional: 吃東西時的味道，也指經歷某事時心裡的感受。
hintEnglish: The taste of food, also the inner feeling of going through something.

exampleSimplified: 警察在现场找到了一颗子弹。
exampleTraditional: 警察在現場找到了一顆子彈。
exampleEnglish: The police found a bullet at the scene.
hintSimplified: 枪里射出去的小小金属东西。
hintTraditional: 槍裡射出去的小小金屬東西。
hintEnglish: The small metal thing fired out of a gun.

exampleSimplified: 这所学校的学生大多是农村子弟。
exampleTraditional: 這所學校的學生大多是農村子弟。
exampleEnglish: Most students at this school are children from rural families.
hintSimplified: 指某个家庭、地方或群体里的年轻后辈。
hintTraditional: 指某個家庭、地方或群體裡的年輕後輩。
hintEnglish: The younger generation of a certain family, place or group.

exampleSimplified: 他希望留下好环境给子孙。
exampleTraditional: 他希望留下好環境給子孫。
exampleEnglish: He hopes to leave a good environment for his descendants.
hintSimplified: 儿子、孙子等，一代一代往下传的家人。
hintTraditional: 兒子、孫子等，一代一代往下傳的家人。
hintEnglish: Sons, grandsons and so on; the family members passed down through generations.

definition: to call oneself; to claim a title; to claim to be; to profess
exampleSimplified: 他自称是这家公司的老板，可是没有人相信。
exampleTraditional: 他自稱是這家公司的老闆，可是沒有人相信。
exampleEnglish: He claims to be the boss of this company, but nobody believes him.
hintSimplified: 自己说自己是某种人或有某种身份，但不一定是真的。
hintTraditional: 自己說自己是某種人或有某種身份，但不一定是真的。
hintEnglish: To say that you yourself are a certain kind of person or have a certain status, though it may not be true.

exampleSimplified: 这次出国学习的费用是我自费的，公司没有补助。
exampleTraditional: 這次出國學習的費用是我自費的，公司沒有補助。
exampleEnglish: I paid for this study trip abroad myself; the company gave no subsidy.
hintSimplified: 钱不是别人给的，而是由自己出。
hintTraditional: 錢不是別人給的，而是由自己出。
hintEnglish: The money isn't provided by someone else; you pay it out of your own pocket.

exampleSimplified: 看到孩子拿到奖，父母都感到非常自豪。
exampleTraditional: 看到孩子拿到獎，父母都感到非常自豪。
exampleEnglish: Seeing their child win the prize, the parents felt very proud.
hintSimplified: 对自己或自己人的成就感到光荣、很满意的心情。
hintTraditional: 對自己或自己人的成就感到光榮、很滿意的心情。
hintEnglish: The feeling of honor and satisfaction about your own or your people's achievements.

gloss: responsible; predisposed to do the right thing; considerate of others
definition: responsible; predisposed to do the right thing; considerate of others; to realize; to be aware of; to feel that; to be conscious of (sth relating to oneself)
exampleSimplified: 他很自觉，不用老师提醒就会按时交作业。
exampleTraditional: 他很自覺，不用老師提醒就會按時交作業。
exampleEnglish: He is very self-disciplined and hands in homework on time without the teacher reminding him.
hintSimplified: 不用别人提醒或管，自己就知道该做什么。
hintTraditional: 不用別人提醒或管，自己就知道該做什麼。
hintEnglish: Knowing by yourself what should be done, without anyone reminding or supervising you.

definition: independent; self-reliant; self-sustaining; to stand on one's own feet; to support oneself
exampleSimplified: 大学毕业以后，他搬出去住，开始学着自立。
exampleTraditional: 大學畢業以後，他搬出去住，開始學著自立。
exampleEnglish: After graduating from university, he moved out and started learning to be independent.
hintSimplified: 不再靠父母或别人，自己养活自己。
hintTraditional: 不再靠父母或別人，自己養活自己。
hintEnglish: No longer relying on parents or others; supporting yourself.

exampleSimplified: 取得一点成绩就自满，是不会进步的。
exampleTraditional: 取得一點成績就自滿，是不會進步的。
exampleEnglish: If you become complacent after a little success, you won't make progress.
hintSimplified: 对自己已有的成绩太满意，不想再努力。
hintTraditional: 對自己已有的成績太滿意，不想再努力。
hintEnglish: Being too pleased with what you have achieved, so you no longer want to work harder.

exampleSimplified: 这个问题的原因不在别人，而在我们自身。
exampleTraditional: 這個問題的原因不在別人，而在我們自身。
exampleEnglish: The cause of this problem lies not in others but in ourselves.
hintSimplified: 指事物或人本来的样子，不包括外面的其他东西。
hintTraditional: 指事物或人本來的樣子，不包括外面的其他東西。
hintEnglish: Refers to a person or thing on its own, not including anything external.

exampleSimplified: 会议结束后，大家可以自行离开。
exampleTraditional: 會議結束後，大家可以自行離開。
exampleEnglish: After the meeting ends, everyone may leave on their own.
hintSimplified: 副词，表示由自己决定、自己去做，不需要别人安排。
hintTraditional: 副詞，表示由自己決定、自己去做，不需要別人安排。
hintEnglish: An adverb meaning to do something on one's own initiative, without arrangement by others.

definition: handmade; homemade; improvised; self-control; self-made; to maintain self-control
exampleSimplified: 这瓶果酱是妈妈自制的，一点也不贵。
exampleTraditional: 這瓶果醬是媽媽自制的，一點也不貴。
exampleEnglish: This jar of jam is homemade by my mom and not expensive at all.
hintSimplified: 不是从店里买的，而是自己动手做出来的。
hintTraditional: 不是從店裡買的，而是自己動手做出來的。
hintEnglish: Not bought in a store, but made by your own hands.

exampleSimplified: 这个地区有高度的自治权，可以决定很多事情。
exampleTraditional: 這個地區有高度的自治權，可以決定很多事情。
exampleEnglish: This region has a high degree of autonomy and can decide many matters.
hintSimplified: 一个地区或团体自己管理自己的事务。
hintTraditional: 一個地區或團體自己管理自己的事務。
hintEnglish: A region or group managing its own affairs.

exampleSimplified: 我最近读了一本名人写的自传，很受感动。
exampleTraditional: 我最近讀了一本名人寫的自傳，很受感動。
exampleEnglish: I recently read a famous person's autobiography and was very moved.
hintSimplified: 一个人亲自写下自己一生经历的书。
hintTraditional: 一個人親自寫下自己一生經歷的書。
hintEnglish: A book in which a person personally writes about the experiences of their own life.

exampleSimplified: 这份海报用了很特别的字体，看起来很漂亮。
exampleTraditional: 這份海報用了很特別的字體，看起來很漂亮。
exampleEnglish: This poster uses a very special font and looks beautiful.
hintSimplified: 文字写出来或印出来的样式，例如楷书、宋体。
hintTraditional: 文字寫出來或印出來的樣式，例如楷書、宋體。
hintEnglish: The style in which writing is written or printed, such as regular script or Song style.

exampleSimplified: 写文章时要小心选择字眼，免得让人误会。
exampleTraditional: 寫文章時要小心選擇字眼，免得讓人誤會。
exampleEnglish: When writing an essay, choose your wording carefully so people don't misunderstand.
hintSimplified: 说话或写文章时选用的词语。
hintTraditional: 說話或寫文章時選用的詞語。
hintEnglish: The words and expressions chosen when speaking or writing.

gloss: characters, words or short phrase appearing on sth
definition: characters, words or short phrase appearing on sth; standard written form of a character
exampleSimplified: 包装上印着“请勿微波”的字样。
exampleTraditional: 包裝上印著“請勿微波”的字樣。
exampleEnglish: The packaging has the words "Do not microwave" printed on it.
hintSimplified: 印或写在东西上面的一小段文字。
hintTraditional: 印或寫在東西上面的一小段文字。
hintEnglish: A short piece of text printed or written on the surface of something.

exampleSimplified: 这个社团的宗旨是帮助需要的人。
exampleTraditional: 這個社團的宗旨是幫助需要的人。
exampleEnglish: The aim of this club is to help people in need.
hintSimplified: 一个团体或组织主要的目的和原则。
hintTraditional: 一個團體或組織主要的目的和原則。
hintEnglish: The main purpose and principle of a group or organization.

exampleSimplified: 新来的总裁在会议上宣布了公司的计划。
exampleTraditional: 新來的總裁在會議上宣佈了公司的計劃。
exampleEnglish: The new president announced the company's plans at the meeting.
hintSimplified: 大公司里地位非常高、负责最后决定的人。
hintTraditional: 大公司裡地位非常高、負責最後決定的人。
hintEnglish: A person of very high rank in a large company who makes the final decisions.

definition: be bound to; have to; must
exampleSimplified: 你病了，总得去看医生才会好。
exampleTraditional: 你病了，總得去看醫生才會好。
exampleEnglish: You're sick; you've got to see a doctor to get better.
hintSimplified: 表示不管怎样一定要做，是没有别的选择的意思。
hintTraditional: 表示不管怎樣一定要做，是沒有別的選擇的意思。
hintEnglish: Expresses that something must be done no matter what, since there's no other choice.

exampleSimplified: 今年公司的销售总额比去年多了两成。
exampleTraditional: 今年公司的銷售總額比去年多了兩成。
exampleEnglish: This year the company's total sales are twenty percent higher than last year.
hintSimplified: 把所有钱加起来之后得到的全部数目。
hintTraditional: 把所有錢加起來之後得到的全部數目。
hintEnglish: The whole amount of money after adding everything together.

exampleSimplified: 这些数字的总和是一百，你算对了吗？
exampleTraditional: 這些數字的總和是一百，你算對了嗎？
exampleEnglish: The sum of these numbers is one hundred. Did you calculate it correctly?
hintSimplified: 把几个数目或东西加在一起得到的结果。
hintTraditional: 把幾個數目或東西加在一起得到的結果。
hintEnglish: The result you get by adding several numbers or things together.

definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; résumé; summary; to conclude; to sum up
exampleSimplified: 会议最后，老板为这一年的工作做了总结。
exampleTraditional: 會議最後，老闆為這一年的工作做了總結。
exampleEnglish: At the end of the meeting, the boss gave a summary of this year's work.
hintSimplified: 把做过的事整理起来，说出主要的成果和经验。
hintTraditional: 把做過的事整理起來，說出主要的成果和經驗。
hintEnglish: To gather what has been done and state the main results and lessons.

exampleSimplified: 参加比赛的人数总数超过了五百人。
exampleTraditional: 參加比賽的人數總數超過了五百人。
exampleEnglish: The total number of people in the competition exceeded five hundred.
hintSimplified: 所有数目加起来后的全部数量。
hintTraditional: 所有數目加起來後的全部數量。
hintEnglish: The entire quantity after all the numbers are added up.

definition: to commit arson; to set on fire
exampleSimplified: 警方正在调查这起纵火案的原因。
exampleTraditional: 警方正在調查這起縱火案的原因。
exampleEnglish: The police are investigating the cause of this arson case.
hintSimplified: 故意点火烧房子或东西，是犯法的行为。
hintTraditional: 故意點火燒房子或東西，是犯法的行為。
hintEnglish: Deliberately setting fire to a house or things, which is a crime.

gloss: to tolerate or condone wrongdoing; to allow (sb) to engage in bad behavior
definition: to tolerate or condone wrongdoing; to allow (sb) to engage in bad behavior
exampleSimplified: 父母不应该纵容孩子乱发脾气。
exampleTraditional: 父母不應該縱容孩子亂發脾氣。
exampleEnglish: Parents shouldn't indulge their children's temper tantrums.
hintSimplified: 对别人的错误行为不管，让他越来越随便。
hintTraditional: 對別人的錯誤行為不管，讓他越來越隨便。
hintEnglish: Not stopping someone's bad behavior, letting them get more and more out of line.

exampleSimplified: 纵使下大雨，我们也要按时出发。
exampleTraditional: 縱使下大雨，我們也要按時出發。
exampleEnglish: Even if it rains heavily, we must set out on time.
hintSimplified: 连词，用来先承认一种情况，后面再说结果不会改变。
hintTraditional: 連詞，用來先承認一種情況，後面再說結果不會改變。
hintEnglish: A conjunction that concedes a situation first, then says the result won't change.

exampleSimplified: 教室外面的走廊上站着很多学生。
exampleTraditional: 教室外面的走廊上站著很多學生。
exampleEnglish: Many students are standing in the corridor outside the classroom.
hintSimplified: 建筑物里连接各个房间的长长的通道。
hintTraditional: 建築物裡連線各個房間的長長的通道。
hintEnglish: A long passage in a building connecting the different rooms.

gloss: to rent; to lease; to hire
definition: to rent; to lease; to hire
exampleSimplified: 他们在市中心租赁了一间办公室。
exampleTraditional: 他們在市中心租賃了一間辦公室。
exampleEnglish: They leased an office in the city center.
hintSimplified: 付钱在一段时间内使用别人的房子或设备,但不是买下来。
hintTraditional: 付錢在一段時間內使用別人的房子或裝置,但不是買下來。
hintEnglish: To pay to use someone else's house or equipment for a period without buying it.

exampleSimplified: 过年的时候,我们会拜祭祖宗。
exampleTraditional: 過年的時候,我們會拜祭祖宗。
exampleEnglish: At New Year, we pay respects to our ancestors.
hintSimplified: 很多年以前的家人,比爷爷奶奶还要早的长辈。
hintTraditional: 很多年以前的家人,比爺爺奶奶還要早的長輩。
hintEnglish: Family members from many years ago, even earlier than grandparents.

definition: to obstruct; to resist; to stop
exampleSimplified: 大树倒在路上,阻挡了所有的车子。
exampleTraditional: 大樹倒在路上,阻擋了所有的車子。
exampleEnglish: A big tree fell on the road and blocked all the cars.
hintSimplified: 站在前面,让人或东西不能继续往前走。
hintTraditional: 站在前面,讓人或東西不能繼續往前走。
hintEnglish: To stand in front so that people or things cannot move forward.

exampleSimplified: 游泳的时候,水会给身体很大的阻力。
exampleTraditional: 游泳的時候,水會給身體很大的阻力。
exampleEnglish: When swimming, water creates a lot of resistance on the body.
hintSimplified: 让物体前进变慢的力量,也可以指做事时遇到的困难。
hintTraditional: 讓物體前進變慢的力量,也可以指做事時遇到的困難。
hintEnglish: A force that slows down movement, or difficulties met when doing something.

exampleSimplified: 有人故意阻挠这个计划,让它没办法进行。
exampleTraditional: 有人故意阻撓這個計劃,讓它沒辦法進行。
exampleEnglish: Someone deliberately obstructed the plan so it couldn't proceed.
hintSimplified: 故意用各种方法破坏别人的事,不让它顺利完成。
hintTraditional: 故意用各種方法破壞別人的事,不讓它順利完成。
hintEnglish: To deliberately use various ways to spoil someone's matter so it can't succeed.

exampleSimplified: 下大雨以后,马路上的交通严重阻塞。
exampleTraditional: 下大雨以後,馬路上的交通嚴重阻塞。
exampleEnglish: After the heavy rain, traffic on the road was seriously blocked.
